Overview:

 

This is the ideal role for a high caliber-marketing professional with significant success in digital campaign management who is looking to join a growing, fast-paced business. As a Digital Campaign Manager, you will be responsible for managing the successful implementation of campaign activities for several assigned markets. This role is focused on post sales fulfillment, working with a variety of teams to gather assets and launch campaigns across a wide range of platforms including display, email, social media, SEM, SEO and more. Responsibilities also include optimizing marketing campaigns, monitoring performance data to ensure campaigns are running properly, and communicating the results to clients on a regular basis.

Responsibilities

What You'll Do:

  • Accountable for ownership of the post-sale process, ensuring full and complete delivery of all digital campaigns, including but not limited to order entry, fulfillment, optimization, and reporting.
  • Account Management: You will work with sales teams and digital clients to support their needs and communicate client expectations to the fulfillment and trafficking teams.
  • Project Management: Ability to work in a fast paced environment, handling several campaigns and markets at one time while tracking timelines/due dates for campaign deliverables, launches and/or revisions.
  • Continuity with Production: Ensure all digital campaigns are moving through the fulfillment process between teams while meeting necessary timelines for client orders.
  • Monitor Campaigns to ensure they are hitting the agreed upon goals during their flights. Adjust as appropriate. Alert appropriate parties of any anticipated problems and be prepared with suggested solutions.
  • Assist with ongoing and month end campaign/order reconciliation to verify delivery against monthly billing amount.
  • Maintain working knowledge of digital inventory: Achieve a thorough understanding of our internal systems so as to effectively and efficiently respond to internal and external requests in a timely fashion.
  • Campaign Reports: At month end and/or campaign end, prepare performance reporting for digital campaigns and provide results to the client with the Account Executive.
  • Stakeholder Communication: As this role will support several assigned markets; clear, professional and efficient communication is imperative between stakeholders (sales team and fulfillment teams) to ensure client campaign execution and performance meets or exceeds standards.

Qualifications

Required & Preferred:

  • Minimum two years experience working with digital marketing campaigns
  • Minimum two years experience working in a sales environment
  • Ability to multi task efficiently in a organized, logical, process-oriented manner
  • Professional demeanor; comfortable presenting to and interacting directly with clients 
  • Demonstrates ability to successfully collaborate with various team across the company
  • Comfortable working with ambiguity and is able to prioritize accordingly
  • Quick-witted, understanding and offering solutions in regards to various responsibilities

job.description:
Overview

Job Title: Digital Content Producer

 

Department: Digital

 

Reporting To: Director, Digital Content Strategy

 

Employment Type: Part-Time

 

Location: Miami, FL

 

Work Arrangement: On-Site

  Pay Transparency: The anticipated starting salary range for individuals expressing interest in this position is $15.00/hr - $18.00/hr. Salary to be determined by the education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities and location of the applicant, as well as internal and external equity. Audacy offers employees who are eligible for benefits with a comprehensive benefits package which includes: a health care coordinator, medical, dental, vision, mental health, telemedicine, flexible spending accounts, health savings account, disability, life insurance, critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, paid time off (sick, flex-time away/vacation days, personal, parental, volunteer), 401(k) retirement plan, legal assistance, life assistance program, identity theft protection, discounted home and auto insurance, and pet insurance.

 

Overview:

 

A highly motivated, creative, and versatile audio and video producer who can identify the best moments, viral content, and news to drive user engagement, downloads, and listening. The ideal candidate has a sharp instinct for what both passionate and more casual fans will engage with, balanced with a mastery of best production practices -- isolating news-making segments and optimizing titles and descriptions. Must thrive in a fast-paced environment and be able to bridge the UX gap between our over-the-air product and web/app streaming platforms.

Responsibilities

What You'll Do:

  • Manage daily (M-F) live video stream
  • Leverage over-the-air content into short and long-form podcast clips and VOD content
  • Use creative headline copy and tagging concepts to help build customized user experiences to drive downloads and “superfans” (consistent users)
  • Produce and publish “Best of” episodes by compiling the top segments from the show each week
  • Work with central digital and local-market staff on workflow for optimizing top content clips (e.g. isolating exclusive interviews)
  • Help activate around breaking news by quickly getting reaction content onto user platforms
  • Partner with local staff to maximize Audacy’s ‘chaptering’ experience
  • Contributing topics and ideas for the show

Qualifications

Required & Preferred:

  • 3+ years of audio production/editing experience
  • Proficient with Adobe Audition and video editing software
  • Experience with content management systems preferred
  • Experience with VMIX, OBS, and/ or Tricaster preferred
  • Sports knowledge, including current and historical figures and storylines
  • Strong writing and editorial skills and the ability to drive engagement for both local and national audiences
  • Strong news judgment, including the ability to make real-time judgments and react independently around breaking/viral audio

Department: Sales

The anticipated starting salary range for CA  individuals expressing interest in this position is $125,000 to $150,000  plus bonus. Salary to be determined by the education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities and location of the applicant, as well as internal and external equity.

Audacy has an exciting digital division focused on providing local and regional businesses best-in-class solutions designed to help them aggressively compete across the web.  Candidates for the Digital Sales Manager must have sales experience in the digital space and be able to step in and drive the company's revenue.  The candidate must be able to demonstrate a strong understanding and history of new business development, lead generation, pipeline management and management of teams.

Audacy offers employees who are eligible for benefits with a comprehensive benefits package which includes: a health care coordinator, medical, dental, vision, mental health, telemedicine, flexible spending accounts, health savings account, disability, life insurance, critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, paid time off (sick, flex-time away/vacation days, personal, parental, volunteer), 401(k) retirement plan, legal assistance, life assistance program, identity theft protection, discounted home and auto insurance, and pet insurance.

Responsibilities

What You'll Do:

  • Participate on sales calls with their team of Audacy Account Executives
  • Personally consult local and regional businesses to understand their needs and aspirations so that tailored solutions can be designed, implemented and executed.
  • Execute an overall business plan and sales strategy that ensures attainment of digital revenue goals.
  • Continuous training of Audacy sales process, products, operations and the Audacy sales story.

job.title: Digital Sales Specialist
job.description:
Overview

Job Title: Digital Sales Specialist

 

Department: Sales

 

Reporting To: Digital Sales Manager

 

Employment Type: Full-Time

 

Location(s): Austin, TX

 

Work Arrangement: Hybrid

 

Overview:

Audacy is seeking a Digital Sales Specialist to spearhead revenue growth through the strategic adoption of our comprehensive digital portfolio. This is a consultative sales support role with client-facing interaction. The role is designed for a candidate with technical and strategic digital knowledge who does not just help sell "products," rather moves our sales team to create comprehensive multi-channel digital strategies tailored to a client’s business objectives.

 

The ideal candidate possesses a deep understanding of the digital landscape — customizing campaigns that bridge top-of-funnel awareness tactics (such as OTT and Digital Audio) with high-intent, bottom-of-funnel conversion tactics (such as Search), including conversion tracking best practices. You will act as a strategic advisor to both our internal local sales team and our valuable clients.

Responsibilities

What You'll Do:

  • Partner with account executives to identify and generate digital sales opportunities.
  • Collect and analyze digital marketing performance data, including client-specific metrics and consumer behavior trends.
  • Conduct needs analysis and present strategic recommendations to clients through in-person and virtual meetings.
  • Develop and present customized digital advertising solutions—including Search, OTT/Video, Display, Digital Audio, and Social Media—to deliver impactful client results.
  • Monitor and optimize active campaigns by analyzing performance metrics to improve efficiency and results.
  • Serve as a strategic advisor to both internal sales teams and clients, fostering strong, collaborative relationships.
  • Strategic thinking, a flexible mindset, and problem solving skills are critical to success in this role. 
  • Maintain an active role in consistently driving digital revenue growth through sales activity.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bilingual preferred.
  • 2+ years sales related experience preferred.
  • 2+ years digital marketing experience preferred.
  • College Degree preferred but not required.
  • Proven success in building client marketing campaigns by utilizing digital platforms (Search, Social, Display, Video, and Audio).
  • Thorough understanding of digital advertising, multi-channel strategies, and customer-centric success metrics.
  • A creative, flexible mindset in creating custom multi-channel campaigns focused on solving client stated needs.
  • Strong problem solving skills - you’re someone who identifies a problem as an opportunity to develop business.
  • Proficiency in Google Workspace and MS Office Suite (specifically Excel and PowerPoint for data visualization). 
  • Must be self-motivated, self-disciplined, have a positive attitude and be an effective communicator.

job.title: Executive Producer
job.description:
Overview

Job Title: Executive Producer - The Chris & Amy Show

 

Department: Programming

 

Reporting To: Brand Manager

 

Employment Type: Full-Time

 

Location(s): St. Louis, M.O

 

Work Arrangement: On-Site

Salary to be determined by the education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities and location of the applicant, as well as internal and external equity.

 

Audacy offers employees who are eligible for benefits with a comprehensive benefits package which includes: a health care coordinator, medical, dental, vision, mental health, telemedicine, flexible spending accounts, health savings account, disability, life insurance, critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, paid time off (sick, flex-time away/vacation days, personal, parental, volunteer), 401(k) retirement plan, student loan payment assistance program, legal assistance, life assistance program, identity theft protection, discounted home and auto insurance, and pet insurance.

 

Overview:

KMOX Radio, the legendary Voice of St. Louis, is looking for a modern, creative and digitally savvy Executive Producer to help take The Chris & Amy Show to the next level. We're looking for someone who understands that a great show can live far beyond the radio clock — on YouTube, social media, podcasts, video, digital platforms and wherever St. Louis audiences consume content. The Executive Producer will oversee the show's daily content strategy, preparation and execution while helping expand The Chris & Amy Show into a multi-platform St. Louis media brand. You'll work closely with Chris and Amy to develop ideas, create compelling conversations, find great guests and stories, and turn the best moments from the show into content that can reach new audiences. You should have a great ear for radio — but you should also have a great eye for content.

Responsibilities

What You'll Do:

  • Develop the daily content strategy and show rundown with Chris and Amy.
  • Identify the stories, conversations and personalities that will drive the show.
  • Create original features, recurring benchmarks, games, bits and listener-driven content.
  • Research for interviews, conversations and major topics.
  • Constantly look for ways to make the show more entertaining, surprising, relevant and local.
  • Running a live radio board and executing a show in real time.
  • Understanding clocks, formats, commercial breaks and station logs.
  • Editing and producing audio quickly and cleanly.
  • Booking and preparing guests.
  • Writing compelling intros, teases, promos and digital copy.
  • Managing live callers, interviews and breaking content.
  • Working with newsroom, traffic, weather and other station resources.
  • Making quick decisions when the show doesn't go according to plan.

Qualifications

More About You:

 

Required & Preferred:

But you also need to think beyond radio.

We're looking for someone who understands that the best moments on The Chris & Amy Show shouldn't end when the microphone is turned off.

You should be able to identify an on-air conversation and immediately see its potential as:

  • A YouTube video.
  • A short-form video.
  • A podcast segment.
  • A social clip.
  • A behind-the-scenes piece.
  • A digital-only conversation.
  • A community or live event opportunity.

The goal is not simply to produce a better radio show.  The goal is to build a bigger Chris & Amy audience — on the radio and everywhere else people consume content.

Expand the show beyond radio

  • Develop a daily content strategy that extends the show across YouTube, video, social media, podcasts and digital platforms.
  • Identify moments during the live show that have the potential to become compelling digital content.
  • Think proactively about content that should be created specifically for digital audiences.
  • Develop short-form video, social clips, interviews, behind-the-scenes content and other original digital features.

The ideal candidate is:

  • An experienced radio producer with a modern content mindset.
  • A strong writer and storyteller.
  • Someone who understands personality-driven radio.
  • Highly knowledgeable about digital video, social media and audience growth.
  • Comfortable creating and editing short-form video and digital content.
  • Someone who understands platforms such as YouTube, Instagram, TikTok and Facebook and knows that each platform requires a different approach.
  • Highly organized but not afraid to throw out the rundown when a great idea comes along.
  • Curious about culture, entertainment, sports, news and — most importantly — St. Louis.
  • Comfortable working with strong personalities.
  • An idea generator who is constantly thinking about "What more can I do?"

Important Notes:

Please be aware that Audacy will never ask you to send money at any point during the hiring process. Communication from legitimate Audacy representatives will only come from email addresses ending in @audacy.com. If you receive any suspicious requests or communications, please verify their authenticity before responding.

This role will serve as the central driver for all legal department initiatives and projects, while maintaining a high standard for document organization, retrieval, and life-cycle contract management.

You will keep key transactions and departmental projects running seamlessly, while maintaining effective contract management, coordinating with internal and external stakeholders, and driving strategic legal initiatives to support overall organizational growth and efficiency.

Responsibilities

What You'll Do:

  • Lead legal operations and  department initiatives and manage and execute legal department projects.
  • Lead project management for multi-faceted transactions (e.g., M&A and financings), including efficiently organizing complex contracts into virtual data rooms for internal and external stakeholders, coordinating cross-functional due diligence streams and responses to counterparty diligence requests, building and maintaining project management tools and trackers to monitor diligence requests and pre- and post-closing matters; maintaining closing conditions checklists, tracking corporate approvals (board resolutions, shareholder consents), overseeing legal document execution and escrow mechanics, securing third party consents, managing closing exchanges, and compiling closing binders. 
  • Function as the primary driver and manager of strategic projects at the request of attorneys and other internal business partners ensuring clear communication of tasks and setting and meeting deadlines.
  • Serve as the primary subject matter expert on document and storage management, contract retrieval, leveraging a strong understanding of contracts and key terms in order to accurately organize, classify, and audit documents for internal searchability. 
  • Manage administration of contract-related resources and collaboration tools, including but not limited to iManage, DocMinder, and physical files and related licenses.  
  • Draft agreements and notices using templates, as well as disclosure schedules for M&A transactions, in each case with attorney oversight.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

More About You:

Required & Preferred:

  • 5+ years of experience working directly with broadcast media and/or entertainment contracts (including talent agreements, vendor agreements, and transactional agreements such as purchase agreements) with a strong grasp of standard deal mechanics and terminology. 
  • Demonstrated experience managing complex transactions and projects, and building or maintaining contract databases and virtual data rooms for transactions and audits. 
  • Proven ability to critically evaluate, analyze, and synthesize disparate information gathered from cross-functional teams such as Finance, HR, IT, and Programming.
  • BA/BS from an accredited college or university, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • Proficient in the Google, Microsoft, and Adobe suites, including building and maintaining project trackers.
  • Ability to handle and prioritize multiple projects simultaneously and operate with limited supervision in a fast-paced, high-volume workplace.
  • Ability to work well with others in a collaborative environment. 
  • Exceptional initiative, judgment, prioritizing and organizational skills.
  • Excellent oral and written communication, analytical skills, and problem-solving ability.
  • High degree of discretion, professionalism, judgment, and follow-through.
  • Prior personnel management experience preferred.

job.title: Multimedia Journalist (Pipeline Posting)
job.description:
Overview

Job Title: Multimedia Journalist

 

Department: Programming

 

Reporting To: TWIN Traffic Operations Manager

 

Employment Type: Full-Time

 

Location(s): Dallas, TX

 

Work Arrangement: On-Site

 

Overview:

NewsRadio 1080 KRLD, Dallas-Fort Worth and Texas State Networks is looking for its next full-time Multimedia Journalist. The ideal candidate is an upbeat, positive, and motivated news junkie who thrives in a fast-paced environment where content is driven by audience demands, breaking news, severe weather, and coverage of major traffic incidents.

 

In this unique and exciting role as a multimedia journalist, you will serve as an editor, anchor, reporter, digital and social content creator for NewsRadio 1080 KRLD’s multiple distribution platforms, including Texas State Networks. The skills utilized may be different each day, based on staffing, content, and audience demands.

 

This full-time position would include a Monday through Friday schedule and may include on-call duties as needed.

 

Please note: This is a pipeline posting. We are always on the lookout for exceptional talent to join our dynamic team. While we may not have an immediate opening, we are continuously building a pipeline of talented individuals who are interested in becoming a part of our organization when opportunities arise. By submitting your application, you will become part of our talent pool. When we have a hiring need that matches your profile, we will reach out to you directly to discuss the opportunity. We appreciate your interest in joining our team and look forward to reviewing your application. 

Responsibilities

What You'll Do:

  • Stay up to date on current affairs and content planning for the day/week.
  • Gather, write, record, edit and deliver news, traffic & weather content, including live coverage from the studio or from the field on KRLD, Texas State Networks, or associated distribution platforms.
  • Identify great audio, write and edit urgent and compelling copy for stories.
  • Assemble/stack, and edit newscasts delivered by another anchor and/or by you, free of any political or social biases. 
  • Anchor multi-hour news shifts on KRLD and/or Texas State Networks.
  • Interview newsmakers and news reactors, including the general public.
  • Development and research of potential news stories, using all newsroom resources, including non-traditional and social media, to identify potential news stories relevant to KRLD’s strategy and target audience.
  • Organize, develop, and coordinate assignments with reporters during hours associated with Editing.
  • Communicate and coordinate with KRLD meteorologist and/or traffic teams during changing weather conditions, severe weather, and significant traffic incidents.
  • Creatively pursue new ways of presenting stories so that they have the most impact on the audience.
  • Contribute to team editorial meetings with story ideas.
  • Learn, understand, and be able to follow and implement KRLD strategy and Audacy policy and procedures.
  • Alert management to content that is questionable or that may be in violation of FCC, corporate or station policies and regulations.
  • Other duties as required by management.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Have a passion for the process of news and news story development.
  • Understanding of newsroom ethical and legal guidelines and restrictions that govern broadcast media.
  • Excellent editorial judgment and deep understanding of current events, politics and news.
  • Keen awareness of the current socio-political landscape, and the ability to separate personal political and social views from influencing story selection and presentation.
  • Contemporary sound and excellent on-air delivery and storytelling skills.
  • Write for both styles of distribution (on-air and digital) and include audio and/or video.
  • Thrive under pressure, especially during breaking news, severe weather, and unrelenting news deadlines.
  • Comfort with on-camera work for social and digital distribution.
  • Fully utilize all the tools of broadcast and social media in the field (Twitter, Facebook, live and recorded video and audio equipment, etc.) 
  • Technical proficiency of audio and video recording equipment and editing software.
  • Proficiency in editing and packaging news sound and interviews.
  • Possess strong multi-tasking skills, and the ability to quickly pivot and produce content spontaneously based on changing news, breaking news, severe weather, etc.
  • Positive and effective communication with team members, advertisers, newsmakers, stringers and network counterparts, listeners and the general public.
  • Understanding of target demographics, and target topics/beats for news coverage.
  • Proficient with basic computer software skills, including Gmail and Slack.

 

Preferred:

  • Familiarity with the Dallas-Fort Worth news environment.
  • 4 year degree in journalism.
  • 1+ years of experience in an active newsroom environment.
  • 1+ years anchoring or reporting news for broadcast or digital media.
  • Burli or (similar news content management system) experience.
  • Experience updating stories on digital CMS platforms (i.e. - WordPress, etc)
  • Ability to edit video, overlay graphics and/or subtitles, etc.
  • Graphic editing skills, and use of products for visual storytelling, such as Canva.

Department: Programming

Overview:

 

Audacy Houston is searching for an interactive, innovative, 3rd voice to add to its award winning morning show, Payne and Pendergast. This personality must be able to contribute daily to a live and local show by bringing engaging content, entertaining sports and lifestyle conversations, and outside the box ideas to connect with the Houston audience both on air and via digital platforms. Strong communication skills, an understanding of all relevant social media platforms, and a full, honest investment in Houston sports are vital for this position. This is a live and local position that requires the personality to be based in the Houston area. Previous on-air experience in a medium to large market is ideal, but not necessary --- most importantly, this position will require a talent with a proven ability to draw in and relate to a passionate and diverse audience.  

 

Audacy offers full time employees with a comprehensive benefits package to include:  health care coordinator, medical, dental, vision, telemedicine, flexible spending accounts, health savings account, disability, life insurance, critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, paid time off (sick, vacation, personal, parental, volunteer), 401(k) retirement plan, discounted employee stock purchase, student loan payment assistance program, legal assistance, life assistance program, identity theft protection, discounted home and auto insurance, and pet insurance.

 

This position will also include, but not require or guarantee, additional opportunities and considerations for corporate podcasts, paid sales endorsements, and promotional appearances.

Job Title: Producer

 

Department: Programming

 

Reporting To: Brand Manager

 

Employment Type: Full-Time

 

Location(s): Houston, TX

Overview:

Audacy Houston has a rare full time producer opportunity on 95.7 The Fan. We are searching for a technically sound, organized, content creation focused producer for Payne and Pendergast, Houston’s most recognizable morning sports talk program. Strong communication skills, an intimate knowledge of WideOrbit and all radio production software, understanding of digital and social media platforms, and a full, honest investment in Houston sports and culture are vital for this position. This is a live and local position that requires the producer to be based in the Houston area. Previous producing experience in a medium to large market is ideal, but not necessary.

 

Audacy offers full time employees with a comprehensive benefits package to include:  health care coordinator, medical, dental, vision, telemedicine, flexible spending accounts, health savings account, disability, life insurance, critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, paid time off (sick, vacation, personal, parental, volunteer), 401(k) retirement plan, discounted employee stock purchase, student loan payment assistance program, legal assistance, life assistance program, identity theft protection, discounted home and auto insurance, and pet insurance.

 

This position will also include, but not require or guarantee, additional opportunities and considerations for on air opportunities, paid sales endorsements, and promotional appearances.

Responsibilities

What You'll Do:

  • Produce and run the audio board for Payne and Pendergast, 6a-10a M-F on 95.7 The Fan
  • Develop a signature “show sound” through the use of music beds, drops, and daily featured audio
  • Help develop topic ideas and content for both on air conversations and social media/digital videos
  • Handle podcasting, live video clipping, social media posting, and other ancillary production  responsibilities for Payne and Pendergast
  • Record and edit daily/weekly press conferences, highlights, and other necessary audio clips to be used for over the air playback
  • Respectfully and responsibly uphold the standards of our brand partnership with the Houston Texans both on-air and on social media
  • Protect the station’s FCC license in all on-air and digital programming
  • Participate in and develop original content for digital and social media platforms
  • Collaborate with Brand Manager and other station staff to develop show benchmarks and participate in station-wide events and promotions
  • Attend regularly scheduled staff meetings and weekly coaching sessions
  • Make appearances to promote the station, show, and sponsors.
  • Travel to station and brand events and broadcasts when required, some of which include: Super Bowl Radio Row, the Army/Navy game, Houston Texans Training Camp, Houston Astros Spring Training, etc.
  • Ensure that promotions and contests are executed properly
  • Other duties as required by management

  • 5+ years Radio Production experience preferred
  • Knowledge of the Houston market preferred
  • Solid audio collection skills and working knowledge of studio audio equipment, including digital systems such as Sound Forge, Audition, & Wide Orbit.

Job Title: Promotions Assistant

Department: Promotions

Reporting To: Promotions Director

Employment Type: Part-Time

Location(s): Denver

Work Arrangement: On-Site/Activation

 

Overview:

Audacy is looking for ambitious, energetic, and outgoing individuals to join our Promotions team! Are you interested in breaking into the broadcast industry? Audacy radio stations are hiring Promotion Representatives to help execute on-site activations at local venues and other events. Must be a "people person" that has a flexible schedule, is available nights and weekends, and is highly motivated, responsible, and friendly. Must be able to lift and carry equipment.

 

Stations You’ll Represent: Audacy Denver is home of Alice 105.9, KS 107.5, 99.5 The Mountain, Front Range 103.1 Country 103.1 & The BET 1430AM

 

The anticipated starting hourly rate for Denver-based individuals expressing interest in this position is $19.29/Hr..

Salary to be determined by the education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities and location of the applicant, as well as internal and external equity.

Audacy offers full time employees with a comprehensive benefits package to include:  health care coordinator, medical, dental, vision, telemedicine, flexible spending accounts, health savings account, disability, life insurance, critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, paid time off (sick, vacation, personal, parental, volunteer), 401(k) retirement plan, discounted employee stock purchase, student loan payment assistance program, legal assistance, life assistance program, identity theft protection, discounted home and auto insurance, and pet insurance.

  This is an evergreen posting. We are always on the lookout for exceptional talent to join our dynamic team. While we may not have an immediate opening, we are continuously building a roster of talented individuals who are interested in becoming a part of our organization when opportunities arise. By submitting your application, you will become part of our talent pool. We appreciate your interest in joining our team and look forward to reviewing your application.  

Responsibilities

What You'll Do:

 

Our Promotions team is responsible for spreading the word and passion for our stations and brands to the masses by taking to the street! You will assist with everything from in-office support such as preparing and executing on-air, online, and on-site contests, contacting winners, processing winner paperwork, andmore, to working live events, appearances, and remote broadcasts assisting with setup, teardown, on-site activations, audio/video equipment, driving station vehicles, and more!

We are looking for energetic, dependable, passionate, flexible team members who use sound judgement and have an outgoing personality that are ready to roll up their sleeves, learn, work hard, and have fun doing it!

If you love music, sports, entertainment, culture, and you have a knack for "figuring it" and "getting it done", we have a team ready to enhance and improve your skills while providing an opportunity to learn and grow in a fast-paced industry.

The Promotions team is responsible for the following, including but not limited to:

● Execute on-site promotional events and coordinate/manage clients and listeners on-site.● Set up, break down, and transport promotional event equipment as required.

● Set up and run audio and other types of equipment during an event.● Hang banners and other staging elements at events.● Record events (ex. photos, videos, and audio) for purposes such as social media platforms and recap of the event.● Responsible for fulfilling winner release forms and other waivers when needed for an event.● Maintain promotional equipment and vehicles in a clean and neat manner● Check email; attend mandatory meetings on time; be able to work weekends, holidays, and blackout dates (specified by Promotions Director/Manager).● Must be available to work Fridays, Saturdays, and Sundays● May need to work with little notice.● Work in a fast paced and upbeat environment

 

Qualifications

 

Required & Preferred:

 

Required:

● A positive attitude, and willingness to be a team player.● Ability to drive company vehicles to and from events.● Ability to lift and/or carry equipment.● Professional appearance and punctuality.● Reliable and dependable mode of transportation.● High School Diploma or GED.● Must be 21 or older.

Preferred:

● Experience using Google Workspaces (Gmail, Google Drive, Google Calendar, etc.) is a plus● Knowledge of promotions software, including but not limited to Vibes (mobile contesting), Aptivada (web contesting and user-generated content engine) and PromoSuite (promotion management software) a plus.● Experience working with the general public is preferred.

 

Other requirements:

● A valid driver’s license, satisfactory completion of a motor vehicle record check, and, if the position requires use of the applicant's own vehicle, proof of insurance, is required.

 

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS: 

● While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to stand; walk; sit; use hands to finger, handle, or feel objects, tools or controls; reach with hands and arms; climb stairs and/or ladders; balance; stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl; talk, hear or smell. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 35 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by the job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.

Overview

Job Title: Promotions Assistant 

 

Department: Promotions

 

Reporting To: Promotions Director

 

Employment Type:    Part-Time

 

Location(s):  Richmond, VA

Work Arrangement: On-Site/Activation

 

Overview:

 

Audacy Richmond is looking for ambitious, energetic, and outgoing individuals to join our Promotions team! 

 

This is a part-time, flex schedule position with a great organization that allows you to get your foot in the door in a fast-paced, industry-leading, media company. The Promotions Assistant/Street Team position is unlike any other – this market allows the opportunity to both showcase and enhance a multitude of desired skill sets including in-field marketing, event production, live broadcast assistance, photography, videography, editing, social media coordination, office assistance and more. You'll be the face, heart, and soul of four powerful brands serving at the forefront of listener interactions, concerts, sport and lifestyle events, and much more.

 

 

Pay Transparency:

 

The anticipated starting salary range for Richmond-based individuals expressing interest in this position is $15.00/Hr..

 

Salary to be determined by the education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities and location of the applicant, as well as internal and external equity.

 

 

Responsibilities

 

What You'll Do:

 

Our Promotions Assistant/Street Team is responsible for spreading the word and passion for our stations and brands to the masses by taking to the street! You will assist with everything from in-office support such as preparing and executing on-air, online, and on-site contests, contacting winners, processing winner paperwork, and more, to working live events, appearances, and remote broadcasts assisting with setup, teardown, on-site activations, audio/video equipment, driving station vehicles, and more! We are looking for energetic, dependable, flexible team members who use sound judgment and have an outgoing personality that are ready to roll up their sleeves, learn, work hard, and have fun doing it! If you love music, sports, entertainment, culture, and you have a knack for "figuring it" and "getting it done", we have a team ready to enhance and improve your skills while providing an opportunity to learn and grow in a fast-paced industry. The Promotions Assistant/Street Team is responsible for the following, including but not limited to: 

  • Execute on-site promotional events and coordinate/manage clients and listeners on-site.
  • Set up, break down, and transport promotional event equipment as required.
  • Set up and run audio and other types of equipment during an event.
  • Hang banners and other staging elements at events.
  • Record events (ex. photos, videos, and audio) for purposes such as social media platforms and

recap of the event.

  • Responsible for fulfilling winner release forms and other waivers when needed for an event.
  • Maintain promotional equipment and vehicles in a clean and neat manner;
  • Check email daily; attend mandatory meetings on time; be able to work weekends, holidays, and

blackout dates (specified by Promotions Director/Manager).

  • Must be available to work Fridays, Saturdays, and Sundays
  • May need to work with little notice.
  • Must be 18 or older.

 

Qualifications

Required & Preferred:

 

Required:

  • A positive attitude, and willingness to be a team player.
  • A valid driver's license, satisfactory completion of a motor vehicle record check, and, if the position requires use of the applicant's own vehicle, proof of insurance is required.
  • Ability to drive company vehicles to and from events.
  • Ability to lift and/or carry equipment.
  • Professional appearance and punctuality.
  • Reliable and dependable mode of transportation.
  • High School Diploma or GED.

 

Preferred:

 

  • Experience using Google Workspaces (Gmail, Google Drive, Google Calendar, etc.) is a plus
  • Knowledge of promotions software, including but not limited to Vibes (mobile contesting),
  • Aptivada (web contesting and user-generated content engine) and PromoSuite (promotion management software) a plus.
  • Experience working with the general public is preferred.

 

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS: 

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to stand; walk; sit; use hands to finger, handle, or feel objects, tools or controls; reach with hands and arms; climb stairs and/or ladders; balance; stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl; talk, hear or smell. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 35 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by the job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.

job.title: Promotions Assistant
job.description:
Overview

Job Title:       Promotions Assistant

 

Department: Promotions

 

Reporting To: Promotions Director

 

Employment Type: Part Time

 

Location(s): Virginia Beach/Norfolk, VA

 

Work Arrangement: Hybrid

 

Overview:

 

Audacy VA Beach-Norfolk  is looking for ambitious, energetic, and outgoing individuals to join our Promotions team! 

 

This is a part-time, flex schedule position with a great organization that allows you to get your foot in the door in a fast-paced, industry-leading, media company. The Promotions Assistant/Street Team position is unlike any other – this market allows the opportunity to both showcase and enhance a multitude of desired skill sets including in-field marketing, event production, live broadcast assistance, photography, videography, editing, social media coordination, office assistance and more. You'll be the face, heart, and soul of four powerful brands serving at the forefront of listener interactions, concerts, sport and lifestyle events, and much more.

 

Pay Transparency:

The anticipated starting salary range for Virginia-based individuals expressing interest in this position is $15.00/Hr. 

Salary to be determined by the education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities and location of the applicant, as well as internal and external equity.

 

Responsibilities

 

What You'll Do:

Our Promotions Assistant/Street Team is responsible for spreading the word and passion for our stations and brands to the masses by taking to the street! You will assist with everything from in-office support such as preparing and executing on-air, online, and on-site contests, contacting winners, processing winner paperwork, and more, to working live events, appearances, and remote broadcasts assisting with setup, teardown, on-site activations, audio/video equipment, driving station vehicles, and more! We are looking for energetic, dependable, flexible team members who use sound judgment and have an outgoing personality that are ready to roll up their sleeves, learn, work hard, and have fun doing it! If you love music, sports, entertainment, culture, and you have a knack for "figuring it" and "getting it done", we have a team ready to enhance and improve your skills while providing an opportunity to learn and grow in a fast-paced industry. The Promotions Assistant/Street Team is responsible for the following, including but not limited to: 

  • Execute on-site promotional events and coordinate/manage clients and listeners on-site.
  • Set up, break down, and transport promotional event equipment as required.
  • Set up and run audio and other types of equipment during an event.
  • Hang banners and other staging elements at events.
  • Record events (ex. photos, videos, and audio) for purposes such as social media platforms and

recap of the event.

  • Responsible for fulfilling winner release forms and other waivers when needed for an event.
  • Maintain promotional equipment and vehicles in a clean and neat manner;
  • Check email daily; attend mandatory meetings on time; be able to work weekends, holidays, and

blackout dates (specified by Promotions Director/Manager).

  • Must be available to work Fridays, Saturdays, and Sundays
  • May need to work with little notice.
  • Must be 18 or older.

 

Qualifications

 

Required:

  • A positive attitude, and willingness to be a team player.
  • A valid driver's license, satisfactory completion of a motor vehicle record check, and, if the position requires use of the applicant's own vehicle, proof of insurance is required.
  • Ability to drive company vehicles to and from events.
  • Ability to lift and/or carry equipment.
  • Professional appearance and punctuality.
  • Reliable and dependable mode of transportation.
  • High School Diploma or GED.

 

Preferred:

 

  • Experience using Google Workspaces (Gmail, Google Drive, Google Calendar, etc.) is a plus
  • Knowledge of promotions software, including but not limited to Vibes (mobile contesting),
  • Aptivada (web contesting and user-generated content engine) and PromoSuite (promotion management software) a plus.
  • Experience working with the general public is preferred.

 

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS: 

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to stand; walk; sit; use hands to finger, handle, or feel objects, tools or controls; reach with hands and arms; climb stairs and/or ladders; balance; stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl; talk, hear or smell. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 35 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by the job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.

Important Notes:

Please be aware that Audacy will never ask you to send money at any point during the hiring process. Communication from legitimate Audacy representatives will only come from email addresses ending in @audacy.com. If you receive any suspicious requests or communications, please verify their authenticity before responding.

job.title: Promotions Technician
job.description:
Overview

Job Title: Promotions Tech

Department: Promotions

 

Reporting to: Regional Promotions Director

 

Employment Type: Part Time

 

Location(s): Buffalo, NY

 

Work Arrangement: On-Site (Office and Remote Locations)

 

Overview:

 

Audacy Buffalo seeks a Promotions Technician for outside field broadcast work. This position is for a versatile utility player capable of performing entry level tasks in the Promotions and Programming departments and maintaining readiness of our branding equipment and vehicle fleet.

The anticipated starting salary range for New York-based individuals expressing interest in this position is $21.00/Hr... 

Salary to be determined by the education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities and location of the applicant, as well as internal and external equity.

 

This is an evergreen job post, which we refresh approximately every 90 days to maintain an active pool of candidates. While we may not have an immediate opening, we continuously build connections with professionals interested in future opportunities. By submitting your application, you’ll become part of our talent community. We will reach out directly to explore the fit. We appreciate your interest and look forward to reviewing your application!

 

Responsibilities

Responsibilities:
  • Maintain readiness of all promotional equipment and station vehicles.
  • Develop and maintain organizational procedures for broadcast equipment.
  • Engineer and execute live remote broadcasts utilizing IP technology.
  • Facilitate, attend, set-up and operate a live performance studio as FOH sound engineer.
  • Be the go-to person for remote broadcast vans equipped with generators and pneumatic masts
  • Assist with setup and repair of broadcast gear, sound equipment (mobile audio, video, and transmission equipment), office equipment and furniture.
  • Additional duties and responsibilities may be assigned.

 

Additional considerations:

 

A Promotions Technician for outside field broadcast work is a specialized field engineer who sets up, operates, and maintains mobile audio, video, and transmission equipment on-site for live sports, news, and entertainment events. They are crucial for ensuring high-quality broadcast feeds are transmitted from remote locations back to the central studio.

 

Key Responsibilities:

 

Promotions Tech for outside field broadcast work operate in high-pressure, on-location environments, which require distinct duties.

 

  • Equipment Rigging: Unloading, cabling, and configuring mobile OB vans, portable field cameras, satellite uplinks, and communication (comms) gear.
  • Signal Management: Controlling and adjusting video and audio signals to ensure optimal strength, clarity, and synchronization during live broadcasting.
  • Field Troubleshooting: Diagnosing and repairing hardware and signal faults quickly while on location to prevent dead air.
  • De-rigging & Maintenance: Carefully packing up sensitive gear and performing routine maintenance on transmission systems between events.

Qualifications

Qualifications:
  • 21+ years of age
  • Hands-on experience and familiarity with industry-standard production gear are highly valued.
  • Must be a self-starter and be responsible to work with little to no supervision.
  • Excellent communication skills both written and spoken.
  • Must be able to work well in a high-pressure, on-location environment,  and have the ability to think “outside the box” to solve issues quickly that may occur.
  • A friendly, customer service oriented attitude and a willingness to complete varied tasks in our Engineering/Programming departments.
  • Must have a valid driver’s license, satisfactory completion of a motor vehicle record check, and, if the position requires use of the applicant's own vehicle, proof of insurance, is required.

Physical Requirements:

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to stand, walk, sit and use hands and fingers to handle or feel objects, tools or controls, reach with hands and arms, climb stairs, balance, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, talk or hear and smell. The employee must regularly lift and/or move up to 75 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by the job include a good sense of direction, close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and the ability to adjust focus.

 

 

Important Notes:

Please be aware that Audacy will never ask you to send money at any point during the hiring process. Communication from legitimate Audacy representatives will only come from email addresses ending in @audacy.com. If you receive any suspicious requests or communications, please verify their authenticity before responding.

job.title: Promotions Technician
job.description:
Overview

Job Title: Promotions Tech

Department: Promotions

 

Reporting to: Regional Promotions Director

 

Employment Type: Part Time

 

Location(s): Norfolk-Virginia Beach, VA

 

Work Arrangement: On-Site (Office and Remote Locations)

 

Overview:

 

Audacy Norfolk seeks a Promotions Technician for outside field broadcast work. This position is for a versatile utility player capable of performing entry level tasks in the Promotions and Programming departments and maintaining readiness of our branding equipment and vehicle fleet.

The anticipated starting salary range for Virginia-based individuals expressing interest in this position is $21.00/Hr... 

Salary to be determined by the education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities and location of the applicant, as well as internal and external equity.

 

This is an evergreen job post, which we refresh approximately every 90 days to maintain an active pool of candidates. While we may not have an immediate opening, we continuously build connections with professionals interested in future opportunities. By submitting your application, you’ll become part of our talent community. We will reach out directly to explore the fit. We appreciate your interest and look forward to reviewing your application!

 

 

Responsibilities

Responsibilities:
  • Maintain readiness of all promotional equipment and station vehicles.
  • Develop and maintain organizational procedures for broadcast equipment.
  • Engineer and execute live remote broadcasts utilizing IP technology.
  • Facilitate, attend, set-up and operate a live performance studio as FOH sound engineer.
  • Be the go-to person for remote broadcast vans equipped with generators and pneumatic masts
  • Assist with setup and repair of broadcast gear, sound equipment (mobile audio, video, and transmission equipment), office equipment and furniture.
  • Additional duties and responsibilities may be assigned.

 

Additional considerations:

 

A Promotions Technician for outside field broadcast work is a specialized field engineer who sets up, operates, and maintains mobile audio, video, and transmission equipment on-site for live sports, news, and entertainment events. They are crucial for ensuring high-quality broadcast feeds are transmitted from remote locations back to the central studio.

 

Key Responsibilities:

 

Promotions Tech for outside field broadcast work operate in high-pressure, on-location environments, which require distinct duties.

 

  • Equipment Rigging: Unloading, cabling, and configuring mobile OB vans, portable field cameras, satellite uplinks, and communication (comms) gear.
  • Signal Management: Controlling and adjusting video and audio signals to ensure optimal strength, clarity, and synchronization during live broadcasting.
  • Field Troubleshooting: Diagnosing and repairing hardware and signal faults quickly while on location to prevent dead air.
  • De-rigging & Maintenance: Carefully packing up sensitive gear and performing routine maintenance on transmission systems between events.

 

 

 

Qualifications

Qualifications:
  • 21+ years of age
  • Hands-on experience and familiarity with industry-standard production gear are highly valued.
  • Must be a self-starter and be responsible to work with little to no supervision.
  • Excellent communication skills both written and spoken.
  • Must be able to work well in a high-pressure, on-location environment,  and have the ability to think “outside the box” to solve issues quickly that may occur.
  • A friendly, customer service oriented attitude and a willingness to complete varied tasks in our Engineering/Programming departments.
  • Must have a valid driver’s license, satisfactory completion of a motor vehicle record check, and, if the position requires use of the applicant's own vehicle, proof of insurance, is required.

Physical Requirements:

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to stand, walk, sit and use hands and fingers to handle or feel objects, tools or controls, reach with hands and arms, climb stairs, balance, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, talk or hear and smell. The employee must regularly lift and/or move up to 75 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by the job include a good sense of direction, close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and the ability to adjust focus.

Please be aware that Audacy will never ask you to send money at any point during the hiring process. Communication from legitimate Audacy representatives will only come from email addresses ending in @audacy.com. If you receive any suspicious requests or communications, please verify their authenticity before responding.

job.description:
Overview

Job Title: Sales Assistant

 

Department: Sales

 

Reporting To: Sales Management

 

Employment Type: Full-Time

 

Location(s): Boston, Massachusetts

 

Work Arrangement: On-site

 

Job Description:

 

Audacy is seeking a dynamic, detail-oriented, and driven Sales Assistant to support our growing media and sales team. This is an ideal role for someone looking to build a career in media sales. You will work closely with Account Executives to ensure flawless execution of advertising campaigns across multiple platforms including radio, digital, social, podcast, and streaming and more.

You will play a key role in supporting strategic planning, media proposals, and account management to help deliver and drive new business growth.

Pay Transparency:

The anticipated starting salary range for Boston-based individuals expressing interest in this position is $52,000.00/Yr.. 

Salary to be determined by the education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities and location of the applicant, as well as internal and external equity.

Audacy offers full time employees with a comprehensive benefits package to include:  health care coordinator, medical, dental, vision, telemedicine, flexible spending accounts, health savings account, disability, life insurance, critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, paid time off (sick, vacation, personal, parental, volunteer), 401(k) retirement plan, discounted employee stock purchase, student loan payment assistance program, legal assistance, life assistance program, identity theft protection, discounted home and auto insurance, and pet insurance.

 

 

Responsibilities

What You'll Do:

 

Key Responsibilities:

Sales Support & Campaign Execution:

 

  • Research target companies, industry news, and business trends to uncover insights that support sales outreach.
  • Develop value-based research(VBR) points that align with prospect needs and position our solutions effectively.
  • Assist Account Executives in preparing proposals and building strategic media plans
  • Track emerging industry themes and competitor activity to keep the sales team apprised of market developments.
  • Maintain organized research notes within Salesforce/CRM to ensure insights are actionable and easily accessible.

Client Communication & Relationship Management:

  • Serve as a liaison between clients and internal departments to ensure campaign objectives and timelines are met.
  • Help manage day-to-day communication and support requests from clients and internal departments such as marketing, and brand managers.
  • Coordinate with the Traffic Department on creative assets, instructions, and troubleshooting.

 Administrative & Reporting Tasks:

  • Create and update sales presentations, media kits, and one-sheets.
  • Consolidate and analyze campaign data to support strategic recommendations and reporting.
  • Maintain organized research notes within Salesforce/CRM to ensure insights are actionable and easily accessible.

Team Collaboration & Learning:

  • Participate in sales meetings, training, and client events as needed.
  • Stay up to date on new media products including podcasting, streaming, OTT, email, SEO/SEM, and social advertising.
  • Proactively identify opportunities to enhance processes and client offerings.

 

Qualifications

Required & Preferred:

Desired Skills & Qualifications:

Required:

Department: Digital 

 

Reporting To: SVP Sales

Overview:

 

Tired of the LA hustle? Thinking about moving to Las Vegas? You'll be in good company—plenty of Californians have already made the move. If you're looking for a fresh start and a great career opportunity, we'd love to hear from you!  

We are seeking a creative, high-energy, and multi-talented Social Media Producer & Graphic Designer to join our media team. This dual-focused role is perfect for a digital storyteller who can seamlessly blend community management with striking visual design.

In this role, you will be the creative force behind five of our distinct radio station brands, driving audience engagement through dynamic social content (video, graphics and written content). Additionally, you will serve as the go-to visual designer for our digital sales team, crafting high-impact marketing collateral, client pitch decks, and digital advertisements that drive revenue.

Audacy offers employees who are eligible for benefits with a comprehensive benefits package which includes: a health care coordinator, medical, dental, vision, mental health, telemedicine, flexible spending accounts, health savings account, disability, life insurance, critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, paid time off (sick, flex-time away/vacation days, personal, parental, volunteer), 401(k) retirement plan, legal assistance, life assistance program, identity theft protection, discounted home and auto insurance, and pet insurance.

Responsibilities

What You'll Do:

Social Media Producer & Content Creation (Approx. 60%)

  • Multi-Account Management: Oversee, curate, and maintain the daily social media presence across multiple platforms (Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, etc.) for five unique radio station brands.
  • Content Production: Concept, shoot, edit, and publish high-performing multimedia content, with a heavy emphasis on short-form video (Reels, TikToks), on-air talent features, station events, and pop-culture trends.
  • Brand Voice & Engagement: Maintain the distinct personality and voice of each station while actively engaging with followers, listeners, and influencers to build community.
  • Analytics & Growth: Track performance metrics across all platforms, adjusting strategies based on data to optimize reach, engagement, and follower growth.

Graphic Design & Sales Support (Approx. 40%)

  • Digital Sales Collateral: Partner with the digital sales team to design compelling media kits, client pitch decks, and sponsorship presentations.
  • Ad & Event Creative: Create eye-catching digital display ads, website banners, concert/event flyers, and promotional graphics for station clients and internal marketing campaigns.
  • Brand Consistency: Ensure all visual assets comply with individual station brand guidelines while pushing the creative envelope.

Qualifications

job.description:
Overview

Job Title: Regional Staff Engineer

Department: Technical

Reporting To: Regional Director, Technical Operations 

Employment Type: Full-Time

Overview:

Audacy is seeking a talented Regional Staff Engineer to join our Houston-based engineering team. This hands-on role is ideal for a proactive professional with robust radio broadcast engineering skills and the flexibility to provide support and travel to multiple markets.

Responsibilities

What You'll Do:

  • Maintain, inspect, and repair all broadcast radio station equipment, including high power FM + HD, AM, digital audio & audio streaming, studio equipment, automation systems, remote control equipment, remote broadcast equipment, satellite downlinks, network infrastructure, generators, backup power systems, and related equipment in keeping with good engineering practices.
  • Support studio operations by managing AOIP networks, studio hardware, UPS systems, remote control equipment, and VOIP/telephone systems.
  • Ensure regulatory compliance by reviewing weekly transmitter and studio logs, EAS tests, and tower lighting requirements per F.C.C. regulations.
  • Install and troubleshoot broadcast IT systems, including WideOrbit and Axia, at both studio and transmitter sites.
  • Oversee critical infrastructure maintenance, including generator testing, fueling, and UPS system supervision.
  • Collaborate with the Corporate Networking Team and vendors to manage ISP/Networking circuits and service calls.
  • Assist in the technical planning and development of facilities, including data networks and backup power systems.
  • Develop instructional materials and provide training for operators on technical equipment and systems.
  • Provide 24/7 emergency support for equipment failures, including availability for weekends and holidays as required.
  • Maintain broadcast IT systems at studios and transmitter sites, such as WideOrbit and Axia 
  • Assist in planning and development of all aspects of technical facilities including studios, transmitters, AOIP, VOIP, satellite, STL, computers and data networks
  • Create instructional materials and teach operators to use technical equipment and systems
  • Handle ISP/Networking problems and service calls. Work with Corp Networking Team, Vendor Technicians to install and troubleshoot circuits.  
  • Generator testing, fueling and supervision of Generator maintenance.
  • UPS testing and supervision of maintenance.
  • Effectively communicate and partner with programming staff as well as outside partners.
  • Additional duties and responsibilities may be assigned as necessary.

Qualifications

More About You:

 

Required:

  • Minimum 5 years broadcast engineering experience.
  • Associate’s degree in electronics preferred.
  • IT networking skills preferred.
  • Knowledge of FCC rules and regulations.
  • Ability to provide support 24/7 in case of equipment failure; available to work various hours/days, including weekends and holidays.
  • FCC General Class License or SBE Certifications are a plus.

Overview

Job Title: Strategic Finance & FP&A Manager

Department: Corporate Finance 

Reporting To: Senior Vice President, Strategic Finance and FP&A 

Employment Type: Full-Time 

Location: Hybrid in New York City 

 

The anticipated salary range for individuals expressing interest in this position is $120,000.00/Yr. - $130,000.00/Yr. and is bonus eligible.

Salary to be determined by the education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities and location of the applicant, as well as internal and external equity.

Role Overview:

Audacy is seeking a high-performing Manager, Strategic Finance & FP&A to drive the financial planning and operational analysis for our Podcasting division while providing corporate finance support at the total-company level.

This role partners closely with the SVP of Strategic Finance, providing hands-on execution support across both podcasting business partnering and corporate finance deliverables. You will bridge the gap between financial analysis and business strategy—translating operational metrics into actionable insights for podcast leadership while supporting enterprise-level executive reporting.

Responsibilities

What You'll Do:

 

Podcasting Business Partnering & Operational FP&A:

  • Executive Business Partnering: Act as a trusted financial partner to Podcasting leadership, Content Development, and Sales Ops, translating operational drivers into financial strategies to maximize division profitability.
  • Business Unit Reporting: Lead the monthly reporting package for the Podcasting division, delivering variance analysis, KPI performance tracking, and operational commentary to podcast leadership. 
  • P&L & Forecast Ownership: Lead monthly rolling forecasting, annual budgeting, and financial performance tracking for the podcasting business unit.
  • Deal Strategy & Commercial Support: Model investment ROI and commercial deal structures for new talent acquisitions, show renewals, and strategic content partnerships.
  • Monetization & Yield Optimization: Partner with ad sales and operations to track yield, inventory utilization, CPM trends, and cost-to-serve dynamics.
  • Financial Operations Oversight: Oversee high-level show financial workflows, ensuring seamless alignment between content operations, vendor invoice processing, and creator payout compliance.

 

Total-Company Strategic Finance:

  • Senior Leadership, Executive & Board Packages: Support preparation of monthly executive reporting packs and quarterly operating reviews; assist in building Board of Directors (BOD) presentation materials.
  • Enterprise Long-Range Planning: Support multi-year 3-statement modeling and the company's long-range planning process.
  • Ad-Hoc Strategic Analysis: Support ad-hoc financial analysis for executive decision-making, including partnership evaluations and cost-efficiency initiatives (with occasional exposure to M&A or strategic transaction analysis as needed).
  • Process & Tool Modernization: Partner across departments to simplify financial consolidation, automate reporting workflows, and enhance business intelligence tools.

Qualifications

More About You:

 

Required & Preferred:

  • Experience: 2–5+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, Strategic Finance, Corporate Development, Investment Banking, or Management Consulting.
  • Industry Exposure: Exposure to Digital Media, Podcasting, Audio, Entertainment, or Advertising Technology preferred, but not required.
  • Business Partnering: Proven ability to build trusted relationships with cross-functional partners outside of finance (Sales, Content, Product, Ops).
  • Financial Modeling: Strong 3-statement modeling skills, scenario planning, and commercial deal evaluation.
  • Executive Communication: Ability to package complex quantitative data into clean visual slides and summaries for executive review.
  • Systems & Tools: Proficiency with core financial tools (advanced Excel required; working experience with NetSuite or Tableau is a plus).
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related field.

Overview:

Audacy’s San Francisco/Northwest Region’s TWIN Division has a rare, full time Traffic/Weather Producer/Reporter position, based at All-News KCBS Radio in San Francisco, the Bay Area’s number one news station. Are you an audacious and tech-savvy broadcast journalist with a positive attitude and impressive work ethic ready to join an elite news radio team? Are you a storyteller with a compelling on-air delivery? Can you translate dispatcher-speak into a language everyone can understand? Can you voice a weather report that doesn’t require a meteorology degree to follow?

 

You should have an expertise and high-comfort level with all things IT, a second-nature social media proficiency (Instagram, Tik Tok) with a natural curiosity and desire to touch the listener in as many ways as imaginable. You are expected to work under tight deadlines in a fast-paced newsroom. We are seeking a broadcast journalist who collaborates with editors and producers. You will be expected to actively participate on various social media channels and contribute content to the Audacy’s digital platforms. You must be passionate, committed, self-motivated and agreeable to a flexible work schedule, which may include evenings, overnights and/or weekends. Excellent written and verbal communication skills are required, and candidates must be able to take a detail-oriented approach to work while meeting tight deadlines. This is not a job for a beginner. Experience in a major market is a plus.

Responsibilities

What You'll Do:

  • Report from the Newsroom over the course of multiple hours on KCBS Radio and other Audacy and non-Audacy stations
  • Gather, write, record, edit and deliver traffic/weather/news content inclusive of providing live coverage
  • Conceptualize, pitch, produce and voice live and/or recorded traffic/weather segments
  • Interview traffic/weather news makers
  • Write scripts and ad-lib material for stories
  • Use social media - including but not limited to Instagram and Tik Tok - during the course of your shift to connect with listeners, promote upcoming stories and interviews, and to highlight station content
  • Contribute content - including but not limited to audio, video and written format - to Audacy’s digital platforms
  • Develop and research potential traffic/weather stories
  • Provide live reads of sponsors within designated reports by the company including logging commercials, mentions, entitlements and discrepancies
  • Record sponsor spec and demo spots as needed
  • Make station appearances as required
  • Protect the station’s FCC licenses
  • Other duties as required by management
  • Position offers SAG-AFTRA Benefits and applicant must be willing to join SAG-AFTRA, (Union Code 105)

Required & Preferred:

  • Minimum 2-year traffic/weather/sports/news reporting for broadcast media
  • Must be computer literate, have excellent writing and presentation skills

Location(s): Philadelphia, PA

Overview:

KYW Newsradio is seeking a dynamic, multi-talented part-time news writer and editor to join our award winning all-news team.

 

This is a critical role responsible for curating, writing, and producing a daypart of all-news radio. The ideal candidate is an agile jounralist and excellent communicator who can excel working closely and collaboratively with a dynamic and diverse newsroom of reporters and anchors, writing and editing and updating daily newscasts and working with newsroom staff to deliver live and breaking news to the people of Greater Philadelphia.

job.title: Director of Editorial, Axios Live
job.description:
1 big thing: The Director of Editorial, Axios Live will oversee editorial content, event framing, and strategic list building for Axios Live programming, leading a small team to ensure Axios’ editorial standards, Smart Brevity style, and journalistic integrity are upheld across all public-facing materials, roundtable discussions, and editorial products, including recap articles. 

Why it matters: As Axios Live expands across live convenings and executive roundtables, this role serves as the crucial editorial compass. You will be a high-caliber editorial leader and manager who applies sharp news judgment to shape timely event concepts, curate high-level editorial rooms, take an active role in real-time coverage of Axios’ biggest live event moments, and deliver post-event recaps that read as sharp journalism.

Go deeper: Axios Live events are among the most sought-after convenings in business, policy, and technology. Reporting to the Head of Editorial Live, the Editorial Director will ensure that our events portfolio reflects our editorial standards, diverse points of view, and help Axios stay at the forefront of news.

In this role, you will:

  • Oversee the drafting, editing, and approval of public-facing live event materials, including event concepts, registration pages, Axios webpages, social coverage, and post-event recap articles using Axios Smart Brevity.
  • Oversee the curation and tiering of editorial participants for Axios Roundtables. Ensure tables feature balanced, expert perspectives across sectors while maintaining editorial control over seating charts and participant mix.
  • Lead, coach, and manage a small, high-performing team of editorial writers and coordinators; set clear priorities, assign events, review deliverables, and foster a collaborative environment.
  • Manage coverage assignments and collaboration with the newsroom around covering some of Axios Live’s biggest stages including our Summit and House products. 
  • Own day-of editorial coverage for assigned live events, serving as the primary liaison to reporters and the newsroom, coordinating quick-turn coverage, leading live social reporting, and writing post-event recaps.
  • Work in close alignment with the Head of Editorial Live, newsroom SMEs/reporters, events operations, pre-sale, sales, and client leads to ensure seamless event execution and brand alignment.
  • Manage real-time editorial flow during live events, brief moderators, ensure all event materials are easily/immediately accessible for breaking news moments, and resolve and be the lead voice of editorial judgement for live editorial issues on the ground.
  • Guide the team in utilizing approved AI tools and custom GPTs to streamline initial research, concept brainstorming, and list discovery while rigorously enforcing accuracy and Smart Brevity standards.

Worthy of your time: Ideal candidates will embody an entrepreneurial spirit, possess exceptional news judgment, and bring the following skills:

  • 6–8+ years of journalism, editorial editing, live-event content creation, or public policy/media experience, ideally within a fast-paced newsroom or live news setting.
  • Proven people management experience, with a track record of coaching editorial team members and reviewing high-volume written deliverables under tight deadlines.
  • Sharp editorial and news judgment, with a deep understanding of policy, business, and tech trends, alongside a strong command of Axios Smart Brevity.
  • Demonstrated expertise in room curation and list strategy, with an understanding of how to build senior, balanced executive tables (C-suite, policymakers, operators, subject-matter experts).
  • Experience navigating commercial/client partnerships while maintaining editorial independence, neutrality, and journalistic red lines.
  • Exceptional writing, line-editing, and copy-editing skills, with the ability to develop sharp, audience-facing event concepts and language, distill complex ideas into clear editorial framing, and produce concise, high-value recap articles.
  • High operational rigor to manage overlapping deadlines across event concept pipelines, guest lists, seating charts, and post-event publications.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted research and editing tools, balancing efficiency with journalistic verification.
  • Ability to travel for major Axios Live events and activations as needed.

Starting salary for this role is in the range of $110,000 - $130,000 and is dependent on numerous factors, including but not limited to location, work experience, and skills. This range does not include other compensation benefits. Axios' compensation philosophy takes into account cost of labor differentials across the country. Because this is a remote-optional job posting, this salary range takes into account all possible locations within the United States, but candidates will only be eligible for the salary range for their location.

Axios is committed to embracing artificial intelligence as a core part of how we work. All team members are expected to actively develop AI literacy and use AI tools to enhance their productivity, creativity, and efficiency. We invest in ongoing learning to ensure every employee is equipped to responsibly and effectively integrate AI into their daily workflows.

job.description:
The big picture: Axios is looking for a Senior Manager of National & SME Growth to lead subscriber acquisition and audience growth across our national newsletter portfolio and a new SME audience growth initiative.

This is a highly visible growth role focused on scaling Axios’s flagship national newsletters while helping build and validate a new SME audience acquisition strategy.

Go deeper: The Senior Manager of National & SME Growth is a strategic, data-driven growth leader responsible for acquisition strategy, experimentation, channel diversification, and audience expansion. In this role, you will:

National Subscriber Growth

  • Own subscriber growth targets across Axios’s national newsletter portfolio
  • Execute acquisition strategies across paid, owned, and earned channels
  • Monitor audience composition, growth performance, and acquisition efficiency
  • Contribute insights and recommendations to weekly growth reporting

Paid Media & Channel Diversification

  • Establish and optimize CAC and conversion benchmarks by audience segment

Distribution, Retention & Operations

  • Partner with Lifecycle Marketing on onboarding, engagement, and retention initiatives

  • Strong analytical skills across CAC, LTV, attribution, and funnel optimization
  • Experience with modern martech and analytics tools (Braze, Segment, Sigma, Piano, etc.)
