Behind the scenes, but ahead of the curve: help us develop the next-generation public service media.

 

The Technology & Infrastructure (T&I) team is the backbone and the future-forward arm of CBC/Radio-Canada. Our purpose is to constantly innovate to evolve and maintain the Corporation's technologies and infrastructure, enabling the creation and continued delivery of quality content across all platforms. We are the people that make stuff work. We make connections between media content, systems, people, and places. We are the space in between.

 

A place with purpose. CBC/Radio-Canada has always been a highly regarded pioneer of media technology—not just in Canada, but around the world. Today, we are transforming ourselves into a modern and agile public service media organization. Technology is the driving force and we are the team making it happen.

 

This is a hybrid role with a mix of in-office and remote work. Work arrangements will be discussed with hiring managers per departmental guidelines and operational needs.

 

The Opportunity

 

Are you passionate about technology transformation, evolving operating models and shaping new ways of working from concept through to adoption? In this key role, you will serve as a strategic technology transformation adviser to leaders and teams, helping diagnose challenges, define and structure change initiatives, and drive operational implementation and adoption across the organization.

 

Reporting to the Director of the Operational Excellence Office within Technology & Infrastructure (T&I), you will join the team leading the Daily Content initiative in Innovation & Delivery. You will be joining us at a pivotal moment as CBC/Radio-Canada undergoes a major overhaul to modernize its content creation platforms. This transformation goes beyond software and tools — it redefines how production platforms are designed, delivered and used within an organizational model focused on product management, agile at scale, and continuous value creation.

 

In this role, you will combine a strategic consulting mindset with hands-on execution across all stages of the transformation. You will analyze complex issues, challenge established ways of working and provide actionable recommendations while actively driving their implementation by designing and producing the strategies, plans, frameworks, tools and other deliverables needed to execute and adopt the transformation.

 

Key areas of focus include transitioning to a product management model, modernizing collaboration with partners and contributors, and driving user adoption of new production tools. You will help define, structure and roll out the transformation and change management strategies required across all levels of the organization.

 

You will also play a central role in bringing together and aligning diverse teams and stakeholders across CBC/Radio-Canada around a shared vision and common goals. Your ability to grasp and navigate a complex organizational ecosystem, balance operational constraints and competing priorities, and exert influence without direct authority will be essential to align perspectives, build consensus, streamline decision-making and remove roadblocks.

 

Working alongside key stakeholders, you will support the organization in preparing for and implementing changes — including by developing and rolling out effective engagement and communications strategies — and by preparing and supporting end users in tandem with our Learning & Development partners.

 

You will work closely with operational and strategic leaders, as well as with the Daily Content Director, to structure challenges, shape recommendations and guide the evolution of work practices and production tools.

 

As a member of T&I’s Operational Excellence Office, you will help ensure alignment, practical execution and long-term adoption of the transformation by continuously refining our approaches based on results, key insights and frontline needs. Beyond the Daily Content initiative, you will also help build the Office’s methods, practices and capabilities as well as nurture a transformation community of practice across CBC/Radio-Canada to share lessons learned and scale high-impact practices.

 

This position can be based in Toronto or Montreal, with occasional travel required.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Advise leaders and teams on defining and implementing technology transformations, engaging early in the life cycle to analyze needs, diagnose challenges, identify required changes and deliver recommendations aligned with the organization's vision and goals.
  • Guide departments and divisions in evolving their operating models and ways of working, advising on process design, governance, roles and responsibilities, and team collaboration structures.
  • Develop approaches, frameworks and tools to structure and implement transformation — including simple, scalable and reusable interaction models and practical guides — with a focus on change management, Lean, SAFe and Scrum methodologies.
  • Design and execute change management and adoption strategies and plans, incorporating impact assessments, organizational readiness, risk mitigation and stakeholder support.
  • Define and lead engagement, communication and capacity-building strategies — including user training and the preparation of delivery teams and change agents — in partnership with Learning & Development.
  • Proactively identify and resolve risks, resistance and operational roadblocks that could hinder transformation and adoption.
  • Define and track metrics to measure the progress, adoption and effectiveness of new ways of working, using data and insights to continuously refine strategies.
  • Actively participate in key transformation forums and events, including strategic and alignment meetings, sprint reviews, program demos and quarterly planning sessions.

 

What You Bring

  • Undergraduate degree in business administration, technology or a field relevant to organizational transformation (or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience).
  • Seven to 10 years' experience leading large-scale technology transformations, including evolving technology operating models, processes, governance structures, roles and responsibilities, and ways of working within complex, matrixed environments.
  • Proven track record as a strategic transformation adviser, with strong skills in analyzing and diagnosing complex issues, challenging current practices, formulating actionable recommendations and guiding execution.
  • Solid understanding of product management models and agile practices at scale, with hands-on experience applying them to tech transformations. Expertise in SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework), Scrum or other scaled agile frameworks required.
  • Experience with Lean and iterative transformation approaches, alongside the ability to adapt strategies and solutions based on key insights, data and frontline needs.
  • Demonstrated experience in end-to-end change management and adoption, including impact analysis, stakeholder engagement, strategic communications and capability building.
  • Knowledge of media production, broadcasting workflows and related technologies (e.g., audio/video editing, publishing, distribution, graphics generation) a major asset.

Are you a vibrant community connector? Creative brand storyteller? Strategic social media marketer?


Your role

CBC Yukon is looking for a Senior Communications and Marketing Specialist to join the CBC Marketing, Communications and Brand team in Whitehorse, YT.


The successful candidate will report to the Manager of Communications, Marketing and Brand for the North, including Yukon, Northwest Territories, Nunavut, and Nunavik. They will collaborate with team members to implement a variety of marketing/communications strategies, projects and initiatives to support CBC’s digital, radio and television programming across the North. 


This position requires someone with a passion for storytelling and relationship building, a deep understanding of the diverse and changing demographics of the region, and who thrives in fast-paced environments and relishes that no two days are the same


This is a permanent position based in Whitehorse, YT. This position is hybrid. An in-office presence in the CBC Whitehorse’s station is required, as is the ability to travel and work at community events and locations across the region as required. 


Duties for this position may include: 

  • Advancing strategic objectives to grow CBC’s connections with younger, diverse audiences, creating strategies to identify new audiences and reach people where they are, both in-person and online.
  • Leading and developing community engagement activities for CBC in the North including working closely with community partners and editorial colleagues on station initiatives, outreach opportunities, community events and stakeholder engagement.
  • Developing, implementing and monitoring strategic integrated marketing plans to promote the CBC brand, programming and initiatives across all platforms (social, digital, radio, TV). 
  • Collaborating with cross-functional teams and departments to develop and generate strategic campaigns that attract target audiences and foster meaningful engagement.
  • Create and implement innovative social media strategies to deepen our community connection and promote awareness and attendance for campaigns and events with new audiences. 
  • Creating strategies to identify new audiences, create tailored on-line experiences, foster brand engagement and enable community connection. 
  • Develop reports demonstrating campaign successes as well as identifying key learnings.
  • Collaborate with marketing communications teams across CBC to elevate national priorities and campaigns while supporting editorial objectives and journalism standards and practices.
  • Cultivate and manage relationships with internal and external partners including community members, partner organizations and vendors.

We are looking for a candidate with the following: 

  • Post-secondary certificate, diploma or a university degree in Communications/Public Relations or Marketing, or an equivalent combination of education, training and experience. 
  • Five or more years of experience in communications, public relations and/or marketing.
  • A strong proven connection to the communities we serve across the North, and experience developing strategies to connect with new, younger and more diverse audiences.
  • Superior writing, editing and proofreading skills, working knowledge of a wide range of communications and marketing materials and tactics and ability to adapt writing for different audiences and platforms.
  • Strong organization and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple projects on tight deadlines and with attention to detail.
  • Demonstrated ability to plan and coordinate events, both in-person and virtual, including development of critical path, run of show and briefing documents, and understanding of budget management.
  • Demonstrated public speaking and networking skills.
  • Superior social media marketing skills, with a keen understanding of digital/social trends and demonstrable success in creating social media content (filming, editing, posting according to brand guidelines), executing strategies/campaigns and managing business channels.
  • Ability to leverage research data to drive marketing decisions.
  • Experience with Google Suite tools (Docs, Drive, Sheets, Slides, Calendar, Meet).
  • Experience with Dash Social or other social media tools, and video editing tools with an understanding of creation, editing, captions for social media content purposes.
  • Flexibility in work hours as workflow demands, including the ability to work shift work, including evenings, weekends and holidays, as required.
  • Availability to travel across the team’s region for short periods if required. A valid driver’s licence as well as a driving record that meets the minimum requirements of CBC/Radio-Canada's insurance company is considered an asset.
  • Knowledge of languages other than English is considered an asset, particularly an Indigenous language.
  • Demonstrated connection to and knowledge of Indigenous cultures and communities, and of the North.

Role Purpose:

Reporting to the Senior Director, Total Compensation, the Senior Manager, Total Compensation leads a team of two Senior Specialists in the governance, strategic design, implementation, and continuous improvement of CBC/Radio-Canada's core total compensation and associated programs. Serving as an operational leader, this role ensures robust compensation governance, provides expert advisory services across Human Resources and Industrial Relations, and leads the functional oversight of the People and Culture Access to Information and Privacy (ATIP) portfolio.

Key Responsibilities:

Compensation Governance, Strategy & Program Management

  • Establish, review, and evolve corporate standards, policies, and methodologies for all compensation-related programs across the Corporation (including market benchmarking, pay structures, job evaluations, and salary reviews).

  • Lead the annual salary planning (merit review) cycle, external market benchmarking studies, and comprehensive pay scale reviews.

  • Develop, implement, and monitor job evaluation plans to ensure regulatory compliance, process efficiency, and alignment with corporate benchmarks.

  • Conduct regular and specialized research into internal and external market practices; develop revised pay structures, models, and policy recommendations for senior leadership.

  • Recommend and implement updates to compensation and related policies to maintain the Corporation’s target competitive market position while ensuring full regulatory compliance and alignment with the corporate strategy.

Pay Equity & Union Collaboration

  • Participate in the implementation of the Corporation’s Pay Equity Plan in close collaboration with unions, leadership, and external consultants.

  • Oversee and conduct mandatory 5-year Pay Equity Audits in accordance with federal regulations, coordinating directly with union representatives and joint committees.

  • Provide strategic compensation input and recommendations for collective bargaining negotiations; provide support  to the Total Compensation expert representative at the bargaining table when required.

Strategic Partnerships & System Optimization

  • Partner with HRIS and HR Services teams in the continuous enhancement and optimization of HR Information Systems (Workday), identifying opportunities to streamline workflows and improve data efficiency.

  • Collaborate with the Benefits and Pension teams to foster a unified Total Rewards model and deliver clear, compelling Total Rewards employee communications.

  • Maintain an integrated HR approach, partnering closely with Talent Management & OD, Industrial Relations, HR Services, and HR Business Partners to ensure cohesive client service delivery.

ATIP & Regulatory Portfolio Oversight

  • Lead the Access to Information and Privacy (ATIP) portfolio for People & Culture, serving as the primary liaison with the corporate ATIP office and external governing bodies.

  • Manage and coordinate all People & Culture responses to ATIP, Privy Council Office, Statistics Canada, and other government/regulatory requests, ensuring accurate and timely delivery.

  • Provide functional guidance, coaching, and subject-matter expertise to HR Business Partners and Talent Acquisition leads on compensation frameworks and ATIP compliance principles.

Team Leadership & Operational Oversight

  • Direct, coach, and mentor a team of two Senior Specialists, establishing clear performance goals, providing developmental feedback, and fostering high team engagement.

  • Oversee the team’s daily workload to ensure high-quality, compliant execution of specialized compensation projects, advisory services, and continuous process improvements.

  • Influence and collaborate across People & Culture to promote process efficiency and operational productivity linked to Total Rewards and ATIP programs.

  • Go to resource when the Senior Director, Total Compensation is unavailable.

Qualifications, Experience & Skills:

Education & Experience

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources Management, Business Administration, Industrial Relations, or a related field (Master’s degree preferred).

  • Professional Experience: 8 to 10 years of progressive HR experience, with at least 5 years dedicated to compensation design, governance, and administration.

  • Leadership Experience: Minimum 2 to 3 years of experience directly managing, supervising, or mentoring direct reports or project teams.

  • Environment: Proven experience working within a complex, unionized public, Crown or private sector environment is strongly preferred.

  • Certifications: CCP (Certified Compensation Professional) or CHRL (Certified Human Resources Leader) designation is an asset.

Knowledge & Skills

  • Bilingualism: Fully bilingual in French and English (written and spoken) is mandatory.

  • Compensation Expertise: Advanced expertise in base pay design, job evaluation methodologies, market salary surveys, and federal pay equity legislation.

  • ATIP & Privacy Knowledge: Strong working knowledge of Access to Information and Privacy regulations and governance principles within the public sector context is an asset.

  • Critical Thinking & Decision-Making: Superior analytical capability and sound judgment to resolve complex, precedent-setting issues while balancing business needs with policy compliance.

  • Interpersonal & Strategic Communication: Excellent negotiation, diplomacy, and communication skills with a demonstrated ability to build strong cross-functional partnerships and influence senior executive stakeholders.

Behind the scenes, but ahead of the curve: help us develop the next-generation public service media organization.

Technology & Infrastructure (T&I) is the backbone and the future-forward arm of CBC/Radio-Canada. Our purpose is to constantly innovate to evolve and maintain the Corporation’s technology and infrastructure. We are the people that make stuff work. We make connections between media content, systems, people and places. We are the space in between.

A place with purpose. CBC/Radio-Canada has always been a highly regarded pioneer of media technology — not just in Canada but around the world. Today, we are transforming ourselves into a modern and agile public service media organization. Technology is the driving force, and we are the team making it happen.

This is a hybrid role with a mix of in-office and remote work. Work arrangements will be discussed with hiring managers per departmental guidelines.

The opportunity

CBC/Radio-Canada operates one of the world’s leading technology infrastructures and one of the largest private networks, which distributes its content and services across the country. CBC/Radio-Canada is looking for a technical senior manager, project oriented, to join our Engineering team. This position requires an interesting mix of leadership and expertise. This is a full-time permanent position, and the successful incumbent would be based in Montreal, with eventual and occasional travel to various other sites nationally.

What’s in it for you?

Challenges. We spend our days solving problems of all kinds. Media systems workflows are highly specialized and complicated; updating, installing and supporting technologies that are organization-wide and that impact broadcasting content is a time-sensitive, complex technical feat. And that’s just the beginning; we have challenges on all fronts. Reporting to the Director, you will help to manage the IT / Telecom Engineering team, support the implementation of important initiatives, help to improve our standards and best practices, as well as build bridges with other departments. Additionally, you will be afforded to work with cutting-edge technology and their experts.  

Perks you can look forward to:

  • Four weeks of vacation per year.
  • Work from home opportunities.
  • Competitive total rewards package.
  • Opportunities to work with cutting edge technology.
  • Opportunities for continued learning and professional development - including access to e-learning services, customized courses and certification opportunities.
  • Opportunities to become a member of our Employee Resource Groups.
  • A creative and dynamic work environment, where your ideas and contributions can be heard, valued and respected.
  • A supportive management team committed to upholding the highest standards of diversity and inclusivity.

As our new Senior Manager, you will:

  • Work on strategic planning of technical resources.
  • Provide support and technical guidance to departmental employees.
  • Meet with stakeholders and business partners to determine requirements and solutions.
  • Take ownership of complex and strategic initiatives.
  • Track the schedules, budgets and progress on initiatives.
  • Contribute to the execution of complex procurement processes.
  • Manage a multidisciplinary team of technical professionals along with associated administrative processes.
  • Define, communicate, and monitor clear priorities, objectives, and performance metrics.
  • Actively participate to create an efficient and agile work environment.
  • Identify opportunities of operational, technical improvements and build innovative processes.

What you bring:

  • Experience in a leadership position and the management of various technical resources.
  • Experience in project management, specifically with the Agile approach.
  • Experience in delivery of high impact and complex technological projects.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Applied Science or Engineering, or a Diploma In Applied Science and Technology.
  • Membership, or eligibility to become a member, of the provincial Engineering Association (PEO, OIQ, … etc) is mandatory.
  • Strong, influential and clear communication skills, in English and French, considered a strong asset.
  • Strong commitment to ethical conduct and adherence to high business standards.
  • Acts as a role model by promoting a culture of trust, fairness, and compliance with organizational policies, and industry best practices.
  • Expertise on various technologies : Networking, Data centers, cabling infrastructure, IT systems (Compute, Storage, Virtualization & Cloud).
  • Knowledge on ST-2110 standards, multicasting, Telecom rooms, cybersecurity, and data management or relevant certifications is considered an asset.
  • Ability to build and maintain strong relationships with employees, peers, partners, management and external vendors.
  • Demonstrates sound decision-making abilities and effective delegation skills.
  • Proven ability to mobilize teams and quickly adapt to shifting priorities.
  • Ability to travel to different CBC locations to oversee different phases of projects.

Your Role

 

Manage enterprise AI roadmap, develop and maintain enterprise AI value framework, reporting, consolidate annual and quarterly AI initiative plans across components, ensure internal alignment and collaboration.

 

Main Responsibilities and Impact:

  • Consolidate business-unit level plans for AI initiatives to deliver against enterprise AI strategy priorities, plan and lead the execution of corporate AI initiatives.
  • Build and maintain the enterprise AI initiative roadmap to ensure delivery, in alignment with strategic priorities.
  • Identify and lead select priority projects, collaborating with relevant teams from across the Corporation and external vendors as needed.

  • Support cross-functional execution of AI initiatives.
  • Develop and implement communication strategies for enterprise AI projects.

  • Develop and maintain tracking and reporting mechanisms for enterprise AI initiatives and overall, AI strategy for internal alignment, SET/Board level visibility.
  • Oversee delivery of commitments relating to domestic and international AI partnerships and industry support activities.

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Strategy or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • Project management certifications (eg: PMP) are a strong plus.

 

Experience (relevant to the role):

  • Demonstrable ability to analyze business metrics, generate actionable insights and report on performance.
  • Key asset: Proficiency with enterprise and consumer AI tools such as LLMs for productivity, familiarity with AI agents and related workflows.

Senior Producer, Audience Growth(English Services) (On-Site)

CBC British Columbia is looking for an experienced newsroom leader who understands how to create content that will grow younger audiences where they look for it - on their phones.

This is a full-time, temporary 10-month position.

As CBC News prioritizes the needs of mobile and streaming audiences and delivers content that aligns with our strategic objectives, the new senior producer of audience growth ensures CBC's content directly connects with people who live and work in the province, including new and younger Canadians. You understand what people want to consume — and where, when, and how they want to consume it. You are obsessed with optimizing display content - the headlines, images and framing that audiences first see when they encounter our stories across platforms.

You bring a deep understanding of platform behaviours, effective publishing practices, video formats, SEO, comments, moderation and audience expectations. You understand and keep up to date on industry trends and technologies. You know how to package compelling text and video for CBC’s mobile and streaming news apps, as well as third‑party platforms like YouTube and TikTok. 

As a strong editorial leader reporting to the executive producers of CBC British Columbia, you work closely with reporters and producers to ensure daily digital storytelling is innovative, timely and consistent with CBC's Journalistic Standards and Practices. You work in conjunction with the wider Audience Growth team to support best practices that set us up to win on mobile and streaming platforms. You are constantly communicating learnings and data back to the teams.

The position requires full-time, on-site presence at the Vancouver CBC Office. 

Key Responsibilities:

  • Provide and interpret audience data to newsroom leaders to help inform their programming decisions.

  • Provide clear, actionable feedback to teams on audience needs and publishing and packaging fundamentals.

  • Work in partnership with CBC News’ Audience Growth team to:

  • Communicate audience insights and context across all platforms to daily news teams.

  • Establish best practices across platforms to deliver on measurable audience growth goals for CBC News.

  • Optimize high-performing local stories (including photos, graphics headlines, story-framing, sidebars, etc.).

  • Evolve tactics for growing local audiences, including new platform experiments (e.g., WhatsApp).

  • Identify training needs across the newsroom.

  • Partner with EPs and MEs to set regional audience targets aligned with engagement objectives.

  • Make quick editorial decisions under pressure in complex, time‑sensitive environments.

  • Work closely with teams to get breaking news to the audience quickly and cohesively.

  • Monitor trends across digital media and adapt workflows and publishing strategies as needed.

  • Partner with executive producers and CBC British Columbia’s Managing Editors to set regional audience targets aligned with engagement objectives.

  • Use key production tools (9CMS, DTV, Media Central, Dalet, Adobe).

Skills & Experience:

  • Minimum seven years of journalism experience, five years of which must include video experience in a breaking news environment.

  • Experience interpreting audience analytics and applying them to editorial and strategic decisions.

  • Demonstrated ability to assign, motivate, and develop staff.

  • Excellent editorial judgment and a strong understanding of CBC’s Journalistic Standards and Practices.

  • Proven passion for strong journalism, innovative video storytelling, and sharp, effective writing.

  • Experience in copy editing, fact‑checking, packaging, and production across platforms.

  • Intimate knowledge and experience producing different video formats, such as vertical and mobile‑optimized storytelling.

  • Nuanced understanding of audience behaviours on social and video‑sharing platforms.

  • Comfortable with constant change; able to adapt, communicate clearly, and maintain composure.

  • Strong coaching skills and ability to train staff quickly.

  • Cultural awareness, openness, and collaborative communication skills.

  • Ability to work flexible hours, including early mornings, evenings, weekends, and holidays.

  • Ability to meet tight deadlines and navigate unexpected overtime.

  • University degree or equivalent experience

Behind the scenes, but ahead of the curve: help us develop the next-generation public service media organization.

 

Technology & Infrastructure (T&I) is the backbone and the future-forward arm of CBC/Radio-Canada. Our purpose is to constantly innovate to evolve and maintain the Corporation’s technology and infrastructure. We are the people that make stuff work. We make connections between media content, systems, people and places. We are the space in between.

 

A place with purpose. CBC/Radio-Canada has always been a highly regarded pioneer of media technology — not just in Canada but around the world. Today, we are transforming ourselves into a modern and agile public service media organization. Technology is the driving force, and we are the team making it happen.

 

This is a hybrid position with a mix of in-office and remote work. Work arrangements will be discussed with hiring managers per departmental guidelines.

 

This position can be based in Montreal, Toronto or Ottawa.


Your Role

 

The Data Governance Analyst operationalizes and drives the adoption of the enterprise data governance framework across the organization. This role acts as a critical bridge between the central Data Governance Office, domain-level data teams, and business stakeholders. The Analyst ensures that policies, data quality programs, and tooling (such as the enterprise data catalog) are seamless to adopt, clearly understood, and effectively tracked from the operational level up to executive council briefings.

 

Main Responsibilities:

  • Framework & Tool Deployment: Support the rollout of the enterprise data governance program, including frameworks, policies, and the implementation of the enterprise data catalog.
  • Manage the activities and artifacts (deliverables, documentations, reports) of the enterprise data governance office.
  • Drive the communication and adoption of data governance roles framework across domains, coordinate the activities of cross-domain working groups and communities of practice as needed.
  • Guiding and supporting data officers, stewards, and custodians by providing practical tools, templates, and guidance. Focus on designing user-friendly processes that make data compliance easier for teams to adopt.
  • Cross-Domain Facilitation: Manage regular communications and touchpoints with distributed business unit data teams to drive framework adoption, monitor progress, and ensure organizational consistency.
  • Roadmap & Milestone Tracking: Partner with data domains to communicate, track, and support the prioritization of data governance milestones within their respective roadmaps and planning cycles.
  • Organize and facilitate meetings, workshops, and working groups; take ownership of documenting, communicating, and tracking post-meeting action items to completion.
  • Stakeholder Education: Serve as an internal data governance advocate. Simplify complex data compliance, metadata, and role-and-responsibility concepts into clear, accessible language for non-technical stakeholders.
  • Maintain up-to-date repository of data governance documentation, standards, and best practices to ensure a single source of truth for the organization.
  • Collaborate with Data Engineering and BI teams to develop and maintain automated data governance dashboards and metrics, tracking overall program progress and compliance.
  • Support the planning, delivery, and reporting of data quality initiatives, including the definition of quality scores and the formal tracking of data quality issues.
  • Develop, synthesize, and deliver clear presentation materials and briefings for executive discussions, stakeholder communications, cross-domain data committees.

 

Qualifications, Experience and Skills:

 

Education:

  • Undergraduate degree in business, engineering, computer science, or quantitative discipline with 3+ years of relevant experience in data governance, management or analytics functions.

 

Experience (relevant to the role):

  • Experience in program development and using data governance tools and platforms such as Collibra, Microsoft, Databricks, Informatica, or similar platforms.
  • Working knowledge of data management concepts, processes, and tools (e.g., Collibra, JIRA, Confluence), with familiarity in SQL and cloud platforms.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Versatility and adaptability to handle diverse tasks.
  • Effective communication and documentation abilities.
  • Dashboard, reporting and data visualization tool experience an asset (eg: PowerBI, Tableau).
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate across business and technology teams.
  • Experience coordinating with data vendors is a plus.
  • Effective stakeholder engagement and relationship‑management skills, including the ability to prepare materials, brief senior leaders, and drive collaboration across diverse internal teams.

This is a 100% on-site position with the possibility of travel to remote locations. Full driver licence class 5 is required. 

Your role:

Senior Systems Analyst manages and supports server-based systems and processes within CBC-Radio Canada’s media production ecosystem.

Responsibilities:

Deploy, maintain and support physical and virtual server-based systems and processes.

Maintain and update automated control room systems (e.g. Ross Overdrive, VizRT, MOSS/iNews protocol)

Provides leadership, planning and coordination of projects to effectively manage the upgrading and maintenance of supported systems, following formal methodologies and change management processes.

Provide escalation level support to frontline support teams. Coordinate work of frontline technical staff.

Provide support, training and mentorship to junior staff and colleagues.

Troubleshoot and resolve moderate to very complex issues within tightly integrated systems that support critical applications.

Participate in off-hours on-call schedule to provide 24/7 support for critical systems.

Develop and implement maintenance procedures, monitor system health, gather system statistics, and troubleshoot reported errors and alarms.

Conduct thorough analysis of technical issues and provide feedback to senior management and production partners.

Develop operational procedures and standards for new systems. Define, coordinate and execute test procedures to validate and improve system functionality.

Log issues and detail solutions in appropriate documentation systems to retain corporate memory and to aid in resolving future problems of a similar nature.

Implement best practices for scalability, supportability, ease of maintenance, and system performance. Configure and design systems to fulfill requirements for uninterrupted 24/7 operation.

Analyze requirements, evaluate hardware and software, and make recommendations for upgrades and acquisitions. Liaise with the vendors to ensure successful acquisition of required components as well as successful integration with other systems.

Plan, coordinate and implement system configurations for new installations or upgrades including security settings, directory structures, networking requirements, access control, capacity requirements and interfacing with databases and/or other applications to meet client requirements.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

Requires strong knowledge of hardware and software configurations, security, performance and utilization methodologies, and familiarity with networked/distributed computing environment concepts and high availability clusters.

Requires ability to write scripts using languages and tools available on supported platforms.

Solid understanding of video and audio system design, file based and streaming codecs, including publishing to cloud based end-points.

Strong troubleshooting skills, an understanding of trend analysis, familiarity with backup/recovery procedures and knowledge of technical processes and methodologies to ensure maximum system efficiency is required.

Solid understanding of network connectivity, technologies, protocols, and security.

Understanding of formal methodologies of project management and change management is an asset.

Strong communication and interpersonal skills, ability to manage multiple competing priorities and to manage time effectively.

Configure and maintain LAWO VSM (Virtual Studio Manager) as the primary control layer for ST 2110 IP media fabrics.

Experience creating and modifying VSM gadgets, logic gates, and storage groups to automate complex routing workflows.

Manage the integration of LAWO hardware (Power Core, On-Air Designer, theWall) with VSM for seamless tally, labeling, and signal orchestration.

Experience using VSM to bridge LAWO IP infrastructure with third-party vendors (e.g., Sony, Grass Valley, Evertz).

Execute advanced programming and configuration of the RTS Adam Intercom system, including port allocation, alpha assignments, and GPIO interfaces.

Ability to manage the Avid Interplay (Production Management) environment including Avid Airspeeds and Nexis Storage Array.

Education and Experience:

Graduate of College or University in Computer Science, Information Technology, Television & Radio Production, or related discipline.

Traditional TV and Radio broadcast knowledge is essential.

Minimum 5 years of applicable technical experience in either TV & Radio Production or Computer Science.

Proven experience installing, configuring and managing Linux and Windows based server operating systems.

Knowledge of 2110 and AES67 is an asset

Experience designing and supporting file based workflows is an asset.

Your role


The CBC Gem team is looking for a skilled Senior Writer (one-year contract) to write punchy, engaging audience-facing copy throughout the streaming service.

Working under the supervision of the Manager, CBC Gem Merchandising, you will write text copy that appears throughout CBC Gem including (but not limited to) short and long series descriptions; carousel copy; collection titles and descriptions. 


We’re looking for someone who can take inputs from a range of sources ranging from independent producers, production executives, distributors, marketing assets, and translate these into scintillating copy with the voice of CBC Gem, drawing audiences in and leading them toward their next stream. 


The ideal candidate will have an extensive background in editorial writing or journalism, the skill of ‘writing short’, as well as a strong interest and knowledge of TV, film, News, Sports and the streaming media space. 


Advice and guidance will be available but initiative and independent judgment are also expected. Your work will involve close collaboration with multiple program units throughout CBC, as well as with our partners.

Since CBC Gem offers a range of both Video on Demand (VOD) and live programming, your role will also have a mix of both long-planned activities along with more responsive, quick-turn writing to respond to in-the-moment events.

Main responsibilities:


  • Writing audience-facing text copy throughout CBC Gem; including series and movie descriptions; collection titles and descriptions; carousel copy;
  • Working closely with the team to maintain a clear, authentic and vibrant voice; 
  • Monitoring best practices in the streaming space for text copy and title packaging;
  • Maintaining a copy calendar and database of descriptions;
  • Immersing yourself in the CBC Gem content library;
  • Reviewing content performance to make data-driven decisions;
  • Working closely with cross-functional teams across the corporation including, but not limited to, the Gem Programming Office, Merchandising, Marketing and Publicity, and Digital Product & Innovation.

Your profile: 

  • University degree or equivalent;
  • Five years of relevant experience;
  • Excellent interpersonal and organizational skills, along with the ability to work under deadlines and with multiple priorities;
  • Keen interest in and an ability to keep pace and adapt to the evolving trends of the streaming media space;
  • Knowledge of and affinity for CBC, its programming and services, and understanding of the media industry;
  • Knowledge of CBC’s journalistic standards and practice an asset (not required);
  • The ability to contribute to the diversity of perspectives on the team with ideas that will help connect with and grow new audiences;
  • Strong knowledge and understanding of, and/or connection to, underrepresented communities across Canada;

At CBC/Radio-Canada, we create content that informs, entertains and connects Canadians on multiple platforms. Our successes and accomplishments are driven by embodying and upholding values, which include creativity, integrity, inclusiveness and relevance. 
 
Do you think you have the ability and drive to keep up with this exciting, ever-changing industry? Whether it be in front of the camera, on air, online or behind the scenes, you would be joining a team that thrives on making connections and telling stories that are important to Canadians.

CBC News is looking for an innovative and versatile video producer with a strong interest in world news and excellent field video producing skills to join our new bureau in Jerusalem, covering the Middle East. If you’re a creator at heart and enjoy storytelling and producing content across visual formats, this job could be for you. 

At a time when the world, and Canada’s place within it, is rapidly changing, being present on the ground to bring stories Canadians want and need to know about is critical. As part of our expanding world coverage team, you’ll work closely with a correspondent in Jerusalem, your colleagues in other world bureaus and journalists with Radio-Canada, who will also be working in the Jerusalem bureau. 

You bring a deep knowledge of the historical complexities of the Middle East and the confidence to help shape the CBC News editorial coverage. 

You’re a technical whiz who will be shooting, editing, packaging and publishing content using a variety of gear and apps. This includes social video content, live hits, live streams and on demand content. 

You are also strong editorially. You have story ideas and are thinking about creative treatments to attract new and younger audiences through social-first formats. You excel at guiding stories from concept to post-production, and are quick to pivot when plans change. 

You are deeply committed to the values of a public service broadcaster. You uphold the CBC Journalistic Standards and Practices, especially our core principles of accuracy, fairness, balance, impartiality and integrity. 

You understand that stories can break at any time of the day and you have a genuine desire to be on-top of that coverage. The position requires long-hours, flexible schedules and a willingness to deploy on a moment’s notice, including to conflict zones. The minimum assignment length for this position is two years and, if agreed to by both parties, may be extended for up to an additional two years. 

What you’ll be doing: 

  • Pitches, shoots, produces and edits short and long-form digital-first video content tailored for platforms like TikTok and YouTube as well as CBC.ca.

  • Manage on-the-ground gear — including cameras, portable lighting, and wireless mics — to capture visually impactful footage and clean audio for news content. 

  • Ingest, organize, assemble, and edit raw footage into compelling narrative formats using industry-standard software (such as Premiere Pro); attention to good sound design and mixing; knowledge of basic motion graphics/titles to elevate production value. 

  • Generate and execute compelling journalism, including researching, writing, generating and editing video, audio and text. 

  • Performing location surveys and identifying special requirements such as audio, lighting, camera angles and equipment, including production limitations. 

  • Providing technical guidance and expertise focused on content production techniques, workflows and creative content gathering techniques for complex situations. 

  • Collaborate effectively across CBC News to ensure comprehensive coverage across multiple platforms, programs and locations. 

What is required: 

  • You are a seasoned video-journalist with at least five (5) years of directly related field experience at a network/national level and, preferably in a foreign environment, who thrives in a deadline driven, high pressure environment. 

  • A superior level of technical knowledge and understanding of live coverage, social treatments, visual gathering, visual production and post-production methods and remote filing tools.

  • A strong sense of creativity, initiative and a high degree of responsibility for the accuracy and quality of work throughout the complete production cycle.

  • Demonstrated editorial skills, showing proficiency in story preparation and production of highly creative, innovative visual storytelling, from story generation through to the final edits. 

  • Strong communication, interpersonal and relationship-building skills are required, including active listening, problem-solving and an ability to work across teams.  

  • Ability to work independently in a deadline-driven environment while maintaining a professional attitude.

  • Must possess a valid passport and have the ability and willingness to travel internationally on short notice. 

  • Graduate degree/diploma from a University or Community college in a relevant course of study or equivalent industry experience. 

  • Ability and willingness to work overtime and various shift patterns including overnights and weekends. 

Your application will be evaluated on your experience, as well as your portfolio of work. 

Please include at least two examples of: 

  • Digital / social stories you produced and shot

  • Packaged daily news video content you shot and edited

job.description:
Welcome to Warner Bros. Discovery… the stuff dreams are made of. Who We Are… When we say, “the stuff dreams are made of,” we’re not just referring to the world of wizards, dragons and superheroes, or even to the wonders of Planet Earth. We are created from the idea that people around the world want more, need more, deserve more. We are the home of the global digital revolution. We are CNN. To see what it’s like to work at CNN, follow @WBDLife on Instagram and X! CNN is hiring a Senior Technical Program Manager to lead high-impact programs that span product, technology, design, and product operations. This is a deeply technical senior individual-contributor role for someone who can move between architecture, code, product strategy, operating models, and executive decision-making without losing the thread. The role reports directly to the Senior Director of Technical Program Management and will be trusted with ambiguous, multi-quarter programs that do not fit neatly inside one function. The programs in this portfolio often have no single functional owner, require trade-offs across several organizations, and need sustained influence with Vice Presidents, Directors, principal-level practitioners, and the teams doing the work. This is not a coordination-only position. The person in this role will define the problem, establish the program strategy, understand the underlying systems, challenge weak assumptions, create alignment, and drive measurable outcomes through delivery, launch, adoption, and iteration. WHAT YOU WILL OWN Lead a portfolio of high-priority, cross-organization technical programs from early problem framing through execution, launch, adoption, and measurable business or customer impact. Turn broad goals into clear program strategies, outcome metrics, decision rights, sequencing, governance, and executable plans across multiple teams. Build and maintain integrated plans, dependencies, critical paths, decision logs, risk views, and executive-level narratives that make the real state of the work visible. Identify the technical, product, organizational, and operational constraints that will determine success; resolve them directly or drive the right leaders to a timely decision. Work with senior leaders, including VPs, to clarify priorities, expose trade-offs, remove blockers, and create durable alignment without relying on formal authority. Move comfortably between several programs and levels of detail in the same day, while preserving context, commitments, and follow-through. Create the minimum effective operating model for each program: enough structure to move quickly and safely, without adding process that does not improve outcomes. Develop trusted relationships across Product, Engineering, Design, Product Operations, Architecture, Data, Security, Editorial, Revenue, and other partner organizations as the work requires. Raise the quality of program leadership across the organization by modeling strong judgment, direct communication, technical curiosity, and disciplined execution. TECHNICAL LEADERSHIP EXPECTATIONS This role is not a software-engineering position, but it is intentionally more technical than a traditional program-management role. The successful candidate must be able to engage engineers and architects as a credible peer and independently investigate technical questions. Read, write, review, and reason about code. Use (ai) code when it is the fastest way to validate an assumption, automate work, inspect data, reproduce a problem, or demonstrate a solution. Understand modern software-delivery practices, including source control, pull requests, testing, CI/CD, observability, incident response, release strategies, and production operations. Evaluate system architecture, service boundaries, API contracts, event flows, data models, cloud infrastructure, security constraints, reliability concerns, and integration risks well enough to shape the program plan. Lead technical discovery with engineers and architects, translate findings into decisions and sequencing, and recognize when a proposed plan is technically incomplete or unrealistic. Use data and technical evidence to distinguish symptoms from root causes and to challenge estimates, assumptions, or dependencies constructively. Communicate technical choices and consequences in language that product, design, operations, and executive stakeholders can act on. PRODUCT, DESIGN, AND OPERATING JUDGMENT Frame the customer, user, editorial, operational, or business problem before converging on a solution; connect program work to a clear value hypothesis. Partner closely with Product and Design to define intended outcomes, success measures,

experience

principles, scope boundaries, and the smallest credible path to learning or value. Pressure-test prioritization using customer impact, strategic fit, technical leverage, cost, risk, reversibility, and opportunity cost. Translate product strategy into a delivery approach that includes discovery, design, engineering, operational readiness, launch, measurement, and follow-up—not just a milestone schedule. Work with Product Operations to improve planning, decision-making, portfolio visibility, adoption, feedback loops, and repeatable ways of working across teams. Recognize when a program needs a product decision, a technical decision, an operating-model change, or an executive trade-off, and drive the correct conversation. EXECUTIVE INFLUENCE AND PROGRAM LEADERSHIP Present complex situations to senior leaders with clarity: what changed, why it matters, what choices exist, what you recommend, and what decision is needed. Escalate early and with options. Avoid status-only escalation and make it easy for leaders to take the next action. Build alignment across leaders who may have different goals, incentives, vocabulary, or operating rhythms; surface disagreement rather than allowing false consensus. Make sound decisions independently within the role's mandate and know when additional input or explicit executive sponsorship is required. Stay effective under ambiguity, organizational change, incomplete information, and shifting priorities while maintaining a high bar for quality and accountability. Create an environment in which teams can raise risks, make decisions, and move quickly without losing transparency or ownership. WHAT YOU WILL BRING

Required qualifications

At least 5 years of direct

experience

leading complex technical programs, with demonstrated principal- or senior-level scope in a matrixed organization. A strong software-engineering foundation or equivalent hands-on technical background, including the ability to complete a practical coding assessment. Demonstrated ability to understand architecture and implementation details, ask precise technical questions, and convert technical realities into an effective program strategy. Strong product judgment, including problem framing, customer or user thinking, prioritization, metrics, experimentation, and trade-off analysis. A record of driving cross-functional outcomes across Product, Engineering, Design, and Operations from ambiguity through launch and adoption.

Experience

influencing Directors, VPs, and other senior leaders through clear reasoning, evidence, strong recommendations, and persistent follow-through. Exceptional independence, ownership, context switching, and organizational awareness; able to enter a new domain quickly and determine what matters. Excellent written and verbal communication, including executive updates, decision documents, program narratives, and direct facilitation of difficult conversations. A practical approach to process: rigorous where risk and complexity demand it, lightweight where speed and learning matter more.

Preferred qualifications

Previous

experience

as a software engineer, engineering lead, architect, technical product manager, or similarly technical role.

Experience

with large-scale consumer digital products, media or publishing systems, subscriptions, advertising, data platforms, AI-enabled products, or platform modernization.

Experience

leading programs that require changes to both technology and the way teams plan, make decisions, or operate.

Experience

working across multiple time zones, business units, vendors, or shared-platform organizations. Comfort using modern development, analytics, planning, and collaboration tools to investigate work directly rather than relying only on reported status. WHAT STRONG PERFORMANCE LOOKS LIKE First 90 days — Context and trust: Build a clear map of the portfolio, systems, stakeholders, constraints, and unresolved decisions. Establish credibility with technical and product leaders and create momentum on the highest-value issues. By 6 months — Independent program leadership: Run multiple high-stakes programs with reliable visibility, strong technical and product framing, timely decisions, and fewer avoidable surprises. Senior leaders should view the role as a force multiplier, not an additional reporting layer. By 12 months — Durable outcomes: Deliver measurable program results, improve the organization's ability to execute across boundaries, and leave behind reusable decision, planning, and operating patterns that make future work faster and clearer. CANDIDATE ASSESSMENT The interview process will evaluate the complete shape of the role rather than program-management mechanics alone. Candidates should expect: A practical coding assessment focused on problem solving, code comprehension, implementation quality, debugging, automation, data handling, or API/system interaction. It is not intended to be a trick-algorithm exercise, but candidates must demonstrate genuine hands-on ability. job.title: Account Executive
job.description:
Discover Your Talent at Connoisseur Media in Grays Harbor, WA! Come work with us! We have an immediate opening for an Account Executive selling our effective marketing solutions—including radio, event, and digital products and services—to small and regional businesses and advertising agencies to help clients grow. The ideal candidate has strong communication, presentation, and time-management skills, is outgoing and gregarious, and can sell to anyone! You will be dedicated to building and maintaining strong client relationships and representing the Company and our digital arm, Connrex Digital, in the marketplace. To be successful in this role, you must be highly motivated, have previous sales experience, be goal-oriented, and demonstrate the ability to hold consultative conversations to generate and drive sales for our Grays Harbor cluster, which includes KXRO-AM/101.7 FM (news/talk), KDUX-FM 104.7 (classic rock), KXXK 95.3 (KIX), and KWOK 1490 AM (ESPN Radio), as well as our digital company, Connrex Digital. job.title: Chief Engineer
job.description:
Connoisseur Media is looking for a Full-Time Engineer for our North Dallas (Sherman-McKinney, TX) market. The ideal candidate has basic knowledge of, or is willing to learn about, radio broadcast technical systems and equipment to ensure reliable, high-quality audio transmission for our three radio stations - 97.5 KLAK, 93.1 KMKT, and 102.5 KMAD-FM. The ideal candidate works well under pressure, creates solutions, and is a resourceful, diligent, engaged, and creative problem-solver, with not just a “can-do” but a “will-do” attitude. While we seek someone well-versed in, or willingness to learn, broadcast engineering, a candidate’s interpersonal and communication skills, as well as business and personal integrity, are just as important as technical ability.

Responsibilities

for this position include: Compliance with FCC regulations and station policies regarding broadcast standards. Maintenance of safety protocols in all engineering practices. Chief Operator (EAS, Maintenance, and Transmitter Readings log management & review). Regular inspection and maintenance of broadcast equipment, including a mix of solid-state and high-power tube transmitters, audio consoles, studio gear, audio automation systems, remote broadcast systems, and other related equipment. Perform hands-on routine preventive maintenance and repairs on all technical systems. Monitor audio quality and signal strength during radio broadcasts and be able to quickly troubleshoot issues, as needed. Under the direction of Corporate IT, complete all necessary procedures and paperwork relating to the market’s computer system and be the local eyes and hands for remote IT Help Desk support. Oversee the installation of new equipment and technologies, including the planning and implementation of upgrades to existing systems. Work with the Director of Engineering and market Operations Manager to manage capital projects and implement corporate initiatives. Maintain minimal downtime of broadcast, audio and computer systems, including emergency repairs, but also planning and advocating for any necessary improvements to all systems. Provide technical support and expertise, as needed, to other departments in planning and executing initiatives. Clear, professional, and productive communication with employees who do not have technical or programming backgrounds, as well as subcontractors and vendors. Develop clear instructions relating to simple tasks for non-technical employees to understand and perform. Maintain an accurate equipment inventory, maintenance logs, and technical schematics. This includes the preparation of reports relating to asset additions/disposals and technical issues and solutions. Requirements of this position include the following: A minimum of 1-3 years audio engineering, Radio/TV broadcast engineering and/or IT experience. Knowledge of FCC Regulations. Availability to travel to multiple market locations and transmitter sites. Familiarity with, or willingness to learn about, broadcast automation and centralized audio routing systems. Basic knowledge of, or willingness to learn about, computer networks, STL systems, RF & landline, including analog, digital, and IP. A flexible self-manager with the ability to prioritize tasks and shift priorities as needed. This position requires a fully insured personal vehicle and a valid driver’s license. The candidate is required to provide a safe driving record covering the past three years. Must be able to develop collaborative and productive relationships with market employees, so market staff can help troubleshoot effectively when the engineer is off-site. On call availability for transmitter, studio, and remote broadcast technical issues, remote alarm calls, emergencies, and be proactive about coverage when unavailable. ​

Preferred Qualifications

Military or Post-Secondary electronics training. SBE Certification.

Experience

with Axia LiveWire routing. Demonstrated Project Management skills.​

The ideal candidate is funny, creative, and plugged into pop culture, entertainment, and current digital trends. This role combines social media management, video production and editing, content creation, livestream production, audience engagement, and digital marketing. The successful candidate will have a strong understanding of what makes content perform across platforms including TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, and X, with the ability to turn moments from the show into compelling, shareable digital content. • An innovator with confidence in making editorial decisions.

job.title: Account Executive - KIRO TV Seattle
job.description:
Location: WA-Seattle

Job Title:  Account Executive - KIRO TV Seattle

 

Position Overview

Cox Media Group (CMG) is seeking Account Executives for outside sales positions selling to new clients and servicing established accounts.  This position is located in Seattle, WA at CMG’s local CBS and Telemundo affiliate, KIRO 7.

 

We’re looking for talented, enthusiastic, motivated, and goal-oriented individuals who thrive in a fast-paced working environment. As an Account Executive, you will work closely with our clients as a trusted advisor to deeply understand their unique business goals and then help them achieve those goals. In this field-based role, you will collaborate with local sales managers and will have industry-leading tools and resources at your fingertips to create solutions that help clients reach their target audiences.  

 

This role specializes in creating new and incremental television and digital revenue. The primary job responsibility is to identify new prospects and present customized multi-platform advertising solutions focused on the customer’s return on investment. The Account Executive is also responsible for retaining and growing their developed accounts through insight proposals, proof of performance, and maximizing all station assets. 

 

To be successful; you need to be driven, resourceful, organized, customer-focused, and analytical. You also need to have effective communication skills and the ability to cultivate client relationships. The ideal candidate should also possess strong presentation and time management skills, along with the ability to generate new business.

 

In return, we offer a unique career opportunity - one where you are given a challenging mission, world-class tools to help you succeed, and the chance to realize your full potential as a sale’s professional. This position offers an opportunity to grow your income through a rewarding commission structure. You’ll also become part of a team that with the mission and purpose of making a positive impact on those we serve. CMG annually generates tens of millions of dollars in economic value for our communities. 

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Identifies and assesses sales opportunities and apply resources and strategies appropriately.
  • Solicits new business through prospecting and cold calling.
  • Consistently works target accounts in the pipeline.
  • Generates revenue through the development of new accounts and growth of existing accounts.
  • Develops advertising solutions for new customers that deliver results to their customers.
  • Provides information to sales management to ensure generation of tracking reports regarding pending deals, forecasts, advertiser, contact and prospect lists.
  • Conducts a need analysis and account reviews to uncover the customer’s most essential needs.
  • Develops effective marketing plans to meet clients’ needs and objectives.
  • Creates compelling and persuasive presentations that facilitate new or additional business.
  • Effectively negotiates advertising rates.
  • Is able to demonstrate product knowledge and value to customers.
  • Matches available station sponsorships with the needs of prospects and clients and persuasively present and sell those sponsorships.
  • Works with internal departments to manage account stewardship throughout the process.
  • Utilizes CRM (HubSpot) to manage day to day activity, build a pipeline and ensure execution along with providing weekly projections and reporting.
  • Upsells current customers by providing proof of performance and solid results.
  • Collaborates with Account Manager to provide timely and accurate traffic instructions; conducts account maintenance including make-goods posts, and aging/collections.
  • Attends sales meetings, training sessions and client remote meetings. 

Minimum Qualifications

  • Minimum of 2 years of new business development and prospecting experience in media sales or related role.
  • Proven record of driving revenue growth through successful campaigns.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and people skills.
  • Ability to multi-task and work in a high pressured, fast paced environment with tight deadlines.
  • Strong marketing, presentation and closing skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Has effectively negotiate with customers to meet a winning return on investment.
  • Has experience prospecting for new clients and sell services to them along with maintaining and upselling existing clients.

Job Title:  Account Executive - WFOX WJAX and Telemundo

 

Position Overview

Cox Media Group (CMG) is seeking Account Executives for outside sales positions selling to new clients and servicing established accounts.

 

We’re looking for talented, enthusiastic, motivated, and goal-oriented individuals who thrive in a fast-paced working environment. As an Account Executive, you will work closely with our clients as a trusted advisor to deeply understand their unique business goals and then help them achieve those goals. In this field-based role, you will collaborate with local sales managers and will have industry-leading tools and resources at your fingertips to create solutions that help clients reach their target audiences.  

 

This role specializes in creating new and incremental television and digital revenue. The primary job responsibility is to identify new prospects and present customized multi-platform advertising solutions focused on the customer’s return on investment. The Account Executive is also responsible for retaining and growing their developed accounts through insight proposals, proof of performance, and maximizing all station assets. 

 

To be successful; you need to be driven, resourceful, organized, customer-focused, and analytical. You also need to have effective communication skills and the ability to cultivate client relationships. The ideal candidate should also possess strong presentation and time management skills, along with the ability to generate new business.

 

In return, we offer a unique career opportunity - one where you are given a challenging mission, world-class tools to help you succeed, and the chance to realize your full potential as a sale’s professional. This position offers an opportunity to grow your income through a rewarding commission structure. You’ll also become part of a team that with the mission and purpose of making a positive impact on those we serve. CMG annually generates tens of millions of dollars in economic value for our communities. 

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Identifies and assesses sales opportunities and apply resources and strategies appropriately.
  • Solicits new business through prospecting and cold calling.
  • Consistently works target accounts in the pipeline.
  • Generates revenue through the development of new accounts and growth of existing accounts.
  • Develops advertising solutions for new customers that deliver results to their customers.
  • Provides information to sales management to ensure generation of tracking reports regarding pending deals, forecasts, advertiser, contact and prospect lists.
  • Conducts a need analysis and account reviews to uncover the customer’s most essential needs.
  • Develops effective marketing plans to meet clients’ needs and objectives.
  • Creates compelling and persuasive presentations that facilitate new or additional business.
  • Effectively negotiates advertising rates.
  • Is able to demonstrate product knowledge and value to customers.
  • Matches available station sponsorships with the needs of prospects and clients and persuasively present and sell those sponsorships.
  • Works with internal departments to manage account stewardship throughout the process.
  • Utilizes CRM (HubSpot) to manage day to day activity, build a pipeline and ensure execution along with providing weekly projections and reporting.
  • Upsells current customers by providing proof of performance and solid results.
  • Collaborates with Account Manager to provide timely and accurate traffic instructions; conducts account maintenance including make-goods posts, and aging/collections.
  • Attends sales meetings, training sessions and client remote meetings. 

Minimum Qualifications

  • Minimum of 2 years of new business development and prospecting experience in sales or 2 years of media marketing experience.
  • Proven record of driving revenue growth through successful campaigns.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and people skills.
  • Ability to multi-task and work in a high pressured, fast paced environment with tight deadlines.
  • Strong marketing, presentation and closing skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Has effectively negotiate with customers to meet a winning return on investment.
  • Has experience prospecting for new clients and sell services to them along with maintaining and upselling existing clients.
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office, PowerPoint, and CRM tools, such as HubSpot.
  • Valid driver's license with an acceptable driving record. 

Preferred Qualifications

  • BA/BS degree with a minimum of three years of media sales, account management or buying experience.
  • Proven history of digital and TV sales success in a local media setting

job.description:
Location: FL-Orlando-South

Job Title:  Assignment Editor - WFTV Orlando

 

Position Overview

WFTV Channel 9, the leading news station in Central Florida, is seeking a highly motivated, organized and experienced Assignment Editor to join our dynamic news team!

 

The ideal candidate is someone who can collaborate with newsroom staff and play a critical role in the daily newsgathering process, responsible for identifying, assigning, and coordinating news coverage for all platforms (broadcast, digital, social). This person must have strong editorial judgment, excellent communication skills, strong organizational skills, top-notch logistics coordination and thrive in a fast-paced, deadline driven environment. You must work well under pressure, meet strict deadlines and respond urgently in breaking news. 

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • See the big picture and understand the significance of editorial content
  • Attend daily editorial meetings, documenting and tracking reporter and photographer assignments in iNews and production planning systems
  • Responsible for logistics: working directly with reporters, photographers, producers, managers, and the Content Center to determine daily news priorities and assignments
  • Dispatch news crews and manage logistics including live gear assignment, parking and access
  • Manage and update the newsroom's assignment desk system, ensuring all story information, contacts, and assignments and photog live sheets are accurate and up to date
  • Communicate with broadcast and digital producers, field crews, and managers
  • Coordinate with Newsone/ABC affiliates, management of CMG share list, Florida partners, and other media organizations across the country, including Cox Radio
  • Conduct story research, fact-check information, maintain awareness of ongoing stories and daily identify follow-up opportunities
  • Plan and execute weekday, weekend and news special coverage on all platforms

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Creating and publishing content to digital and social media platforms
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with local law enforcement, fire departments, government agencies, and community contacts
  • Monitor scanners and social media, wire services, and internal tips to identify breaking news
  • Field incoming calls and emails from the public, assessing news value and directing appropriately
  • Assign photographers to edit anchor packages, retracks or other shooting duties 
  • Routine interruptions and unforeseen assignments are to be expected
  • Ensure compliance with journalistic ethics and legal standards
  • The schedule may include nights, weekends, holidays, and overnights
  • Expected to work under deadline constraints and meet precise deadlines

Minimum Qualifications

  • At least 2-years of experience on a newsroom assignment desk or similar newsgathering role, preferably in a top 20 market.
  • Exceptional news judgment and ability to quickly assess the importance of events.
  • Superior communication and interpersonal skills, both written and verbal.
  • Ability to multi-task, strong organizational and communication skills.
  • The ideal candidate is someone who can work well with newsroom staff and have technical knowledge of newsgathering resources
  • Ability to work collaboratively as part of a team and independently when necessary.
  • Strong understanding of AP-style writing
  • Strong knowledge of social media platforms
  • Physical demands and essential physical abilities include: a combination of physical work (standing, walking, lifting and carrying items such as laptop computers, pulling file drawers)
  • Knowledge of the local market is a plus
  • BA or equivalent professional experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with iNews or similar newsroom content management systems.
  • Familiarity with digital news platforms and social media best practices for news dissemination.

job.description:
Location: OH-Dayton

Job Title:  Board Operator (Part Time) - Dayton Radio

 

Position Overview

Are you a self-starter and critical thinker who takes tremendous pride in a job well done? Do you love the radio business and have experience running a radio board? Are you ready to learn from the best in the industry while enhancing your on-air radio skills? If this sounds like you then Cox Media Group Dayton has an opening for a part-time radio board-operator/producer position on our industry award winning radio team.

 

The successful candidate will be an expert at multi-tasking, tech savvy and familiar with on air radio equipment. This is a critical job and during a shift, our board operator/producers are responsible for managing and monitoring our programming on air as well as providing engineering support for local & nationally syndicated talk shows serving tens of thousands of listeners every hour. This position will put you right in the middle of our fast-paced news environment where you will serve as the technical producer for live newscasts, as well as manage on-air breaking news and severe weather situations.  To be successful you will thrive on being prepared, innovating workflows, multi-tasking during shows and when the situation demands it, you will have the ability to trouble-shoot issues under pressure while keeping your cool. Candidates should be able to run a radio board and feel confident on air while they gain valuable airtime and industry experience learning with the best in the business.
