job.title: Broadcast Technology Engineer - WFTV Orlando
job.description:
Location: FL-Orlando-South

Job Title:  Broadcast Technology Engineer - WFTV Orlando

 

Position Overview

The Broadcast Technology Engineer is responsible for the design, installation, support, and continuous improvement of critical broadcast, production, newsroom, master control, RF, IP, and media technology systems. This role serves as a senior technical resource for integrating traditional broadcast infrastructure with IT, network, automation, cloud, and file-based media workflows. The position helps ensure reliable on-air operations, resilient content delivery, secure technology practices, efficient workflows, and strong collaboration across Engineering, IT, News, Production, Digital, vendors, and corporate technology teams.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Maintain, support, and improve master control systems, including playout servers, automation, ingest, transcoding, content delivery, file transfer, monitoring, and interfaces with traffic and scheduling platforms.
  • Support newsroom and production technology workflows, including NRCS platforms, media asset management, shared storage, editing environments, graphics, encoding, streaming, and digital publishing integrations.
  • Provide senior-level support for production control room and studio systems, including production automation, routing, control interfaces, video/audio systems, timing, intercom, graphics, monitoring, and related operational workflows.
  • Partner with IT and network teams to support broadcast network infrastructure, including switches, routers, VLANs, subnets, ACLs, IP transport, streaming, connectivity, and system interoperability across broadcast and enterprise environments.
  • Lead troubleshooting and incident response for on-air, production, and distribution issues; document root cause, corrective actions, and follow-up steps to improve reliability and reduce repeat failures.
  • Maintain system security and operational readiness through software, firmware, and operating system updates; access control coordination; vulnerability remediation support; backup validation; disaster recovery planning; and compliance with corporate IT and broadcast technology standards.
  • Develop and maintain accurate technical documentation, drawings, signal-flow diagrams, system inventories, configuration notes, standard operating procedures, and version records.
  • Collaborate with end users, vendors, Engineering, IT, News, Production, Digital, and corporate technology teams to design, test, and implement workflow improvements that support reliable content creation, distribution, and live operations.
  • Mentor less experienced engineers and technical staff by sharing standards, troubleshooting methods, documentation practices, and operational best practices.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5–7 years of progressive experience supporting broadcast engineering, media technology, production systems, master control, newsroom systems, RF, or related IT/media workflows.
  • Strong understanding of broadcast signal flow, file-based workflows, IP networking, streaming, encoding/transcoding, shared storage, media asset management, automation, and content delivery systems.
  • Hands-on experience with broadcast platforms such as automation, playout, NRCS, editing, graphics, media storage, transcode, streaming, monitoring, and live production systems.
  • Knowledge of FCC requirements, EAS, RF systems, transmitter operations, technical compliance, and applicable broadcast industry standards.
  • Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues under time-sensitive, live-broadcast conditions while communicating clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience coordinating software, firmware, operating system updates, access controls, backups, documentation, and change-management practices in a mission-critical technology environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, strong organizational discipline, attention to detail, and a customer-service mindset.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, support planned and unplanned work, participate in project execution, and remain effective in a fast-paced operational environment.
  • Proficiency with standard productivity tools, technical documentation tools, remote support methods, and common operating systems used in broadcast and media environments.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Preferred qualifications include experience with cloud or hybrid media workflows, IP-based video transport, automation scripting, cybersecurity practices, disaster recovery planning, vendor management, mentoring, and platforms such as Avid, Telestream, Ross, Grass Valley, Harmonic, LiveU, or similar broadcast/media systems.

Job Title:  Digital Content Producer - KIRO TV

 

Position Overview

KIRO 7 News is seeking a Digital Content Center Producer to help drive audience growth, maximize engagement, and lead our digital-first news strategy.

 

This role is central to how we cover breaking news, elevate enterprise journalism, and connect with audiences across web, mobile, OTT, search, and social platforms.

 

The ideal candidate is an expert in digital audience development, SEO, and content optimization, with strong editorial judgment and exceptional writing and editing skills. They understand how audiences discover news, what drives engagement and loyalty, and how to use analytics to make real-time content decisions. They thrive in fast-moving news environments, know how to identify high-impact stories, and can quickly adapt coverage strategies based on audience trends and performance data.

 

This is a hands-on, on-site role within the Content Center. Digital Content Center Producers collaborate closely with reporters, producers, photographers, and newsroom leadership to ensure KIRO 7 is first, fastest, and most accurate online while continuously expanding our digital audience and strengthening our position as Western Washington's leading local news source.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Monitor local and national news, field calls and tips, listen to police and emergency scanners, and track developing stories through public records and court systems.
  • Communicate and coordinate with newsroom staff and sources as stories develop.
  • Write, edit, and publish content across digital platforms including KIRO7.com, the mobile app, OTT, social media channels, and push alerts.
  • Develop and execute SEO strategies that improve search visibility, audience growth, and long-term content performance.
  • Optimize headlines, story structure, metadata, and distribution plans using SEO and audience insights.
  • Use analytics platforms including Chartbeat, Tableau, Google Trends, and social analytics tools to inform content decisions and identify growth opportunities.
  • Ensure daily content production and audience engagement goals are met.
  • Stream breaking news, major coverage events, and live newscasts.
  • Exercise strong editorial judgment during breaking news and high-volume coverage situations.
  • Identify opportunities to grow reach, engagement, and referral traffic through search, social, and emerging platforms.
  • Collaborate with newsroom teams to integrate digital storytelling into broadcast workflows and strengthen cross-platform coordination.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Journalism, Communications, Digital Media, Marketing, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Proven ability to manage breaking news and make sound editorial decisions in a fast-paced newsroom environment.
  • Exceptional writing, editing, headline writing, and copy-editing skills.

  • Experience coaching or leading newsroom staff on digital best practices, audience growth, and content optimization.
  • Familiarity with Google Analytics, Google Search Console, Google Trends, Chartbeat, Tableau, and other audience intelligence platforms.

Position Overview

The Digital Executive Producer at WSB TV in Atlanta, Georgia will lead our digital content strategy and daily execution across all digital platforms, including web, app, social media, streaming, connected TV, and emerging platforms.

 

The EP is responsible for day-to-day decision-making, and will be an expert at story selection, headline writing, social media, vertical video production, SEO, AP Style writing and editing, and breaking news for a digital audience. The Digital Executive Producer will oversee a team of digital producers and content creators while working closely with newsroom managers, executive producers, reporters, photographers, and assignment editors to ensure our journalism reaches audiences wherever they consume news. This position requires strong editorial judgment, advanced digital storytelling skills, deep audience development expertise, and a proven ability to lead a high-performing team in a fast-paced, breaking news environment. The EP will understand the unique competences and audience consumption preferences of owned platforms and third-party digital platforms. You should be fluent in at least one CMS and have experience with audience signaling tools.

 

The ideal candidate is a newsroom leader who understands the evolving media landscape, can balance audience growth with journalistic excellence, has strong people skills and can manage others to drive best-in-class digital news coverage.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Excel at breaking news and AP style writing and editing for a digital audience

We invite you to join us!

Location: Other CMG TV Markets locations will be considered

Process Improvements:

job.description:
Location: FL-Orlando-South

Job Title:  Director of Engineering - WFTV/WRDQ Orlando

 

Position Overview

WFTV/WRDQ Orlando TV is seeking a Director of Engineering to lead the station’s technical operations, broadcast infrastructure, facilities systems, regulatory compliance, and technology modernization efforts. This role is responsible for ensuring reliable on-air operations, protecting the station license, maintaining studio and transmitter facilities, and partnering with News, Production, Sales, Traffic, Master Control, IT, and station leadership to support high-quality local journalism and business continuity. The Director of Engineering leads the technical team, oversees capital and operating budgets, manages vendor relationships, and drives continuous improvement across broadcast, IT, RF transmission, automation, production, network, cloud, and facility systems.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Lead all technical operations for the station, including studio production systems, newsroom technology, master control workflows, automation, media storage, signal distribution, ENG, remote production, and transmission facilities.
  • Ensure reliable, compliant operation of transmitters, towers, RF systems, satellite and microwave systems, EAS equipment, monitoring systems, generators, UPS systems, HVAC, and other critical infrastructure.
  • Protect the station license by maintaining compliance with federal, state and local regulatory agencies, including required documentation, inspections, testing, and corrective actions.
  • Develop and lead a strong engineering culture focused on safety, accountability, service, collaboration, training, responsiveness, and continuous improvement.
  • Manage, coach, and develop the station technical team, including staffing plans, performance expectations, succession planning, technical training, and emergency coverage.
  • Partner with station leadership to align engineering priorities with operational goals, audience needs, local news production, company initiatives, and long-term technology strategy.
  • Plan, execute, and track annual operating and capital budgets, including forecasting, business case development, bid solicitation, vendor selection, documentation, and project delivery.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities (continued)

  • Lead capital projects from concept through implementation, ensuring projects are delivered safely, on time, within budget, and with minimal disruption to on-air operations.
  • Support modernization of the station’s broadcast and IT environment, including IP-based workflows, automation, cloud or hybrid systems, cybersecurity practices, disaster recovery, network resilience, and scalable production tools.
  • Maintain strong working relationships with vendors, contractors, corporate technology teams, property management, and internal departments to resolve issues and improve service.
  • Communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders during outages, planned maintenance, project work, and operational incidents, including impact, status, timelines, and follow-up actions.
  • Lead after-action reviews for significant technical incidents, document root causes and corrective actions, and implement improvements to reduce repeat issues.
  • Prepare timely status reports, budget updates, project documentation, technical records, and leadership briefings as required.
  • Serve as an essential leader during emergencies, severe weather, breaking news, major technical failures, or other events requiring immediate technical response.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in broadcast engineering, electrical engineering, information technology, media technology, or a related technical field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Minimum of 5–10 years of progressively responsible broadcast, media technology, or engineering experience, including leadership or management responsibility.
  • Strong understanding of television broadcast operations, RF transmission, studio production, newsroom systems, master control, automation, signal flow, media workflows, and FCC compliance.
  • Working knowledge of IT infrastructure, networks, firewalls, switches, servers, operating systems, endpoint management, cybersecurity fundamentals, and business continuity practices.
  • Experience managing operating budgets, capital budgets, technical projects, vendor relationships, documentation, and cross-functional project teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead, coach, prioritize, and develop technical staff in a fast-paced, deadline-driven, 24/7 operational environment.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical issues clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, organizational, and decision-making skills, including the ability to assess operational risk and respond effectively during urgent situations.
  • Customer-service mindset and professional approach when working with internal departments, corporate partners, vendors, contractors, clients, and the public.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively, manage multiple priorities, and provide leadership during nights, weekends, holidays, emergencies, or outages as needed.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in a mid- or major-market television station, multi-site broadcast environment, or highly complex live production operation.
  • Experience with IP video/audio, cloud playout, broadcast automation, newsroom systems, remote production, bonded cellular, streaming, virtualization, and disaster recovery workflows.
  • Familiarity with ATSC 3.0, HDR, SMPTE standards, cybersecurity frameworks, and emerging broadcast technology trends.
  • SBE certification, PMP certification, cybersecurity certification, or other relevant technical credentials.

job.description:
Location: GA-Atlanta

Job Title:  Director, AI Execution & Operations

 

Position Overview

The Director, AI Execution & Operations is a full-time hybrid role based in Atlanta, Georgia. This position is responsible for turning Cox Media Group's AI strategy into measurable business outcomes through the successful execution, adoption, governance, and operationalization of AI initiatives across the enterprise.

 

This role serves as the operational leader for CMG's enterprise AI initiatives, partnering with business, technology, and cross-functional AI stakeholders to drive adoption, coordinate execution, and accelerate value realization across the organization.

 

The ideal candidate brings firsthand experience implementing enterprise AI programs and understands both the opportunities and challenges of AI adoption at scale. They have helped organizations deploy, govern, enable, support, measure, and expand AI capabilities, and can leverage those experiences to help CMG accelerate adoption, scale successful outcomes, and avoid common implementation pitfalls. They combine strong operational leadership with a hands-on, problem-solving mindset, bringing curiosity, practical AI expertise, and a willingness to explore new ideas, experiment, and apply AI to solve real business challenges.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

AI Strategy Execution & Delivery

  • Execute and operationalize the enterprise AI strategy and roadmap.
  • Coordinate and support AI initiatives across business and technology teams, establishing repeatable execution and deployment models that enable successful adoption and scale across business units.
  • Track milestones, dependencies, risks, and business outcomes across the AI portfolio.
  • Identify and resolve execution risks, dependencies, and implementation barriers.
  • Ensure AI initiatives align with defined business objectives and success measures.

 

AI Adoption, Enablement & Change Leadership

  • Develop and coordinate enterprise AI adoption strategies in partnership with business leaders, AI champions, and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to business stakeholders by sharing AI best practices, lessons learned, and recommendations that help scale successful outcomes.
  • Partner with AI champions, business stakeholders, and cross-functional AI leaders to build, support, and expand CMG's AI Champion Network.
  • Coordinate communications, awareness campaigns, webinars, and employee engagement activities.
  • Partner with business leaders to support adoption and embed AI into day-to-day workflows.
  • Coordinate AI training, workshops, office hours, and enablement programs to accelerate adoption across the organization.
  • Create adoption playbooks, implementation guidance, best practices, FAQs, and success stories.
  • Establish mechanisms for gathering employee feedback and measuring adoption effectiveness.
  • Identify and address barriers preventing AI adoption and sustained usage.
  • Promote sharing of successful use cases and lessons learned across business units.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities (continued)

Analytics, Reporting & Value Realization

  • Define and maintain AI adoption, utilization, productivity, and value realization metrics.
  • Develop executive dashboards, scorecards, and operational reporting frameworks.
  • Measure productivity improvements, operational efficiencies, and business impact generated by AI initiatives.
  • Establish methodologies for tracking ROI and benefits realization.
  • Monitor adoption trends and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Prepare executive reporting on AI performance, adoption, and business outcomes.
  • Validate and communicate success stories and realized business value across the organization.

 

AI Operational Leadership & Continuous Improvement

  • Serve as an internal subject matter expert on enterprise AI execution, operationalization, adoption, and scaling.
  • Partner with business and technology teams to identify opportunities, experiment with new approaches, and apply AI capabilities to solve practical business challenges and improve business outcomes.
  • Foster collaboration across teams pursuing AI initiatives to encourage knowledge sharing, consistency, and reuse of successful practices and solutions.
  • Monitor emerging AI capabilities and industry practices, applying lessons learned and recommending improvements to adoption approaches, governance processes, and operating models.
  • Identify opportunities to standardize and simplify AI deployment and support processes.
  • Help business leaders successfully integrate AI into existing workflows and operating models.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities (cont.)

AI Operations & Governance Coordination

  • Manage AI intake, evaluation, prioritization support, and execution tracking processes.
  • Support and coordinate governance reviews, stakeholder discussions, and decision-making activities in partnership with established governance bodies, business leaders, and AI stakeholders.
  • Support implementation of AI policies, standards, and governance requirements.
  • Partner with Technology, Security, Legal, and HR stakeholders to ensure compliance with established governance frameworks.
  • Maintain AI operational documentation, reporting, and decision records.
  • Develop scalable operational processes that support long-term AI growth and enterprise adoption.
  • Ensure governance decisions are implemented consistently across AI initiatives

 

Stakeholder Partnership & Collaboration

  • Partner with business AI leaders, champions, and stakeholders to support department-specific AI initiatives, share best practices, and accelerate adoption across the organization.
  • Facilitate collaboration and build strong partnerships across business and technology teams to accelerate AI adoption and value realization.
  • Maintain consistent executive communication and reporting cadences.
  • Manage operational relationships with AI vendors, consultants, implementation partners, and service providers.
  • Support evaluation and implementation planning for new AI solutions and capabilities.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Organizational Leadership, or a related field.
  • An equivalent combination of education, professional experience, certifications, and demonstrated success leading technology transformation, AI adoption, operational excellence, automation, and organizational change will be considered.
  • 5+ years of relevant work in technology, AI adoption, operational leadership, change management, enterprise program execution, business operations, or related disciplines.
  • Demonstrated success leading complex cross-functional initiatives with executive visibility and measurable business outcomes.
  • Natural curiosity and a track record of applying technology, automation, or AI to solve business problems and improve operational outcomes.
  • Track record of translating business needs into practical AI-enabled solutions and operational improvements.
  • Hands-on experience implementing and applying Microsoft Copilot, AI agents, automation, or related AI technologies in a business environment.

  • Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Partnering across business, technology, vendor, and executive stakeholder groups to successfully execute AI initiatives and drive business value.
  • Driving technology adoption, communications, stakeholder engagement, and AI enablement programs.
  • Building executive reporting, KPI frameworks, operational dashboards, and business performance metrics.
  • Measuring AI utilization, productivity gains, business impact, and value realization.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Advanced experience building and scaling solutions using Copilot Studio, Power Automate, Azure AI, AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, or similar AI platforms.
  • Experience establishing AI governance, adoption, enablement, or value realization frameworks.
  • Knowledge of enterprise AI governance, security, risk management, and responsible AI principles.
  • Experience scaling AI initiatives from pilot programs into ongoing business operations.

job.description:
Location: FL-Tampa

Job Title:  Engineering Manager - Tampa Radio

 

Position Overview

Tampa Radio is looking for a Manager of Engineering who will be responsible for executing all broadcast related engineering functions for Cox Media Group (CMG) radio stations in the local market. Responsibilities include, but are not limited to, all radio frequency (RF) operations, broadcast and digital distribution systems, studio equipment, tower site operations, IP-based broadcast infrastructure, cybersecurity practices, backup and recovery, and security systems. Planning, execution, and timely completion of all projects, maintenance, upgrades, lifecycle replacements, infrastructure improvements, and modernization initiatives while ensuring compliance with all FCC, FAA, FEMA, OSHA, and company rules, regulations, and guidelines. Maintain, maximize, and service the station’s transmitter, studio, digital distribution, networking, and station facilities. Advise management in the long-range planning for the replacement, modernization, resilience, and secure operation of station equipment and systems. The Manager of Engineering is responsible for improving operational capabilities and supporting all revenue and audience-producing efforts. They will work closely with Engineering, IT, programming, content, sales, operations, and other departments in the maintenance and operation of their equipment and technical systems.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Install, maintain, and support all broadcast equipment including transmission systems, transceivers, satellite receivers, and broadcast automation equipment for optimum performance 
  • Mange remote, on-location broadcast scheduling, site coordination, timely broadcast equipment setup and operation.  Safely store and maintain remote broadcast equipment 
  • Document equipment installation, wiring, maintenance, repair, and replacement 
  • Ensure that all projects are properly implemented and executed per agreed-upon schedule 
  • Work varied and extended hours may include some weekends, holidays, on-call, and required local travel for scheduled after-hours projects or when emergencies or failure of critical equipment occurs to the operation of the station 
  • Respond to equipment outages, malfunctions, and related technical problems at studio, transmitter, and translator locations 
  • Ensure operation and oversee maintenance of company vehicles with the safety of the operator, other personnel, and the public in mind, according to the guidelines of the station and CMG 
  • Update, improve and implement our business continuity plan and contribute as a member of our crisis management team 
  • Support IP-based broadcast infrastructure, including switching, routing, VLANs, firewalls, VPNs, wireless systems, AoIP platforms, remote control systems, and monitoring tools
  • Support cybersecurity, patching, endpoint protection, access control, secure configuration, backup and recovery, and vulnerability remediation practices across critical technical systems
  • Plan and execute preventative maintenance, technology upgrades, lifecycle replacements, infrastructure improvements, and modernization projects that strengthen reliability, security, scalability, and operational resilience
  • Partner with Engineering, IT, programming, content, sales, and operations teams to understand business needs, solve technical problems, and deliver dependable service-oriented support

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in broadcast engineering, radio technical operations, media technology, IT infrastructure, or a related technical field.
  • Strong knowledge of broadcast systems, RF transmission, studio operations, automation, audio chains, remote control systems, and digital distribution workflows.
  • Hands-on experience supporting IP-connected infrastructure, including switches, routers, VLANs, firewalls, VPNs, DNS, NTP, SNMP, and wireless systems.
  • Working knowledge of cybersecurity fundamentals, patching, endpoint protection, backup and recovery, and secure system configuration.
  • Ability to diagnose and resolve complex technical issues quickly, especially during outages or time-sensitive station operations.
  • Strong communication, documentation, project management, prioritization, and follow-through skills.
  • Valid driver’s license, reliable transportation, and ability to support station facilities, transmitter sites, and remote locations as needed.
  • Ability to work varied hours, including nights, weekends, holidays, and on-call support when critical systems require immediate response.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Associate’s or bachelor’s degree in Electronics, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Society of Broadcast Engineers certification or relevant IT, networking, cybersecurity, cloud, or vendor certifications.
  • Experience with radio automation, AoIP systems, HD Radio, high-powered AM/FM transmission, broadcast monitoring/control platforms, or remote broadcast technology.
  • Familiarity with virtualized or cloud-connected infrastructure, Windows Server, Active Directory/Azure, Linux, backup platforms, Fortinet, Cisco, Veeam, Wheatstone, WideOrbit, Burk, or comparable platforms.

job.title: Executive Business Partner - CMG
job.description:
Location: GA-Atlanta

Job Title:  Executive Business Partner - CMG

 

Position Overview

The Executive Business Partner plays a critical role in helping executive leaders operate effectively in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment. By providing proactive support, coordinating priorities, managing critical communications, and ensuring follow-through on key activities, the Executive Business Partner acts as a force multiplier for executive leadership, creating the capacity for leaders to focus on strategic objectives and business results.

 

This role goes beyond traditional administrative support by serving as a highly organized coordinator, relationship builder, and problem solver who helps create structure, streamline processes, and improve efficiency across the executive's areas of responsibility. Success in this role requires sound judgment, initiative, adaptability, strong communication skills, and a commitment to excellence.

 

By anticipating needs, identifying risks and bottlenecks, and proactively driving follow-through, the Executive Business Partner helps maximize organizational effectiveness and the impact of executive leader(s) and their teams.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Executive Support & Coordination

  • Provides comprehensive support to executive and senior leaders, including complex calendar management, scheduling prioritization, meeting coordination, travel planning, expense reporting, and administrative support.
  • Proactively manages the executive’s time, energy and strategic priorities by identifying conflicts, anticipating emerging issues, preparing decision-ready materials, and ensuring leaders are well-prepared for meetings and positioned for effective decision making and execution.
  • Coordinates internal and external meetings, executive events, leadership forums, off-sites, and other business-related activities, including agendas, logistics, materials, and follow-up.
  • Maintains awareness of key business priorities, organizational developments, and leadership initiatives to help proactively coordinate activities; identify scheduling considerations, dependencies, risks, and opportunities; and items requiring executive attention.

 

Meeting & Communication Management

  • Develops meeting agendas, presentation materials, executive briefings, summaries, reports, and communications that support productive discussions and informed leadership conversations.
  • Coordinates follow-up communications, tracks action items, and maintains documentation of meeting outcomes and commitments to ensure accountability for critical deliverables.
  • Serves as a liaison between executives and internal and external stakeholders, maintaining professionalism, responsiveness, confidentiality, and discretion.

 

Project & Process Support

  • Supports special projects and business initiatives through organization, coordination, information gathering, documentation, and progress tracking.
  • Tracks key deliverables, deadlines, and commitments and follows up with stakeholders to support timely completion and clear accountability.
  • Creates and maintains project trackers, dashboards, templates, and other tools that support efficient execution and visibility.
  • Assists with coordination across departments, project teams, and executive support partners to promote alignment and effective communication.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities (continued)

Operational Excellence

  • Leverages technology and productivity tools, including AI-enabled solutions such as Microsoft Copilot, to streamline administrative and operational tasks.
  • Establishes and maintains effective processes, workflows, and organizational systems that improve efficiency and consistency.
  • Establishes and manages executive operating rhythms, including leadership meetings, business reviews, action-item tracking, communication cadence, and executive follow-up processes. 
  • Identifies opportunities for process improvements and recommends practical enhancements to increase effectiveness.

 

Relationship Management

  • Builds positive working relationships across all levels of the organization.
  • Demonstrates professionalism, discretion, and sound judgment when handling sensitive and confidential information.
  • Supports a collaborative and service-oriented environment while maintaining flexibility in response to changing business needs

Competencies for Success

Executive Presence - Communicates professionally and effectively with leaders, employees, and external stakeholders.

Operational Excellence - Creates structure, manages details, and consistently delivers high-quality work in a fast-paced environment.

Business Judgment - Understands priorities, exercises sound judgment, and appropriately escalates issues when needed.

Initiative - Anticipates needs, takes action, and looks ahead to identify opportunities to improve efficiency and effectiveness.

Accountability - Demonstrates ownership, follows through on commitments, and ensures details are completed accurately and on time.

Relationship Building - Builds strong partnerships through collaboration, responsiveness, and trust.

Adaptability - Effectively manages changing priorities, ambiguity, and competing demands while maintaining a positive attitude.

Strategic Acumen - Understands organizational objectives, business priorities, and leadership goals; connects daily activities to broader business outcomes and helps drive strategic execution.

Influencing Without Authority - Builds alignment, gains commitment, and drives follow-through across stakeholders through credibility, relationships, communication, and accountability. 

Continuous Improvement - Seeks opportunities to improve processes, leverage technology, and enhance overall productivity.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Minimum of 7 years of experience providing executive support, executive operations, business operations, chief of staff, project coordination, or related support to senior leaders.
  • Demonstrated ability to anticipate executive needs, exercise independent judgment, and operate with a high degree of autonomy while managing competing priorities. 
  • Proven ability to influence outcomes and drive accountability across teams without direct reporting authority.
  • Experience supporting C-suite, executive-level, or senior business leaders within a complex, fast-paced organization.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage highly complex calendars, competing priorities, time-sensitive meetings, travel, expense reporting, and executive communications.
  • Strong business judgment, discretion, professionalism, and ability to handle confidential information appropriately.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare polished executive materials, presentations, summaries, and correspondence.
  • Expert proficiency with Microsoft Office, Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint, and related productivity tools.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, resourceful, and able to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Proven ability to build trusted relationships, collaborate across functions, and interact effectively with senior executives, external partners, and internal stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration, communications, organizational leadership, project management, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
  • Experience supporting executives with distributed teams or managing scheduling across multiple time zones.
  • Experience in media, technology, professional services, or another dynamic, matrixed environment.
  • Experience supporting governance-related activities, executive off-sites, or confidential leadership forums.
  • Experience using AI and productivity tools such as Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, or similar platforms to streamline workflows, improve reporting, and enhance executive productivity.
  • Experience developing executive dashboards, project trackers, templates, and operating cadence tools.

About Cox Media Group 
CMG Media Corporation (d/b/a Cox Media Group) is an industry-leading media company with unparalleled brands, award-winning content, and exceptional team members. CMG provides valuable local and national journalism and entertainment content to the people and communities it serves. The company's businesses encompass 14 high-quality, market-leading television brands in 9 markets; 45 top-performing radio stations delivering multiple genres of content in 9 markets; and numerous streaming and digital platforms. CMG's TV portfolio includes multiple primary affiliates of ABC, CBS, FOX, NBC, Telemundo and MyNetworkTV, as well as several valuable news and independent stations. For more information about CMG, visit www.coxmediagroup.com

job.title: Executive Producer - WFTV Orlando
job.description:
Location: FL-Orlando-South

Job Title:  Executive Producer - WFTV Orlando

 

Position Overview

The Executive Producer at WFTV in Orlando, FL will manage a team of TV producers and writers while working with, anchors, reporters, photographers, editors, and directors to create dynamic newscasts in one of the top newsrooms in the country. The EP crafts the look of the shows, manages story count, flow and placement of every story. They set the coverage expectation and manage repetition. The EP manages breaking news and the speed and style in which we get it on the air whenever news breaks. The person in this job must be a quick-moving innovator who can lead the team in a changing media environment. The EP assists in all aspects of leading and managing a team such as establishing schedules, goal setting, and employee relations and works closely with fellow managers to craft and execute successful strategies and newscasts.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Newscast & Brand Management – 90%

  • Ensure product stays on brand.
  • Manage breaking news.
  • Copy edits stories in newscasts to ensure they are on target with research objectives.
  • Manages story count and placement. Must be intimate with the rundown. Manage story count vs. big story coverage.
  • Set the coverage expectation by holding meetings with producers and conducting newscast critiques.
  • Manage repetition within newscasts and from newscast to newscast.
  • Ensures the product stays on brand. Holds producers accountable on story selection and ensures anchors and meteorologists stay on target with delivery.
  • Manages breaking news. Ensures that we are on the air quickly. Monitors the execution in the control room. Facilitates drills to ensure talent is up to speed.
  • Innovate to match research as viewing behavior changes.
  • Executes live-streaming strategy to encourage viewership on mobile and on other digital platforms.
  • Works closely with talent on social posts to encourage viewership of the newscast.
  • Crafts newscasts look by working with the Creative Services Department.
  • Holds writing seminars and trains new employees.
  • Must fill in line producer as needed

 

Administrative – 10%

  • The EP leads and manages a team of TV and digital producers, writers, anchors, reporters, photographers, editors, and directors.
  • Assists in establishing schedules, goal setting, and employee relations. 

 

Physical Demands:

  • A combination of physical work (standing, walking, lifting and carrying items such as laptop computers, pulling file drawers.
  • Document review and computer use, including ability to manipulate fingers to operate computer keyboard and mouse.
  • Expected to work under deadline constraints and meet precise deadlines (including self-imposed deadlines). 
  • Routine interruptions and unforeseen assignments are to be expected.
  • The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate. 

 

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5 or more years of newsroom experience required 
  • Must be a quick leading innovator who can lead a team in a changing media environment 
  • Must understand and be able to execute on evolving digital platforms

job.description:
Location: PA-Pittsburgh

Job Title:  Information Technology Manager - WPXI TV

 

Position Overview

WPXI TV, a Cox Media Group (CMG) station in Pittsburgh, PA, is seeking an experienced, highly motivated I.T. Manager. Operating in the nation’s 26th largest television market, this hands-on leadership role manages the station's entire computing environment, localized server architecture, high-security network perimeters, and integrated broadcast-I.T. ecosystems.

 

The I.T. Manager ensures 24/7/365 operational continuity for our live news, production, and multi-platform digital channels. The ideal candidate will blend advanced systems administration with deep technical knowledge of specialized, automated broadcast television environments. This role reports directly to the Director of Engineering and works in tandem with the station's local engineering team and CMG corporate technology group.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Broadcast-I.T. Integration & Support: Maintain high-level technical oversight, provisioning, and daily troubleshooting for mission-critical newsroom and automation systems including Avid, iNews, Grass Valley Ignite, Harmonic, Crispin, Chyron, and Wide Orbit.
  • Infrastructure & Storage Management: Administer and optimize local storage and server environments, directly overseeing the station’s virtualized server platforms (VMware/Hyper-V) and high-capacity NetApp network-attached storage (NAS/SAN) infrastructure.
  • Network & Security Enforcement: Serve as the local gatekeeper for network security. Manage, patch, and monitor the station's Fortinet infrastructure (firewalls, switches, and secure access points), ensuring strict adherence to CMG corporate cybersecurity mandates.
  • Systems & Automation Administration: Direct the optimization of Microsoft enterprise environments, Active Directory, endpoint systems, and localized automated script pipelines to minimize operational overhead and drive reliability.
  • User Support Leadership: Manage the local help desk workflow, ensuring high-priority, zero-downtime technical support for live control rooms, field news crews, digital production teams, sales, and administrative staff.
  • Disaster Recovery & Redundancy: Formulate, test, and manage strict local business continuity blueprints, ensuring off-site cloud backups and local hardware redundancies preserve the on-air and digital stream integrity during critical weather or emergency events.

 

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Broadcast Engineering, or equivalent combined professional experience.
  •  5+ years of experience in systems administration, network engineering, or I.T. infrastructure management, with a proven track record working inside a high-pressure, live broadcast television or multi-platform media environment.
  • Technical Proficiencies:
    • Advanced administration of Microsoft Server, Active Directory, Group Policy, and desktop operating systems.
    • Strong knowledge of virtualization technologies (VMware Horizon/vSphere) and enterprise storage management (NetApp solutions).
    • Profound understanding of core networking concepts (TCP/IP, VLAN segmentation, routing protocols, and QoS settings for media over IP).
  • Must be willing to participate in an on-call emergency rotation encompassing nights, weekends, and holiday coverage to support a continuous news cycle.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Security & Networking Certifications: Active certifications in corporate networking and perimeter protection (e.g., Fortinet Network Security Expert (NSE), Cisco CCNA, or Microsoft Certified Solutions Expert).
  • Industry Accreditations: Society of Broadcast Engineers (SBE) certifications—specifically the Certified Broadcast Networking Engineer (CBNE) or Certified Broadcast Networking Technologist (CBNT)—are highly valued.

This role focuses on generating new and incremental radio and digital revenue. The main job is to prospect for new business, develop innovative cross-platform advertising solutions, run effective marketing campaigns, and build strong relationships and business partnerships within the community. The Media Consultant is also responsible for retaining and expanding their existing accounts through insight-driven proposals, performance metrics, and by maximizing all radio station and digital assets.

 

To succeed, you’ll need to be driven, resourceful, organized, customer-focused, and a problem-solver. You also must have effective communication skills and the ability to build both new and lasting client relationships. The ideal candidate should have strong presentation and time management skills, along with the ability to generate new business.

 

In return, we offer a unique career opportunity - one where you face a challenging mission, have access to world-class tools to help you succeed, and can realize your full potential as a sales professional. You’ll also join a team dedicated to making a positive impact on those we serve. CMG annually generates tens of millions of dollars in economic value for our communities.

Job Title:  Morning Show Co-Host - WNGC Athens Radio

 

Position Overview

WNGC Radio is seeking a dynamic, personality-driven Morning Show Co-Host to join North Georgia's heritage Country radio station. This role is one of the primary on-air voices of the morning show and helps build audience loyalty, grow ratings and digital engagement, create compelling multiplatform content, and represent WNGC in the community.

 

We are looking for a great storyteller with a strong point of view, quick wit, and passion for Country music, local culture, and audience engagement. The ideal candidate understands how to maintain forward momentum through effective teasing, pacing, and content execution while connecting naturally with listeners on-air, online, and in person.

 

Please include your Air Check Package with application!

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Co-host a live, personality-driven morning show that delivers compelling storytelling, listener interaction, local content, interviews, and engaging entertainment.
  • Develop and execute daily content plans, recurring features, story arcs, and digital content across social, video, web, and podcast platforms.
  • Voice-track assigned shifts and create commercial, promotional, and endorsement content as needed.
  • Represent WNGC at community events, promotions, concerts, remote broadcasts, and client activities while collaborating across departments to support audience growth and revenue opportunities.
  • Operate the control board, radio automation system, phone system, and other studio equipment, including editing interviews, phone content, and other audio.
  • Execute station strategy while supporting ratings growth, digital engagement, FCC compliance, and ongoing professional development.
  • Participate in regular show planning, coaching, airchecks, and content reviews.
  • Maintain reliable attendance, punctuality, and professional judgment in a live, deadline-driven environment.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Demonstrated on-air radio experience with strong storytelling, audience engagement, and personality-driven content skills.
  • Strong on-air presence with a relatable, topical, and occasionally humorous point of view.
  • Understanding of audience retention, content pacing, teasing, show momentum, and the Country radio audience.
  • Excellent written, verbal, interpersonal, and vocal delivery skills.
  • Experience with audio editing software, such as Adobe Audition, and radio automation systems, such as WideOrbit.
  • Proficiency creating social media and video content across multiple digital platforms.
  • Creative, prepared, coachable, and able to collaborate effectively within a morning show and across Programming, Promotions, Digital, and Sales with a strong work ethic and team-first mindset.
  • Availability for early mornings, local or regional travel, and occasional evenings, weekends, holidays, events, and remote broadcasts.
  • Valid driver’s license and ability to meet applicable company driving requirements.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Knowledge of Country music, Country lifestyle culture, and relevant pop-culture trends.
  • Familiarity with the Athens/North Georgia market and local audience interests.
  • Passion for North Georgia, its communities, and the local audience WNGC serves.
  • Experience creating podcast, video, interview, or social-first content.
  • Prior experience with remote broadcasts, promotions, concerts, community events, or client-facing appearances.

job.description:
Location: WA-Seattle

Job Title:  News Producer - KIRO TV Seattle

 

Position Overview

Cox Media Group (CMG) has an exciting opportunity for a News Producer who is creative, curious, and highly organized, and can build fast-paced, accurate, and memorable newscasts for broadcast, digital, and social platforms.

 

This role is ideal for a strong storyteller who thrives in a live newsroom, makes sound editorial decisions under pressure, and brings urgency, context, and clarity to every story. The News Producer will collaborate closely with anchors, reporters, meteorologists, editors, photographers, digital teams, and production staff to deliver compelling coverage that serves our viewers and upholds the highest standards of journalism.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Produces engaging, accurate, and well-paced newscasts that reflect strong news judgment and clear editorial priorities.
  • Writes compelling broadcast copy, including opens, teases, intros, tags, headlines, and transitions.
  • Leads live coverage with confidence, including breaking news, severe weather, developing stories, and special coverage.
  • Makes smart, timely rundown adjustments as stories change throughout the day.
  • Collaborates with anchors, reporters, meteorologists, photographers, editors, digital teams, and production teams to execute strong storytelling across platforms.
  • Uses video, graphics, live elements, social media, digital tools, and studio resources to strengthen story presentation.
  • Contributes story ideas, coverage plans, and creative approaches in editorial meetings.
  • Verifies information, upholds journalistic standards, and ensures accuracy, fairness, and clarity in all content.
  • Communicates clearly in the control room and remains calm, flexible, and solutions-focused during high-pressure coverage.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in journalism, Communications, Media, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • Experience producing live newscasts and writing for broadcast, digital, and social platforms.
  • Strong news judgment and understanding of newscast structure, pacing, showcasing, and execution.
  • Ability to make fast, accurate editorial decisions during breaking news, severe weather, and other high-pressure coverage.
  • Strong writing, communication, organization, and control-room leadership skills.
  • Ability to prioritize, multitask, and adapt quickly in a fast-paced newsroom
  • High professional standards, sound ethics, and a commitment to accuracy, fairness, and responsible journalism.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior medium- to large-market newsroom experience.
  • Demonstrated track record producing strong live, breaking news, or severe weather coverage.
  • At least 2 years of professional local television news experience.

 

The wage scale for this position is $33.56 per hour to $35.58 per hour.

  • Part-time employees will receive one hour of paid sick leave for every 40 hours worked.

Job Title:  Weekend Anchor - WFTV

 

Position Overview

WFTV Channel 9 Eyewitness News is seeking a dynamic, credible, and enterprising journalist to serve as our Weekend Anchor/Reporter. This position requires a strong newsroom leader who can confidently anchor weekend newscasts while also producing impactful, original reporting during the week.

 

The successful candidate will anchor Saturday and Sunday newscasts and report in the field three days per week. Reporting is a critical component of this role. We are looking for a journalist who can uncover stories through source development, document research, public records requests, and relentless newsgathering.

 

The ideal candidate is an enterprise-driven journalist who consistently generates original story ideas, develops exclusive content, and turns meaningful enterprise stories on the same day they are pitched, bringing forward investigative and accountability-focused story ideas that matter to Central Florida viewers.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Weekend Anchor Responsibilities

  • Anchor live Saturday and Sunday newscasts with authority, credibility, and strong storytelling.
  • Lead breaking news and severe weather coverage during weekend broadcasts.
  • Collaborate with producers, reporters, meteorologists, and newsroom leaders to shape editorial content and presentation.
  • Write, edit, and review scripts to ensure accuracy, fairness, and journalistic excellence.
  • Serve as a newsroom leader who reinforces WFTV's standards of journalism and storytelling.

 

Reporting & Investigative Responsibilities

  • Report in the field three days each week for broadcast, digital, and streaming platforms.
  • Pitch original enterprise story ideas in the morning editorial meeting and execute those stories the same day.
  • Develop and maintain a robust network of sources across government, law enforcement, business, education, and the community.
  • Generate exclusive content through public records requests, database research, source cultivation, and document analysis.
  • Pursue accountability journalism that uncovers information viewers would not otherwise know.
  • Identify investigative angles to daily news stories and develop them into deeper enterprise reports.
  • Deliver compelling live reports from the field, particularly during breaking news and major community events.
  • Write accurate, impactful, and visually compelling stories under daily deadline pressure.
  • Collaborate with photographers, producers, and digital teams to maximize storytelling across all platforms.
  • Produce digital content and supporting materials related to enterprise and investigative stories.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Journalism, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Demonstrated success developing enterprise stories.
  • Exceptional live reporting and ad-lib skills.
  • Strong on-air presence with the ability to connect with viewers.
  • Excellent writing, storytelling, and interviewing skills.
  • Strong news judgment and ability to thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
  • Must possess a valid driver's license and maintain an acceptable driving record.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Minimum of three to five years of television news reporting experience; anchoring experience strongly preferred.

job.title: Media Market Manager – Myrtle Beach
job.description:
Description

  

Market Manager – Myrtle Beach

Dick Broadcasting Company | Myrtle Beach, South Carolina
Full-Time | Exempt

Dick Broadcasting Company is looking for an entrepreneurial leader to lead our Myrtle Beach market.

This is not a caretaker position.

We are looking for someone who wants to build — a great team, strong brands, lasting client relationships, revenue, and a successful business. You will lead a four-station operation and its growing digital business with significant autonomy and direct responsibility for the market’s results.

For more than 72 years, Dick Broadcasting Company has built successful local media brands by remaining committed to the communities we serve. As a family-owned company, we believe local leadership matters. Our Market Managers are given the freedom to identify opportunities, make decisions, try new things, develop people, solve problems, and grow their business.

This position is based in Myrtle Beach, South Carolina, one of the Southeast’s most dynamic and rapidly growing markets. Beyond being a world-class tourism destination, Myrtle Beach offers a strong local business community, tremendous population growth, beaches, golf, entertainment, and an outstanding quality of life.

If you are a successful Local Sales Manager, General Sales Manager, Digital Sales Manager, small-market General Manager, or another proven media leader ready for greater responsibility, this could be your opportunity to lead a market.

What You’ll Do

Build and lead a great team.
Recruit, develop, coach, and retain talented people. Create an environment where people enjoy coming to work, know what is expected of them, celebrate wins together, and are continually challenged to get better.

Grow the business.
Lead the market’s revenue strategy across broadcast and digital, with a strong emphasis on local-direct new business, account growth, and finding new opportunities for DBC and our clients.

Develop people.
Spend time with your team. Coach sales leaders and sellers in the field, brainstorm with programming and content teams, provide regular feedback, recognize great work, and help good people become even better at what they do.

Be part of the sales effort.
Participate in key client meetings and help create a sales culture where prospecting, discovery, presenting solutions, following up, and closing business happen consistently. Be a resource for the sales team without becoming the sales team.

Know what is happening in the business.
Establish clear expectations and strong operating rhythms. Use financial results, sales activity, CRM data, ratings, digital performance, and other key metrics to recognize momentum, identify opportunities, and address problems early.

Be part of the Myrtle Beach community.
Build relationships with advertisers, agencies, community organizations, and business leaders. Be visible in the market and help ensure our brands continue to be an important part of the communities we serve.

Protect and grow our brands.
Work closely with programming and content leaders to keep our stations entertaining, relevant to listeners, valuable to advertisers, and connected to Myrtle Beach.

Manage the P&L.
Take responsibility for the financial performance of the market, including revenue growth, profitability, forecasting, expense discipline, and annual operating and capital budgets.

Lead the entire operation.
Oversee programming, sales, digital, technical operations, human resources, and business administration while ensuring the stations remain compliant with applicable FCC rules and regulations.


Requirements

 What We’re Looking For

We are less interested in a particular title than we are in finding the right leader. The successful candidate will bring:

  • A  demonstrated ability to grow revenue and develop new business.
  • Proven  experience leading, coaching, motivating, and developing people.
  • Strong  business judgment and an understanding of budgets, forecasting, expenses, and profitability.
  • The ability to set clear expectations and hold themselves and others  accountable while building a positive team culture.
  • An  understanding of digital advertising and how broadcast and digital solutions can work together to solve client problems.
  • Curiosity,  creativity, and a willingness to try new things.
  • Strong communication, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.
  • The confidence to make decisions and the humility to listen to other ideas.
  • An entrepreneurial mindset and a desire to find opportunities rather than wait for them to appear.
  • Knowledge of FCC regulations and broadcast operations, or the ability and willingness to quickly develop that knowledge.
  • A  college degree or equivalent professional experience.
  • A  valid driver’s license.

Who Will Thrive Here

This opportunity is best suited for someone who loves building something with a team.

We are looking for a leader who enjoys being around people — coaching sellers, brainstorming ideas with programmers, getting out in the community, celebrating wins, solving problems, and helping good people become even better at what they do.

You should also be comfortable setting clear expectations, making decisions, having difficult conversations when necessary, meeting with clients, and understanding the financial performance of the business.

At DBC, our Market Managers have significant autonomy to lead their markets. With that freedom comes accountability, but also the opportunity to try things, move quickly, and make a real impact.A leader who genuinely cares about people while maintaining high expectations for performance will thrive here — someone who celebrates wins, addresses problems quickly, and believes that developing a successful team and building a successful business go hand in hand.If you are looking for an opportunity to build a great team, grow a business, have some fun along the way, and lead one of DBC’s key markets, we would like to hear from you.


Benefits

Dick Broadcasting Company offers a comprehensive and competitive benefits package, including:

  • Paid Time Off (Vacation, Personal and Sick)
  • Medical, Dental, Vision, Disability, and Life Insurance
  • Flexible Spending Account
  • 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan

job.title: ABC News SEO Intern, Spring 2027
job.description:
About the Role & Program:

The ABC News Digital group is responsible for creating, distributing and optimizing ABC News content across all platforms.


ABC News is seeking an SEO intern to assist in executing daily and long-term search strategy across ABC News brands and optimizing digital and video content across all platforms. This individual will work across all areas of search strategy for multiple teams. In addition, this position will help optimize video content for discoverability on YouTube.The candidate should have strong news judgment and a solid understanding ofeditorial workflows and strategies. They should be comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment, demonstrating impeccable judgment and collaborating across teams.


This internship is a full-time, six-month commitment in the New York, New York area from January 2027 - June 2027.


What You Will Do:
As an SEO intern, you will support with search strategy across all ABC News brands by optimizing videos, live streams, and digital articles for traditional search engines and LLMs. You will monitor real-time trends using search tools like Google Trends and SEMrush to surface editorial opportunities and provide actionable insights to teams across the news division. Collaborating closely with editorial and video departments, you’ll apply best practices to everything from breaking news and special projects to evergreen lifestyle content. This fast-paced role requires a detail-oriented individual with a passion for audience growth and a strong desire to master the evolving digital news landscape.


On any given day you might:

  • Optimize daily YouTube videos and live streams by drafting titles, descriptions, tags, and CTAs aligned with trending topics and audience intent
  • Assist in optimizing with keywords, links, and clear headings for traditional search, answer engines, and LLMs
  • Monitor search and YouTube trends using tools like Google Trends, SEMrush, and YouTube Studio to surface timely editorial and video opportunities
  • Assist in compiling daily and ad hoc search trend notes to multiple teams across the news division
  • Partner with editorial and video teams to apply best practices across headlines, metadata, playlists, and recurring video series
  • Assist with SEO support for breaking news, evergreen content, and special projects, including eCommerce and lifestyle coverage

Required Qualifications & Skills:

  • Experience in journalism, news reporting, news production, or digital news content through coursework, internships, campus media, or related projects.
  • Knowledge of SEO, YouTube, digital video, and audience growth
  • Familiarity with SEO best practices and emerging AI discoverability strategies
  • Experience working with data, trends, and performance metrics
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities with attention to detail in a fast-paced environment.
  • Familiarity with analytics tools is a plus, but not required

Eligibility Requirements & Program Information

Candidates for this opportunity MUST meet all of the below requirements:

  • Be enrolled in an accredited college/university pursuing a degree taking at least one class at time of application OR currently participating in a Disney College Program or Disney Internship.
  • Current Disney Interns, College, International, or Culinary Program Participants: You may only work for ONE consecutive year (12 months) in any combination of an internship and/or program.
  • Be at least 18 years of age
  • Possess unrestricted work authorization

 

Additional Information

  • Able to have a consistent, reliable work schedule throughout the internship
  • Fully available from January 2027 - June 2027
  • Fully available from Monday through Friday, primarily, and occasionally nights and weekends for the duration of the internship, 40 hours each week
  • Able to provide own housing for the duration of the internship program in the New York, New York area
  • Able to provide/have reliable transportation to/from work

The pay rate for this role in New York is $23.00 per hour. Job Title

Associate, Business Operations & Systems, Events

Job Description

About the Position

The Associate, Business Operations & Systems, Events will improve the processes and systems that help the Events team work efficiently across its portfolio. The role will focus on understanding current workflows, identifying opportunities to simplify them, and helping implement solutions that can scale across events.


About the Team

The Events team brings People Inc.’s brands to life through live experiences that connect audiences, talent, partners, and communities. Reporting to the Sr. Director of Events, this role will support events including the Food & Wine Classic in Aspen, the Food & Wine Classic in Charleston, and others within the Food portfolio.


In-office Expectations: This New York-based position is hybrid, with three days per week in the office and up to two days remote.


Position Contributions

25% Business Operations & Process Improvement

  • Support the Events systems roadmap by assessing and prioritizing improvements based on business impact and organizational needs.
  • Evaluate existing workflows and recommend practical ways to simplify or improve them.
  • Help pilot solutions within individual events and expand them across the portfolio where appropriate.

25% Systems Development & Airtable

  • Help develop Airtable as a core operational platform for event planning, programming, budgets and invoicing, sponsorships, customer service, and other workflows.
  • Identify opportunities to consolidate or redesign spreadsheets, documents, trackers, and manual processes.
  • Support interfaces, dashboards, views, and reporting that improve visibility and decision-making.

25% Project & Roadmap Management

  • Support systems and process improvement projects from discovery through implementation, with clear objectives, stakeholders, timelines, and outcomes.
  • Coordinate feedback, dependencies, and follow-up across teams; communicate progress and risks to Events leadership.
  • Measure the impact of implemented solutions and identify further improvements.

15% Cross-Functional Partnership & Adoption

  • Gather feedback from teams and translate it into system requirements and improvements.
  • Support testing, rollout, documentation, and training for new processes and systems.
  • Monitor adoption and help establish ownership so systems remain accurate and useful over time.

10% Automation, AI & Reporting

  • Identify opportunities for automation, AI, reporting, and alerts that support Events operations.
  • Translate business needs into clear use cases and requirements for technical partners.
  • Stay current on tools and capabilities that could improve how the team works.

Minimum Qualifications and Job Requirements

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience.

Experience

  • 2+ years of experience in event operations, business operations, process improvement, program management, or a related field.
  • Experience supporting live events, media, hospitality, production, or another environment with complex workflows and competing deadlines.
  • Experience partnering with technical or systems teams to translate business needs into workflows, test solutions, and support implementation.
  • Preferred experience improving processes across multiple teams or events, developing dashboards or reporting, or moving teams from manual trackers to more structured systems.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Strong project management, analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Ability to evaluate workflows, identify practical improvements, and coordinate work across teams with different priorities and levels of technical expertise.
  • Attention to detail and the ability to adapt solutions as business needs evolve.
  • Preferred familiarity with Airtable, Excel, or similar platforms, including databases, interfaces, automations, and integrations.
  • Preferred familiarity with workflow automation and AI-enabled business tools.

job.title: Cloud Platform Engineering Intern
job.description:
Job Title

Cloud Platform Engineering Intern

Job Description

About People Inc:
People Inc. is America’s largest digital and print publisher. Our 40+ iconic and fast-growing brands harness the best intent-driven content, the fastest sites, and the fewest ads to help nearly 200 million people every month, including 95 percent of US women, make decisions, take action, and find inspiration. People Inc. brands include PEOPLE, Better Homes & Gardens, Verywell, FOOD & WINE, The Spruce, Allrecipes, Byrdie, REAL SIMPLE, Investopedia, Southern Living and more.

About The Role:

We are seeking a Cloud Platform Engineering Intern to help build, automate, and validate infrastructure across Amazon Web Services (AWS), Google Cloud Platform (GCP), and Kubernetes environments.

This role is ideal for someone interested in cloud engineering, platform automation, and the emerging use of AI in infrastructure operations. The intern will work alongside Cloud Platform engineers to build tools that interact with infrastructure, collect and analyze operational data, validate configurations, and produce actionable reports.

The position will have a strong focus on Kubernetes, Infrastructure as Code, Configuration as Code, and AI-assisted infrastructure management. The intern will gain practical experience working with production-oriented cloud platforms while learning how to build automation that is secure, observable, repeatable, and safe to operate.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop tools and scripts that query, inspect, and report on AWS, GCP, and Kubernetes resources.

  • Build infrastructure inventory, configuration validation, compliance reporting, and operational health-check utilities.

  • Help automate cloud and Kubernetes infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform.

  • Contribute to Configuration as Code using tools such as Helm, Kustomize, Ansible, and declarative YAML.

  • Develop AI-assisted workflows for infrastructure analysis, troubleshooting, configuration generation, and validation.

  • Implement safeguards for AI-enabled infrastructure workflows, including schema validation, policy checks, dry-run capabilities, approval gates, and human review.

  • Integrate infrastructure tools with cloud APIs, Kubernetes APIs, CI/CD pipelines, Git repositories, and observability platforms.

  • Assist with validating Kubernetes manifests, Terraform plans, deployment configurations, and cloud resource settings.

  • Build reports and dashboards that identify configuration drift, resource usage, security risks, operational issues, and optimization opportunities.

  • Write unit and integration tests for infrastructure automation and validation tools.

  • Document tools, workflows, configuration standards, and operational procedures.

  • Participate in code reviews, technical design discussions, and platform engineering planning.

  • Work with engineers to investigate infrastructure issues and identify opportunities for automation.

Required Qualifications:

  • Currently pursuing a degree or equivalent training in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.

  • Foundational programming or scripting experience in one or more languages such as Python, Go, JavaScript/TypeScript, or Bash.

  • Basic understanding of Linux, networking, APIs, source control, and software development practices.

  • Familiarity with containers and an interest in Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure.

  • Familiarity with Git and collaborative development workflows.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to learn unfamiliar technologies and ask effective technical questions.

  • Clear written and verbal communication skills.

  • Interest in automation, developer platforms, and reliable infrastructure operations.

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience with any of the following is helpful but not required:

  • AWS or Google Cloud Platform.

  • Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, or Kustomize.

  • Terraform or another Infrastructure as Code framework.

  • Ansible or other configuration-management tools.

  • CI/CD platforms such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Argo CD, or Argo Workflows

  • REST APIs, cloud SDKs, or Kubernetes client libraries.

  • Data collection, reporting, dashboards, or observability tools.

  • Large language models, AI agents, tool-calling systems, or Model Context Protocol (MCP).

  • Automated testing, policy-as-code, or configuration validation.

  • Cloud security concepts such as IAM, workload identity, secrets management, and least-privilege access.

* This People Inc. Canada internship is scheduled to end in May 2027.

Job Title

Events Associate

Job Description

People Inc. is seeking an Events Associate to support the planning, development, and execution of the Food & Wine Classic in Aspen, Food & Wine Classic in Charleston, and additional events within the Food events portfolio.

 

Reporting to the Senior Director of Events, this role will support key event workstreams and special initiatives from planning through on-site execution, while serving as a lead for guest-facing experiences across both events. Responsibilities will span attendee communications, registration, customer service, on-site guest operations, and other initiatives that shape how consumers experience the events.


The ideal candidate is a hands-on event operator with a strong hospitality mindset who can move comfortably between big-picture thinking and detailed execution. They are proactive, highly organized, collaborative, and energized by both identifying ways to improve an experience and building the plan to make it happen.


Hybrid 3x a week- (New York) 

In-office Expectations: This position is hybrid in-office, with the ability to work remotely for up to 2 days per week.


About The Positions Contributions:

Weight % Accountabilities, Actions and Expected Measurable Results


40% Event Planning & Management:  Manage assigned event workstreams and initiatives from initial planning through on-site execution and post-event wrap-up.

Responsibilities include:

  • Lead assigned event workstreams independently, developing project plans, timelines, budgets, and operational requirements.
  • Coordinate across internal teams, venues, vendors, production partners, and other external stakeholders to move projects forward.
  • Manage timelines and deliverables, proactively identifying risks, dependencies, and solutions.
  • Develop and manage run-of-shows, operational plans, and other event documentation as needed.
  • Support site visits and broader planning priorities across Aspen and Charleston.
  • Travel to and work on-site at both events, taking an active role in event execution and problem-solving.
  • Lead additional event products or special initiatives based on annual priorities and team needs.

30% Guest Experience:  Serve as a key lead for the attendee experience across Aspen and Charleston, partnering with event leadership and cross-functional teams to create thoughtful, seamless, and memorable guest experiences.

Responsibilities include:

  • Champion the attendee perspective throughout the planning process and identify opportunities to improve the guest journey.
  • Lead the implementation of approved guest experience improvements from planning through execution.
  • Own key on-site guest experience workstreams, including pass pickup, guest flow and queue management, wayfinding, guest-facing signage, and on-site hospitality.

  • Use attendee feedback, customer service trends, and on-site observations to identify pain points and recommend improvements.

30% Guest Communications, Registration & Customer Service:  Manage the communications, registration tools, and support guests need to confidently prepare for and navigate the event.

Responsibilities include:

  • Develop and execute the post-purchase attendee communication journey, including confirmation communications, seminar registration reminders, Know Before You Go communications, FAQs, schedule updates, and other event information.
  • Manage attendee-facing website content and information, coordinating updates with internal teams and external website partners.
  • Partner closely with Marketing to ensure a seamless transition from the pre-purchase consumer journey to the post-purchase attendee experience.
  • Support the day-to-day relationship with ticketing and registration platforms, including setup, attendee-facing functionality, testing, and quality assurance.
  • Manage customer service inquiries and coordinate responses and escalations across internal teams as needed.
