  • Demonstrated experience independently managing event workstreams from planning through on-site execution.
  • Experience managing multiple projects, timelines, vendors, and stakeholders simultaneously.
  • Experience working cross-functionally in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment.
  • Comfort working with event technology, registration platforms, websites, or other customer-facing digital tools.
  • Experience managing on-site event operations and troubleshooting in real time.

  • Strong event management and project ownership skills with the ability to take a workstream from concept through execution.
  • A hospitality mindset and strong instinct for what creates an exceptional consumer experience.
  • Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, and follow-through.

job.description:
Job Title

Video Revenue Operations Analyst

Job Description

About The Position | Major Goals and Objectives and Location Requirements:

The Video Revenue Operations Analyst  plays a key role in the pre/post sale of digital video advertising campaigns, ensuring People Inc.  wins business, maximizes yield, and meets/exceeds clients’ goals. This position is responsible for supporting day-to-day video ad operations, including inventory forecasting, pricing and margin review, product solutions, campaign pacing, key performance indicator optimizations, and post-campaign analysis.  The ideal candidate is self-motivated and demonstrates excellent analytical and written communication skills.  Experience with digital/web video advertising is a plus.     


Schedule Requirements:

In-office Expectations: This position is hybrid in-office, with the ability to work remotely for up to 2 days per week.


About The Team | The Team and/or Brand:

Video Revenue Operations partners with Sales, Account Strategy, and Ad Operations to develop feasible proposals, execute campaigns, and use performance data to improve results.

About The Position’s Contributions:

Weight % Accountabilities, Actions, and Expected Measurable Results

35%

  • Review video media plans for inventory availability, product fit, pricing, performance goals, and expected margin.
  • Forecast available video inventory and identify delivery risks or opportunities before proposals are finalized.
  • Analyze campaign data and optimize efficiently throughout the lifecycle of the advertisement to meet both Key Performance Indicator (KPIs) and benchmarks (including viewability and brand safety where appropriate)

35%

  • Partner with Sales and Account Strategy to develop video proposals that align product capabilities, available scale, budgets, and client goals.  
  • Coordinate post-sale video activation with Ad Operations and other partners, confirming campaign setup and resolving launch or delivery issues.
  • Prepare clear campaign reporting, performance insights, and post-campaign analysis for internal teams and clients; support monthly billing reconciliation.

30%

  • Partner with syndication vendors on DDM video content feeds, site list reviews, and campaign execution & performance deliverables. 
  • Maintain working knowledge of video products, ad serving, measurement, and key campaign metrics; document findings and share improvements with the team.

The Role’s Minimum Qualifications and Job Requirements:

job.title: Financial Analyst II
job.description:
Overview

Called to K-LOVE

 

Inspiring People to Move Closer to Jesus

 

At K-LOVE, every role is ministry.

 

We hire first for ministry alignment and a shared commitment to our faith, mission, vision, and values. We then seek talented professionals who can use their God-given gifts, skills, and experience to serve with excellence.

 

If you love Jesus and are called to be part of a ministry that places Christ at the center of everything we do, we invite you to explore this opportunity. If your heart aligns with our mission and you possess the knowledge, skills, and abilities needed for the role, please keep reading.

 

 

Reporting to the Financial Analysis Manager, the Financial Analyst II provides experienced-level financial analysis and modeling to support strategic decision-making across the Ministry. This role independently manages portions of the forecasting, budgetary review, and financial planning process.

 

 

* This is an in-office position in Franklin, TN

 

Do our values align with yours?  Mission, Beliefs & Values. If so, please read on. 

 

 

Here’s just some of what you will be doing daily…

  • Conduct independent variance analysis and partner with departments to explain results.
  • Create and refine complex financial models for capital investment and Ministry growth initiatives.
  • Prepare monthly and quarterly forecasting reports for senior leadership.
  • Improve existing reporting tools and propose automation or visualization improvements.
  • Assist with Ministry-wide budgeting processes and identify cost-saving opportunities.
  • Interpret financial data and develop actionable insights that support Ministry success.
  • Mentor entry-level analysts and provide quality review of work.
  • Track and report on cash management processes, helping to improve forecasting accuracy.
  • Collaborate with other departments to support special projects and strategic planning.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

 

We are looking for a very specific skill set and business acumen. If you can say yes to each of these requirements, then we want to meet you!

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or a related field.
  • MBA, CPA or CFA preferred or in progress
  • Minimum of 2+ years of financial analysis experience.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills to engage non-financial audiences.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple deliverables independently.
  • Excellent Excel and financial modeling skills; knowledge of financial systems preferred.
  • Exceptional organizational, interpersonal, and communication skills with a heart for Ministry.
  • Capacity to inspire and develop others while embracing feedback, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • A collaborative and flexible style, with a strong service mentality. Need to be seen as a team player
  • Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to develop sincere business/Ministry relationships.
  • Strong written and verbal communication and presentation skills.
  • Demonstrated commitment to the social sector with a passion for our mission and values.

 

Employment Requirements

  • Must pass a pre-employment reference screen and background check.
  • Proof of legal authorization to work in the United States.
  • Must agree with K-LOVE Christ-Centered Life Covenant and Statement of Faith

 

 

Why work for K-LOVE?

 

K-LOVE is a nonprofit, multi-platform media company on a mission to draw people closer to Christ. Founded in 1982 in Santa Rosa, CA, with a singular radio station, K-LOVE today owns and operates the nation's two largest Christian music radio networks (K-LOVE and Air1) with over 1,000 broadcast signals across all 50 states, streaming audio reaching around the world, and a growing family of media ministries including podcasts, books, films, concerts, and events. K-LOVE employs nearly 500 team members between its office in Nashville, TN and field locations around the country. You can view our mission and values here Mission, Beliefs & Values. 

 

What can we offer you?

  • Industry leading Medical, Dental & Vision coverage
  • Short/long term disability and life insurance
  • Robust 401K with company match
  • Parental leave with Baby Bonding pay
  • Generous PTO, holiday and sick pay
  • Unique company culture that includes exclusive access to concerts, movie premieres, media industry events, and more
  • Leadership and Career Development Programs

job.title: Major Gifts Officer-Central Region
job.description:
Overview

Called to K-LOVE

 

Inspiring People to Move Closer to Jesus

 

At K-LOVE, every role is ministry.

 

We hire first for ministry alignment and a shared commitment to our faith, mission, vision, and values. We then seek talented professionals who can use their God-given gifts, skills, and experience to serve with excellence.

 

If you love Jesus and are called to be part of a ministry that places Christ at the center of everything we do, we invite you to explore this opportunity. If your heart aligns with our mission and you possess the knowledge, skills, and abilities needed for the role, please keep reading.

 

 

The Major Gifts Officer builds trusted, ministry-centered relationships with major gift donors and prospective partners, helping them connect their God-given passions with opportunities to advance K-LOVE’s mission. This role guides donors through meaningful engagement—identifying, cultivating, soliciting, stewarding, and closing philanthropic gifts—while developing thoughtful strategies that deepen long-term partnership and transformational generosity.

 

In addition, a VALUES FIT is top priority. Do our values align with yours?  Mission, Beliefs & Values. If so, please read on.

 

Travel required. Central Region.

 

Here’s just some of what you will be doing daily…

  • Serve as the primary relationship steward for an assigned portfolio of major gift donors and prospective partners, fostering trust, prayerful engagement, and alignment with the ministry’s mission.
  • Develop and execute donor strategies that invite transformational philanthropy, including five-, six-, and seven-figure gifts and planned giving opportunities that advance K-LOVE ministries.
  • Plan, coordinate, and travel to regularly visit donors and prospective partners in person, cultivating meaningful relationships through face-to-face engagement that supports donor strategy, stewardship, solicitation, and long-term ministry partnership.
  • Guide donors through the full major gift cycle, including identification, qualification, cultivation, solicitation, closing, stewardship, recognition, and ongoing engagement.
  • Create individualized engagement plans that reflect each donor’s interests, values, giving history, and desire to make a lasting ministry impact.
  • Prepare and present compelling gift opportunities in a timely, donor-centered manner that honors the donor’s relationship with the ministry and invites generous partnership.
  • Provide thoughtful stewardship that keeps donors informed of ministry impact, celebrates their generosity, and encourages continued engagement in sharing the hope of Christ.
  • Collaborate with Donor Engagement, Program, and ministry teams to align donor interests with strategic initiatives, meaningful experiences, and opportunities for deeper partnership.
  • Participate in portfolio review and planning processes, maintaining accurate donor records, contact reports, stewardship notes, and next steps to support coordinated relationship management.
  • Represent the ministry at donor meetings, regional gatherings, national events, and other engagement opportunities that strengthen relationships and advance mission partnership.
  • Adhere to guidelines and administrative procedures including submitting expense reimbursements, invoices, and contact report.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

We are looking for a very specific skill set. If you can say yes to each of these requirements, then we want to meet you! 

  • Bachelors’ degree; or a combination of education/training with relevant experience required
  • Fundraising certification a plus.
  • A minimum of 5 years of donor development, major gift, planned giving, or transferable relationship-development experience, with demonstrated ability to cultivate, solicit, steward, and close significant philanthropic gifts.
  • Demonstrated ability to listen well, discern donor motivations, and translate donor passions into meaningful ministry partnership opportunities.
  • Strong understanding of major gift fundraising practices, planned giving concepts, donor strategy, stewardship, and ethical relationship management.
  • Ability to travel and attend events and donor meetings that may occur in the evenings and/or on weekends.Operate successfully with a high degree of autonomy
  • Experience using Microsoft Office Suite; and CRM experience in Salesforce is a plus.
  • Ability to think strategically, set priorities, define desired outcomes, and guide donor engagement plans from initial cultivation through long-term stewardship.
  • Excellent organization, follow-through, and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple donor relationships, strategies, and administrative responsibilities with care.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to build trusted relationships with individuals, families, foundations, corporations, and ministry partners.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to engage philanthropic leaders through authentic, gracious, mission-centered conversations.
  • Commitment to accuracy, transparency, confidentiality, accountability, and ethical fundraising in all donor communications, reporting, and internal collaboration.
  • Ability to mentor Team Members and help them grow spiritually and professionally, leading by example.

Why work for K-LOVE?

 

K-LOVE is a nonprofit, multi-platform media company on a mission to draw people closer to Christ. Founded in 1982 in Santa Rosa, CA, with a singular radio station, K-LOVE today owns and operates the nation's two largest Christian music radio networks (K-LOVE and Air1) with over 1,000 broadcast signals across all 50 states, streaming audio reaching around the world, and a growing family of media ministries including podcasts, books, films, concerts, and events. K-LOVE employs nearly 500 team members in Franklin, TN, Rocklin, CA, and field locations around the country. You can view our mission and values here Mission, Beliefs & Values. 

 

What can we offer you?

  • Industry leading Medical, Dental & Vision coverage
  • Short/long term disability and life insurance
  • Robust 401K with company match
  • Parental leave with Baby Bonding pay
  • Generous PTO, holiday and sick pay
  • Unique company culture that includes exclusive access to concerts, movie premieres, media industry events, and more
  • Leadership and Career Development Programs 

 

“As an Equal Opportunity Employer, K-LOVE makes employment decisions based on merit and other legitimate reasons. The Company is committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment and equal employment opportunities regardless of protected class, characteristic or status. However, K-LOVE is a religious non-profit organization where all team members contribute to the Company’s mission of encouraging our audiences “to have a meaningful relationship with Christ.” Therefore, pursuant to the Civil Rights Act of 1964, Section 702 (42 U.S.C. 2000e I(a)), K-LOVE has the right to hire only candidates who agree with the Company’s Statement of Faith, Mission, Vision, and Values. Also, as a religious non-profit organization, the Company is not governed by the CA Fair Employment and Housing Act.”

Social Media Coordinator assists with content creation, marketing, analytics, live-event coverage, talent relations and advertising for social media and helps build online communities by nurturing existing audiences and developing new ones. This position also plays a key role as the alternate for digital channels (web, app, email, ads) and digital content (e.g. producer, editor and content manager) roles. Their primary goal is to further the mission of Air1, K-LOVE, Goodsource and other brands by helping to create, produce and approve branded and campaign content for digital communities. 

 

 

This is a onsite position located in Franklin, Tennessee.

 

Here's some of what you will be doing:

  •  
  • Suggest or write social media copy, schedule posts and assist with creation of photos, videos, live video and other content. 
  • Monitor, analyze and report on analytics to inform future content and social media campaigns.
  • Improve and grow social media accounts by assisting social media managers.
  • Aid and occasionally lead the content creation process for graphics, videos or text-only posts.
  • Assist with the planning, management and execution of social media campaigns, ensuring close alignment with Air1, K-LOVE, Goodsource and other brands. 
  • Monitor the health of all ministry social media accounts and maintain their cybersecurity.
  • Help administer social media management tools such as Planable and Rival IQ.
  • Serve as backup, as needed, for web, email and other digital platforms.
  • Support project management using tools such as Wrike and Google Drive.
  • Recommend strategies and assist with placing paid social media campaigns.
  • Monitor Air1, K-LOVE, Goodsource and other brand websites, ministry partners and artist pages to find relevant content to be shared on social media channels.
  • Manage multiple tasks simultaneously while maintaining flexibility, creativity and control over work projects. 
  • Job responsibilities are subject to review and change

Here's some experience we are seeking: 

  • Bachelor’s degree in digital media, marketing, communications or combination of education, training and relevant experience required.
  • Minimum three years experience in social media management, digital marketing or content creation.
  • Experience working with and managing brand/company social media profiles (e.g., Facebook, X, Instagram, YouTube and TikTok).
  • Possess hands-on experience with Adobe Creative Cloud.
  • Solid understanding of creating photo and video content with Photoshop, video editing software (e.g. Premiere Pro) and social media apps.
  • Deep understanding of analytics and what drives impressions, engagements and conversions.
  • Creative, resourceful and possess initiative with a solid sense of social media and marketing communication.
  • Keen sense of judgment regarding organization, trends, presentation and creating social media content.
  • Solid understanding of copywriting (AP Style), formatting and distributing content for the web and social media. Must be able to provide social media and copywriting samples. 
  • Self-managed and work independently.
  • Have a passion for social media and the content our audiences care about.
  • Strong attention to detail, comfortable with multi-tasking and solid organization skills.
  • Live-event coverage experience a plus.
  • Ability to meet tight deadlines, work independently and as a member of a team.
  • General experience with other digital platforms (web, app, email, etc.) a plus.
  • A collaborative and flexible style, with strong service mentality. Need to be seen as a team player.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to develop sincere business/ministry relationships.

  • Robust 401K with company match

job.description:
Technology is at the heart of Disney’s past, present, and future. Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology is a global organization of engineers, product developers, designers, technologists, data scientists, and more – all working to build and advance the technological backbone for Disney’s media business globally.

The team marries technology with creativity to build world-class products, enhance storytelling, and drive velocity, innovation, and scalability for our businesses. We are Storytellers and Innovators. Creators and Builders. Entertainers and Engineers. We work with every part of The Walt Disney Company’s media portfolio to advance the technological foundation and consumer media touch points serving millions of people around the world. 

Here are a few reasons why we think you’d love working here:

1.      Building the future of Disney’s media: Our Technologists are designing and building the products and platforms that will power our media, advertising, and distribution businesses for years to come.

2.      Reach, Scale & Impact: More than ever, Disney’s technology and products serve as a signature doorway for fans' connections with the company’s brands and stories. Disney+. Hulu. ESPN. ABC. ABC News…and many more. These products and brands – and the unmatched stories, storytellers, and events they carry – matter to millions of people globally. 

3.      Innovation: We develop and implement groundbreaking products and techniques that shape industry norms, and solve complex and distinctive technical problems.

Content Platforms & Operations is responsible for the development and ongoing advancement of the technical and operational functions driving the worldwide distribution and monetization of Disney’s linear networks and theatrical content. This includes Disney’s media supply chain and storage, network and theatrical distribution operations, media localization, network transmission and origination, and more. The global team also plays a critical role as the primary collaboration point for Product & Technology with Disney’s EMEA, APAC, and LATAM regional business teams

Job Summary:

The Copy Coordinator is responsible for the proper acquisition of all commercial content for the On-Air logs. Responsibilities may change daily to fit the needs of the department.

Responsibilities and Duties of the Role:

  • Work with Agencies and Sales departments on managing and maintaining the accuracy of all traffic commercial copy data.
  • The application of commercial copy by adhering to Agency instructions and any specification schedules provided by Sales Administration.
  • Work closely with Sales/Marketing for all Sponsorship accommodations to ensure the accurate placement of spots and billboards.
  • Maintain and file all commercial instructions for assigned accounts.
  • Work closely with Inventory Manager and digital media providers in obtaining commercial delivery status.
  • Work closely with Sales to ensure advertiser accommodations are met.
  • Communicate and resolve copy related issues with Sales and management to maximize inventory.
  • Assist Traffic management with various departmental projects.
  • Works closely with BS&P to ensure spots are approved to air.

Required Education, Experience/Skills/Training:

Basic Qualifications

  • ​Must have 1-3 years’ experience in Television Traffic.
  • Must be computer literate. 
  • Must have clerical and data input experience. 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Working knowledge of various Traffic systems, Microsoft Word and Excel

  • Must be organized, detail oriented and self-motivated.

  • Must have strong interpersonal skills and capable of working effectively within a team environment and across multiple business platforms.

  • Must be capable of learning new system procedures/functions as they pertain to the needs of our business.
  • Must be capable of explaining oneself both verbally and in writing. Ability to make decisions quickly and effectively under pressure.
  • Must have a positive attitude and willing to adapt in an industry environment where change is inevitable.

job.title: Lead Product Manager
job.description:
At Disney, we’re storytellers. We make the impossible, possible. The Walt Disney Company (TWDC) is a world-class entertainment and technological leader. Walt’s passion was to continuously envision new ways to move audiences around the world—a passion that remains our touchstone in an enterprise that stretches from theme parks, resorts and a cruise line to sports, news, movies and a variety of other businesses. Uniting each endeavor is a commitment to creating and delivering unforgettable experiences — and we’re constantly looking for new ways to enhance these exciting experiences.

The Lead Product Manager will be responsible for product strategy, concept development, and defining and executing these initiatives in collaboration with our key stakeholders and partners. The role will understand business and technical capabilities, identify gaps and deliver product roadmaps for new capabilities.

A successful candidate will be highly collaborative, able to work extremely effectively in a matrix organization while wearing multiple hats, be comfortable working autonomously, and adept at synthesizing a variety of technologies and capabilities into high quality, simple products and applications. 

As the subject matter expert for Disney Experiences (DX) Technology & Digital under Inventory & Sales Services, the role will be a liaison to development, implementation and support teams as well as support projects, enhancements, backlog and prioritization of features and capabilities.

The ideal candidate is a proactive self-starter with a knack for creating and executing a product vision, all while possessing a passion for learning. If you thrive on taking ownership, driving action, and contributing to the growth of product organizations, we want to hear from you! 

What you will do:

  • Lead creation of technical specification and user stories to enable system modification or development
  • Works with project team, business and other stakeholders to align roadmaps and strategy, understand the business needs, define requirements, guide work, schedule it for release, validate stakeholder responses and provide feedback  
  • Ensures requirements are aligned to the business goals of the project and refined to a sufficient level of detail to allow Architects and Software Engineers to design, develop and implement appropriate solutions
  • Identifies high level solution options for the business
  • Reviews and signs off on solution designs, ensuring business requirements are verified, validated and delivered
  • Combines business requirements into prioritized backlog grouped into project iterations in time to allow design/delivery to commence
  • Manages the scope and traceability of requirements throughout the project lifecycle, ensuring that they are understood by the project team and met by the delivered solution
  • Participates in functional design, construction and testing
  • Ensures the benefits, impact and release of all changes are tracked and managed
  • Ensures the required outcomes are built, tested, communicated, and delivered on time and within budget
  • Provides technical guidance and oversight
  • Leads complex analysis, providing guidance and oversight
  • Develops and maintains relationships with business, vendor and technology stakeholders
  • Provides thought leadership and asserts influence by driving complex projects to completion effectively and efficiently
  • Provides subject matter expertise on the business, associated processes and systems
  • Drives Agile standups, backlog grooming, planning
  • Recommends process and technology improvements to increase the effectiveness of the product
  • Manages project interdependencies in support of business strategies, roadmaps and financial commitments
  • Escalates issues and recommends appropriate solutions
  • Identifies product improvement opportunities by staying involved in product sustainment and customer feedback
  • Mentors team members on application of best practices and standards
  • Manages product roadmap in terms of prioritizing initiatives relative to business needs
  • Works with the business to determine the real issue that needs to be solved or the opportunity to do things differently
  • Develops highly complex business cases to ensure benefits align to strategic and tactical business objectives 
  • Supports the business in business, technical and financial feasibility assessments
  • Manages partner expectations, scope and budget discussion                                                       
  • Provides advice and recommendations on emerging trends which will be useful to both the business and IT in the delivery of the projects
  • Manages business engagement and stakeholder management activities for large or complex projects
  • Assists in identifying and managing risks, issues and dependencies

Required Qualifications & Skills:

  • 7+ years of product management or equivalent experience driving product strategy and execution, with a technical focus
  • Basic knowledge on Public Cloud Technologies like AWS
  • Proven experience leading teams within an agile, collaborative environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify, understand and drive resolution of complex critical issues
  • Excellent analytical, written and verbal communication skills
  • Previous experience with JIRA, Smartsheets, or similar tools
  • Demonstrated success in launching and scaling products by recognizing customer needs, creating a vision, building roadmaps, identifying success measurements, and executing excellence with peers.
  • Strong technical knowledge with experience leading large initiatives that span several teams and functional areas.
  • Proven ability to translate customer and business needs through requirements and user stories.
  • Strong communicator with proven ability to bring clarity and direction through written and verbal communication skills.
  • Data and hypothesis-driven aptitude, with the ability to flex business and technical thinking.

Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration or similar field or related work experience

Technology is at the heart of Disney’s past, present, and future. Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology is a global organization of engineers, product developers, designers, technologists, data scientists, and more – all working to build and advance the technological backbone for Disney’s media business globally.


The team marries technology with creativity to build world-class products, enhance storytelling, and drive velocity, innovation, and scalability for our businesses. We are Storytellers and Innovators. Creators and Builders. Entertainers and Engineers. We work with every part of The Walt Disney Company’s media portfolio to advance the technological foundation and consumer media touch points serving millions of people around the world.

 

Content Platforms & Operations is responsible for the development and ongoing advancement of the technical and operational functions driving the worldwide distribution and monetization of Disney’s linear networks and theatrical content. This includes Disney’s media supply chain and storage, network and theatrical distribution operations, media localization, network transmission and origination, and more. The global team also plays a critical role as the primary collaboration point for Product & Technology with Disney’s EMEA, APAC, and LATAM regional business teams.

 

Here are a few reasons why we think you’d love working here:

1. Building the future of Disney’s media: Our Technologists are designing and building the products and platforms that will power our media, advertising, and distribution businesses for years to come.

2. Reach, Scale & Impact: More than ever, Disney’s technology and products serve as a signature doorway for fans' connections with the company’s brands and stories. Disney+. Hulu. ESPN. ABC. ABC News…and many more. These products and brands – and the unmatched stories, storytellers, and events they carry – matter to millions of people globally. 

3. Innovation: We develop and implement groundbreaking products and techniques that shape industry norms and solve complex and distinctive technical problems.

Support the ABC Traffic & Log Operations Department in the New York office. Responsibilities include, but are not limited to, assisting with prepping the daily network logs for broadcast to East, Central, Mountain and Pacific affiliates.

  • Attend operational meetings and collaborate with the rest of the Program Operations department.
  • Assist with special projects as needed

  • Must have strong interpersonal skills and be capable of working effectively within a team environment and across multiple business platforms.
  • Must be capable of learning new system procedures/functions as they pertain to the needs of our business.
  • Must be capable of explaining oneself both verbally and in writing.
  • Ability to make decisions quickly and effectively under pressure.
  • Must have a willingness to adapt to an industry environment where change is inevitable.
  • Up to 29 hours per week.
  • Non-traditional working hours are required i.e. nights, weekends, holidays.

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Working knowledge of Broadcast Traffic systems or Television Traffic
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Word and Excel

 

Education  

  • Bachelors degree in Media Communications, Television/Radio Broadcasting or comparable field of study, and /or equivalent experience

  • Your unique view and experience.

  • Defining, reviewing, and documenting software and system designs in a high throughput, low latency microservices environment.

  • Enhancing systems’ observability with proper metrics, monitors, and alerts.

  • Bridge the gap between diverse team requirements and technical capabilities to deliver cohesive, scalable solutions.

  • Mentoring and inspiring others in all aspects of professional software development.

job.description:

Since its launch, the show has become one of the nation’s most successful daily news podcasts, earning recognition from the Edward R. Murrow Awards, Signal Awards, Webbys, and more for its excellence in journalism, storytelling, and innovation.


Start Here is entering a defining new chapter—transforming into a daily news video podcast that reaches audiences wherever and however they choose to engage, while continuing to deliver the trusted podcast its dedicated audience relies on each day. We’re seeking an experienced Producer with a background in writing and producing news and feature segments in audio and visual mediums, to help in this next phase of growth of an award-winning franchise as it evolves into a premier multi-platform news destination.


This is a hands-on role for a producer who can operate from concept to execution— helping guide day-to-day production, write and produce video podcast segments daily, as well as being an active voice in terms of long-term editorial strategy, audience growth, and innovation. You’ll join at a pivotal moment in the show’s history, with an opportunity to help lead its expansion from a category-defining podcast into a flagship daily news video podcast across streaming, social, and digital platforms—all while preserving the journalistic excellence that has made Start Here an essential part of people’s mornings.


The schedule for this role will be Sunday - Thursday, 2 p.m. - 10 p.m. EST, or later depending on breaking news.

Responsibilities

  • Be part of the overall editorial and production strategy for Start Here, being a part of daily content creation and guiding the show’s evolution into a daily news video podcast and multi-platform news franchise.

  • Work with the editors who cut and produce the show’s segments and episodes, collaborating with the host and editor throughout the production process.
  • Opportunity to be a core member of a high-performing team, fostering a collaborative newsroom culture while ensuring every episode delivers exceptional journalism, storytelling, and visual execution.
  • Be a key voice to help drive the creative vision, visual identity, and audience growth strategy for the franchise, developing platform-specific content and distribution approaches that maximize engagement across YouTube, social media, streaming, and emerging platforms.
  • Collaborate across editorial, production, graphics, audience development, Legal, Standards, and Rights & Clearances teams to deliver high-quality content, ensure compliance with company policies, and expand the show’s reach through original and social-first storytelling.

Basic Qualifications

job.description:
The Recurring Remote Associate Director II position (AD II) will work with Directors in preparing, supporting, and executing high level Studio, Remote and REMI productions. The Recurring Remote Associate Director II must have comprehensive knowledge and mastery of the Associate Director role, including strong multi-tasking and communication skills, plus leadership qualities. In addition, will contribute to content ideas based on developing storylines across sports. The Recurring Remote Associate Director II needs to possess strong project management skills and be able to contribute to multiple high-profile productions at one time. The Recurring Remote Associate Director II will be required to mentor ADIs and Stage Managers and must provide comprehensive written feedback on their development and performance to Directing Management. The Recurring Remote Associate Director II will direct assigned productions to begin the path toward Director. 

 

This role is Part Time in the Los Angeles, CA area with limited benefits.

 

Responsibilities:

  • Assists the Director during a production by timing elements, keying fonts, and coordinating feeds. Maintains communication with live shots by providing alerts and cues, and ensure the proper framing, audio and video levels meet on-air standards. Assists in communication of traffic changes, graphics requests, music cues, and source changes with media.
  • During Ignite/Automated productions – ADs will assist in routing, papping, framing and clearing remote guests, selecting music for studio productions and MOS’ing into the rundown, assist Director with checking codes and rundown changes.
  • Assists the Director with pre-production elements including billboards, promotions, teases, graphics, special effects and virtual imagery, coordinates video and fonts within the production.  
  • Participates in meetings with Production to assist in the development of visual content for the show.
  • Working with the Director and Production staff, will request images and monitor graphics to support storylines throughout the show. Will execute studio moves with requested elements during pre-production or discuss with director to be executed live.
  • Verifies locations of guests (remote and studio) with Audio and Transmission/VCC by providing paperwork (FrameStores, IFBs, booking windows).
  • Assists the Director, Producer and Coordinating Producer with PCR setup, including the comms and monitoring build.
  • Contributes to the planning and organizing of special projects.  Interacts with other departments for a common goal.
  • Works with the assigned lead Directors on special graphics elements and animations for specialty shows.
  • On REMI productions, assists the Producer and Director in managing game-related responsibilities and traffic. Communicates directly with multiple positions, including the timeout coordinator or red hat to ensure the game and control room are in sync. Generates cards with promotional, sales and editorial copy for talent to read on air.  Runs the preproduction session.
  • Directs Ignite and ViBox productions for digital and radio programming, plus pre-recorded segments in conventional control rooms and mobile units for studio and remote productions. 
  • Coaches and mentors Associate Directors and Stage Managers. Provides feedback to support development, and documents in written form to Management. Written feedback should be thoughtful and comprehensive with clear, detailed examples. 
  • Practices and maintains the Directing Department performance standards as they apply to leadership, communication, operations, personal development, and productions, and consistently performs all the duties and functions required of the role. Demonstrates strong leadership qualities in all interactions and decisions.

Required Qualifications:  

  • Minimum of 3 years’ experience in Directing department or network equivalent.
  • A thorough understanding of television production is mandatory.
  • Clear, concise, and comprehensive verbal communication skills.
  • Strong interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to think quickly in a pressure situation.
  • Leadership skills are a must as the position includes facility and crew oversight, organization and show execution, plus problem solving.
  • Hard working, detail oriented, creative, passionate about production and interested in technology.

 

Preferred Qualifications: 

  • Minimum of 5 years’ experience at the Associate Director level in Directing department or network equivalent, Director equivalent in local television.

Preferred Education:

job.title: Sr Mgr, Software Engineering
job.description:
At Disney Experiences Technology, our team creates world-class immersive and digital experiences for the Company’s vacation brands, Disney’s Parks and Resorts worldwide, Disney Cruise Line, Aulani, A Disney Resort & Spa, and Disney Vacation Club. The Disney Experiences Technology team is responsible for the end-to-end digital and physical Guest experience for all technology & digital-led initiatives across the Attractions & Entertainment, Food & Beverage, Resorts & Transportation, and Merchandise lines of business as well as other initiatives including the MyDisneyExperience app and Hey, Disney! 

Our team delivers large-scale, data-driven initiatives that enable business insight, operational efficiency, and enterprise-wide value across Disney Experiences. The DX Transformation Delivery Management Organization (DMO) partners closely with Business Functional Teams, Product, Engineering, Architecture, and Technology leaders to execute complex, initiatives that accelerate value by enabling data analytics and AI-ready capabilities at scale.

The Senior Manager, AI Delivery Execution sits at the leading edge of the DX Technology Transformation team, responsible for embedding AI and automation into every transformation initiative to drive scaled, compounding value over time. They will identify high-impact opportunities, building business cases, designing solutions, and driving execution through to production fully integrated into the platforms, processes, and workflows that power the DX segment. The role requires deep technical expertise in AI and automation, a strong focus on measurable outcomes, and the leadership presence to influence senior stakeholders, drive adoption, and build a high-performing team that consistently delivers at the edge of what’s possible.

What You’ll Do
  • Define and own the AI and automation strategy, prioritizing and delivering use cases aligned to business goals while leading end‑to‑end execution—from definition and design through engineering, testing, integration, and production deployment within transformation programs.
  • Design reusable AI and automation accelerators — patterns, frameworks, and components — that can be deployed across multiple DX businesses, functions, and programs, compounding value at the segment level.
  • Partner with technology teams to align on AI capability roadmaps, data readiness requirements, and the governance model for AI tools built on the centralized data platform.
  • Establish delivery standards for AI and automation engineering — including solution design, model governance, testing rigor, deployment reliability, and production monitoring — ensuring quality and sustainability at scale.
  • Accountabile for engineering quality, technical standards, and scalable solution delivery
  • Lead, manage, and develop a high-performing team, providing clarity of direction, technical mentorship, and accountability for delivery excellence.
  • Serve as a trusted strategic partner to senior business leaders across Finance, HR, and other functional areas — helping them understand what AI can and cannot do, building realistic expectations, and co-designing solutions that drive adoption and lasting value.
  • Communicate AI and automation strategy, progress, and outcomes to executive audiences — including Directors, VPs, and SVPs — through clear, business-grounded narratives that connect technical work to segment-level value.

Required Qualifications & Skills
  • 10+ years of experience in AI, machine learning, data engineering, or automation, with at least 3 years in a leadership role managing technical teams in an enterprise environment.
  • Proven delivery record taking AI and automation capabilities from concept through production in complex, matrixed organizations — with demonstrated, measurable business outcomes.
  • Deep technical fluency in applied AI/ML — including large language models, generative AI, agentic workflows, machine learning pipelines, and enterprise automation patterns (RPA, workflow orchestration, intelligent process automation).
  • Strong business value orientation: the ability to translate technical AI capability into a clear business case, quantify potential value, and track realized outcomes against that case post-deployment.
  • Experience designing and deploying reusable AI/automation frameworks or accelerators that scale across multiple programs, functions, or business units — not just one-off point solutions.
  • Demonstrated ability to integrate AI and automation capabilities into enterprise data platforms, operational systems, and business workflows — not just build them in isolation.
  • Strong cross-functional leadership skills, including the ability to influence senior stakeholders without authority, navigate organizational complexity, and drive alignment across diverse teams.
  • Experience managing and developing technical teams, including performance management, career development, and building a culture of delivery excellence and continuous learning.
  • Executive-level communication skills: comfortable translating complex AI concepts into business language for VP and SVP audiences, and building the credibility to be a trusted advisor on AI strategy.
  • Experience working in a segment-wide or enterprise-wide context, where solutions must scale across multiple business units with differing operational models and technology landscapes.

Technical Expertise

AI & Machine Learning

  • Applied experience with large language models (LLMs), generative AI, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and agentic AI frameworks in enterprise production environments.
  • Proficiency with ML lifecycle management — including model training, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and responsible AI governance (bias, fairness, explainability).
  • Familiarity with AI platforms and tooling such as Azure OpenAI, AWS SageMaker, Databricks, or equivalent enterprise AI infrastructure.

Automation & Integration

  • Hands-on experience with enterprise automation patterns including RPA, workflow orchestration (e.g., Apache Airflow, Azure Logic Apps), and intelligent process automation.
  • Experience integrating AI and automation capabilities with enterprise data platforms, ERP/EPM systems, and operational workflows.
  • Familiarity with data engineering fundamentals — pipelines, transformation, data quality, and the data readiness requirements that underpin AI effectiveness.

Platforms & Tooling

  • Experience with cloud-native data and AI platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP) and modern data platform architectures (lakehouses, data meshes, semantic layers).
  • Familiarity with BI and analytics tooling (Tableau, Power BI) and how AI-generated insights are surfaced and consumed by business users.
  • Proficiency with delivery and collaboration tools including Jira, Confluence, and Smartsheet.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience in a theme park, hospitality, retail, or large-scale consumer operations environment where AI and automation were applied to operational efficiency or financial insight use cases.
  • Experience building AI capabilities on top of a centralized data platform or data lakehouse architecture.
  • Familiarity with enterprise performance management (EPM) systems and the data and AI use cases they enable.
  • Experience delivering AI programs with international scope, including awareness of regional data privacy regulations (GDPR, PDPA, PIPL) and cross-border data governance.
  • Prior experience operating as the “AI center of excellence” function within a large organization, establishing standards, governance, and a use-case pipeline.

Education
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related technical discipline plus 10+ years of relevant experience, or
  • Master’s degree (preferred) in a relevant technical or quantitative field plus 8+ years of relevant experience, or
  • Equivalent combination of education and professional experience demonstrating M2-level technical leadership in AI and automation.

Federated Media South Bend is seeking a Promotions Director to lead and execute all station promotions, events, contesting, and community engagement initiatives across four market-leading radio brands: 103.9 The Bear, B100, Froggy 102.7, and 95.3 MNC.

This is a hands-on role focused on planning, coordination, and execution, with additional operational and logistical support provided by a Promotions Coordinator. The Promotions Director owns the full promotions lifecycle from concept, through execution and recap, while providing clear direction, approvals, and oversight across on-air, online, and on-site platforms.

The role serves as the strategic and operational hub connecting Programming, Sales, Digital, on-air staff, and the Promotions Coordinator to ensure promotions are executed at a high level and on schedule.

 

Key Responsibilities

Promotions Strategy & Execution

  • Develop, plan, and execute station promotions aligned with each brand’s identity and audience.
  • Serve as the project manager for all promotions across on-air, web, social, email, and live events.
  • Plan and oversee major tentpole events, live broadcasts, charity initiatives, concerts, and station appearances.
  • Maintain strong working relationships with venues, promoters, sponsors, and community partners.


Contesting & Compliance

  • Design and manage contest structures, timelines, rules, and prize fulfillment.
  • Ensure all contesting and promotions are FCC-compliant and follow company guidelines.
  • Oversee ticket inventories, prize distribution, waivers, and winner documentation.

 

Event & Remote Management

  • Oversee all station events, remotes, and on-site activations from planning to execution.
  • Coordinate logistics including staffing, station vehicles, equipment, signage, and branding.
  • Serve as lead on-site representative at major station events.


Collaboration with Programming & Sales

  • Work closely with Program Directors to ensure promotions align with station strategy and on-air execution.
  • Collaborate with Sales to develop promotions that support client initiatives while protecting station brands.
  • Evaluate promotional proposals to ensure brand fit, execution feasibility, and audience value.


Digital & On-Air Support

  • Oversee promotional messaging across social media, websites, email, and on-air platforms.
  • Write or approve promotional copy including liners, social posts, web content, and text/email messaging.
  • Ensure accuracy, consistency, and brand alignment across all platforms.


Leadership & Team Management

  • Directly supervise and provide direction to the Promotions Coordinator and part-time promotions staff.
  • Assign and prioritize tasks, timelines, and execution details through established workflows.
  • Lead promotions meetings, assign tasks, and manage timelines and expectations.
  • Serve as final approval point for promotional concepts, messaging, and execution plans.


Reporting & Recaps

  • Produce promotional recaps including photos, documentation, and sponsor deliverables.
  • Track execution performance and provide post-promotion summaries to internal teams.

 

Qualifications

  • Prior experience in radio promotions, events, or related fields is preferred but not required.
  • Strong organizational, project management, and leadership skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple promotions simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to work nights, weekends, and holidays as needed for events.
  • Valid driver’s license with a clean driving record.

 

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • Opportunity to lead promotions for four highly visible radio brands.
  • A collaborative, fast-moving radio environment with strong community presence.
  • Supportive leadership and clear operational structure.

Federated Media is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Email resume to Kyle Guderian at kyleg@federatedmedia.com

job.title: Accounting Supervisor
job.description:
We are seeking a proactive, highly organized, and detail-oriented Accounting Supervisor to join the FOX team in Mexico City. In this role, you will oversee day-to-day general accounting operations, manage AR workflows, and drive the month-end closing process across Mexico and Central America.

Serving as a crucial bridge between operational execution and managerial oversight, you will ensure total financial accuracy, regional tax compliance (including Mexican CFDI 4.0 and local tax/e-invoicing regulations across Central American countries), and strict alignment with US GAAP and local statutory standards.

The ideal candidate possesses strong analytical skills, expertise in multi-entity regional accounting, and proven experience guiding junior accounting staff within a dynamic, fast-paced multinational environment.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Regional Accounting Operations: Supervise daily accounting activities across Mexico and Central American entities, including general ledger maintenance, AR operational cycle, accruals, prepaid expenses, and fixed assets.
  • Month-End Close: Lead and streamline monthly, quarterly, and annual closing schedules for regional entities, preparing and reviewing complex journal entries, intercompany transactions, and balance sheet reconciliations.
  • Tax Compliance & Invoicing Standards: Ensure strict adherence to local tax regulations across all assigned jurisdictions (including Mexican CFDI 4.0, payment complements, and Central American e-invoicing and tax requirements).
  • Collaboration: Collaborate effectively with shared service centers, corporate finance, regional tax, and treasury teams.
  • Audit & Internal Controls: Maintain and enforce robust internal control policies across regional entities. Assist the Accounting Manager in coordinating internal and external audit deliverables for local and corporate audits.
  • Process Optimization: Actively identify opportunities to standardize and automate accounting processes across countries.
  • Stakeholder & Customer Management: Serve as a key escalation point for complex cross-border customer reconciliations, regional onboarding due diligence, and multi-country operational inquiries.

Qualifications:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in accounting.
  • Experience: 5 years of progressive accounting experience, with at least 1–2 years supervising or mentoring accounting staff within a multinational corporate environment. Experience managing or supporting Central American entities is highly preferred.
  • Language Skills: Professional proficiency in both English and Spanish (written and verbal) is required.
  • Technical & Tax Expertise: Deep expertise in Mexican electronic invoicing/tax regulations (CFDI 4.0) and working knowledge of Central American tax and statutory requirements. Solid proficiency in local GAAP and working knowledge of US GAAP and/or IFRS.
  • Systems Experience: Hands-on experience with major ERP systems. Familiarity with multi-entity financial software and tools such as Workday, Coupa, or Graphite is highly desirable. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
  • Leadership & Analytical Skills: Strong leadership capabilities, attention to detail, and a proactive problem-solving mindset with the ability to manage tight deadlines and multi-country priorities.

job.title: Acquisition Marketing Manager
job.description:
The FOX direct-to-consumer (DTC) platform is a new, forward-looking initiative within Tubi Media Group that brings FOX’s unparalleled content portfolio—news, sports, and entertainment—directly to consumers via an innovative subscription streaming service.

Driven by a highly experienced leadership team with extensive backgrounds at the intersections of media, technology, streaming, and content—and built with the full support of Fox Corporation—this venture combines entrepreneurial energy with deep media expertise.

Our vision is to create a unified, modern viewing experience that puts the consumer first—seamlessly integrating live and on-demand content across platforms.

At the intersection of cutting-edge technology and trusted storytelling, this is an opportunity to shape the future of streaming at one of the most pivotal moments in media. We’re assembling a world-class team to deliver on that vision—and we’re just getting started.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for an Acquisition Marketing Manager to own acquisition marketing operations across FOX One’s paid and owned & operated channels. This role will serve as the central point of organization and communication across campaigns and placements, ensuring creative, timelines, approvals, and execution remain aligned back to the FOX One strategy.

You will manage the day-to-day workflow with our agency partner, keeping paid acquisition campaigns on track from creative specifications through launch. You will also own the end-to-end trafficking process for owned & operated and synergy placements, partnering closely with FOX News, FOX Sports, FOX Entertainment, and Tubi. Across these efforts, you will ensure messaging, assets, and placements are coordinated and consistent while serving as a key resource for campaign status, troubleshooting, and execution.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Support media plan development and execution across paid and owned & operated channels to drive subscriber acquisition, keeping multiple concurrent campaigns, creative assets, placements, and deadlines organized and on track
  • Manage the relationship and daily workflow with our outside agency, as well as other vendors and platforms, coordinating campaign specifications, creative assets, timelines, approvals, and deliverables
  • Own the end-to-end trafficking process for owned & operated and synergy placements in partnership with FOX News, FOX Sports, FOX Entertainment, and Tubi
  • Partner with the brand and creative team to request, approve, and traffic assets, and steward creative alignment strategy across campaigns to ensure the right message reaches the right placement and audience
  • Coordinate with agencies, platforms, and vendors on campaign execution and optimization, and serve as a central point of contact providing clear status updates and proactively identifying and resolving execution issues
  • Build and maintain processes and tracking systems, including campaign documentation and trackers, that create visibility across campaigns, stakeholders, deliverables, and deadlines
  • Conduct competitive and audience research to inform campaign strategy
  • Partner closely with business units and creative teams to ensure assets meet campaign requirements and are delivered on schedule
  • Proactively flag risks, troubleshoot issues, and hold internal and external partners accountable to campaign timelines

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Typically, 7+ years of experience in media, ad operations, marketing, or a related area, with demonstrated ownership of campaign strategy or asset creative processes
  • Demonstrated experience stewarding creative alignment, ensuring messaging and assets are seamlessly tailored to and optimized for the right placements and audience touchpoints
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple concurrent campaigns, deliverables, and stakeholders while maintaining strong attention to detail
  • Impeccable organizational skills and the ability to build and maintain processes that keep creative and campaigns aligned across teams
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience working across internal business units, creative teams, and external agency partners
  • Ability to proactively identify and communicate issues, troubleshoot campaign execution challenges, and hold partners accountable to deadlines
  • Occasional flexibility to work evenings and weekends in support of live programming, breaking news, launches, and marquee events.
  • Regular, on-site attendance at the workplace a minimum of 3 days per week is an essential function of the position. Selected candidate must be able to reliably meet this requirement.

NICE TO HAVE, BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER

  • Experience working in paid social, CTV, or programmatic campaigns
  • Familiarity with Excel, Airtable, and Figma for campaign tracking, reporting, and workflow management
  • Experience working within a lean team or marketing organization and successfully managing responsibilities across multiple areas

job.title: Digital Journalist, LiveNOW from FOX
job.description:
As a Digital Journalist you will join the team behind LiveNOW from FOX, FOX TV Stations’ national live streaming news channel. LiveNOW brings viewers the most relevant and engaging live news coverage occurring right now across the country and the world. We are a team of passionate content creators seamlessly moving between the biggest live events and stories as they happen to keep our viewers informed. LiveNOW is always raw, live and unfiltered, with limited commentary and no opinion. Our Digital Journalists watch with viewers as breaking news unfolds, leveraging the latest newsroom technologies to help the audience understand what is occurring and answering their questions.

Reporting to the Executive Producer you will curate, produce, and host live coverage of breaking news and important events as they happen. You will be responsible for giving our audience an in-the-moment view of what’s going on right now. If you are a self-professed news junkie who always knows what’s going on around the world looking for an opportunity that blends being a host, reporter, and producer, look no further than LiveNOW!

This position is based in LiveNOW’s west coast newsroom at FOX 10 Phoenix.

Schedule: Tuesday - Saturday, 4PM-12:30AM (local timezone)

**Only applications with a reel will be considered for this position. Reels may be submitted in your application as a link or attachment.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Gather, produce, and present original content live for breaking news and major news events, on digital, social, streaming and broadcast platforms nationwide.
  • Simultaneously manage content and live video production, including video switching and graphics.
  • Monitor live video feeds, newsgathering tools and social media for the latest information and content.
  • Maintain constant communication with FOX O&O stations as well as other internal and external partners to coordinate receiving video and new information.
  • Stay up-to-date on news and current events.
  • Pitch story ideas and contribute to the editorial process while adhering to journalistic standards
  • Assist in editorial planning and monitor real-time analytics.
  • Support other Digital Journalists in producing content.
  • Other duties assigned as deemed appropriate and necessary.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • At least 3 years of experience reporting and hosting live news coverage.
  • BA/BS degree preferably in Journalism, Communications or related field.
  • Strong knowledge of current events with a deep understanding of how viewers are consuming news in this media landscape.
  • Excellent live communicator with the ability to host continuous coverage over extended periods of time.
  • Proven ability to guide viewers through live breaking news and major events happening around the world in an easy-to-follow manner.
  • Great research skills and editorial judgment with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced breaking news environment.
  • Familiarity and curiosity for newsroom technologies (TriCaster).
  • Understanding of digital production and live video workflows.
  • Strong communication, organization, and problem-solving skills.
  • Flexibility to work early mornings, nights, weekends, and holidays

Why Join LiveNOW from FOX?

At LiveNOW, you’ll be part of a team redefining how news is delivered in the digital era. We bring audiences live, unfiltered breaking and events from around the country in real time—no scripts, no anchors, just the story as it unfolds. With millions of viewers tuning in across multiple platforms, this is your chance to help shape the future of live digital journalism.

job.title: Director, Insights & Analytics
job.description:
FOX News Media is looking for a Director, Insights & Analytics to lead data and analytics for our subscription services portfolio. Anchored today by FOX Nation, a premium subscription streaming service, this leader will own all subscription analytics across the full and growing portfolio.

This is an entrepreneurial, high-visibility role for someone who is energized by ambiguity and wants to help build a business, not just report on it. You will be equally comfortable writing complex SQL to get to the data yourself, defining a brand-new subscriber metric framework from scratch, and presenting acquisition and retention insight to senior executives.

You will own the full subscriber lifecycle covering acquisition, engagement, and retention and translating consumer and revenue data into clear, decision-ready narratives that shape content, marketing, product, and pricing strategy across our subscription products.  This role will have two direct reports who will be focused on optimizing marketing strategies, spend to drive acquisition, retention and engagement on our platforms.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITES 

  • Own end-to-end subscription analytics for FOX Nation and, as the portfolio grows, for additional subscription services across FOX News Media, spanning acquisition, onboarding, engagement, retention, churn, win-back, and lifetime value
  • Independently access, query, and interrogate data using advanced SQL, you will frequently be the one getting to the answer directly, not waiting on it
  • Define and evolve the subscriber analytics framework and metric definitions that will serve as the standard across current and future subscription products
  • Lead engagement analysis for FOX Nation across web, mobile app, CTV, social, third-party platforms, and FOX One — pulling data directly and partnering with other analytics, product, and data engineering teams to source what you need

job.title: Director, Media Workflows
job.description:
The Media Workflows department is the connective tissue of FOX Sports’ content operations — an umbrella group spanning post production, live studio playback, workflows from ingest to air for all of FOX Sports’ production and operations teams. FOX Sports produces a wide array of live sports as well as original studio and other programming for air on the FOX Broadcasting Channel, FS1 & FS2, and digital platforms such as FOX One and various social media channels.

As content volume, speed-to-air, and the number of distribution surfaces continue to grow, the department’s mandate is no longer only to keep these workflows running reliably — it is to continuously re-engineer them into a media supply chain that is increasingly software-defined, cloud-enabled, data-rich, and agent-assisted, without compromising the reliability that live production demands.

The Director, Media Workflows carries a deliberate dual mandate: to run today’s post production and live studio workflows and operations with uncompromising reliability, and to lead the transformation of those operations — introducing AI, automation, and orchestration as core, owned outcomes rather than experiments at the edges. This is a single leadership role that both operates the plant and changes it.

Reporting to the Vice President of Media Workflows, the Director oversees all facets of Post Production — managing media teams for post and live productions, technical operation of edit bays, live studio edit/playback systems, and capital projects for improvements across all areas.

Within the first 12–18 months, this Director will have kept live and post production reliably on-air while measurably advancing the department’s transformation: Agents and automation embedded into named workflows with tracked ROI; a metadata and content-as-data foundation in place; a repeatable innovation pipeline moving proofs-of-concept into production; and a workforce actively reskilled for automated/assisted operations. The measure is not that the workflows still run — it is that they are demonstrably faster, more discoverable, more automated, and more resilient than they were.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

Operations & Production Continuity

  • Oversee workflow practices across technical facilities — hardware, software, and personnel — to meet the creative and operational requirements of all shows and events
  • Architect and maintain content management and workflow systems at an enterprise level, spanning operational requirements for live and post production and administrative management
  • Maintain focus on high-level company objectives while managing the granular, interconnected dependencies of highly visible live production workflows; solves problems appropriately and escalates when necessary
  • Own capital planning and project delivery for improvements across all post production and media workflow areas, sequencing modernization against live-event and craft edit obligations

Automation & Workflow Orchestration

  • Design agentic and human-in-the-loop workflows that embed agents into production, defining where automation acts autonomously and where human review is required, with editorial quality and speed-to-air as the measured outcomes
  • Own the orchestration and automation layer connecting MAM/PAM, playback, and ingest systems —event-driven and API-first — treating these workflows as products with roadmaps rather than facilities to keep alive
  • Accountable for Innovation ROI: define success metrics, tracks adoption and cost-to-value, and retires tools that do not earn their place

Cloud, Hybrid & Distributed Production

  • Accountable for cloud and hybrid media workflows and for remote/distributed post production models, extending edit and playback beyond fixed on-prem facilities, exchanging content anywhere in the world
  • Partner with Engineering to define the reference architecture for where workloads run (on-prem, cloud, or hybrid) based on latency, cost, and reliability

Content Protection & Resilience

  • Accountable for content protection and resilience across a surface widened by cloud services and third-party vendors — partnering with Information Security on vendor and supply-chain risk
  • Ensure automated pipelines fail safely, with monitoring, fallbacks, and recovery paths appropriate to live, no-second-take production

Workforce Transformation & Change Leadership

  • Lead reskilling and role redefinition as automation reshapes media operations, defining how post and live-production roles evolve alongside automated workflows
  • Own management of NABET union freelancers — contract policy, workflow practices, scheduling, budget, and personnel matters — and navigates union relationships thoughtfully through operational and technological change.
  • Serve as change agent for the department, bringing team leads and frontline staff along through transformation with clear communication and prioritized, fluid information

Innovation Pipeline & Strategic Partnerships

  • Run innovation as a repeatable function — structured proofs-of-concept, an emerging-technology evaluation pipeline, and clear graduation criteria from pilot to production — rather than as ad hoc experimentation.
  • Manage strategic cloud, automation, and tooling partnerships, positioning Fox Sports to assert industry leadership in workflow and media-technology advances.

Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Maintain operational continuity and alignment across Fox Sports — other Operations groups, Production, Engineering, Media Management, technology groups, and Creative Services.
  • Sustain close relationships with production leads to understand evolving workflow needs, and with engineering and technical leaders to align strategy, technology trends, and vendor direction.
  • Further a culture of collaboration, operational excellence, and accountability within post production and, indirectly, across FOX Sports

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • 8+ years of professional experience in network-level broadcast and/or post production environments.
  • Hands-on experience with cloud and hybrid media workflows and their operational and cost-governance implications for post-production or broadcast environments.
  • Experience deploying AI/ML into production workflows — not only fluency with tools (Gemini, Claude, ChatGPT, etc.), but hands-on experience integrating AI services, designing agentic or human-in-the-loop workflows, and evaluating outcomes. Understanding of machine-learning training and implementation
  • Expertise with post production tools across editorial and graphics applications, MAM/PAM solutions, media-centric file-based workflows, and digital file-transfer solutions
  • Strong background in leading technical teams, change management, and enterprise-level business initiatives, with the ability to build consensus and motivate staff across a large landscape
  • Excellent verbal, written, presentation, and documentation skills; proficiency across Google Workspace and collaboration tools (Slack, Zoom, Outlook); knowledge of both Mac and PC environments

NICE TO HAVE BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER

  • Education in TV Production, Broadcasting, Engineering, or a related communications field
  • 3+ years of enterprise-level management in a related field; supplemental education in business management
  • Direct or adjacent experience in product development / product management, software engineering, or DevOps — the disciplines behind treating workflows as products and automation as software
  • Familiarity with distributed / HRP (at-home) production models and cloud FinOps
  • Awareness of content-authenticity and provenance standards (e.g., C2PA) and the rights, likeness, and governance considerations around synthetic and AI-modified media
  • Exposure to observability/telemetry practices and defining operations by measured SLAs and quality
