job.title: Director, Product Operations & Delivery
job.description:
El Director de Operaciones de Producto y Delivery es el enlace principal entre el negocio de FOX One México y las áreas centralizadas de Producto, Operaciones de Producto, Delivery e Ingeniería.

Este puesto existe por tres razones, en este orden:

  • México está migrando. FOX One México está migrando de extremo a extremo desde sus plataformas de proveedor actuales —aplicaciones, identidad, comercio, derechos de acceso (entitlements), playout y distribución— hacia el stack tecnológico de FOX DTC, con un lanzamiento de primera fase previsto para el 15 de febrero de 2027. El mercado necesita una contraparte operativa dedicada dentro de la organización que lo está construyendo.
  • Después hay que operar México. Tras el lanzamiento, la salud del producto y de la operación debe medirse de forma continua, convertirse en trabajo de producto priorizado y en optimización de procesos de negocio, y llevarse a través de Delivery hasta un resultado validado.
  • América Latina es el siguiente paso. México es la primera instancia de un modelo replicable, no un caso aislado. Este puesto construye el modelo operativo, los procesos y la automatización que hacen que los siguientes mercados sean más rápidos y económicos, y asegura que las necesidades locales se resuelvan configurando una plataforma multi-tenant en lugar de desarrollos específicos por mercado.

La posición está facultada para actuar con autonomía —identificar oportunidades, formarse un criterio propio e iniciar trabajo sin esperar una solicitud formal— acompañada de la colaboración y comunicación necesarias para alinear a los líderes y aplicar las mejores prácticas de la organización DTC en favor de la escala y la eficiencia.

Responsabilidades Principales

Liderazgo de la Operación y del Negocio

  • Ser el responsable operativo del día a día y el punto de contacto único de FOX One México dentro de la organización de tecnología.
  • Investigar incidencias, llegar a conclusiones e impulsar mejoras de forma independiente, presentando una recomendación y no solo un reporte.
  • Construir relaciones de confianza con la dirección del negocio local, merchandising, mercadotecnia, finanzas y atención al cliente, y con sus contrapartes centralizadas en Estados Unidos.
  • Responsabilizarse de la preparación del mercado durante la migración y el lanzamiento: habilitación de merchandising, preparación de atención al cliente, operaciones locales de finanzas y negocio, y operación del día del lanzamiento.
  • Representar la realidad operativa del mercado en la planeación central, incluyendo aquello que no puede posponerse sin impacto al cliente.

Salud del Producto y de la Operación

  • Definir y ser responsable del marco de salud de producto y operación: qué se mide, qué se considera un buen resultado y dónde se ubican los umbrales.
  • Asegurar que existan los dashboards, las alertas y las revisiones recurrentes para que la salud sea visible sin que nadie tenga que solicitarla, en colaboración con los equipos que las construyen.
  • Detectar de forma temprana deterioros y riesgos emergentes, asegurar el diagnóstico de la causa y convertirlo en una corrección operativa o en una mejora de producto definida.
  • Establecer la línea base de medición de cada nuevo mercado de LATAM desde el lanzamiento, en lugar de reconstruirla después.

Gestión de Producto y Mejoras

  • Traducir las necesidades del negocio y de la operación en planteamientos de problema y SOPs que Delivery e Ingeniería puedan ejecutar sin una reunión de aclaración.
  • Facilitar la recepción y priorización de iniciativas del mercado dentro del modelo operativo DTC, y negociar capacidad en el roadmap frente a otros mercados y productos.
  • Validar que las soluciones entregadas cumplieron el objetivo que las justificó, medido contra el marco de salud, y señalarlo con claridad cuando no haya sido así.

Mejora de Procesos y Automatización

  • Tratar el modelo operativo como un producto: identificar dónde los procesos son manuales, lentos, propensos a error o dependientes de una sola persona, y corregirlos.
  • Mejorar la recepción de solicitudes, la priorización, el seguimiento de la ejecución, la gestión de liberaciones, la atención de incidentes y los reportes, alineados a las prácticas de gestión de portafolio de DTC.
  • Automatizar el trabajo operativo y de reporteo recurrente junto con Ingeniería, Analytics y los equipos de herramientas internas. Lo que es aceptable hacer a mano para un mercado resulta inviable con varios.
  • Documentar el modelo operativo para que pueda transferirse a un nuevo mercado, a una nueva persona o a un equipo.

Coordinación de la Entrega (Delivery)

  • Dirigir la ejecución con los equipos centralizados de Delivery y los equipos de Ingeniería distribuidos: requerimientos, dependencias, secuenciación, riesgos y fechas.
  • Mantener la visión de ejecución, dependencias y riesgos como un documento vivo, con una persona responsable y un siguiente paso en cada punto abierto.
  • Administrar la ruta crítica y poder expresar en una sola frase qué está bloqueando el lanzamiento o la liberación.
  • Eliminar bloqueos de forma activa: escalar de manera temprana, convocar a las personas correctas y cerrar el ciclo por escrito el mismo día.
  • Responsabilizarse de la preparación para la liberación y el cutover: criterios de go/no-go, ensayos, operación del día del lanzamiento, plan de reversión (rollback) y comunicación de incidentes.
  • Hacer cumplir la disciplina operativa: decisiones registradas, cambios de alcance documentados y acuerdos verbales asentados por escrito.

Reportes y Comunicación

  • Ser responsable del ritmo operativo del mercado: señal operativa diaria, estatus semanal de ejecución y riesgos, y revisión mensual de negocio y plataforma.
  • Reportar salud de plataforma y producto, desempeño del negocio, riesgos y dependencias, incidentes con impacto al cliente y estado del pipeline — con análisis y recomendación, no volcados de datos.
  • Servir de puente entre Negocio, Producto, Operaciones de Producto, Delivery, Ingeniería, Atención al Cliente, Mercadotecnia y Finanzas, en dos idiomas y entre husos horarios.
  • Gestionar de forma bilingüe la comunicación de escalamientos e incidentes con impacto al cliente. Un retraso debe surgir desde esta posición antes de manifestarse como una fecha incumplida.

Expansión Regional (LATAM)

  • Convertir lo aprendido en México en un manual replicable de lanzamiento de mercados: preparación operativa, línea base de medición, atención al cliente, comercio y habilitación de merchandising.
  • Definir qué es genuinamente específico de cada mercado y qué debe resolverse configurando la plataforma multi-tenant, y cuestionar las propuestas de desarrollos aislados.
  • Responsabilizarse de la preparación operativa de los siguientes mercados de LATAM y hacer crecer la función regional conforme aumente el alcance.

job.title: Director, TVOD & Revenue Share
job.description:
FOX Entertainment Global is seeking a Director of TVOD and Revenue-Share to lead transactional content sales and account management across digital platforms and partners. This role will drive revenue growth through the strategic licensing and distribution of FOX content across TVOD, electronic sell-through, and revenue-share business models.

The Director will serve as a senior, client-facing leader responsible for day-to-day account relationships, commercial strategy, and execution. The role will maximize the value of FOX’s content by applying a deep understanding of licensed media rights, windowing, pricing economics, promotional strategy, and partner business objectives. Success will require strong analytical judgment, cross-functional leadership, and the ability to move complex initiatives forward under strict deadlines.

Regular, on-site attendance at the workplace for a minimum of four (4) days per week is an essential function of the position. The selected candidate must be able to reliably meet this requirement.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead TVOD and revenue-share sales strategy across a portfolio of digital platforms, retailers, and distribution partners
  • Serve as the primary day-to-day point of contact for key client accounts, managing ongoing account activity, priorities, deliverables, and escalations
  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with platform, retailer, and digital distribution partners to support renewals, growth, and long-term collaboration
  • Develop and execute joint business plans with clients, using sales analysis, performance trends, and market intelligence to identify opportunities and establish priorities
  • Analyze account performance, title-level results, revenue trends, pricing, and promotional effectiveness to inform commercial recommendations
  • Manage promotional strategy, including content selection, pricing economics, merchandising opportunities, release timing, and marketing support
  • Evaluate and optimize content availability, rights, and windowing to maximize revenue across transactional and revenue-share opportunities
  • Partner with internal teams to coordinate title setup, product information, materials, pricing, availability, promotions, and other launch requirements
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Legal, Finance, Marketing, Operations, Content Planning, and Distribution teams to execute deals and account plans
  • Review and apply licensing agreements, deal terms, revenue-share structures, and other commercial arrangements to ensure accurate and effective execution
  • Support negotiations and deal structuring, balancing partner needs with FOX’s financial, rights, and strategic objectives
  • Track account commitments, timelines, deliverables, and workflows to ensure projects are completed accurately and on schedule
  • Monitor industry trends, competitive activity, platform changes, and emerging digital business models to inform sales strategy
  • Prepare clear account updates, sales analyses, forecasts, presentations, and recommendations for internal leadership and external partners
  • Identify and pursue new opportunities to expand distribution, improve performance, and increase the value of FOX’s content library
  • Represent FOX in relevant client meetings, industry events, and business planning discussions

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • 7+ years of experience in transactional content sales, digital distribution, licensing, or account management, preferably at a major studio or media company
  • 2+ years of experience operating as a direct client-facing primary point of contact and managing day-to-day account activities
  • Experience managing promotional strategy, including content selection, pricing economics, merchandising, and marketing coordination
  • Deep understanding of licensed media rights, content availability, windowing, and digital distribution models
  • Demonstrated experience in sales analysis, performance reporting, forecasting, and joint business planning
  • Familiarity with licensing agreements, revenue-share structures, commercial terms, and deal execution; negotiation experience preferred
  • Strong critical-thinking skills and the ability to translate data, market dynamics, and client objectives into practical recommendations
  • Proven ability to lead projects and workflows across multiple teams while managing competing priorities and strict deadlines
  • Excellent communication, presentation, relationship-building, and stakeholder-management skills
  • Self-starter who takes initiative, exercises sound judgment, and is comfortable managing responsibilities with limited direction
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple accounts, deliverables, and timelines in a fast-paced environment

NICE TO HAVE BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER

  • MBA
  • Experience working with international clients, markets, or digital distribution businesses
  • Familiarity with AI tools and their practical application in professional environments

job.title: Host/Producer (Overnights), LiveNOW from FOX
job.description:
Schedule: Thursday – Monday

  • Weekends (Saturday & Sunday): 12:00 AM – 8:30 AM
  • Weekdays (Thursday, Friday & Monday): 11:00 PM – 7:30 AM

LiveNOW from FOX is looking for an Overnight Host/Producer to join FOX TV Stations’ national live streaming news offering. As the Overnight Host/Producer you will be part of the team that keeps viewers informed and engaged at all hours of the day! You’ll get the best of both worlds – hosting live, on-air coverage on some nights, and driving viewer engagement while supporting other hosts behind the scenes on others. This flexible role is ideal for a dynamic journalist who thrives both in front of the camera and behind the scenes. You’ll balance real-time coverage of what’s happening right now with forward-thinking content presentation and finding innovative ways to help viewers find the live events and latest updates they’re looking for.

LiveNOW brings viewers the most relevant and engaging live news coverage occurring right now across the country and the world. We are a team of passionate journalists and content producers seamlessly moving between the biggest events and stories as they happen to keep our audience informed. LiveNOW is always raw, live and unfiltered, with limited commentary and no opinion.

**Only applications with a reel will be considered for this position. Reels may be submitted in your application as a link or attachment.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Gather, produce, and present live coverage of breaking news and major events across digital, streaming, social, and broadcast platforms.
  • Host live streams, guiding viewers through developing stories in a clear, engaging, and informative manner.
  • Research, plan, and build editorial coverage, including booking guests, coordinating interviews, and preparing for upcoming news events.
  • Manage live video production elements including switching, graphics, and stream execution.
  • Monitor live feeds, wires, social media, and newsgathering tools to identify breaking news and emerging stories.
  • Execute and evolve the editorial plan, maintaining calendars and ensuring coverage is forward-looking and well-coordinated.
  • Collaborate with FOX O&O stations and internal/external partners to source live video, interviews, and content.
  • Pitch story ideas and contribute to editorial decision-making while upholding journalistic standards.
  • Monitor real-time analytics to inform coverage decisions and optimize content performance.
  • Support teammates across roles, including stepping in on-air or behind the scenes as needed.
  • Maintain strong relationships with key contacts and sources to support coverage.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Strong knowledge of current events and a deep understanding of how audiences consume news across digital platforms.
  • Proven ability to communicate clearly and confidently both on-air and behind the scenes in a fast-paced, unscripted breaking news environment.
  • Excellent editorial judgment, research skills, and attention to detail.
  • Experience with digital news production, live streaming workflows, and newsroom technologies (e.g., TriCaster or similar).
  • Strong organizational and planning skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and think several steps ahead.
  • Ability to thrive under pressure and pivot quickly as news develops.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.
  • Proficiency in newsgathering tools, social media, and digital analytics platforms.
  • On-camera hosting or reporting experience required.
  • Flexibility to work varied hours, weekends, and holidays as news demands.

Why Join LiveNOW from FOX?

At LiveNOW, you’ll be part of a team redefining how news is delivered in the digital era. We bring audiences live, unfiltered news and events from around the country in real time—no scripts, no anchors, just the story as it unfolds. With millions of viewers tuning in across multiple platforms, this is your chance to help shape the future of live digital journalism.

job.title: Manager Care Ops (LatAm)
job.description:
El puesto de Gerente, Operaciones de Atención al Cliente - LATAM es una posición de liderazgo clave en la intersección entre la ejecución en primera línea y las operaciones estratégicas. Este rol es responsable de habilitar un soporte al cliente escalable y de alta calidad en toda América Latina, brindando a los agentes la guía, las herramientas y los procesos que necesitan para ofrecer experiencias excepcionales a los clientes.

Serás el socio operativo principal para el equipo de atención al cliente de LATAM, trabajando de forma multifuncional con los equipos de Atención al Cliente, Marketing, Producto y Tecnología para operacionalizar iniciativas, evaluar impactos y mantener comunicaciones de primer nivel con los agentes. Se requiere dominio del español para asegurar una colaboración genuina con los equipos y stakeholders regionales.

Operaciones de Atención al Cliente y Habilitación de Agentes

  • Ser responsable de impulsar comunicaciones claras y consistentes hacia los agentes a través de múltiples productos e iniciativas, asegurando que los equipos de primera línea estén preparados, informados y capacitados para atender las consultas de los clientes.
  • Diseñar, mantener y gobernar el contenido de la intranet, los procedimientos operativos estándar y las herramientas de ventas/soporte que mejoren la preparación, el compromiso y el desempeño de los agentes.
  • Garantizar la calidad, precisión y consistencia de toda la documentación operativa y dirigida a los agentes.
  • Desarrollar y mantener un conocimiento profundo de las operaciones de Atención al Cliente, incluyendo sistemas, flujos de trabajo y particularidades regionales del mercado de LATAM.
  • Crear, actualizar y gestionar documentación operativa dentro de las plataformas de gestión del conocimiento aprobadas.

Liderazgo de Proyectos Operativos

  • Liderar iniciativas y flujos de trabajo operativos que impactan a Atención al Cliente, aplicando las mejores prácticas de gestión de proyectos, actuando como socio operativo integrado más que como una función formal de PMO.
  • Evaluar y comunicar con claridad el impacto operativo y en la experiencia del cliente de nuevas iniciativas, promociones, lanzamientos de herramientas o cambios en los sistemas.
  • Colaborar con equipos multifuncionales para definir requisitos, cronogramas, dependencias y factores de riesgo relacionados con las operaciones de Atención al Cliente.
  • Mantener a los stakeholders informados y alineados sobre el avance de los proyectos, especialmente aquellos que afectan a los agentes y clientes de LATAM.
  • Aplicar resolución de problemas estructurada y disciplina operativa para resolver desafíos de forma rápida y sostenible.

Datos, Insights y Reportes

  • Usar datos para identificar tendencias de desempeño, brechas y oportunidades en las operaciones de atención al cliente y la experiencia de los agentes.
  • Colaborar con los equipos de Analítica, Herramientas y Tecnología, y Marketing para desarrollar y mantener reportes sobre el desempeño de los agentes y los resultados de la experiencia del cliente.
  • Traducir los insights basados en datos en recomendaciones concretas que equilibren la defensa del cliente con las prioridades del negocio.

Colaboración y Liderazgo

  • Ser el socio principal de Operaciones de Atención al Cliente de LATAM, construyendo relaciones multifuncionales sólidas con stakeholders de toda la organización.
  • Defender la experiencia del agente en primera línea y del cliente, alineándose con las metas y prioridades más amplias de la organización.

job.title: Manager, Accounting & Financial Reporting
job.description:
The Manager, Accounting & Financial Reporting is an integral member of the Finance team supporting the Fox Digital & Technology organization. The Manager, Accounting & Financial Reporting is responsible for the financial integrity and operational oversight of the Digital & Technology P&L, managing monthly and quarterly close processes to ensure accurate, timely, and complete financial reporting. In addition, this role serves as a key business partner to operational stakeholders and external suppliers across all purchasing and invoicing activities. The Manager oversees the end-to-end Procure-to-Pay process, collaborating cross-functionally to drive financial discipline, process efficiency, and strong internal controls. This position plays a critical role in validating financial results, including reconciliation of the full Balance Sheet and P&L, investigating variances, and ensuring reported results align with business expectations.

The Manager exercises strong independent judgment in resolving issues, demonstrates ownership, and consistently delivers high-quality, timely results without the need for constant supervision. Additionally, this role collaborates with the FP&A team during budget and forecast cycles to support planning activities and ensure alignment between actual results and forward-looking projections. This position reports directly to the Sr. Manager, Accounting & Financial Reporting.
 

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

Month-End Close/General Accounting 

  • Manage monthly and quarterly close processes for the Operating Division, including oversight of third-party goods and services, proper expense codification, and accurate general ledger recording

  • Analyze actual spending results and review accrual journal entries to ensure completeness and accuracy of third-party costs across both the P&L and Balance Sheet

  • Serve as a subject-matter expert on monthly financial results, clearly articulating drivers of spend, key variances, and accounting treatments to finance and operational stakeholders

  • Partner with operational leaders and the FP&A team to investigate expense fluctuations, provide variance explanations, and support reporting deliverables

  • Perform and validate monthly reconciliation of key Balance Sheet accounts to ensure reported financial results are accurate, supported, and compliant with internal controls

job.title: Manager, Insights & Analytics - Subscription
job.description:
FOX News Media is looking for a Manager, Insights & Analytics to support our growing portfolio of subscription products, anchored today by FOX Nation.

This is a hands-on analytics role. You will work across the full subscription lifecycle — how subscribers are acquired and retained, and what they actually do once they subscribe. Engagement and content consumption, marketing and activation, user journeys, churn and cohort behavior all sit within your scope. The common thread is SQL: we are looking for someone who can get to any subscription dataset, understand what it does and does not say, and turn it into an answer a business partner can use.

Because the role is scoped broadly rather than by function, it can flex as the portfolio grows. You may work across products alongside a marketing-focused counterpart, or take end-to-end analytics ownership of a single business unit depending on where the business needs depth. You will work closely with key operational stakeholders to understand how to best interpret data shifts day to day and identify trends to inform the business.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITES:

Subscriber & Engagement Reporting

  • Build and own engagement reporting for subscription products — active days, session frequency, content starts and completion, title and category performance, and platform mix across web, mobile app, CTV, and third-party platforms
  • Analyze subscriber acquisition, retention, churn (voluntary and involuntary), cancellations, and plan mix and their impact on engagement
  • Connect engagement to retention, identifying the early-tenure behaviors that separate subscribers who stay from those who churn, and translating that into onboarding, content, and lifecycle recommendations
  • Build and maintain dashboards tracking key subscription and engagement metrics, in partnership with Data Engineering
  • Maintain and evolve recurring performance comparisons (month-over-month, cohort-over-cohort, pre- and post-launch), proactively flagging anomalies such as app issues, tracking gaps, and data quality problems before they distort reporting
  • Provide guidance to finance on cost as it relates to engagement of programming and inform future content strategies and acquisitions

Hands-On Data & Query Work

  • Write and maintain SQL (Snowflake or comparable) against subscription, billing, engagement, campaign, and behavioral data — joins, aggregations, CTEs, and window functions against large and imperfect sources
  • Conduct cohort analysis to identify trends by acquisition channel, offer, plan type, tenure, platform, and content affinity
  • Troubleshoot data discrepancies across platforms and internal tracking (naming mismatches, missing records, deduplication logic) and resolve them at the query level
  • Support the transition from manual, on-demand reporting to self-service dashboards in partnership with Data Engineering

Marketing, Lifecycle & Campaign Measurement

  • Analyze campaign performance across marketing and CRM channels — email, push, in-app, SMS, and paid media — and connect activity to downstream subscriber acquisition, engagement, and retention
  • Support attribution analysis (e.g., first-touch) to measure the impact of campaigns on subscription conversion and migration efforts
  • Conduct segmentation analysis to surface engagement trends, at-risk segments, and personalization opportunities
  • Support experimentation and test design, helping isolate confounding variables (for example content quality versus message format, or seasonality versus offer effect) so results are interpretable

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Translate analysis into clear, digestible summaries and recommendations for Programming, Marketing, CRM, Content, Product, and Finance stakeholders, tailoring the narrative to each audience
  • Respond to ad hoc requests from senior stakeholders with quick turnaround, clear caveats, and accurate data
  • Flag data quality issues and tracking gaps to Data Engineering and Analytics Engineering partners, and follow through to resolution

WHAT YOU WILL NEED:

  • Strong SQL skills required — able to independently write and troubleshoot queries involving joins, aggregations, CTEs, and window functions against large datasets. This is a must-have and the core of the role
  • Experience in subscription, growth, product, marketing, or media analytics, or a related quantitative and reporting role
  • Genuine curiosity about the whole subscriber picture — comfort moving between a churn cohort, a content engagement question, and a campaign performance read in the same week
  • Experience analyzing or reporting on subscription and lifecycle metrics (acquisition, churn, cancellations, retention, LTV)
  • Comfort working in a BI or visualization tool (Looker, Tableau, Power BI, Hex, or similar)
  • Strong Excel and Google Sheets skills for ad hoc analysis, including pivot tables
  • Good communication skills — able to explain data findings, and their limitations, clearly to non-technical stakeholders
  • Detail-oriented, with a track record of catching and resolving data quality issues before they reach leadership
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with recurring deadlines and frequent ad hoc requests
  • Experience with AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor
  • Familiarity with product analytics or engagement measurement tools (e.g., Adobe Analytics, Google Analytics 4, Amplitude) a plus
  • Familiarity with subscription billing platforms (e.g., Recurly, Zuora, Stripe Billing) a plus
  • Exposure to a CRM or lifecycle platform such as Braze a plus
  • Prior experience in media, streaming, publishing, or another content subscription business a plus
  • Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Math, Business Analytics) or equivalent practical experience

job.title: Manager, Technical Projects & Innovation
job.description:
FOX Sports Remote Engineering & Operations runs a standing portfolio of technical initiatives — private 5G at venues, in-helmet point-of-view cameras, camera tracking and augmented reality, connected-ball and player tracking, volumetric capture, and automated content moderation. Most of them are technically sound and short of hands. This role exists to move them.

This is a hands-on job. You will spend a real share of your week doing the work yourself — on-site testing, integration, writing specifications, chasing vendors to a decision. You will also be the person who makes sure the rest of it happens: that every project has a next milestone and a date, that equipment was specified early enough to actually be ordered, and that the people who needed to know were told before it affected them.

If you're looking for a role that sets technology strategy from a distance, this isn't it. If you want to ship things that end up on air across NFL, MLB, College Football, NASCAR, UFL, and International Soccer, it is.

Stated plainly so expectations are clear from the start: this role executes, recommends, and escalates. Cross-sport technical architecture and vendor strategy sit with our Director of Engineering; remote integration and the plant interface sit with our Remote Integration Engineering lead; capital authority sits with the SVP. You'll work as a peer to both — they set the technical direction, you carry it to completion. That division is deliberate, and it means you can be excellent at this job without having to be the deepest engineer in the department.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Drive our active technical initiatives to their next milestones — on-site tests and evaluations, vendor and partner coordination, and a live date on every card
  • Escalate the calls that need executive judgment quickly rather than letting a project sit while a decision waits
  • Produce specifications, equipment lists, and build calendars early enough that our integration and logistics function can procure and ship against real lead times rather than against deadlines
  • Support major capital projects from requirements through commissioning, in partnership with the teams that own integration and procurement
  • Apply and document the engineering standards our Director of Engineering sets, and hold new builds to them
  • When a property wants an exception, capture it, assess it, and raise it — rather than absorbing it quietly and letting the standard erode
  • Own the status reporting this function has been missing: where projects stand, what's at risk, what decisions are needed, and by when
  • Act as the Field Operations point of contact with our information security team, own the Field Operations security dashboard, and drive remediation items to closure under the security architecture our Director of Engineering owns
  • Give every initiative in the portfolio a next milestone and a date — and surface the stalled ones rather than letting them sit
  • Stand up status reporting that partners come to rely on
  • Get technical requirements to integration and logistics inside their lead times, every time.
  • Document the engineering standards as they exist today, with exceptions logged rather than absorbed.
  • Take the security dashboard fully in hand and bring remediation current
  • Take enough execution off our senior engineering staff that architecture and standards work can actually get done

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • 5+ years in broadcast or live production engineering, with at least one or two leading projects or people
  • track record of getting technical projects across the line — including the unglamorous parts: vendor follow-through, lead times, and closing items out — we have deep technical expertise in the group; what we need alongside it is someone who converts decisions into finished work on a date.
  • Hands-on capability across IP video infrastructure (ST 2110, JPEG XS), RF and wireless camera systems, transmission, and remote production workflows — enough to earn credibility and do the work, without needing to be the deepest technical voice in the room
  • Judgment to work as a peer to senior technical colleagues: taking architectural direction from them while holding them to dates, and escalating rather than absorbing when the two conflict
  • Comfort working in a union environment
  • Written communication strong enough that people actually read your status and act on it
  • Willingness to travel and work event schedules, including nights, weekends, and holidays — expect heavier load during football season and around major events.

HOW WE'LL MEASURE SUCCESS

  • Every initiative in the portfolio has an owner, a milestone, and a date — and nothing sits stalled without being surfaced.
  • Partners describe communication from this function as predictable
  • Technical requirements reach integration and logistics within lead times
  • Projects delivered on schedule, with exceptions to standard logged rather than absorbed
  • Security remediation is current rather than accumulating
  • Measurably less execution work sitting with the Director of Engineering at year-end than at the start

job.title: News Anchor
job.description:
FOX6 is reimagining local news, and we’re looking for a morning anchor who brings more than polished prompter skills. We’ve moved away from formulaic rundowns and traditional scripting in favor of authentic, unscripted, high-impact local journalism centered on live, breaking, and evolving stories. We need an active journalist and high-energy content creator.

We're also looking for a true newsroom leader - someone who demonstrates and inspires initiative, curiosity, empathy, and accountability.

This role requires a dedicated morning person comfortable with a 2:30 a.m. start time. You’ll kick off your shift steering fast-paced, streaming-first coverage. You'll spend the early morning news hours sourcing original stories and engaging in real-time reporting from the newsroom; you'll then co-anchor late-morning hours. This role isn't about showing up to present the content; it's about actively building it.

If you love becoming the subject matter expert for the stories you cover, thrive in fluid on-air conversation, and seek out real-time engagement with teammates and audiences across TV and streaming platforms, this is your opportunity to help shape the future of local news.

In return, FOX provides a stellar benefits package including 3 weeks’ vacation to start, amazing healthcare benefits, and a very generous 401(k) match.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Lead with courage, serving as a collaborative newsroom culture setter who fosters an environment of trust and open communication.
  • Drive fair, accurate, unscripted, and dynamic morning news coverage on-air and across digital and streaming platforms.
  • Pitch, research, and create original story content throughout the morning shift, seamlessly integrating your reporting into live coverage via newsroom hits and anchor-desk coverage.
  • Guide viewers through live, breaking news without relying on a teleprompter, acting as a well-informed authority on local, regional, and national stories.
  • Conduct meaningful, extended Q&As with field reporters and guests, asking insightful questions that add context to live stories.
  • Collaborate with producers, photojournalists, reporters, and digital team members to build a continuous stream of live and active morning content.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Minimum of five years of on-camera journalism experience; previous anchoring and/or streaming experience preferred.
  • Demonstrated track record of leading with curiosity and accountability, with the ability to offer and receive direct, constructive feedback.
  • Proven ability to anchor and ad-lib comfortably in an unscripted format.
  • Strong news judgement, sharp journalistic instincts, and a track record of enterprise story creation.
  • High comfort level with digital platforms, streaming tech, and social media for gathering news and engaging audiences.
  • Journalism degree or a closely related field preferred.
  • Must be a genuine early riser ready for a 2:30 a.m. call time.

job.title: Platform Ops & Delivery (Sr. SDET)
job.description:
La plataforma directa al consumidor (DTC) de FOX es una iniciativa nueva y visionaria dentro de Tubi Media Group que lleva el incomparable portafolio de contenido de FOX —noticias, deportes y entretenimiento— directamente a los consumidores a través de un innovador servicio de streaming por suscripción.

Impulsado por un equipo de liderazgo altamente experimentado, con trayectorias en la intersección de los medios, la tecnología, el streaming y el contenido, y respaldado plenamente por Fox Corporation, este proyecto combina energía emprendedora con un profundo conocimiento de la industria de los medios.

Nuestra visión es crear una experiencia de visualización unificada y moderna que ponga al consumidor en primer lugar, integrando de forma fluida el contenido en vivo y bajo demanda en todas las plataformas.

En la intersección entre la tecnología de vanguardia y la narrativa de confianza, esta es una oportunidad para dar forma al futuro del streaming en uno de los momentos más decisivos de la industria de los medios. Estamos formando un equipo de clase mundial para cumplir esa visión, y apenas estamos comenzando.

FOX ONE es la aplicación de streaming directa al consumidor de FOX Corporation, ya activa y en operación en Estados Unidos. FOX ONE se está expandiendo ahora a América Latina, y buscamos a un(a) Sr. Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) con base en la Ciudad de México para liderar la ingeniería de calidad de esa expansión. Este es un rol de ingeniería altamente técnico y práctico, para alguien que ve la calidad como una disciplina central de la ingeniería y que pueda definir cómo se construye, prueba, lanza y monitorea la versión de FOX ONE para LATAM.

Como Sr. SDET, colaborarás estrechamente con los equipos de Producto, Ingeniería, Operaciones y Delivery desde las primeras etapas de planeación hasta producción. Te asegurarás de que la calidad se diseñe dentro del trabajo de expansión a LATAM, en lugar de validarse al final. Al comprender el producto actual de FOX ONE, los requisitos del mercado de LATAM y la arquitectura de la plataforma, identificarás riesgos de forma proactiva, definirás estrategias de pruebas y construirás capacidades de automatización en paralelo con el desarrollo de funcionalidades para la región.

Extenderás la plataforma de ingeniería de calidad ya existente de FOX ONE para dar soporte a la expansión en LATAM, adaptando los frameworks y las herramientas construidas para el producto de EE. UU. de modo que funcionen de forma confiable en los distintos idiomas, monedas, dispositivos y entornos regulatorios de México. Este rol requiere un fuerte criterio técnico e implementación práctica, junto con una colaboración cercana con el equipo de plataforma de EE. UU. para decidir qué se debe reutilizar y qué se debe reconstruir para la región.

El candidato o candidata ideal combina sólidas habilidades de ingeniería de software, experiencia consolidada en automatización de pruebas, una mentalidad orientada al producto y un enfoque “AI-first” hacia las pruebas y la ingeniería. Te sientes cómodo(a) cuestionando supuestos, contribuyendo a la dirección técnica y generando resultados de calidad dentro de tu equipo y de los equipos con los que colaboras de cerca, a medida que FOX ONE se expande a un nuevo mercado. Y lo más importante: entiendes que la calidad va más allá de las pruebas previas al lanzamiento y requiere una validación continua de la experiencia del cliente a lo largo de todo el ciclo de vida del producto.

  • Colaborar con los Product Managers y los equipos de Ingeniería, Operaciones y Delivery durante las fases de descubrimiento, planeación y diseño, para identificar desde el inicio los requisitos de calidad y los riesgos.
  • Traducir los requisitos de producto, los objetivos de negocio y los recorridos del cliente en estrategias de pruebas escalables y frameworks de validación automatizada.
  • Construir frameworks de pruebas, herramientas y capacidades de automatización en paralelo con el desarrollo de funcionalidades, para garantizar la preparación para el lanzamiento.
  • Definir quality gates, criterios de lanzamiento y estándares de preparación para el lanzamiento de tu(s) área(s) de producto dentro de FOX ONE.
  • Diseñar e implementar arquitecturas de pruebas end-to-end que validen la experiencia del cliente en web, móvil, TV conectada, servicios backend, APIs e integraciones de plataforma.
  • Contribuir a la estrategia de pruebas de las capacidades de plataforma usadas por tu equipo y por los equipos con los que colaboras de cerca.
  • Desarrollar capacidades automatizadas de generación de datos de prueba, configuración de entornos y orquestación que den soporte a pruebas continuas a gran escala.
  • Crear suites de regresión automatizadas que validen de forma continua los recorridos críticos del usuario en todos los clientes y plataformas soportados.
  • Construir validación automatizada para experiencias complejas como Multiview, autenticación, derechos de acceso (entitlement), suscripción, comercio, descubrimiento de contenido, reproducción y flujos de transmisión en vivo.
  • Asegurar que Multiview y otras capacidades de la plataforma se prueben automáticamente en todos los dispositivos, configuraciones, tipos de contenido y escenarios de reproducción soportados.
  • Validar de forma continua los recorridos del cliente antes y después de cada lanzamiento, para asegurar que la experiencia en producción se mantenga estable, confiable y con buen desempeño.
  • Extender la plataforma de ingeniería de calidad, los frameworks de pruebas y las capacidades de automatización ya existentes de FOX ONE, para dar soporte a la expansión en LATAM.
  • Ayudar a establecer prácticas de ingeniería de calidad dentro del equipo que puedan compartirse con equipos de producto e ingeniería afines.
  • Aprovechar herramientas y flujos de trabajo impulsados por IA para mejorar la generación de pruebas, la cobertura de automatización, el análisis de defectos, el mantenimiento y la productividad de ingeniería.
  • Influir en las decisiones de ingeniería, el enfoque de pruebas y las prácticas de calidad dentro de tu equipo y de los equipos con los que colaboras de cerca.
  • Mentorear a ingenieros junior y de nivel medio, y promover las mejores prácticas de ingeniería de calidad dentro del equipo.
  • Validar la localización e internacionalización del contenido en español mexicano, incluyendo interfaz traducida, subtítulos/doblaje, formatos de fecha/moneda/números, y problemas de expansión o truncamiento de texto.

job.description:
FoxNXT is FOX Entertainment’s next-generation technology studio, built to expand what our creative teams can achieve and put more of every production dollar on screen. Our work spans four pillars: R&D, Production, Talent, and Education.

We turn emerging technology into practical tools and workflows across scripted, unscripted, animation, and marketing. We test in real productions, learn what works, and make those lessons useful across the business. We also develop talent and help our creative and production teams build the skills to use these tools confidently.

Our approach starts with people and craft. We work with creative partners to solve real production problems, protect creative intent, and use AI responsibly, with respect for rights, the creative community, and the resources production consumes.

The Project Manager turns priorities into coordinated action. You will manage intake, establish clear plans and ownership, track delivery, and make sure the right decisions happen at the right time. Working across creative, production, technical, and business teams, you will keep an accurate picture of what is moving, what is blocked, and what needs attention.

We are looking for someone who is organized, curious, direct, and comfortable working through ambiguity. You ask good questions, follow through, and raise problems early with a recommendation. You know when to resolve an issue yourself and when to bring others in. You build enough structure to help talented people do their best work as the business grows.

Regular, on-site attendance at the workplace for a minimum of four (4) days per week is an essential function of the position. The selected candidate must be able to reliably meet this requirement.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

job.title: Senior Engineer, Commerce
job.description:
Fox Tech desarrolla los productos digitales detrás de las marcas de deportes y entretenimiento de FOX. Nuestras aplicaciones funcionan en web, móvil y dispositivos de sala de estar, y millones de personas las usan, generalmente todas al mismo tiempo cuando comienza un partido. Esos picos de tráfico determinan cómo construimos todo.

Estamos contratando ingenieros para construir la próxima generación de nuestros productos de streaming.

Te unirás al equipo de Comercio, que es responsable de los sistemas que manejan el dinero: pagos, impuestos, facturación y suscripciones en todos nuestros productos directos al consumidor. Un error aquí cuesta dólares reales, y un checkout lento cuesta un suscriptor, por lo que el estándar de corrección y disponibilidad es más alto que en casi cualquier otra parte de la infraestructura.

La mayor parte del trabajo ocurre detrás de la interfaz de checkout: autorización y captura de pagos; reembolsos, disputas y reconciliación; el ciclo de vida de las suscripciones, incluyendo renovaciones, upgrades, downgrades, cancelaciones y todos los estados intermedios; idempotencia y procesamiento de webhooks contra APIs de proveedores que reintentan, llegan fuera de orden y a veces “mienten”; cálculo de impuestos a través de proveedores externos; y el alcance de PCI DSS, manteniendo los datos sensibles de los clientes donde deben estar.

Trabajarás con stakeholders de distintas áreas de negocio de FOX, que no todas venden de la misma forma ni al mismo público. Parte del trabajo consiste en construir capacidades de comercio que puedan reutilizarse entre ellas sin homogeneizar la experiencia de cada una.

El ecosistema de desarrollo ha cambiado drásticamente en los últimos dos años, y nosotros hemos cambiado con él. Nuestros ingenieros usan agentes de código y herramientas de IA generativa como parte de su flujo de trabajo normal, no como un experimento ocasional. Esperamos que llegues con fluidez real: que sepas en qué casos estas herramientas son confiables y en cuáles no lo son, y que ya tengas tus propios hábitos para revisar, probar y proteger lo que producen.

Las herramientas en sí seguirán cambiando. Lo que funcionaba hace seis meses ya está desactualizado, y lo que estandaricemos este trimestre probablemente no será lo que usemos el próximo año. Buscamos ingenieros que vean esto como algo normal y que estén dispuestos a seguir replanteando su propio flujo de trabajo.

Para ser claros sobre el estándar: las herramientas de IA elevan lo que esperamos de ti, no lo reducen. Tú eres responsable del código, de las decisiones de diseño y del comportamiento en producción, sin importar quién (o qué) escribió el primer borrador.

  • Liderar la dirección técnica de las principales capacidades de comercio, desde el diseño hasta la operación en producción.
  • Liderar discusiones de arquitectura y tomar las decisiones de compromiso entre confiabilidad, costo, seguridad y velocidad de entrega.
  • Escribir código de alta calidad con cobertura de pruebas significativa y automatización.
  • Asumir la responsabilidad de producción: respuesta a incidentes, análisis de causa raíz y el trabajo de seguimiento que evita que el mismo incidente vuelva a ocurrir.
  • Mentorear a otros ingenieros y elevar el estándar de ingeniería del equipo.
  • Evaluar tecnologías emergentes de pagos y comercio, y argumentar a favor de cambios que mejoren de forma medible la conversión, la confiabilidad o el costo operativo.
  • Comercio se mantiene estable durante los grandes eventos en vivo, cuando el tráfico llega todo de una vez.
  • Los cambios de pagos y suscripciones se lanzan de forma segura, y puedes señalar la métrica que se movió.
  • Otras áreas de negocio de FOX pueden construir sobre tu trabajo sin heredar el flujo de checkout de otro equipo.
  • Licenciatura en Ciencias de la Computación, o experiencia equivalente.
  • 5+ años de experiencia en ingeniería de software, con enfoque en APIs escalables y seguras, y sistemas basados en eventos.
  • Sólido dominio de Go. Nuestros servicios de comercio están escritos casi en su totalidad en Go, y necesitamos que empieces a escribir código de producción en este lenguaje desde el inicio.
  • Experiencia demostrable usando herramientas de IA generativa en desarrollo de software profesional. Puedes explicar dónde mejoraron tu flujo de trabajo, dónde introdujeron riesgos, y cómo revisas, pruebas y proteges el código asistido por IA.
  • Experiencia en el dominio de comercio. Has trabajado con Stripe, Adyen, Braintree o similares, y entiendes cómo se conectan las piezas entre sí.
  • Bases sólidas de ciencias de la computación e instintos fuertes de resolución de problemas.
  • Experiencia con decisiones de diseño y arquitectura de software a gran escala.
  • Sólida experiencia con SQL y NoSQL, idealmente DynamoDB y Redis.
  • Experiencia profesional con AWS u otro proveedor de nube.
  • Experiencia práctica con contenedores y Kubernetes.
  • Nuestros sistemas dan soporte a eventos en vivo y nuestro equipo está distribuido globalmente, por lo que el puesto implica algo de trabajo fuera del horario habitual: llamadas programadas entre regiones, además de respuesta a incidentes durante eventos importantes.
  • Aplicaciones de streaming, especialmente aquellas que manejan eventos en vivo a gran escala.
  • Comercio electrónico, particularmente tráfico de alta disponibilidad en eventos como Black Friday.
  • Gestión del ciclo de vida de suscripciones: renovaciones, upgrades, downgrades y cancelaciones.
  • Idempotencia, procesamiento de webhooks, reintentos y consistencia eventual.
  • Comercio integrado directamente en una experiencia de streaming de video. Si has explorado esto, nos gustaría saberlo.

Size isn’t our measure; we prioritize impact, meticulously planning events that resonate deeply with audiences and amplify reach beyond limits. Fueled by a relentless pursuit of excellence and unwavering audience-centricity, we cultivate a culture of fearless collaboration that transcends teams and industries. Our diverse team, architects of audacity, builds bridges, fosters innovation, and unlocks unprecedented synergy. We are an internal brand engagement and experience agency providing strategy, creative solutions, and measurable deliverables in events, activations, design, and technology to all divisions of FOX Corporation, including FOX Entertainment, FOX Sports, TUBI, Ad Sales, FOX News, Distribution, and FOX Corporate.

We are seeking a dependable Senior Manager, Event & Experiential with a high degree of ethical compass, who thrives on high energy, moves fast, thinks big, and LOVES ENTERTAINMENT! This individual will demonstrate strong ownership of projects, bringing original thinking, sharp execution, and creative strategy to deliver elevated, meaningful engagements that build and maintain trust with fans, stakeholders, and internal teams. This role requires anticipating stakeholder needs, providing creative solutions, and expertly leading and inspiring teams to create events and activations, sometimes with minimal oversight, ensuring stakeholder goals are brought to life.

job.title: Senior Manager, Growth & Partnerships Analytics
job.description:
The FOX direct-to-consumer (DTC) platform is a new, forward-looking initiative within Tubi Media Group that brings FOX's unparalleled content portfolio including news, sports, and entertainment directly to consumers through an innovative subscription streaming service.

Led by a highly experienced team with deep backgrounds across media, technology, streaming, and content, and fully supported by Fox Corporation, this venture blends entrepreneurial spirit with strong media expertise.

Our vision is to create a unified, modern viewing experience that prioritizes the consumer and integrates live and on-demand content across multiple platforms.

This is a rare opportunity to help shape the future of streaming during a transformative time in media. We are building a world-class team to bring that vision to life, and we're just getting started.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As the Senior Manager, Growth & Partnerships Analytics, you will lead performance analysis and executive-ready insights that explain what's driving subscription growth, channel performance, and promotional effectiveness, providing dedicated analytical support and strategic thinking for Growth & Partnerships, without duplicating FP&A's forecasting or deal-modeling work.

Embedded within FOX One's centralized analytics organization, this role serves as the critical thought partner to Strategy and Business Development leadership.

The ideal candidate combines analytical rigor with strong commercial acumen and executive storytelling to influence high-impact strategic decisions.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Lead deep-dive analyses across direct subscription, distribution, and channel performance to identify what's driving growth, retention, and profitability.
  • Serve as the dedicated analytics and strategy partner to Growth & Partnerships, providing the analytical horsepower that function needs to move initiatives forward.
  • Design and analyze controlled experiments (A/B testing) to assess pricing, promotional, and offer effectiveness.
  • Translate performance and consumption trends into a clear point of view for Strategy and Business Development decision-making.
  • Partner with FP&A to ensure strategic decisions are grounded in accurate performance data — feeding their forecasting rather than duplicating it.
  • Leverage large-scale datasets using SQL and BI tools to uncover performance drivers and statistical relationships.
  • Deliver executive-ready insights for monthly and ad hoc leadership reviews.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED:

  • BA in Business, Finance, Economics, Analytics, Statistics, or related field.
  • Typically, 8+ years in analytics, strategy, or business intelligence within subscription, media, technology, or digital platforms.
  • Strong track record turning performance data into clear insights and recommendations for non-technical senior stakeholders.
  • Experience supporting Growth Analytics and Partnerships functions within a subscription or media business — collaborating on shared metrics without owning deal modeling.
  • Experience delivering executive-level presentations and translating complex analytics into clear business recommendations.
  • Demonstrated cross-functional collaboration across product, marketing, finance, operations, and partnerships.
  • Comfortable operating as an individual contributor, embedded closely with Growth & Partnerships stakeholders rather than managing a dedicated team.
  • Regular, on-site attendance at the workplace a minimum of 3 days per week is an essential function of the position. Selected candidate must be able to reliably meet this requirement.

NICE TO HAVE, BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Statistics, Data Science, Economics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field.
  • Advanced SQL proficiency with demonstrated ability to extract, manipulate, and analyze large datasets.
  • Strong experience in Tableau or Power BI, including executive dashboard development.
  • Experience analyzing partnership economics, revenue share structures, promotional ROI, and channel profitability.
  • Experience performing opportunity sizing and market modeling to support new revenue streams and distribution expansion.

job.title: Senior Operations Manager
job.description:
Fox is seeking a highly technical Senior Operations Manager to lead the evolution of customer billing, subscription, and payment experiences across FOX ONE’s digital ecosystem. This role sits at the intersection of CRM Marketing, subscription lifecycle management, payments, and customer communications—requiring both strong product ownership and a deep technical foundation.

The ideal candidate brings hands-on engineering experience and a strong understanding of modern payment architectures, APIs, and distributed system integrations. You will partner closely with engineering, data, legal, and marketing teams to design and optimize secure, scalable payment, subscription, and transactional communication solutions that support acquisition, retention, and monetization across web, mobile, and connected TV platforms.

Our ecosystem includes PCI-compliant payment processing integrated with CRM platforms, subscription management systems, and communication tools, supporting recurring billing, promotions, and compliant customer messaging across multiple regions.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own and prioritize the product backlog for subscription billing, payment processing, and CRM-driven monetization and communication initiatives 
  • Translate marketing, legal, and business requirements into detailed technical user stories, acceptance criteria, and system-level specifications 
  • Collaborate with engineering on architecture, API design, and technical trade-offs across payment, CRM, and messaging systems 
  • Lead Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog grooming, and roadmap execution 
  • Drive integrations with payment gateways, subscription platforms, transactional email providers, fraud tools, and third-party marketing technologies 
  • Design and optimize end-to-end subscription and billing communication flows, including signup confirmations, receipts, renewals, payment failures, retries, refunds, and cancellations 
  • Ensure all payment and customer communication workflows meet PCI-DSS, CAN-SPAM, CASL (as applicable), and state-level regulatory requirements (e.g., California Auto-Renewal Law, CCPA/CPRA)

  • Monitor and improve key KPIs across payments and communications (conversion, deliverability, open rates, authorization rates, churn, retries, and chargebacks) 
  • Identify and mitigate technical and compliance risks early, proactively driving resolution 
  • Support product launches, experimentation (A/B testing), and continuous optimization of the subscriber lifecycle and communication strategy 
  • Own processor and partner integrations, improving delivery efficiency through better sequencing, parallelization, and reduced rework 

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Typically, 8+ years of experience as an Operations Manager, Technical Product Owner, Product Manager, or similar role in a digital or subscription-based business 
  • 3–5+ years of hands-on software engineering experience (backend or full-stack preferred) 
  • 3+ years of experience working with payment gateways, subscription billing platforms, and/or transactional messaging systems
  • Subscription lifecycle management (trial, conversion, renewal, churn, win-back) 
  • Payment processing flows (authorization, capture, settlement, retries, refunds)
  • Transactional email systems (e.g., SendGrid, Amazon SES, Braze) and event-driven communication architectures 
  • RESTful APIs, event-driven systems, and microservices architecture 
  • Tokenization, encryption, and secure data handling 
  • PCI-DSS compliance and card-not-present transactions 
  • BI Monitoring detection tools and risk mitigation management
  • Familiarity with CAN-SPAM, CASL, and email compliance best practices 
  • Working knowledge of state-level regulations impacting subscriptions and communications (e.g., California Auto-Renewal Law, CCPA/CPRA, and similar consumer protection laws) 
  • Understanding of consent, opt-in/opt-out, and disclosure requirements across payment and communication touchpoints 
  • Regular, on-site attendance at the workplace a minimum of 3 days per week is an essential function of the position. Selected candidate must be able to reliably meet this requirement.

NICE TO HAVE, BUT NOT A DEAL BREAKER

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field 
  • Streaming, media, or direct-to-consumer (DTC) subscription platforms 
  • CRM and marketing automation platforms (e.g., Salesforce, Braze, Adobe)

job.title: Senior Staff Orchestration Engineer
job.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

FOX is seeking a Senior Staff Orchestration Engineer to serve as a senior individual contributor driving the architecture and delivery of advanced enterprise orchestration and AI-first technical solutions. This role sits at the intersection of software engineering, artificial intelligence, enterprise architecture, and business operations, solving complex, cross-functional problems by building the intelligent orchestration layer that connects systems, data, AI capabilities, and people across FOX.

As a Senior Staff Orchestration Engineer, you will operate beyond individual workflow implementation to define technical direction, establish architectural patterns, and solve some of the organization’s most ambiguous and technically challenging automation problems. You will design solutions that combine enterprise APIs, event-driven architectures, orchestration platforms, custom software, and emerging AI capabilities—including large language models and agentic workflows—to fundamentally rethink how work gets done.

You will act as a hands-on technical leader and forward-deployed engineer, working directly with business and technology leaders to understand complex operational challenges, rapidly prototype solutions, and translate successful concepts into secure, resilient, reusable enterprise capabilities. You will influence engineering practices and architecture across teams while remaining deeply involved in design, coding, integration, and delivery.

Your work will help evolve FOX from manual and ticket-driven processes toward an AI-first, automation-first operating model in which intelligent systems can coordinate work across applications, automate complex decisions and actions, and enable employees to accomplish more through self-service experiences.

This is a high-impact individual contributor role for an engineer who thrives on ambiguity, moves fluidly between architecture and implementation, and can turn emerging technologies into practical enterprise solutions with measurable business impact.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Architect and deliver sophisticated, end-to-end orchestration solutions spanning enterprise applications, APIs, data, events, automation platforms, and AI services
  • Define the technical architecture and engineering patterns for enterprise orchestration, establishing reusable approaches that enable solutions to scale beyond individual workflows or business units
  • Design and build AI-first workflows and agentic solutions that combine large language models, enterprise data, APIs, tools, and deterministic business logic to automate complex knowledge and operational work
  • Evaluate where AI, traditional software engineering, workflow orchestration, RPA, or a combination of approaches provides the most effective solution to a business problem
  • Serve as a hands-on, forward-deployed technical leader, partnering directly with stakeholders to decompose ambiguous business challenges and rapidly design, prototype, and productionize solutions
  • Build robust integrations across collaboration, HR, finance, procurement, project management, content, data, and other enterprise platforms using APIs, webhooks, events, and custom services
  • Develop custom services, integration components, and orchestration logic using technologies such as Python, JavaScript, or Node.js when platform capabilities alone are insufficient
  • Design AI solutions with appropriate grounding, tool use, context management, evaluation, observability, and human-in-the-loop controls for enterprise environments
  • Transform manual, ticket-driven, and multi-system processes into intelligent, event-driven and self-service experiences that materially reduce cycle time and operational friction
  • Establish technical standards for orchestration architecture, integration design, reliability, observability, testing, versioning, deployment, and lifecycle management
  • Design reusable frameworks, connectors, abstractions, templates, and reference architectures that accelerate automation and AI solution development across FOX
  • Identify architectural bottlenecks and systemic opportunities where shared orchestration capabilities can eliminate duplicated engineering effort across teams
  • Rapidly prototype emerging AI and automation technologies, determine their enterprise applicability, and translate promising concepts into production-grade solutions
  • Partner with security, privacy, enterprise architecture, infrastructure, and application teams to ensure solutions meet FOX requirements for security, governance, resilience, and scalability
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to engineers and power users, raising engineering quality and enabling teams to build safely on shared orchestration capabilities
  • Influence technology strategy and architectural decisions across organizational boundaries through technical expertise, prototypes, reference implementations, and demonstrated business outcomes

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Typically, 8+ years experience designing and delivering complex enterprise software, integration, automation, or orchestration solutions at scale
  • Demonstrated ability to operate as a senior technical individual contributor, owning architecture and technical direction for complex initiatives spanning multiple systems, teams, and business domains
  • Deep expertise in API-driven system integration, including REST APIs, webhooks, event-driven patterns, authentication and authorization, JSON payloads, error handling, resiliency, and distributed system considerations
  • Strong software engineering skills in Python, TypeScript, Node.js, or comparable technologies, with the ability to move comfortably between architectural design and hands-on implementation
  • Experience architecting solutions using workflow orchestration, integration, automation, or low-code/no-code platforms while understanding when custom engineering is required
  • Hands-on experience applying AI technologies to real-world technical or business problems, including integrating large language models or AI services into applications and workflows
  • Strong understanding of modern AI application patterns such as retrieval and grounding, tool/API invocation, structured outputs, workflow-based agents, evaluation, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop design
  • Experience designing production systems with appropriate security, observability, reliability, testing, versioning, deployment, and operational controls
  • Ability to decompose highly ambiguous, cross-functional business problems into clear technical architectures and pragmatic implementation strategies
  • Demonstrated success rapidly prototyping complex solutions and evolving them into maintainable, scalable production capabilities
  • Strong architectural judgment and the ability to make thoughtful tradeoffs across speed, complexity, extensibility, reliability, security, and business value
  • Experience influencing engineering practices and technical decisions across teams without relying on direct reporting authority
  • Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to engineers, architects, business stakeholders, and senior leaders
  • Strong systems thinking and a track record of identifying reusable platform capabilities rather than solving each automation problem independently
  • A builder mindset with curiosity about emerging technologies and the judgment to distinguish meaningful enterprise capabilities from technology trends
  • Regular, on-site attendance at the workplace a minimum of 3 days per week is an essential function of the position. Selected candidate must be able to reliably meet this requirement.

NICE TO HAVE, BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER

  • Experience designing or deploying agentic AI systems that coordinate models, tools, APIs, enterprise data, and human approvals
  • Experience with enterprise AI platforms, LLM APIs, retrieval-augmented generation, vector search, model evaluation, or AI observability technologies
  • Experience establishing enterprise automation, AI, or orchestration architecture standards and governance frameworks
  • Familiarity with major enterprise systems across HR, finance, procurement, collaboration, identity, IT service management, or project management
  • Experience with event-driven architectures, message queues, serverless computing, cloud-native services, or integration-platform architecture
  • Familiarity with RPA and browser-based automation for systems where APIs are unavailable or insufficient
  • Experience building internal developer platforms, reusable integration frameworks, or shared automation capabilities used by multiple engineering teams
  • Experience enabling technical and non-technical power users while establishing appropriate platform guardrails and governance
  • Background in enterprise transformation, process modernization, or large-scale operational automation

job.title: Senior Union Payroll Associate
job.description:
The Senior Union Payroll Associate performs a variety of functions necessary for the accurate and timely processing of multi-state, multi-company, weekly and bi-weekly payrolls for union and non-union freelance employees. The Senior Union Payroll Associate coordinates, validates, and implements work procedures that require comprehensive operational knowledge of union collective bargaining agreements and federal and state regulations related to wage garnishment, taxation and wage‐hour law.


While there are no direct people responsibilities, the Senior Union Payroll Associate will coordinate independently with other associates, leaders, and teams outside of Payroll Shared Services to accomplish tasks, meet deadlines, champion process improvement initiatives, and enhance the employee experience.


A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Perform all duties necessary to ensure timely and accurate processing of multi-state, multi-company weekly and bi-weekly payrolls for union and non-union freelance employees in accordance with collective bargaining agreements and other contracts and in compliance with applicable FOX policies and federal, state, and local regulations
  • Process on demand payments, retroactive payments, one-time payments, tax adjustments, stop payments, void checks, direct deposit reversals, and overpayment collections in accordance with FOX policies, collective bargaining agreements, and in compliance with federal, state, and local regulations
  • Interpret and set up withholding orders for levies, garnishments, child support, and other involuntary wage assignment orders in the payroll system within the regulated period
  • Understand union pay and paid time off rules and the timekeeping system and address employee questions as needed
  • Provide testing support during the implementation of the new timekeeping system and assist with team training
  • Perform detailed pre-payroll processing audits of earnings, deductions, benefits, garnishments, and tax setups to prevent pay-impacting errors when payroll is processed
  • Audit and reconcile union-related inputs, including union dues, initiation fees, and retirement contributions, to ensure accuracy and strict adherence to collective bargaining agreements
  • Understand proper taxation of all employee payments, including employer paid union benefits, and address employee questions as needed
  • Review, test, and update Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) regularly to ensure operational accuracy, compliance, and continuous process efficiency
  • Provide subject matter expertise on union timekeeping rules and processes, to include paid time off plans. This requires the ability to interpret rules outlined in collective bargaining agreements (CBAs) and other union related documents
  • Assist employees and management with questions, concerns, or requests regarding union payroll. This includes properly applying technical knowledge and skills, communicating, and listening effectively
  • Serve as a go-to expert for union payroll questions, managing the timely resolution of customer issues, including handling customer escalations, performing and documenting Root Cause Analysis, and implementing remedial procedures to close gaps identified
  • Ensure compliance with all company policies, internal controls, and SOX controls

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • 4+ years hands-on union payroll processing experience, preferably with IBEW, IATSE, AFTRA, and/or NABET collective bargaining agreements
  • Experience with interpreting and setting up withholding orders for levies, garnishments, child support, and other involuntary wage assignment orders
  • Experience and knowledge of automated time and attendance systems
  • Experience with initiating and leading standardization and process improvement initiatives
  • Strong working knowledge of FLSA, federal, state, and local wage and hour and tax regulations. 
  • Ability to interpret collective bargaining agreements for pay and paid time off rules.
  • Strong interpersonal skills – you are approachable, responsive, and team focused
  • Intermediate Excel using VLOOKUP and pivots.
  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written
  • Excellent judgment, analytical and problem-solving skills
  • High degree of professionalism and solid ability in delivering high quality customer service and establishing/maintaining effective and collaborative working relationships

NICE TO HAVE BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER

  • Fundamental Payroll Certification (FPC) or Certified Payroll Professional (CPP) designation
  • Experience with Workday Payroll

FOX is proud to support a culture of creativity, entrepreneurial spirit and community that attracts the industry’s brightest talent. The FOX Internship Program offers an exciting opportunity for you to gain practical experience while interning for one of the biggest sports, media, and entertainment companies in the world. You will have the opportunity to participate in real-world projects, which provides valuable work experience and leadership skills.

Our Technical Operations team offers an unique experience for our interns. Working with the Technical Operations team will expose you to our Control Room/Studio Operations, as well as Transmission, Lighting and Editing.

You will be exposed to our prompter systems and software. Our interns will gain exposure to facets of studio operations including teleprompter, studio setup, and other studio positions.

Please note this internship is offered on-site in New York.

ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS:

  • Must be actively enrolled in an accredited college or university and pursuing an undergraduate or graduate degree during the length of the program
  • Current class standing of sophomore, (second-year college student) or above
  • Strong academic record
  • Committed and available to work for the entire length of the program
  • Access to own housing and transportation to/from the assigned internship site

STUDENTS SELECTED TO MOVE FORWARD IN THE INTERVIEW PROCESS:

  • Must demonstrate knowledge of current events and/or business news

TO APPLY:

  • Submit a 1-page resume (PDF preferred)
  • Submit a cover letter (PDF Preferred)
  • Explain why your background and experience make you a good fit for our program
  • Share your top areas of interest

STUDENTS ACCEPTED INTO THE SPRING 2027 PROGRAM:

Are required to provide a copy of an unofficial transcript or letter from the adviser/registrar showing proof of enrollment

AREAS OF PLACEMENT:

You will be considered for an internship based on the content of your cover letter, as well as your prior experience and interests, as determined during the recruitment process. You may be placed on FOX News Channel or FOX Business Network with the Technical Operations team.

SPRING 2027 SCHEDULE:

General Application Deadline: Sunday, November 22, 2026

Program Timeline: Monday, February 8, 2027 - Friday, April 16, 2027

Scheduled Weekly Hours: 16 - 24 hours per week 

NOTE: Schedules vary based on department needs and your availability. We do our best to work around your class schedule.

STANDING OUT AS A TOP CANDIDATE:

Successful students have:

  • Knowledge of current FOX programming and talent
  • The ability to maintain a professional demeanor when interfacing with talent and executives
  • The ability to work in a fast paced and deadline driven environment
  • The ability to work well on teams and collaborative efforts
  • Knowledge of the company and news/media industry
  • Strong written & verbal communication skills
  • Strong understanding of current events on a national scale
  • Knowledge of software systems and programs relevant to your desired area of placement. For example: Adobe Premiere, Adobe Audition, iNews, Avid, FinalCut Pro, Dalet
  • A self-starter attitude and pro-active nature
  • Strong attention to detail

PROGRAM FEATURES:
FOX Master Classes: A variety of presentations, panels, discussions, and trainings geared toward advancing your knowledge of our company, industry, and software systems
Professional Development Series: A variety of activities geared toward enhancing your professional development
Networking Opportunities: Numerous opportunities to connect with fellow interns and other professionals within the company

 
#EntryLevel #EarlyCareer

We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable law.
