job.title: Coordinator, Distributed Partnerships
job.description:
Coordinator, Distributed Partnerships

This role is remote and can be based anywhere in the US, except for Alaska, Hawaii and Wyoming. Preferable locations would be NYC or Washington D.C.

USA TODAY CO. is seeking a Coordinator, Distributed Partnerships, to report to the Senior Director, Business Development and Distributed Partnerships. This role will support the day-to-day execution and growth of our Distributed Partnerships business, including data management, business tracking, operational support, and cross-functional coordination across News Aggregator, Social Media, Content Licensing, AI Licensing, Philanthropy, and Film Production partnerships.

USA TODAY Co. has built an established and industry-leading content licensing and distribution business, managing strategic partnerships with some of the world’s largest platforms and technology companies, including Meta, YouTube, TikTok, Apple News, Yahoo, Google, and Samsung. As one of the largest media companies in the U.S., we leverage the scale of our flagship USA TODAY brand, our sports enthusiast brands, and 200+ local publications to extend the reach and value of our content well beyond our owned and operated platforms.

We are looking for a driven and ambitious coordinator with a strong administrative foundation who is eager to grow their career within a fast-paced, high-growth content distribution and partnerships business.

Responsibilities:

Organize partner contracts and maintain detailed knowledge of basic deal terms, expirations and renewal timelines.

Create new workflows, improve existing business operations, and assist in the execution of new initiatives.

Own data tracking and analysis of revenue and performance metrics for the Distributed Partnerships team.

Navigate multiple dashboards and track incoming partner reports to maintain robust monthly and quarterly performance Excel sheets.

Proactively identify trends and anomalies in partner data sets to the Distributed Partnerships leaders.

Design, produce and present data reports, PowerPoint presentations, and visualizations to senior team leaders to demonstrate business initiatives and performance.

Work closely with cross-functional teams such as Editorial, Sales, Marketing, Product, and Audience to support data-driven initiatives.

Assist the Distributed Partnerships team with initiatives and tasks to strengthen and support key partnerships.

Ideate and identify new business and partnership opportunities based on a strong understanding of USA TODAY Co.’s content portfolio and the evolving media landscape.

Curate and distribute a weekly internal Content Monetization newsletter, highlighting industry specific insights, news, and updates.

Provide administrative support across the team, including coordinating travel, scheduling and organizing meetings, booking reservations, processing expenses, preparing meeting materials, and maintaining team documentation.

Maintain knowledge and awareness of competitive marketplace and provide team with regular briefings on the media industry.

Requirements:

Bachelor's or master's degree in communications, journalism, marketing or related field or equivalent combination of education and experience.

2+ years' experience in a business, analytics or administrative role.

Experience using Salesforce for contract management.

Superior Excel and PowerPoint skills – experience developing graphs, creating pivot tables, utilizing basic formulas and macros is required.

Ability to read and understand contracts to ensure deal compliance.

Experience managing file sharing systems (Sharepoint, WeTransfer, Dropbox, etc.)

Experience working with internal and external stakeholders.

Extremely detail oriented and data obsessed.

Exceptional executive presence.

Experience supporting Executive team members.

Strategic thinker, self-starter, and creative problem solver.

Excellent communicator in written and verbal form.

Extremely versatile, dedicated to efficient productivity.

Application Instructions

We are eager to learn more about you and how you fit this role. When you apply, don’t limit your upload to a resume; show us what you’ve done. To do so, please submit:

1.    Your resume – one to two pages. 2.    A cover letter that outlines how you would approach the job.   Completing these steps will ensure that your application receives the highest consideration.   #Newsgnt#LI-NC1#LI-Remote

Base compensation is reflective of many factors, including, but not limited to, the market in which one lives/works, individual education level, skills, certifications and experience. Note: variable compensation is not reflected in these figures and based on the role, may be applicable.

job.title: Inside Sales Representative - Communities Choice
job.description:
Inside Sales Representative

Community Choice | Inside Sales | Uncapped Earning Potential

Company: LocaliQ, powered by the USA TODAY NetworkBrand: Community ChoiceWork Arrangement: Inside Sales

About Community Choice

At Community Choice, we connect local businesses with the people and communities they want to reach through exciting events, sponsorships, and promotional opportunities.

Powered by LocaliQ and the USA TODAY Network, we combine local connections with the resources and expertise of a nationally recognized media organization. Our team helps businesses get in front of their ideal customers while creating memorable experiences within their communities.

As an Inside Sales Representative, you’ll play a key role in bringing those partnerships to life. You’ll connect with business owners and decision-makers, uncover their goals and marketing challenges, introduce sponsorship and advertising opportunities, and help create partnerships that deliver visibility, engagement, and value.

If you’re energized by competition, motivated by results, and enjoy the challenge of turning a prospect’s business goals into a marketing solution, this could be the opportunity for you.

About the Role

This is a full-cycle, high-energy sales role where you’ll own the process from the first conversation through the close.

You’ll spend your day prospecting for new business, connecting with small and medium-sized businesses, conducting needs-based conversations, presenting event sponsorship and advertising opportunities, and building relationships with decision-makers.

The ideal salesperson isn't simply looking to make a sale—they know how to ask the right questions, uncover pain points, understand what a business is trying to accomplish, and connect those needs to the right solution.

Community Choice offers defined sponsorship and marketing packages, so success comes from understanding the customer's needs and effectively positioning the solutions available rather than creating a completely custom offering for every client.

You’ll manage your own pipeline, work toward monthly revenue and activity goals, and use Salesforce CRM to stay organized and keep opportunities moving forward.

This role combines new business prospecting with relationship building and nurturing. You’ll need the drive to consistently create new opportunities while also having the patience and follow-through to develop prospects and move them through the sales process.

The role is built for someone who enjoys having clear goals, wants their effort to directly impact their earnings, and thrives in an environment where activity, persistence, strategic selling, and results matter.

With strong training, sales tools, marketing resources, and leadership support behind you, you’ll have the opportunity to build your sales skills while growing your book of business.

Why This Role Stands Out

$19.24/hour base pay + uncapped commission

On-Target Earnings of approximately $65K

Top performers earning $100K+ annually

Opportunity to own the full sales cycle, from prospecting through close

Sell exciting event sponsorships, advertising, and promotional partnerships

Use a consultative sales approach to uncover business needs and position marketing solutions

Work with local businesses and help them increase their visibility in the community

Comprehensive onboarding, training, and ongoing sales development

Access to Salesforce, marketing resources, lead support, and sales tools

Clear opportunities for career growth and advancement

Collaborative, high-energy team environment with strong leadership support

Backed by LocaliQ and the USA TODAY Network

What You Will Do

Own the full sales cycle by prospecting, qualifying, conducting needs assessments, presenting, negotiating, and closing new business

Conduct consistent daily outbound outreach to small and medium-sized businesses

Build relationships with business owners and key decision-makers

Ask thoughtful questions to understand business goals, marketing challenges, and customer acquisition needs

Identify pain points and recommend the Community Choice sponsorship and advertising solutions that best align with those needs

Effectively communicate the value and business impact of marketing opportunities rather than relying primarily on price

Build, manage, and maintain a strong sales pipeline using Salesforce CRM

Balance new business development with consistent follow-up and nurturing of existing opportunities

Conduct sales presentations and confidently communicate the value of Community Choice opportunities

Consistently work toward and exceed monthly revenue and activity goals

Identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling additional solutions

Maintain accurate CRM notes, activity tracking, pipeline information, and forecasting

Stay persistent and engaged throughout the sales process to turn opportunities into new partnerships

Qualifications

2–5 years of proven sales experience, with B2B, outbound, consultative, advertising, marketing, media, sponsorship, or account acquisition experience preferred

Demonstrated ability to consistently meet or exceed sales goals or quotas

Experience with consultative or solution-based selling

Strong ability to conduct needs assessments, uncover pain points, and connect customer needs to available solutions

Confident communicator with a strong phone presence

Comfortable making frequent outbound calls and initiating conversations with new prospects

Strong closing and negotiation skills

Highly self-motivated, organized, and competitive

Internally motivated and driven to succeed without needing constant direction or external motivation

Comfortable working in a performance-based, commission-driven environment

Ability to manage multiple opportunities and maintain consistent follow-up

Comfortable adapting your sales approach while working within defined products and packages

Experience with Salesforce or another CRM is a plus

Bachelor’s degree or media/advertising sales experience is a plus

Who Thrives Here

The people who succeed in this role are competitive, persistent, confident, strategic, and motivated by results. They enjoy picking up the phone, starting conversations, overcoming objections, and finding a way to move an opportunity forward.

The strongest candidates will have experience selling through value rather than simply competing on price. They know how to get beyond the initial request, ask questions, identify what's really driving the customer's decision, and position a solution around the customer's goals.

You don't need to be an events expert on day one. What matters most is your ability to build relationships, ask good questions, uncover business needs, handle rejection, stay organized, and keep pushing toward the next opportunity.

This role is especially well suited for someone who enjoys a mix of hunting and nurturing—someone who can create new opportunities through consistent prospecting but also has the relationship-building skills and follow-through to develop those opportunities over time.

Because our solutions are built around defined packages, the ability to work within an established solution set and confidently position the value of those offerings is important. Salespeople who are highly dependent on creating completely customized solutions for every customer may find the role less natural.

If you enjoy a fast pace, clear goals, strategic selling, and the opportunity to directly influence your earnings through your own performance, you'll find plenty of room to grow here.

What Success Looks Like

First 3 Months:Complete onboarding and product training, build your prospecting habits, learn the Community Choice event portfolio and available packages, and begin developing a strong sales pipeline through consistent outbound activity and effective discovery conversations.

6 Months:Consistently prospect, manage a healthy pipeline, conduct confident needs-based sales conversations, effectively position Community Choice solutions, nurture opportunities, and establish steady performance against revenue and activity goals.

12 Months:Own your sales cycle with confidence, consistently deliver against revenue goals, build a strong book of business, develop lasting client relationships, and identify opportunities to expand your impact and earnings.

Benefits & Growth

We want our sales team to have the tools, training, and opportunity to build a successful career.

$19.24/hour base pay

Uncapped commission

~$65K OTE

Top performers earning $100K+ annually

Comprehensive onboarding and sales training

Ongoing coaching and professional development

Salesforce and industry-leading sales tools

Marketing resources and lead support

Career progression and advancement opportunities

Collaborative, high-energy sales culture

Leadership support focused on helping you succeed

Make an Impact. Build Relationships. Get Rewarded.

Community Choice gives you the opportunity to sell something businesses can get excited about—events and experiences that put them directly in front of their communities and customers.

If you’re ready to build relationships, uncover business needs, chase big goals, and turn your sales ability into uncapped earning potential, we want to meet you.

The hourly rate for this role will range between $17.00 and $19.24. Base compensation is reflective of many factors, including, but not limited to, the market in which one lives/works, individual education level, skills, certifications and experience. Note: variable compensation is not reflected in these figures and based on the role, may be applicable.

job.title: Merchandise Manager - Event Production
job.description:
The Merchandise Manager is responsible for owning and executing the financial targets for the RAGBRAI merchandise program. This role drives product mix, planning, and buying strategies to improve product quality, operational efficiency, and overall profitability.

The Merchandise Manager oversees the merchandise program, including management of the Shopify storefront, live events, the RAGBRAI HQ retail space product launches, and online inventory. This role works closely with Marketing and Creative teams to develop compelling merchandise assortments, coordinate product launches, and ensure brand consistency across both online and on-site retail channels.

Merchandise Planning and Financial Management

Analyze historical sales data, leverage registration trends, and use market insights to set revenue targets and inventory strategy.

Partner with Event Director to align financial goals by building and managing detailed merchandise budgets and forecasts.

Manage the purchasing process from order placement through production and delivery timelines.

Develop analytical and data-driven financial models to track sales performance and refine projections and forecasts.

Own post-event financial recaps, including SKU-level sales analysis, margin performance, and year-over-year comparisons.

Identify opportunities to improve inventory efficiency and reduce excess inventory.

Maintain clean, organized financial documentation for all merchandise orders to support Accounting & Finance processes.

Develop and manage the annual merchandise calendar, aligning product drops and campaigns with the broader marketing schedule.

Product Sourcing, Development and Buying

Build product orders and collaborate with the Creative team to develop assortments that align with event brand identity, customer demand, and profitability targets.

Determine product mix, pricing strategy, and inventory depth, ensuring cost and budget projections are updated as needed.

Source products that meet desired aesthetic direction, quality standards, trends and cost targets.

Work with Creative team to develop merchandise concepts, artwork applications, and product specifications.

Manage product development timelines and production calendars for events and ecommerce program

Research and source new vendors, and maintain strong relationships with an established vendor base.

Ecommerce & Digital Merchandising

Manage the online merchandise store through the Shopify platform, including product listings, inventory updates, pricing, and promotions.

Ensure product pages are optimized with accurate descriptions, size charts, imagery, and inventory availability.

Coordinate product launches with marketing campaigns and event calendar.

Monitor ecommerce performance metrics and identify opportunities to improve conversion rates and online sales.

In Person/Retail Events

Works with Expo Event Ops Coordinator to secure placement in each location

Responsible for managing a team of contractors or volunteer staff facilitate quick and smooth point-of-sale transactions

Perform physical duties as required by the role, such as moving equipment or transferring merchandise between locations

Inventory management, assisting guests with purchases, and overseeing sales transactions while maintaining a positive atmosphere

Implement dynamic event retail activations and strategies to maximize sales growth and improve customer experience

Assist with operational tasks and contribute to a positive shopping experience through merchandise upkeep and customer engagement

Act as a brand ambassador for RAGBRAI, its local sponsors and venues

Merchandise Marketing & Collaboration

Partner with the Marketing team to promote merchandise through email, social media, and digital campaigns.

Collaborate with Creative and graphic design teams to develop artwork, product concepts, and branded merchandise collections.

Support merchandise storytelling and promotional initiatives that drive both online and event-based sales.

Provide product insights and sales trends to inform future merchandise and marketing strategies.

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities and Worker Characteristics

3–4 years of experience in retail merchandising, planning, or buying.

Experience in revenue optimization, product development, and merchandising strategy.

Deep understanding of merchandising and marketing strategies within a retail environment.

Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Word.

Working knowledge of ecommerce platforms such as Shopify.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively with internal teams, vendors, and external partners.

Demonstrated integrity, professionalism, and sound judgment in all business interactions.

Proactive, analytical, and collaborative mindset with strong attention to detail.

Creative and curious mindset with an interest in fashion, merchandise, and live events.

Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to remain effective in high-pressure environments.

Excellent organizational skills.

Willingness and ability to travel and work non-traditional hours, including evenings and weekends during events.

job.title: Press Operator I
job.description:
Press Operator I

Gannett Publishing Services

Wilmington, Delaware

“We have an opening for a highly motivated individual in the Gannett corporation at one of our regional print facilities.”

“It is a fast-paced manufacturing operation which would require basic mechanical and\or manufacturing skill sets” This position is Full Time and will offer $20 per hour based on work-related experience.

The Wilmington GPS group is looking for a full-time Press Operator I to assist with daily production on our Goss HO presses. The work includes working with a team to prepare the presses for production, operates the presses or any of their components, cleans the presses and the pressroom, maintains the mechanical readiness of the presses, and other duties as assigned.Every member of the pressroom staff constantly strives to achieve the following goals, and the contribution of every press operator is necessary for success:

·Optimum quality of printed products.

·Observance of all scheduled start and stop times.

·Conservation of material resources, especially newsprint.

·A clean and safe working environment.

Requirements:

This position requires a high school education or equivalent. Three years’ experience in web offset printing is desirable, although production experience of any kind may be helpful.Mechanical ability and familiarity with computers is preferred. Candidates should have the ability to adapt to change, prioritize work, handle multiple tasks, remain flexible and interact with people while demonstrating patience.You must be able to lift/carry up to 100 pounds. Must be able to push/pull up to 2000 pounds. A press operator spends most working hours on his/her feet.In addition to long periods of standing, a press operator is required to climb stairs on the six-level press structure.Operators engaged in press maintenance and some cleaning activities will be required to stoop, kneel, crouch and crawl. They often work in confined areas. Color vision is required.

This position is full-time shift work, which may include scheduled nights, and weekends.

job.title: Press Operator II
job.description:
Press Operator IIGannett Publishing ServicesRockaway, NJ

The Rockaway Facility is looking for a full time Press Operator to assist with daily production on our double wide presses. Under the direction of press management & supervisors—the Press Operator Il is assigned to perform printing related tasks that may include, but are not limited to: working as Primary Ink setting or Folder operator, oversight of plate processing; spotting plates; reel set-up & operation; newsprint staging; roll preparation; CMYK ink setting; advanced press operational controls; equipment maintenance; and specified reporting.

Every member of the pressroom staff constantly strives to achieve the following goals, and the contribution of every press operator is necessary for success. The primary objective is to support efficient press operations as needed to achieve & maintain on-time production, product quality standards, low waste, and operational safety.

Optimum quality of printed products.Observance of all scheduled start and stop times.Conservation of material resources, especially newsprint.A clean and safe working environment.

Requirements:

Candidate must be proficient in Mitsubishi, Wifag or similar newspaper press operations and functions. Must have knowledge of printing techniques, understanding basic ink/water balance, press quality standards.

Read and layout press diagrams accurately to accommodate color demand while maintaining maximum labor and waste efficiencies. Must understand how to layout press runs, install leads, and switch angle bars.

Must be proficient in all reel room operations and procedures.

Must understand all reel functions including tensioning system, roll delivery systems, roll/butt diameter, candidates should have the ability to adapt to change, prioritize work, handle multiple tasks, remain flexible and interact with people while demonstrating patience.

Must be able to work in a fast-paced environment and meet all deadlines.

Forklift and clamp truck certification a plus.

Must have solid organizational and computer skills including good working knowledge of general business and Microsoft software programs.

You must be able to lift/carry up to 75 pounds. Must be able to push/pull up to 2000 pounds. A press operator Il spends most working hours on his/her feet. In addition to extended periods of standing, a press operator is required to climb stairs on the six-level press structure. Operators engaged in press maintenance and some cleaning activities will be required to stoop, kneel, crouch and crawl. They often work in confined areas. Color vision is required.

This position is Full-time shift work, which may include scheduled nights, weekends, and holidays.

As the Account Manager, you will act as the primary point of contact for client concerns and needs post-sales.

Must possess strong expertise in existing & emerging business marketing solutions, coupled with the ability to collaborate with our sales partners, post sales optimizers to identify opportunities, and effectively deliver solutions that maximize a client's ROI; are minimum expectations. In this dynamic role, a change-minded person will be crucial for effectively navigating the ever-evolving landscape of digital and traditional marketing concepts. Seamlessly, the AM will integrate with various teams and adapt to new challenges, ensuring that strategies remain agile and responsive to client needs.

Position Requirements:

Closely partner with sales team(s), in owning the client relationship by: building solid rapport, demonstrating transparency, & delivering results against joint business objectives

Understand, manage, and anticipate client expectations, gain client alignment, and fully mobilize/engage partner teams against the aligned approach while maintaining a strong communicative relationship

Create a consistent open line of communication ensuring our value story & service successes are in parallel to a client's needs/goals via performance reviews (Weekly, Monthly, etc.)

Articulate media programs to devise appropriate strategies and campaign implementation plans

Work alongside our sales, and post sales optimization teams to formulate and act upon appropriate digital strategies and executions. These actions will aid in meeting and exceeding our clients' business goals.

Advise our clients on how best to leverage feasible ongoing and impending marketing strategies

Ensure a highly consistent marketing message across paid search, organic presence, display, social media, and O&O digital/print marketing channels

Daily proficiency in customer relationship management, online search, and display advertising techniques and LocaliQ proprietary technologies

Review day to day campaign performance in collaboration with post sales optimization counterparts, assess digital campaign trends, facilitate client advertising performance discussions, & identify proactively creative new advertising techniques to further our client’s digital marketing needs

Hold primary responsibility for communicating and collaborating with backend support resources including, but not limited to, various digital solutions and ad operations teams, focused on delivering and exceeding client objectives (Daily, Weekly, Monthly, As Needed)

Key Skills:

Ability to quickly master business process, marketing, and technology concepts

Demonstrated expertise in customer relationship management

Mastery of key technologies and systems to review and advise on digital marketing campaigns

Advanced capabilities to effectively understand and speak toward digital advertising campaigns –Search, Display, Marketing Management Systems, traditional marketing endeavors etc.

Strong technical skills to recommend, assess, modify/adjust, & routinely improve marketing campaigns over their lifecycle

Demonstrated expertise with digital marketing publishing systems & processes

Excellent verbal & written communication skills

Demonstrate understanding of how retail/service media, sales, and operations work together to successfully drive a business

Proven track record in relationship building and account management

Works efficiently and is always looking to streamline processes & workflows

Moderate Excel and PowerPoint skills required

Key Competencies:

Marketing Concepts & Digital Marketing Acumen: pay-per-click, programmatic display, social, email marketing, and tracking concepts (Analytics/GA4), Leads, etc.)

Customer Focus

Proactive Creative & Analytical Thinking

Business Process & Technology Acumen

Team Collaboration

Conflict Management

Flexible With Change Management

Proven Success in Implementing Ideas in a Fast- Paced Environment

Attentive To Detail

About You:

Bachelor's degree in general business, economics, finance, marketing, advertising, public relations, journalism, or English

2+ years of hands-on experience managing online/digital advertising campaigns

Must have 3+ years of client-facing service/account management experience

Google Ads & Google Analytics Certified

About Us:

Are you looking for a company that values innovation, passion, and a healthy work/life balance? A job where you feel supported and appreciated? At LocaliQ, we know our employees drive success, and we strive to create a thriving company culture where you will enjoy coming to work every day. Here, you can walk through the halls and bump into our CEO, catch an inter-office ping pong tournament, or support a local cause with your fellow employees. Are you ready to join a company where you can have fun and work with some of brightest people in digital marketing? Our mission is to help local businesses all over the world reach more local customers online. As a leader in powering online marketing for local businesses, LocaliQ has been recognized for outstanding products and exceptional employees, having won Google’s Quality Account Champion in North America and Google’s Innovation Champion Award in Canada. job.title: Sr. Database Engineer
job.description:
As a Database Engineer, you will help operate and improve the database systems that power LOCALiQ, running primarily in the cloud across MySQL, PostgreSQL, and BigQuery. You will partner closely with software engineers, data engineers, analysts, and data scientists to keep our data platforms fast, safe, and available as our products scale.

This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who is curious about data challenges, comfortable operating production systems, and motivated to automate the work that shouldn't be done by hand. You'll have the support of a senior team while owning meaningful pieces of the platform yourself.

We are a fast-paced, product-led engineering organization building the next generation of digital marketing management systems in partnership with Google, Bing, Yahoo, Facebook, and Snap. If you are technical, analytical, and eager to build solutions that directly impact the business, we want to talk to you.

What You'll Do

· Design, build, and operate database systems on MySQL, PostgreSQL, and BigQuery, primarily on Google Cloud Platform.

· Maintain performance, availability, and security across LOCALiQ's production database estate.

· Ensure data safety and data integrity, including backup, recovery, and disaster recovery validation.

· Perform routine database operations such as upgrades, patching, schema changes, replication management, and capacity planning.

· Tune and troubleshoot slow queries, blocking, and replication issues alongside application teams.

· Review database changes to minimize deployment risk, and help teams design schemas and access patterns that scale.

· Automate recurring operational work through scripting, infrastructure as code, and CI/CD pipelines.

· Participate in a scheduled 24x7 on-call rotation shared with other team members.

Required Skills

· 3+ years of experience in a Database Engineer, Database Administrator, or similar role.

· Hands-on experience managing production database infrastructure in a cloud environment (GCP, AWS, or Azure).

· Working knowledge of relational databases — MySQL and/or PostgreSQL — including administration, replication, and backup/recovery.

· Strong SQL skills, including the ability to read, write, and optimize non-trivial queries.

· Programming experience in at least one language — Python preferred, but Go, Java, Ruby, or similar are all valuable.

· Experience with Git version control and working on code as part of a team.

· Sound judgment around change management, risk, and data integrity in production systems.

· BS or MS in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

· Curiosity, self-direction, and a bias toward automating repetitive work.

Preferred Skills

· Experience with Google Cloud Platform, particularly Cloud SQL, BigQuery, GKE, and Pub/Sub (equivalent AWS experience with RDS, Redshift, EKS, and SQS is welcome).

· Experience with BigQuery or another cloud data warehouse, including cost and performance optimization.

· Experience data modeling and data transformation tools like Dataform or DBT

· Experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform), containers, and CI/CD practices such as test automation and automated deployments.

· Comfort working in an Agile/Scrum environment.

· Exposure to digital marketing or online advertising data (SEO/SEM) is an advantage.

#LI-REMOTE

#LI-NR2

job.title: Strategic Account Executive
job.description:
Strategic Account Executive – Outside Sales

Join one of the nation's leading digital marketing organizations and help local businesses grow through SEO, search marketing, social advertising, OTT, websites, reputation management, and more. You'll own your territory, build client relationships, and earn uncapped commissions backed by the trusted reach of the USA TODAY Network.

Territory-Based | Remote | Client-Facing Market Role

Company: LocaliQ, powered by the USA TODAY Network Location: Outside Sales, territory-based role in Indianapolis | Virtual (home office with work in field)

About LocaliQ

At LocaliQ, part of USA TODAY Co., we help businesses grow by bringing together advanced marketing technology, trusted audience reach, and the expertise to turn it into results. In this role, you’ll work at the intersection of digital marketing and one of the most trusted media networks in the country—helping businesses connect with customers across the full marketing funnel.

You’ll partner with clients to understand their goals, build strategies that combine performance-driven digital solutions with the reach of the USA TODAY Network, and deliver measurable outcomes. This is an opportunity to be part of a team that doesn’t just sell products. We bring together the right mix of solutions to drive real business growth.

About the Role

Our Account Executive role is a consultative, relationship-driven sales position for someone who loves owning the full sales cycle—from net-new prospecting through long-term account growth—and who thrives in both hunting and managing client relationships.

In this role, you will actively hunt for net-new business, while also managing, growing, and expanding an ongoing book of clients. You’ll create tailored marketing strategies, guide businesses from first conversation through ongoing performance discussions, and continually identify opportunities to deepen partnerships over time. You’ll act as a trusted marketing partner—not a transactional seller—balancing new business development with retention, upsell, and account expansion to drive long-term client value.

Our Account Executive role is partnered with a post-sales team that manages campaign performance, optimizes results, and prepares reporting. Additional support resources are available, including the Data and Insights team, Client Strategists, and other product-specific resources.

In your first 90 days, you’ll gain confidence in LocaliQ’s solutions, tools, and sales approach while building meaningful prospecting and discovery habits. By the end of this period, you’ll be owning your territory and sales cycle end-to-end, with the support and coaching needed to set you up for long-term success.

Why This Role Stands Out:

Competitive base salary with uncapped commission and strong earning potential

Contests, and recognition programs for top performers

Consultative, full-cycle sales role with ownership from first conversation through long-term account growth

Hybrid flexibility with autonomy to manage your schedule and territory

Strong onboarding, coaching, and sales enablement to support a successful ramp

Access to an extensive mix of digital and traditional marketing solutions, enabling consultative, end-to-end strategies tailored to each client’s growth objectives

Career progression into senior sales and leadership roles

Backed by marketing expertise, post-sale specialists, and industry-leading tools

What You Will Do

Build a consistent prospecting cadence using cold calls, email, social outreach, networking, and in-person or virtual meetings to develop a strong pipeline.

Manage and grow a territory by balancing new business development, client retention, and account expansion.

Lead thoughtful discovery conversations to understand business goals, marketing challenges, and growth opportunities.

Build and present data-informed digital and traditional marketing proposals that connect strategy, tactics, and budget to client goals.

Own the full sales cycle—from initial outreach through close—while maintaining accurate CRM activity, pipeline management, and forecasting.

Partner with internal account management, creative, and strategy teams to support strong client outcomes.

Stay engaged post-sale through reporting, optimization, and performance conversations that support renewals and continued growth.

Qualifications

5 years of B2B sales experience with success in new business development, account growth, or business development roles.

Ability to run a full-cycle, consultative sales process—from discovery through proposal, negotiation, and close.

Strong prospecting skills across phone, email, social, networking, and relationship-based outreach.

Experience using CRM and sales tools with disciplined pipeline management and follow-up.

Comfort learning and discussing digital marketing solutions such as search, social, display, and video (direct experience is a plus, not required).

Excellent communication skills, business curiosity, and the ability to build credibility with diverse clients and stakeholders, influencing decisions through clear data-driven recommendations.

Proficiency with CRM, Microsoft Office Suite, and AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot.

Valid driver’s license and vehicle insurance

Who Thrives Here

High performers in this role are resilient, self-motivated, strategic and creative minded and competitive, with a strong drive to outperform and continuously take on greater impact. They are coachable and highly self-directed, comfortable initiating outreach, staying organized, asking thoughtful questions, and using data and tools to work efficiently. Energized by real-time results, they handle rejection well and maintain full ownership of their performance and trajectory.

Benefits

We believe high performance should be recognized and supported through compensation, development, and real opportunity to grow your skills.

Competitive base salary + Uncapped commission opportunity

401(k) with company match

Career progression opportunities

Flexibility and autonomy in a remote work environment.  Candidate must live in designated territory.

High-performance culture with recognition, incentives, and more.

Comprehensive health, dental & vision coverage options and more

Unlimited MTO time off, including paid holidays

Expense reimbursement

Structured onboarding to get you ramped fast

Ongoing coaching from experienced leaders

Access to industry-leading tools, resources, and marketing expertise

Step into a territory where you can own the full sales cycle, bring smart marketing solutions to the table, and be recognized for the results you deliver. If you’re ready to grow your career and be part of a high-performing team, we encourage you to apply.

job.title: ESPN LA Part-Time Digital Content Creator
job.description:

  • Support talent during projects and shoots by helping bring creative concepts to life while following partner guidelines and campaign expectations.
  • Ensure that partner goals are met and campaign deliverables are executed.
  • Produce recaps, sizzle reels, and specs for social and sales purposes.
  • Actively participate in Digital Team Connect meetings to share ideas, best practices, and social media recommendations across Good Karma.

  • Travel to help capture events, live shows/podcasts, in-game content, and more.
  • When applicable, assist with setup, teardown, and other marketing responsibilities at our events and live remotes.
  • Integrate AI tools into daily workflows to enhance and optimize digital content, improve communication, project coordination and operational efficiency while maintaining appropriate human oversight.
  • Collaborate across departments to support organizational goals and perform other duties as assigned.
  • Be a Good Karma ambassador by demonstrating our core values: Be Honest, Work Hard, Over Deliver, Listen, Teamwork, and Follow Through.

Preferred knowledge, skills and qualifications 

  • Proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite, including Premiere Pro, After Effects, and Photoshop, as well as Canva and PowerPoint
  • Ability to set up camera, lights, and audio equipment 
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to work within tight deadlines
  • Experience with Illustrator, Adobe Animate, vMix, CapCut, and Sway is a plus
  • Knowledge of Switcher Studio, OBS, Streamyard or livestreaming platforms
  • Ability to participate in brainstorm sessions and ideate marketing solutions
  • Valid driver's license and ability to drive station vehicles to and from events as needed.

This is a part-time, hourly position.

Pay Transparency: The anticipated starting hourly range for California-based individuals expressing interest in this position is $18.42 - $20.00 per hour. The hourly rate is to be determined by the education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, and location of the applicant, as well as internal and external equity.

Opportunity for Growth  

Teammates have the opportunity to continuously learn and grow within Good Karma and are responsible for representing Good Karma Sports, our story, and our core values inside and outside the workplace. Teammates are encouraged to take a proactive role in building relationships and seeking opportunities throughout the company.  

How to Apply  

Apply by submitting resume to www.goodkarmasports.com/careers. All are encouraged to apply.  

About Good Karma Sports

Good Karma Sports is a sports media and marketing company that helps brands build meaningful connections with fans in and around the game. Combining national reach, regional expertise and deep local relationships, the company develops and executes multi-platform strategies across audio, podcasts, video, digital, social, talent, live experiences and premium sports partnerships. 

For nearly 30 years, Good Karma has paired sports-first expertise and trusted relationships with best-in-class execution to deliver results for brands, publishers, leagues, teams, communities and fans. Today, Good Karma Sports has more than 500 teammates across 12 offices nationwide and has been recognized as a Best Place to Work by Front Office Sports, Sports Business Journal and USA TODAY.

## 

Good Karma Sports is an Equal Opportunity Employer.  We consistently renew our commitment to creating and maintaining an inclusive workplace for all.  We foster integrity, respect within the workplace, and believe that the foundation of our success is our collective differences and diversity of thought.  We welcome all to help us continue to build a community that embodies and promotes diversity, inclusion, and belonging for all.

job.title: Producer - Newsradio 620 WTMJ

  • Work with on-air hosts to develop daily content plans and social media strategies.
  • Source potential contributors and interviewees.
  • Post on social media about the show, including stories, interviews, and podcasts.

  • Perform other duties as assigned.
  • Represent Good Karma Sports as an ambassador of the company’s core values: Listen, Be Honest, Follow Through, Work Hard, Teamwork, and Over Deliver.

Preferred knowledge, skills and qualifications:

  • Previous experience producing news-talk programming, working in a newsroom, or working in television news.
  • A passion for local news and covering impactful stories.
  • An understanding of the daily news cycle and current events.
  • A desire to be part of a team and work in a fast-paced environment.
  • Personal sense of responsibility and accountability.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills.

  • Valid driver’s license required.

Our team produces nearly 40 hours of broadcast content each week, along with a constant presence online at KBTX.com.
KBTX is routinely recognized among the best in the state by organizations including the Associated Press, RTDNA, and the Lone Star EMMY Chapter of the National Academy of Television Arts and Sciences. The station has won four consecutive Texas Association of Broadcasters’ Bonner McLane Public Service awards, and in 2023 won a National Edward R. Murrow Award for Digital content. KBTX is also a recent Texas AP Broadcasters/Freedom of Information Foundation of Texas Station of the Year and Texas Associated Press Broadcasters Station of the Year.

The station has launched the careers of many well-known journalists, meteorologists, and network executives, and takes pride in helping talent grow quickly into the nation’s largest television markets. The work family of KBTX is made up of a group of dedicated, professional, and passionate individuals who are the backbone of our daily mission.

Bryan-College Station, Texas, is a community of more than 250,000 people and the largest single metro in the Waco-Temple-Bryan DMA. The twin cities have a unique small-town feeling, but offer big-city amenities, including a vibrant arts community, a city-wide, all-terrain trail system, and world-class dining and nightlife. Bryan and College Station are routinely recognized as leaders in quality of life and as one of the fastest-growing communities in the country.

College Station is home to Texas A&M University, the nation’s largest university. Aggie home football games attract more than 100,000 in the stands, with tens of thousands more camped outside celebrating at tailgates during football weekends.
Learn more about KBTX at www.kbtx.com.

The Right Fit: This position is designed for a well-rounded engineer who thrives at the intersection of broadcast and IT. The ideal candidate is a steady hand, a creative problem solver, and a trusted partner ready to help lead one of the Wabash Valley’s most dynamic television operations.
Core Responsibilities:

Broadcast and Production Systems:
- Maintain, repair, and optimize all studio, control room, and transmission systems
- Support Grass Valley Kayak HD, production switchers, Chyron graphics systems, Grass Valley routers, Imagine ADC master control, and Wheatstone audio consoles
- Manage signal flow across SDI infrastructure, including routing, monitoring, and conversion systems.
- Work closely with production and news teams to resolve live on-air technical issues quickly and effectively
- Create and maintain clear system documentation and standard operating procedures

Information Technology and Networking:
- Work with the Regional IT manager to maintain Information technology and support users locally.
- Oversee VMware virtual machines, Windows servers, user workstations, and system backups in coordination with corporate IT
- Manage Active Directory, LAN/WAN-related hardware, and local network security
- Support newsroom systems, automation interfaces, and shared storage environments
- Maintain alignment with Gray Media corporate IT and broadcast technology initiatives
- Ensure proper cybersecurity practices and software updates across technical systems

Leadership and Collaboration:
- Serve as a key technical leader when the Chief Engineer is unavailable or off-site
- Promote proactive maintenance and continuous improvement within the department
- Communicate effectively with newsroom, production, and corporate personnel
- Maintain a calm, professional demeanor under pressure and during live operations

Qualifications/Requirements:

Desired Qualifications/Requirements:
- Working knowledge of Grass Valley switchers, Evertz, Imagine,& Grass Valley Routers, and ENPS
- Understanding of SDI signal flow, routing, audio distribution, and monitoring systems
- Experience with VMware virtual environments, Windows server, Active Directory, and system backups
- Knowledge of VLANs, routing, and network configuration within a broadcast plant
- Basic understanding of transmitters and RF fundamentals preferred
- Must be available for on-call support, including evenings, weekends, and holidays as needed
- Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities with a proactive mindset
- Strong organizational and documentation skills with attention to detail
- Effective communication and vendor management skills
- Ability to manage multiple priorities in a live production environment
- 5 or more years of experience in broadcast engineering and information technology

Job Summary/Description:  

Are you a tech-savvy problem solver who loves the thrill of keeping a complex system running smoothly? Do you thrive on the challenge of bridging the gap between traditional broadcasting and the future of media? We’re looking for a Broadcast/IT Maintenance Technician who isn't just looking for a job, but a chance to be the technical backbone of WLUC. Whether it’s ensuring our live streams are rock-solid or keeping our newsroom systems firing on all cylinders, you’ll be the one making sure the magic happens—across every screen.

Duties/Responsibilities include, but are not limited to: 

• Own the infrastructure: Install and maintain the video, audio, and computer systems that power our station, from server-based record systems to non-linear editors.

• Manage the fleet: Help keep our team moving by scheduling vehicle maintenance and performing weekly inspections (because news happens everywhere).
• Maintain the environment: Handle general building maintenance and even assist with plowing at studio or transmitter locations when the U.P. weather gets "interesting."

• Digital fluency: Strong familiarity with Microsoft operating systems, Office, and core LAN/WAN networking technologies.

• Physical agility: You’re comfortable climbing a ladder (up to 10 feet).
• Flexibility: You understand that media is a 24/7 business and are ready to accommodate shift changes, including evenings and weekends.

K8 News is searching for a commanding, trusted, and engaging Chief Meteorologist to lead the K8 Weather Team and serve as the trusted face and voice of our severe weather coverage. - Minimum of four years of on-air broadcast meteorology and severe weather forecasting experience.
- AMS Certified Broadcast Meteorologist (CBM) designation or NWA Seal of Approval preferred.
- Proficiency with weather graphics platforms and newsroom systems.
- Advanced competency in Doppler radar, dual-polarization products, and numerical weather prediction models.
- Proven ability to ad-lib and deliver calm, decisive live coverage during breaking severe weather.
- Strong scientific communication skills with the ability to translate complex data into accessible public information.

Bryan-College Station, Texas is a community of more than 250,000 people and the largest single metro in the Waco-Temple-Bryan DMA. The twin cities have a unique small town feeling, but offers big city amenities, including a vibrant arts community, a city-wide, all-terrain trail system, and world-class dining and nightlife. Bryan and College Station are routinely recognized as leaders in quality of life and as one of the fastest-growing communities in the country.

College Station is home to Texas A&M University, the nation’s largest university. Aggie home football games attract more than 100,000 in the stands, with tens of thousands more camped outside celebrating at tailgates during football weekends.

About WTVG:

WTVG is located in Northwestern Ohio. Our viewers and customers are extremely friendly and down-to-earth. We are a region of proud automotive workers home to Chrysler and GM plants. We are extremely passionate about our collegiate sports teams, including The Ohio State University Buckeyes, the University of Michigan Wolverines, the University of Toledo Rockets, and the Bowling Green University Falcons.

We enjoy all four seasons and the activities that come with each. Nature is always a short distance away, with many surrounding parks and Lake Erie for recreation. The roller coaster capital of the world, Cedar Point, is just a short drive from the television station. We have two minor league sports teams. The Toledo Mud Hens have a rich baseball history and loyal following. Not to be outdone are the fans of our hockey team, the Toledo Walleye. We also love our food. There are many outstanding restaurants and local festivals throughout the year.

Since 1948, generations of families have grown up counting on WTVG to be a window to their world on-air and now digitally. We take pride in our ratings, our content, our status, and the need to maintain the work ethic that got us to where we are.

There has always been a family atmosphere at WTVG. We care about each other, and know that we are stronger as one team than as many individuals. We take our jobs seriously, and know that we can be successful and have fun at the same time.

job.description:

Gray Media, or Gray, is a multimedia company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. The company is the nation's largest owner of top-rated local television stations and digital assets serving 113 television markets that collectively reach approximately 36 percent of US television households. About WBTV:

WBTV was the first television station to sign on in the Carolinas and is considered the “most trustworthy source of news and information” in the area, according to research. Being “On Your Side” for the community is WBTV's guiding principle and drives its award-winning newscasts and quality local journalism. Visit www.wbtv.com to learn more.

Job Summary/Description:

WBTV is seeking a creative, driven Digital Content Producer to create, coordinate, and distribute news content across WBTV's digital platforms and social media. This role is also responsible for developing unique, engaging angles that resonate with digital audiences.

Duties/Responsibilities (but are not limited to) the following:

- Digital news production & reporting
- Report, write, and publish news stories daily, with a focus on the most impactful local, regional, and national news.
- Develop original digital story ideas and enterprise content that go beyond traditional coverage.
- Produce clear, accurate, and engaging copy that adheres to Associated Press (AP) style and WBTV editorial standards.
- Platform management & publishing
- Coordinate and publish content across WBTV.com, WBTV mobile and streaming apps, YouTube, and all major social media platforms.
- Adapt stories and headlines for individual platforms, optimizing content presentation based on audience behavior and best practices.
- Regularly create and schedule social media posts to promote WBTV content and engage audiences.
- Analytics & strategy
- Monitor audience analytics and performance metrics across platforms.
- Use data insights to inform editorial decisions, refine content strategy, and identify opportunities for growth and engagement.
- Respond to shifting priorities in a fast-paced news environment, adjusting coverage strategies as needed.
- Editorial standards & collaboration
- Demonstrate strong news judgment in story selection, framing, and presentation.
- Collaborate with newsroom staff, including reporters, anchors, producers, and photographers, to maximize the impact of WBTV’s digital content.
- Uphold the highest journalistic standards of accuracy, fairness, and integrity across all digital platforms.
- Provide copyediting and developmental editing support for digital stories and social posts as needed.

Qualifications/Requirements:

- 3–5 years of experience in digital content production and strategy within a newsroom or similar information-sharing environment.
- Proven journalistic writing skills with a clear understanding of AP style.
- Strong copyediting and developmental editing skills with attention to detail and accuracy.
- Demonstrated ability to exercise strong news judgment in a fast-paced environment.
- Experience executing journalistic storytelling across multiple digital platforms, with an understanding of how to tailor content and presentation for each platform.
- Solid understanding of SEO best practices and how to apply them to news content.
- Ability to work under pressure and meet tight, changing deadlines.
- Excellent organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
- Familiarity with digital analytics tools and the ability to interpret data to drive editorial decisions.
- Strong collaboration and communication skills.

job.title: DIGITAL CONTENT PRODUCER (P/T) - WKYT
job.description:
About Gray Media:

Today, we are a growing multimedia company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. We are the nation's largest owner of top-rated local television stations and digital assets serving 117 full-power television markets that collectively reach approximately 37% of US television households. The portfolio includes 80 markets with the top-rated television station and 100 markets with the first- and/or second-highest-rated television station in average all-day ratings across 116 of such markets that were measured by Nielsen in 2025. We also own the largest Telemundo Affiliate group with 46 markets and Gray Digital Media, a full-service digital agency offering national and local clients digital marketing strategies with the most advanced digital products and services. Our additional media properties include video production companies Raycom Sports, Tupelo Media Group, and PowerNation Studios, and studio production facilities Assembly Atlanta and Third Rail Studios.

About WKYT:

WKYT-TV is home to the CBS and CW affiliates in beautiful Lexington, KY. The station sits amongst picturesque horse farms in the Thoroughbred Capital of the World.

The Lexington DMA (#63) provides a competitive news environment, and WKYT has emerged as the news leader, producing over 11.5 hours of news per day. Our team of award-winning professionals thrives in a fast-paced, yet fun, environment.

Lexington is home to a thriving downtown scene, phenomenal restaurants and breweries, and, of course, Keeneland Race Course, the most beautiful horse track you'll ever visit. For outdoor enthusiasts, Red River Gorge and the Appalachian Mountains are calling your name. And in the summers, Lake Cumberland is just a short drive south to get your boating fix.

Lexington is home to the University of Kentucky, where basketball is a way of life! Once you see a game at historic Rupp Arena, your life will never be the same!

Job Summary/Description:

WKYT in Lexington, Kentucky, is looking for a part-time weekend digital content producer for its award-winning and innovative digital platforms. We have all the tools for success and innovation in digital content: an outstanding, dedicated team in front of the camera and behind the scenes; live streaming capabilities with multiple live trucks and TVUs; access to a drone for enhancing coverage; and a podcasting studio.

This producer will help power both news and sports digital and social coverage on weekends — publishing breaking news fast, supporting game-night highlights/scores/recaps, and creating social-first video for station accounts.

Part-time: Friday, Saturday, Sunday, 2:00 p.m. – 10:30 p.m. (~25.5 hrs/week)

Duties/Responsibilities will include (but are not limited to):

• Work Friday, Saturday, and Sunday, 2 p.m. to 10:30 p.m., supporting digital publishing, streaming, and social coverage.
• Publish breaking/newsroom content quickly and accurately to our website and station social platforms.
• Support both News and Sports digital + social — including game nights: turn highlights, scores, and recaps fast across web, app, streaming, and social.
• Work directly with our Streaming Desk to clip, distribute, and optimize live/near-live content.
• Edit and publish content natively inside social apps (especially Instagram and TikTok) using platform best practices (vertical video, captions, hooks, etc.).
• Create/produce vertical video for station news and sports accounts; operate (or learn to operate) our newsroom editing system to cut and export social-ready video.
• Collaborate with news managers, producers, assignment editors, reporters, photographers, weather, and sports to anticipate content needs and execute coverage plans.
• Strengthen stories with clean writing, headlines, basic graphics/templates, research, and consistent station branding.
• Write clearly for multiple platforms under tight deadlines with strong editorial judgment, accuracy, and adherence to journalistic ethics and libel laws.
Schedule:
• Part-time: Friday, Saturday, Sunday, 2:00 p.m. – 10:30 p.m. (~25.5 hrs/week)
• Some holiday and late-night work may be required depending on sports/news coverage needs.

Qualifications/Requirements:

• Bachelor’s degree in journalism/communications or related field (or equivalent newsroom/digital experience).
• Must have consistent availability for Fri-Sun 2-10:30 p.m. schedule.
• Demonstrated ability to publish quickly and accurately on digital platforms (web + social).
• Comfortable editing short-form video; experience with in-app editing tools (IG/TikTok) strongly preferred.
• Experience with a newsroom CMS and basic video editing tools preferred; willingness to learn our editing system is required.
• Strong news judgment, clean writing, attention to detail, and calm decision-making under deadline pressure.
• Strong communication and collaboration skills; thrives in a fast-paced, team-driven environment. Passion for both news and sports coverage a plus.

About GDM (Gray Media Group):

Gray’s Digital Technology group builds and operates the products that bring local news, sports, and live programming to audiences across 100+ television stations – on the web, on mobile, and on connected TV platforms. Quality is critical to ensure viewers are focused on journalism, not the technology that delivers it. You will help make sure that what we ship is reliable, accessible, and ready when it counts – election night, severe weather, breaking news.

Job Summary/Description:

The Digital QA Analyst validates the quality, functionality, accessibility, and reliability of digital products across web, mobile, connected TV, APIs, data feeds, and internal systems. You’ll partner closely with Product Owners, developers, and business stakeholders to confirm that what we build meets requirements, holds up under real-world use, and is genuinely ready for release. The right person combines strong testing fundamentals, critical thinking, technical curiosity, and a sharp eye for detail to catch problems early and promote quality at every stage of the development lifecycle, not just at the end.

Duties/Responsibilities include, but are not limited to: 

• Design, plan, and execute testing activities across web, mobile, connected TV (CTV), APIs, data feeds, and internal platforms to ensure products meet quality and business expectations.
• Collaborate with Product Owners, developers, and stakeholders throughout the software development lifecycle to clarify requirements, identify risks, and improve overall product quality.
• Create and maintain test strategies, test cases, regression suites, and documentation while prioritizing testing efforts based on risk, complexity, user impact, and release timelines.
• Identify, document, and validate defects through resolution, providing clear communication on testing status, release readiness, and potential risks.
• Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by analyzing quality trends, supporting efficient QA processes, and helping expand test automation coverage where it provides the greatest value.

Test design and planning:
• Build test strategies, cases, and validation approaches from requirements, Jira tickets, stakeholder input, and product knowledge.
• Partner with Product Owners and developers early in the software lifecycle to surface risks, clarify requirements, and improve testability before development starts.
• Prioritize coverage by risk, complexity, business, and user impact, and release timelines.

Test execution across platforms:
• Run functional, regression, integration, exploratory, accessibility, and user acceptance testing across web, mobile, CTV, and internal platforms.
• Execute cross-browser, cross-device, and mobile testing.
• Test connected-TV apps (Roku, Apple TV, Fire TV, Android TV) for playback, captions, ad behavior, and live-versus-VOD scenarios.
• Validate APIs, data feeds, AI-generated outputs, JSON/XML payloads, and downstream integrations.

Defect lifecycle:
• Identify defects, usability issues, edge cases, and unexpected behavior.
• Write clear defect reports with reproduction steps, expected-versus-actual results, and supporting evidence.
• Re-test fixes and confirm resolution before release.

Collaboration and process:
• Take part in sprint planning, backlog refinement, standups, and retrospectives.
• Work alongside developers to isolate issues and support root-cause analysis.
• Maintain regression suites, test documentation, and repeatable QA processes.
• Validate release readiness and communicate status, risks, and recommendations clearly.

Continuous improvement:
• Track quality trends, recurring defects, and areas of technical debt that affect product
stability.
• Help identify where automated testing would add the most value, and partner with
engineering to grow coverage and efficiency.
• Contribute to initiatives that raise product quality and team effectiveness.

Qualifications/Requirements:

• A minimum of 3 years of experience in software quality assurance, digital product testing, or a related field, with hands-on experience testing web applications, mobile applications, internal systems, or other digital products.
• Strong understanding of software testing methodologies, including functional, regression, integration, exploratory, accessibility, and user acceptance testing, with the ability to identify issues and validate solutions across multiple platforms.
• 3+ years of experience in software QA, digital product testing, or a closely related field.
• Hands-on experience testing web applications, mobile applications, internal systems, or other digital products.
• Strong grasp of functional, regression, integration, exploratory, accessibility, and acceptance testing.
• Ability to turn requirements and user workflows into effective test cases and scenarios.
• Experience validating APIs, structured data, and system integrations.
• Strong defect documentation and the collaboration skills to work across the full SDLC.
• Working understanding of accessibility principles, and willingness to build accessibility checks into everyday testing.
• Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving instincts.
• Excellent written and verbal communication

Preferred Qualifications:
• Experience testing media, broadcast, publishing, CMS, or other content-driven platforms.
• Experience testing connected-TV/OTT apps and validating video playback, closed captions, and ad insertion (SSAI/DAI).
• Experience validating JSON/XML/API responses and integration workflows.
• Basic SQL for validation and troubleshooting.
• Experience testing iOS and Android applications.
• Familiarity with browser developer tools and network inspection.
• Exposure to test automation and an interest in growing automated coverage.
• Accessibility testing against WCAG guidelines.
• Experience supporting release validation and production readiness.

What Success Looks Like:
• Requirements are validated thoroughly before release.
• Critical workflows perform reliably across every supported platform – including playback and ad delivery.
• Defects are identified early and communicated clearly enough to influence product and development decisions.
• Releases ship with predictable quality and few production-impacting issues, which means less rework afterward.
• Test coverage and regression confidence improve over time.
• Stakeholders have clear visibility into QA status, risks, and release readiness.
• Engineering trusts the quality bar on every release.

WILX, the highly rated NBC affiliate located in Lansing, Michigan, for more than 60 years, is on a growth trajectory. WILX currently produces 33 hours of news per week and is growing. A market leader in news, digital, and social media, WILX News 10 is home to Emmy Award-winning reporters and a recipient of the Michigan Association of Broadcasters “Station of the Year” award. Lansing is just an hour away from Grand Rapids, downtown Detroit, and a day-trip “up north” for some of the most beautiful places in the country. If you love lakes, boating, fishing, camping, beaches, downhill skiing, wine, craft brew, Broadway shows, Big 10 sports, minor-league baseball, NFL/NBA/NHL games…Michigan has it all!

We produce 62 hours of live, televised newscasts per week between KOLD and our shared services partner, KMSB Fox 11. If you’ve never been to Tucson, let us tell you all the things you’ll love: Plentiful sunshine, natural beauty, diverse culture, active lifestyles, great food, hundreds of miles of hiking trails, breathtaking views, unforgettable sunsets, challenging biking trails, community events, accessible natural locations for all ages… it would have been quicker for us to just say you’ll love it all.

Southern Arizona’s most-watched station, 13 News, is looking for a creative, passionate, detail-oriented morning Executive Producer to lead our team. This is a great opportunity to serve our vibrant communities through meaningful journalism and impactful storytelling. This person will ensure the execution of the station’s strong "Live, Local, Late Breaking" brand. Established in 1953, WLFI (News 18) is the premier television station serving the Lafayette-West Lafayette area - DMA Market 189. As a CBS affiliate, it provides comprehensive local news, weather, and sports coverage across West-Central Indiana. The Lafayette-West Lafayette area is a dynamic blend of small-town charm and high-tech innovation. Lafayette serves as the scenic county seat, featuring a vibrant, walkable downtown filled with quaint local shops & eclectic dining. Across the river, West Lafayette is the proud home of Purdue University, part of the BIG 10 Athletic Conference, and nationally ranked in multiple areas. Purdue is also an international hub for research. Overall, the area offers a rich quality of life with over 50 parks, the Columbian Park Zoo, and the Celery Bog Nature Area. With its proximity to Indianapolis and Chicago, it provides a perfect balance of Midwestern hospitality and global influence.

Our News and Weather Apps, podcasts, and streaming content offered through Connected TV platforms reach audiences far beyond broadcast. Our mission is "To Tell Alaska's Story," and we strive to consistently distinguish ourselves as Alaska's preferred source for news, information, and community service.

The Training Program:

Are you tired of just watching from the sidelines? Ready to stop "shadowing" and start actually doing the work that reaches thousands of people every single day? We’re looking for the next generation of media powerhouses, producers, reporters, weather experts, and sales executives who are hungry to dive head-first into the fast-paced world of local media. This isn't your typical "get the coffee" internship. The Gray Media Training Program is a high-octane, 10-week immersive experience where you don’t just learn the job; you own it. Whether you’re crafting the lead story for the evening news, tracking a cold front on our weather tech, or closing a digital ad deal, you’ll be a vital part of our award -winning team from day one.

General Responsibilities:

What You’ll Do:

  • Own the role: Step into the shoes of a producer, MMJ, Meteorologist, or Media Sales executive and handle real-world assignments (yes, the kind that may go on air and online). 
  • Drive digital engagement: Create content that lives beyond the TV screen; think social media, streaming apps, and web stories—because we’re digital-first, always.
  • Collaborate with pros: Work side-by-side with seasoned veterans who are the best in the business, gaining insights you won’t find in any textbook.
  • Commit to the craft: Dedicate 25 hours per week for 10 weeks to mastering your specialty and building a professional-grade portfolio.
  • Make an impact: Tell stories that matter to the community or help local businesses grow through innovative media strategies. 
  • Build your future: Position yourself at the front of the line for full-time career opportunities within Gray Media’s network of 113 stations.

What You Bring:

  • Current enrollment: You’re a college student (Junior or Senior status preferred) chasing a degree in Journalism, Communications, Sales, Marketing, or a related field.
  • A "doer" mindset: You aren't afraid to get your hands dirty and take initiative; you’re here to work, not just watch.
  • Digital savvy: You understand that media happens everywhere, from the big screen to the palm of someone’s hand.
  • Strong work ethic: You bring urgency, organization, and a "can-do" attitude to every shift.
  • Communication skills: You can tell a story, pitch an idea, or explain a forecast with clarity and confidence.
  • Reliability: You’re ready to commit to the full 10-week program and the 25-hour weekly schedule.
  • Passion for local: You care about the community and want to see how local media makes a real difference.

Why You’ll Love It Here:

  • Real-world experience: You’ll graduate with more than just a line on your resume; you’ll have the experience of having done the job.
  • Unprecedented access: With 113 stations across the U.S., you’re part of a massive, innovative network that’s leading the future of media.
  • Career fast-track: We love hiring our own. This program is designed to be the ultimate audition for your first full-time role with Gray.
  • Paid training: Earn while you learn. This is a paid internship. 
  • A culture of innovation: We’re evolving on purpose, and you’ll be right there on the front lines of that evolution.

    Qualifications/Requirements:

          • Be currently enrolled in a college/university, preferably in your senior year.
          • Strong work ethic and organizational skills.
          • Earning a degree in Broadcast Journalism/Communications, or related fields, with a desire to get hands-on experience in the local media industry.

    • Marketing

    Ready to stop practicing and start performing? Let’s build the future of media together

job.description:
About Gray Media:

Gray Media, or Gray, is a multimedia company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. The company is the nation's largest owner of top-rated local television stations and digital assets serving 113 television markets that collectively reach approximately 36 percent of US television households. The portfolio includes 77 markets with the top-rated television station and 100 markets with the first and/or second-highest-rated television station, as well as the largest Telemundo Affiliate group with 45 markets totaling nearly 1.5 million Hispanic TV Households. The company also owns Gray Digital Media, a full-service digital agency offering national and local clients digital marketing strategies with the most advanced digital products and services. Gray's additional media properties include video production companies Raycom Sports, Tupelo Media Group, and PowerNation Studios, and studio production facilities Assembly Atlanta and Third Rail Studios.

About KFVS:

KFVS12 is the #1 local TV station serving as the CBS/CW/MeTV/Outlaw/Telemundo/Oxygen/GRIT affiliate in the Cape Girardeau, Missouri/Paducah, Kentucky/Harrisburg, Illinois market. Founded in 1954, KFVS12 has a rich heritage of serving "America's Heartland" with the best local news and weather information, along with a legacy of community service and disaster relief. KFVS12 produces more local news than any other station in the market, currently offering over 50 hours of news content every week, along with special high-profile, topical local programming. Heartland News on KFVS12 consistently leads the competition in award-winning journalism having been honored this year with numerous Missouri and Illinois Broadcasters' Awards as well as the prestigious Edward R. Murrow Awards.

The Cape Girardeau market covers 45 counties in four states and is home to four division-one universities. It is where the North meets the South and the East meets the West. The area is rich with many diverse communities, including historic riverfront towns, that offer a variety of unique benefits and recreational opportunities. It is also conveniently located for easy travel to St. Louis, Memphis, Nashville, and Chicago.

The station has an exceptional staff that is committed to maintaining the legacy of the institution of KFVS. They are forward-thinking with news coverage in on-air newscasts and 24/7 on numerous digital platforms, consistently leading the competition in digital traffic across the board. This provides exciting opportunities throughout the station including News, Sales, Marketing, Engineering, and more.

These positions will teach producing, shooting, and editing skills while contributing and creating content for Spanish-speaking Gray Television outlets. Partnership Universities include:

  • Inter-American University – Universidad Inter American De Puerto Rico
