job.title: Account Executive - North Carolina
job.description:
Account Executive – North Carolina

Lee Enterprises, partnering with Amplified Digital, is seeking a driven and results-oriented Outside Sales Executive with a hunter mentality to sell digital advertising solutions to businesses.

Position Responsibilities

Prospect and generate new business through cold calling, networking, referrals, email outreach, and in-person and virtual meetings.

Consistently maintain a high level of outbound prospecting activity and sales appointments to build and advance the sales pipeline.

Identify and develop relationships with prospective clients and key decision-makers across an assigned geographic territory.

Conduct needs assessments to understand client goals, target audiences, marketing challenges, and desired outcomes.

Develop and present customized digital advertising proposals that align with client objectives and budgets.

Sell a comprehensive suite of digital advertising solutions, including, but not limited to, display, search, social, video, OTT/CTV, and website solutions.

Create, manage, and advance a sales pipeline from initial prospecting through close.

Negotiate and close new business while consistently working toward or exceeding assigned revenue goals.

Establish, grow, and manage a significant book of business through new client acquisition, retention, and account expansion.

Collaborate with internal digital marketing, campaign fulfillment, creative, analytics, and sales support teams to develop and execute client campaigns.

Monitor campaign performance and communicate results and optimization opportunities to clients.

Maintain accurate and timely prospect, client, activity, and pipeline information within the company CRM.

Stay current on digital advertising trends, emerging technologies, products, and competitive offerings.

Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities

Hunter mentality and strong drive to identify and pursue new business opportunities.

Consultative sales approach with the ability to uncover client needs and translate business objectives into effective advertising solutions.

Strong presentation, negotiation, closing, and relationship-building skills.

Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Strong understanding of digital marketing platforms, advertising technology, and campaign performance metrics.

Ability to confidently present and communicate with business owners, executives, and other decision-makers.

Strong organizational, time-management, and territory-management skills.

Self-motivated and results-oriented, with the ability to work independently in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment.

Ability to manage multiple opportunities and priorities while maintaining consistent follow-through.

Ability to analyze campaign performance and use data to communicate value and identify opportunities for optimization.

Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.

Familiarity with CRM systems and sales analytics.

Valid driver's license and reliable transportation required.

Ability to travel as needed throughout the assigned territory and work effectively across all U.S. time zones.

Education & Experience

Minimum 3 years of recent outside sales experience required; digital advertising, media, marketing services, or B2B sales experience preferred.

Proven track record of prospecting, developing new business, and closing sales.

Demonstrated success establishing and growing a significant book of business.

Experience selling across a large geographic territory preferred.

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Advertising, Communications, Business, or a related field preferred; equivalent professional experience may be considered.

Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite required.

Experience with HubSpot or another CRM platform preferred.

Working knowledge of Google Analytics and Google Ads preferred; relevant certifications are a plus.

job.title: Business Reporter
job.description:
The Tulsa World seeks a hard-charging, multidimensional journalist to lead our business coverage. This is a key newsroom role tied to our audience growth strategy. We’re looking for a razor-sharp reporter who can produce local business news across platforms while helping shape coverage priorities and expand our reach.

Tulsa is home to major energy and aerospace companies, the nation's largest inland river port and a thriving small-business community. In 2024, Tulsa recorded $3.8 billion in exports — $1 billion more than Oklahoma City. From global corporations to locally owned businesses, Tulsa is full of untold stories about innovation, entrepreneurship, economic development and decisions about Oklahoma's future.

We’re looking for a journalist who can distill complicated topics for a broad audience, uncover stories that matter. The ideal candidate will combine exceptional reporting skills with strong news judgment, digital fluency and motivation to grow readership and subscriptions.

Position Responsibilities

Help shape the Tulsa World's business coverage by identifying stories that inform readers, hold decision-makers accountable and drive digital audience growth.

Report, research and write enterprise, investigative, breaking news, explanatory stories and Q&A’s about Tulsa's business community and Oklahoma's economy.

Develop coverage of key industries, including energy, aerospace, manufacturing, transportation and logistics, while recognizing the importance of locally owned small businesses.

Explain how business intersects with government, public policy, politics and everyday life in Oklahoma.

Collaborate with editors and reporters to establish daily and long-term coverage priorities.

Produce journalism across multiple platforms, including digital and print articles, short-form video and social media.

Identify opportunities to turn one story into several assets, including explainers, FAQs, photo galleries and video.

Build and maintain a strong network of sources, including business leaders, entrepreneurs, workers, economists, policymakers and community stakeholders.

Use audience analytics, search trends and digital engagement practices to identify opportunities to reach new readers and convert them into subscribers.

Write engaging, SEO-friendly headlines and develop creative approaches to presenting complex business stories.

Respond quickly and accurately to breaking business news while maintaining a strong pipeline of enterprise reporting.

Uphold the highest standards of journalism ethics, accuracy, fairness, independence and accountability.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

Knowledge of how business, politics, public policy and economic development intersect.

Knowledge of digital audience analytics, SEO and strategies for increasing reader engagement and subscriptions.

Skills in organizational and time management.

Skills in reporting, writing, editing and critical thinking.

Skills in strong news judgment.

Ability to produce high-impact business journalism in a fast-paced, competitive news environment.

Ability to make complicated financial, economic and policy issues accessible to a broad audience.

Ability to identify original, hyper-local stories that distinguish the Tulsa World's coverage.

Ability to produce digital-first journalism and work across multiple platforms.

Ability to balance breaking news, daily reporting and ambitious enterprise projects.

Ability to build relationships throughout Tulsa's business community.

Ability to collaborate and help the newsroom deliver a best-in-class journalism product.

Ability to communicate information clearly in writing and speaking so others will understand you

Ability to work independently and as a team under deadlines

Ability to use equipment such as cameras, recording devices and lighting to produce optimal visual media

Role is hybrid in Tulsa with at least Tuesdays in the office

Education & Experience

A bachelor’s degree in journalism or related field or equivalent related experience is preferred.

A minimum of three years of relevant reporting experience is required.

Demonstrated experience covering business, economics, public policy or related subjects is preferred.

Experience using BLOX is a bonus.

How to Apply

Please submit a resume, three published work samples and a cover letter addressed to Tulsa World Executive Editor Kristen Wright. Your cover letter should explain your approach to business journalism, your experience producing digital coverage and your vision for reaching and engaging Tulsa's business community and readers.

job.title: Business Reporter - Quad City Times
job.description:
Business Reporter — Quad-City Times

The Quad-City Times seeks a tenacious business reporter who will uncover the deals, decisions and power players shaping the local economy and chase down stories no other outlet has.

We want a reporter who builds sources, follows the money and digs into the decisions shaping the Quad-Cities economy. You should have the competitive drive to get stories first and the persistence to uncover information that businesses and public officials aren’t volunteering. This job requires someone who takes ownership of the beat and drives coverage without waiting for assignments.

The beat spans major employers, small businesses, manufacturing, development, commercial real estate, retail and the workforce on both sides of the Mississippi River. Your reporting will explain what business decisions mean for people’s jobs, neighborhoods and daily lives.

What you’ll do

Consistently pitch and pursue exclusive stories. Cultivate sources who bring you tips, spot developments early and chase promising leads with urgency and persistence.

Break news about employers, development projects, openings and closings, expansions, layoffs and changes in the local economy.

Go beyond announcements and ribbon-cuttings to examine how businesses operate, who benefits from investment and whether promises become reality.

Develop sources throughout the community, including workers, entrepreneurs, executives, developers, labor leaders, customers and neighborhood residents.

Use public records, financial filings, court documents and data to uncover stories and independently verify claims.

Scrutinize public incentives and economic development deals, tracking spending, commitments and results.

Connect regional and national economic trends to specific local consequences, making complex business issues clear and relevant.

Deliver a mix of quick-turn news, useful explainers, compelling profiles and deeper enterprise reporting.

Collaborate with editors and visual journalists to produce strong digital coverage, using audience questions and readership insights to sharpen the beat.

Uphold high standards for accuracy, fairness and independence, including when covering powerful local interests and advertisers.

What you’ll bring

Strong reporting, interviewing and writing skills, with work samples that demonstrate initiative and original reporting.

A record of finding stories beyond press releases and scheduled meetings, whether in professional, student or other journalism.

The confidence to ask difficult questions and the persistence to follow up when answers are incomplete.

An ability to understand financial information, evaluate data and explain complex subjects in plain language.

Strong news judgment and the ability to balance breaking news with longer-term reporting.

A commitment to building sources across industries, neighborhoods and levels of economic power.

Comfort with digital publishing and a willingness to develop visual and multimedia storytelling skills.

The ability to report throughout the Quad-Cities and adjust your schedule when news requires it.

Experience covering business, development, labor or local government is helpful. Knowledge of the Quad-Cities is a plus; curiosity, initiative and a drive to own the beat are essential.

How to apply

Submit a resume, a brief cover letter and three to five work samples. Explain how you uncovered at least one original story, and pitch two business stories you would pursue in the Quad-Cities.

job.title: Culture Reporter - Quad City Times
job.description:
Culture Reporter — Quad-City Times

The Quad-City Times seeks an ambitious, enterprising culture reporter who will aggressively pursue original stories and deliver coverage readers can’t find anywhere else.

We want someone who develops sources, follows tips, asks persistent questions and gets out into the community to uncover stories before they become public announcements. You should have a competitive drive to break news and the curiosity to recognize a compelling story others have missed.

This beat spans the people, places and ideas shaping culture in the Quad-Cities, from music, art and theater to food, festivals and neighborhood traditions. The expectation is to move beyond event previews and press releases to produce exclusive reporting, revealing profiles and deeply reported stories that help readers understand their community.

What you'll do

Consistently pitch and pursue original stories no other outlet has. Cultivate sources who bring you tips, spot developments early and follow promising leads with urgency and persistence.

Own and develop the culture beat, generating original ideas and building relationships with artists, performers, business owners, cultural organizations and residents.

Deliver a mix of timely news, reported features, profiles and useful guides that help readers decide where to go and what to experience.

Break news about cultural institutions, venues, restaurants and emerging trends, and follow developments beyond their initial announcement.

Explore questions of money, access, growth and change, including how cultural investment affects neighborhoods and whose stories receive attention.

Seek out communities, traditions and voices that have been overlooked in local coverage.

Collaborate with editors and visual journalists to tell stories through words, photography, video and other digital formats.

Use audience feedback and readership insights to make coverage more useful, discover new questions and build lasting reader relationships.

Maintain high standards for accuracy, fairness and independence, including when covering businesses and organizations featured in entertainment coverage.

What you’ll bring

Strong reporting, interviewing and writing skills, demonstrated through published work, student journalism or comparable experience.

The ability to balance quick-turn stories with deeper enterprise reporting and manage competing deadlines.

Curiosity about local culture and an instinct for finding the larger story behind an event or trend.

A commitment to inclusive sourcing and building trust across communities.

Comfort with digital publishing and social media, plus a willingness to develop photography and video skills.

The ability to report throughout the Quad-Cities and work occasional evenings and weekends as coverage requires.

Experience covering culture, arts, entertainment, food or community life is helpful. Knowledge of the Quad-Cities is a plus; an eagerness to learn the region is essential.

How to apply

Submit a resume, a brief cover letter and three to five work samples. Tell us how you would approach this beat and suggest two stories you would pursue.

job.title: Director of Advertising Technology and Operations
job.description:
The Director of Advertising Technology & Operations leads the IT function that supports Lee Enterprises’ advertising business. The role is accountable for the reliability and direction of advertising platforms, integrations, and technical operations spanning sales and order entry, digital fulfillment, creative and print production, billing and payments, and reporting.

The Director leads technical staff, sets priorities across daily support and change initiatives, and serves as a primary IT partner to Advertising leadership. Working with Finance, Sales Enablement, Product, Application Development, Infrastructure, Security, the PMO, and vendors, this position turns business needs into practical technology plans and provides leadership for major implementations and migrations.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

Directly supervises and develops the platform support analysts and other technical staff assigned to Advertising Operations. Sets individual and team priorities, allocates work, manages performance, plans coverage and succession, and supports staff development.

Core Responsibilities:

Own the IT strategy and operational performance of advertising order management, CRM and sales workflows, creative and production systems, digital advertising, payment processing, reporting, and related third-party platforms.

Directly lead the platform support analysts and other assigned technical staff; establish priorities, allocate capacity, develop employees, and maintain support coverage and institutional knowledge for critical systems.

Partner with Advertising and IT leadership to translate business requirements into technology roadmaps and a prioritized Jira backlog, balancing operational support, enhancements, and project delivery against available capacity.

Oversee application support, incident escalation, problem resolution, upgrades, change management, and operational readiness for revenue- and production-critical systems.

Lead the technical and operational aspects of platform implementations and migrations, including requirements, testing, cutover, stabilization, and transition or retirement of legacy systems.

Oversee integrations and data flows among order management, CRM, digital fulfillment, creative and pagination systems, billing, payments, and reporting; establish priorities for configuration, automation, and enhancements.

Ensure system changes are tested across connected workflows and validated with business users, including production checks and reconciliation where transactions affect financial records.

Partner with Finance on advertising billing, accounts receivable, payments, reconciliation, and controls at the points where advertising and financial systems meet.

Coordinate with development, architecture, infrastructure, security, and service management teams to resolve issues and align platforms with enterprise standards.

Manage advertising technology vendor relationships, including escalations, implementation commitments, service performance, technical requirements, and product direction.

Maintain operational documentation, access governance, audit support, business continuity, and disaster recovery practices for advertising systems.

Use Jira and a regular Agile planning and review cadence to track commitments, completed work, blockers, and dependencies; report delivery progress, system health, risks, and resource needs to IT leadership and business stakeholders. Coordinate timely response to critical issues, including after-hours escalation when necessary.

Preferred Skills & Experience:

Experience leading enterprise applications and technical teams in a complex, integrated operating environment.

Ability to direct work across application support, systems analysis, integrations, production technology, and software development disciplines.

Working knowledge of APIs, data exchanges, automation, vendor-hosted platforms, and the controls needed to support reliable cross-system processes.

Experience leading major implementations, migrations, upgrades, and vendor relationships while balancing ongoing support needs.

Ability to use Agile practices and Jira to manage a transparent backlog, guide planning and delivery reviews, and communicate progress and technical risks to engineers, vendors, business partners, and senior leaders.

Advertising, media, order management, CRM, digital fulfillment, payment, or production systems experience preferred; familiarity with Naviga Ad, Adbase, HubSpot, Google Ad Manager, or related platforms is an advantage.

Education & Experience:

Bachelor’s degree in information technology, computer science, business, or a related field preferred; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.

Eight or more years of progressive experience in IT, enterprise applications, business systems, or related work, including at least three years leading technical teams or major technology programs.

Experience supporting integrated systems in a multi-location or enterprise environment preferred.

job.title: Distribution Coordinator
job.description:

Must be able to lift 15 lbs.  Must pass background check and drug screen.

job.title: General Assignment Reporter-Aberdeen, SD
job.description:
General Assignment Reporter-Aberdeen, SD

The Aberdeen American News, part of Lee Enterprises, seeks a driven, digital-first general assignment reporter to cover Aberdeen, South Dakota, and contribute to statewide reporting. Breaking news and public safety will be central responsibilities, alongside coverage of local government, education and community life.

We’re looking for a resourceful journalist who can become an essential source of local news by breaking stories, asking consequential questions and explaining what developments mean for the people who live here.

This reporter will take a leading role in covering crime, courts, law enforcement, emergency response and other public safety issues. The job requires urgency when news breaks, sound judgment as events unfold and a commitment to verifying information before publishing. Building trusted sources across public safety agencies and the broader community will be essential.

Strong coverage goes beyond the initial incident. This reporter will pursue follow-up stories, examine public records and hold institutions accountable, helping readers understand the causes, consequences and community impact of public safety issues. We want reporting that treats victims, families and others affected by traumatic events with care and fairness.

The broader general assignment beat offers opportunities to explore how Aberdeen works and the people shaping its future. The ideal candidate is curious, persistent and eager to uncover both the issues everyone is discussing and those that deserve more attention, including local stories with statewide or national significance.

You should be comfortable working calmly under tight deadlines, making calls, reporting from the scene, delivering scoops and turning complex information into clear, conversational stories. This role requires balancing developing news with daily coverage and enterprise reporting, while keeping readers informed through timely, verified updates.

Digital storytelling is central to the job. We want someone who writes sharp, accurate headlines, understands search optimization and uses audience insights to identify useful coverage. You should be willing to experiment with live updates, explainers, Q&As, video and other formats that help readers understand the news.

Collaboration is equally important. This reporter will work closely with editors and colleagues, welcome feedback and participate in peer editing to strengthen our local and statewide coverage.

Responsibilities

Lead breaking news and public safety coverage, responding quickly to significant incidents and providing accurate, timely updates as stories develop.

Build and maintain sources among law enforcement, fire and emergency services, courts, local officials and community members.

Cover crime and court proceedings with accuracy, fairness and context, clearly distinguishing allegations from established facts.

Pursue public records and data to produce enterprise stories, accountability reporting and meaningful follow-ups to breaking news.

Report on local government, education, community issues and other general assignment topics.

Monitor developing news, community conversations and audience trends to identify consequential stories and emerging issues.

Produce clear, engaging coverage through articles, photography, video, newsletters, social media and alternative story formats.

Use audience metrics and search trends to inform story selection, strengthen headlines and help readers find our journalism.

Balance urgent assignments with planned coverage, managing multiple deadlines while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.

Collaborate with editors and colleagues on coverage plans, peer editing and new approaches to serving audiences, including useful evergreen content.

Requirements

A bachelor’s or master’s degree in journalism, communications or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

Strong reporting, writing and communication skills, with the ability to produce accurate, clear work under tight deadlines.

Sound news judgment and an understanding of journalism ethics, sourcing and verification.

The initiative to develop sources, ask difficult questions and pursue stories beyond official statements.

Ability to respond to breaking news and adapt coverage priorities as events unfold.

Familiarity with digital publishing, social media and search optimization; experience using social platforms to identify and report stories is a plus.

Experience with public records, public safety or courts reporting is a plus.

Ability to produce photos and video; experience creating graphics for digital and social audiences is a plus.

A collaborative approach and willingness to learn new tools and skills.

A valid driver’s license, reliable transportation and the minimum liability insurance required by state law.

Employment is contingent on passing a post-offer, pre-employment background check, motor vehicle record check and drug screen.

Why Join Us?

Lee Enterprises offers competitive wages in a dynamic, interesting work environment with career growth opportunities.  We offer an extensive benefit program that can be personalized to your needs. Our benefit program includes medical, dental, vision, short and long-term disability, company provided life insurance and supplemental life insurance. In addition, we offer a 401K retirement plan with company match.  We also offer generous paid time off to allow flexibility to balance personal life and work.  This includes paid parental leave for new parents.

Lee Enterprises is a leading provider of local news and information and a major subscription and advertising platform, with daily and weekly newspapers and rapidly expanding digital products serving 114 markets across 25 states. Our core commitment is to provide valuable, intensely local news and information to the communities we serve.

Lee Enterprises is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We respect and celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

For more information about Lee, check us out at www.lee.net.

job.title: Government/Municipal/General Assignment Reporter
job.description:
Government/Municipal/General Assignment Reporter

The Kenosha News, a division of Lee Enterprises, is looking for a full-time newspaper reporter/photographer who writes clearly, can develop relationships with sources and has an ability to take initiative. job.title: High School & College Sports Reporter-Sioux Falls, SD
job.description:
High School & College Sports Reporter-Sioux Falls, SD

The Argus Leader, part of Lee Enterprises, seeks an ambitious, enterprising reporter to cover high school and NCAA Division I college sports for our digital and print audiences in Sioux Falls and across South Dakota.

High school sports will be the foundation of this beat, and Division I college sports coverage will be a key responsibility. We’re looking for a journalist who can break news, deliver insightful analysis and tell memorable stories about the athletes, coaches and communities that make sports matter.

Our prep coverage emphasizes recruiting, distinctive features and regional and state tournament competition. The beat spans Sioux Falls and surrounding communities, including Brandon, Harrisburg and Tea, with travel across South Dakota for championships and other important events.

This reporter will also work closely with our college sports reporter to plan and produce compelling Division I coverage. Collaboration will be essential to identifying strong stories, coordinating coverage and following local athletes as they move from high school to college competition.

The ideal candidate goes beyond scores and play-by-play to explain why games were won or lost, what a program’s decisions mean and what fans should watch next. Just as important, this reporter will uncover the human stories behind the competition: the ambitions, challenges and experiences of student-athletes, coaches and families.

We want a resourceful journalist who builds trusted sources, breaks recruiting and commitment news, and becomes an essential source of sports coverage in South Dakota. You should think digital first, use audience insights to guide coverage and be comfortable producing video, photography and other content that connects with readers across platforms.

Based in South Dakota’s largest city, this position offers the opportunity to cover a vibrant sports community in a regional hub for health care, agriculture, business, dining and entertainment.

What You’ll Bring

The drive to make the Argus Leader an essential source for high school and Division I college sports coverage.

Strong news judgment and the ability to find compelling stories that serve existing readers and attract new audiences.

A competitive approach to breaking news, paired with a commitment to accuracy, fairness and context.

Curiosity about the people behind the results and an ability to turn strong reporting into engaging storytelling.

Initiative in developing sources and maintaining relationships with athletes, coaches, families and athletic programs.

A collaborative mindset and enthusiasm for contributing to statewide sports coverage.

Responsibilities

Report and produce accurate, engaging high school and Division I college sports coverage, including breaking news, enterprise stories, features, recruiting updates and analysis.

Collaborate with our college sports reporter and editors to set coverage priorities, coordinate assignments and develop stories across both beats.

Build a reliable source network to identify emerging stories and break news, including college commitments by top South Dakota recruits.

Cover key games, tournaments and championships, with travel as needed.

Use search trends, social platforms and other reporting tools to discover story ideas and understand audience interests.

Shoot and edit photos and video, and obtain appropriate permissions for contributed visual content.

Tell stories in formats suited to the audience and platform, including articles, Q&As, lists, photo galleries and video.

Use real-time audience metrics to inform coverage decisions and respond to reader interest.

Engage with audiences on social media and promote coverage effectively.

Requirements

A bachelor’s or master’s degree in journalism, communications or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

Professional journalism experience or significant internship experience.

Strong reporting, writing, communication and time-management skills.

Demonstrated ability to meet deadlines and produce clean, accurate, publication-ready work.

Ability to shoot and edit photos and video and publish quickly across digital platforms.

Proficiency with social media for reporting, source development, audience engagement and story promotion.

A sound understanding of journalism ethics, sourcing and verification.

A valid driver’s license, reliable transportation and the minimum liability insurance required by state law.

Employment is contingent on passing a post-offer, pre-employment background check, motor vehicle record check and urinalysis drug screen.

How to Apply

Show us what you can do and how you would approach this beat. Submit one PDF containing the following materials, in this order:

Your resume: One to two pages.

A cover letter: Explain how you would approach high school and Division I college sports coverage for the Argus Leader.

Links to six online work samples: Choose examples that best demonstrate your reporting, writing and multimedia skills. For collaborative work, briefly describe your contribution.

Please combine all application materials into a single PDF before uploading so we can fully review your qualifications and work.

Why Join Us?

Lee Enterprises offers competitive wages in a dynamic, interesting work environment with career growth opportunities.  We offer an extensive benefit program that can be personalized to your needs. Our benefit program includes medical, dental, vision, short and long-term disability, company provided life insurance and supplemental life insurance. In addition, we offer a 401K retirement plan with company match.  We also offer generous paid time off to allow flexibility to balance personal life and work.  This includes paid parental leave for new parents.

Lee Enterprises is a leading provider of local news and information and a major subscription and advertising platform, with daily and weekly newspapers and rapidly expanding digital products serving 114 markets across 25 states. Our core commitment is to provide valuable, intensely local news and information to the communities we serve.

Lee Enterprises is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We respect and celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

For more information about Lee, check us out at www.lee.net.

job.title: Managing Editor - Quad City Times
job.description:
Managing Editor — Quad-City Times, The Dispatch/Rock Island Argus and Muscatine Journal

The Quad-City Times, The Dispatch/Rock Island Argus and Muscatine Journal are seeking an ambitious, rigorous and entrepreneurial leader to shape the next phase of growth for our newsrooms as Managing Editor.

This person will directly oversee day-to-day news coverage across the three publications while playing a key role in developing and executing newsroom strategy.

The ideal candidate will combine uncompromising journalistic integrity with an insatiable appetite for innovation, strengthening trusted, tradition-rich news organizations while helping them thrive in a rapidly changing, multiplatform world.

Our publications have deep roots in the communities they serve and a long history of delivering essential local journalism. The successful candidate will respect that legacy while working urgently to build the future of the organization.

The Quad-Cities and Muscatine comprise a distinctive region spanning two states and connected by the Mississippi River. The area is shaped by manufacturing, agriculture, health care, higher education, arts and culture, and consequential politics in both Iowa and Illinois. Our coverage aims to capture the vibrancy and complexity of these communities across multiple platforms and in multiple formats.

What you’ll do

Guide a team of reporters covering the Quad-Cities, Muscatine, eastern Iowa and western Illinois.

Direct ambitious daily reporting, breaking-news coverage, enterprise journalism and accountability work across all three publications.

Help shape our multiplatform product lineup, including newsletters, podcasts, video, visual journalism and whatever comes next.

Embrace a “lead from the field” model by finding meaningful ways to contribute to coverage as a reporter, writer, editor and content creator.

Coordinate coverage across communities while ensuring each publication retains a strong local identity and responds to the distinct needs of its audience.

Coach journalists, set clear expectations and cultivate a collaborative newsroom culture built around urgency, accuracy, creativity and public service.

Use audience insights and sound news judgment to identify coverage priorities, strengthen engagement and grow readership.

Build and maintain relationships with key community and company stakeholders throughout the region.

What we’re looking for

A proven track record of leading high-impact news coverage in a fast-paced, competitive environment.

Strong news judgment and a commitment to accurate, independent and courageous local journalism.

An appreciation for the news, politics, business and cultural landscapes of the Quad-Cities, Muscatine, Iowa and Illinois.

The ability to lead effectively across multiple publications, communities and platforms.

A relentless desire to innovate, experiment and build new products and approaches.

A commitment to developing journalists and creating a newsroom where people can do ambitious, meaningful work.

Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with reporters, editors, audiences and other stakeholders.

Please attach your résumé, three work samples and a 500-to-750-word memo describing your vision for the role. Address the memo to Executive Editor Analisa Trofimuk and include it with your application.

job.title: North Carolina Digital Editor
job.description:
The North Carolina digital editor for Lee Enterprises leads digital content strategy and production across our eight North Carolina newsrooms, working closely with editors to expand the reach, frequency and usefulness of our journalism. This position reports to the executive editor.

Position Responsibilities

Helps newsrooms think beyond a single story by developing coverage as evolving packages that can include updates, explainers, video, visuals, newsletters, social posts and other digital formats.

Works with editors and content producers to identify opportunities to update, repackage and redistribute strong local journalism and to use approved technology and AI tools to make that work more efficient.

Key leader on our North Carolina leadership team, which is based in Winston-Salem and consists of the North Carolina editor and Triad leadership, including sports, to strengthen coverage planning, drive strategy, improve collaboration among newsrooms and develop new approaches to reaching and retaining readers.

Helps test and implement new digital storytelling and audience strategies, uses performance data to inform decisions and provides training and coaching to editors and reporters across the state.

Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities

Strong ethical compass, news judgment, quick decision-making, robust work ethic, and willingness to collaborate.

Understands how to drive digital audiences to content and how to keep subscribers engaged.

The ability to work with staff in Winston-Salem and Greensboro, as well as our community newsrooms in Hickory, Statesville, Morganton, Marion, Mooresville and Concord, both in person and remotely.

Education & Experience

Experience building an online audience for a daily newspaper, either as a content producer, an editor or both.

Bachelor’s degree combined with newsroom experience.

We use Blox as our content management system, AI for brainstorming, reframing existing content and tweaking headlines, and Grammarly to assist with editing. A familiarity with these is a plus, as is hands-on experience with social media platforms including Facebook, Instagram and X.

job.title: Advertising Sales Executive
job.description:
Job Type Full-time Description

 

Advertising Sales Executive


We don’t just broadcast messages. Radio has the power to make people listen- and, more importantly, act. 


At Midwest Communications, we’re not simply in the business of selling commercials. We help local businesses get noticed, solve marketing challenges, connect with the right customers, and turn great ideas into results.

As an Advertising Sales Executive, you’ll become a trusted marketing partner for businesses in your community. You’ll learn what a client is trying to accomplish, identify opportunities, and build marketing strategies using radio, digital, social media, promotions, and more.

What You’ll Do:

  • Help local businesses become stronger and more successful - understand what they’re trying to accomplish and find ways to help them by using marketing strategies across radio, digital, social media, and promotions.
  • Create new opportunities for growth- conduct needs assessments and build relationships with businesses that could benefit from what Midwest Communications has to offer.
  • Build a presence by attending client meetings, networking events, and community functions. 
  • Turn marketing strategies into results- help clients connect with customers, increase awareness, drive traffic, generate leads, and grow their business.
  • Create your own success story- develop new business, grow existing partnerships, and build a book of clients you’re proud to represent.
  • Stay ahead of the market by tracking the latest trends, competitor offerings, and best industry practices. 

What We Offer:

  • A full-time position with an established and successful business.
  • Competitive pay with commission and benefits ($45,000-$60,000 based on experience). Start with a guaranteed draw while you build your business and client relationships, with additional earning potential through commission. 
    • Paid time off/holidays, health/dental/vision insurance, 401(k), flexible spending accounts, life insurance, and disability coverage. 
  • Professional development and sales training.
  • Performance based incentives/bonuses.
  • Opportunities to grow within Midwest Communications, Inc.

We’re Looking for Someone Who...

  • Has a bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, business, or a related field—or equivalent experience.
  • Has previous sales experience; advertising or media experience is a plus.
  • Understands sales activity, forecasting, and CRM software.
  • Is a strong communicator, negotiator, presenter, and problem-solver. 
  • Has a valid Wisconsin driver’s license, reliable transportation, and can pass a background check. 
  • Is self-motivated, goal-oriented, and capable of working independently.

The Midwest Communications, Inc Culture

At Midwest Communications, we’re invested in the longevity and success of our sales teams. You’ll join an established team of professional sales consultants who know how to build relationships, uncover opportunities, and create solutions that make an impact. You will also work alongside talented programming, promotions, digital, and production teams to create campaigns. 

As a privately owned, family-founded business, we expect our team members to take ownership of their work while also maintaining a laid-back, collaborative atmosphere. You’ll have the tools, resources, and support of an established media company but the autonomy to build relationships, develop your business, and make your mark in the local market.


Are you ready to make your mark in the radio industry? We’d love to hear from you.

job.description:

Position Summary

The Game Production Supervisor, Local Media, is responsible for coordinating and overseeing the planning and execution of live NBA game broadcasts and related programming across assigned Local Media productions. Reporting to the Game Production Lead, this role translates overall production strategy and editorial direction into consistent, high-quality game broadcasts, providing day-to-day production leadership from pre-production through live event execution and post-production review. Working closely with internal production teams, team and local broadcast partners, Studio Teams, Event Teams, Production Technology, Broadcast Engineering & Operations, Graphics, Programming, Distribution, Content Planning, and third-party vendors, the Game Production Supervisor ensures assigned productions meet established creative, editorial, technical, operational, and financial expectations. This role serves as a leader for assigned games and markets, with primary responsibility for editorial execution, production quality, budget and schedule oversight, and effective coordination among internal and external partners, while escalating broader strategic, stakeholder, or resource decisions to the Game Production Lead as appropriate.

Major Responsibilities

Oversee assigned live NBA game broadcasts and related programming from pre-production through live event execution and post-production, ensuring productions meet established creative, editorial, technical, and operational standards. Execute production strategy and editorial priorities established by the Game Production Lead and Local Media leadership, translating direction into actionable game plans, rundowns, schedules, staffing needs, and production workflows. Provide editorial leadership for assigned productions, coordinating storylines, content priorities, talent needs, graphics, replay, sponsored elements, and other game presentation components with internal and external production teams. Lead day-to-day communication with studio teams and other production partners regarding content and talent availability, daily schedules, production requirements, and special requests. Manage production quality, schedules, and budget performance for assigned remote and centralized productions; identify variances, risks, and resource needs and escalate material issues to the Game Production Lead. Lead pre-production meetings, production rehearsals, game-day coordination, post-game reviews, and operational debriefs for assigned productions to drive continuous improvement and consistency. Identify opportunities to improve production workflows, editorial execution, operational efficiency, and broadcast quality across Local Media productions, and partner with the Game Production Lead on longer-term enhancements. job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

The NBCU Account Director, Performance & Growth will focus exclusively on driving demand for performance brands across our suite of linear and digital products including all streaming products, with a focus on driving new and incremental revenue for the full NBCU portfolio (One Platform). This individual will play a critical role within our fast-paced advertising sales team, managing relationships across external clients and independent media agencies. The role requires building relationships with key internal stakeholders and collaborative partners across the NBCU organization. Expertise within the performance and digital landscape is a must. This person must have the ability to operate effectively at the cross-section of performance and digital media as these skills are critical to achieving success in this role. This role will report directly into to the Vice President, Performance & Growth. 

  • Drive linear and digital advertising demand of the NBCU Platform for specific performance brands and agencies in the direct-to-consumer category

The Analyst HR Operations Security & Applications is responsible for assisting the HR Operations team with supporting and enhancing HR processes and systems for all employees. This position is part of a broader team in HR Operations that is responsible for all aspects of supporting, maintaining and optimizing the systems utilized by our HR community and partners. This role is crucial in supporting the functional security administration of all HR applications globally. The Analyst serves as a point-of-contact for assigned functional areas and assists subject matter experts with ensuring data integrity, maintaining proper system access, testing role changes, developing security reports and analyzing existing processes for improvement opportunities. This position will report to the Senior Manager, HR Operations Security & Applications

Here you can:

  • Functional Security
    • Administer the processing of system access requests for all users of HR applications, ensuring timely and accurate provisioning and deprovisioning of system access.
    • Troubleshoot and research system and security access-related issues reported by users, providing timely resolution and support to maintain uninterrupted system functionality.
    • Conduct quarterly security audits and user access reviews to assess compliance with data security policies, procedures, and SOX requirements.
    • Gather and documents requirements for new security access requests and partners with the IT security team on the creation and testing of new security roles.
    • Partner with stakeholders on existing security role modifications and enhancements from impact assessment, testing to implementation.
    • Develop and maintain a variety of security audit reports or queries utilizing applicable reporting tools.
    • Provide functional security support for annual/recurring HR processes such as Performance Management, Compensation, COI, and Executive Reorgs.
    • Maintain security related configuration and end user authorizations.
  • Applications
    • Collaborate with stakeholders and cross-functional teams to gather, analyze, and document requirements for new applications or enhancements to existing applications.
    • Drive new application releases and prioritizes the scope of key features aimed at enhancing the user experience for HR.
    • Serve as primary point of contact for HR and IT teams on application related matters, providing updates, gathering feedback and addressing concerns.
    • Translate business requirements into functional design documents for technical teams
    • Provide support and training to end users to ensure successful adoption and utilization of new application features.
    • Develop and maintains end user guidelines and documentation.
  • Projects/Process Improvements
    • Participate in system implementation projects from a functional security perspective, end-to-end through requirements, design, build, test, and implementation phases.
    • Recommend and/or supports process improvements and program changes.
    • Supports HR projects aimed at improving HR processes and systems, including but not limited to large-scale deployments.
    • Use project management skills in managing security workstream activities for the duration of project.
    • Other duties and responsibilities will be assigned as needed.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, HR, Technology or equivalent relevant work experience

Fully Remote: This position has been designated as fully remote, meaning that the position is expected to contribute from a non-NBCUniversal worksite, most commonly an employee’s residence.

job.title: Animation Production Intern, DreamWorks Animation, Spring 2027
job.description:
DreamWorks Animation is looking for more adventurous dreamers who shoot for the moon. We tell stories about the journeys our unconventional heroes take to make dreams come true. As a growth-minded studio, we pride ourselves on being one of the world’s leading producers of high-quality, award-winning, animated films and series, reaching consumers around the globe. We push to feel more, laugh more, and build immersive new worlds.

DreamWorks creates a diverse array of original content in a variety of formats, delivering compelling stories with unique characters. We place tremendous value on the experiences our talent brings to the table from their own non-traditional paths to success. We believe in frequent communication and that transparency and trust yield the best work. We are a community of artists, technologists, innovators, and creators, who are passionate about animation and also happen to love eating lunch together.

In the DreamWorks Internship Program, interns work in an engaging and exciting environment alongside creative leaders and artists who are committed to building an inclusive and collaborative culture. Interns are immersed into feature and TV productions while gaining hands-on experience at our studio. Open to students and recent grads, we love those who are driven and hungry to learn, are curious and resourceful, and most importantly, are passionate about animation.

The Internship Program also showcases best-in-class opportunities by offering executive speaker series, professional/career development workshops, artistic classes, community outreach opportunities, movie screenings, and much more!

If you are part of the fandom and believe teamwork makes the dream work, join us in #livingthedream and #doingyourdreamwork! 

Spring 2027 Animation Production Internship: 

  • Applications close: October 19, 2026 at 11:59pm PT

  • Program Dates: January 25 - April 1, 2027

  • Time Commitment: Part-Time (24 hours per week required)

  • Format: In Person (Tuesday - Thursday)

Responsibilities: "What would you say you do here?”

A Production Intern will be assigned to either a feature film or TV production and gain insight into production responsibilities, workflows and processes. Additionally, they will be able to observe and learn about the animation pipeline and creative process. 

Production Interns handle various production activities under the direction of their Production Manager. Interns will help to take on new challenges in efforts to gain a more detailed knowledge of the animation industry, animated television or feature pipeline and workflows. 

Interns must have strong written and verbal communication skills, are self-motivated, are outstanding teammates who take initiative, have the ability to prioritize multiple requests, have a strong attention to detail and organizational skills. 

Basic Qualifications: “What do I need to have in order to do this job?”

  • Knowledge of office management software (Excel, Word, Gmail, etc.) is vital

  • Candidates should be well organized, highly self-motivated individuals who function well in fast-paced, frenetic production based environments

  • Must be confident and proactive with excellent communication skills (written, verbal and interpersonal)

  • Must feel comfortable interacting with employees at all levels of the organization

  • Pursuing an Associate, Bachelor or Graduate degree at a College/University (or equivalent), or be a recent graduate (within six months of graduation date)

  • Must be 18 years of age or older

  • Must be willing to work in Glendale, California

  • Ability to provide own relocation, housing and transportation

  • Authorized to work in the United States without visa sponsorship

Desired Characteristics: “What can I offer?” 

  • Film/TV, Animation/Illustration, Media Studies or related majors preferred.

  • Proven understanding of FlowPro (formerly Shotgrid) is a plus

Hourly Rate:  $18.47

Hybrid: This position has been designated as hybrid, which currently requires contributing from the office a minimum of three days per week. Beginning January 5, 2026, hybrid employees will be required to work from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time.

job.title: Associate Art Director - Characters | Directeur.trice Artistique Associé.e – Personnages
job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

NBCUniversal est l’une des principales entreprises mondiales de médias et de divertissement. Nous créons du contenu de calibre mondial, que nous distribuons à travers notre portefeuille de cinéma, de télévision et de diffusion en continu, et que nous faisons vivre par le biais de nos destinations de parcs thématiques mondiaux, de nos produits de consommation et de nos expériences. Nous détenons et exploitons des marques de divertissement et d’information de premier plan, notamment NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo et Peacock, notre service de diffusion en continu haut de gamme financé par la publicité. Nous produisons et distribuons des œuvres cinématographiques et des contenus télévisuels de premier plan grâce à nos puissants studios de cinéma et de télévision, notamment Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation et Focus Features, ainsi qu’aux quatre studios de télévision mondiaux regroupés sous la bannière Universal Studio Group. Nous exploitons également des parcs thématiques et des expériences de calibre industriel à travers le monde par l’entremise de Universal Destinations & Experiences, notamment Universal Orlando Resort, domicile de Universal Epic Universe, et Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal est une filiale de Comcast Corporation. Visitez https://www.nbcuniversal.com pour plus d’information.  

Notre impact repose sur l’amélioration des communautés dans lesquelles nos employé·e·s, nos client·e·s et nos publics vivent et travaillent. Nous avons une riche tradition d’engagement communautaire et veillons à ce que nos employé·e·s aient l’occasion de servir leurs communautés. Nous défendons une culture inclusive et nous efforçons d’attirer et de développer une main-d’œuvre talentueuse afin de créer et de diffuser une vaste gamme de contenus reflétant la diversité de notre monde.

Role Summary

NBCUniversal is seeking an experienced Associate Art Director – Characters to lead, define and drive the visual direction and consistency of characters for an ambitious new interactive entertainment experience. This role is responsible for ensuring that the full character ecosystem—including hero characters and large-scale population systems—achieves a high level of quality, cohesion, and scalability. 

Reporting to the Art Director, the Associate Art Director – Characters will work closely with Character Art Leads, Technical Art, and cross-disciplinary teams to ensure alignment across pipelines, systems, and production goals. The role involves leading and managing Character Art Leads while providing high-level direction, establishing standards, and maintaining consistency across internal teams and external partners. 

Responsibilities

  • Define and communicate the visual direction for characters across the full project. 
  • Ensure consistency and quality across the full character ecosystem (hero characters and crowd systems). 
  • Lead and manage Character Art Leads and Review Artists, providing mentoring, direction, feedback, and alignment. 
  • Review assets and validate quality to ensure alignment with artistic and technical standards. 
  • Drive cross-discipline collaboration with Animation, Design, Tech Art, and Lighting teams. 
  • Ensure alignment between art direction, production constraints, and scalable pipelines. 
  • Maintain visual consistency across internal production and external partners. 
  • Identify risks and guide teams to deliver quality at scale across large production environments. 

Résumé du poste 

NBCUniversal est à la recherche d’une personne expérimentée au poste de directeur(trice) artistique associé(e) – Personnages afin de diriger, définir et faire évoluer l’orientation visuelle ainsi que la cohérence des personnages pour une nouvelle expérience ambitieuse de divertissement interactif. Ce rôle est responsable d’assurer un haut niveau de qualité, de cohérence et de scalabilité pour l’ensemble de l’écosystème de personnages, incluant les personnages principaux et les systèmes de population à grande échelle. 

Sous la direction de la Directrice Artistique, le·la Directeur.trice Artistique Associé.e – Personnages collaborera étroitement avec les Leads Character Art, les équipes d’artistes techniques et les équipes transverses afin d’assurer l’alignement entre pipelines, systèmes et objectifs de production. Le rôle inclut la gestion des Leads Character ainsi que la définition de standards, la direction artistique globale et la cohérence entre équipes internes et partenaires externes. 

Responsabilités 

  • Définir et communiquer la direction visuelle des personnages à l’échelle du projet. 
  • Assurer la cohérence et la qualité pour l’ensemble de l’écosystème (personnages principaux et systèmes de foule). 
  • Encadrer et manager les Leads Character Art, et les Artists de review, en assurant mentorat, direction, feedback et alignement. 
  • Réviser les assets et valider la qualité afin de respecter les standards artistiques et techniques. 
  • Piloter la collaboration transversale avec les équipes Animation, Design, Artistes Techniques et Éclairage. 
  • Assurer l’alignement entre direction artistique, contraintes de production et pipelines scalables. 
  • Maintenir la cohérence visuelle entre production interne et partenaires externes. 
  • Identifier les risques et guider les équipes pour livrer à grande échelle avec un haut niveau de qualité. 

 

Basic Qualifications 

  • Extensive experience (10+ yrs) in AAA game development with a focus on character art. 
  • Proven experience leading multiple teams or disciplines on published AAA title. 
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating high-quality character work and artistic direction. 
  • Strong understanding of modular character pipelines and real-time production workflows. 
  • Experience working with large-scale character systems including crowd or customization pipelines. 
  • Strong experience with real-time engines. Unreal Engine 5 and Metahuman experience is a plus. 
  • Solid comprehension of technical constraints allowing scalability on multiple platforms, from high-end to mobile. 
  • Ability to translate artistic vision into clear direction for teams. 
  • Excellent leadership, communication, and collaboration skills. 

Desired Characteristics 

  • Experience defining artistic vision and ability to maintain a scalable and cohesive character style identity on large-scale and open-world productions. 
  • Strong understanding of scalable character systems and production constraints. 
  • Experience working with outsourcing partners and distributed teams. 
  • Strategic mindset with strong prioritization and alignment skills. 
  • Strong sensitivity to realism, diversity, and character representation. 
  • Deep understanding of the gaming industry, current trends and player preferences. 
  • Excellent communication and natural practice of positive leadership skills and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment. 
  • Passion for storytelling through character design. 
  • Desire to think and explore innovative solutions. 

Eligibility Requirements 

  • Interested candidates must apply to be considered. 
  • Must be willing to work in our Montreal office a minimum of 4 days a week. 
  • Must be legally authorized to work in Canada. 
  • Must be willing to travel for work related business, if necessary 

Qualifications de base 

  • Expérience significative (+10 ans) en développement de jeux AAA avec un focus sur les personnages. 
  • Expérience avérée en gestion de plusieurs équipes ou disciplines sur une production AAA publiee. 
  • Portfolio solide démontrant une forte qualité en personnages et direction artistique. 
  • Bonne compréhension des pipelines de personnages et des workflows temps réel. 
  • Expérience avec les systèmes de personnages modulaires à grande échelle incluant foules ou systèmes de personnalisation. 
  • Expérience solide avec des moteurs temps reels. Expérience avec Unreal Engine 5 et Metahumain est un plus 
  • Solide compréhension des contraintes techniques permettant la scalabilité sur différentes plateformes de hautes qualités ainsi que sur mobile. 
  • Capacité à traduire une vision artistique en direction claire pour les équipes. 
  • Excellentes compétences en leadership, communication et collaboration. 

Atouts souhaités 

  • Expérience dans la définition d’une vision artistique et habilite a mainenir une identite visuelle coherente au travers d’une productions à grande échelle et monde ouvert. 
  • Bonne compréhension des systèmes de personnages scalables et des contraintes de production. 
  • Expérience avec partenaires externes et équipes distribuées. 
  • Vision stratégique et forte capacité de priorisation et d’alignement. 
  • Sensibilité au réalisme, à la diversité et à la représentation. 
  • Profonde compréhension de l’industrie du jeu vidéo, des modes actuelles et des gouts des joueurs. 
  • Excellente capacite de communication et pratique naturelle du leadership positif, ainsi qu’une facilite à s’épanouir dans un environnement dynamique. 
  • Passion pour la narration au travers des designs de personnages. 
  • Desir reel de penser et d’explorer des solutions innovantes. 

Exigences d’admissibilité 

  • Les personnes intéressées doivent soumettre leur candidature afin d’être considérées.  
  • Doit être disposé·e à travailler dans nos bureaux de Montréal au minimum quatre (4) jours par semaine.  
  • Doit être légalement autorisé·e à travailler au Canada. 
  • • Doit être disposé·e à se déplacer pour des raisons professionnelles, au besoin.

job.title: Associate Editor, Social, NBC News Digital
job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

NBC News is looking for an Associate Editor, Social to bring our journalism to life across social platforms. You’ll work with reporters, editors, designers and others at NBC News to turn breaking news and original reporting into thoughtful, engaging social journalism — from a strong headline or visual treatment to a full platform-specific rollout. You’ll also be responsible for the day-to-day distribution of NBC News stories across Facebook, X, Threads, Bluesky, LinkedIn, Reddit and Instagram, making sure our journalism reaches audiences wherever they are. 

This is a hands-on role for someone who follows the news closely and understands what makes people stop scrolling and engage, and you’ll have a desire to experiment with how NBC News’ journalism can connect with different audiences on social platforms. You’ll work across a wide range of stories and formats and social storytelling, audience engagement and distribution strategies. 

The role is best suited for a creative thinker who has a deep understanding of the native languages of various social media platforms. You should also have some experience in graphic design and light video editing. 

The position can be based in New York or Los Angeles and is five days a week, Monday-Friday, starting at 1pm ET. You will report to the Senior Editor, Social. 

This position is represented by the News Guild – NY CWA. 

Responsibilities:

  • Distribute original reporting and breaking news on NBC News’ social accounts
  • Work with the art, photo and data graphics teams to create bespoke social graphics
  • Write accurate and compelling headlines and social copy
  • Work with the social video teams to distribute original video content
  • Select strong visuals for story promotion and live event coverage
  • Identify zeitgeisty stories and shareable moments on social media and surface them to the news teams
  • Repackage content for distribution on different social platforms
  • Track audience behavior to help inform promotion and overall strategy
  • Occasionally help curate NBCNews.com homepage and app owned platforms
  • At least 1 year of experience working in social media
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent and comparable work experience
  • Excellent writing skills, solid news judgment and a creative eye
  • Experience creating shareable content
  • Basic knowledge of graphic design
  • Experience using newsroom tools such as TrueAnthem or Social Flow and Chartbeat or Parse.ly
  • The position can be located in New York, NY or Los Angeles, CA

Desired skills:

  • Basic knowledge of Premiere Pro and video editing

Additional Requirements:

  • Hybrid: This position has been designated as hybrid, generally contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The company reserves the right to change the in office requirement at any time.

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website.

Salary range: $75,000 - $80,000

NBCUniversal's policy is to provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, gender identity or expression, age, national origin or ancestry, citizenship, disability, sexual orientation, marital status, pregnancy, veteran status, membership in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

job.description:

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. The Media Operations, Operations & Technology group is responsible for prepping content needed for domestic and international distribution as well as broadcast operations. This includes transcode, edit and delivery services to meet client fulfilment around the globe 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. Aside from supporting the day-to-day content supply, this position becomes integral to the success of high-profile LRP and strategic goals. We also support marketing supply chains as well as network stunts and events, which have included the Olympics, FIFA World Cup, and the Superbowl in the past.

The Content Solutions Specialist is responsible for strategy, administration, workflow design & solutions, integrations, and day-to-day operational builds. This role sits at the intersection of business stakeholders, clients, product, engineering, and operations; translating requirements into scalable content supply chain workflows and DAM/MAM solutions that support fast turnaround projects and LRP goals. This role designs and implements automations that support the full media asset lifecycle—from ingest through metadata enrichment & translations, QC, versioning, transcoding, delivery, and archival. 

The ideal candidate is deeply technical, operationally minded, and comfortable both gathering requirements from non-technical partners, and working closely with product and engineering to bring short term and long term workflow designs into the larger supply chain.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Design, build, and support end-to-end DAM/MAM supply chain workflows covering: 
    • Asset ingest (file- and API-based) 
    • Metadata validation, normalization, transformation and enrichment 
    • Automated QC and review workflows 
    • Transcoding and proxy generation 
    • Versioning, derivatives, packaging, and delivery 
  • Design and support API-based integrations between internal and third-party tooling and clients, for both upstream/downstream systems (e.g., MAMs, encoders, delivery platforms, analytics, metadata stores). 
  • Partner with Engineering on REST APIs, MCP integrations, webhooks, JSON/XML schemas/contracts, event-driven patterns, and authentication models. 
  • Build and maintain integration workflows using low-code (Java, YAML, Python, etc.) and automation platforms (e.g., Qibb, Power Automate/Logic Apps, ETLworks, AirTable) to orchestrate cross-system handoffs, automate operational processes and reduce manual touchpoints.
  • Build and support ETL metadata architecture, schemas and workflows supporting content ingestion, transformation, validation, enrichment, and fulfillment.
  • Support and integrate supplementary CSC/Marketing Supply chain systems including AI Video & Image Technologies, Orange Logic DAM, Telestream Vantage Encoding, AWS EMC, Fabric Metadata, and other marketing, metadata, analytics, and discovery tools that intersect with the media content lifecycle.
  • Design and build agentic AI/ML‑enabled workflows using Microsoft Copilot Studio (or equivalent), creating agents that streamline operational pain points, enable self‑service, orchestrate multi‑step workflows, and improve team productivity.
  • Create productivity and support solutions using our tools to enhance BAU & Projects.
  • Advise and maintain vendor engagement, including feature requests, issue escalation, release validation, and platform upgrade risk/benefits. 

Qualifications

Requirements: 

  • 2+ years of experience in full‑stack development using low‑code platforms to build scalable workflow solutions, leveraging Java, Python, or YAML for customization and integration.
  • 3+ years of experience in an operational, product, support or customer facing position for a media or technology company.
  • 3+ years experience in a role demonstrating strong technical, quantitative, or analytical skills
  • 3+ years experience in a role exhibiting excellent written and oral communications, effective interpersonal skills, project management, and presentation abilities

 

Desired Characteristics:

  • Significant experience working with all stages of the editorial data life cycle – from acquisition to input to organization and structuring within dynamic databases, with flexible and various reporting needs, both ‘living’ and ‘static’, including expertise in troubleshooting and streamlining outputs and driving tangible insights.
