job.title: Director, Media Experimentation & Engagement
job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

The Director, Media Experimentation & Engagement leads NBCU’s incrementality and engagement measurement program for Performance and Device media. Experimentation is the causal calibration source for Growth Media Analytics’ measurement triangle: the function that keeps Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM) and Multi-Touch Attribution (MTA) decision-grade. You own the learning agenda, set the standard for rigor, and translate test results into clear budget guidance leaders can act on with speed and confidence. You define how NBCU measures media’s effect on subscriber value and engagement, a critical causal measurement practice for the business. You manage a team to high-quality execution and train the next set of analytic leaders, and you are the face of Growth Media Analytics to Performance Media, Device Media, Growth Strategy, and Decision Sciences leadership on experimentation methodology. 

Key Responsibilities 

  • Own and scale the experimentation roadmap. Grow structured testing from roughly 15 to 75 panels per year while raising rigor on budget-grade decisions. Define the learning agenda, decision questions, hypotheses, success metrics, guardrails, and power thresholds, and approve or reject vendor designs against those standards. 
  • Define and lead engagement measurement. Build NBCU’s forward approach to measuring media’s effect on subscriber engagement and retention, in partnership with Growth Strategy and Decision Sciences. This includes variance reduction techniques for low-signal continuous outcomes, and the translation from measured lift to revenue and retention value. 
  • Own always-on holdouts. Lead holdout design and execution across Performance and Device media, including persistent engagement holdouts. 
  • Collaborate with Media Partners. Direct how NBCU uses conversion-lift (CLS) programs and clean room environments (Meta Advanced Analytics, Google ADH, Amazon AMC) for exposure mapping and lift measurement and set the standard for what partners can and cannot answer. 
  • Own measurement calibration. Serve as the source of truth for calibrating MMM and MTA, keeping media measurement consistent and decision-grade across the portfolio. 
  • Lead experimentation vendor relationships. Manage relationships across incrementality vendors, including new vendor onboarding, data transfer, validating methodology and result, and ensuring critical deliverables are shared to the business.  
  • Represent the team at the executive level. Own measurement-methodology relationships with Performance Media and Device Media leadership, Growth Strategy, Finance, and Decision Sciences. Challenge entrenched measurement beliefs and drive adoption of decision-grade testing. 
  • Build and develop the pod. Directly manage and develop a Manager and an Analyst, and uplevel cross-functional partner teams on test design, statistical power, and common pitfalls. 
  • Drive AI-enabled scale. Use agentic AI and automated analytics workflows to expand testing throughput, insight generation, and decisioning. 
  • 8+ years of relevant experience in media measurement and analytics, including experience at measurement vendors or agencies, and including direct people management and a track record of building and developing teams
  • 5+ years expertise in experimentation design and causal inference for media (structured testing, geo experiments, difference-in-differences, platform holdouts), with the ability to evaluate vendor assumptions and methods.
  • Strong foundation across the measurement triangle of MMM, MTA, and experimentation, with proven ability to reconcile and calibrate across them and translate results into business decisions.
  • Fluent in SQL and Excel, and proficient in at least one of R or Python for data analysis.

Desired Characteristics

  • Demonstrated experience presenting insights to executive audiences, with ability to create process/governance and ability to answer difficult questions in high pressure situations.
  • 2+ years of experience partnering with (or working at) incrementality measurement vendors (e.g., Haus, Measured, or similar) and managing media, agency, and vendor relationships.
  • Platform experience across Google, Meta, and TikTok incrementality, and at least one CTV or Device environment (e.g., Roku, Samsung, Vizio).
  • Working knowledge of clean room environments, with a clear point of view on where they produce decision-grade evidence and where they do not.
  • Demonstrated ability to measure and optimize multiple KPIs, including acquisition, engagement, and performance outcomes.
  • Experience leveraging, or strong interest in adopting, agentic AI and automated analytics workflows to scale experimentation and decisioning.
  • Excellent communication skills and executive presence, with the ability to influence in a highly matrixed environment.
  • Strong interest in the media industry, specifically television and streaming.
  • Strong sense of accountability, curiosity, and an innovative mindset, with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

Additional Requirements

  • Hybrid: This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time. 
  • This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website. Salary range: $135,000 - $180,000 (bonus and long-term incentive eligible). 
     

As part of our selection process, external candidates may be required to attend an in-person interview with an NBCUniversal employee at one of our locations prior to a hiring decision. NBCUniversal's policy is to provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, gender identity or expression, age, national origin or ancestry, citizenship, disability, sexual orientation, marital status, pregnancy, veteran status, membership in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. Role Purpose

The Director will lead the development and execution of on-platform promo strategy for Peacock content, with a focus on driving audience engagement, optimizing the viewer journey, and maximizing impact of owned media across the platform. The Director is responsible for translating programming priorities into strategic, data-driven media plans for all Peacock Originals. 

This role owns how promo is surfaced on Peacock, defining placement, prioritization, and exposure across the full user journey to maximize the impact of owned media.

Critical to this role is the ability to manage the trafficking system that delivers campaigns, ensuring the media plans are accurately reflecting the expected user experience.

The Director leads and develops a team responsible for campaign planning, trafficking, and ongoing optimization, ensuring flawless execution in a fast-faced environment.

Sitting at the intersection of content marketing, platform usage, and audience strategy, this role connects media planning and performance insights into a cohesive executional framework applied across all Peacock content.

Responsibilities

  • Own media planning for Peacock content (Originals, P1 films, Next-Day content, acquired series) translating content priorities into deliverables against audience needs and strategic placements.
  • Oversee end-to-end campaign execution, ensuring alignment from campaign planning, to trafficking, to platform delivery.
  • Translate audience journey strategies into specific promo tactics by managing content exposure across discovery, engagement, and retention stages.
  • Ensure promos trafficked in FreeWheel are scheduled accurately and create operational efficiency by working closely with Ad Ops.
  • Execute Next-Day content priorities for NBC, Bravo and Sports. Ensure goals are met and adjust based on performances.
  • Lead campaign optimization using performance data to adjust promo weight, placement strategy, and engagement tactics.
  • Partner with analytics team to evaluate engagement trends, content performance and conversion effectiveness.
  • Manage and develop a team responsible for campaign planning, trafficking, and optimization, driving speed, precision, and accountability.  

Basic Requirements 

  • 6+ years in the entertainment media planning space, preferably in streaming
  • Demonstrated experience owning campaign execution from planning through trafficking and delivery
  • Hands-on experience with campaign trafficking systems (e.g. FreeWheel or similar platforms)
  • Strong understanding of streaming platforms, content surfacing, and audience engagement metrics
  • Experience managing high-volume campaign execution and fast-paced planning cycles
  • Strong understanding of media metrics (Nielsen, AMRLD data) to translate data into action
  • Comfortable with 3rd party measurement and the rigor associated
  • Ability to work on ad hoc projects and on weekends with short notice

Desired Characteristics 

  • Outstanding attention to detail, organizational skills & communication skills
  • Highly analytical, able to translate data into immediate optimization action
  • Deep understanding of audience lifecycle and user behaviors across streaming platforms
  • Ability to operate in fast-paced, daily optimization environments
  • Excellent in cross-functional collaboration
  • Comfortable making clear, fast decisions under pressure
  • Passionate about the entertainment industry and content

job.title: DreamWorks Technology - Principal Engineer, AI
job.description:
DreamWorks Animation is looking for more adventurous dreamers who shoot for the moon. We tell stories about the journeys our unconventional heroes take to make dreams come true. As a growth-minded studio, we pride ourselves on being one of the world's leading producers of high-quality, award-winning, animated films and series, reaching consumers around the globe. We push to feel more, laugh more, and build immersive new worlds.

DreamWorks creates a diverse array of original content in a variety of formats, delivering compelling stories with unique characters. We place tremendous value on the experiences our talent brings to the table from their own non-traditional paths to success. We believe in frequent communication and that transparency and trust yield the best work. We are a community of artists, technologists, innovators, and creators, who are passionate about animation and also happen to love eating lunch together. 

DreamWorks is seeking a highly collaborative AI Architect who will be a hands-on technical leader assistive across multiple teams aimed to provide results to both technical and creative departments. This role involves identifying, designing, and delivering AI-powered agentic architecture that eliminates the repetitive, manual, low-creativity tasks that pull artists and production management away from their craft, while maintaining high operational availability to ensure production systems run reliably. An ideal candidate should be an adventurous, growth-minded problem solver who thrives in collaborative environments, values transparency and trust, and possesses a deep passion for leveraging technology to empower artists and storytellers. 

If you are part of the fandom and believe teamwork makes the dream work, join us in #livingthedream and #doingyourdreamwork!

“What would you say you do here?”

  • Collaborate and advise on next-generation AI-assisted agentic workflows strategy alongside product owners, developers and creatives. 
  • Design and own the architecture for AI-powered frameworks and automation across the entire Studio pipeline and platforms.
  • Define the end-to-end architecture for ingestion, processing, and routing of operational telemetry (metrics, logs, traces).
  • Integrate solutions with popular industry DCC tools.
  • Prototype solutions for high-friction tasks: asset tagging, scene prep, render queue management, shot setup, and versioning.
  • Define technical standards and integration patterns for AI tooling across departments and shows.
  • Evaluate and select AI frameworks, foundation models, and automation technologies for creative production and operational stability.
  • Build and maintain a library of reusable AI components and automation patterns.
  • Partner with platform, systems and security teams to monitor model drift, system latency, and system security.
  • Write, test, and deploy production-ready tools that run reliably inside active show pipelines.
  • Develop reference implementations that set the canonical pattern for future pipeline AI work.
  • Partner with engineers and TDs to fold automation into existing artist-facing toolsets.
  • Maintain and iterate on deployed tools based on artist feedback and production data.
  • Drive adoption across both technical and creative departments so tools are understood, trusted, and used.
  • Create lightweight training and documentation for artists and engineers.
  • Establish metrics for automation impact and report results to studio leadership on a regular cadence.
  • Champion a culture of continuous improvement and surface new automation opportunities as workflows evolve.

“What do I need to have in order to do this job?”

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • 10+ years building production systems, with 2+ years building AI/ML systems for real workflows.
  • Hands-on experience deploying enterprise software in AI, data, or integration environments.
  • Expertise with containerization, orchestration, Python, TypeScript, React, and AI frameworks such as LangGraph, Spring AI and MCP.
  • Deep understanding of LLM model integration and tuning.
  • Experience with designing automation that reduces manual work in complex, multi-stakeholder environments.
  • Proven ability to influence senior engineers without authority and to be the person others learn from.
  • History of building and supporting durable artifacts: frameworks, templates, training, open source that extend to other projects.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to translate fluently between artists, production management, and engineers.
  • Genuine passion for animation, storytelling, or creative production.

“What can I offer?”

  • 2+ years in a Principal, Staff, or Lead role responsible for AI or pipeline automation, ideally in a creative studio.
  • Strong understanding of the animation production pipeline, departmental workflows, and industry-standard digital content creation (DCC) software.
  • Familiarity with animation frameworks and standards such as USD, Autodesk Flow Production Tracking and Jira.
  • Experience measuring and reporting the productivity impact of engineering tooling investments.
  • Stays current with AI trends and emerging technologies.

Hybrid: This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time.

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website.

Salary range: $190,000 - $230,000

job.title: Engineering Supervisor
job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

The Engineering Supervisor will work closely with the Manager of Facilities Engineer and provide supervision of the Engineering team at both low and high-rise buildings. This includes the efficient operation, oversight and upkeep of the central plants, the installation, maintenance and repair of mechanical equipment, controls, plumbing and electrical systems, building envelopes, and grounds. You will troubleshoot and resolve technical issues, coordinate all maintenance activities, manage vendor and employee relationships, and collaborate with contractors to ensure the facility operates efficiently, remains safe and is compliant with all regulations.

What You’ll Do:

  • Execute weekly workplans, including preventative, corrective and reactive maintenance work orders assigned through the CMMS and mobile platforms
  • Maintain accurate records of maintenance activity, equipment performance, repair history, and costs in the CMMS
  • Work closely with the Chief Engineer to provide support for central chiller plants and other critical infrastructure supporting the sites, data centers, and critical spaces
  • Maintain, troubleshoot, and repair mechanical, electrical and plumbing systems, including critical infrastructure, to ensure continuous, efficient, and safe operations
  • Partner with Facility Operations on all MEP and critical infrastructure preventative maintenance programs
  • Participate and provide support for annual LAFD REG4 testing
  • Monitor N4 building automation systems (BAS) to optimize energy use, systems performance, and maintain comfortable environments for employees and guests. Provide updates to management and Central Monitoring teams on alarms and impacts on operations
  • Work closely with the Critical Infrastructure System team on the ArcGIS platform, projects and emergency response strategies  
  • Partner with the Asset Management team to drive EAM processes and ensure assets are tagged and data is accurate in the Master Asset List
  • Participate in the development and implementation of standard operating procedures (SOP) and key performance indicators (KPI’s) with Facility Operations and the Asset Management team
  • Oversee vendor and 3rd party contracted services to ensure scope of work is completed as required. Includes having all documents and costs added to the asset in the CMMS  
  • Partner with NBCU departments to ensure compliance and safety tasks are addressed promptly (AQMD, OSHA, ADA and other regulatory requirements)
  • Support emergency preparedness initiatives and attend drills and exercises related to fire, disaster response, and business continuity
  • Ensure that general safety, fire prevention regulations, and safe working habits are enforced
  • Attend bid walks and assist with project oversite when required 
  • Support of multiple sites and assign tasks to Engineering teams as required within the Los Angeles area 
  • Maintain OSHA 30-hour certification  
  • Other duties as assigned

Let’s Talk About You:

  • Cool Under Pressure – You handle stressful situations with ease and professionalism while juggling multiple stakeholders and competing priorities
  • Communicates with ease – You have a way with words; written and verbal
  • Tech-savvy – You are an MS Office whiz and can take on new software with ease

What You Have:

  • High school diploma, GED, or equivalent
  • 7+ years of experience in building engineering or a related field
  • Working knowledge of Class A commercial building operations and applicable fire/life safety testing requirements, including Los Angeles REG 4 where relevant.
  • Demonstrated proficiency with HVAC, plumbing, electrical, and building automation systems (BAS), including the ability to troubleshoot and coordinate repairs.
  • Knowledge of applicable building codes, safety standards, regulatory requirements, and energy efficiency practices.
  • Valid state Class C Driver’s License

What Will Make You Stand Out:

  • Associates degree or technical certification in building systems
  • OSHA 30-Hour General Industry certification, or ability to obtain/maintain certification within a company-designated timeframe.
  • Tridium N4 knowledge
  • EPA Universal Certification for refrigerants
  • Relevant trade license HVAC, electrical, plumbing, low voltage

Additional Requirements:

  • Required On-Site: This position is required to be performed full-time from an NBCUniversal-designated worksite. 
  • Ability to work flexible hours and travel as needed

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. NBCUniversal is looking for a Facility Technician! In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring the efficient operation, maintenance and repair of building envelopes, systems, equipment, grounds and infrastructure. You will troubleshoot and resolve technical issues, conduct preventative maintenance, respond to service calls, escort vendors on site, and collaborate with contractors to ensure the facility operates efficiently, remains safe and is compliant with all regulations.

What You'll Do:

  • Maintain, troubleshoot, and repair mechanical, electrical and plumbing systems, including critical infrastructure, to ensure continuous, efficient, and safe operations
  • Monitor building automation systems (BAS) to optimize energy use, systems performance, and maintain comfortable environments for employees and guests
  • Address and resolve building system failures in a timely manner to minimize disruptions
  • Respond to service requests and emergencies during and after business hours
  • Conduct site inspections and meter readings as required
  • Complete preventative, corrective and reactive maintenance work orders assigned through the CMMS and mobile platform
  • Maintain accurate records of maintenance activity, equipment performance, repair history, and costs in the CMMS
  • Work closely with the Asset Management team to ensure assets are tagged and data is accurate in the Master Asset List
  • Participate in the development and implementation of standard operating procedures (SOP) and key performance indicators (KPI’s) with Facility Operations and the Asset Management team
  • Oversee and support vendor and 3rd party contracted services.
  • Schedule and coordinate service calls with internal teams and external vendors
  • Partner with NBCU departments to ensure compliance and safety tasks are addressed promptly 
  • Support emergency preparedness initiatives and attend drills and exercises related to fire, disaster response, and business continuity
  • Adhere to OSHA, ADA and other regulatory requirements
  • Support Facility Operations and support teams with event set-ups
  • Interior & exterior painting and general carpentry tasks as needed
  • Attend bid walks and assist with project oversite when required  
  • Other duties as assigned

Let’s Talk About You:

  • Cool Under Pressure – You handle stressful situations with ease and professionalism while juggling multiple stakeholders and competing priorities
  • Communicates with ease – You have a way with words; written and verbal
  • Tech-savvy – You are an MS Office whiz and can take on new software with ease

What You Have:

  • High school diploma or equivalent required;
  • 3+ years of experience in building engineering, facilities management or a related field or equivalent
  • Understanding of Class A commercial building operations
  • Demonstrated proficiency with HVAC, plumbing, electrical, and building automation systems (BAS)
  • Knowledge of applicable building codes, safety standards, regulatory requirements, and energy efficiency practices.
  • Valid state Class C Driver’s License

What Would Make You Stand Out:

  • Associates degree or technical certification in building systems
  • Strong troubleshooting and diagnostic skills
  • Relevant trade license or certifications (HVAC, electrical, plumbing, low voltage)
  • EPA Universal Certification for refrigerants
  • Understanding of Class A high rise operations and REG 4

Additional Requirements:

  • Required On-Site: This position is required to be performed full-time from an NBCUniversal-designated worksite. 
  • Ability to work flexible hours and travel as needed

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website. Salary range: $46.00 - $48.00/hourly

job.title: Feature Development Intern, DreamWorks Animation, Spring 2027
job.description:

As a growth-minded studio, we pride ourselves on being one of the world’s leading producers of high-quality, award-winning, animated films and series, reaching consumers around the globe. DreamWorks creates a diverse array of original content in a variety of formats, delivering compelling stories with unique characters. We place tremendous value on the experiences our talent brings to the table from their own non-traditional paths to success. We believe in frequent communication and that transparency and trust yield the best work. We are a community of artists, technologists, innovators, and creators, who are passionate about animation and also happen to love eating lunch together.

In the DreamWorks Internship Program, interns work in an engaging and exciting environment alongside creative leaders and artists who are committed to building an inclusive and collaborative culture. Interns are immersed into TV and Feature animated productions while gaining hands-on experience at our studio. Open to students and recent grads, we love those who are driven and hungry to learn, are curious and resourceful, and most importantly, are passionate about animation. 

The Internship Program also showcases best-in-class opportunities by offering executive speaker series, professional/career development workshops, artistic classes, community outreach opportunities, movie screenings, and much more!

Supporting NBCUniversal’s owned portfolio of properties as well as third-party partners across the theme park business, UDX FPP creates products, experiences and partnerships that deepen fandom and connects audiences around the world with the characters, stories and worlds that define Universal.

Working closely with the Senior Manager, Toys & Hardlines North America, the Category Manager will drive growth across designated Toys & Hardlines categories, including Infant/Preschool, Construction, and select franchise programs. This role manages licensing partners, supports new business development, aligns product strategies with franchise priorities, and tracks financial performance to drive revenue growth.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Manage a portfolio of strategic and category-specific licensing partners, including day-to-day account management and business planning.
  • Partner with licensees to develop consumer products programs that support brand objectives and revenue growth.
  • Negotiate licensing agreements and amendments from proposal through execution in partnership with Legal and Finance.
  • Identify and evaluate new business opportunities, partner prospects, category extensions, and product trends.
  • Collaborate with Franchise, Category Management, and Product Development teams to align product line plans with brand strategy.
  • Lead marketing approval workflows and submission processes for assigned categories, including Construction.
  • Manage forecasts, budgets, and financial tracking for assigned licensing partners and categories.
  • Partner with the North America Retail Sales team to maximize retail opportunities and strengthen consumer-level execution.
  • Coordinate across Legal, Finance, Franchise, Retail, Product Development, and Marketing to ensure alignment and execution.
  • Perform additional duties and responsibilities as assigned to meet the evolving needs of the team and business.
  • Ability to travel as required to support business and operational needs.
  • Minimum 5+ years of experience in category management, brand management, licensing, consumer products, or a related field.
  • Experience managing external partners and negotiating commercial agreements.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to identify and pursue new business opportunities, driving category growth and innovation
  • Knowledge of the product development lifecycle and retail merchandise planning
  • Experience in brand building, selling brands, and an understanding of the licensing, retail, and product development landscape
  • Familiarity with licensed consumer products and key licensing contract terms.
  • Strong financial acumen, forecasting capability, and analytical skills.
  • Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Strategic thinker who can manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
  • Proven ability to work in a fast-paced environment, manage multiple tasks concurrently, and remain adaptable to shifting priorities

Role Summary

The Manager, Compensation will lead and execute a broad range of compensation initiatives, including market pricing, compensation planning, program administration, job architecture, and the evaluation of compensation practices and policies. This role will serve as a trusted advisor to HR and business stakeholders, translating complex data into clear insights and recommendations that support competitive, equitable, and effective compensation programs. The Manager will independently manage projects, strengthen processes and governance, and help deliver a consistent employee and stakeholder experience.

Responsibilities

  • Lead market pricing, benchmarking, and competitive assessments for a broad range of roles, and develop well-supported compensation recommendations for HR and business leaders.
  • Serve as a compensation advisor to HR partners and business stakeholders, providing guidance on compensation programs, pay decisions, organizational changes, and other complex compensation matters.
  • Participate in external compensation surveys and oversee the organization, validation, and analysis of market data
  • Manage the administration and ongoing enhancement of employee recognition programs, including peer-to-peer recognition, anniversary milestone recognition, and spot recognition. Evaluate participation and effectiveness, manage vendor relationships, coordinate with internal stakeholders, and drive a consistent and engaging employee experience.
  • Develop compensation-related communications, presentations, and educational materials for employees, managers, HR partners, and senior leadership, translating complex concepts into clear and actionable guidance.
  • Evaluate compensation levels, pay mix, program effectiveness, market competitiveness, and internal equity, identifying risks, opportunities, and recommended actions.
  • Lead key components of annual compensation planning, including process coordination, data validation, reporting, analytics, issue resolution, and stakeholder support.
  • Support compensation governance and regulatory compliance by strengthening controls, documentation, reporting, and consistent process execution.
  • Monitor market, industry, regulatory, and economic trends, and recommend enhancements that support the ongoing effectiveness and competitiveness of compensation programs.
  • Partner with HR Operations and HR Technology teams to define business requirements, improve processes, resolve system issues, and ensure HR systems accurately support compensation programs, job architecture, and pay administration.

Basic Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience.
  • 5+ years of progressive compensation experience, or related experience in human resources, finance, consulting, or a similar analytical discipline.

Desired Characteristics:

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Finance, Mathematics, Business Administration, or a related field preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience independently managing compensation programs and projects, including market pricing, salary administration, incentive compensation, compensation planning, or compensation analytics.
  • Experience advising HR and business leaders on compensation matters and developing recommendations for complex or sensitive situations.
  • Experience working with compensation survey data, HRIS platforms, compensation systems, and reporting tools; experience supporting job architecture and employee recognition programs is a plus.
  • Advanced Excel skills, including data analysis, financial modelling, reporting, and data validation; ability to work effectively with large and complex data sets.
  • Strong analytical, critical-thinking, and problem-solving skills with exceptional attention to detail and sound judgment.
  • Ability to translate complex data and compensation concepts into clear, concise, and actionable recommendations for a range of audiences.
  • Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate effectively across all levels of the organization.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and drive work forward independently.
  • Demonstrated professionalism, discretion, and integrity in handling sensitive and confidential information.

The Manager, Executive Compensation supports the design, administration, and ongoing management of the Company's executive compensation programs. The Manager is responsible for developing insights and recommendations that inform executive compensation decisions, monitoring market and regulatory developments, and supporting Compensation Committee and senior leadership materials.   • Manage executive compensation survey submissions and market data sources, ensuring the integrity and effective use of data to support recommendations and decision-making.
  • Support the design, administration, and ongoing evaluation of executive compensation programs to ensure alignment with business objectives, market practices, governance standards, and shareholder expectations.

  • Prepare executive compensation analyses, reports, presentations, and recommendations for senior leadership, the Compensation Committee, and Board-level discussions.
  • Lead and support executive compensation governance activities, including annual proxy statement preparation, executive compensation disclosures, and related documentation.
  • Develop compensation recommendations by evaluating market data, internal considerations, business needs, governance requirements, and potential risks.
  • Lead compensation projects and workstreams from inception through implementation, ensuring timely execution, accuracy, and effective stakeholder communication.

  • Prepare analyses and materials related to executive compensation programs, equity awards, compensation planning, and other compensation initiatives.
  • Identify process improvement opportunities, operational risks, and data quality issues, and implement solutions to enhance efficiency, controls, and overall program effectiveness.
  • Apply compensation philosophies, policies, and governance principles consistently while exercising sound judgment in complex, sensitive, and high-impact situations.
  • Partner effectively with Finance, Legal, HR, and external advisors to support executive compensation initiatives, governance requirements, and strategic projects.

  • 5+ years of progressive compensation experience.
  • Experience supporting executive compensation, equity compensation, deferred compensation, or related compensation programs within a publicly traded company.
  • Experience conducting compensation analyses and market benchmarking.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.

What We'll Look For:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Mathematics, Human Resources, or a related field preferred.
  • Experience supporting SEC filings, proxy statement preparation, executive compensation disclosures, or related governance activities preferred.
  • Solid analytical, financial modeling, and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience working with compensation survey data, market pricing tools, HRIS platforms, compensation systems, and reporting tools.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence decisions and build credibility with business partners and stakeholders.
  • Ability to communicate complex compensation concepts and recommendations effectively to senior leaders and business partners.
  • Proven project management and organizational skills, with the ability to lead cross-functional projects and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to lead through ambiguity, balance competing priorities, and drive stakeholder alignment toward decisions.
  • Exceptional judgment in complex or sensitive compensation matters, including the ability to handle highly confidential information with discretion.
  • Excellent attention to detail and commitment to quality and accuracy.

job.title: Manager, Facilities Engineering
job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

NBCUniversal is looking for a Manager of Facilities Engineering! In this role, you will be responsible for overseeing a team of Engineers and support staff on the efficient operation, maintenance and repair of building envelopes, systems, equipment, infrastructure and grounds for both low and high rise buildings. You will troubleshoot and resolve technical issues, coordinate all maintenance activities, manage vendor relationships, and collaborate with contractors to ensure the facility operates efficiently, remains safe and is compliant with all regulations.

What You’ll Do:

  • Oversee chiller plants and other critical infrastructure supporting the sites, data centers, and critical spaces
  • Maintain, troubleshoot, and repair mechanical, electrical and plumbing systems, including critical infrastructure, to ensure continuous, efficient, and safe operations
  • Manage all MEP and critical infrastructure preventative maintenance programs. Including creating and maintaining an annual service calendar
  • Maintain accurate records of maintenance activity, equipment performance, repair history, and costs in the CMMS
  • Coordinate and oversee annual LAFD REG4 testing
  • Monitor N4 building automation systems (BAS) to optimize energy use, systems performance, and maintain comfortable environments for employees and guests. Provide updates to management and Central Monitoring teams on alarms and impacts on operations
  • Develop weekly workplans and assign preventative, corrective and reactive maintenance work orders assigned through the CMMS and mobile platform with the assistance of the planner / scheduler
  • Work closely with the Critical Infrastructure System team on the ArcGIS platform, projects and emergency response strategies  
  • Assist the Asset Management team developing and driving EAM processes and ensuring assets are tagged and data is accurate in the Master Asset List
  • Participate in the development and implementation of standard operating procedures (SOP) and key performance indicators (KPI’s) with Facility Operations and the Asset Management team
  • Manage vendor and 3rd party contracted services to ensure scope of work is completed as required. Includes having all documents and costs added to the asset in the CMMS  
  • Partner with NBCU departments to ensure compliance and safety tasks are addressed promptly (AQMD, OSHA, ADA and other regulatory requirements)
  • Support emergency preparedness initiatives and attend drills and exercises related to fire, disaster response, and business continuity
  • Work closely with the Director of Facilities and Facility Managers on capital project planning, annual operating budgets, including attending bid walks and assisting with project oversite when required 
  • Support of multiple sites and assign tasks to Engineering teams as required within the Los Angeles area 
  • Maintain OSHA 30-hour certification  
  • Other duties as assigned 

Let’s Talk About You:

  • Cool Under Pressure – You handle stressful situations with ease and professionalism while juggling multiple stakeholders and competing priorities
  • Facilities Guru- You have extensive experience leading complex facility operations and engineering solutions. You are a pro at managing mechanical, electrical, and plumbing systems, along with general maintenance of grounds, facilities and otherwise
  • Analytical expert- Strong troubleshooting and diagnostic skills
  • Project Wrangler – expertise in seeing opportunities for improvement, gaining support, breaking down to bite-sized chunks, executing and seeking feedback will give you a superpower to strategically partner with clients and change workflow as opportunities arise
  • Juggler – You know how to manage multiple tasks and priorities and move them all along effectively while keeping stakeholders updating and informed
  • Executer – You get things done!  Using strong business acumen, inciteful analytical skills, and superior organizational skills, troubleshooting skills, and diagnostic skills to manage through competing priorities within a matrixed environment
  • Self-starter – You are motivated, can work with minimal guidance, and can identify helpful resources to get the job done

What You Have:

  • High school diploma, GED, or equivalent 
  • 10+ years of experience in building engineering, facilities operations, critical infrastructure, or a related field.
  • Working knowledge of Class A commercial building operations and applicable fire/life safety testing requirements, including Los Angeles REG 4 where relevant.
  • Demonstrated proficiency with HVAC, plumbing, electrical, and building automation systems (BAS), including the ability to troubleshoot and coordinate repairs.
  • Knowledge of applicable building codes, safety standards, regulatory requirements, and energy efficiency practices.
  • Valid state Class C Driver’s License

What Will Make You Stand Out:

  • OSHA 30-Hour General Industry certification, or ability to obtain/maintain certification within a company-designated timeframe.
  • Associates degree or technical certification in building systems
  • EPA Universal Certification for refrigerants
  • Tridium N4 knowledge
  • Relevant trade license HVAC, electrical, plumbing, low voltage

Additional Requirements:

  • Required On-Site: This position is required to be performed full-time from an NBCUniversal-designated worksite. 
  • Ability to work flexible hours and travel as needed

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website. Salary range: $120,000 - $145,000 (bonus eligible)

NBCUniversal is seeking a Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing (MEP) Manager to join the Facilities Operations and Engineering team in Universal City, CA. This role works closely with all divisions of West Coast Studio Operations and reports to the Director of Critical Infrastructure. As an individual contributor, the MEP Manager is responsible for overseeing day-to-day facility operations across the NBCUniversal Studio Lot, ensuring reliability, efficiency, and operational excellence.
 

What You’ll Do: 

  • Works under the direction of the Director of Facilities Infrastructure Systems to support MEP operations across studio facilities and production environments, ensuring reliable and efficient infrastructure.
  • Enforce safety protocols across MEP operations, ensuring full compliance with EHS regulations and industry’s best practices. 
  • Monitor the quality of all MEP services, repairs, and installations to ensure work meets technical specifications and the highest performance standards. 
  • Collaborate with the asset management team to maintain accurate inventory and lifecycle tracking of all equipment and infrastructure, supporting long-term planning and capital replacement strategies. 
  • Ensure preventive maintenance programs and inspection routines are consistently executed to maintain system performance, safety, and regulatory compliance. 
  • Partner with the Contracts Manager to support procurement and financial activities, including vendor sourcing, RFP development, contract negotiation and administration, budget tracking, and purchase approvals. 
  • Engage with external vendors and contractors, ensuring work is delivered on time, within scope, and aligned with quality expectations and contractual requirements. 
  • Troubleshoot and respond to operational challenges including after-hours issues such as equipment failures, HVAC disruptions, and electrical or plumbing incidents that may impact production and theme park/CityWalk operations in some instances. 
  • Coordinate and prioritize MEP work requests, ensuring timely and accurate completion across electrical, plumbing, and HVAC systems. 
  • Contribute to the development and management of the studio operations budget, ensuring effective resource allocation and cost control. 
  • Participate in the planning and oversight of capital improvement projects involving MEP systems, ensuring timely and cost-effective delivery. Monitor project performance, including schedule adherence, cost control, quality standards, and estimate reviews.
  • Support critical infrastructure planning, enterprise standards development, and general building systems automation/reporting to include supporting external sites as needed.
  • Maintain accurate documentation and provide regular updates to leadership and stakeholders. 
  • Coordinate daily operational schedules across MEP functions to ensure alignment with production needs. 
  • Recommend and support the procurement of equipment, tools, and supplies to improve operational efficiency and effectiveness. 
  • Collaborate with engineers, architects, and cross-functional teams to ensure successful project planning and implementation. 
  • Support the development and implementation of training programs to ensure MEP staff remain proficient with current technologies, codes, and standards. 
  • Support initiatives focused on energy efficiency and sustainability in alignment with organizational environmental goals. 
  • Partner with Emergency Services teams to ensure rapid and effective response to MEP related incidents. Ensure all facility modifications comply with applicable codes and regulations, including those related to fire protection and boiler systems.
  • Attend required meetings and participate in ongoing professional development to maintain technical expertise. 
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Let’s Talk About You…

  • Analytical - You create tools and processes quickly and accurately to provide job estimates for clients levering deep industry experience, historical trends, teams and vendor relationships.

  • 3+ years prior experience in facility maintenance operations
  • 3+ years of experience managing union personnel
  • 2+ years of experience in work planning and analysis
  • 2+ years of experience in cost-effective internal business practices
  • 2+ years of experience in data analytics and verification
     

What Would Make You a Stand-out:

  • Strong understanding of mechanical systems (HVAC, piping, cooling systems, building automation, utilities and electrical systems)
  • Experience with enterprise Integrated Workplace Management Systems, work planning and scheduling and materials management
  • Demonstrates proficiency in Microsoft Office, ArcGIS, Building/Energy Management Systems such as Tridium and other relevant tools.

NBC News is seeking experienced Freelance Technical Production Managers (TPMs) to support live news programming across multiple control rooms, studios, special events, and remote productions. This position includes overnight, early morning, daytime, evening, holiday, and weekend shifts. Candidates must be available to work a flexible schedule and support breaking news coverage when required. 

Based in New York, the TPM serves as the central operational point between editorial, technical, production, engineering, transmission, and studio teams to ensure seamless execution of live programming.

Key Responsibilities

Production Planning & Live Show Operations

  • Coordinate, verify and manage all technical elements required for live broadcasts, taped productions, special reports, and breaking news coverage.
  • Build and review rundowns, production notes, transmission requirements, guest information and staffing assignments before air. Coordinate remote guests, correspondents, bureaus, Zoom/FaceTime interviews, and transmission resources.
  • Serve as the primary operational liaison between Producers, Directors, Technical Directors, Audio Operators, Graphics Operators, Studio Crews, and Engineering Teams. 
  • Track and escalate technical issues while ensuring minimal impact to air.

Technical Coordination

  • Work closely with Engineering, Studio Maintenance, Media Traffic, Capture Management, Staging, Lighting, Audio, Video/Robo, and Graphics teams.
  • Coordinate records, transmission paths, return feeds, IFBs, PLs, and communication resources.
  • Ensure control room wall routing, guest returns, prompter feeds, and production resources are properly configured.

Crew & Resource Management

  • Confirm daily crew assignments using scheduling systems and crew reports.
  • Review staffing needs and identify coverage gaps.
  • Escalate late arrivals, call-outs, and operational issues.

#LI-onsite

  • 2+ years of experience working in a News environment.
  • 2+ years of operational experience in broadcast studio and production control room.

  • Strong administrative, and organizational skills.
  • Strong on-air operations and technical background.
  • Ability to work all shifts including days, overnights, weekends and holidays.
  • Proven working knowledge with control room and studio technology.
  • Solid leadership, clear communication, excellent interpersonal, and team building skills required.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Demonstrated management experience and customer focus.
  • Experience working with DGA, NABET, IATSE, as well as non-represented.
  • Excellent team facilitation and knowledge of team problem solving techniques.

NBCUniversal is seeking a Principal Character Artist (Face) to define and drive facial art standards and solve complex character challenges for an ambitious interactive entertainment experience. This role is responsible for ensuring that facial assets achieve the highest visual quality, expressiveness, and technical quality across the project.

The Principal Character Artist (Face) will work closely with the Lead Character Artist (Face), Animation, Technical Art, and cross-disciplinary teams to ensure that facial systems support both artistic vision and production needs. The role focuses on advancing pipelines, methodologies, and facial systems, acting as a key expert in areas such as scanning, blendshape workflows, real-time character performance and will drive benchmarks.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Define and maintain high-quality standards for facial assets across the project.
  • Solve complex artistic and technical challenges related to facial realism and performance.
  • Act as an expert in facial systems including scanning, blendshape pipelines, and real-time character workflows.
  • Collaborate closely with Animation and Technical Art teams to ensure seamless integration of facial rigs and performance systems.
  • Contribute to the design and evolution of facial pipelines, tools, and best practices.
  • Produce benchmarks and ensure consistency and quality across facial assets within the production pipeline.
  • Support the Lead Character Artist (Face) and broader team with high-level expertise and guidance.
  • Drive innovation in facial workflows to improve expressive realism, scalability, and efficiency.
  • Review and validate facial content to ensure alignment with artistic and technical standards.

RÉSUMÉ DU POSTE

NBCUniversal est à la recherche d’une personne pour occuper le poste d’Artiste principal en personnages (Face) afin de définir et de faire progresser les normes artistiques liées aux visages et de résoudre des défis complexes liés aux personnages pour une expérience ambitieuse de divertissement interactif. Ce rôle est responsable de veiller à ce que les ressources faciales atteignent les plus hauts standards de qualité visuelle, d’expressivité et d’excellence technique à l’échelle du projet.

La personne occupant le poste d’Artiste principal en personnages (Visage) travaillera en étroite collaboration avec l’Artiste en chef des personnages (Face), les équipes d’Animation, d’Art technique et d’autres disciplines afin de s’assurer que les systèmes faciaux répondent à la fois à la vision artistique et aux besoins de production. Le rôle est axé sur l’avancement des pipelines, des méthodologies et des systèmes faciaux, en agissant comme personne experte de référence dans des domaines tels que la numérisation 3D, les flux de travail de blendshapes, la performance de personnages en temps réel, et en établissant des références de qualité.

RESPONSABILITÉS

  • Définir et maintenir des normes de haute qualité pour les ressources faciales à l’échelle du projet.
  • Résoudre des défis artistiques et techniques complexes liés au réalisme facial et à la performance des personnages.
  • Agir à titre de personne experte en systèmes faciaux, notamment en matière de numérisation 3D, de pipelines de blendshapes et de flux de travail en temps réel.
  • Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes d’Animation et d’Art technique afin d’assurer une intégration harmonieuse des rigs faciaux et des systèmes de performance.
  • Contribuer à la conception et à l’évolution des pipelines faciaux, des outils et des meilleures pratiques.
  • Produire des références de qualité et assurer la cohérence et la qualité des ressources faciales au sein du pipeline de production.
  • Soutenir l’Artiste en chef des personnages (Face) et l’équipe élargie grâce à une expertise et à des conseils de haut niveau.
  • Favoriser l’innovation dans les flux de travail faciaux afin d’améliorer le réalisme expressif, l’évolutivité et l’efficacité.
  • Réviser et valider le contenu facial afin d’assurer son alignement avec les normes artistiques et techniques.

 

      Basic Qualifications

      • Extensive experience in AAA game development with a focus on modular character art.
      • Strong portfolio demonstrating expertise in high-quality facial modeling and realism.
      • Advanced understanding of human facial anatomy, expressions, and performance.
      • Strong expertise in facial systems, including blendshapes, scanning, and real-time pipelines.
      • Experience working closely with Animation and Technical Art teams.
      • Strong understanding of modular character pipelines and production workflows.
      • Ability to solve complex artistic and technical challenges.
      • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

      Desired Characteristics

      • Experience developing or improving facial pipelines and systems at scale.
      • Strong knowledge of performance capture workflows.
      • Experience with Unreal Engine and modern character pipelines (e.g., Metahuman).
      • Experience working with distributed teams or external partners.
      • Passion for pushing realism and character expressiveness.
      • Desire to think and explore innovative solutions.

      Qualifications de base

      • Expérience approfondie du développement de jeux AAA, avec un accent sur l’art de personnages modulaires.
      • Portfolio solide démontrant une expertise en modélisation faciale de haute qualité et en réalisme.
      • Compréhension avancée de l’anatomie faciale humaine, des expressions et de la performance.
      • Grande expertise des systèmes faciaux, y compris les blendshapes, la numérisation 3D et les pipelines en temps réel.
      • Expérience de collaboration étroite avec les équipes d’Animation et d’Art technique.
      • Excellente compréhension des pipelines de personnages modulaires et des flux de production.
      • Capacité à résoudre des défis artistiques et techniques complexes.
      • Excellentes aptitudes en communication et en collaboration.

job.title: Producer
job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

NBC News is seeking a seasoned, driven Producer to support newsgathering, storytelling, and live production across all platforms. This role will work closely with a Correspondent and production teams to pitch, develop, report, and execute compelling journalism—from breaking news to in-depth features, investigative reporting to national coverage.

The ideal candidate is a creative journalist with sharp editorial judgment, strong writing and research skills, and the confidence to thrive under pressure. This producer should be equally at home in the field, on location, or in the control room, and adept at delivering both live and taped segments that meet NBC’s highest editorial standards. The ideal candidate is a news junkie who can’t wait to get out the door and, on the road, to cover that next story. This producer should also enjoy storytelling for morning television, an evening newscast and everything in between. The ability to shoot and edit is a plus, along with a sense of what does well on social media or in vertical video formats.

This role is right for you if you’re a versatile storyteller who thrives on urgency and impact. You move seamlessly between producing, reporting, and writing, and you’re as comfortable leading coverage during breaking news as you are crafting enterprise stories. You’re highly organized, competitive, and relentless about accuracy and detail—yet collaborative, adaptable, and energized by working with correspondents and teams under tight deadlines. Most importantly, you’re passionate about journalism that informs, engages, and makes a difference.

Responsibilities:

  • Partner with Correspondent and show teams to develop, report, and deliver strong, visually compelling stories with clear narratives and well-researched journalism.
  • Pitch, field produce, write, and fact-check stories across NBC News linear and streaming platforms, including daily news, longform pieces, and cross-platform content.
  • Conduct original reporting, deep research, and source interviews.
  • Secure guest bookings in a competitive environment; conduct pre-interviews and prepare talking points.
  • Ability to travel at a moment’s notice to cover a story and commit to staying on the road as long as the story takes.
  • Collaborate with control rooms, senior producers, and editorial teams to build rundowns, write intros, and produce live and taped segments.
  • Oversee field operations, including live shots, remote anchor setups, and breaking news coverage.
  • Track and manage correspondent’s schedule when working with them closely. 
  • Work closely with editors to ensure high-quality video packages, graphics, and sound.
  • Partner with Standards & Legal to ensure all content adheres to editorial and corporate guidelines.
  • Maintain strong communication between the Correspondent, senior leadership, assignment desk and production teams.
  • Contribute ideas for a wide range of content including news-of-day, lifestyle features, celebrity interviews, and human-interest stories.

Basic Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in journalism, communications, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
  • Minimum 5 years’ experience in network news, cable, or talk show production, including live and taped segments.
  • Strong journalistic writing, research, and editorial judgment skills.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of U.S. politics, current events, pop culture, and lifestyle trends.
  • Experience shooting (DSLR or iPhone) and editing (Avid and/or Adobe Premiere).
  • Strong ability to navigate newsroom tools and technology (Slack, NCX, Latakoo, etc.)
  • Proven ability to work in fast-paced environments under tight deadlines.
  • Must be willing to work nights, weekends, holidays, and overtime with short notice.
  • Must be able to travel frequently, domestically and internationally.
  • Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills; ability to collaborate across teams.

Desired Characteristics:

  • Strong storytelling ability with creativity in pitching original ideas.
  • Experience working with live programming.
  • Cool under pressure and comfortable managing breaking news situations.
  • A self-starter with strong organizational and multitasking skills.
  • Knowledge of NBC News Policies, Guidelines, and Practices.

Additional Requirements:

Fully Remote: This position has been designated as fully remote, based in Dallas, TX, meaning that the position is expected to contribute from a non-NBCUniversal worksite, most commonly an employee’s residence. This role will report to Miami bureau leadership.

This position is eligible for company-sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. job.title: Product Designer
job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

Job Description

We’re looking for a Product Designer to create intuitive, engaging, and user-centered digital experiences across our web and mobile products. You’ll collaborate closely with Product Managers, Engineers, Researchers, and other stakeholders to solve complex problems through thoughtful design and data-informed decision making.

This role requires a strong understanding of UX and UI design principles, exceptional communication skills, and expert proficiency in Figma.

This is a role in our audience development digital marketing group and will focus on platforms that include the Bravo, NBC Insider, Peacock Blog consumer facing web platforms along with our B2B NBC Affiliate Marketing application. This is an onsite role in our New York or LA Office where expectations are being in Office Monday through Thursday and remote day on Fridays.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the end-to-end design process from discovery through final implementation.
  • Collaborate with Product Managers, Engineering and Stakeholders to define product requirements and user experiences.
  • Create user flows, journey maps, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity UI designs.
  • Design responsive experiences across desktop, tablet, and mobile platforms.
  • Develop and maintain design systems, component libraries, and interaction patterns.
  • Conduct competitive analysis and incorporate user research and usability findings into design decisions.
  • Develop interactive prototypes to communicate concepts and validate solutions.
  • Work within and contribute to the company’s design system to ensure consistency and scalability.
  • Present design concepts and rationale to cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
  • Partner with developers during implementation to ensure design quality and accuracy.
  • Iterate on designs based on user feedback, analytics, experimentation, and business goals.
  • Stay current with industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in product design.

Basic Requirements:

  • 3+ years of experience designing digital products for web and/or mobile applications.
  • Advanced proficiency in Figma is required, including:
    • Auto Layout
    • Components and Variants
    • Variables
    • Design Systems
    • Interactive Prototyping
    • Dev Mode and developer handoff
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end product design work and problem-solving skills.
  • Solid understanding of UX principles, interaction design, information architecture, accessibility, and visual design.
  • Experience creating wireframes, user flows, mockups, and prototypes.
  • Ability to communicate design decisions clearly and present work to stakeholders.
  • Experience working within Agile product development teams.
  • Strong collaboration, organization, and time management skills.
  • Required Skills
    • Figma (required)
    • User Experience (UX) Design
    • User Interface (UI) Design
    • Wireframing
    • Interactive Prototyping
    • Design Systems
    • Information Architecture
    • Visual Design
    • Responsive Design
    • Accessibility (WCAG)
    • Cross-functional Collaboration
    • Problem Solving
    • Communication and Presentation

Desired Characteristics:

  • Experience maintaining or contributing to a design system.
  • Experience conducting usability testing or working with UX research.
  • Familiarity with A/B testing and data-informed product decisions.
  • Understanding of front-end technologies such as HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
  • Experience designing subscription, B2B, or content-driven digital products is a plus.

What Success Looks Like:

  • Delivers polished, user-centered designs that solve customer and business needs.
  • Collaborates effectively across Product, Engineering, and Design teams.
  • Produces high-quality Figma files that are organized, scalable, and developer-friendly.
  • Uses research, analytics, and user feedback to continuously improve product experiences.
  • Contributes to the evolution of the design system and overall design quality.

Additional Requirements:

  • Hybrid: This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time.
  • This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website.
  • Salary range: $85,000- $110,000

job.title: Product Manager
job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

NBCUniversal’s Enterprise Product Team builds products that provide essential capabilities to organizations throughout NBCUniversal. The team leverages deep relationships with our business engagement and engineering counterparts to build cohesive, end-to-end solutions for their clients or users. The product portfolio is aligned around critical NBCU functions such as Content/Title Management, Data & Analytics, Scheduling & Distribution, Media Asset Management and Content Sales.

As a part of the Product team, you will be responsible for several products in your department.  You will be in constant communication with clients on anything product related, including development progress, deliverables, and timelines. You will lead grooming sessions, and execute product demos, and walkthroughs.  You are an expert in your area’s product features, capabilities, and functionality.  You will be a consultant on new multi-product initiatives or programs.  You will be a mentor to Product Specialists. 

Essential Responsibilities

Product Lifecycle Management

  • Manage the end-to-end life cycle of products, from ideation through delivery and ongoing optimization.
  • Define and own overall product vision, strategy, and success metrics for key initiatives, including data warehouse and business intelligence platforms.

Roadmap & Backlog Ownership

  • Develop and maintain feature roadmaps, prioritizing capabilities based on business needs and strategic goals.
  • Lead grooming sessions to ensure a consistently up-to-date backlog of clearly defined features and user stories.
  • Fully document product features and capabilities in JIRA, including measurable acceptance criteria.

Stakeholder Engagement & Requirements Gathering

  • Collaborate across functions (Engineering, Ad Sales, Programming, Operations, Product, Architecture) to capture and analyze requests, define data needs, and align priorities.
  • Translate complex business requirements into actionable product features and conceptual models.

Technical Collaboration & Solution Design

  • Partner with architecture and solutions leaders to identify optimal technical solutions that meet client and business needs.
  • Work closely with engineering teams and vendors to implement automation and workflow optimizations.

Data-Driven Product Development

  • Perform hands-on data exploration and analysis of large datasets to inform product decisions and enable data-driven features.
  • Continually leverage business insights and analytics to refine platform strategy and solve high-impact problems.

Quality Assurance & Compliance

  • Define and execute user acceptance testing for new features and integrations.
  • Ensure all workflows and vendor deliverables adhere to NBCUniversal standards and industry regulations.

Incident & Change Management

  • Coordinate resolution of operational issues promptly to minimize disruption.
  • Manage change requests effectively to maintain stability in live environments.

Reporting & Analytics
