NBCUniversal’s Enterprise Product Team builds products that provide essential capabilities to organizations throughout NBCUniversal. The team leverages deep relationships with our business engagement and engineering counterparts to build cohesive, end-to-end solutions for their clients or users. The product portfolio is aligned around critical NBCU functions such as Content/Title Management, Data & Analytics, Scheduling & Distribution, Media Asset Management and Content Sales.

As a part of the Product team, you will be responsible for several products in your department.  You will be in constant communication with clients on anything product related, including development progress, deliverables, and timelines. You will lead grooming sessions, and execute product demos, and walkthroughs.  You are an expert in your area’s product features, capabilities, and functionality.  You will be a consultant on new multi-product initiatives or programs.  You will be a mentor to Product Specialists. 

Essential Responsibilities

Product Lifecycle Management

  • Manage the end-to-end life cycle of products, from ideation through delivery and ongoing optimization.
  • Define and own overall product vision, strategy, and success metrics for key initiatives, including data warehouse and business intelligence platforms.

Roadmap & Backlog Ownership

  • Develop and maintain feature roadmaps, prioritizing capabilities based on business needs and strategic goals.
  • Lead grooming sessions to ensure a consistently up-to-date backlog of clearly defined features and user stories.
  • Fully document product features and capabilities in JIRA, including measurable acceptance criteria.

Stakeholder Engagement & Requirements Gathering

  • Collaborate across functions (Engineering, Ad Sales, Programming, Operations, Product, Architecture) to capture and analyze requests, define data needs, and align priorities.
  • Translate complex business requirements into actionable product features and conceptual models.

Technical Collaboration & Solution Design

  • Partner with architecture and solutions leaders to identify optimal technical solutions that meet client and business needs.
  • Work closely with engineering teams and vendors to implement automation and workflow optimizations.

Data-Driven Product Development

  • Perform hands-on data exploration and analysis of large datasets to inform product decisions and enable data-driven features.
  • Continually leverage business insights and analytics to refine platform strategy and solve high-impact problems.

Quality Assurance & Compliance

  • Define and execute user acceptance testing for new features and integrations.
  • Ensure all workflows and vendor deliverables adhere to NBCUniversal standards and industry regulations.

Incident & Change Management

  • Coordinate resolution of operational issues promptly to minimize disruption.
  • Manage change requests effectively to maintain stability in live environments.

Reporting & Analytics

  • Track and report on vendor performance metrics (uptime, error rates, turnaround times).
  • Provide actionable insights and recommendations to improve service quality and operational efficiency.

Documentation & Governance

  • Maintain comprehensive documentation for processes, integrations, and SLAs.
  • Ensure all product and vendor workflows comply with internal standards and regulatory requirements.

  • Expertise in the SDLC process, with a focus on scoping, iteration planning, user story and acceptance criteria writing, rollout management.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills - capable of assessing ambiguous situations, evaluating diverse factors, and adapting existing approaches to devise effective solutions.
  • Proven ability to influence and collaborate with senior stakeholders - including those unfamiliar with the subject matter, by tailoring communication style and providing guidance on challenging issues.
  • Experience working on problems of diverse scope - requiring sound judgment, interpretation, and decision-making with minimal supervision.

 

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • At least 2 years of direct client engagement experience
  • Experience in Television/Broadcast, Media, Technology, or related field
  • Experience with Agile methodology
  • Experience with using Jira or a similar system to track and maintain feature requirements and development progress
  • Natural problem solver, who is adaptable in a fast-paced environment and is highly collaborative

job.title: Product Manager
job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

We are seeking an experienced and motivated Technical Product Manager to join the AI Content and Media Product team within Operations & Technology. This role sits at the intersection of machine learning systems, large‑scale media workflows, metadata standards, and enterprise integrations, translating complex technical capabilities into scalable, production‑ready products used across NBCUniversal.

This is a hands‑on senior individual contributor role that combines strong product judgment, technical fluency, and execution. The role partners closely with Engineering, Data Science, Program Management, and business stakeholders to ensure your product delivers clear, reliable value aligned to organizational goals.

Responsibilities:

  • Product Development
    • Collaborate with cross‑functional teams including Engineering, Data Science, Program Management, Product, and Scrum to scope, develop, and deliver GenAI‑powered product capabilities
    • Develop a deep understanding of stakeholder workflows and business needs to define clear, actionable product requirements and user stories
    • Own one or more defined product areas, driving work from discovery through delivery and iteration
    • Partner with cross‑functional teams to define and maintain an outcome‑based roadmap grounded in customer insights, technical constraints, and business priorities
    • Conduct product testing to validate functionality, accuracy, and performance, and support demos and product reviews
    • Own and maintain product features post‑launch, incorporating feedback to continuously refine and improve capabilities
  • Execution & Stakeholder Engagement
    • Drive execution of product roadmaps, ensuring alignment with near‑ and mid‑term priorities
    • Partner with internal stakeholders and external vendors across the end to end GenAI use case lifecycle
    • Prepare and present product updates, documentation, metrics, and recommendations to stakeholders and leadership
    • Evaluate tradeoffs between model quality, performance, cost, and latency in partnership with technical teams
  • Innovation & Continuous Improvement
    • Stay informed on emerging AI, LLM, and machine learning technologies and relevant vendor offerings
    • Contribute to identifying reusable GenAI patterns and capabilities to support future product development
    • Identify opportunities to enhance product capabilities, improve operational processes, and drive efficiency
    • Provide mentorship and day‑to‑day guidance to junior Product Managers through collaboration, feedback, and shared execution

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience
  • 5+ years of relevant professional experience in product management, product development, or related technical roles
  • Proven experience working as a Product Owner or Technical Product Manager on complex, technology‑driven products
  • Strong ability to translate technical concepts and system behavior into clear product requirements for both technical and non‑technical audiences
  • Experience partnering closely with engineering and data science teams to deliver AI‑ or data‑driven products
  • Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast‑paced environment
  • Solid understanding of agile methodologies and modern product development practices

Desired Characteristics:

  • Strong collaboration skills and the ability to build effective working relationships across teams
  • Advanced analytical, problem‑solving, and critical‑thinking skills
  • Self‑starter comfortable operating in an evolving and ambiguous problem space
  • Familiarity with product management tools such as Jira, Confluence, and Airtable
  • Proficiency with Lucidchart, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, and SharePoint
  • Experience in the Media & Entertainment industry
  • Knowledge of data governance, privacy, legal compliance, cybersecurity, and ethical AI best practices
  • Experience writing, reviewing, or contributing to codebases in modern programming languages

Additional Requirements:

  • This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time.

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website. Salary range: $110,000 - $145,000

As part of our selection process, external candidates may be required to attend an in-person interview with an NBCUniversal employee at one of our locations prior to a hiring decision. NBCUniversal's policy is to provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, gender identity or expression, age, national origin or ancestry, citizenship, disability, sexual orientation, marital status, pregnancy, veteran status, membership in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

NBCU’s Telemundo Enterprises is seeking a Senior Analyst, Digital Analytics to join the Cross-Platform Analytics team and help drive data-informed decisions across Telemundo’s digital and streaming business. This role will focus on analyzing cross-platform content and audience performance and translating complex data into clear, actionable insights for stakeholders across Streaming, Programming, Marketing, Editorial, and Strategy & Insights. The ideal candidate combines strong analytical and problem-solving skills with an ability to tell compelling stories with data and will play an important role in developing executive-ready reporting, supporting high-priority ad-hoc analyses, and mentoring junior analysts on the team.

Responsibilities

  • Analyze cross-platform content performance across Telemundo’s digital and streaming ecosystem, including VOD, live, FAST, and other digitally distributed content.
  • Support data analysis and reporting requests by querying dashboards and reporting tools such as Tableau and Domo, and translating findings into actionable insights for stakeholders.
  • Conduct title-level and content-driven analyses to identify trends in audience engagement, consumption, and performance across platforms.
  • Build clean, executive-ready PowerPoint narratives explaining title-level and content-driven trends in Telemundo Streaming growth for recurring reporting, strategic initiatives, and high-visibility ad-hoc requests.
  • Develop and maintain recurring reports, analyses, and performance frameworks that help stakeholders understand what is driving changes in streaming and digital performance.
  • Partner with Streaming, Programming, Marketing, Editorial, and Strategy & Insights teams to answer complex business questions and support data-led decision making.
  • Lead ad-hoc analyses and deep dives to uncover audience and content insights, including audience segmentation, consumption and behavior analysis, and findings that inform content development, programming, and broader business strategy.
  • Identify trends, opportunities, and anomalies in the data and clearly communicate the implications to both analytical and non-technical audiences.
  • Help ensure data quality and accuracy by identifying inconsistencies, validating results, and partnering with technical teams to resolve data and reporting issues.
  • Mentor and guide junior analysts by reviewing analyses, providing feedback, and helping raise the team’s overall analytical rigor and storytelling standards.
  • Contribute to improving analytical processes, reporting methodologies, and scalable approaches to cross-platform analytics.

Basic Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant quantitative field such as Business Analytics, Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, or a related discipline.
  • 3+ years of experience in analytics, preferably within media, digital, streaming, television, or another consumer-facing business.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to work quickly and accurately while producing high-quality, error-free results.
  • High proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including pivot tables, advanced formulas, lookups, modeling, and other analytical functionality.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in SQL and experience working with large datasets and/or cloud data warehouses such as Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, or equivalent platforms.
  • Experience with data visualization and reporting tools such as Tableau, Domo, or equivalent platforms.
  • Strong PowerPoint skills with demonstrated experience building clear, concise, executive-ready presentations and data narratives.
  • Fluency in the language of digital media and online measurement, including impressions, CTR, CPM, eCPM, uniques, pageviews, visits, viewability, starts, minutes, completion, and other engagement metrics.
  • Strong understanding of streaming and digital content performance metrics and audience behavior.
  • Experience conducting audience segmentation and analyzing audience consumption and behavioral patterns.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with experience presenting analytical findings to senior stakeholders and executive audiences.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently, and deliver high-quality analysis in a fast-paced environment.

Desired Characteristics

  • Experience analyzing cross-platform content performance within a streaming, subscription, or digital media business.
  • Experience using audience and content analytics to inform content development, programming, or strategic decisions.
  • Familiarity with TV and streaming business models and performance metrics.
  • Experience evaluating the relationship between content, audience behavior, and streaming performance.
  • Experience using data to develop forecasts, benchmarks, projections, or performance estimates.
  • Experience with statistical analysis, modeling, experimentation, or other advanced analytical techniques.
  • Strong data storytelling skills and the ability to turn complex analysis into a simple, compelling narrative.
  • Experience mentoring junior analysts or contributing to the development of analytical best practices.
  • Strong curiosity and interest in understanding the 'why' behind audience and content performance.
  • Spanish language proficiency is a plus.

The Senior Data Engineer, Data Mgmt and BI will design, build, and support scalable data solutions that enable trusted analytics, operational reporting, and data-driven decision making across the organization. This role will partner closely with product, analytics, engineering, and business stakeholders to translate ambiguous business needs into reliable technical solutions, while helping establish strong engineering standards across data pipelines, cloud platforms, data models, APIs, automation, and observability. The ideal candidate is a hands-on engineer who can work independently, mentor others, communicate clearly with technical and non-technical partners, and continuously improve how data is delivered, governed, tested, and supported in a fast-moving environment. 

  • Design, build, test, deploy, and maintain scalable data pipelines that ingest, transform, validate, and publish structured and semi-structured data from internal and external sources. 
  • Translate business and product requirements into technical designs, data models, integration patterns, and execution plans that support reliable analytics and operational workflows. 
  • Develop reusable, maintainable code using modern data engineering practices, with an emphasis on performance, testability, observability, and long-term supportability. 
  • Build and optimize batch, event-driven, and serverless data processing patterns using cloud-native services and distributed processing frameworks. 
  • Contribute to architecture decisions across data lake, warehouse, orchestration, metadata, API, and application integration patterns. 
  • Implement data quality checks, monitoring, alerting, and operational runbooks to ensure pipelines are accurate, reliable, and supportable in production. 
  • Design and maintain CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, deployment workflows, and infrastructure-as-code patterns that improve delivery speed and reduce operational risk. 
  • Partner with analytics, BI, product, and business teams to enable timely, trusted, and well-documented data products and reporting solutions. 
  • Evaluate source systems, APIs, files, data contracts, and transformation logic to identify risks, dependencies, data gaps, and opportunities for simplification. 
  • Participate in Agile delivery practices including sprint planning, backlog refinement, code reviews, release planning, incident response, and retrospectives. 
  • Mentor engineers, promote engineering best practices, and help raise the quality bar for code, documentation, testing, and production readiness. 
  • Create and maintain clear technical documentation, architecture diagrams, data lineage notes, implementation guides, and support materials as systems evolve. 
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
  • 5+ years of hands-on data engineering experience designing, building, testing, deploying, and supporting production data pipelines. 
  • Strong experience with data modeling, data architecture, ETL/ELT patterns, metadata, data quality, and data warehouse or data lake methodologies. 
  • Hands-on experience with cloud data engineering services such as AWS S3, Lambda, Athena, EMR or EMR Serverless, Glue, Step Functions, SNS, SQS, or comparable technologies. 
  • Strong programming experience in Scala, Java, SQL, or similar languages used for data processing, automation, and integration. 
  • Experience with distributed processing and modern data platforms such as Spark, Databricks, Snowflake, Apache Iceberg, Hive, Redshift, Postgres, SingleStore, or comparable technologies. 
  • Experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, source control workflows, automated testing, and deployment practices using GitHub Actions or similar tools. 
  • Strong understanding of Agile delivery, DevOps practices, incident response, production support, monitoring, and performance tuning. 
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot complex data, application, and platform issues. 
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to engineers, product owners, business stakeholders, and leadership. 

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS: 

  • Experience working in media, advertising, streaming, analytics, or other data-intensive business environments. 
  • Experience building pipelines that integrate files, APIs, event streams, relational systems, data lakes, and warehouse platforms. 
  • Experience with orchestration and workflow tools such as Apache Airflow, AWS Glue, Amazon MWAA, or similar platforms. 
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code, cloud security, IAM, secrets management, and secure engineering practices. 
  • Experience with BI and reporting tools such as Tableau, MicroStrategy, Looker, or similar tools. 
  • Experience designing performant data models, curated datasets, APIs, or interfaces that support analytics, reporting, and operational decision making. 
  • Familiarity with data governance, lineage, observability, data contracts, and production support practices. 
  • Ability to operate independently in ambiguous situations, drive clarity, identify dependencies, and move work from concept through delivery. 
  • Strong ownership mindset with the ability to balance delivery speed, engineering quality, stakeholder communication, and operational readiness. 
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams, including engineering, product, analytics, operations, vendors, and business stakeholders. 
  • Curiosity about emerging data engineering, automation, and AI-assisted development practices, with a practical focus on improving engineering productivity and solution quality.

The Rockefeller Center Operations (RCO) Facilities Engineering team manages all aspects of the Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing, Fire Alarm, Fire Protection (MEPFP), emergency power, BMS, mission-critical, and life-safety systems for the 24x7 operations in the NY, NJ, and Washington, DC campuses, encompassing approximately 2.5M square feet across 10 commercial buildings of production, technical, and office space.

The Sr. Director of Engineering will be responsible for oversight of engineering operations, including preventive and corrective maintenance, capital planning and project execution, environmental and energy performance and overall operational readiness of NBCUniversal infrastructure. Additionally, this individual should be able to balance the engineering aspects of the position while providing leadership, strategic insight and communication to peers and Sr. Executives.

These responsibilities include but are not limited to the following:

  • Ensure the integrity and operation of the facilities critical infrastructure systems which are paramount to our operational reliability, where the goal is a 99.999% on-air performance
  • Operate, maintain, and implement all critical and non-critical MEPFP systems including installation and monitoring of the BMS, EPMS, and other system dashboards
  • Manage a union represented staff of approximately 45 engineers and electricians providing 24/7/365 coverage for all facilities
  • Review work tickets, staff productivity, budgets, and vendor relationships for compliance with KPI’s
  • Develop and manage both operating and capital budgets
  • Implement continuous improvement programs to increase equipment reliability, reduce unplanned downtime, and extend asset life
  • Track and trend critical system usage and reserve capacity, providing clients with the necessary data needed to make informed business decisions and long-term planning
  • Respond and provide solutions to critical system issues. Lead incident reviews, root-cause analysis, and follow-up corrective actions for any significant or repeated system failures
  • Develop Method of Procedures (MOPs) and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for maintenance and required project work
  • Provide technical assistance and support to the Fire Life Safety team, with the operation, upgrade, and maintenance of the fire alarm systems throughout the facilities
  • Oversee all MEP projects and coordinate with the appropriate third-party engineers and contractors to review and execute such projects. Ability to perform detailed drawing review of MEP design and operational analysis as part of the design phase.
  • Long-term strategic planning of capital projects, including budgeting, scoping and execution
  • Collaborate and coordinate with business units on projects throughout the facility that utilize critical infrastructure systems
  • Oversee and schedule off hours work, either to cover major critical systems events such as system upgrades or cutovers, or to cover major broadcast events
  • Nurture relationship and maintain an open line of communication with ConEd and facility utility providers to manage/mitigate issues such as utility transients as well as coordinating utility preventative maintenance moratoriums, etc.
  • Coordinate and communicate with the landlords to address building infrastructure activities and events

Required Qualifications: 

  • 7+ years of experience in the management of critical MEPS systems
  • Demonstrates integrity, personal responsibility, and initiative
  • Understanding of the latest technologies and design philosophies for critical systems as well as thorough knowledge of all MEPS and BMS systems
  • Understanding of construction projects and methodologies
  • The ability to clearly articulate technical information to a variety of technical levels
  • The ability to develop and present presentation material in a concise and effective manner
  • Will require 24/7 availability to address emergencies and other unforeseen issues
  • Must be willing to work in New York and, at times in our NJ and Washington, DC facilities. Some oversight, and coordination, will be required for the Broadcast Operations Center located in Centennial, Colorado
  • Strong communication and presentations skills
  • Must be 18 years or older

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Hands-on field type experience is a plus
  • Ability to prioritize and multi-task
  • Effectively be able to lead by example

Platform Distribution and Partnerships is a division of NBCUniversal's media group responsible for the distribution and monetization of the company’s multi-billion-dollar linear and streaming services portfolio to pay-tv providers, NBC broadcast affiliates, consumer technology platforms and devices, and consumer brands. A key revenue-generator, the division is comprised of content distribution, affiliate relations, and strategic partnerships across NBC, Peacock, Bravo, Telemundo, and various FAST channels.

The Senior Director, Platform Distribution & Partnerships will report to the Senior Vice President, Platform Distribution & Partnerships and lead a team responsible for managing and growing v/MVPD, Peacock and FAST distribution. This role oversees the negotiation, execution, and ongoing management of distribution agreements across major v/MVPD, Peacock and FAST partners for NBCU’s portfolio of media assets. The Senior Director will drive strategic partner initiatives from incubation through implementation, ensuring strong execution and alignment with business objectives. This is a highly cross-functional role with touchpoints across Marketing, Product, Technology, Legal, Finance, Decision Sciences, Ad Sales, and Operations, requiring deep collaboration to maximize partner impact and optimize distribution strategies.

  • Structure, model, and evaluate partnership agreements to optimize terms and drive measurable business impact, balancing short-term objectives with long-term strategic positioning.
  • Act as a thought leader within the organization, influencing internal stakeholders and advocating for innovative distribution approaches to maximize reach and engagement.
  • Represent NBCUniversal at external meetings, industry events, and partner engagements, reinforcing the company’s position as a leader in media distribution.

NBCUniversal’s Ad Sales Creative Group, part of Rock Studios, is an industry-leading, award-winning team that develops groundbreaking creative campaigns and premium marketing experiences for the world’s most influential brands. We partner closely with advertisers to deliver custom, multi-platform solutions that leverage the power of NBCUniversal’s iconic content, talent, intellectual property and audiences across linear, streaming, digital, social and live experiences.

We are seeking a Senior Executive Producer to serve as one of the senior production leaders within Rock Studios. You will oversee a significant slate of advertising and marketing productions, partnering with creative, sales, clients and internal business teams to bring ambitious ideas from concept through final delivery.

As an ideal candidate, you will have deep production expertise with strategic leadership, strong creative instincts and exceptional business judgment. You'll need extensive experience producing integrated campaigns across a wide range of budgets, timelines and production models and be equally comfortable developing a production approach, negotiating a major production bid, finding smart solutions within limited resources, advising senior stakeholders, managing high-profile talent, leading a set, and solving problems when the unexpected happens.

This is both a hands-on Executive Producer and senior leadership role. You will directly oversee marquee projects while mentoring production teams, strengthening external partnerships and helping evolve how Rock Studios approaches production at scale.

This position reports directly to the Vice President, Production & Operations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as Executive Producer across a diverse portfolio of advertising, branded content and integrated marketing initiatives—from lean, fast-turn assignments to complex marquee productions—overseeing work from early creative development and scoping through production, post-production and final delivery.
  • Partner closely with creative teams to evaluate concepts for feasibility, identify the strongest production approach and translate ambitious ideas into exceptional, executable work while protecting the creative intent.
  • Lead production across a broad range of formats, including custom branded content, digital and social campaigns, talent-led content, original branded entertainment series.
  • Own the production strategy for assigned campaigns, including production methodology, schedules, budgets, staffing models, vendor strategy, risk assessment and contingency planning.
  • Develop and manage production budgets and estimates across a wide range of scales; oversee competitive bidding, bid leveling, vendor negotiations, cost reporting, change management and final reconciliation while maximizing creative value within available resources.
  • Lead director, production company and key vendor searches; identify and negotiate with the right creative and production partners for each assignment while maintaining a strong external network of directors, producers, crews, studios and post-production partners.
  • Oversee all phases of production and post-production, including pre-production, casting, locations, talent, crew, technical planning, on-set execution, editorial, motion graphics, VFX, music, sound, color, finishing, versioning and final delivery.
  • Partner closely with Legal, Finance, Music Services, Talent Relations and other internal teams to ensure productions meet NBCUniversal standards and business requirements.
  • Maintain strong working knowledge of production contracts, rights and clearances, music licensing, releases, insurance, labor requirements and applicable union and guild considerations.
  • Serve as a trusted senior production partner to internal stakeholders, clients and agencies, helping teams understand production implications, solve challenges and establish realistic scopes, budgets and timelines.
  • Participate in the development and pitching of major opportunities when production strategy, feasibility, budgeting or executional expertise is required.
  • Build trusted relationships across NBCUniversal and with clients, agencies and external partners, representing Rock Studios with credibility and authority in senior-level conversations.
  • Oversee and mentor producers and freelance production teams, establishing clear expectations and helping develop the next generation of production leaders.
  • Partner with the Vice President, Production & Operations on resource planning, production forecasting, staffing strategy, vendor strategy and allocation of production resources across the broader slate.
  • Help evolve Rock Studios’ production organization by identifying opportunities to improve workflows, methodologies and infrastructure while fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, creative ambition and responsible financial stewardship.
  • Proactively assess creative, financial, logistical, legal and reputational risk and develop solutions before those risks affect the work.

Requirements

  • Deep expertise in advertising and marketing production, with significant experience leading multi-platform campaigns across a range of scales and budgets—from lean, fast-turn productions to complex, high-budget work.
  • Extensive experience working within an advertising agency, creative agency, production company, brand studio, entertainment marketing organization or comparable creative production environment.
  • Ability to operate simultaneously as a strategic production leader and hands-on Executive Producer, leading multiple concurrent productions while maintaining command of creative, financial and logistical details.
  • Exceptional understanding of physical production and post-production workflows across live action, editorial, VFX, motion design, music, audio and finishing.
  • Strong command of production finance, including estimating, bidding, negotiating, cost management, forecasting and reconciliation, with the ability to maximize production value at varying budget levels.
  • Extensive experience managing directors, production companies, freelance producers, crews and post-production partners.
  • Strong knowledge of production business affairs, talent agreements, music and footage licensing, releases, rights and clearances, union and guild requirements and other production-related legal considerations.
  • Proven experience producing with celebrity or high-profile talent and managing sensitive, high-stakes productions.
  • Strong creative judgment with the ability to contribute meaningfully to creative conversations while understanding the distinction between creative leadership and production leadership.
  • Exceptional business judgment, communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to balance creative ambition, client objectives, production realities and financial responsibility while working with senior executives, clients, creative leaders and external partners.
  • Ability to lead through ambiguity, make decisions quickly and remain calm, pragmatic and solutions-oriented in high-pressure environments.
  • Strong leadership and mentorship skills with experience developing producers and building high-performing production teams.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.
  • 12+ years of professional production experience, including substantial experience in advertising, branded content, marketing or agency production.
  • Significant experience serving as an Executive Producer or equivalent senior production leader on integrated advertising and marketing campaigns.
  • Proven track record of delivering complex productions on time, on budget and at a consistently high creative standard.
  • Experience managing production budgets of varying scale and complexity and negotiating with production companies, vendors and creative partners.
  • Willingness to travel and work outside traditional business hours when productions require it.

Desired Characteristics

  • Experience within a leading advertising agency, creative agency, entertainment company, network, streamer or sophisticated in-house brand studio.
  • Experience with both traditional advertising production and emerging formats across streaming, digital, social, experiential and creator-led content.
  • A deep and current network of directors, production companies, producers, crews and post-production partners.
  • A reputation for being an excellent partner to creative teams -- someone who finds ways to make ambitious ideas happen rather than simply identifying limitations.
  • Strong executive presence paired with a low-ego, collaborative leadership style.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset and comfort working in an environment where the work, technology and production models continue to evolve.
  • Passion for outstanding creative work and a track record of building the teams and production environments required to achieve it.

Hybrid: This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time. 

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website.

job.title: Senior Producer (Pillar) | Producteur(trice) principal(e) (Pilier)
job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

NBCUniversal est l’un des leaders mondiaux du secteur des médias et du divertissement. Nous créons des contenus d’exception, que nous diffusons à travers notre portefeuille de films, de programmes télévisés et de services de streaming, et que nous donnons vie grâce à nos parcs à thème internationaux, nos produits grand public et nos expériences. Nous détenons et exploitons des marques de premier plan dans les domaines du divertissement et de l’information, notamment NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, les chaînes locales NBC, Bravo et Peacock, notre service de streaming premium financé par la publicité. Nous produisons et distribuons des films et des programmes de divertissement de premier ordre grâce à nos puissants studios de cinéma et de télévision, notamment Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation et Focus Features, ainsi qu’aux quatre studios de télévision mondiaux regroupés sous la bannière Universal Studio Group. Nous exploitons également des parcs à thème et des expériences de premier plan à travers le monde via Universal Destinations & Experiences, notamment l’Universal Orlando Resort, qui abrite l’Universal Epic Universe, et Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal est une filiale de Comcast Corporation. Rendez-vous sur www.nbcuniversal.com pour plus d’informations.

Notre impact repose sur l’amélioration des communautés dans lesquelles vivent et travaillent nos employés, nos clients et nos publics. Nous avons une riche tradition d’engagement social et veillons à ce que nos employés aient la possibilité de s’investir au sein de leurs communautés. Nous défendons une culture inclusive et nous nous efforçons d’attirer et de former une main-d’œuvre talentueuse afin de créer et de proposer un large éventail de contenus reflétant notre monde.

We’re looking for an experienced Senior Producer (Pillar) in AAA game development to support delivery across a large-scale project. You will partner closely with the Product Owner, and pod leads to translating priorities into clear plans, facilitating key Scrum rituals, removing blockers, managing dependencies, and supporting team health across the pillar. 

This role combines game production experience, agile facilitation, and day-to-day team leadership. You will help create a collaborative, transparent, and accountable environment where teams can deliver high-quality work with focus and clarity. If it sounds like you, we’d love to meet you! 

Key Responsibilities: 

  • Translate pillar priorities into sprint plans, team commitments, and clear delivery expectations.  
  • Facilitate planning, refinement, reviews, retrospectives, and cross-pod coordination rituals.  
  • Maintain visibility on progress, risks, dependencies, capacity, and delivery confidence.  
  • Keep backlogs clear, prioritized, and actionable in partnership with the Product Owner, pod leads, and craft directors.  
  • Identify blockers early and help teams resolve or escalate them effectively.  
  • Support communication across pods so teams have the context they need to make decisions.  
  • Improve workflows, rituals, and delivery habits through retrospectives and team feedback.  
  • Coordinate execution against production pipelines, milestones, and broader project goals.  
  • Reinforce a culture of collaboration, transparency, ownership, adaptability, and shared responsibility for quality. 

Nous recherchons un(e) Senior Producer expérimenté(e) (Pilier), dans le développement de jeux AAA afin de soutenir la livraison d’un projet à grande échelle. Vous collaborerez étroitement avec le Product Owner et les leads de pods afin de traduire les priorités en plans clairs, d’animer les principaux rituels Scrum, de lever les blocages, de gérer les dépendances et de soutenir la santé des équipes au sein du pilier. 

Ce rôle combine une expérience en production de jeux, en facilitation agile et en leadership opérationnel au quotidien. Vous contribuerez à créer un environnement collaboratif, transparent et responsable, où les équipes peuvent livrer un travail de haute qualité avec concentration et clarté. Si ce poste vous correspond, nous serions ravis de vous rencontrer ! 

Responsabilités Principales:

  • Traduire les priorités du pilier en plans de sprint, engagements des équipes et attentes de livraison claires.  
  • Animer les rituels agiles clés : planification, refinement, revues, rétrospectives et coordination inter‑pods.  
  • Maintenir une visibilité sur l’avancement, les risques, les dépendances, la capacité et le niveau de confiance de la livraison.  
  • Maintenir des backlogs clairs, priorisés et exploitables en partenariat avec le Product Owner, les leads de pods et les directeurs de discipline.  
  • Identifier les blocages en amont et aider les équipes à les résoudre ou à les escalader efficacement.  
  • Soutenir la communication entre les pods afin que les équipes disposent du contexte nécessaire à la prise de décision.  
  • Améliorer les flux de travail, les rituels et les habitudes de livraison grâce aux rétrospectives et aux retours des équipes.  
  • Coordonner l’exécution en lien avec les pipelines de production, les jalons et les objectifs globaux du projet.  
  • Renforcer une culture de collaboration, de transparence, de responsabilisation, d’adaptabilité et de responsabilité collective en matière de qualité. 

Basic Qualifications:

  • Minimum 10 years of experience in AAA game production, content production, asset production, or related production roles. Proven experience in game production, ideally on complex AAA or large-scale projects.  
  • Experience operating as a Scrum Master, agile producer, delivery lead, or senior producer supporting multiple teams.  
  • Strong understanding of Scrum, Kanban, or hybrid production approaches.  
  • Ability to partner effectively with Product Owners, pod leads, craft directors, and multidisciplinary development teams.  
  • Strong facilitation skills, with the ability to run productive meetings, clarify decisions, and drive alignment.  
  • Experience with sprint planning, backlog refinement, retrospectives, risk tracking, dependency management, and delivery follow-up.  
  • Experience with milestone planning, sprint execution, production gates, and hybrid agile models. 
  • Ability to manage cross-team dependencies, identify risks early, and create transparency around delivery confidence.  
  • Excellent communication, problem-solving, and collaboration skills.  
  • Ability to manage ambiguity and help teams break complex goals into executable plans.  
  • Experience working with JIRA or similar project management tools.  
  • Demonstrated ability to build trust and support a positive, collaborative development culture. 
  • Experience supporting multiple teams within a product area, pillar, or large-scale development initiative. 

Desired Qualifications:

  • Experience supporting multidisciplinary pods, feature teams, or cross-functional strike teams.  
  • Scrum Master certification or formal agile training.  
  • Experience with live service development, platform development, UGC systems, or large-scale online games.   
  • Experience managing technical pipelines, scalable systems, cross team cross function dependencies. 
  • Background in a development discipline such as design, engineering, art, QA, technical art, or production technology.  
  • Experience working with external development partners, outsourcing teams, or co-development vendors. 

Eligibility Requirements:

  • Interested candidates must apply to be considered.
  • Must be willing to work in our Montreal office a minimum of 4 days a week.
  • Must be willing to work overtime when required, in accordance with Quebec labor standards.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in Canada.
  • Must be willing to travel for work related business, if necessary

Qualifications De Base: 

  • Minimum de 10 ans d’expérience en production de jeux AAA, production de contenu, production d’assets ou dans des rôles de production équivalents. Expérience avérée en production de jeux, idéalement sur des projets AAA complexes ou à grande échelle.  
  • Expérience en tant que Scrum Master, producer agile, responsable de la livraison ou senior producer accompagnant plusieurs équipes.  
  • Bonne compréhension des approches de production Scrum, Kanban ou hybrides.  
  • Capacité à collaborer efficacement avec les Product Owners, les leads de pods, les directeurs de discipline et des équipes de développement multidisciplinaires.  
  • Solides compétences en facilitation, avec la capacité d’animer des réunions productives, de clarifier les décisions et de favoriser l’alignement.  
  • Expérience en planification de sprints, refinement des backlogs, rétrospectives, suivi des risques, gestion des dépendances et suivi de la livraison.  
  • Expérience en planification des jalons, exécution des sprints, étapes de production et modèles agiles hybrides. 
  • Capacité à gérer les dépendances inter-équipes, à identifier les risques en amont et à assurer la transparence sur la confiance de livraison.  
  • Excellentes compétences en communication, résolution de problèmes et collaboration.  
  • Capacité à gérer l’ambiguïté et à aider les équipes à transformer des objectifs complexes en plans exécutables.  
  • Expérience avec JIRA ou des outils de gestion de projet similaires.  
  • Capacité démontrée à instaurer la confiance et à soutenir une culture de développement positive et collaborative. 
  • Expérience en support de plusieurs équipes au sein d’un domaine produit, d’un pilier ou d’une initiative de développement à grande échelle. 

Qualifications Souhaitées:

  • Expérience en support de pods multidisciplinaires, d’équipes feature ou d’équipes transverses (strike teams).  
  • Certification Scrum Master ou formation formelle en méthodes agiles.  
  • Expérience en développement de live service, développement de plateformes, systèmes UGC ou jeux en ligne à grande échelle.  
  • Expérience dans la gestion de pipelines techniques, de systèmes scalables et de dépendances inter-équipes et inter-fonctionnelles. 
  • Formation ou expérience dans une discipline de développement telle que le design, l’ingénierie, l’art, le QA, l’art technique ou la technologie de production.  
  • Expérience de collaboration avec des partenaires de développement externes, des équipes d’externalisation ou des prestataires en co-développement. 

Exigences D’admissibilité:

  • Doit être disposé·e à travailler dans nos bureaux de Montréal au minimum quatre (4) jours par semaine.   
  • Doit être disposé·e à effectuer des heures supplémentaires lorsque requis, conformément aux normes du travail du Québec.     
  • Doit être légalement autorisé·e à travailler au Canada.
  • Doit être disposé·e à se déplacer pour des raisons professionnelles, au besoin.

job.title: Senior Producer - Pillar | Responsable senior de la production - Pilier
job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

RESPONSIBILITIES

We’re looking for an experienced Senior Producer in AAA game development to lead production strategy and delivery planning for a product pillar.

Partnering closely with the Product Owner, craft directors, pod leads, and production leadership, you will ensure the pillar goals are translated into a clear, executable delivery plan aligned with project milestones and production gates. You will maintain the broader view across the pillar, connecting work across pods, validating dependencies and integration points with other pillars, identifying delivery risks and gaps, and ensuring teams are collectively progressing toward agreed outcomes.

This role requires someone who can move comfortably between strategic planning and execution oversight: you will focus on ensuring that the overall pillar plan is coherent, realistic, integrated with the broader project, and on track for delivery.

· Own the pillar delivery plan, translating product priorities into clear milestone and gate commitments.
· Partner with the Product Owner and craft leadership on scope, sequencing, priorities, and delivery expectations.
· Guide Associate Producers across pods to keep pod plans aligned with pillar outcomes, dependencies, and commitments.
· Align with other Senior Producers and project leadership on cross-pillar dependencies and the broader project roadmap.
· Represent the pillar in executive and stakeholder reviews, presenting plans, progress, risks, trade-offs, and key decisions.
· Track progress against milestone and gate objectives, identifying risks, gaps, and misalignment early.
· Maintain visibility on scope, capacity, dependencies, risks, and delivery confidence across the pillar.
· Challenge plans and assumptions to ensure commitments remain achievable and aligned with project priorities.
· Assess the impact of scope or priority changes on dependencies, milestones, and gate deliverables.
· Ensure deliverables and validation criteria are clear ahead of gates and key reviews.
· Support resolution and escalation of issues affecting broader pillar delivery.
· Improve pillar-level planning, coordination, and delivery practices while reinforcing accountability and collaboration.

RESPONSABILITÉS

Nous recherchons une personne possédant une solide expérience à titre de producteur senior en développement de jeux AAA afin de piloter la stratégie de production et la planification de la livraison pour un pilier du produit.

En étroite collaboration avec le Product Owner, les directions des disciplines, les responsables de pods et la direction de la production, vous veillerez à ce que les objectifs du pilier soient traduits en un plan de livraison clair et réalisable, aligné sur les jalons du projet et les gates de production. Vous maintiendrez une vue d’ensemble du pilier en reliant le travail entre les différents pods, en validant les dépendances et les points d’intégration avec les autres piliers, en repérant les risques et les écarts liés à la livraison et en veillant à ce que les équipes progressent collectivement vers les résultats convenus.

Ce rôle exige une personne capable de passer aisément de la planification stratégique au suivi de l’exécution. Vous veillerez principalement à ce que le plan global du pilier soit cohérent, réaliste, intégré à l’ensemble du projet et en bonne voie d’être livré.

· Prendre en charge le plan de livraison du pilier en traduisant les priorités du produit en engagements clairs pour les jalons et les gates.
· Collaborer avec le Product Owner et la direction des disciplines sur la portée, le séquencement, les priorités et les attentes en matière de livraison.
· Guider les producteurs associés des différents pods afin que leurs plans demeurent alignés sur les résultats, les dépendances et les engagements du pilier.
· S’aligner avec les autres producteurs seniors et la direction du projet sur les dépendances entre les piliers et la feuille de route globale du projet.
· Représenter le pilier lors des revues avec la direction et les parties prenantes en présentant les plans, l’avancement, les risques, les compromis et les décisions clés.
· Suivre l’avancement par rapport aux objectifs des jalons et des gates et repérer rapidement les risques, les écarts et les désalignements.
· Maintenir une visibilité sur la portée, la capacité, les dépendances, les risques et le niveau de confiance quant à la livraison à l’échelle du pilier.
· Remettre en question les plans et les hypothèses afin de veiller à ce que les engagements demeurent réalisables et alignés sur les priorités du projet.
· Évaluer l’incidence des changements de portée ou de priorités sur les dépendances, les jalons et les livrables associés aux gates.
· Veiller à ce que les livrables et les critères de validation soient clairement définis avant les gates et les revues clés.
· Soutenir la résolution et l’escalade des enjeux ayant une incidence sur la livraison globale du pilier.
· Améliorer les pratiques de planification, de coordination et de livraison à l’échelle du pilier tout en renforçant la responsabilisation et la collaboration.

Basic Requirements:

· 10+ years of experience in AAA game production or related production roles on complex, large-scale projects.
· Experience with live games, UGC, or evolving game ecosystems.
· Experience partnering closely with Game Design teams.
· Strong interest in AI technologies and game-development applications.
· Advanced JIRA expertise, including workflows, dashboards, and production pipelines.
· Ability to adapt communication to different audiences, from development teams to executives.

· Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills.
· Ability to operate at both strategic and tactical levels.
· Adaptable and comfortable working in evolving environments.

Desired Requirements:

· Porting experience.
· Mobile development experience.
· Experience managing technical pipelines, scalable systems, or complex cross-functional dependencies.
· Strong working knowledge of a development discipline such as design, engineering, art, QA, or technical art.
· Experience working with external development, outsourcing, or co-development partners.
· Experience in organizations combining Agile team execution with milestone and gate-based production planning.

Exigences de base :

· 10 ans ou plus d’expérience en production de jeux AAA ou dans des rôles de production connexes sur des projets complexes de grande envergure.
· Expérience avec les jeux en exploitation, l’UGC ou les écosystèmes de jeu évolutifs.
· Expérience de collaboration étroite avec des équipes de Game Design.
· Intérêt marqué pour les technologies d’AI et leurs applications au développement de jeux.
· Expertise avancée de JIRA, notamment en matière de workflows, de dashboards et de pipelines de production.
· Capacité à adapter les communications à différents publics, des équipes de développement à la direction.

· Solides aptitudes en pensée critique et en résolution de problèmes.
· Capacité à intervenir tant sur le plan stratégique que tactique.
· Grande capacité d’adaptation et aisance à travailler dans des environnements en évolution.

Exigences souhaitées :

· Expérience en portage.
· Expérience en développement mobile.
· Expérience de la gestion de pipelines techniques, de systèmes évolutifs ou de dépendances interfonctionnelles complexes.
· Solide connaissance pratique d’une discipline de développement comme le design, l’ingénierie, l’art, le QA ou l’art technique.
· Expérience de collaboration avec des partenaires de développement externe, d’externalisation ou de codéveloppement.
· Expérience au sein d’organisations combinant l’exécution des équipes en mode Agile avec une planification de production fondée sur des jalons et des gates.

job.title: Senior Product Manager, Programmatic Demand
job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

NBCUniversal’s Ad Sales One Platform Ad Products team builds and operates the systems that power NBCUniversal’s $10B+ advertising business, including core ad serving, programmatic, and activation capabilities across CTV and digital.

Within AP&S, the Programmatic Demand team is responsible for product strategy and development of demand-side capabilities across NBCU’s programmatic ecosystem.

We are seeking a Senior Product Manager, Programmatic Demand to drive the evolution of how programmatic demand is optimized, scaled, and productized across NBCU’s streaming footprint.

Role Overview

This role focuses on developing scalable products, systems, and workflows that improve programmatic demand performance across NBCU’s ad tech stack.

You will identify inefficiencies in auction dynamics, platform behavior, and partner integrations—and translate those insights into durable product solutions rather than one-off optimizations.

A key focus area will be live event monetization, where concurrency, DSP behavior, and system constraints introduce complex demand-side challenges that require structured, product-led solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Auction Performance & Optimization Systems

  • Design and build scalable solutions (tools, workflows, automation) to analyze and optimize auction performance across bid rate, win rate, fill, pacing, and timeouts
  • Translate performance insights into productized capabilities (e.g., automated optimization frameworks, configuration layers, or decisioning logic)
  • Partner with Engineering to implement systems that continuously improve demand efficiency and revenue outcomes

Live Event Monetization (CTV Focus)

  • Identify performance gaps and system constraints in live event auctions (e.g., scaling limits, DSP throttling, timeout behavior)
  • Drive development of product solutions to increase stability, scalability, and performance in high-concurrency environments
  • Partner cross-functionally and externally to ensure platform and partner readiness for tentpole events

Platform Configuration & Deal Strategy

  • Define product-driven approaches to deal structure, configuration standards, and optimization across PG and PMP
  • Improve how platform settings (e.g., in FreeWheel and partner DSPs) translate into predictable demand performance
  • Productize best practices to reduce inefficiencies and variability in deal execution

Partner Integrations & Performance

  • Identify systemic partner performance issues and drive long-term solutions (vs. one-off fixes)
  • Inform product strategy based on partner capabilities, limitations, and evolving DSP behavior

Additional Responsibilities

  • Product Development & Testing: Own requirements and validation for demand optimization features and experiments
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Align Product, Engineering, Ad Ops, Sales, and Strategy on priorities and outcomes
  • Issue Resolution: Lead root cause analysis and improve systems/processes to prevent recurring issues
  • Documentation & Enablement: Translate product functionality into clear internal guidance and GTM alignment
  • Market Insights: Monitor industry trends and inform product direction

Qualifications

  • Strong understanding of programmatic advertising ecosystems, including digital ad serving, measurement frameworks, identity signals, and privacy controls—and how these components work together to enable scalable, addressable advertising across CTV and digital environments
  • Experience implementing and validating measurement and data pipelines, with a focus on ensuring consistency and accuracy across platforms (e.g., bid requests, attribution, viewability, IVT, and delivery metrics)
  • Solid working knowledge of privacy regulations and industry signals (e.g., CCPA, GDPR, GPP, ATT, COPPA), and their implications for data usage, identity resolution, targeting, and measurement in a programmatic context
  • Experience understanding identity and user signals (e.g., device IDs, platform identifiers, consent signals) to enable privacy-compliant audience targeting and optimization
  • Proven ability to translate complex technical, business, and regulatory requirements into scalable, productized solutions - particularly within programmatic demand, auction dynamics, or partner integrations
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience diagnosing performance gaps, data discrepancies, and system inefficiencies, and driving root-cause resolution in production environments

job.description:

NBCUniversal est l’un des leaders mondiaux du secteur des médias et du divertissement. Nous créons des contenus d’exception, que nous diffusons à travers notre portefeuille de films, de programmes télévisés et de services de streaming, et que nous donnons vie grâce à nos parcs à thème internationaux, nos produits grand public et nos expériences. Nous détenons et exploitons des marques de premier plan dans les domaines du divertissement et de l’information, notamment NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, les chaînes locales NBC, Bravo et Peacock, notre service de streaming premium financé par la publicité. Nous produisons et distribuons des films et des programmes de divertissement de premier ordre grâce à nos puissants studios de cinéma et de télévision, notamment Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation et Focus Features, ainsi qu’aux quatre studios de télévision mondiaux regroupés sous la bannière Universal Studio Group. Nous exploitons également des parcs à thème et des expériences de premier plan à travers le monde via Universal Destinations & Experiences, notamment l’Universal Orlando Resort, qui abrite l’Universal Epic Universe, et Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal est une filiale de Comcast Corporation. Rendez-vous sur www.nbcuniversal.com pour plus d’informations.

Notre impact repose sur l’amélioration des communautés dans lesquelles vivent et travaillent nos employés, nos clients et nos publics. Nous avons une riche tradition d’engagement social et veillons à ce que nos employés aient la possibilité de s’investir au sein de leurs communautés. Nous défendons une culture inclusive et nous nous efforçons d’attirer et de former une main-d’œuvre talentueuse afin de créer et de proposer un large éventail de contenus reflétant notre monde.

We are seeking a Reinforcement Learning Engineer with experience manipulating virtual environments to train autonomous agents. This role focuses on the design of robust simulation environments, reward structures, and policy architectures that can navigate complex, multi-sensor landscapes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Cross-Functional Coordination: Work with partner ML and Annotation engineers and TPMs to spec out data, simulation, and training requirements.
  • Environment Design: Build and maintain high-fidelity 2D/3D simulation environments (using tools like Unity, Unreal, or Isaac Sim) that serve as the training ground for RL agents.
  • Reward Engineering: Design and tune complex reward functions that align agent behavior with product goals and safety constraints.
  • Algorithm Implementation: Develop and optimize RL algorithms (e.g., PPO, SAC, or Offline RL) capable of handling high-dimensional 3D observation spaces.
  • Sim-to-Real Strategy: Analyze the "reality gap" and implement domain randomization or adaptation techniques to ensure models perform reliably in real-world scenarios.

Nous sommes à la recherche d’un(e) ingénieur(e) en apprentissage par renforcement ayant de l’expérience dans la création et l’exploitation d’environnements virtuels pour l’entraînement d’agents autonomes. Ce rôle consiste à concevoir des environnements de simulation robustes, des structures de récompense et des architectures de politiques capables d’évoluer dans des contextes complexes et multi-capteurs.

Vous jouerez un rôle clé dans le rapprochement entre simulation et performance réelle en développant des systèmes RL évolutifs et en garantissant un comportement fiable des agents dans des conditions variées.

  • Collaboration interfonctionnelle : Travailler avec les ingénieurs ML, les équipes d’annotation et les TPM afin de définir les besoins en données, en simulation et en entraînement.
  • Conception d’environnements : Développer et maintenir des environnements de simulation 2D/3D à haute fidélité à l’aide d’outils tels que Unity, Unreal ou Isaac Sim.
  • Ingénierie des récompenses : Concevoir et optimiser des fonctions de récompense afin d’aligner le comportement des agents avec les objectifs produit et les contraintes de sécurité.
  • Implémentation d’algorithmes : Développer et optimiser des algorithmes d’apprentissage par renforcement (ex. : PPO, SAC, RL hors ligne) adaptés à des espaces d’observation à haute dimension.
  • Stratégie sim-to-real : Réduire l’écart entre simulation et réalité à l’aide de techniques comme la randomisation de domaine et l’adaptation afin d’assurer des performances fiables en conditions réelles.
  • Education: Graduate degree (Master’s or PhD) in Robotics, Computer Science, AI, or a related field with a focus on Reinforcement Learning, Imitation Learning, or other Online Machine Learning fields.
  • Professional Experience: Proven experience as an RL Engineer or Research Engineer in a fast-paced environment.
  • Industry Context: Prior experience in industries with complex multi-disciplinary teams such as robotics, smart grids, precision agriculture, game development, or aerospace.

Technical Proficiency:

  • Core Tools: Fluency with Python, Git, and the Unix shell.
  • RL Frameworks: Deep familiarity with frameworks like Ray Rllib, Stable Baselines3, or CleanRL.
  • Physics & 3D Engines: Experience with physics engines (MuJoCo, Bullet) or 3D game engines.
  • Ecosystem: Familiarity with collaborative tools such as Jira/Confluence, Slack, a Git server, and an experiment tracking framework.

Attributes:

  • Strong Mathematical Background: Essential for understanding Markov Decision Processes (MDPs) and gradient-based optimization.
  • High Attention to Detail: Critical for debugging non-deterministic agent behaviors and ensuring environment parity.

 

  • Formation : Maîtrise ou Doctorat en robotique, informatique, intelligence artificielle ou domaine connexe avec une spécialisation en apprentissage par renforcement, imitation ou apprentissage en ligne.
  • Expérience : Expérience démontrée en tant qu’ingénieur(e) en apprentissage par renforcement ou en recherche dans un environnement dynamique.
  • Contexte industriel : Une expérience dans des secteurs multidisciplinaires tels que la robotique, les réseaux intelligents, l’agriculture de précision, les jeux vidéo ou l’aérospatiale est fortement valorisée.

Compétences techniques

  • Outils principaux : Excellente maîtrise de Python, Git et des environnements Unix.
  • Frameworks RL : Expérience avec des frameworks tels que Ray RLlib, Stable Baselines3 ou CleanRL.
  • Physique et simulation : Expérience avec des moteurs physiques (MuJoCo, Bullet) ou des environnements de simulation 3D.
  • Écosystème : Familiarité avec des outils collaboratifs tels que Jira, Confluence, Slack, les workflows Git et les plateformes de suivi d’expériences.

Qualités recherchées

  • Solides bases mathématiques : Bonne compréhension des processus de décision de Markov (MDP) et de l’optimisation basée sur le gradient.
  • Rigueur et précision : Capacité à déboguer des systèmes non déterministes et à assurer la cohérence et la précision des environnements de simulation.

job.description:

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

The Sous Chef – Margaritaville, will be responsible for directing, managing and successfully operating a high volume branded concept on CityWalk. As Sous Chef, the position will be a primary “go-to” for the kitchen team and responsible for the functions and flow of the back of the house.

The Sous Chef is responsible for ensuring that the food served always meets or exceeds standards of excellence. While this position will report to the Restaurant Chef, this position is responsible for setting the expectations for all kitchen team members to maximize productivity. This individual must be able to work effectively with limited supervision and demonstrate leadership to motivate others.

Essential Functions:

  • Drive operating profit goals and sales.
  • Optimize profits by controlling food, beverage, and labor costs.
  • Consistently achieve operational excellence.
  • Develop and retain exceptional talent.
  • Ensure compliance with all local, state, and federal laws regarding food quality, safety, labor, and employment.
  • Partner with Human Resources to train and develop restaurant leaders at every level.
  • Maintain or exceed weekly budgeted variable operation profit by controlling cost of goods & variable labor.
  • Communicate restaurant results to the Restaurant Chef and General Manager with recommendations for improvement.
  • Ensure high Team Member and Guest Engagement.
  • Mentors and counsels team members and enforce appropriate policies and procedures ensuring that everything is within compliance of venue and company standards.
  • Promote company's mission and values.
  • Ensure company policy and brand standards are followed.
  • Optimize profits by controlling food, beverage, and labor costs.
  • Prepare and present hourly team member reviews.
  • Complete all tasks assigned by the Executive Sous Chef on time.

Responsibilities Include:

  • Order supplies, food and ingredients based on rapidly shifting demand.
  • Hire and train kitchen staff in specific stations, and cross-train as necessary.  
  • Create schedules for kitchen staff to ensure there are always enough workers to meet the demand.
  • Maintain inventory levels and conduct full inventories.
  • Schedule and oversee necessary maintenance and repairs on kitchen appliances.  
  • Assist the management team with menu changes and adjustments. 
  • Respond personally to guest questions, special recipe requests and complaints.
  • Maintain a clean workspace and all times.
  • Work at a fast and efficient pace. The Sous Chef is a “working chef.”
  • Ability to read and follow recipes as well as follow up with prep and line cooks food preparation.
  • Has a thorough knowledge of food cost, labor cost and inventory functions.
  • Chemical safety comprehension.
  • Analyze financial reports to quickly identify and address trends and issues in area performance, including cost of goods, variable labor, and profitability.
  • Exceed annual operating profit targets.

Basic Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Hospitality Management or a related field; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Minimum of 5 years of management experience in high quality chain or independent restaurant group.
  • Thorough knowledge of MS Excel, Word, PowerPoint and POS systems.
  • Ability to work rotating schedules, holidays, weekends and nights.

Desired Characteristics:

  • Proven track record and experience in the development and implementation of strong training programs and tools developed to reduce employee attrition and create internal culture of development for staff.
  • Excellent management skills in leading a diverse team and working under tight and fast track deadlines.
  • Strong P&L experience, command of budgeting and costs controls.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication, interpersonal, organizational and multi-tasking skills.
  • Ability to effectively communicate across all lines of business, and with all levels of management.
  • Strong organizational, planning, delegation, mentoring and coaching skills.
  • A strong passion for delivering the highest quality of guest service and superior food concepts.

Additional Requirements:

  • (Required On-Site: This position is required to be performed full-time from an NBCUniversal-designated worksite.

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website. Salary range: $70,304 - 75,000 (SIC eligible)

Universal Pictures Home Entertainment (UPHE) markets and distributes NBC Universal’s film and television offerings across transactional digital and disc formats worldwide. UPHE distributes through its own operations in parts of North America, Europe, Asia Pacific and South America and through a variety of licensee partnerships across major territories around the world.
