The Senior Multi-Platform Producer/Booker is responsible for producing and line producing live news programming and developing compelling content across broadcast, streaming, digital, and social platforms. This senior editorial role requires strong live-production experience, excellent editorial judgment, and the ability to manage all elements of a show from concept through air.

The Senior Producer will play a key role in the control room, building and managing rundowns, responding to breaking news, coordinating correspondents and live elements, and making real-time editorial decisions. The position also identifies newsworthy stories, books high-profile guests and newsmakers, and produces interviews and segments across multiple platforms.

Responsibilities

  • Line produce live newscasts, special reports, and breaking-news coverage, managing the rundown and making real-time editorial and timing decisions from the control room
  • Lead the editorial and production execution of programming across linear television, streaming/FAST, digital, and social platforms
  • Build, organize, and continuously update rundowns based on breaking news and evolving editorial priorities
  • Coordinate anchors, correspondents, reporters, control room teams, and field crews to execute live programming
  • Manage live shots, satellite interviews, remote guests, video, graphics, banners, scripts, and other production elements
  • Make quick editorial decisions during live coverage while maintaining accuracy, balance, standards, and production quality
  • Produce live and taped interviews and segments from initial concept and research through final execution
  • Identify, pitch, and develop strong news, political, and community stories that can work across multiple platforms
  • Book high-profile guests, newsmakers, experts, political figures, analysts, and community leaders
  • Research topics and prepare strong, editorially sound interview questions and briefing materials
  • Write and edit scripts, teases, banners, headlines, and other editorial copy
  • Adapt content and storytelling for the specific needs of broadcast, streaming, digital, and social audiences
  • Collaborate closely with executive producers, assignment editors, correspondents, reporters, digital teams, and newsroom leadership
  • Help plan and execute major breaking-news events, elections, debates, town halls, special events, and other large-scale coverage
  • Maintain strong relationships with sources, press offices, publicists, experts, and community leaders
  • Provide editorial guidance and mentorship to producers, associate producers, and bookers
  • Work effectively under intense deadline pressure and adjust programming quickly as news develops

job.description:

We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

The Global Streaming Platform powers the best entertainment experiences from Peacock, NOW/WOW, and SkyShowtime. When you join our team, you'll work across our dynamic portfolio supported by media industry leaders Comcast, NBCUniversal, and Sky. With unequalled scale, our teams make the most out of every opportunity to collaborate and learn from one another. We're always looking for ways to innovate faster, accelerate our growth, and consistently offer a best-in-class consumer experience across more than 70 countries. Most importantly, we're backed by a culture of respect. We embrace authenticity and inspire our people to thrive.  

The Viewing Product team lives and breathes design excellence. We’re a cross-functional team of product managers, UX researchers, UX designers, product engineers, and data scientists. Here you’ll find more than a job. You’ll find a fast-paced, high-performance team of forward-thinking colleagues that want to be at the epicenter of technology, sports, news, TV, movies and more. Our work is central to our mission to deliver a future-focused user experience across our best-in-class streaming platforms. Together, we’re committed to getting customers to content they love, faster and more easily. 

 

What You’ll Do:

As a Sr. Product Design Manager on the Discovery & Playback Experience team, you will lead, grow, and mentor a small team of designers while remaining hands-on as a senior individual contributor. You’ll have the unique opportunity to define the vision, strategy, and design direction for how audiences find and watch content on Peacock. You’ll strike a balance between guiding your team's work with owning high-priority projects yourself — ensuring alignment with our organization's goals, design principles, and long-term product vision.

Our team is focused on delivering best-in-class discovery and playback experiences with a strong emphasis on TV, alongside mobile and web. From helping viewers find their next favorite show to crafting intuitive playback, live events, replays, and lean-back viewing, you'll help build experiences that meet viewers where they are and elevate how they watch.

This role calls for a true player-coach: someone who can translate user needs into elegant, cross-platform experiences while also coaching a small team of designers to do the same. You'll drive innovation, foster collaboration across disciplines, and shape the future of how audiences discover and connect with content on Peacock — all while staying close to the craft.

As a Sr. Product Design Manager, you will:

  • Deliver production-ready UX designs aligned with overarching business and UX goals for domestic and international audiences.
  • Manage, coach, and grow a small team of product designers — running critiques, weighing cross-functional priorities, supporting career development, and defining patterns and practices for the team and the product.
  • Drive stakeholder and leadership alignment around research insights and design decisions.
  • Collaborate with the larger UX team around ideation and concept explorations throughout project lifecycles; facilitate and drive UX solutions, discussions, and planning while maintaining project oversight.
  • Identify actionable insights and ensure they align with long-term design and product strategies.
  • Balance people leadership with hands-on design work, staying close enough to the details to lead by example.
  • Maintain a critical eye and an obsessive attention to detail.

Experience and Skills Must-Haves

You're a seasoned designer and recognized people leader with relentlessly high standards and deep operational knowledge across every aspect of UX and product design — especially in crafting intuitive discovery and playback experiences for TV, mobile, and web.

You're thoughtful and curious, always learning from both viewers and teammates. You stay fully versed in consumer digital product trends, emerging technologies, and interaction models shaping the future of how audiences find and watch content.

You listen to the voice of the viewer and let data guide your decisions — blending qualitative insights with performance metrics to design experiences that resonate.

You identify the most impactful ideas and push them through a rigorous course of evaluation, experimentation, and release — from early concept to launch.

You're fluid and adaptable — able to pivot seamlessly between managing your team and contributing as a seasoned designer, across projects and priorities.

You're a storyteller and strong communicator, able to articulate design rationale and rally cross-functional partners around a shared vision — and to coach your team to do the same.

You can speak confidently to industry best practices, evolving viewer behaviors, market strategies, and competitor standards in the streaming space.

You're scrappy, driven, and the natural owner of both bold ideas and practical, high-quality output — equally comfortable managing a team, defining the big picture, or jumping into the details yourself.

You thrive in a fast-paced environment where iteration is constant and collaboration is key

  • Degree in design, computer science, human factors or equivalent work experience.
  • Design professional with 7+ years of relevant work experience, including 3+ years directly managing, mentoring, and developing designers.
  • Proven experience as a player-coach — able to manage and grow a small team while continuing to produce senior-level design work yourself.
  • Ability to clearly communicate design solutions to stakeholders.
  • Understanding of interaction design principles.
  • Demonstrable fluency with Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, and AI tools.
  • Has experience in and knowledge of UX/prototyping development and motion graphics best practices.
  • Excellent collaborative skills with critical thinking and creative problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to operate independently and manage multiple projects in a deadline-driven environment.
  • Strong portfolio of solid web, mobile, and digital-media required.
  • Deep knowledge of cross-platform usability standards and UI specifications.
  • Well-versed in streaming platforms like Roku, Fire TV, Samsung, Apple TV, X1, etc.
  • Experience with accessibility, localization, and internationalization best practices.

 

Hybrid: This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time.

We're looking for a product manager who embeds directly with engineering, product, and business teams to build and ship AI products that directly serve our NBCUniversal businesses. As a Senior Product Manager in the Enterprise Business Solutions AI Product team, you will own the full lifecycle of agent products — from discovery through deployment and ongoing iteration. You'll build intelligent workflows that automate program operations, surface insights from complex data, and enable teams across NBCUniversal to work with agentic solutions.  

Your work will have a direct, measurable business impact on our employees’ experience and effectiveness in their work outputs. This role is a blend of technical, design, education, and product thinking. You will understand business needs deeply, identify where AI creates leverage, write code, and ship solutions that will drive real business impact. 

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with client-facing teams to understand customer use cases, ensuring conversational agents meet the needs of both end users and stakeholders.

  • Create and present documentation to business partners, execute product demos and walk-throughs, and deliver AI-driven analytics capabilities that enable real-time, data-informed decision-making across the enterprise.

  • 8+ years of experience in digital product development or a closely related field 
  • Exceptional communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels. 
  • Proven expertise in developing and deploying Large Language Models (LLMs) and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architecture (prompt engineering, tool use, agent orchestration), NLP, machine learning algorithms, and big data analytics. 
  • Analytical skills for identifying user patterns, insights, and performance metrics. 
  • Ability to gather and comprehend complex requirements and challenges across all business levels. 
  • Ability to convey complex technical issues to both technical and non-technical audiences, with ability to define requirements and iterate on solutions 
  • Hands-on experience with understanding and building products on large data sets and enterprise data architectures requiring systems integration, data governance, and security compliance. 
  • Hands-on experience with AI platforms, cloud services, and analytics tools (e.g., Python, Azure, AWS, Google Cloud) 
  • Expertise in SDLC process, scoping, iteration planning, user story writing, rollout management. 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) or similar tool-use frameworks 
  • Experience embedded with business teams to build solutions (solutions engineering, field engineering, or similar)

As our Senior Software Engineer, you’ll join the Content Delivery Engineering team (CDE) within NBCUniversal’s Global Video Engineering organization in New York City, USA. Your mission is to get involved with delivering outstanding VOD, live event, and linear streaming experiences to millions of viewers across our US, UK, EU, and Africa services - including Peacock, SkyShowtime, Showmax, and NOW/WOW.

You’ll collaborate daily with colleagues across the US, UK and beyond – excellent communication skills are essential. Our team specializes in large-scale Multi-Content Delivery Network design and operations, performance telemetry and analytics, selection & interfacing with content origins via multiple workflows - dynamic ad insertion, manifest manipulation and integrating new player technologies.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain high-performance software systems and features—primarily in Go—used to deliver world-class video content at massive scale for brands like Peacock, SkyShowtime, Showmax, and NOW/WOW.
  • Build reliable, testable, and user-focused services supporting key streaming workflows, such as VOD, live events, linear channels, dynamic ad insertion, and manifest manipulation.
  • Participate in thoughtful and consistent code reviews that promote high code quality, clear architectural patterns, and healthy engineering culture.
  • Partner closely with Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) to architect systems that are highly available, resilient, performant, and fault-tolerant across multiple regions.
  • Leverage observability tooling (metrics, logs, traces) and performance analytics to detect issues proactively and drive fast, data-driven root-cause analysis.
  • Contribute to the design and evolution of multi-CDN strategies, routing logic, and origin workflows that ensure exceptional global streaming performance.
  • Collaborate daily with engineers across the US, UK, EU, and Africa—requiring clear communication and strong documentation skills.
  • Influence technical direction, system architecture, and best practices as a senior member of the Content Delivery Engineering team.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 3+ years of professional software engineering experience, including hands-on development in Go (preferred) or Python.
  • Experience deploying and operating applications in cloud environments (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure) using containers and orchestration tools such as Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Strong understanding of CI/CD workflows and experience using Git-based repositories, automated testing frameworks, and build pipelines.
  • Practical experience with Site Reliability Engineering concepts such as reliability targets (SLIs/SLOs), auto-scaling, distributed systems reliability, or incident response.
  • Familiarity with Agile development methodologies (Scrum, Kanban).
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including ability to articulate design decisions and collaborate with distributed teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with CDNs (e.g., Akamai, CloudFront, Fastly, Cloudflare) or streaming media delivery systems.
  • Understanding of video streaming technologies such as HLS, DASH, manifests, origins, or content routing.
  • Experience building systems that support global scale, multi-region deployments, or high availability architectures.

job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. As a growth-minded studio, we pride ourselves on being one of the world’s leading producers of high-quality, award-winning, animated films and series, reaching consumers around the globe. We push to feel more, laugh more, and build immersive new worlds.

DreamWorks creates a diverse array of original content in a variety of formats, delivering compelling stories with unique characters. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

Responsibilities:

  • Drive accurate weather forecasts and content on all platforms
  • Be available at any time dangerous weather conditions occur
  • Deliver urgent and accurate breaking weather news 
  • Keep news team informed of upcoming weather conditions for coverage plans
  • Work directly with WSI to troubleshoot issues or needs
  • Produce weather forecasts, segments and stories
  • Tell the market’s weather stories in a way that connects with and captivates viewers. 
  • Develop innovative and creative ways of presenting the daily weather story, with an emphasis on accuracy and integrity of data.
  • Produce weather graphics and analyze data from the National Weather Service as well as other meteorological sources. 
  • Work with the producers and news team to create complete coverage of weather. Also prepare and post forecasts for multiple platforms.
  • Some live reporting and attendance at community and weather-related events will be required.
  • Use of social media daily and especially during severe events.
  • Integrate use of augmented reality graphics into daily weather presentations

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website.  Salary range: $130,000 - $150,000.   

Basic Qualifications

  • Minimum of three years’ experience as a television weather meteorologist/anchor

Desired Characteristics

  • Bilingual a plus (English/Spanish)
  • Seal from accredited national weather organization (NWA, AMS) preferred
  • BS degree in meteorology preferred.
  • Experience with severe weather coverage, including but not limited to heavy snow, hurricanes, tornados, severe thunderstorms, flooding and ice events
  • Passion to be a part of a major weather event, no matter when it happens
  • Compelling on-air presence - crisp, clear, and confidant
  • Should thrive working under the intense deadline pressure of television weather.
  • Technologically savvy with strong computer skills (working knowledge of WSI system preferred.)
  • Excellent written and verbal communication/presentation skills.
  • Strong leadership qualities and self-motivation.
  • Understanding of the demands of an on-air HD environment

Additional Job Requirements

  • Interested candidate must submit a resume/CV through www.nbcunicareers.com to be considered
  • Must have the ability to work flexible and sometimes long hours due to the nature of weather events.
  • Must be 18 years or greater.
  • Must have unrestricted work authorization to work in the United States.
  • Must be willing to work in Needham, MA
  • Required on-site: This position is required to be performed full-time from an NBCUniversal-designated worksite.

Over the past 225 years, The Post has evolved into a multi-platform media company spanning print, digital, video, audio, app, television and commerce.


The New York Post is looking for a creative, versatile Design Editor (Tuesday-Saturday, 6pm-2am) to join our fast-paced newsroom. If you have a passion for bold visuals, a digital-first mindset, and the skills to turn ideas into eye-catching designs, this role is for you. job.title: Director of Data & Analytics
job.description:
Job Description:


The New York Post provides readers with the best in News, Sports, Pop Culture, Fashion and Entertainment – with signature wit, irreverence and authority, averaging 90 million unique viewers a month. Over the past 223 years, The Post has evolved into a multi-platform media company spanning print, digital, video, audio, app, television and commerce.


We are seeking an experienced, highly hands-on Director of Data & Analytics to join our Data Science & Analytics team. Reporting into our Vice President of Data Science & Analytics, this is a high-impact leadership role responsible for turning data into actionable insights that shape how The New York Post operates, grows its audience, and drives commercial performance.


The ideal candidate is both a strategic leader and a hands-on analytics expert; someone who can set direction and lead a team, but is equally comfortable rolling up their sleeves, digging into data, building analyses, and delivering answers themselves. You will work closely with leaders and stakeholders across Editorial, Commercial, Product, Marketing, Affiliate/E-Commerce, Data Engineering, and Product, helping teams understand what the data is telling us and, more importantly, what they should do with it.


This is an opportunity for someone who thrives in a fast-moving media environment where priorities evolve quickly, questions don't always come neatly defined, and the ability to deliver high-quality insights on a tight timeline is critical. Working closely with our newsroom means being comfortable with urgency and quick turnaround while maintaining a high standard of analytical rigor.


The right person will be energized by the pace and variety of The New York Post, is someone who doesn't need every question defined for them, and is comfortable navigating ambiguity while seeing changing priorities as an opportunity to solve new problems. Most importantly, you should be passionate about using data not simply to report what happened, but to help people across the organization make smarter, faster, more informed decisions.


Responsibilities:


  • Lead and develop a high-performing analytics team, managing a team of 3+ Data/Business Analysts and providing mentorship, prioritization, coaching, and professional development.
  • Establish the strategy, priorities, and operating model for analytics across the organization, ensuring the team is focused on the highest-impact business and editorial opportunities.
  • Serve as a trusted data and analytics partner to senior stakeholders across Editorial and Commercial, translating business questions into clear analytical approaches and actionable recommendations.
  • Partner closely with newsroom leadership and editorial teams to develop insights that support audience growth, content strategy, engagement, performance, and decision-making.
  • Work with Commercial, Advertising, Marketing, and other business teams to analyze campaign performance, audience behavior, revenue opportunities, and media performance.
  • Act as a hands-on analytics leader who can independently investigate complex questions, work directly with large datasets, build analyses, and deliver insights — not simply manage work from above.
  • Develop and maintain automated reporting, dashboards, and data products that give stakeholders timely, reliable visibility into the metrics that matter most.
  • Champion a data-driven culture by helping stakeholders understand not only what is happening in the business, but why it is happening and what actions the data supports.
  • Lead the development and integration of advanced analytics models and methodologies to improve media performance, audience engagement, campaign effectiveness, and business outcomes.
  • Analyze campaign and media performance across platforms and channels, identifying trends, opportunities, and areas for optimization.
  • Partner with Data Engineering and Data Science teams to integrate, structure, and leverage data from marketing clean rooms and other internal and external data sources.
  • Collaborate with Product, Technology, and Data teams to improve data accessibility, quality, and usability and to identify opportunities to build scalable data products.
  • Partner with senior management to develop and refine business and media strategies based on data-driven insights.
  • Help establish analytics best practices, standards, and methodologies across the organization, including approaches to measurement, experimentation, attribution, and media effectiveness.
  • Support the development of sports analytics capabilities and identify new opportunities to leverage data across The Post's sports business and editorial operations.
  • Translate complex analytical findings into clear, compelling narratives that can be understood and acted upon by both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Operate effectively in an ambiguous, fast-paced environment, where priorities can shift quickly and new analytical questions emerge regularly.
  • Balance longer-term strategic initiatives with urgent, high-priority requests, maintaining quality and accuracy while delivering against tight newsroom and business timelines.
  • Identify opportunities to proactively use data to answer questions stakeholders may not yet be asking and surface insights that can create meaningful business impact.

Requirements:


  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Economics, Statistics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field preferred.
  • 6–10+ years of progressive experience in data, analytics, business intelligence, or a related discipline, preferably within media, entertainment, sports, digital publishing, advertising, or another fast-paced consumer business.
  • Previous experience leading and developing a team of analysts, with the ability to balance people leadership with hands-on individual contribution; You should be equally comfortable presenting insights to senior leadership, partnering with an editor on an urgent newsroom question, coaching an analyst through a complex project, or opening up SQL and figuring out the answer yourself.
  • Strong track record of partnering with senior stakeholders across multiple functions and using data to influence business decisions.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting both commercial/business and editorial or content-oriented stakeholders is strongly preferred.
  • Extensive experience with BI and visualization tools such as Looker, Power BI, or Tableau.
  • Advanced proficiency in SQL and experience working with Python and large, complex datasets.
  • Proven ability to independently scope, execute, and communicate complex analytical projects from start to finish.
  • Experience driving data and analytics initiatives within digital media, direct-to-consumer, marketing, advertising, sports, or other high-volume digital environments.
  • Strong understanding of modern cloud data architectures, including data warehouses, data marts, lakehouse environments, multi-cloud architectures, real-time data, and data productization.
  • Expertise in media measurement methodologies and technologies, including experimentation, attribution, and Media Mix Modeling (MMM).
  • Strong understanding of campaign analytics, audience measurement, data extraction, media optimization, and performance reporting.
  • Experience applying advanced analytical and research techniques to solve complex business problems.
  • Ability to translate complex technical or analytical concepts into clear, actionable business recommendations.
  • Advanced understanding of media, audience, engagement, and commercial metrics and their application to business decision-making.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify meaningful patterns and insights within large datasets and communicate those findings effectively.
  • Exceptional problem-solving skills, intellectual curiosity, and attention to detail.
  • Ability to thrive in a highly collaborative, fast-moving, and sometimes ambiguous environment where priorities and business needs can change quickly.
  • Strong project management and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage multiple stakeholders and deliver against tight deadlines.
  • A roll-up-your-sleeves mentality — you are comfortable getting into the data yourself, challenging assumptions, troubleshooting an analysis, and doing the work when needed.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with everyone from data scientists and engineers to newsroom editors and commercial executives.

Note: This position will be expected to adhere to our hybrid work model, requiring three (3) days per week in the office. This schedule is subject to change based on business needs.

job.title: Director of Engineering
job.description:
Job Description:


The New York Post is one of America’s most iconic and recognizable news brands — delivering bold headlines, unforgettable scoops, and sharp commentary since 1801. With a legacy built on fearless journalism and a distinctly New York attitude, The Post has evolved far beyond its print roots to become a modern media powerhouse. 


Today, the New York Post Digital Network is one of the most influential voices in the industry, reaching over 80 million unique users each month across our expansive, ever-growing portfolio. Anchored by NYPost.com, PageSix.com, and Decider.com, our digital brands deliver must-read breaking news, sports, entertainment, pop culture, and lifestyle coverage with the same wit, edge, and energy that define The Post. With innovation at our core, we’ve built a true multi-platform ecosystem — spanning web, mobile apps, video, audio, social, print, TV, and commerce. From viral headlines and exclusive stories to original series, podcasts, and live events, we’re engaging audiences where they are — and always on the pulse of what’s next. 


We’re looking for a Director of Engineering to join our technology team and lead the systems that power The Post’s digital future. This is a hands-on engineering role with core responsibilities around infrastructure services, data pipelines, personalization systems, consumer AI, internal AI tooling, and custom APIs across AWS and GCP projects. 


You are a hands-on technical leader who builds robust high-performance services for websites. You will own the plumbing that enables our newsroom, data science, marketing, and product teams to deliver cutting-edge digital experiences at scale. You’ll work alongside technology leadership in a fast-paced newsroom. You will partner with editorial leaders, share architectural solutions with other business units in the US, UK, and Australia, and direct your engineering team with experienced tactics and thoughtful strategy. 


Please Note: Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States on a permanent basis. Sponsorship, including employment visa sponsorship or transfer, is not available for this position now or in the future.


Key Responsibilities: 

  • Manage and support a small team of high-achieving agile software and data engineers.
  • Design, build, and operate cloud-based APIs supporting specialized needs of our consumer websites, native mobile apps. 
  • Work daily with compute services, query services, storage services, and big data services with technologies like Vertex AI, Lambdas, DynamoDB, Cloud Functions, S3, Kubernetes, Glue, and BigQuery. 
  • Be able to personally troubleshoot an issue from Javascript in a browser down through DNS, networking, applications, containers and operating systems or serverless services, and into dependent service tiers. 
  • Own data ingestion pipelines for real-time and batch processing of large-scale content and event data. 
  • Understand how to implement and scale custom APIs to support editorial workflows, AI, personalization, analytics, and user-facing applications. 
  • Own the team’s codebases, pull requests, testing, maintenance and release process.
  • Partner with product, editorial, and data science teams to deliver infrastructure and services that meet business needs. 
  • Monitor, optimize, and improve the reliability, security, and cost efficiency of cloud-based systems.
  • Communicate and present a vision for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Organize architecture discussions. 
  • Run and/or supervise agile sprint ceremonies. 

Qualifications:

Must-Haves 

  • MS or BS in computer science, or related field. 
  • 10+ years of professional software engineering experience. 
  • 5+ years experience leading engineering teams. 
  • Agile best practices. 
  • Proficiency in modern programming languages and frameworks such as Python, Node.js, or Go.
  • Solid familiarity of common AWS and/or GCP services . 
  • Robust experience with REST and GraphQL APIs, authentication/authorization, and API best practices. 
  • Firm grasp of the tools of the trade including AI tools, IDEs, Git, JIRA, and agile methodologies.
  • Comfort with code reviews, unit tests, QA and UAT processes, and knowledge of end-to-end testing frameworks. 
  • Strong troubleshooting skills 
  • Attention to detail, thoroughness, a proactive approach to problem-solving, and a comfort in diving in and learning things from scratch. 
  • Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Great-to-Have Experience

  • Familiarity with content-management systems, media, news, publishing, video technology, ad technology, or other high-traffic consumer-facing industries. 
  • Hands-on experience with generative-AI models, LLM prompting, and/or machine learning.
  • Personalization and recommendation systems. 
  • Experience building and deploying data pipelines (e.g., Airflow, Dataflow, Glue, or similar tools)
  • Comfort with Linux administration, shell scripting, ssh, crontabs, etc. 
  • Experience with monitoring, logging, dashboard, and alarming tools (e.g., CloudWatch, Datadog, Splunk, etc.) 
  • Knowledge of data warehouse technologies (BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, etc.)
  • Understanding of CI/CD workflows and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes a plus) 

Note: The New York Post follows a hybrid work model. This position would be expected to be in the office a minimum of 3 days per week (subject to change).

job.title: Director of Product
job.description:
Job Description:


The New York Post is one of America’s most iconic and recognizable news brands: delivering bold journalism, industry-leading entertainment coverage, and innovative digital experiences to millions of readers every day. With a legacy built on fearless reporting and a distinctly New York attitude, The Post has evolved far beyond its print roots to become a modern media powerhouse. Today, the New York Post Digital Network reaches millions of readers each month across an expansive portfolio of brands, including NYPost.com, PageSix.com, Decider.com, and The California Post.


We are seeking an experienced and strategic Director of Product to lead the vision, strategy, and execution of digital product initiatives across the New York Post Media Group. Reporting to the Chief Technology Officer (CTO), this highly collaborative leadership role will oversee a small team of Product Managers while remaining hands-on in the development and execution of product strategy.


This is a highly visible, stakeholder-facing role for a product leader who understands both product and the business. The Director will partner closely with Editorial, Audience Development, Engineering, Design, Data, Revenue, Marketing, and Executive Leadership to identify opportunities, establish priorities, and build digital experiences that grow audiences, deepen engagement, and drive measurable business impact.


The ideal candidate is both a strategic product leader and a hands-on, scrappy operator; someone who can think big and define long-term product vision while also rolling up their sleeves to write user stories, prioritize backlogs, analyze performance metrics, solve problems creatively, and partner closely with engineering teams to move ideas from concept to market. They are equally comfortable presenting product strategies, roadmaps, and recommendations to senior stakeholders as they are working directly with their team to bring ideas to life. They thrive in a fast-paced environment, are comfortable navigating ambiguity and competing priorities, and know how to find practical, resourceful ways to get things done without losing sight of the bigger picture.


Responsibilities


Product Strategy & Execution

  • Own the end-to-end product lifecycle across a portfolio of digital products, from discovery and prioritization through launch, optimization, and continuous improvement.
  • Develop and execute product strategies and roadmaps aligned with company objectives and audience growth initiatives.
  • Translate business needs into detailed product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and technical specifications.
  • Prioritize initiatives using customer insights, analytics, market research, and business impact.
  • Partner closely with Engineering, Design, Data, Editorial, and key stakeholders throughout the product development lifecycle.
  • Define success metrics, measure product performance, and continuously iterate based on user feedback and data.

Audience Growth & User Experience

  • Collaborate with Editorial, Audience Development, Marketing, and Analytics teams to create engaging digital experiences that increase user acquisition, engagement, retention, and loyalty.
  • Drive product innovation across key consumer touchpoints, including:
    • Homepage
    • Article experiences
    • Mobile applications
    • Newsletters
    • AI-powered products and experiences
    • Search and content discovery
    • Registration and subscription experiences
    • Video products
    • Emerging platforms

Hands-On Product Leadership

  • Actively manage product delivery through agile methodologies, ensuring timely and high-quality execution.
  • Lead backlog refinement, sprint planning, prioritization sessions, and product grooming.
  • Review prototypes, user flows, and design concepts to ensure exceptional user experiences.
  • Partner closely with developers to remove blockers and facilitate efficient product delivery.
  • Perform quality assurance and user acceptance testing prior to product launches.
  • Monitor product performance and KPIs following releases and identify opportunities for ongoing optimization.

Product Management Excellence

  • Establish and champion best practices for product management across the organization.
  • Introduce scalable product processes and frameworks that improve prioritization, collaboration, and execution.
  • Advocate for user-centered design principles and data-driven decision-making.
  • Foster a culture of experimentation, continuous learning, and rapid iteration.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Lead complex initiatives across Product, Engineering, Editorial, Audience Development, Design, Data, Advertising, Marketing, and Executive Leadership.
  • Align cross-functional teams around shared objectives while balancing business priorities with technical feasibility.
  • Build strong relationships across the organization to ensure successful execution of strategic initiatives.

Innovation & Industry Leadership

  • Stay current on emerging trends across digital publishing, consumer technology, artificial intelligence, and media.
  • Evaluate opportunities in areas including:
    • Artificial Intelligence
    • Personalization
    • Search and discovery
    • News consumption trends
    • Mobile experiences
    • Subscription products
    • Creator platforms
    • Audience engagement technologies
  • Bring innovative ideas that help keep the New York Post at the forefront of digital media.

Requirements

  • 7+ years of deep, progressive experience in digital product management, with significant ownership of consumer-facing digital products throughout the full product lifecycle, preferably within media, publishing, or consumer technology.
  • Strong understanding of digital publishing, audience development, and media business models.
  • Proven success leading consumer-facing web and mobile product initiatives end-to-end, from discovery and business case development through launch, measurement, and continuous optimization.
  • Experience working cross-functionally with Engineering, Editorial, Design, Data, and Revenue teams, with an understanding of how product decisions can support audience monetization, advertising performance, subscriptions, and broader business objectives.
  • Strong hands-on experience with CMS, content publishing workflows, newsletters, push notifications, or similar audience engagement products.
  • Demonstrated ability to balance strategic product vision with hands-on execution and translate business needs into clear product priorities and roadmaps.
  • Experience managing and developing Product Managers, while providing strategic direction and maintaining a hands-on approach to product leadership.
  • Exceptional analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and project management skills.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels.
  • Passion for building innovative products that delight users and drive measurable business results.
  • Demonstrated ability to work in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment and take a scrappy, solutions-oriented approach to getting things done.

Technical Experience


Experience with many of the following is preferred:

  • Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban)
  • Jira and product management platforms
  • CMS platforms (WordPress VIP preferred)
  • Mobile application development
  • Product analytics platforms
  • A/B and multivariate testing
  • UX research methodologies
  • Artificial intelligence products and emerging technologies
  • CI/CD pipelines and modern software development practices

Preferred Experience


Experience working with one or more of the following is highly desirable:

  • Digital news publishing
  • Media and entertainment
  • Audience development and growth
  • Subscription products
  • Advertising technology
  • Recommendation engines
  • AI-powered consumer products
  • Personalization technologies
  • Search and content discovery
  • Newsletter platforms
  • Video products

Success in the First Year


You'll know you're succeeding if you:


  • Launch impactful product enhancements that drive audience growth and engagement.
  • Build trusted partnerships across Editorial, Engineering, Audience Development, Design, Data, and Revenue.
  • Establish clear product priorities and predictable delivery processes.
  • Improve product performance through experimentation, analytics, and continuous optimization.
  • Help shape the next generation of AI-powered products and experiences across the New York Post Digital Network.

Note: This position will be expected to adhere to our hybrid work model, requiring three (3) days per week in the office. This schedule is subject to change based on business needs.

job.title: Director, Paid Social
job.description:
Job Description:


The New York Post provides readers with the best in News, Sports, Pop Culture, Fashion and Entertainment  – with signature wit, irreverence and authority averaging 90 million unique viewers a month. Over the past 225 years, The Post has evolved into a multi-platform media company spanning print, digital, video, audio, app, television and commerce.

The New York Post is seeking a full-time Director, Paid Social to help lead the paid social strategy and play a pivotal role in growing the business. You will collaborate closely with video, design, marketing, and product teams to ensure a cohesive and engaging experience for our followers.

Reporting to the Senior Director of Social Media, you will have a significant impact on the success of brand partnerships, sponsorship opportunities and paid social across the business. 

Job Responsibilities:

  • Own the paid social strategy across The New York Post's portfolio, serving as the internal subject matter expert across planning, activation, optimization, measurement, and emerging opportunities.

  • Lead and mentor a team of paid social professionals, providing direction and coaching while establishing scalable workflows, processes, and best practices.

  • Develop and execute end-to-end paid social strategies that grow audience, engagement, traffic, content reach, and revenue, while aligning with broader company objectives.

  • Manage and optimize campaigns across Meta (Facebook/Instagram), TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, Snapchat, and X, staying ahead of platform updates, new products, and emerging capabilities.

  • Partner with the Senior Director of Social Media, editorial, and social teams to connect paid and organic strategy, identify high-potential content, and drive audience growth and monetization.

  • Collaborate with Sales, Brand Partnerships, marketing, product, design, and video teams to develop cohesive paid-social campaigns, sponsorship solutions, and advertiser programs.

  • Serve as a strategic partner to internal stakeholders, using platform expertise, audience insights, performance data, and reporting to make recommendations and drive optimization.

  • Build and maintain performance dashboards, reporting frameworks, and KPIs while monitoring campaign pacing and identifying opportunities to improve results.

  • Identify and test new platforms, formats, targeting strategies, tools, and optimization techniques, acting as an internal trend spotter across the evolving social ecosystem.

  • Educate stakeholders on paid social capabilities and best practices while balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution in a fast-paced, 24/7 media environment. 

What We’re Looking For: 

  • 4+ years of experience in paid social, paid media, digital media, or a related field, with significant hands-on campaign management and optimization experience.

  • 1–2+ years of experience managing, mentoring, or leading a team.

  • Deep knowledge of paid social platforms, including Meta/Facebook/Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, Snapchat, and X.

  • Demonstrated experience developing and executing paid social strategies across planning, activation, optimization, measurement, and reporting.

  • Strong understanding of paid social fundamentals, including audience development, campaign structure, bidding, pacing, budget management, creative formats, targeting, and optimization.

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate complex data into clear insights and actionable recommendations, including experience building dashboards and reporting to senior stakeholders.

  • Excellent cross-functional collaboration and communication skills, with experience partnering across editorial, sales, marketing, product, design, video, and social teams.

  • Experience in a publisher, media company, agency, entertainment organization, or other fast-paced digital environment is highly valued, along with an understanding of the relationship between content, audience growth, paid media, and revenue.

  • Highly organized, proactive, and adaptable, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and identify opportunities in a fast-moving environment.

  • Experience with photo/video editing, social content creation, writing, or copy-editing is a plus.

  • Must be flexible around occasional weekend and holiday work based on the needs of a 24/7 media organization.

Note: This role will be on-site five days per week in our New York newsroom. The schedule for this role is Mon-Fri, 9am-5pm EST.

job.title: Lifestyle News Editor, The California Post
job.description:
Job Description:


The California Post is seeking an experienced and audience driven Lifestyle News Editor to direct coverage of our lifestyle content in California — working across verticals including sex & relationships, fashion, real estate, parenting, travel, food & drink, science & technology and general interest. This role offers the right candidate the opportunity to set the lifestyle agenda in one of the most exciting cities in America.

The successful candidate will be skilled at identifying the topics everyone wants to read and talk about  — and then produce and edit content in The Post’s uniquely irreverent tone of voice. They should have both high level copy editing experience as well as an innate understanding of audience metrics, and how to write a sparkling headline that generates conversation and traffic. They will also be skilled in mining social media and competitive news sources for the best leads — and know how to turn online and real-life chatter into stories that give depth to the Post’s lifestyle section and put it ahead of the trends.

Application Instructions: Applicants should submit a cover letter and applicable work samples/clips for consideration.

Responsibilities:

  • Generating an endless font of innovative and agenda-setting daily trending and exclusive ideas.

  • Assigning and editing trending daily stories, as well as long lead stories where needed. 

  • Overseeing the production of a number of daily stories — from writing headlines in the Post’s signature wit to ensuring SEO best practices to coordinating photo shoots and imagery. 

  • Analyzing web traffic to drive audience engagement and meet goals of the department.

  • Monitoring the news to look for opportunities to add depth to our headlines through original reporting, first-person perspectives and expert explainers.

  • Managing the lifestyle reporters on the team.

  • Coordinating closely with departments such as photo, video, and audience development.

Requirements:

  • At least 10 years of progressive editorial experience in a news or high-volume magazine environment, preferably focused on lifestyle content, including experience in an editor or editorial leadership capacity.

  • Excellent news judgement and the sharpest of editing and writing prowess. 

  • Your finger on the pulse of the topics and trends of interest to the Post audience. 

  • Proven understanding of what makes a story successful across digital platforms - from headlines to visuals and optimization. 

  • Proficiency in WordPress or similar CMS.

  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple stories, writers, and deadlines simultaneously.

  • Comfortable making fast, decisive editorial calls in a breaking news environment.

  • Collaborative team player who can work across departments including visuals, social, and audience development.

  • An understanding of referral traffic, particularly, social, search and Discover.

  • Knowledge in driving and retaining audiences, with deeper, engagement focused content. 

  • Familiarity with analytics tools and performance metrics to help guide coverage and strategy.

We are looking for Part-Time News Reporters (~24 hours per week) to join the California Post team.

Reporting to the Deputy News Editor, the General Assignment News Reporter will have a focus on breaking exclusive stories and covering major events unfolding in Los Angeles and beyond. From delivering exclusive, engaging, agenda setting stories to covering wildfires, celebrity scandals, local politics, crime, courts and viral moments, this reporter will be on the front line of our coverage in one of the country’s most dynamic and newsworthy cities.

job.title: Part-Time Editor
job.description:
Job Description:


The New York Post provides readers with the best in News, Sports, Pop Culture, Fashion and Entertainment – with signature wit, irreverence and authority averaging 90 million unique viewers a month. Over the past 225 years, The Post has evolved into a multi-platform media company spanning print, digital, video, audio, app, television and commerce.

The NY Post is looking for an experienced editor for a part-time role (16-24 hours per week) with the Sunday staff. The editor is expected to be a line and assignment editor who possesses fine attention to detail, critical thinking skills, and who can also aggressively transform breaking copy on deadline to sing in The Post's unique tabloid voice.

The editor should be able to mine, assign and edit an array of stories -- impactful, quirky, scandalous, etc. -- on immediate deadline for our website, and also for the Sunday print edition. The editor must be able to give clear direction to our team of award-winning field reporters and in-office journos.

The Sunday team breaks local, national and international news, investigates government corruption, crushes hypocrisy wherever we find it, mines the world for the quirky and the funny, and delivers award-winning, long- and short-form journalism in the boldest tabloid voice.

The NY Post is the nation’s 5th-largest U.S. newspaper by circulation and its website routinely generates tens of millions of pageviews every weekend. The ability to handle anything from a breaking brief to a sprawling news feature, in a wide range of subjects, is needed. And you’ll even get to spitball with the rest of us on our world-famous Page 1 headlines.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher
  • A minimum of 5 years of editing in a busy newsroom
  • Comfortable editing/re-writing both breaking news and long-form stories in lively tabloid prose for web and print
  • A keen understanding of the voice of the Post
  • A knack for finding stories our readers crave
  • A critical eye for facts and tone
  • Broad knowledge base
  • Willingness to collaborate and ability to communicate with a close-knit team of NYC’s best journalists

Note: This position requires onsite work in our Midtown Manhattan office 1–2 days per week, with a regular Friday–Saturday schedule.

job.title: Product Manager, Strategic Programs
job.description:
Job Description:


The New York Post is looking for a Product Manager, Strategic Programs to join our newly created Product Innovation and Strategy team.


This is a chance to help shape what comes next for one of the most recognizable media brands in the country. You will work on new products, AI, emerging technology, and ideas that can actually make their way into the hands of our audience. Think websites, apps, new digital experiences, internal tools, automation, and entirely new ways of doing things.


This is a highly visible role with direct access to stakeholders and C Suite leadership. Our team is here to experiment, move quickly, and take ideas from “what if?” to something real. You will have room to test new technology, try things that have never been done before, figure out what works, and run with the ideas that have potential.


We are looking for someone who is scrappy, curious, self motivated, and genuinely excited about product and innovation. Someone who does not need to be told what to do next, is comfortable with ambiguity, and enjoys figuring out solutions when there is no obvious playbook. If you are excited by AI, constantly experimenting with new tools, and want your work to have a visible impact, this is a role where you can do that.


What You Will Do:


  • Own strategic product and innovation initiatives from idea through launch, keeping projects moving and turning concepts into real products and experiences.
  • Work directly with stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Editorial, Design, Data, Commercial, and other teams to understand opportunities and build solutions.
  • Experiment with AI tools, emerging technologies, and new platforms to identify ways we can improve our products, workflows, audience experience, and business.
  • Take an idea, figure out what is possible, test it, learn from it, and determine whether it should move forward.
  • Turn business needs into clear product requirements, user stories, project plans, priorities, and next steps.
  • Be hands on. Jump into the work, solve problems, test solutions, and do whatever is needed to keep an initiative moving.
  • Identify opportunities to use AI and automation to make our teams more efficient and our products better.
  • Partner with technical teams to help turn concepts and experiments into practical, scalable solutions.
  • Define success metrics and KPIs, track results, gather feedback, and use what you learn to improve or rethink an initiative.
  • Coordinate testing and launch activities and make sure new products and experiences are ready for our audiences.
  • Keep up with what is happening across AI, technology, media, and the broader product landscape and bring new ideas to the table.
  • Manage multiple initiatives and know when to prioritize, reprioritize, push something forward, or change direction.

What We Are Looking For:


  • 3 to 4 years of experience in Product Management, Product Innovation, Strategic Programs, Project Management, or a similar role is the sweet spot for this position.
  • Someone who genuinely cares about product and wants to build things, not simply manage timelines.
  • Genuine enthusiasm for AI and emerging technology, with hands on experience experimenting with Generative AI tools and an interest in learning what is coming next.
  • A self starter who can take an ambiguous problem and figure out where to start without needing constant direction.
  • Someone who is scrappy and resourceful and enjoys finding creative solutions when the obvious answer does not exist.
  • Strong project and product management skills, including the ability to prioritize, organize, manage competing deadlines, and drive work through completion.
  • Excellent communication skills and the confidence to work directly with stakeholders, senior leaders, and C Suite executives.
  • Someone who can move comfortably between strategy and execution and is willing to roll up their sleeves and do the work.
  • Strong problem solving skills and the ability to work across technical and non technical teams.
  • Experience defining product requirements, managing projects, and using data and feedback to measure success.
  • Experience with tools such as Jira, Airtable, Monday.com, or similar platforms.

Preferred Qualifications


  • Media, news, publishing, entertainment, or another fast moving consumer facing industry is highly preferred.
  • Experience working on digital products, emerging technology, AI, automation, or innovation initiatives.
  • Strong understanding of current AI tools and a genuine curiosity about how AI can change products and workflows.
  • Familiarity with content management systems, publishing technology, video, advertising technology, personalization, recommendation systems, or other high traffic digital products.
  • Basic understanding of APIs, software development, or cloud platforms.
  • Familiarity with Agile or Scrum methodologies.
  • Experience presenting ideas, projects, or recommendations to senior management.

Why This Role?


  • Build things people actually see. Your work can show up across NYPost.com, our apps, digital products, and other experiences used by millions of people.
  • Experiment with AI and new technology. We want people who are excited to try new things and figure out how they can actually benefit the business.
  • Work with senior leadership. This is a high visibility team with direct communication and exposure to C Suite executives.
  • Have the freedom to run with ideas. This is a newly created team built around innovation, experimentation, and finding what comes next.
  • Work across the business. You will collaborate with Product, Engineering, Editorial, Design, Data, Commercial, and other teams rather than operating in a silo.
  • Make an impact. You will not just create roadmaps or manage projects. You will help decide what we build, test new ideas, and see those ideas become real.
  • Be part of something new. This team is at the forefront of NYP's innovation and startup initiatives, with the opportunity to help shape both the products and the way we work.

Note: The New York Post follows a hybrid work model. This position is expected to be in the office a minimum of 3 days per week, subject to change based on business needs.

We are seeking a driven General Assignment Reporter (Courts & Crime Focus) to join the California Post team.


Reporting to the Deputy News Editor, this reporter will react quickly to major breaking news across the San Francisco Bay Area while focusing closely on courts, crime, and public safety. This role requires flexibility, sharp instincts, and a high-velocity reporting style—whether you’re responding to an urgent spot news event, covering a high-profile trial, or breaking down a rapidly developing regional story. You will be on the front lines of one of the nation’s most dynamic news environments, turning fast-moving events into clear, authoritative reporting.


Responsibilities:

  • Cover real-time general assignment and breaking news across the San Francisco Bay Area with speed, accuracy, and urgency for the California Post.
  • Anchor coverage on major criminal and civil court cases, law enforcement agency accountability, and public safety issues impacting the region.
  • Pivot seamlessly between broad general assignment reporting, spot news, public safety incidents, and regional enterprise assignments as stories unfold.
  • Spot local stories with viral potential or national resonance and deliver exclusive angles before the competition.
  • Cultivate strong relationships across law enforcement, legal communities, municipal agencies, emergency services, and local neighborhoods.
  • File rapid updates across web, mobile, social media, and video platforms, continuously updating developing stories in real time.
  • Actively monitor police blotters, court filings, public records, and social feeds to spot scoops and emerging trends.
  • Travel regularly across the Bay Area to cover breaking news scenes, courthouses, hearings, trials, and major verdict announcements in person.

Requirements:

  • Several years of experience reporting for a fast-paced digital or print newsroom, with a background in general assignment, breaking news, or public safety beats.
  • Superior news judgment with a proven ability to write fast, clean, and compelling copy on tight deadlines while managing multiple assignments.
  • Solid understanding of legal documents, court filings, and police operations, with the ability to translate complex legal jargon into clear, accessible prose.
  • A relentless approach to newsgathering and a track record of building trusted sources across public safety and municipal agencies.
  • Proficiency with CMS platforms (e.g., WordPress), SEO best practices, and social media distribution tools.
  • Comfort presenting short-form video updates or discussing stories on camera for digital platforms.
  • A desire to be first and best on major breaking stories while maintaining the highest standards of journalistic integrity and accuracy.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Spanish or secondary language fluency.
  • An established social media presence or professional digital following.

Note: This role is expected to be based remotely in the San Francisco Bay Area. All work arrangements are subject to change based on business needs.

job.title: Sports Account Executive, Ad Sales
job.description:
Job Description :

The New York Post is the Best Sports in Town.

From the voices fans know and trust to the stories you won’t find anywhere else, the New York Post brings sports to life with insider access both on and off the field. And we’re just getting started. Our sports business continues to grow across Post Sports, Post Action, Post Sports+ and original sports video, creating new and exciting ways for brands to connect with passionate, highly engaged audiences.


We’re looking for an Account Executive, Sports Ad Sales who knows how to sell, loves the thrill of the pitch and closing a deal, and genuinely lives and breathes sports. This is a great opportunity for a relationship driven, strategic seller who wants to build meaningful partnerships around some of the biggest sports stories, personalities and moments in New York.


You’ll bring a strong network across agencies and direct clients, a proven track record of opening doors and growing business, and the confidence to take a partnership from first conversation to close.


The ideal candidate has approximately 4 to 6 years of omni channel media sales experience in a major market, with experience working directly with clients and media agencies. Most importantly, you’re a smart, energetic seller who understands where sports, culture, media and brands intersect and knows how to turn that intersection into revenue.


This New York based role reports to the NYP Sports Ad Sales Director and will play a key role across the full sales cycle, from prospecting and pitching to closing, growing and retaining client partnerships.


What You’ll Do


  • Identify, prospect and develop new business opportunities across agencies and direct clients, turning conversations into meaningful, long term partnerships.
  • Leverage our sports content, audience, talent, platforms and premium opportunities to create compelling solutions for advertisers.
  • Manage opportunities from initial outreach and discovery through pitch, negotiation, close and ongoing partnership management.
  • Work closely with internal teams to develop creative, strategic and integrated solutions that help clients achieve their business goals.
  • Deliver compelling sales presentations and confidently communicate why the New York Post is the right partner for a brand.
  • Develop trusted relationships with clients and agency partners, providing responsive, thoughtful communication and an exceptional buyer experience.
  • Preserve and expand the existing customer base while consistently identifying opportunities for upsell, cross sell and deeper partnerships.
  • Consistently work toward and exceed established revenue goals with a proactive, results oriented approach.
  • Stay close to competitors, category trends, advertiser activity and the evolving sports and media landscape to uncover new opportunities.
  • Use research, prospecting tools and your own network to consistently build a strong pipeline of qualified opportunities.

What We’re Looking For


  • 4 to 6 years of experience in media sales, digital advertising or a similar client facing sales environment, preferably in a major market.
  • A proven track record of prospecting, winning new business and growing client relationships.
  • Strong agency and/or direct client relationships within the digital media and advertising ecosystem.
  • Experience selling omni channel or integrated media solutions across multiple platforms.
  • A genuine passion for sports and an understanding of the sports media landscape. You don’t have to be able to name every backup quarterback in the league, but you should be excited by sports, know what fans care about and understand why brands want to be part of the conversation.
  • A competitive, entrepreneurial sales mentality. You enjoy the chase, aren’t afraid to pick up the phone and get energized by opening new doors.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to confidently pitch ideas and build relationships at all levels.
  • Familiarity with market research and prospecting tools such as MediaRadar, WINMO and similar platforms.
  • Highly organized, self motivated and accountable, with the ability to manage multiple opportunities and priorities at once.
  • A fast learner who can adapt to a constantly evolving media, sports and advertising landscape.
  • Results driven, enthusiastic and collaborative, with the confidence and personality to represent the New York Post in the marketplace.

The Bottom Line

If you love sports, love selling and love the idea of building partnerships around some of the biggest moments in sports, we want to hear from you.


Note: This role will adhere to a hybrid work model (4 days per week in our NYC office), subject to change as business needs evolve.


Compensation: Base salary of $80,000–$100,000, plus a sales bonus/commission plan. On-target earnings (OTE) of $140,000–$175,000 are based on achieving 100% of sales goals.


Note: Our sales compensation plan rewards strong performance, with incentive multipliers for exceeding sales targets and additional earning potential for top performers.


Pay-for-performance is a key element in our strategy to attract, engage, and motivate talented people to do their best work. Accordingly, offers extended for this role will include an annual bonus target typically expressed as percentage of salary. Similarly to salary, set annual incentive bonus targets are based on a variety of factors including competitive market practice, experience, tenure, and essential skills.

Equal Opportunity Employer

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status or any other protected characteristic. EEO/Disabled/Vets
