job.title: Digital Media Buyer & Planner
job.description:
General Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Plan, execute, manage, and optimize paid media campaigns across Facebook, Instagram, X, Google, YouTube, and other digital advertising platforms.
  • Develop media plans and buying strategies based on campaign objectives, target audiences, budgets, and performance goals.
  • Develop and manage audience targeting strategies, including demographic, behavioral, interest-based, remarketing, and lookalike audiences.
  • Manage campaign budgets, pacing, bidding strategies, placements, and audience allocation to maximize performance and return on advertising investment.
  • Monitor campaign performance and make ongoing adjustments based on key performance indicators, audience behavior, costs, and campaign objectives.
  • Analyze campaign and audience performance to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for optimization.
  • Evaluate the performance of creative assets, messaging, audiences, and placements and assist with A/B testing strategies.
  • Manage campaign setup, trafficking, tracking, quality assurance, and implementation to ensure accurate campaign launches.
  • Partner with creative, marketing, digital, and other internal teams to coordinate campaign assets, messaging, landing pages, and tracking requirements.
  • Prepare campaign performance reports and translate data and audience insights into actionable recommendations.
  • Track campaign spending and ensuring budgets are appropriately paced and aligned with approved media plans.
  • Leverage AI tools, including ChatGPT, Claude, Microsoft Copilot, and other emerging technologies, to support audience research, campaign analysis, reporting, and optimization.
  • Monitor emerging digital platforms, advertising products, audience trends, and technologies and recommend new opportunities when appropriate.
  • Manage multiple campaigns and priorities while meeting campaign launch and reporting deadlines.
  • Perform additional duties and responsibilities as assigned.

Position Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Advertising, Communications, Business, Analytics, or a related field preferred.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in digital media buying, media planning, paid social, paid search, performance marketing, or programmatic advertising.
  • Hands-on experience planning, launching, managing, and optimizing paid digital advertising campaigns.
  • Strong working knowledge of Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads required; experience with X Ads, YouTube, and other digital advertising platforms preferred.
  • Experience with programmatic advertising platforms and DSPs such as DV360, The Trade Desk, Yahoo DSP, or similar platforms is a plus.
  • Strong understanding of audience targeting, segmentation, retargeting, campaign optimization, and digital advertising performance metrics.
  • Experience analyzing campaign performance and using data to make media buying and optimization decisions.
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel; experience with Google Analytics, data visualization, or other reporting tools preferred.
  • Familiarity with AI tools and an interest in applying emerging technologies to digital advertising, analysis, and campaign optimization.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills with excellent attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple campaigns, budgets, platforms, and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

     Compensation & Benefits

    • Competitive salary - $85k -$110k depending on skills and relevant experience.
    • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance plans.
    • 401(k) retirement plan with company match.
    • Paid time off and holidays.
    • Professional development and training opportunities.
    • Collaborative and inclusive work environment.

job.title: Executive Producer
job.description:
Core Duties and Responsibilities:  

  • Determine the best news stories for the program and create the daily rundown.
  • Lead the program from pre-production through the live broadcast.
  • Manage and adjust the rundown as news develops during the live broadcast.
  • Collaborate with show hosts and on-air talent in program preparation and execution.
  • Provide direction to hosts and production staff and address editorial or production issues as they arise.
  • Identify compelling news stories and develop story ideas, research, and plan segments.
  • Manage breaking news and make real-time editorial decisions when coverage changes.
  • Coordinate with producers, associate producers, booking producers, assignment editors, reporters, digital teams, and other newsroom personnel.
  • Oversee the selection and integration of guests into the program.
  • Oversee the production and accuracy of video, graphics, live shots, packages, and other visual elements.
  • Lead and communicate with the control room during the live broadcast, including coordination with the director, producers, graphics, video, audio, and technical teams.
  • Delegate responsibilities as appropriate to producers, associate producers, and booking producers.
  • Supervise and provide feedback to production staff.
  • Ensure content is accurate, properly sourced, and meets editorial standards.
  • Produce timely content under tight deadlines.
  • Stay up to date with domestic and international news, politics, and current events.
  • Monitor program performance and identify opportunities for improvement.

Position Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in journalism, communications, or similar.
  • 5+ years of live television news production experience, including significant Executive Producer or Senior Producer experience.
  • Strong live control-room and breaking-news experience.
  • Experience working directly with on-air talent and managing a production team.
  • Strong writing, editorial, and organizational skills.
  • Ability to make quick editorial decisions and remain composed under pressure.
  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Ability to work effectively as part of a team with strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience with newsroom/rundown systems and broadcast production tools.
  • Team player with effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Proactive and solutions focused.
  • Willingness to work evenings, weekends, holidays, and extended hours as needed.

Compensation & Benefits:

  • Competitive salary of $135k to $200k depending on skills and relevant experience.
  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance plans.
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company match.
  • Paid time off and holidays.
  • Collaborative and inclusive work environment.

job.title: Mgr. Creator & Influencer Partnerships
job.description:
Core Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Develop and manage creator and influencer partnership programs that support audience growth, engagement, and brand awareness across NEWSMAX platforms.
  • Manage relationships with both external creators and influencers and internal NEWSMAX talent, including hosts, correspondents, contributors, and other on-air personalities participating in creator and social media initiatives.
  • Identify, recruit, onboard, and manage relationships with creators, influencers, podcasters, content publishers, and other digital partners.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for creator and influencer partnerships from onboarding through campaign completion.
  • Coordinate all aspects of creator and influencer agreements, including contracts, deliverables, content approvals, usage rights, renewals, and compliance requirements.
  • Negotiate partnership terms, compensation, content requirements, and promotional commitments with creators, agencies, and talent representatives.
  • Manage creator compensation programs, including budget tracking, invoicing, payment processing, reconciliation, and reporting.
  • Partner with internal NEWSMAX talent to develop and execute social media content, audience growth initiatives, creator partnerships, and cross-platform promotional campaigns.
  • Collaborate with marketing, social media, creative, digital, and editorial teams to execute creator-led campaigns and promotional initiatives.
  • Monitor campaign performance and provide reporting and recommendations based on engagement, reach, traffic, and other key performance indicators.
  • Develop strategies to increase the social media reach, engagement, and creator effectiveness of NEWSMAX hosts, correspondents, and talent across major platforms.
  • Coordinate content creation opportunities, campaign participation, promotional activations, and social media collaborations involving NEWSMAX talent and external creators.
  • Provide guidance and support to internal creators regarding platform best practices, audience development, content optimization, and brand alignment.
  • Maintain creator databases, campaign calendars, contract records, and partnership documentation.
  • Research emerging creators, social media trends, and platform opportunities to support business growth.
  • Leverage AI tools, including ChatGPT, Claude, Microsoft Copilot, and other emerging technologies, to support creator discovery, campaign management, reporting, and workflow efficiency.
  • Manage multiple partnerships, campaigns, budgets, and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Perform additional duties and responsibilities as assigned.

Position Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing, Communications, Public Relations, Business, Media, or a related field preferred.
  • Minimum of 4 years of experience in creator marketing, influencer marketing, talent partnerships, social media marketing, or related fields.
  • Experience managing creator or influencer partnerships from negotiation through campaign execution.
  • Strong understanding of major social media platforms, including Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X, Facebook, LinkedIn, and emerging channels.
  • Experience negotiating contracts, managing deliverables, and overseeing creator compensation programs.
  • Strong project management, organizational, and communication skills.
  • Experience tracking campaign performance and translating data into actionable recommendations.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and social media content management and analytics tools.
  • Knowledge of FTC influencer disclosure requirements and sponsored content best practices preferred.
  • Familiarity with AI tools and an interest in applying emerging technologies to creator marketing and campaign management.
  • Experience in media, digital publishing, broadcast television, news, entertainment, or talent management is preferred.
  • Ability to thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced environment while managing multiple projects and deadlines.

 Compensation & Benefits:

  • Competitive salary - $80k - $110k, depending on skills and relevant experience.
  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance plans.
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company match.
  • Paid time off and holidays.
  • Collaborative and inclusive work environment.

  • Valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record.
  • Experience achieving long-range objectives and implementing the strategies and actions to achieve them.
  • Proficiency with computers, telephones, copiers, scanners, fax machines and other office equipment.

job.title: Account Executive/Marketing Consultant
job.description:
A KXAN Marketing Consultant is a strategic sales professional responsible for generating advertising revenue through Broadcast Television, OTT/Streaming, and Digital Marketing solutions. In this role, you will identify and develop new business opportunities, uncover client marketing needs, create customized advertising strategies, and oversee campaign execution and performance.

  • Represent the most trusted local news brand in Central Texas.
  • Offer clients a full suite of advertising solutions, including broadcast television, streaming, and digital marketing.
  • Work with local businesses and agencies across one of the fastest-growing markets in the country.
  • Receive ongoing training, coaching, and professional development opportunities.
  • Build a rewarding career with one of the nation's leading local media companies.

  • Prospect and develop new business through outbound outreach, networking, referrals, and in-market visits.

  • Excellent relationship-building skills with the ability to establish long-term client partnerships.
  • Self-motivated, results-oriented, and driven to meet and exceed revenue goals.
  • Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.

Education & Experience

job.title: Anchor/ Reporter
job.description:
The News Anchor  serves as the primary presenter of news stories and other content for all platforms in a manner that is clear, engaging and meaningful to news consumers.

  • Presents news stories and other content for all platforms.
  • Ensures that all news content meets company standards for journalistic integrity and production quality.
  • Writes and delivers news stories in a clear and concise manner.
  • Produces newscasts and communicates clear direction with team members.
  • Assists in writing, copy editing, researching and coordinating news programming and other content.
  • Acts as a field reporter as assigned.
  • Conducts interviews with news personnel and others.
  • Responds to breaking news and other urgent newsrooms situations as required.
  • Participates in promotional activities including public appearances.
  • Performs special projects and other duties as assigned.

job.title: Anchor/Reporter
job.description:
Anchor/Reporter

 

KDVR/KWGN, the Nexstar-owned FOX/CW duopoly in Denver, Colorado, is seeking an experienced news co-anchor/reporter to join our CW2 Daybreak team.   

 

We are looking for an authentic, dynamic, engaging talent who can connect with an audience on all platforms. The ideal candidate will have solid news judgment, strong anchoring and reporting skills, and the ability to tell memorable stories. 

 

We are looking for a newsroom leader who is a self-starter, a good newsroom citizen and an advocate for the target viewer. The ideal candidate will be an experienced anchor who thrives on bringing value to our local audience, drives important and breaking news and who pitches good local enterprise stories and does daily in-depth reporting.

 

Responsibilities

·     Conversational anchor skills, ability to adlib with ease and connect audiences through professionalism and personality.

·     Covers “day-of” news in accordance with station brand initiatives and audience content priorities.

·     Must have good time management skills and be able to anchor and report every shift.

·     Ability to perform strong, interactive live shots

·     Ability to anchor/host streaming programs.

·     Fill-in as anchor on other newscasts when necessary

·     Works with producers and writers to improve newscasts

·     Engage with audience on all relevant social media platforms

·     Represents station at public events

Qualifications

·     Minimum of 5 years of on-air experience

·     Minimum of 3 years of anchoring experience

·     Past anchoring and reporting experience required

·     Proven track record of leadership and newscast ratings growth

·     Strong journalistic ethics

·     Ability to work under tight deadlines and work a flexible schedule that includes a regular early morning shift.

·     Degree in Journalism or related field

 

 Salary Range: $100K -- $130K Depending on Experience

job.title: Client Solutions Specialist
job.description:
THE OPPORTUNITY


Nexstar's advertising business continues to evolve across broadcast, digital, streaming, sponsorships and data-driven marketing solutions.

At FOX40, this position will play an important role in supporting a local sales team as the complexity and volume of integrated advertising opportunities continue to grow.


The Client Solutions Specialist will help bridge Sales, Digital, Research and Creative - making it easier for our Account Executives to bring sophisticated solutions to market while ensuring those opportunities are effectively coordinated and executed.


The goal is simple: help our sellers spend more time selling, help our teams execute more efficiently, and help FOX40 create, grow and retain revenue.


POSITION SUMMARY


Nexstar Media Group's FOX40 is seeking a highly organized, creative and solutions-oriented Sales & Digital Solutions Specialist to support a team of local Account Executives and help drive the continued growth of our broadcast, digital, streaming, sponsorship and integrated advertising business.


Although this role includes traditional sales support duties (order entry, revisions and WideOrbit traffic coordination) it goes beyond traditional sales support.


As advertising solutions become increasingly multi-platform, this position will help connect our sales team with the research, digital capabilities, sponsorship opportunities, creative resources and internal expertise needed to develop and execute effective client solutions.


Working closely with Sales leadership, Account Executives, Digital, Research, Commercial Production and Nexstar resources, the Sales & Digital Solutions Specialist will help move opportunities from idea to proposal to execution - while creating processes and materials that allow our sellers to spend more time selling.

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


DIGITAL & INTEGRATED SALES SUPPORT

  • Support local Account Executives in the development of broadcast, digital, streaming/CTV, social, search, sponsorship and integrated advertising solutions.
  • Help sellers navigate Nexstar's expanding portfolio of digital products, capabilities and internal resources.
  • Coordinate with Digital and other Nexstar teams to obtain product information, pricing, fulfillment requirements, research and campaign recommendations.
  • Support complex digital opportunities and integrated client proposals from initial concept through execution.
  • Assist with major RFPs and new-business opportunities by coordinating research, capabilities, pricing and required internal resources.
  • Help translate complex digital capabilities into clear, easy-to-sell client solutions.

SPONSORSHIP & REVENUE DEVELOPMENT

  • Work with Sales leadership to develop FOX40 sponsorships, sports packages, seasonal opportunities, community initiatives and custom programs.
  • Identify station programming, events, content and digital capabilities that can be packaged into new revenue opportunities.
  • Package broadcast, streaming, digital, social and custom-content assets into cohesive client solutions.
  • Maintain an organized and current library of available sponsorships, packages, sales materials and opportunities.
  • Coordinate the execution and fulfillment of sold sponsorships and integrated programs.

SALES PRESENTATIONS, RESEARCH & STORYTELLING

  • Research client categories, prospects, consumer trends, competitive activity and market opportunities.
  • Turn audience insights and research into clear, persuasive client-facing stories.
  • Develop polished presentations, one-sheets, proposals and sales materials.
  • Assist Account Executives with preparation for important client meetings, new-business presentations and RFPs.
  • Create customizable materials that allow sellers to respond quickly to opportunities.

CAMPAIGN COORDINATION & EXECUTION

  • Serve as a central point of coordination among Sales, Digital, Commercial Production, Creative Services and other internal resources for integrated campaigns.
  • Coordinate creative requests, client assets, approvals, production schedules and deadlines.
  • Track complex projects from initial concept through completion.
  • Maintain visibility into project status and proactively communicate next steps or potential roadblocks.
  • Help ensure that client objectives and sales strategy are accurately communicated to the teams responsible for execution.

CAMPAIGN RECAPS, RENEWALS & UPSELL

  • Develop client-facing post-campaign recaps that clearly demonstrate campaign execution and results.
  • Gather digital metrics, screenshots, creative assets, broadcast elements and other proof-of-performance.
  • Turn campaign results into compelling success stories that support renewals and upsell opportunities.
  • Help develop FOX40 case studies showcasing successful client partnerships.

SALES ENABLEMENT & PROCESS IMPROVEMENT

  • Help create and maintain tools, resources and processes that make it easier for the sales team to sell increasingly complex advertising solutions.
  • Serve as a resource for Account Executives seeking information about available products, sponsorships, digital capabilities and internal resources.
  • Coordinate multiple projects and priorities across Sales, Digital and Creative teams.
  • Support strategic sales initiatives and revenue-development projects identified by Sales leadership.
  • Provide general sales support as needed while maintaining primary focus on digital solutions, sponsorships, sales enablement and revenue-generating initiatives.

SALES SUPPORT & ORDER MANAGEMENT (AS NEEDED)

  • Provide backup sales support to local Account Executives as needed, including order entry, revisions and traffic coordination in WideOrbit.
  • Enter, revise and manage broadcast, digital and streaming orders in WideOrbit, ensuring accuracy of rates, dates, units, copy instructions and rotations.
  • Coordinate with Traffic, Billing and Accounting to help resolve discrepancies between orders, schedules, invoices and agency instructions.
  • Submit special billing requests, issue preemptions and maintain stewardship reports as needed.
  • Assist with contract generation, order stewardship and recap reports to support Account Executives, particularly during high-volume sales periods.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • Experience in media, advertising, digital marketing, sales support, account management, marketing or a related field.
  • Familiarity with the WideOrbit Sales & Traffic system and general order-entry processes a plus.
  • Strong organizational, time and project-management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
  • Strong written communication and storytelling skills.
  • Ability to take research, data or complex information and turn it into a clear client-facing story.
  • Strong PowerPoint or presentation-development skills.
  • Interest in digital advertising, streaming/CTV, emerging advertising products and integrated marketing.
  • Ability to work effectively across multiple departments and with different levels of the organization.
  • Proactive problem-solving skills and the ability to find answers and move projects forward.
  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced sales environment and supporting multiple Account Executives.

 

EEO Statement: All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by local, state, or federal laws, rules, or regulations.

KTXL Fox40 will consider qualified applicants with a criminal history pursuant to the California Fair Chance Act. You do not need to disclose your criminal history or participate in a background check until a conditional job offer is made to you. After making a conditional offer and running a background check, if KTXL Fox40 is concerned about conviction that is directly related to the job, you will be given the chance to explain the circumstances surrounding the conviction, provide mitigating evidence, or challenge the accuracy of the background report.

job.title: Digital Account Executive
job.description:
KOIN 6 Television & Portland's CW


Help Businesses Grow Through the Power of Video, Digital Marketing, and Local Media


KOIN 6 Television and Portland's CW, part of Nexstar Media Group, are seeking a high-performing Digital Account Executive to help businesses connect with consumers through today's most effective advertising solutions.


This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of broadcast television, streaming video, connected TV (CTV), digital marketing, social media, search, and data-driven advertising. You'll partner with local businesses and regional agencies to develop integrated campaigns that drive awareness, engagement, and measurable business results.


If you're a consultative seller who enjoys building relationships, solving marketing challenges, and delivering innovative advertising solutions, we invite you to join our team.


Why Join KOIN 6 & Nexstar?


As America's largest local media company, Nexstar offers the reach, resources, and technology of a national media leader combined with the local market influence of trusted brands like KOIN 6.

You'll have access to:

· Industry-leading television, streaming, and digital advertising solutions

· A robust portfolio of video marketing products across every screen

· Proprietary audience targeting and data-driven advertising tools

· Ongoing sales training and professional development

· Competitive compensation with uncapped earning potential

· Comprehensive benefits package

· A collaborative and results-oriented culture

What You'll Do


Develop New Business

  • Prospect, qualify, and secure new advertising partnerships with local businesses and regional agencies.
  • Identify opportunities through networking, referrals, cold outreach, and market intelligence.
  • Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of sales opportunities.

Serve as a Trusted Marketing Advisor


  • Consult with business owners and marketing leaders to understand their goals and challenges.
  • Develop strategic marketing recommendations based on business objectives, consumer insights, and industry trends.
  • Present customized advertising solutions that deliver measurable outcomes.


Sell Advanced Advertising Solutions


Represent a comprehensive portfolio that includes:


  • Broadcast Television
  • Connected TV (CTV) & Streaming Video
  • Over-the-Top (OTT) Advertising
  • Programmatic Display
  • Targeted Digital Video
  • Social Media Advertising
  • Search Engine Marketing (SEM)
  • Search Engine Optimization (SEO)
  • Sponsored Content
  • Audience Extension Products
  • Email Marketing
  • Emerging Advertising Technologies

Drive Revenue Growth


  • Consistently achieve and exceed revenue goals.
  • Grow existing account relationships while generating new business.
  • Accurately forecast sales activity and revenue opportunities.

Stay Ahead of Industry Trends


  • Maintain expertise in developing digital and video advertising technologies.
  • Understand changing consumer media habits and advertising best practices.
  • Help clients navigate an increasingly fragmented media landscape with confidence.

What You'll Bring


Sales Excellence


  • Proven success in media, digital, advertising, or business-to-business sales.
  • Strong prospecting, presentation, negotiation, and closing skills.
  • Ability to develop new business while maintaining long-term client relationships.

Digital & Video Marketing Knowledge


  • Understanding of modern digital advertising strategies and performance metrics.
  • Familiarity with video advertising, streaming platforms, audience targeting, and campaign measurement.
  • Knowledge of tools such as Google Analytics, Google Ad Manager, CRM platforms, or comparable technologies is a plus.

Consultative Mindset


  • Ability to uncover business needs and translate them into effective marketing solutions.
  • Strong problem-solving and strategic thinking skills.
  • Confidence engaging with decision-makers at all levels.

Professionalism & Organization


  • Excellent communication and presentation skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and time-management abilities.
  • Comfortable managing multiple opportunities in a dynamic environment.

Qualifications


  • Bachelor's degree preferred.
  • 3+ years of experience in media, digital, advertising, or consultative sales.
  • Demonstrated track record of achieving sales goals and developing new business relationships.
  • Valid driver's license and reliable transportation for client meetings.

The Opportunity


Advertising is evolving quickly, and video has become the dominant medium for reaching consumers across television, streaming, mobile, and connected devices. At KOIN 6 and Portland's CW, you'll help businesses leverage the latest marketing technologies while representing some of the most trusted media brands in the region.


If you're motivated by building relationships, creating innovative campaigns, and helping businesses grow, this is an opportunity to build a rewarding career with a recognized industry leader.


Apply Today

Visit the Careers page at KOIN.com or Nexstar Media Group to complete the online application process.

job.title: Digital Content Producer
job.description:
Position responsibilities:

  • Curate and aggregate a steady stream of interesting content that is packaged and promoted in a way that generates engagement and repeat site visitation
  • Monitor all forms of media (print, TV, digital, blogs and social) and be the quick to report breaking news stories and always on the hunt for exclusive and or trending content that will grow engagement and drive loyal, local traffic
  • Excellent at writing headlines that grow audience and engagement
  • Prioritize packaging content that grows page views per visitor and time on site, using headline testing, metric tools and observed patterns to guide decision making
  • Understand different ways to tell a story, particularly producing short videos and choosing great photos
  • Evaluate website traffic trends to make decisions on both daily content needs and longer-term content curation that will grow local audience
  • Build positive working relationships with newsroom staff and management, work collaboratively on enterprise content, and creating opportunities to market web content on broadcast
  • Promote and distribute news content on social media platforms and through other audience engagement tools
  • Monitor scanners, wires, news releases, emails, and social media for story leads
  • Plan and produce live or recorded digital-exclusive content (e.g., interviews, explainers, behind-the-scenes)
  • Assist with development, planning, and follow-up of news stories for all platform
  • Keep the newsroom informed of breaking news and developing stories throughout the day
  • Answer phones, vet story tips, and maintain daily news logs

job.title: Digital Media Manager
job.description:
The Digital Media Manager leads the station's digital content strategy across website, mobile, social media, streaming, and emerging platforms. This position is responsible for growing audience engagement, increasing digital revenue opportunities, overseeing digital content production, and ensuring the newsroom maximizes the reach and impact of its content across all platforms.

 

The ideal candidate is a strong leader who understands digital journalism, audience development, social media strategy, analytics, SEO, video publishing, and content monetization. This person will work closely with newsroom, marketing, sales, and production teams to execute a comprehensive digital strategy that supports the station's brand and business goals.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Content Leadership

  • Lead the daily digital content strategy and execution across all station platforms.
  • Manage website and mobile content to ensure accuracy, timeliness, and audience engagement.
  • Oversee digital producers, executive producer,  and content creators to ensure high-quality storytelling.
  • Develop and enforce digital content standards, workflows, and best practices.
  • Ensure breaking news, severe weather, sports, and special coverage are optimized for digital audiences.

Audience Growth & Engagement

  • Develop strategies to increase website traffic, video views, social engagement, and newsletter subscriptions.
  • Monitor audience trends and identify opportunities to expand digital reach.
  • Lead social media strategy across all platforms, including Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, X, YouTube, and emerging channels.
  • Build audience engagement initiatives that encourage community interaction and loyalty.

SEO & Analytics

  • Utilize SEO best practices to maximize search performance.
  • Monitor key performance indicators using audience analytics tools.
  • Generate regular reports on traffic, engagement, video consumption, and audience growth.
  • Use data to guide editorial decisions and content strategies.

Video & Streaming Strategy

  • Oversee publishing and optimization of video content on websites, apps, social media, OTT, and streaming platforms.
  • Work with producers and reporters to create digital-first video content.
  • Identify opportunities for live streaming and digital-exclusive programming.
  • Support the growth of CTV and OTT products.

Team Leadership

  • Recruit, train, mentor, and evaluate digital content staff.
  • Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, and collaboration.
  • Conduct regular coaching sessions and performance evaluations.
  • Coordinate schedules and workflow to ensure adequate digital coverage.

Cross-Department Collaboration

job.title: Manager, Finance – Benefits and Compensation
job.description:
Preferred Location: Irving, TX; Alternate Locations: New York, NY or Chicago, IL


Nexstar Media Group, Inc. (“Nexstar” or the “Company”) is seeking a highly skilled and detail-oriented Manager, Finance - Benefits and Compensation to oversee the administration, compliance, and financial management of the Company's benefits and compensation-related programs. This role serves as a key member of the Finance team and is responsible for managing the Company’s pension plans, analyzing and managing the financial impact of the 401(k) programs, benefit plans, and compensation strategies.


The ideal candidate will possess strong financial acumen, retirement plan expertise, project management skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively with internal stakeholders, external actuaries, investment advisors, trustees, third-party administrators, and senior leadership.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities



Retirement Plan Administration


· Manage the day-to-day administration of Nexstar's qualified and non-qualified retirement programs, including pension and 401(k) plans.

· Partner with actuaries, auditors, trustees, recordkeepers, and third-party administrators to support retirement plan operations.

· Monitor plan compliance with applicable IRS, DOL, ERISA, and PBGC regulations.

· Assist with annual audits, Form 5500 filings, actuarial valuations, and government reporting requirements.


Governance & Committee Management


· Prepare and maintain Retirement Committee presentation materials and meeting schedules.

· Coordinate agendas, supporting documentation, and communications for Retirement Committee meetings.

· Track committee decisions and ensure appropriate follow-up on approved actions.


Benefits & Compensation Support


· Support the financial oversight of employee benefits programs.

· Assist in compensation planning initiatives, salary administration, market benchmarking, and annual compensation review processes.

· Analyze compensation and benefits data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities.

· Develop reports and presentations for Finance, Human Resources, and executive leadership teams.

· Ensure compensation and retirement plan processes align with company policies and regulatory requirements.


Financial Reporting & Analysis


· Assist with budgeting and forecasting for retirement and benefits programs.

· Monitor funding obligations, benefit payment activity, and plan expenses.

· Support accounting and finance teams with pension and benefit-related financial disclosures and reporting requirements.


Cross-Functional Collaboration


· Partner closely with internal HR and payroll teams to ensure seamless administration of retirement and compensation programs.

· Participate in process improvement initiatives designed to enhance efficiency, compliance, and employee experience.


Qualifications


· Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Human Resources, or related field required.

· 5+ years of experience in retirement plan administration, pension accounting, benefits finance, compensation, or related area.

· Experience managing pension plans, 401(k) plans, and retirement plan compliance activities.

· Strong understanding of ERISA, IRS, DOL, and PBGC regulations.

· Experience working with actuarial consultants, auditors, trustees, and third-party administrators.

· Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and financial reporting tools.

· Strong analytical, organizational, and project management skills.

· Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

· Ability to manage multiple priorities and maintain strict confidentiality.


Preferred Qualifications


· CPA, CEBS, ASPPA, QKA, QPA, CFP, or similar professional designation preferred.

· Experience within a public company or large multi-location organization.

· Knowledge of executive compensation and equity-based programs is a plus.

· Experience with pension plans.


Key Competencies


· Financial Analysis

· Retirement Plan Administration

· Pension Funding & Compliance

· Compensation Planning

· Governance & Committee Management

· Regulatory Compliance

· Strategic Thinking

· Attention to Detail

· Relationship Management

· Project Management


Compensation: $120k-$140k annualized, commensurate with applicant’s experience and skill level.

job.description:
WGNO-TV in New Orleans, a #DigitalFirst operation with a focus on delivering local content 24/7 across all platforms is looking for an assertive, multi-talented person to serve as a Multimedia Journalist.

job.title: News Producer
job.description:
News Producer – Job Description

The successful candidate should consistently produce a show that stands out as best in their market. You should know how to “produce up” a story, live and breathe digital and thrive at integrating it into your shows.

We’re seeking someone with 4+ years of news producing experience. A Bachelor’s degree is required.

  • Essential Functions: 

• Be creative and create compelling and memorable newscasts 
• Write creative headlines and teases 
• Maintain working knowledge of current events, community issues, and local contacts 
• Search wire services, network feeds, websites, and social media to find relevant material for newscasts 
• Collaborate with news operations staff to build graphics 
• Work with directors and anchors on presentation of stories

• Clear, concise, conversational writing skills 
• Excellent communication skills 
• Demonstrate solid news judgment 
• Maintain strong journalistic ethics 
• Strong initiative and attention to detail 
• Research and brainstorm story ideas, present ideas in editorial meetings • Generate promotable story ideas daily 
• Post and update stories to station website and social media sites, engage viewers 
• Communicate with the web staff during breaking news 
• Perform other job-related duties as assigned 
• Write news stories 
• Assist producers in formatting other newscasts

Essential Skills & Abilities: 
• Knowledge of newsroom software 
• Knowledge of web posting software 
• Strong research skills, including online research using various search engines 
• Ability to stay current with national and local news/weather 
• Knowledge of engaging on social media 
• Ability to meet tight deadlines and work well under pressure 
• Ability to work independently with little supervision 
• Demonstrate leadership through training and mentoring less experienced staff members; guide others to get the desired outcome

• Edit video and audio on industry standard equipment

job.description:
Take advantage of a fantastic opportunity with WBTW News 13, the unrivaled media powerhouse in the Myrtle Beach-Florence region. We have an immediate opening for a News Producer to join our award-winning newsroom.


We are looking for a creative, organized, and driven journalist who thrives in a fast-paced environment and is passionate about producing compelling local news. This is more than just a job. It is an exciting career opportunity with Nexstar Media Group, where you will play a key role in shaping daily newscasts and informing the communities we serve.


As a News Producer, you will produce daily newscasts by selecting and organizing stories, determining the order in which they are presented, writing teases and other compelling content, timing news programs, editing video, and posting content to the station website. The ideal candidate will have strong news judgment, excellent writing skills, the ability to meet tight deadlines, and a commitment to producing accurate and engaging broadcasts.

WBTW News 13 is seeking a Newscast Producer. This role is responsible for the complete execution of daily newscasts across broadcast and digital platforms. The ideal candidate has strong writing  and communication skills who can collaborate positively with reporters, anchors, and production teams to deliver compelling, accurate, and showcase-value broadcasts.


Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Newscast Production: Conceptualize, structure, and stack daily newscasts, determining the strategic order and precise timing of stories.
  • Content Creation: Write engaging, broadcast-ready scripts, teases, and copy for anchors, ensuring strict adherence to journalistic standards and accuracy.
  • Control Room Leadership: Serve as a calm, decisive leader in the control room, effectively managing breaking news, severe weather coverage, and real-time rundown adjustments.
  • Team Collaboration: Partner productively with reporters, photographers, assignment desks, and the graphics team to coordinate visual elements and streamline news delivery.
  • Multi-Platform Distribution: Produce content across all platforms, including editing video clips and writing stories for the station website and digital applications.

Requirements & Skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Journalism or Communications is preferred but not required.

job.description:

job.title: Associate, Real-Time Systems (External Agency Staff)
job.description:
The Associate, Real-Time Systems supports the design, configuration, operation, and troubleshooting of Real-Time Systems that power NFL Media digital graphics experiences, including FAST channels, NFL+, RedZone, and other digital productions. This role serves as a technical resource for Viz graphics workflows, ticker systems, L-Bar applications, data integrations, and real-time content delivery while helping ensure reliable operation of critical production systems.

Responsibilities

  • Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot Viz graphics systems, render engines, ticker systems, L-Bar applications, and supporting software environments to ensure reliable delivery of graphics across FAST, digital, and RedZone platforms.
  • Support end-to-end graphics workflows including data-driven Viz graphics, scorebars, ticker content, promotional elements, sponsorship integrations, countdown clocks, and lower-third graphic packages to ensure accurate on-air and digital presentation.
  • Maintain RTS applications, databases, APIs, and automated page generation tools while validating data flow between internal services, graphics systems, and production environments.
  • Serve as a frontline technical resource during live productions by diagnosing and resolving graphics, connectivity, software, and data issues to minimize operational disruptions.
  • Partner with production, engineering, and operations teams to support FAST channel graphics, RedZone L-Bar workflows, ticker content management, and digital platform graphics delivery.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, diagrams, workflow guides, system inventories, and operational procedures while identifying opportunities for process improvements and automation.
  • Assist with preparation, testing, deployment, and operational support for major league events including the NFL Draft, NFL Combine, International Games, Kickoff, Playoffs, and Super Bowl coverage.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Broadcast Technology, Information Systems, Computer Science, Digital Media, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 3+ years of experience supporting broadcast graphics, digital media operations, production technology, or real-time systems.
  • Experience supporting Vizrt, graphics rendering systems, or similar real-time graphics platforms.
  • Working knowledge of networking, Windows administration, system configuration, and troubleshooting.
  • Familiarity with data-driven graphics, APIs, databases, and content automation workflows.
  • Experience supporting live production, digital streaming, or broadcast operations.
  • Ability to work independently in fast-paced, deadline-driven environments.

Qualifications

  • Experience supporting FAST channels, OTT streaming platforms, or sports media operations.
  • Experience with Viz Trio, Viz Engine, ticker systems, or graphics automation workflows.
  • Familiarity with SQL databases and scripting/automation tools.
  • Experience supporting major live sporting events.

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Detail-oriented with strong organizational abilities.
  • Ability to remain calm under pressure during live productions.
  • Strong customer service mindset and production support orientation.

Physical Demands

  • Ability to work in control rooms, machine rooms, and production environments.
  • Occasional lifting and movement of production or IT equipment up to 40 pounds.

Travel

  • No travel typically required.

 Terms / Expected Hours of Work

  • Flexible schedule required.
  • Evening, overnight, weekend, and holiday work may be required during live productions and major events.
  • Overtime may be required based on production schedules.

job.title: Director, Event Partnership Strategy & Development
job.description:
The NFL is seeking a Director, Event Partnership Strategy & Development to help drive the growth, innovation, and commercial success of the League's Events & International portfolio. Working closely with senior leadership, this role will lead strategic partnership initiatives, manage critical League commercial relationships, and identify new opportunities to expand revenue, enhance fan engagement, and strengthen the NFL's event platforms. 

The Director will serve as a key connector across Events, International, Sponsorship, Media, Consumer Products, Finance, Corporate Strategy, and the 32 Clubs. The role will develop business strategies, evaluate growth opportunities, and execute high-impact initiatives across major NFL tentpole events, including the Super Bowl, NFL Draft, NFL Scouting Combine, Kickoff, NFL Flag Championships, and International Games. 

The ideal candidate combines strategic thinking, commercial acumen, relationship leadership, analytical rigor, and execution excellence. This individual will be comfortable moving between long-range strategy and day-to-day partner management, translating insights into clear recommendations and measurable business results. 

Responsibilities

Partnership Strategy & Commercial Management 

  • Serve as the day-to-day business lead for select League commercial partnerships, including On Location and event retail partners, managing relationships that drive meaningful revenue, fan engagement, operational performance, and long-term strategic value. 
  • Develop and execute growth plans that maximize commercial performance and identify opportunities to expand assets, activation platforms, audience reach, and partner value. 
  • Establish clear objectives, governance, performance expectations, and issue-escalation paths with partners to ensure consistent delivery against contractual and strategic commitments. 
  • Build trusted relationships with senior executives across partner organizations, serving as a strategic advisor and solution-oriented representative of the League. 
  • Support the development, negotiation, renewal, and implementation of strategic commercial agreements in partnership with Legal, Finance, and other stakeholders. 

Strategic Growth & Business Development 

  • Lead the identification, evaluation, and advancement of new revenue opportunities, business models, partnership structures, and growth initiatives across the NFL's Major Events & International portfolio. 
  • Help shape the long-term business strategy for key NFL event platforms, defining future commercial opportunities, fan experiences, and growth priorities that support broader League objectives. 
  • Develop business cases, strategic frameworks, and executive recommendations to evaluate potential investments, partnerships, new platforms, and other commercial opportunities. 
  • Monitor market trends, consumer behavior, emerging technologies, and competitive activity across sports, entertainment, media, hospitality, and live events to identify opportunities that strengthen the NFL's business position. 

Cross-Functional Leadership & Execution 

  • Lead cross-functional teams through the end-to-end development and execution of strategic initiatives, establishing clear objectives, workplans, decision points, responsibilities, and measures of success. 
  • Collaborate across Events, International, Sponsorship, Finance, Media, Consumer Products, Legal, Club Business Development, and other League functions to develop integrated business solutions and drive alignment. 
  • Oversee concurrent workstreams from concept through implementation, ensuring initiatives are delivered on time, within scope, and in accordance with League priorities and partner commitments. 
  • Anticipate risks, identify challenges and interdependencies, and proactively develop recommendations that support successful execution and sustainable business outcomes. 

Executive Communications & Stakeholder Engagement 

  • Prepare and present business cases, strategic recommendations, partnership updates, and performance assessments for senior leadership, ownership committees, Clubs, and external partners. 
  • Develop post-event and post-initiative assessments that capture business performance, key learnings, growth opportunities, and recommendations for future improvement.  
  • Establish performance measurement frameworks, KPIs, and reporting tools that provide clear visibility into commercial results, partner delivery, and areas for future growth. 
  • Translate complex business issues, research, and financial information into clear insights and actionable recommendations for senior leadership and other decision-makers. 

People & Team Leadership 

  • Provide day-to-day leadership, coaching, and development for assigned team members and project resources, setting clear priorities and reinforcing accountability, collaboration, and high-quality execution. 
  • Help allocate resources across partnership management, business development, analytical work, and strategic initiatives to ensure the team remains focused on the highest-impact priorities. 
  • Contribute to a high-performing and inclusive team culture that values commercial curiosity, sound judgment, continuous improvement, and shared success. 

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree in business, finance, strategy, or a related field is a plus. 
  • 10+ years of progressive experience in sports, media, entertainment, live events, hospitality, consulting, financial services, or another commercially oriented business environment. 
  • Demonstrated experience developing business cases, partnership strategies, revenue growth initiatives, or new business opportunities. 
  • Strong commercial and financial acumen, including experience evaluating revenue models, forecasts, investments, and performance metrics. 
  • Proven ability to manage complex partner relationships and influence senior internal and external stakeholders without direct authority. 

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Exceptional executive communication, writing, presentation, and facilitation skills, with the ability to distill complex issues into clear recommendations. 
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint and Excel, including experience developing executive-level presentations and data-driven analyses. 
  • Entrepreneurial, collaborative, and highly organized, with sound judgment, strong attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple time-sensitive priorities in a matrixed organization. 

Salary / Pay Range

The NFL expects to hire for this position near the middle of the range. Only in truly rare and exceptional circumstances, where an external candidate has experience, credentials or expertise that far exceed those required or expected for the position, would the NFL consider paying a salary or rate near the higher end of the range.

job.title: Manager, Football Business Strategy
job.description:
The Manager, Football Business Strategy will plan, implement, and execute initiatives that support Football Operations strategic priorities. The role will lead the research, testing, and development required to evaluate and implement innovations across Future of Football workstreams, while managing a portfolio of high- impact projects. This role will also address a diverse set of football business challenges by partnering regularly with internal departments, clubs, vendors, sponsors and other external stakeholders. The Manager, Football Business Strategy may also oversee interns, rotational analysts, coordinators, or project-based contributors supporting Football Business Strategy and Operations.

Responsibilities

  • Support the planning, execution, and oversight of strategic initiatives that support Football Operations priorities, including football innovation, game operations and policy, international growth, and long-range organizational planning.
  • Manage the League’s Future of Football portfolio, including technology evaluations, pilot programs, stakeholder alignment, testing plans, implementation support, and performance reporting for Football Operations leadership and club stakeholders.
  • Support Football Operations business planning, budget development, forecasting, enterprise risk management, KPI reporting, and strategic decision-making through financial, operational, and scenario analysis.
  • Serve as the project manager for football technology and data initiatives, including club analytics devices, data-sharing programs, operational technology deployments, game day support, and vendor-supported innovation efforts.
  • Develop executive-level presentations, recommendations, memoranda, and reporting for senior leadership, the Competition Committee, Future of Football Committee, Technology Committee, and other key stakeholder groups.
  • Lead vendor evaluation, procurement, contract administration, payment tracking, and RFP processes across assigned workstreams, including technology platforms, football operations services, and innovation partnerships.
  • Partner with internal and external partners to identify opportunities to improve football operations through emerging technologies, automation, data, and artificial intelligence.
  • Support international football development initiatives programs that strengthen football ecosystems, expand participation pathways, and support the long-term growth of the game globally.
  • Coordinate complex cross-functional projects and stakeholder engagement efforts, ensuring alignment across clubs, League departments, vendors, and external football organizations while delivering against established timelines and strategic objectives.
  • Maintain detailed project plans, timelines, decision logs, budgets, and status reporting for assigned initiatives.
  • Provide support across League tentpole events, football technology testing, and other Football Operations priorities.
  • Demonstrate flexibility in addressing ad hoc projects and evolving organizational needs.

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum 5-7+ years of experience
  • Bachelor’s degree
  • Experience in football operations, sports technology, data, and AI, with familiarity across emerging technologies, integration, and adoption workflows.
  • Experience managing strategic, operational, technology, or consulting projects with multiple stakeholders and concurrent workstreams.
  • Experience with budgeting, forecasting, vendor management, procurement, contracting, or RFP processes preferred.
  • Excellent attention to detail, organization, judgment, and follow-

job.description:

  • Facilitate communication and exchange of ideas with the NFL Network graphics department

  • Excellent organization skills required

  • Strong understanding of the workflow in a TV control room environment
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment

job.title: Seasonal Part-Time Segment Producer
job.description:
The NFL Media Group located in Inglewood, CA is looking for a seasonal part-time NFL RedZone Segment Producer. This position will report to the Coordinating Producer for NFL RedZone.

Responsibilities

  • Oversees EVS operators in the tape room during live NFL RedZone production, serving as a tape/live producer of the games that are assigned
  • Responsible for spotting key plays, interesting storylines during a full slate of NFL games
  • Take direction from show Producers to enhance content on NFL RedZone
  • Guides edit team through edits of highlights, and sound needed during the day for NFL RedZone
  • Coordinates with the on-air staff to write accurate and informative content as it relates to the segment
  • Uses a high level of sports knowledge and news judgment to determine the agenda, concepts, and content of the assigned games within NFL RedZone
  • Assign and give creative and editorial notes for high end element production
  • Supervise both short-form & long-form highlight production
  • Copy-edit scripts
  • Supervise, train, and mentor Associate Producers & Production Assistants
  • Produce sound for fill segments during NFL RedZone
  • Explain edit instructions in detail
  • Must bring creative statistical ideas to the NFL RedZone preshow meeting on Sunday mornings to help team enhance the show for the viewer
  • Bring to life statical information given in preshow editorial meeting when overseeing the live games that are assigned

Required Qualifications

  • 4-6 years of progressively complex studio or related production experience
  • Good production skills related to sporting events and graphics
  • A strong knowledge of live television production dynamics and working knowledge of the equipment and technologies in EVS, the control room and edit bays
  • Ability to carry out a broad range of assignments that range from highlight supervising to segment producing to on-air graphics with little or no preparation time in between
  • Have a good knowledge of the NFL and sports history
  • Supervisory experience with good leadership skills
  • Good writing and copy-editing skills
  • Knowledge of television graphics and VizRT graphics
  • Technical knowledge required - must have knowledge of what "works" on television
  • Specific knowledge of television production techniques used in a EVS tape room as well as the control room

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Communication, Journalism or equivalent experience in a related field
  • Advanced understanding of linear editing and on-air graphics systems

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Must have strong editorial skills and NFL knowledge to know what video and soundbites are best to edit
  • Must be able to respond quickly on short deadlines
  • Adhere to established production schedule to meet deadlines
  • A team-first attitude is mandatory

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

  • Part-time, up to 29 hours/week
  • 7:30am - 4:30pm Sunday availability
  • Overtime may be required on any given NFL RedZone Sunday
  • Seasonal employment up to 7 months

job.title: Seasonal Recruiter
job.description:
The Seasonal Recruiter will lead seasonal recruitment efforts for various NFL offices.  In this role, you will be a talent advisor and build strong relationships with the senior management team. The successful candidate will play a pivotal role with senior management, hiring managers, compensation, finance, and HR Business Partners in driving hiring and employee retention efficiencies that support the NFL's vision, mission, and values. 

Please note this role is in-person/office five days a week based in Mount Laurel, NJ. Up to seven months of anticipated engagement (subject to change based on business needs).

Responsibilities 

  • Manage 40 to 50+ open seasonal requisitions at once across multiple departments and locations during peak hiring periods 
  • Execute full-cycle, high volume recruitment including screening, interviewing, and extending offers 
  • Support Early Career recruitment efforts during non-peak seasonal hiring times 
  • Build strong working relationships with HR and hiring managers to understand business needs, seasonal headcount planning, and job requirements 
  • Identify, and recruit candidates for a wide range of temporary roles across media, production, and game operations 
  • Maintain accurate and organized data in the applicant tracking system (Greenhouse) for all candidates and requisitions 
  • Create and deliver regular search status updates to hiring managers and partners 
  • Ensure equitable hiring processes in line with NFL standards and policies 
  • Build and maintain talent pipelines to support recurring seasonal staffing needs 
  • Represent the NFL at in person or virtual hiring events, job fairs, and recruiting programs as needed 
  • Manage offer processes including recommendations, drafting and extending offers, and negotiations as permitted 
  • Ensure onboarding requirements are completed, including background checks, offer letters, new hire paperwork, and start date coordination 
  • Partner with HR teams to support smooth onboarding experiences 
  • Ensure compliance with EEO, ADA, and all applicable federal and state employment laws 

Required Qualifications 

  • Bachelor’s degree with 4+ years of high‑volume recruitment experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience 
  • Demonstrated ability to efficiently manage 40 to 50+ high‑volume requisitions simultaneously 
  • Experience working with various recruitment platforms including, but not limited to Greenhouse, LinkedIn, and HireVue. 
  • Strong working knowledge of federal and state employment law as well as corporate recruitment processes 
  • Superior candidate management experience 
  • Excellent project management skills  

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics 

  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment 
  • Experience supporting large‑scale, fast‑turnaround staffing initiatives 
  • Strong business acumen and the ability to quickly learn operational needs across multiple departments 
  • Ability to work both collaboratively and independently with minimal supervision 
  • Detail‑oriented with the ability to manage competing priorities and tight deadlines 
  • Consistent follow‑through, strong initiative, and proactive problem‑solving skills 

Terms /Expected Hours of Work 

  • Up to seven months of anticipated engagement (subject to change based on business needs) 
  • NFL employees are required to work 40 hours per week and at times, this role may require overtime (time worked in excess of 40 hours) and/or weekends.  
  • FLSA non-exempt  
  • Please note that this job posting is for a position with one of the NFL’s third-party agency partners that provides services to the NFL. 

Salary / Pay Range 

This job posting contains a pay range, which represents the range of salaries or hourly rates that the NFL believes, in good faith, at the time of this posting that it might be willing to pay for the posted job in the location(s) specified. The NFL expects to hire for this position near the middle of the range. Only in truly rare and exceptional circumstances, where an external candidate has experience, credentials or expertise that far exceed those required or expected for the position, would the NFL consider paying a salary or rate near the higher end of the range. 

Salary $30—$40 USD

job.title: Senior Coordinator, International Growth
job.description:
The Senior Coordinator, International Growth, is focused on helping shape and articulate the strategic direction of the NFL’s international business. This position will also help to develop and evaluate new initiatives that drive growth across various aspects of the business.

Responsibilities:

  • Support the development and execution of strategies to drive long-term strategic value for the League in the international market, balancing financial, strategic, operational, and partnership consideration
  • Research, design, develop, and recommend data-informed concepts and solutions across international
  • Project manage specific initiatives from beginning to end, including preliminary business case analysis, execution plan development, cross-functional communication, and post-project impact assessments
  • Own financial analysis, KPI development, and other data tracking associated with ongoing projects and initiatives
  • Partner with key NFL departments, including: Sponsorship, Consumer Products, Media, Football Development, Events, Club BD, Legal, Finance, Marketing, among others
  • Manage day-to-day coordination across territory offices and the League office with a focus on cross-functional information sharing and collaboration
  • Create documents and presentation materials for executive-level audiences
  • Coordinate and track various components of the Global Markets Program, in collaboration with Club Business Development
  • Support the International and Events teams with annual and long-term business planning

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • 2-3 years strategy experience, preferably with a management consulting or sports/events background
  • Excellent project management skills and ability to deliver against deadlines while simultaneously managing multiple projects
  • Strong abilities in presentation design and financial modeling/analysis (requires proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint)
  • Strong organizational skills and high attention to detail
  • Adept communicator with the ability to create, nurture, and sustain key relationships across many different areas of businesses (with various time zones and cultural nuances)
  • Problem-solver, solution-oriented, a strategic and creative thinker

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience working in an international role at a sports management organization
  • Proven success in consulting, sports management, and/or international business

job.title: Senior Coordinator, Licensing (12-month Leave Cover)
job.description:
The Senior Coordinator, Licensing (Europe) supports the growth and execution of the NFL's consumer products, licensing, retail, and fan commerce initiatives across the European market. This role will assist in managing partner relationships, supporting e-commerce and retail programs, coordinating marketing and product development activities, and contributing to revenue-generating initiatives across key categories and channels. The position works closely with internal stakeholders, external partners, and NFL Clubs to help deliver an integrated consumer products strategy that supports fan engagement and business growth throughout Europe.

Responsibilities:

  • Support the day-to-day management of consumer products and licensing partners across product development, marketing, retail, and business operations.
  • Assist in the execution of initiatives that support annual revenue and business growth objectives across Europe.
  • Coordinate key activities related to the NFL Europe e-commerce business, including assortment planning, promotional execution, sales tracking, and reporting.
  • Partner with Consumer Products and Marketing teams to support the development and execution of annual marketing plans across social media, digital, CRM, influencer, and media channels.
  • Support partner marketing programs, retail activations, and fan engagement initiatives across European markets.
  • Coordinate product development activities, including quality control reviews, product approvals, rights management processes, and market-specific product opportunities.
  • Assist partners in executing retail strategies and identifying opportunities to expand market presence and product distribution.
  • Support merchandise and retail operations for NFL games, events, and activations throughout Europe.
  • Coordinate consumer products initiatives related to NFL Club Global Markets Programs and support locally relevant fan engagement efforts.
  • Work with internal insights and analytics teams to leverage fan and market data that inform product, retail, and partner strategies.
  • Prepare regular business reports, forecasts, sales updates, and performance analyses for internal and external stakeholders.
  • Support management of licensing agencies and partner portfolios across designated territories.
  • Track and monitor regional consumer products marketing funds and assist with budget reporting.
  • Provide administrative, operational, and project coordination support across the European Consumer Products business.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.

job.description:
Bilingual Sales Consultant, Austin, Texas← View all Norsan Media careersNorsan Media

Bilingual Sales Consultant

Austin, Texas•Full-time
$30,000+ annuallyApply
About the Job
Are you a results-driven, bilingual sales professional with proven sales experience, preferably in advertising, media, or marketing but not necessary looking for an opportunity in media sales?

Do you have a passion for helping businesses grow through innovative advertising solutions? If so, we want you on our team!

Why Join Us?
At Norsan Media, we are more than just a media company, we are a trusted voice in the Latino community, delivering engaging radio, print, digital, and event experiences across multiple markets. As a Bilingual Sales Consultant, you’ll play a key role in helping businesses connect with their audience through impactful radio advertising campaigns.

What You’ll Do:
  • Identify and develop new business opportunities by prospecting potential clients.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, understanding their unique advertising needs.
  • Create customized advertising solutions that align with clients’ marketing goals.
  • Negotiate and close advertising contracts that deliver mutual success.
  • Work closely with internal teams to ensure seamless campaign execution.
  • Monitor ad performance, provide insights, and recommend optimizations.
  • Stay ahead of market trends and competitor activities to provide strategic advice.

What We’re Looking For:
  • Bilingual (English & Spanish) with excellent communication skills.
  • Proven sales experience, preferably in advertising, media, or marketing.
  • A go-getter attitude with strong prospecting and networking skills.
  • Ability to understand client objectives and develop tailored marketing solutions.
  • Skilled in negotiation and closing deals.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple projects.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and CRM software.

What We Offer:
  • $30,000 annual base salary + uncapped commission (your earnings are in your hands!).
  • Ongoing training and professional growth opportunities.
  • A dynamic, collaborative, and supportive work environment.
  • Flexible schedule and remote work options. Mileage reimbursement for client visits.

Ready to Make an Impact?
If you’re passionate about sales, media, and making a difference in the Hispanic market, we’d love to hear from you!

Apply today and start your journey with Norsan Media!
About Us:
The company currently owns and operates Regional Mexican, Latin Urban, Latin Pop/Tropical, Spanish Adult Contemporary stations in the Southeast and Austin, TX. The company has a combined reach of over 3 million Hispanics with their coverage in the US. In 2004, NORSAN launched Norsan Media in the Southeast and is based in Charlotte, NC and currently owns over 50 radio stations, 4 TV stations, a weekly regional digital and printed publication, and digital marketing and social media platforms in North Carolina, South Carolina, Florida and Texas.

Norsan Media’s holding company, NORSAN, was founded in 1987 by Norberto Sanchez. He continues to serve as Chairman of the company. NORSAN currently owns and operates 18 restaurants including Frontera Mexican Kitchen, Luciano’s Ristorante Italiano, Pampas Steakhouse, Frankie’s the Steakhouse, La Capital MX, H&W Steakhouse, Pinto’s Mexican Made Easy concept and operates the 1818 Club. Prime Meats, a USDA and SQF certified company providing high-quality meats to various distributors across half of the US, was recently acquired by Shoreline Equity Partners where Norberto Sanchez continues as Chairman of the Board.Apply

job.title: ACPR Federal Manager
job.description:
OVERVIEW

A thriving, mission-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility – and our employees do too. We are innovators and leaders in diverse fields, from journalism and digital media to IT and development. Every day, our employees and member stations touch the lives of millions worldwide. 

Across our organization, we’re building a workplace where collaboration is essential, diverse voices are heard, and inclusion is the key to our success. We are committed to doing the right thing in our journalism and in every role at NPR. This means that integrity, adherence to our ethical standards, and compliance with legal obligations are fundamental responsibilities for every employee at NPR.

Application Deadline and Instructions:

  • Please submit your resume and cover letter by 5:00 pm EST October 9th, 2026
  • Please answer the following prompt in your cover letter:
    • Tell us about a policy or program that you played a role in changing, developing or creating from the original idea to the execution. Please include what you learned from that experience.

 

Under NPR’s Employee Code of Conduct, this employee will be considered an “Outward-Facing Employee”, and as such should (i) avoid public participation in political and partisan activities in order to protect NPR’s reputation and its ability to pursue its mission; and (ii) refrain from public statements or actions that might call into question NPR’s commitment to accuracy and fairness.

Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain a sophisticated political network across Capitol Hill and federal agencies, serving as a registered lobbyist; manage LDA compliance activities pertaining to ACPR.
  • Proactively manage a dynamic advocacy strategy for ACPR federal initiatives in support of public radio stations. 
  • Track, analyze, and brief internal leadership on legislative, regulatory, and policy developments impacting ACPR’s federal strategy.
  • Design and execute proactive engagement plans, including policy briefings, staff delegations, and advocacy days that support public radio station relationships with Capitol Hill.
  • Regularly meet with Hill staff, including all Committees relevant to public radio, to educate them, utilizing all available communications means to keep them informed on relevant public radio updates.
  • Conduct in-depth research on Members of Congress and executive branch officials to develop effective political and advocacy strategies.
  • Research and track upcoming congressional hearings, monitor administrative policy announcements, and distribute notes to internal teams and coalition partners.
  • Partner with the ACPR Sr. Manager for Communications & Engagement to develop and transmit ACPR advocacy materials, including hill blasts, factsheets, testimony, and blog posts.

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

Minimum Qualifications 

  • 5-7 years experience in a government affairs or advocacy role
  • Time spent working in Congress with an emphasis on the House of Representatives, or working on agriculture or Farm Bill issues
  • Existing professional networks on the Hill, with an emphasis on the House of Representatives
  • Experience navigating the federal appropriations process 
  • Experience with nonpartisan advocacy initiatives 
  • Proficient in the use of MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Google suite products

Preferred Qualifications

  • Demonstrable experience creating new programs, championing appropriations on behalf of a member organization and/or trade association, and/or establishing or adapting appropriations
  • Awareness of local media ecosystems, emergency communications networks, rural development, and/or local cultural institutions

Required Skills/Competencies

  • Ability to communicate clearly to a variety of audiences including public radio leaders, public officials, stakeholders and the general public
  • Experience working with bipartisan lawmakers and a commitment to working in a nonpartisan environment
  • Willingness to work collaboratively with an evolving team
  • Enthusiasm for the mission of public radio

Education Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Political Science, Public Policy, Communications or a related field, or equivalent work experience

Work Location & Requirements

  • Hybrid Permitted: This is a hybrid permitted role. Some aspects of this role require duties better performed at an NPR facility. The employee will be required to be in the office at the Washington, D.C. location at least 3 days a week- Monday, Wednesday, and Thursday. The employee must also reside in an NPR-supported location based on the number of on-site days they choose.

Job Type

  • This is a full-time, exempt position.

Compensation

Salary Range: The U.S.-based anticipated salary range for this opportunity is $132,000 - $139,000 plus benefits. The range displayed reflects the minimum and maximum salaries NPR expects to provide for new hires for the position across all US locations.

NPR Benefits: NPR provides comprehensive benefits for employees and dependents. Regular, full-time employees scheduled to work 30 hours or more per week are eligible to enroll in NPR’s benefits options. Benefits include access to health and wellness, paid time off, and financial well-being. Plan options include medical, dental, vision, life/ accidental death and dismemberment, long-term disability, short-term disability, and voluntary retirement savings to all eligible NPR employees. 

Does this sound like you? If so, we want to hear from you.

#LI-HYBRID
