job.title: Temporary Video Producer III, Planet Money
job.description:
OVERVIEW

A thriving, mission-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility – and our employees do too. We are innovators and leaders in diverse fields, from journalism and digital media to IT and development. Every day, our employees and member stations touch the lives of millions worldwide. 

Across our organization, we’re building a workplace where collaboration is essential, diverse voices are heard, and inclusion is the key to our success. We are committed to doing the right thing in our journalism and in every role at NPR. This means that integrity, adherence to our ethical standards, and compliance with legal obligations are fundamental responsibilities for every employee at NPR.

Application Instructions or Deadline: 

Application Deadline: Monday, October 12th at 5pm ET.

Materials to Submit:

  • A cover letter detailing your creative approach to explanatory journalism on video, your vision for adapting audio reporting to social platforms, and how you foster collaborative learning environments for colleagues new to video production.
  • Links to three short-form videos you conceived, shot, or edited that best illustrate your storytelling technique, editorial judgment, and technical execution. Please provide brief contextual notes on your specific role in each project within your cover letter.

Intro to Position

We’re looking for an experienced video maker to help us transition into a new era of video at Planet Money. The role is part creator, part strategist, part trainer.

Maybe you are a creator ready to join a team. Maybe you are a visual journalist who likes to build systems and start things. Maybe you’ve managed social channels and want to apply that to public media journalism. Maybe something else we haven’t thought of. In any case, here’s the job. 

First, you’ll work with the existing podcast/audio teams at Planet Money and The Indicator to pilot different types of social video or different processes for making them. Then together we will assess what works, what’s worth doing, and what’s not, and you’ll help us update our social video strategy and build sustainable workflows based on what we learn. By the end of your assignment, we hope to have a few new ways to represent our audio journalism on new platforms that our existing staff can sustainably carry on. 

A big part of the job will be helping our audio producers become comfortable creating more video on their own. You’ll help the audio team learn new video tools, analyze metrics and make smart choices about what to adapt to video and what not to. 

There’s wide latitude for experimentation, and an excellent team of creative, smart, fun journalists to collaborate with, including our existing video team. You’ll have lots of support and material to work with, and you’ll be a full part of the Planet Money and Indicator teams, with all the access to the podcast and reporting processes you need to make this work, including collaborating with our existing video colleagues. 

This is a temporary role with a specific mission: help a talented podcast team get a sustainable social video operation up and running and set them up to carry it forward after the assignment ends. There may also be some opportunities to pilot longer-form video, but our first priority is getting short-form systems working well. 

A little background may help you decide if this role is right for you:

Planet Money is like a little economics-themed media outlet within NPR. We explain how economics works and how it affects everyone’s life. We use stories to make the explanations memorable. We do this across media: two podcasts, Planet Money and The Indicator; regular segments on Morning Edition and All Things Considered; two newsletters; a nationally distributed weekend broadcast radio hour with How I Built This; a bestselling book; a board game; and, of course, video.

We’re extremely proud of our video presence, which has gone through several eras, beginning with our T-shirt project in 2013, to a series of live-action shorts in 2019, to a runaway TikTok channel starting in 2020. Now we’re ready to experiment more broadly with how Planet Money and The Indicator show up on video, and how we can do it more consistently and more frequently.

We are not replacing or ending our current short video approach. We couldn’t be more proud of that work! 

Our goal is to build on the excellent social videos our video team is already making. We love what we’re making there, and it works! We want to add more frequent videos that are more closely connected to the reporting we’re doing on the podcast and newsletters. To do that, we need more members of our team participating (maybe on camera and maybe in editing, that’s for you to help us answer). We want to find more opportunities to capture video and new processes that make all of that possible in intelligent, thoughtful and creative ways. Then we will know how to invest in our expanded video future. 

That’s where this role comes in. If you think you can help us build it, please apply.

 

This is a union-represented role covered under the terms of a collective bargaining agreement with: SAG-AFTRA. 

This is an NPR editorial role covered under the terms of the NPR Ethics Handbook. All editorial staff are bound by this guidance. Editorial staff is defined as staff members who play a role in shaping the journalistic or creative direction of NPR's content, including events.    

Responsibilities

  • Work with Planet Money leadership, video creators and NPR visual and social teams to refine and implement Planet Money’s video strategy, gathering and using audience and performance data to inform decisions. 
  • Lead experimentation with different forms of video journalism, assess results and help determine which approaches Planet Money should focus on. 
  • Collaborate with Planet Money and The Indicator editors, producers and hosts to conceive, produce, shoot, edit and publish video for NPR’s platforms and social media.
  • Train and coach some of our audio producers in video production and visual storytelling, video tools and interpreting performance metrics.
  • Develop short-form social video and other visual projects that extend Planet Money and The Indicator’s journalism to new and existing audiences.
  • Write and edit social video posts, captions, stories and other supporting copy and contribute to community engagement alongside other members of the team.
  • Coordinate production, publication and assessment of programming for visual platforms in collaboration with NPR’s visual and social teams.
  • Establish sustainable video production workflows that the podcast teams can continue on their own. 
  • Maintain NPR editorial and ethical guidelines in all production.

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

Minimum Qualifications 

  • At least four years of experience regularly making videos regularly in a journalistic, explanatory or comparable editorial setting. Please send us samples. 
  • At least two years of experience managing or creating video for social and digital platforms, with demonstrated experience using audience and performance data to inform editorial or creative decisions. 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Knowledge of and interest in the topics Planet Money and The Indicator cover
  • Experience managing social media channels for a news or media organization, publisher or other editorial brand.
  • Experience helping journalists or other content creators develop video production and visual storytelling skills.

Required Skills/Competencies

  • Mastery of Adobe Creative Cloud programs related to video, photo and design. (Photoshop, After Effects, Premiere).
  • Advanced skill and experience with video podcasting tools such as Riverside, Descript and comparable platforms. 
  • Strong knowledge of YouTube, TikTok, Instagram and other relevant social media platforms, including experience using platform analytics and data for audience growth. 
  • Strong visual storytelling skills and editorial judgment across short-form and social video.
  • Ability to contribute to and execute a comprehensive, cross-platform video and social strategy.
  • Ability to manage multiple complex projects simultaneously and work effectively under tight deadlines.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to coach colleagues with varying levels of video experience.
  • Strong understanding of copyright, journalistic ethics and editorial standards.
  • Demonstrated commitment to increasing audience diversity.
  • Proven ability to communicate clearly and to consistently work well with others and as part of a team, demonstrating at all times respect for the diverse constituencies at NPR and within the public radio system.
  • Must be able to lift video equipment weighing up to 30 pounds.
  • Ability and willingness to work varied shifts as needed.

Education Requirements

  • While we value formal education, especially if you’ve studied the topic areas we cover, we do not believe that any specific degree is needed to perform this job successfully. 

Work Location & Requirements

  • Hybrid Permitted: This is a hybrid permitted role. The employee will be required to be in the office at the New York City location at least 3 days a week. The employee must also reside in the New York City area. 

Job Type

  • This is a temporary (6-month) full-time position.

Compensation

Hourly Rate: The U.S.-based anticipated hourly rate for this opportunity is $56.26 per hour. The range displayed reflects the maximum hourly rate NPR expects to provide for new hires for the position across all US locations.

NPR Benefits: NPR provides comprehensive benefits for employees and dependents. Benefits include access to health and wellness, paid time off, and financial well-being. Plan options include medical, dental, vision, life/ accidental death and dismemberment, long-term disability, short-term disability, and voluntary retirement savings to all eligible NPR employees.

job.description:
OVERVIEW

A thriving, mission-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility – and our employees do too. We are innovators and leaders in diverse fields, from journalism and digital media to IT and development. Every day, our employees and member stations touch the lives of millions worldwide. 

Across our organization, we’re building a workplace where collaboration is essential, diverse voices are heard, and inclusion is the key to our success. We are committed to doing the right thing in our journalism and in every role at NPR. This means that integrity, adherence to our ethical standards, and compliance with legal obligations are fundamental responsibilities for every employee at NPR.

Intro to Position

Reporting directly to the Chief Content Officer (CCO), the Vice President of Talent Strategy serves as the principal architect, relationship builder, and strategic scout for creative, journalistic, and host talent across NPR. In this role, you will work side-by-side with the CCO and editorial leadership to align talent acquisition, career stewardship, and creator partnerships directly with NPR’s long-term multimedia vision.

You will nurture trusted relationships with our established roster of award-winning journalists, hosts, and commentators while proactively identifying, evaluating, and attracting emerging voices from independent media, podcasts, newsletters, and digital platforms. Serving as an executive bridge across Content, People, Legal, and Member station network, you will champion a collaborative environment where exceptional storytellers can thrive and expand public media's reach across platforms.

This is an NPR editorial role covered under the terms of the NPR Ethics Handbook. All editorial staff are bound by this guidance. Editorial staff is defined as staff members who play a role in shaping the journalistic or creative direction of NPR's content, including events.

Responsibilities

  • Executive Talent Relationship Management: Serve as the primary executive liaison and trusted advisor to high-profile journalists, hosts, and creative contributors, cultivating sustainable career pathways and retention strategies in close collaboration with the CCO.
  • Talent Scouting & Pipeline Development: Design and lead a comprehensive discovery strategy across traditional broadcast, podcasting, newsletter platforms, social ecosystems, and independent journalism to build an ongoing, diverse pipeline of on-air and digital talent.
  • Cross-Functional Mediation & Advocacy: Act as the central connective tissue between creative talent, talent representatives (agents, managers, attorneys), and internal executive teams (People Team, Legal, Marketing, and Operations) to align individual goals with organizational priorities.
  • Complex Contract Structuring & Negotiations: In close coordination with the CCO, Legal, and People teams, oversee talent agreement frameworks, leading contract renewals, compensation structures, and rights agreements with precision and diplomatic finesse.
  • Editorial Standards & Mission Alignment: Ensure all talent recruitment, onboarding, and partner strategies rigorously reflect NPR’s core mission, journalistic ethics, and commitment to public service.
  • Audience Forecasting & Metric Analysis: Partner with Content Insights and divisional leadership to evaluate audience consumption trends and identify future talent requirements across evolving media such as video, episodic audio, and experiential storytelling.
  • DEI Talent Initiatives: Systematically embed diversity, equity, and inclusion principles into every phase of talent identification, pipeline cultivation, and retention.

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

Minimum Qualifications 

  • 12+ years of progressive executive leadership in talent management, talent relations, media recruiting, or creative talent strategy within news, podcasting, digital media, or broadcast entertainment.
  • Demonstrated, active network of professional relationships with journalists, creators, literary and talent agencies, management firms, and digital-first storytellers.
  • Proven track record of structuring and negotiating complex, multi-party talent contracts, intellectual property rights, and compensation agreements in compliance with organizational policies.
  • Demonstrated success building and sustaining diverse, multi-perspective talent rosters that engage cross-generational and culturally diverse audiences.
  • Substantive experience acting as a trusted mediator in high-stakes creative environments, resolving interpersonal, contractual, or operational friction with discretion and high emotional intelligence.
  • Unwavering commitment to editorial independence, high-integrity journalism, and the civic mission of public media.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience navigating talent relations within a federated, public service, or non-profit media network operating alongside union collective bargaining agreements (e.g., SAG-AFTRA).
  • Proven experience executing creator-led co-productions, live podcast tours, or multi-platform distribution partnerships.
  • Familiarity with the commercial and sponsorship frameworks unique to digital audio, podcast monetization, and multi-market station networks.

Required Skills/Competencies

  • Executive Relationship Building: Exceptional diplomatic presence with the proven ability to build trust quickly with high-profile personalities, agents, and senior internal stakeholders.
  • Contractual & Negotiation Acumen: Strong fluency with creative intellectual property rights, talent deal points, non-disclosure terms, and talent contract structuring.

  • Crisis Management & Discretion: Exceptional judgment, confidentiality, and composure when navigating sensitive personnel or creative matters under public or time pressure.

A ONErpm busca garantir seu legado como uma marca global com impacto na comunidade artística, nos negócios da música e na sociedade em geral – somos uma empresa inclusiva de inovação, música e tecnologia. Em maio de 2026, a ONErpm possui mais de 46 escritórios em 32 países em praticamente todos os continentes ao redor do mundo.

job.title: Label Services Manager (Lagos, Nigeria)
job.description:
About ONErpm:

Founded in 2010, ONErpm business model revolves around artist discovery and development and offers three levels of service to meet the needs of creators at any stage of their career. As a global music solutions company with 45 offices and studios in +35 countries, ONErpm encompasses distribution, label solutions, content production, publishing, and an innovative marketing group that includes in-house advertising and influencer agencies. ONErpm currently has approximately 600 colleagues across the world, with significant presence in Brazil, the U.S, South America and other markets.

About The Role

The Label Services Manager, Nigeria will be based in ONErpm’s Lagos office and will be responsible for developing ONErpm’s business in Nigeria while managing a roster of artists and label clients. The role will work closely with artists, labels, DSPs and their teams to plan, release and promote music and video content, while providing strategic guidance to drive audience growth and revenue. The role will also support the management and development of the Nigeria team.

Working closely with the Director, A&R and Operations – Africa, the role supportsONErpm’s regional strategy and represents the company in Nigeria.

This role requires a minimum of three days per week onsite at the Lagos office.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Label Services & Client Management: Oversee day-to-day label services for ONErpm’s Nigeria roster, working closely with the A&R and Project Management teams to ensure clients receive effective support throughout the release cycle. Support client onboarding and provide guidance on ONErpm’s platform, analytics, and royalty reporting tools, while identifying opportunities to improvemclient performance and satisfaction.

2. Distribution & Release Management : Plan and deliver releases with accuratemmetadata and DSP compliance. Coordinate across teams to grow cross-market opportunities, resolve distribution issues, and keep clients’ releases on schedulemand performing well.

3. Business Development & Partnerships: Identify and develop strategic partnerships and commercial opportunities with DSPs, brands, media, and industry stakeholders to drive ONErpm’s growth, market presence, and audience reach.

4. Performance Tracking & revenue Optimization: Use streaming, audience and platform analytics to evaluate performance and provide actionable insights. Support clients in maximizing monetization across YouTube, TikTok, Facebook and other UGC platforms.

Qualifications:

3 to 5 years of experience in a senior music industry role, or 5+ years in distribution,

label, DSP, artist management or related roles across A&R, business development, account management or label services.

Strong knowledge of and relationships within the Nigerian music industry, with a proven track record in business development, client management and team leadership.

Passionate about music, comfortable managing multiple projects and timelines, technologically adept, commercially minded and able to think creatively and strategically.

A strong understanding of current music and pop culture trends, an entrepreneurial mindset and a proactive approach to problem-solving are essential.

Experience in team management with effective leadership skills.

Organized, thorough, and responsive.

Strong communication and teamwork skills

Creativity and willingness to think outside the box


The ideal candidate is …

... passionate about music

... a creative thinker with a demonstrated ability to apply ideas strategically while working to a set budget and timeline

... technologically adept and quick to learn new platforms

... up-to-date knowledge on all music and pop culture trends

... optimistic-minded, self-starter with an entrepreneurial attitude and knack for problem-solving.

job.description:
Responsibilities

Growth Strategy: Develop channel- and release-specific plans (premieres, Shorts, visualizers, lyric videos, catalog content) with clear subscriber, views, and watch time targets.

Optimization: Review and improve metadata, thumbnails, playlists, end screens, and overall channel structure. Manage Official Artist Channels (OACs) and their verification process.

Shorts and New Formats: Drive strategies around Shorts, livestreams, and collaborations to expand reach, particularly for emerging artists.

Artist and Label Relations: Serve as the main video point of contact for artist managers and artist teams, providing guidance and training on YouTube best practices.

Data and Reporting: Analyze YouTube Analytics and internal reports to identify opportunities, measure performance, and present insights to regional and global teams.

Collaboration with YouTube and Internal Teams: Coordinate with YouTube’s Partnerships team, A&R, Marketing, and Rights teams on campaigns, featuring opportunities, and Content ID-related matters.

Required Qualifications

- 3 to 5 years of experience in marketing, advertising, or the entertainment industry.

- Proven experience developing data-driven content strategies with measurable results.

- Strong understanding of the Southern Cone music scene, including urban, trap, RKT, cumbia, cuarteto, pop, rock, and folk music.

- Intermediate to advanced proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets; experience with Looker Studio or tools such as vidIQ or TubeBuddy is preferred.

- Intermediate English proficiency, as the global team operates in English; Portuguese is a plus.

- Self-driven, organized, and able to communicate effectively with artists and their teams.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience managing or growing YouTube channels, ideally within the music industry, such as a distributor, record label, MCN, or agency.

- Knowledge of the YouTube algorithm, YouTube Studio, Analytics, and the monetization ecosystem.

- Experience working within an MCN and developing YouTube monetization strategies.

- Knowledge of asset types, including sound recordings, music videos, compositions, art tracks, and web assets, as well as experience handling claims, disputes, and ownership conflicts within Content ID.

- Experience in rights management.

- YouTube certifications, such as Music Certification or Content Ownership.

- Established network within the local music industry.

job.title: 403(g) Maintenance Technician
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

In This Role You'll:


Paramount Tech is hiring a 403g Maintenance Technician responsible for maintenance and support of production and broadcast systems for the CBS Network and affiliated production units, providing critical 24x7 support for on-air and production infrastructure. This role covers hands-on troubleshooting and repair of routing systems, audio/video transport and IP media infrastructure (SDI and SMPTE 2110), production switchers, audio consoles, media file transfer and storage systems, video acquisition and playback servers, non-linear postproduction systems, production intercom, cameras, prompters, and other studio production systems, working to mitigate impact to production and on-air deadlines. This is a shift-based role covering rotating shifts including nights, weekends, and holidays, with on-call/callback responsibilities per the applicable collective bargaining agreement.

 

Basic Qualifications You Bring:

 

•    3+ years' experience working with professional television broadcast equipment, with demonstrated ability to troubleshoot to the component/system level under time pressure, in a live production environment.
•    Hands-on experience with broadcast test equipment (waveform monitors, vector-scopes, audio analyzers, cable/fiber test sets) and cable/fiber termination and testing.
•    In-depth knowledge in of the following: Video, Audio, Cameras, Control/Data Systems, RF, Fiber-Optics, and IP media distribution (SMPTE 2110/2059).
•    Working knowledge of IP networking fundamentals — VLANs, subnetting, multicast, and basic switch/router configuration — sufficient to troubleshoot IP-based media infrastructure.
•    Strong understanding of broadcast media systems design and signal flow; ability to read and work from schematics and as-built documentation.
•    Experience with Windows, Linux, and macOS workstation/server environments as used in broadcast and postproduction facilities.
•    Ability to communicate technical root-cause and status updates clearly to non-technical production staff (directors, TDs, producers) during live troubleshooting.
•    Ability to perform physical work associated with rack and machine room environments, including lifting equipment and working in confined or elevated spaces.

 

Bonus Skills:

 

•    Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Broadcast Engineering, or IT preferred.
•    Direct experience with SMPTE ST 2110 (2110-20/30/40) and ST 2059 PTP timing in a production environment.
•    Scripting/automation experience (Python, JSON) for diagnostics, monitoring, or system integration.
•    Experience with virtualized and cloud-based media systems, including container management.
•    Familiarity with NMOS control/discovery frameworks in an IP media environment.
•    Familiarity with Evertz, Grass Valley routing systems; RTS intercom, Sony switchers and cameras, EVS, Grass Valley AMPP video playout/record servers a plus.

 

 

#LI-TG1

Paramount Skydance Corporation (NASDAQ: PSKY) is a leading global media and entertainment company that creates premium content and experiences for audiences worldwide. Driven by iconic studios, networks and streaming services, Paramount's portfolio of consumer brands includes CBS, Showtime Networks, Paramount Pictures, Nickelodeon, MTV, Comedy Central, BET, Paramount+, and Pluto TV, among others. Paramount delivers the largest share of the U.S. television audience and boasts one of the industry's most important and extensive libraries of TV and film titles. In addition to offering innovative streaming services and digital video products, the company provides powerful capabilities in production, distribution and advertising solutions.

 

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

 

Hiring Salary Range: $31.10 - 65.52. 

 

The hiring salary range for this position applies to New York City, California, Colorado, Washington state, and most other geographies. Starting pay for the successful applicant depends on a variety of job-related factors, including but not limited to geographic location, market demands, experience, training, and education.  The benefits available for this position include medical, dental, vision, 401(k) plan, life insurance coverage, disability benefits, tuition assistance program and PTO or, if applicable,  as otherwise dictated by the appropriate Collective Bargaining Agreement.   

 

What We Offer:
  • Attractive compensation and comprehensive benefits packages. Check out our full list of benefits here: https://www.paramount.com/careers/benefits
  • Generous paid time off.
  • An exciting and fulfilling opportunity to be part of one of Paramount’s most dynamic teams.
  • Opportunities for both on-site and virtual engagement events.
  • Unique opportunities to make meaningful connections and build a vibrant community, both inside and outside the workplace.
  • Explore life at Paramount: https://www.paramount.com/careers/life-at-paramount

From the programming and movies we create to employee benefits/programs and social impact outreach initiatives, we believe that opportunity, access, resources and rewards should be available to and for the benefit of all. job.title: 403(g) Technician
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

 

The Media Manager is responsible for ingesting all forms of media received from photographers, producers, and field crews into designated servers and project environments. This includes media delivered on memory cards, optical discs, hard drives, and other storage formats. Attention to detail is essential, as producers and editors rely on the Media Manager to organize, label, and ingest media accurately and consistently—often under tight deadlines and during breaking news coverage. The successful candidate must be highly organized, meticulous, and capable of maintaining accuracy in a fast-paced environment. Precise labeling and proper organization of all media assets are critical to ensuring proficient editorial workflows.

 

The ideal candidate should possess a working knowledge of professional camera systems and the various file formats and codecs they produce. Equipment and formats encountered regularly include:
Camera Systems

  • Sony FX9, FX6, FX3, X400, A7S, F5
  • All Sony Prosumer cameras
  • GoPro, Sony ZV-1 (POV Cams)

Media Formats / Codecs

  • QuickTime
  • H.264 (various implementations)
  • AVCHD
  • .MTS
  •  MXF
  • Additional professional broadcast file formats as required

 

Requirements:

  • Strong knowledge with broadcast routers and patch bays. This role requires daily operation of routing systems and occasional use of patch bays. The successful candidate must be comfortable routing signals, downlinking feeds, and utilizing in-house routing and satellite tuning systems.
  • Working knowledge of Avid Interplay and Avid Media Composer (including NewsCutter). Candidates should be comfortable creating pitch reels, assembling b-roll packages, organizing media within Interplay, importing assets into projects, and editing material on a timeline.
  • Excellent organizational and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with producers, editors, and production teams.
  • The Media Manager must be able to manage multiple assignments simultaneously, prioritize competing deadlines, and respond effectively to the demands of live and breaking news production across broadcasts such as CBS Evening News, CBS Mornings, CBS Sunday Morning, and other network programming.
  • Comfortable operating professional audio equipment, including audio mixers, and properly wiring microphones for talent and guests during interviews, live shots, and studio productions.
  • The role also requires the ability to run and connect audio and video cabling between equipment, wall panels, and patch points while maintaining established engineering and production standards.
  • Ability to work efficiently in a high-pressure, deadline-driven newsroom while maintaining exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.

 

Union Requirement:

  • This position is represented by the International Brotherhood of Electrical Workers (IBEW). The selected candidate must meet all applicable IBEW membership requirements and will be required to join the union as a condition of employment.


CBS News and Stations, brings together the power of CBS News, 28 owned television stations in 17 major U.S. markets, the CBS News Streaming Network, CBS News Streaming local platforms, local websites and cbsnews.com, under one umbrella. CBS News and Stations is home to the nation’s #1 news program 60 MINUTES, the CBS News Streaming Network, the first 24/7 digital streaming news network, the award-winning broadcasts CBS MORNINGS, CBS SATURDAY MORNING, the CBS EVENING NEWS, CBS SUNDAY MORNING, CBS WEEKEND EVENING NEWS, 48 HOURS and FACE THE NATION WITH MARGARET BRENNAN. CBS News and Stations provides news and information for the CBS Television Network,  CBSNews.com, CBS News Radio and podcasts, Paramount +, all digital platforms, and the CBS News Streaming Network, the premier 24/7 anchored streaming news service that is available free to everyone with access to the internet. The CBS News Streaming Network is the destination for breaking news, live events, original reporting and storytelling, and programs from CBS News and Stations’ top anchors and correspondents working locally, nationally and around the globe. CBS News’ streaming services, across national and local, amassed more than 1.01 billion streams in 2021. Launched in November 2014 as CBSN, the CBS News Streaming Network is available on 30 digital platforms and apps, as well as CBSNews.com and Paramount+. The service is available live in 91 countries. CBS News and Stations is dedicated to providing the highest quality journalism under standards it pioneered and continues to set in today’s digital age. CBS News earns more prestigious journalism awards than any other broadcast news division.

Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

WHO WE ARE

#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?

 

We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

WCBS-TV is the #1 CBS owned-and-operated station in the nation’s largest media market, and together with Paramount+ and the full CBS Stations portfolio, we give advertisers something rare: reach that spans every screen, every daypart, and every device.


THE OPPORTUNITY

This is not a maintenance role. This is a growth role built for a broadcast-experienced seller who is capable of doing it all — someone who has spent time in local TV, knows how to maximize opportunities, and is hungry to excel as a multi-screen, multi-market powerhouse.

 

As an Account Executive on the Local Ad Sales team at CBS, you will sell across our full O&O footprint — with the ability to close multi-market broadcast deals that span from coast to coast. Layered on top of that is the opportunity to sell Paramount+ and Pluto TV streaming inventory, giving clients a truly end-to-end screen solution backed by one of the most recognized brands in media.

 

You will bring new business to the table. You will build client relationships that outlast any single campaign. And you will be held to results.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

 

  • Hunt — hard. Prospect relentlessly across local, regional, and national categories. New-to-station and non-traditional revenue is your primary mandate. You don't wait for the phone to ring.
  • Sell all screens. Drive revenue across CBS O&O broadcast, Paramount+ and Pluto TV — in a single, integrated pitch.
  • Go multi-market. Leverage the full 17-market CBS O&O footprint to bring advertisers a scaled broadcast solution to reach audiences across any & all markets.
  • Build, don't inherit. Develop direct client and agency relationships from the ground up. Own your pipeline and your outcomes.
  • Think like a strategist. Package custom solutions — tentpole programs, sports integrations, streaming packages, sponsorships — tailored to client business objectives, not just available inventory.
  • Own your numbers. Manage quarterly and annual account plans, forecast accurately, and hit your monthly and quarterly revenue goals.
  • Stay ahead of the market. Know the linear and streaming landscape. Understand where categories are investing and why. Bring category intelligence into every client conversation.
  • Collaborate to win. Partner with Integrated Marketing, Account Management, Traffic, and to deliver seamless, high-impact campaigns from pre-sale through post-recap.
  • Stay sharp. Keep a pulse on marketplace trends, category dynamics, and the evolving linear and streaming landscape.
  • Represent KOVR Sacramento at client meetings, presentations, and station events.

 


Key Responsibilities:

 

  • Prospect, develop, and manage new and existing business accounts to achieve and exceed revenue goals
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships through remarkable service and strategic guidance
  • Identify client needs and create customized, creative multi-media advertising campaigns
  • Present and sell integrated advertising solutions across broadcast, digital, and emerging platforms
  • Demonstrate strong negotiation and closing skills throughout the sales cycle
    Utilize media research and ratings tools (e.g., Nielsen and similar platforms) to develop data-driven proposals

 

WHAT YOU BRING

 

Required:

 

  • 2+ years of local broadcast experience, multi-platform, or local media advertising sales with a verifiable track record of hitting or exceeding revenue goals.
  • Real hunger—you prospect, you pitch, you close. You don’t wait for business to come to you.
  • Strong consultative selling skills with the ability to build lasting client partnerships.
  • Experience working with both advertising agencies and direct clients.
  • Outstanding presentation, negotiation, and closing skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to manage a high-volume, fast-paced book of business with professionalism and precision.
  • Valid CA driver's license. 

 

Preferred:

 

  • Experience selling streaming, digital, or OTT inventory in addition to linear television.
  • Familiarity with Paramount+, Pluto TV, or FAST/AVOD platform sales.
  • Experience selling multi-market or national broadcast packages.
  • Bachelor's degree preferred.
  • Proficiency with WideOrbit, Strata, Salesforce, and Microsoft Excel.


CBS News and Stations, brings together the power of CBS News, 28 owned television stations in 17 major U.S. markets, the CBS News Streaming Network, CBS News Streaming local platforms, local websites and cbsnews.com, under one umbrella. CBS News and Stations is home to the nation’s #1 news program 60 MINUTES, the CBS News Streaming Network, the first 24/7 digital streaming news network, the award-winning broadcasts CBS MORNINGS, CBS SATURDAY MORNING, the CBS EVENING NEWS, CBS SUNDAY MORNING, CBS WEEKEND EVENING NEWS, 48 HOURS and FACE THE NATION WITH MARGARET BRENNAN. CBS News and Stations provides news and information for the CBS Television Network,  CBSNews.com, CBS News Radio and podcasts, Paramount +, all digital platforms, and the CBS News Streaming Network, the premier 24/7 anchored streaming news service that is available free to everyone with access to the internet. The CBS News Streaming Network is the destination for breaking news, live events, original reporting and storytelling, and programs from CBS News and Stations’ top anchors and correspondents working locally, nationally and around the globe. CBS News’ streaming services, across national and local, amassed more than 1.01 billion streams in 2021. Launched in November 2014 as CBSN, the CBS News Streaming Network is available on 30 digital platforms and apps, as well as CBSNews.com and Paramount+. The service is available live in 91 countries. CBS News and Stations is dedicated to providing the highest quality journalism under standards it pioneered and continues to set in today’s digital age. CBS News earns more prestigious journalism awards than any other broadcast news division.

  • Assist in selling streaming campaigns, with the opportunity to include linear inventory for cross-platform packages

Basic Qualifications

job.title: Anchor/Reporter Sports
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.


WBBM-TV, the CBS Owned & Operated station in Chicago, is seeking a dynamic, forward-thinking Anchor/Reporter (Sports) to help lead and shape our sports coverage across all platforms.


Local newsrooms and sports journalism are evolving rapidly, and this role is built for the modern era of media. The ideal candidate will be an anchor and multi-platform storyteller who actively drives engagement across digital channels, social media, and our 24/7 streaming network. Beyond the studio anchor desk, you will host key sports specials, anchor and report live remotely from major events, and enterprise compelling stories that connect with Chicago’s passionate sports community.
We are looking for an engaging, relatable personality and insightful expert who looks far beyond basic scores and stats and must be an exceptional writer capable of scripting concise, creative, and platform-tailored content for linear television, streaming broadcasts, and digital platforms.

 

Chicago is one of the greatest, most intense sports towns in the world. From legendary professional franchises to regional college sports and historic high school programs, our audience demands deep market knowledge, authentic connection, and modern storytelling that meets viewers wherever they consume news.

 

RESPONSIBILITIES:
•    Anchor & Host: Lead energetic, authoritative sports segments on linear broadcasts; host high-profile station sports specials and digital/streaming original programming.
•    Multi-Platform Content Generation: Actively write, produce, and adapt sports content tailored specifically for linear TV, CBS News Chicago Streaming, CBSChicago.com, and key social platforms (Instagram, X, TikTok, YouTube).
•    Remote & Field Reporting: Anchor and report live on location from marquee sporting events, breaking sports news, and deep-dive feature assignments.
•    Modern Storytelling & Enterprise: Move beyond traditional game recaps to enterprise original, character-driven stories; contribute consistently to daily editorial meetings with ideas built for a modern, digital-first newsroom.
•    Digital & Social Strategy: Execute a proactive social media strategy to engage Chicago sports fans in real time, build community, break news, and drive audience tune-in across platforms.
•    Linear Writing & Segment Scripting: Write sharp, conversational copy and craft well-structured segments and package scripts designed for high-impact linear and streaming broadcasts.
•    Journalistic Integrity: Maintain strict journalistic standards, accuracy, and strong editorial judgment in a fast-paced, rapidly shifting multi-platform newsroom.

 

REQUIREMENTS / QUALIFICATIONS:
•    Experience: Proven experience as a Sports Anchor/Reporter in a major market (Top 10 preferred), with a demonstrated track record of success across linear and digital platforms.
•    Modern Journalism Mindset: Strong understanding of how sports consumption habits are shifting and a passion for experimenting with new digital, streaming, and social storytelling formats.
•    On-Air & On-Screen Presence: Commanding, authentic, and versatile presentation style suited for linear studio anchoring, streaming coverage, and digital video content.
•    Market Expertise: Deep knowledge of Chicago and national sports—including professional leagues, regional college athletics, and high school sports culture.
•    Writing Excellence: Superior writing skills with the ability to adjust tone and format effectively for linear television, digital articles, streaming scripts, and social copy.
•    Collaboration & Adaptability: Ability to thrive under live pressure, multi-task, and collaborate seamlessly with newsroom producers, digital team members, photojournalists, and editors.
•    Schedule Flexibility: Willingness and availability to work a flexible schedule that regularly includes evenings, weekends, holidays, and travel for major sports coverage.
•    This is a SAG/AFTRA position

job.title: Assignment Desk Assistant (per diem)
job.description:
We are seeking a motivated Assignment Desk Assistant to support daily newsroom operations in Chicago. This role is ideal for someone with newsroom experience who is eager to grow, learn, and contribute to breaking news and investigative reporting. This is a WGA covered position.   This position is per diem.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Assist the Assignment Editor and work closely with reporters, photographers, and producers to coordinate breaking news coverage and support content for broadcast, digital, and streaming platforms.

  • Help generate story ideas and track leads and tips.
  • Support follow-ups on past stories and assist with research.
  • Other duties as assigned.

 

Preferred Skills 

  • Strong interest in news gathering and current events.
  • Good organizational skills and ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong communication skills and willingness to learn.

  • 1–2 years of newsroom or media experience preferred.

job.title: Assistant News Director
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

CBS Atlanta, the brand-new station in the CBS stations group, is seeking an experienced, thoughtful, and collaborative leader to oversee day-to-day newsroom operations in the role of Assistant News Director. This person will drive all aspects of the editorial mission and work closely with the News Director to implement strategic planning for content across all platforms. This role will have a special emphasis around the CBS News Atlanta streaming platform.

 

 

RESPONSIBILITIES INCLUDE BUT ARE NOT LIMITED TO:

· This leader is a key decision maker in the newsroom, ensuring all content meets journalistic standards as well as the strategic vision set in partnership with the VP/News Director.

· Exhibit deep understanding of the news mission and work closely with reporters, producers, EPs and the assignment desk to make sure the entire team is completing the mission daily.

· Develop best in class coverage plans that are thoughtful and comprehensive for breaking news and longer-term projects, always remembering the importance of context and balance.

· Maximize the news, weather and sports experience for the audience in a state-of the-art full VR environment.

· Work with News Director & Creative Services VP to develop a strategic plan for placement and promotion of enterprise content.

· Must be an innovator who looks for opportunities to acquire new viewers through data-driven experimentation with content and production.

· Must have a strong track record of managing projects of all kinds with excellent attention to detail and timely completion.

· Collaborate closely with all members of the team, including station attorneys and CBS Standards, to develop ethical and balanced reporting.

· Protect the culture by seeking out and including perspectives from all corners of the newsroom.

· Conduct regular check-ins with members of the team and offer feedback and mentoring.

 

 

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

· 6+ years in local news management and 2+ years in a major market required

· Bachelor’s degree in journalism required

· Knowledge of Atlanta DMA is strongly preferred

 

ADDITIONAL QUALIFICATIONS:

· Must be willing to work on weekends, holidays and overnight hours as needed

· Must have deep knowledge of all functions of the news operation in order to effectively “pull the levers” to ensure content/shows are crafted to the highest standards and efficiency

· Must embrace an “always on” mentality, willing to take calls, answer emails and troubleshoot newsroom issues 24/7

job.title: Associate Producer, Soccer (Freelance)
job.description:
The Associate Producer will be responsible for a variety of production responsibilities to support our studio coverage. Responsibilities include coordinating graphics on studio shows, as well as sport specific research, especially CBS Sports Golazo Network, UEFA Champions & Europa League, Serie A, and Concacaf.

This is a freelance position based in Stamford, CT. Non-traditional hours, nights, weekends, and holidays are to be expected.

Responsibilities:

  • Use deep knowledge and strong techniques to generate and support ideas based on betting, live events, breaking news, and other developments in the soccer world.
  • Build relationships with producers, on-air talent, and graphics to ensure the highest quality of video tape assets.
  • Understand how linear and social production align to create compelling studio content
  • Anticipate, identify, and respond to relevant trends, developing storylines and noteworthy performances for soccer coverage
  • Communicate in a timely and effective manner with producers to provide thorough, creative, and accurate video content
  • Proactively identify and suggest segment or video ideas for studio coverage
  • Develop original, creative ideas for video elements that present analysis, storylines, and trending issues in soccer.
  • Ability to clip and edit/format video materials through Adobe Premiere

Basic Qualifications:

  • Excellent knowledge of soccer is required.
  • Minimum 3 years in the production field
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
  • Extensive knowledge of how a studio show control room works and operates
  • Must be able to work nights, weekends, holidays, and flexible hours.
  • Must be able to be in the studio on show days in Stamford, CT.

Additional Qualifications:

  • Excellent interpersonal and multi-tasking skills, as well as a keen attention to detail, are required.
  • Must be a self-starter with demonstrated initiative.
  • Control room experience a plus
  • Knowledge of the entire soccer landscape and ability to think outside the box visually
  • High knowledge of soccer, both internationally and domestically
  • Able to work under tight deadlines and handle a high-pressure environment
  • Excellent communication, writing and interpersonal skills
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Ability to work independently and within a teamwork environment
  • Bilingual abilities are a plus

 

 

 

CBS Sports, a year-round leader in cross-platform sports coverage, broadcasts a portfolio of events on the CBS Television Network, including THE NFL ON CBS; college football, including the SEC ON CBS; college basketball, including the NCAA Division I Men's Basketball Championship; golf, including The Masters®, PGA Championship and PGA TOUR; soccer, including the UEFA Champions League and NWSL; and CBS SPORTS SPECTACULAR. 

In addition, the division includes CBS SPORTS NETWORK, the 24-hour cable home of CBS Sports which televises live sports programming throughout the year, including college football and basketball games, UEFA Champions League and Europa League action, Italy's Serie A matches, Concacaf national team competitions, as well as a full slate of original programming and studio coverage. 

CBS Sports also delivers an extensive lineup of global soccer coverage on Paramount+, including every UEFA club competition match, all Serie A matches as well as Concacaf national team competitions, and produces INSIDE THE NFL for Paramount+. CBS Sports Digital's multi-platform offerings include CBSSports.com and the CBS Sports apps for mobile and connected TV devices; the 24/7 streaming sports news network CBS Sports HQ; 247Sports; MaxPreps; CBS Sports fantasy games; and SportsLine.

job.title: Broadcast Engineer
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

OVERVIEW & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Day to day maintenance and support of station’s core infrastructure, not limited to news editing systems, control room automation and components, local news channel and streaming systems, transmitter operations, studio equipment as well as field operations equipment and vehicles.
  • Install, upgrade, troubleshoot and repair electronic equipment to a component level (hardware/software).
  • Work collaboratively in the design, construction and execution of station engineering projects and initiatives.
  • Work with equipment manufacturers and vendors to resolve issues, including ordering parts/services.
  • Review discrepancy reports and address issues with minimal supervision.
  • Contribute daily end of shift reports for issue hand-off and project progress tracking
  • Other duties, as assigned by Broadcast Operations & Engineering management.

 

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • A sound engineering foundation and the ability to troubleshoot and repair complex television broadcast systems.
  • Strong technical background in video transmission and encoding, newsroom systems, ingest, wireless and cellular bonded technologies, automation systems, microwave, master control, satellite, streaming, control room, IT, studio and field operations and IP technology.
  • Expertise and experience with RF transmission and related technologies.
  • Cable fabrication and termination experience. 
  • Candidate must be a self-starter with a developed work ethic and be highly organized.
  • Strong project management and coordination skills.
  • Outstanding communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to effectively communicate and work with other members of the engineering staff, station employees and management, and outside vendors in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
  • Ability to train fellow engineers in new systems, technologies, procedures and techniques.
  • Must be able to work weekends, holidays, overtime and varying shifts when necessary to meet station needs, sometimes with little notice.
  • Valid driver’s license.

 

EXPECTED EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

  • College degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Sciences, or similar field.
  • 2-5 years of experience in broadcast engineering or technical operations. 
  • Knowledge and experience working with control room automation, cameras and recording devices, non-linear editing systems, transcoding products, routers, encoders, and video servers.
  • Knowledge of and understanding of FCC rules and regulations.
  • Experience in IT, including an understanding of networking, software, and desktop/server operating systems.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office Applications, Video Conferencing Software, and Computer Aided Drafting Software. 
  • Experience with GatesAir ULXTE transmitters a plus.

job.title: CBS Sports Assignment Editor, Golazo (Freelance)
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

Overview 

CBS Sports seeks an Assignment Editor for a full-time freelance position that will support productions for CBS Sports Golazo Network, a year-round, 24/7 home for soccer fans with free matches, highlights, news and analysis. The Assignment Editor must stay up to date on soccer events to prioritize and anticipate needs for coverage and content acquisition, while conducting newsgathering across multiple CBS platforms, including but not limited to CBS Sports’ linear and digital productions, our partners across CBS News, Radio, and Affiliates, as well as schools, their local stations, and social platforms.  The Assignment Editor must be able to aggressively respond to breaking news and requests, and work closely with internal teams and operations to ensure all audio and video material is recorded and distributed across productions and platforms. The Assignment Editor may also be responsible for hiring ENG crews and making sure their needs are met and coordinating with remote productions providing live and taped content for all shows. The Assignment Editor will team with other desk staff on schedule and calendar planning for all soccer events, related coverage, and guests.  The Assignment Editor will maintain daily contact with studio producers to anticipate, respond to, and meet their show needs.  The Assignment Editor will meet regularly with editorial staff to discuss new ideas and content, will have close contact with Legal and Business Affairs contributors to navigate rights and clearance issues. This job will be primarily an in-person role, and shifts will include regularly working on nights and weekends.

 

Responsibilities

  • Identify and acquire content for use across Golazo Network and related productions, including news conferences, interviews and highlights. 

  • Conduct newsgathering across multiple CBS Sports platforms; React immediately to breaking news and requests to support all soccer coverage

  • Must be able to work in a fast-paced environment, and communicate with urgency and clarity to producers, on-air talent and production associates. 

  • Must be skilled at identifying news and emerging storylines; gathering ideas and content for potential storytelling to enhance and support coverage across CBS Sports platforms.

  • Use deep sports knowledge, an insatiable curiosity and sound news judgment, to support storytelling that is timely, relevant, innovative and inclusive.

  • Demonstrate an understanding of sports media production, including knowledge of successful content creation for television, digital video, social media, or similar programming  

  • Stay informed and up to date on soccer events and storylines; Provide story ideas and recommend content for use in coverage

  • Proactively identify and suggest solutions to address potential coverage  

  • Hire freelance ENG crews

  • Understand compliance with rights and clearance guidelines 

  • Must be able to handle logistics under deadline

  • Schedule and calendar planning on all soccer events

  • Communicate regularly with producers on content

  • Gather transmission information (fiber, satellite, streaming, etc.) for televised games

  • Work closely with media asset management to ensure all games and content are being recorded and archived 

 

Qualifications

  • Strong knowledge of soccer across multiple leagues

  • Demonstrated depth of knowledge in fiber, satellite, cellular, FTP, and viral newsgathering procedures

  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously

  • Must have experience with variety of approaches to Internet searches and be fluent in electronic newsgathering techniques, including quickly navigating the Internet and best practices for utilizing social media.

  • Strong editorial judgment and a resourceful ability to conduct content research and a passion for discovering content and sharing information is a must.

  • Must be able to work nights, weekends, and flexible hours.

  • Able to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment under deadlines and prioritize assignments

  • Strong leadership, interpersonal and communication skills

  • Must have excellent writing and communication skills and demonstrate keen attention to detail.

  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously 

  • Must be able to work with limited supervision while also thriving in a team-oriented environment

  • History of working collaboratively across departments with peers and colleagues to advance content and coverage

  • Must have experience performing well under pressure, including a proven track record of responding effectively to feedback even up against deadlines for air. 

 

Experience

  • 2+ years of experience in a television- or digital-production related field

  • Bachelor’s degree in journalism or equivalent training and experience

  • Prior experience in sports journalism is a plus

 

 

 

 

CBS Sports, a year-round leader in cross-platform sports coverage, broadcasts a portfolio of events on the CBS Television Network, including THE NFL ON CBS; college football, including the Big Ten ON CBS; college basketball, including the NCAA Division I Men's Basketball Championship; golf, including The Masters®, PGA Championship and PGA TOUR; soccer, including the UEFA Champions League and NWSL; and CBS SPORTS SPECTACULAR. 

In addition, the division includes CBS SPORTS NETWORK, the 24-hour cable home of CBS Sports which televises live sports programming throughout the year, including college football and basketball games, UEFA Champions League and Europa League action, Italy's Serie A matches, Concacaf national team competitions, as well as a full slate of original programming and studio coverage. 

CBS Sports also delivers an extensive lineup of global soccer coverage on Paramount+, including every UEFA club competition match, all Serie A matches as well as Concacaf national team competitions, and produces INSIDE THE NFL for Paramount+. CBS Sports Digital's multi-platform offerings include CBSSports.com and the CBS Sports apps for mobile and connected TV devices; the 24/7 streaming sports news network CBS Sports HQ; 247Sports; MaxPreps; CBS Sports fantasy games; and SportsLine.

job.title: Counsel
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

Overview:

The Counsel will work with Business Affairs executives in the negotiation, structuring, and management of deals across the studio's scripted television content – spanning development, production, and distribution/licensing. This role focuses on negotiating deals and/or drafting agreements for the studio's projects, with a primary emphasis on content intended for sale and licensing to various third-party broadcasters, cable networks, and streaming platforms. The Counsel will work closely with staff attorneys and cross-functional business teams. Strong transactional skills, a sophisticated understanding of the evolving content landscape, an ability to manage multiple high-stakes matters concurrently, and a great balance of legal expertise and business acumen are required. The role is critical in protecting the studio's interests, mitigating legal risk, and advising executives on strategic business and legal matters. This is a full-time in-office role, reporting to the VP, Business Affairs.    

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Deal Negotiation & Structuring: Lead and/or assist the negotiating and structuring of a wide range of complex agreements essential to scripted television, including: Acquisitions: Rights/underlying property acquisitions (e.g., life rights, book options/purchases). Above-the-Line Talent: Writers, producers, directors, and principal cast, interfacing directly with talent representatives and agencies. Production & Co-Production: Domestic and international co-production agreements, financing, and production services agreements. Licensing & Distribution: Sale/license of studio-produced content to third-party platforms (e.g., streamers, networks) and international distributors
  • Relationship Management & Collaboration: Cultivate strong, communicative relationships with various internal business groups, outside counsel, studio executives, and talent reps
  • Strategic Business Counsel & Risk Management: Provide timely, practical, and strategic advice to Development, Production, and Finance teams regarding deal terms, legal risks, rights analysis, chain-of-title, intellectual property, clearances, and guild/union compliance (WGA, DGA, SAG-AFTRA)
  • Leverage broad, in-depth understanding of the entertainment industry to identify creative, win-win solutions that achieve business goals while mitigating risk
  • Policy & Procedure: Collaborate on foundational practices for the department, leading to more standardized, consistent practices around procedures, deal-making, and contracts
  • Rights Management & IP: Partner with internal IP and Rights Management teams, as well as outside counsel, on rights matters, copyright and trademark matters, and clearance issues
  • Capacity: Proven ability to manage a high volume of negotiations and transactions while prioritizing key deadlines across various business teams

 

Basic Qualifications:

  • 5+ years’ experience negotiating a wide range of deals and drafting agreements in scripted television development and production at a major production company, television studio, network, streamer, or top-tier entertainment law company

Summary
The Data Engineering team is hiring a Data Engineer – Data Pipeline & ETL. You will help build and maintain scalable data platforms and ETL/ELT pipelines in a fast-moving environment. In this role, you will build and support batch and real-time data systems powering analytics, ML, and AI applications. You will also grow your expertise in modern data architecture and cloud-native best practices.


Key Responsibilities

Build and Maintain Scalable Data Pipelines

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable batch and streaming data pipelines for large-scale structured and unstructured datasets.
  • Build robust ETL/ELT frameworks supporting analytics, BI, experimentation, and machine learning use cases.
  • Optimize pipelines for performance, reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency.
  • Implement advanced ingestion patterns including CDC, incremental loads, and event-driven processing.

Data Modeling & Data Warehouse Architecture

  • Design scalable, dimensional, and hybrid data models optimized for analytics and ML use cases.
  • Develop reusable transformation layers (semantic layers) that serve BI, ML, and AI applications.
  • Write optimized, production-grade SQL for large-scale analytics workloads.
  • Contribute to query optimization, indexing, partitioning, and performance tuning across distributed systems and cloud warehouses.

Modern Data Pipeline Development

  • Build and maintain modular data components following established framework patterns.
  • Contribute to architectural decisions across streaming systems, data lakes, and warehouses.

Data Quality, Governance & Observability

  • Implement automated data validation, anomaly detection, and monitoring frameworks.
  • Establish data lineage and metadata standards to support reproducibility in ML workflows.
  • Enforce governance, privacy, and security best practices, particularly for sensitive AI datasets.
  • Ensure responsible AI data usage and compliance standards.

 

Required Technical Skills

Advanced Data Pipeline & ETL/ELT Expertise

  • 2–4+ years of experience building and scaling ETL/ELT pipelines in production environments.
  • Experience with workflow orchestration tools such as Airflow, Composer, or similar platforms.
  • Strong understanding of distributed data processing concepts.

SQL & Data Modeling for Analytics & ML

  • Expert-level SQL skills for large-scale transformation and analytics.
  • Experience designing scalable warehouse schemas and ML-ready data layers.
  • Strong experience optimizing complex queries across multi-terabyte datasets.

Programming & ML Data Integration

  • Proficiency in Python (or similar language) for data processing and ML pipeline integration.
  • Experience with distributed processing frameworks such as Spark.
  • Familiarity integrating data pipelines with ML platforms such as Vertex AI (preferred), Databricks ML, or equivalent.

Streaming & Event-Driven Systems

  • Experience building real-time data pipelines using Kafka, Pub/Sub, or similar technologies.
  • Understanding of feature streaming, low-latency data processing, and event-driven architectures.
  • Ability to architect and build real-time dashboards using Superset.

Cloud & Modern AI Data Platforms

  • Experience designing cloud-native data architectures (GCP preferred).
  • Experience with lakehouse architectures and cloud data warehouses.
  • Familiarity with vector databases, embeddings pipelines, and AI-serving infrastructure is a plus.

 

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 2–4+ years of experience in data engineering, data pipeline development, or related fields.
  • Strong foundation in modern data engineering principles, distributed systems design, and cloud-native architectures.
  • Demonstrated ability to design and operate large-scale production data systems.
  • Proven track record of technical leadership and cross-functional collaboration.

job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?  


We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture. 

 Apply to join our new platform initiative and take ownership of building a centralized performance testing automation platform for games development. In this role, you will collaborate with developers, designers, and QA teams to design and deliver a unified system that aggregates performance data from multiple game engines, processes results, and clearly highlights performance issues. 

 You will play a key role in defining the software architecture, database schemas, and overall system experience, while helping to track and visualize optimization progress over time. As this is a brand‑new platform with no prior internal equivalent, you’ll have a unique opportunity to shape its foundations and influence how performance testing is approached across our game development teams. 

 

 

What you will do: 

  • Develop and maintain a platform (applications, integrations and infrastructure) supporting gaming department

  • Partner closely with software architects, game developers, QA, and operations to remove bottlenecks and improve delivery 

  • Build and Maintain CI/CD Pipelines 

  • Script repetitive tasks and develop self-service tools for developers 

  • Design and manage infrastructure 

  • Implement and manage containers, stand up and manage VMs 

  • Implement logging, monitoring, and alerting 

  • Ensure infrastructure is scalable, secure, and reliable. 

 

We are looking for Engineers that: 

  • Are curious, with a desire to learn and the ambition to quickly become a self-reliant, top-notch software engineer,  

  • Value collaboration, knowledge sharing, and contributing to the team's overall effectiveness,  

  • Equally enjoys coding applications and managing infrastructure 

  • Keep up to date with modern web technologies,   

  • Want to actively participate in decision making and fully understand products they work on,   

  • Open to learn new programing languages, 

  • Enjoy working in a team,   

  • Easily and openly communicate in English.  

 

And on the technical side, we need: 

  • 3+ years of experience in software development, build automation, delivery and deployment 

  • Good understanding of concepts like CI/CD, GitOps, configuration management, cloud platforms, version control, automation, monitoring, analytics, containerization, and microservices architecture 

  • Comfortable coding in at least one programing language (preferred: Kotlin, Java, JavaScript, Python, C++/C#) 

  • Experienced in code collaboration in Git, 

  • Experienced in containers orchestration in Kubernetes, 

  • Good knowledge and practical experience managing Cloud infrastructure. OCI is a huge plus. 

  • Experience standing up and maintaining Windows and/or Linux VMs 

  • Bonus: hands-on experience with Unreal Engine 

  • Bonus: hands-on experience scripting in BuildGraph 

  • Bonus: hands-on experience in code collaboration using Perforce 

  

We keep our technologies up-to-date, and have a major impact on the tool set: 

  • CI/CD & Automation: Horde, Jenkins, ArgoCD 

  • Infrastructure & Platform: OCI, Terraform, Ansible 

  • Containers & Virtualization: Kubernetes, Podman, Proxmox, KVM 

  • Observability & Reliability: Prometheus, Grafana, New Relic 

  • Game Development: Unreal Engine 

  • Source Control Management: Perforce, Git 

  • Operating Systems: Linux, Windows 

 

We offer: 

  • Employment contract, 

  • Multisport card + private medical care, 

  • Access to e-learning and self-development platforms, 

  • Office library, 

  • English and Polish language lessons, 

  • We participate in and speak at conferences, also join/ run public meet-ups, 

  • In-house activities: tech talks, hackathons, 

  • You can use 10% of your working time to pursue your personal development, and side projects, 

  • Active global inclusion and CSR groups, 

  • Well located, modern office with lots of amenities – adjustable desks, electronics toolkit, 3D printer ready for you to use, pool table, console, table tennis, massage chair.

CBS News Minnesota is looking for a Digital Line Producer to work on WCCO's live stream and linear newscasts, WCCO.com and other digital/social outlets, managing and creating content for audiences! The content producer will work with a digital team to manage, optimize, and time live and on-demand video content for mobile, desktop and OTT platforms. The content producer works in coordination with News Managers and Broadcast Line Producers during live news programs, and takes on other responsibilities such as writing headlines, publishing and updating articles, editing and publishing video, conducting interviews, and optimizing SEO, discoverability and shareability of all content.

 

 


RESPONSIBILITIES INCLUDE, BUT ARE NOT LIMITED, TO:


· Leading all aspects of content on CBS News Minnesota by building show rundowns and segments, editing video and scripts whenever needed.

· Aggressively manage and publish updated news stories and video segments, concentrating on developing stories and breaking news.

· Tracking news and events; coordinating coverage with managers and line producers.

· Constantly updating news content in the stream and producing breaking news and other updates as they happen instead of waiting for a scheduled newscast.

· Anticipating the needs of CBS News Minnesota for video, graphics, scripts and other elements.

· Coding/stacking rundown content regarding video, graphics, scripts and other elements.

· Writing memorable headlines, scripts and segments. Optimize headlines, captions, and video titles for in-platform search (TikTok, YouTube, Instagram) in addition to traditional web SEO.

· Working with managers and the entire digital team to develop and produce special content applying the resources and storytelling of the entire WCCO Newsroom.

· Conducting interviews in the field or over web camera, shooting video, producing content, and editing video for audiences on digital and social media platforms.

· Demonstrating expertise in timing in a control room environment.

· Build videos for multiple platforms, including WCCO.com, YouTube, and WCCO’s social media channels, with an emphasis on verticals and social reels.

· Other duties as assigned.

 

 


REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:


· Multiplatform fluency, with day-to-day focus on managing and timing live video opportunities, but able to flex into social content, web publishing, and broadcast/linear producing support.

· Proven experience in crafting and publishing digital news stories and video content.

· Proven success operating in a fast-paced news environment, a field that often requires pivots to new technological realities and tools.

· Ability to prioritize multiple tasks under tight deadlines to write headlines, publish articles, and edit video for live digital publishing/broadcast.

· Familiarity with non-linear editing systems such as Edius/Stratus, Final Cut, Adobe Premiere required.

· Familiarity with iNews and Crispin Rapid Play preferred.

· Available for early mornings, nights, weekends, and holidays.

· Strong ability to write accurate and compelling copy for both broadcast and web.

· Knowledge of Associated Press style and journalism ethics and standards.

· Knowledge of social media and the competitive digital news environment.

· Understanding of multi-platform discovery — Google Discover, AI Overviews, and in-platform search on TikTok/YouTube/Instagram — in addition to traditional SEO and Google Trends.
