  • Proactively prevent and mitigate production incidents.

  • Enable engineering teams to successfully deliver mission-critical features and enhancements.

  • Identify technical risks and bottlenecks and propose effective mitigation strategies.

Required Skills

Android Development Expertise

  • Expert-level proficiency in Kotlin and Java.

  • Strong understanding of Android SDK and Android platform ecosystems.

  • Deep knowledge of architectural patterns and modern Android development approaches, including:

    • MVVM

    • MVI

    • Clean Architecture

    • Jetpack Compose

    • Material Design

  • Experience with Android Studio and Gradle.

  • Strong understanding and implementation of software design patterns.

System Design & Architecture

  • Proven ability to design scalable, high-performing, and secure Android applications.

  • Experience integrating complex RESTful APIs and third-party libraries.

Testing & Quality Assurance

  • Extensive experience writing unit, UI, and automated tests using frameworks such as JUnit and Espresso.

  • Experience implementing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Jenkins and GitHub Actions.

Performance Optimization

  • Experience identifying and resolving performance bottlenecks, including memory leaks, rendering issues, and network inefficiencies.

  • Proficiency with Android performance analysis tools, including Android Profiler and LeakCanary.

Leadership & Communication

  • Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to engineers, stakeholders, and executive audiences.

  • Demonstrated success mentoring and developing high-performing engineering teams.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 7+ years of professional software development experience, including 6+ years focused on Android development.

  • Demonstrated success leading and delivering large-scale Android projects in production environments across multiple Agile/Scrum teams.

  • Proven track record of architectural ownership and technical decision-making.

  • Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management skills with the ability to facilitate business and technical discussions.

  • Strong focus on software quality and user experience.

  • Ability to translate business objectives into technical requirements and solutions.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience developing applications for Android, Android TV, Amazon Fire TV, and related platforms.

  • Experience publishing applications to the Google Play Store and/or Amazon Appstore.

  • Experience working remotely with globally distributed and cross-functional teams.

  • Experience with multi-module Android architectures.

  • Experience supporting accessibility technologies such as JAWS, VoiceOver, ZoomText, and keyboard-only navigation.

  • Familiarity with WCAG accessibility standards and accessibility-focused development practices.

  • Experience implementing accessibility features such as:

    • TalkBack support

    • contentDescription and labelFor attributes

    • Dynamic text scaling

    • Responsive UI design

    • Accessibility announcements

AI Literacy

  • Daily hands-on experience with AI coding assistants such as Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent tools.

  • Strong prompt engineering skills and ability to critically evaluate AI-generated code before production use.

  • Working knowledge of:

    • Large Language Models (LLMs)

    • Embeddings

    • Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)

    • Prompt engineering

  • Experience building or prototyping ML- or LLM-powered product features, including search, ranking, personalization, content understanding, or in-app AI experiences.

  • Strong understanding of responsible AI practices, including privacy, intellectual property considerations, attribution, and human-review requirements.

Preferred / Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with video streaming technologies, including HLS and MPEG-DASH.

  • Experience working with ExoPlayer.

job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

 

Lead Product Designer, CBS Sports App

Discipline: Design | Team Model: Embedded on a cross-functional CBS Sports App squad

Location: New York, NY

 

The Mission

CBS Sports is the digital stadium for millions of fans. We hold the rights to the biggest moments in sports—NFL, UEFA Champions League, March Madness, the Masters, and UFC. We aren't just a scoreboard; we’re a massive content engine of fantasy leagues, live video, and deep journalism. We’re looking for a Lead Product Designer to join a small, cross-functional squad that operates with the speed of a startup and the scale of a legacy giant.

 

The Role: Build and Own

You won’t just work on a product; you’ll own the design outcomes from first framing through ship. We believe in a builder culture where designers aren't waiting for handoffs or research gates. You will:

  • Own the Project: Take full responsibility for your product squad’s design outcomes. You lead the direction from initial concept to the final shipped experience.

  • Build Constantly: Prototype early and often. We use AI tools (like Cursor or Claude) to visualize ideas and test interactions before they hit engineering, letting us move faster than ever.

  • Lead with Visual Craft: We need designers who bring energy, taste, and dynamic design sensibilities. Whether it’s motion that obeys physics or layouts that capture the intensity of game day, your work should set the bar for the squad.

  • Shape the Product: You’ll trade honest, real-time feedback with engineers and PMs. We don't just "deliver" designs; we shape products in the build.

 

Core Capabilities

  • Visual Design: You have a refined eye for type hierarchy, layouts, and intuitive UI/UX. You deliver high-impact, immersive designs for complex app systems that capture the intensity of game day and live sports.

  • Motion & Interactivity: You understand motion as a logical system. Your designs feel tactile, precise, and alive.

  • Fluency in Native Design: You have deep experience with mobile paradigms (iOS/Android). You know how to leverage native capabilities to elevate the user experience.

  • Owner Mindset: You treat research as a velocity tool, not a gate. You use your intuition, analytics, and direct fan feedback to make smart product decisions quickly.

 

Basic Qualifications

  • 8+ years of end-to-end product design experience.

  • A portfolio showing shipped consumer work on mobile apps or web (required).

  • Comfort moving across prototyping, production, and interaction design without handoffs.

 

Additional Qualifications

  • Passion for sports, betting, live events, or broadcast media.

  • Experience with AI-assisted design or prototyping workflows.

  • Contributions to a design system.

 

 

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

job.title: Legal Counsel
job.description:
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture. 

 

In Australia, we deliver premium content on any screen, anytime, anywhere, via an enhanced viewing ecosystem.   We pride ourselves on creating content that gets people talking. What’s more, you can watch and stream for free on 10, 10 Drama, 10 Comedy and Nickelodeon, plus a vast array of Free Ad-Supported Streaming TV (FAST channels) as well as our subscription video on demand service Paramount+.  

 

 

We now have a rare opportunity available for an up-and-coming lawyer who is excited by the appeal of gaining broad media law experience in a role that will allow you to develop skills in both commercial and clearance & litigation matters.  

 

We’re looking for a collaborative and friendly team player who is eager to learn and is flexible to adapt in the fast pace and changing needs of a dynamic media business.  

 

Enough about us! What you’ll do as a Legal Counsel:  

  

This role has dual functions, comprising both the commercial function for the negotiation, preparation, review and finalisation of agreements relating to the development, production and acquisition of media content, as well as a clearance & litigation function for the clearance of content for broadcast against the various laws and regulations applying to Australian media.  

   

Functions will include:  

  • Assisting with drafting, negotiating and reviewing principal contracts including program acquisition, production and licence, development, format, distribution, funding, ancillary, talent and other production and intellectual property licences and agreements.  
  • Assuming direct responsibility for drafting and negotiating foundational agreements such as non-disclosure agreements, standard program licences, location agreements/filming permits for productions/promos, waivers, talent/participant releases, photography releases, program partnership/sponsorship agreements, event sponsorship agreements, footage licences  
  • Advising on intellectual property matters  
  • Providing general commercial legal advice, such as interpreting contracts  
  • Clearance of 10 News, social posts and general news legal clearance  
  • Clearance of non-news programs including Have You Been Paying Attention?, Gogglebox, Cheap Seats and Sam Pang.  
  • Assisting with the preparation of Cease-and-Desist letters  
  • Advertising and commercial integration clearance, including betting and gambling legislation  
  • Assisting senior lawyers with litigation and dispute resolution  
  • Assisting in preparing Legal training materials and updating Legal team internal guidance notes  

 

What are we looking for in a Legal Counsel? What’s important?     

  • A qualified lawyer holding, or eligible to hold, a practising certificate in NSW or Victoria  
  • 2-4 years of relevant post qualification experience in a top tier law firm or highly regarded in-house legal team  
  • Enthusiasm, passion and the willingness to learn and develop new skills and expertise  
  • Experience advising on media and/or intellectual property issues, and/or a good result in relevant university subject(s) in this area  
  • Commercial aptitude, including the ability to advise within the framework of Ten’s business objectives and risk profile  
  • Deep technical proficiency in contract and intellectual property laws  
  • An interest in content production and the media industry  
  • Exceptional attention to detail  
  • Excellent and effective interpersonal, written and communication skills, including an ability to adapt to and communicate with all types of people internally and externally  
  • Ability to work collaboratively and effectively as a team member  
  • Excellent time management skills and the ability to perform a variety of tasks  

 

 

Paramount embraces differences and we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds regardless of factors such as race, colour, sex, language, religion, political or other opinion, national or social origin, property or birth. These grounds also include age, nationality, marital status, disability, place of residence and sexual orientation.  

 

We’re honoured to have been named on Diversity Council Australia’s annual list of Inclusive Employers in 2023-24 and 2024-25. This acknowledgement highlights our commitment to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace where all employees feel valued and supported. 

 

Paramount acknowledges Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples as Australia's original storytellers and the first peoples of the lands where we create, broadcast and connect. We pay our respects to their timeless stories that continue to shape Country and culture.

The CBS Stations' Local Ad Sales team is responsible for driving all local revenue growth across all Paramount Global streaming & digital assets, as well as the 27 owned & operated CBS Television Stations. This team collaborates across Paramount Global and CBS Stations divisions, providing thought leadership that drives the local sales GTM strategy, innovation opportunities, training & development, and revenue generation.


Position Overview:


We are looking for exceptional candidates for the Manager, Account Management role, who will train and develop Account Managers to drive client and campaign excellence across our portfolio of digital & streaming assets, inclusive of Paramount+, CBS, Pluto TV, and more. The candidate will also work closely and collaborate with sales teams, clients, and internal Paramount teams.


Role Details:

 

The Manager, Account Management sits between individual-contributor account management and regional sales leadership, providing the day-to-day client and campaign management, coaching, and quality control that the Account Manager team needs to deliver sales performance. While the Account Managers roll up into their Directors, the Manager, Account Management works in tandem with the Regional Digital Sales Director(s) and Local Sales Management to translate revenue goals and priorities into clear direction for the team.

 

The Manager, Account Management, will work directly with Account Managers on account sales strategy, campaign specifics, and client escalations. This role is also the primary point of contact for the internal teams that power local sales delivery -- including Data, Ad Operations, Yield, Marketing, Research, and Ad Systems -- building and maintaining the workflows the Local team relies on to execute successfully. The ideal candidate is a proactive, organized communicator who is energized by developing people, driving excellence, and building a strong culture.


Your Day-to-Day:

  • Directly develop the Account Manager team, including workload distribution, coaching, and sales performance feedback
  • Work in tandem with the Regional Digital Sales Director(s) to lead the Account Manager team through the full sales cycle for all clients
  • Serve as the primary point of contact with Data, Ad Operations, Yield, Marketing, Research, Ad Systems, and other internal teams to deliver the best-in-class client experience
  • Partner with Directors and Sales Leadership to ensure Account Managers have the tools, training, and support needed to execute digital & streaming campaigns and become a future account executive
  • Identify workflow gaps between Local Sales and internal partner teams, and drive process improvements that drive revenue growth
  • Report team & client performance, and development progress to the Regional Digital Sales Director

 

Qualifications:
What you bring to the team:

 

You have:

  • 3+ years of experience in advertising/media account management, sales or sales support, with digital, streaming and/or linear experience preferred
  • Prior experience mentoring, training, or informally leading other account management or sales staff
  • Ability to lead cross-functional teams (e.g. Ad Operations, Yield, Data, Marketing, Research) to solve workflow and process challenges on behalf of the sales team

job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

Overview:

 

We are seeking a highly skilled and proficient Manager, Application Security and Compliance to lead the design, implementation, and maintenance of our Oracle Fusion and Oracle EPM security architecture. In this role, you will serve as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for application security and Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) compliance across our enterprise systems. You will be in charge of ensuring strict Segregation of Duties (SoD), managing user access governance, and mitigating risk across Oracle Fusion (ERP, Procurement, and HCM), Oracle EPM, and Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC). The ideal candidate brings a blend of technical expertise in Oracle Identity and Access Management (IAM) and a deep knowledge of IT General Controls (ITGC) and compliance frameworks.


Responsibilities:

 

  • Security Architecture and Role Management Design and Maintenance: Create custom job roles and duty roles. Keep data security policies updated in Oracle Fusion (ERP, Procurement, HCM), Oracle EPM, and FDI environments.

  • Identity Management: Leverage Oracle IAM to manage user provisioning, de-provisioning, and identity lifecycles. OIC Security: Define and govern security roles, privileges, and access controls within Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC).

  • Access Governance: Oversee user access reviews and certification campaigns, with an opportunity to leverage Oracle Access Governance for automated provisioning and analytics.

  • Compliance & Risk Management SOX Compliance: Ensure all Oracle environments strictly adhere to SOX compliance, ITGCs, and internal security policies.

  • Risk Mitigation: Implement, configure, and manage Oracle Fusion Risk Management Cloud (Advanced Access Controls and Advanced Financial Controls) to continuously monitor and uphold Segregation of Duties (SoD).

  • Audit Support: Serve as the primary point of contact for internal and external auditors, providing necessary reports, evidence, and system walkthroughs.

  • Remediation: Identify security vulnerabilities or SoD conflicts and proactively design and execute remediation plans.

 

Basic Qualifications:

 

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Accounting Information Systems, or a related field.

  • 5+ years of experience specializing in Oracle Application Security and IT Audit/Compliance. Strong knowledge of SOX compliance, COSO framework, and IT General Controls (ITGC).

  • Oracle Fusion Expertise: Proven experience designing and maintaining complex security roles across Oracle Fusion ERP, Procurement, and HCM.

  • Oracle EPM Security: Hands-on experience managing security matrices and user access within Oracle Enterprise Performance Management.

  • Oracle IAM: Sound knowledge and deep hands-on experience with Oracle Identity and Access Management frameworks.

  • Risk Management Cloud: Direct implementation experience with Oracle Fusion Risk Management Cloud (AAC/AFC) for SoD and transaction monitoring.

  • OIC Knowledge: Clear comprehension of Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) roles, privileges, and integration security.



Additional Qualifications:

 

  • Hands-on expertise or certification in Oracle Access Governance.

  • Relevant professional certifications (e.g., CISA, CRISC, CISSP, or Oracle Certified Security Specialist).

  • Great communication skills. Ability to explain complex technical security concepts in simple terms for business compliance requirements.

  • Solid analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail.

  • Ability to collaborate successfully with cross-functional teams, including Finance, HR, IT, and Internal Audit.

job.title: Manager, Brand Marketing & Global Events
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

Overview:

The Manager, Brand Marketing & Global Events will support the development, planning, and execution of consumer-facing events and experiential marketing programs across Paramount Streaming, including Paramount+ and Pluto TV. This role will play a key part in bringing our brands, content, sports partnerships, and fan experiences to life through strategic activations that drive awareness, engagement, and fandom among audiences worldwide.   This position will lead daily planning and execution of various activities, both domestic and international. It will play a key role in coordinating different functions. This includes planning operations, communicating with stakeholders, and carrying out on-site tasks. Key initiatives may include major sponsorships, fan conventions, festivals, premieres, and brand experiences, including programs such as Formula 1, CCXP Mexico, CCXP Brazil, and other strategic events throughout the year.   The ideal candidate is highly organized, collaborative, detail-oriented, and thrives in a dynamic environment. They are equally comfortable managing logistics and timelines as they are contributing ideas, solving problems, and partnering across a broad group of stakeholders to deliver extraordinary consumer experiences. They are forward-thinking, solutions-oriented, enthusiastic to learn, and enthusiastic about helping bring world-class entertainment and fan experiences to audiences around the globe.   This is an onsite position at our New York office.  

Responsibilities include but not limited to:

  • Lead day-to-day planning and execution for global consumer activations, experiential programs, sponsorships, and live events across Paramount+ and Pluto TV.
  • Manage project timelines, workbacks, key deliverables, and stakeholder communications to ensure initiatives remain on track and aligned with business objectives.
  • Oversee event logistics including venue management, staffing, travel, shipping, credentialing, vendor management, and production requirements.
  • Serve as a key point of contact for event operations, proactively identifying risks, solving challenges, and ensuring seamless execution.
  • Support on-site event management and execution. Helping deliver best-in-class experiences for consumers, partners, talent, and internal stakeholders.
  • Track budgets, purchase orders, invoices, and financial reconciliations in partnership with internal finance teams.
  • Partner closely with teams across Marketing, Creative, Communications, Social, Media, Partnerships, Production, Programming, Legal, Finance, and International organizations.
  • Manage day-to-day communication across internal stakeholders, agencies, vendors, and external partners.
  • Coordinate approvals, asset requests, creative reviews, and operational requirements to support successful event execution.
  • Foster alignment between domestic and international teams to ensure activations are executed successfully while addressing regional market needs.
  • Contribute to activation strategy and planning by helping shape event concepts, consumer experiences, and engagement opportunities that support broader business and marketing goals.
  • Own project documentation, timelines, status reports, meeting recaps, and stakeholder updates.
  • Identify risks, dependencies, and operational challenges, proactively recommending solutions and escalation paths when needed.
  • Support the development of presentations, planning materials, executive updates, and post-event recaps.
  • Track and organize activation performance metrics, attendee feedback, earned media results, partner reporting, and other key success indicators.
  • Lead post-event recap development and document key learnings and recommendations.
  • Support ongoing optimization efforts by identifying opportunities to improve processes, execution, and consumer impact across future activations.

 

Basic Qualifications:

  • 6+ years of experience in consumer activation, experiential marketing, live events, brand activations, or related fields.

 

Additional Qualifications:

  • Proven experience planning and executing large-scale consumer activations, festivals, conventions, experiential programs, or live events.
  • Robust project management skills with the ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously.
  • Remarkable organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Solid written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to build relationships and work successfully across diverse teams and stakeholders.
  • Comfortable operating in a dynamic environment with evolving priorities.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, and project management tools.
  • Experience in entertainment, media, streaming, sports, or consumer brands.
  • Experience supporting international events or working with global stakeholders.
  • Awareness with fan conventions, experiential marketing, or live event production.
  • Professional proficiency in Spanish and/or Portuguese is a plus.
  • Experience working with Latin American markets and international stakeholders is preferred.
  • Affinity for entertainment, pop culture, sports, and consumer engagement.

 

Paramount+, a direct-to-consumer digital subscription video on-demand and live streaming service from Paramount Global, combines live sports, breaking news, and a mountain of entertainment. job.title: Manager, Internal Audit, Risk and Analytics
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Overview and Responsibilities

As a Manager of Risk & Data Analytics, you deliver data-driven insights, lead risk-based audits, and support investigations, risk assessments, and special projects across Paramount. You work with leaders across corporate, media, streaming, and production to evaluate processes, governance, and controls using useful judgment and analytics. The role requires comfort with complex data, deep risk assessment skills, and the ability to operate in fast-moving, judgment-heavy environments. Engagements include operational reviews, T&E and production audits, and advisory projects in partnership with SOX, Compliance, Legal, Finance, and other teams.   Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:  
  • Plan and lead risk‑based analytics to support operational audits, advisory work, and special projects across corporate, media, streaming, advertising, and production areas
  • Develop focused project objectives, scopes, and risk assessments aligned to key business priorities
  • Design flexible approaches for non‑routine or evolving activities requiring solid professional judgment
  • Use analytics to evaluate processes, controls, and governance, and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, accountability, and growth
  • Conduct end‑to‑end process walkthroughs and root‑cause analysis to address underlying issues
  • Assess operational maturity and scalability in high‑growth or transformational initiatives
  • Apply advanced analytics to audit planning, testing, investigations, and continuous risk monitoring
  • Analyze complex datasets to identify trends, anomalies, and emerging risks across areas such as production, T&E, payroll, vendor payments, and revenue
  • Translate business risks into targeted, meaningful analytics and communicate insights through clear visuals and presentations
  • Lead or support special projects through data collection, validation, analysis, and documentation of findings
  • Synthesize insights from multiple systems and data sources and present conclusions through dashboards and presentations
  • Build robust relationships with business leaders and cross‑functional partners, including SOX, Compliance, Finance, and Legal
  • Communicate results and recommendations clearly, explaining root cause, risk, and business impact in an accessible language
  • Create recommendations that fit the business needs. When needed, promote remediation plans while keeping a focus on solutions
  • Serve as a trusted advisor while maintaining sovereignty and objectivity
  • Manage, coach, and develop team members while ensuring quality, consistency, and adherence to internal standards
  • Advance the team’s shift toward insight‑driven, judgment‑based auditing
  • Contribute to annual risk assessments and audit planning using data and industry insights
  • Support continuous improvement of Internal Audit methodologies, analytics capabilities, and investigative approaches
  • Partner with the Audit executive team on analytics tools, technologies, and industry trends to enhance the function’s capabilities
  • Assess audit and operational risks, design effective analytics procedures, identify control gaps, and manage multiple engagements in a dynamic environment
  • Apply sound judgment, professional skepticism, and well-developed communication skills to drive outcomes and maintain high standards of quality and integrity
  Basic Qualifications  
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, Data Analytics, Information Systems, or a related field
  • 7+ years of experience in internal audit, external audit, risk management, data analytics, or a related discipline
  Additional Qualifications  
  • Experience leading or executing analytics-driven reviews, including areas such as T&E, production, vendor payments, or revenue-related processes
  • Big Four or consulting experience preferred
  • Professional certification(s) such as CIA, CPA, CFE, CISA, or equivalent (active or in progress) preferred

job.description:
Got a nose for a great story and the relationships to get it placed? Paramount+ is looking for a Publicity Manager to join our Direct-to-Consumer team in Berlin on a temporary contract for circa 1 year — helping bring our Originals to life across Germany, Switzerland, and Austria.

This is a fast-start opportunity for a publicity pro who wants to get straight into the action. You'll sit at the centre of campaigns from first announcement through premiere night: building media strategy, wrangling talent schedules, pulling off press days that actually land, and keeping a fast-moving campaign calendar on track. One day you're pitching a top entertainment journalist, the next you're briefing talent ahead of a junket, the next you're in the room with Marketing and Creative shaping how a show gets positioned in a crowded streaming market.

  • Executing publicity campaigns for Paramount+ Original series — scripted and unscripted

  • Partnering across Marketing, Creative, Awards, and Events to keep campaigns joined-up
  • Tracking coverage and campaign performance so we know what's working

What you'll bring

  • 5+ years in entertainment publicity for TV, streaming, or film
  • A working knowledge of the DACH media landscape — journalists, trades, podcasts, and platforms
  • Comfort managing talent relationships with professionalism and discretion

This role also leads a team of Project Managers, responsible for their day-to-day workload, growth, and development, and ensuring the team's work stays aligned to architectural priorities.


Your Day-to-Day:
●    Serve as the subject matter expert on core technical architecture, working directly with engineers on how architectural changes get implemented, what they touch, and where they introduce risk.
●    Manage and develop a team of Project Managers, overseeing workload distribution, prioritization across their portfolios, and their growth as program/project managers.
●    Guide requirements-gathering on large architectural initiatives toward an agreed MVP, managing scope creep as multiple teams propose competing approaches.
●    Stand up and lead focused working groups (tiger teams) to execute isolated architectural changes without disrupting the broader platform.
●    Run and facilitate Architecture Intake, a standing forum with engineering leads across architecture and feature teams, reviewing new RFCs before they're committed to the roadmap.
●    Triage daily requests and escalations from feature teams across Paramount Streaming's platforms that depend on shared architecture systems, distinguishing routine asks from signals of deeper dependency issues.
●    Communicate program health, risk, and architectural roadmap status to engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.


Basic Qualifications:
●    7+ years of technical program management experience in a complex, matrixed engineering organization, ideally supporting platform or architecture teams rather than feature delivery teams.
●    Prior experience managing or mentoring other program/project managers, with direct people-management responsibility (performance, growth, workload balancing).
●    Demonstrated ability to understand and reason about system architecture deeply enough to evaluate engineering estimates, scoping, and technical tradeoffs directly with engineers, not just track them.
●    Experience running structured technical review processes (e.g., architecture review boards, RFC processes) to drive cross-team alignment on technical direction.
●    Experience managing platform or infrastructure work with dependencies across multiple engineering teams and SRE.
●    Strong judgment on when to escalate, when to push back, and when to let engineering teams self-direct.
●    High proficiency with Jira, Confluence, and technical documentation; strong written and verbal communication with both engineers and leadership.
●    Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

Preferred Qualifications:
●    Familiarity with Next.js, Module Federation, micro-frontend architectures, or similar web platform technologies.
●    Experience in direct-to-consumer streaming, media, or high-traffic web platforms.
●    Background as a software engineer or technical lead prior to moving into program management.

job.title: Media Exchange Operator
job.description:
Paramount Skydance Corporation is a leading global media and entertainment company that creates premium content and experiences for audiences worldwide. Driven by iconic studios, networks and streaming services, Paramount's portfolio of consumer brands includes CBS, Showtime Networks, Paramount Pictures, Nickelodeon, MTV, Comedy Central, BET, Paramount+, Pluto TV, Network 10 (Australia) and Channel 5 (UK).   In Australia, we deliver premium content on any screen, anytime, anywhere, via an enhanced viewing ecosystem.   We pride ourselves on creating content that gets people talking. What’s more, you can watch and stream for free on 10, 10 Drama, 10 Comedy and Nickelodeon, plus a vast array of Free Ad-Supported Streaming TV (FAST channels) as well as our subscription video on demand service Paramount+.   

 

 

We’re now looking for a Media Exchange Operator to join our busy Sydney station on a CASUAL basis, with hours and days varying depending on demand. 

 

What you’ll do as a Media Exchange Operator:

You’ll combine your strong attention to detail and technical skills to ingest and prepare media for News and Production, working closely with newsroom and production staff to keep media-based operations running smoothly. Working with state-of-the-art technology in a supportive, high-morale team, you’ll have the chance to expand your skills, collaborate across business units and engage in the power of content.

This is a place where variety is the norm, teamwork is strong, and learning opportunities are everywhere.

 

Functions will also include:

 

  • Ingesting media for News and Production, from local news gathering and production shoots to international satellite feeds.
  • Scheduling records for News and Production, ensuring media assets are readily available within our Media Asset Management system for all our internal production teams and newsroom.
  • Preparing and monitoring playout media for live studio News and Production, applying advanced workflow tools to track media through each stage of the process.
  • QC of News and Production media assets, ensuring technical standards are maintained.
  • Maintaining clear media metadata naming conventions and asset organisation within a vast media management system shared by a large number of users
  • Maintaining archival requirements, ensuring media assets are properly kept for future use.
  • Completing basic editing to prepare media for playout, or condense content where necessary.
  • Liaising with newsroom and production staff, the Network Operations Centre (NOC) and acquisitions crews, ensuring all broadcast items are ready for edit when required.
  • Distributing media to internal teams and external organisations, ensuring accurate and timely delivery.

 

What are we looking for in a Media Exchange Operator? What’s important?

•    You will need to be a highly motivated self-starter who can thrive in a deadline driven environment 
•    Have effective communication skills with strong customer service focus. 
•    High attention to detail.
•    Strong computer literacy and enjoy the use of new technology
•    Ability to learn and adapt to continuously evolving technology, practices and procedures. 
•    Can work within a 24/7 day rotating roster.

As Partnership Manager, Programmatic Partnerships, you'll team up with Paramount's core DSP, SSP, and platform partner leads to grow our TV programmatic business! You will own the relationships with technical and analytical contacts at our DSP and SSP programmatic partners. You'll also own the relationships at our platform/distribution partners (e.g., Roku, Samsung, Amazon Fire TV) and mediation platforms like SpringServe, Publica, etc. You'll work across all of these groups to boost value — and revenue — across our partner ecosystem. job.title: Principal Machine Learning Engineer, Content Engineering
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Principal Machine Learning Engineer, Content Engineering (45445) 

 

 

Overview:

 

We are seeking a Senior Lead / Principal Machine Learning Engineer to lead our ShortForm & Video Intelligence pod. This team is in charge of a critical mission: the automated transformation of our massive long-form content library into "ShortForm" assets—high-impact clips, "gists," and social-ready highlights. You will lead the development of the models that "watch" our content to identify narrative hooks, emotional climaxes, and key characters to create compelling bite-sized experiences.

 

This is a deeply technical leadership role requiring mastery of multi-modal machine learning. You will oversee the creation of intelligence layers that perform video safety analysis (nudity/profanity detection), spoiler detection, and sophisticated narrative comprehension. Your work ensures that our ShortForm content is not only engaging but also safe, contextually precise, and optimized for discovery across the Paramount ecosystem.

 

The ShortForm pod unlocks the value of our entire catalog. In this role, you will directly shape:

 

  • The "Gist" Ecosystem: Building the engine that generates short-form previews, allowing users to "snack" on content before committing to a full watch.
  • Platform Safety & Integrity: Owning the "Video Intelligence" filters that protect our brand and users through automated detection of sensitive or restricted content.
  • Narrative AI: Transitioning beyond simple metadata to a world where AI understands story arcs, character importance, and "viral" moments within a film or episode. 

 

Responsibilities:

 

  • Lead the ShortForm Pod: Define the technical roadmap for automated clip generation and video insight, managing a high-performing pod of ML engineers.
  • Architect Multi-Modal Models: Design and deploy models that synthesize signals across video (pixels), audio (speech/music), and text (transcripts/scripts) to understand content context.
  • Own Video Intelligence: Develop and scale robust computer vision and audio classifiers for nudity, profanity, and sensitive content detection.
  • Advance Narrative Understanding: Build models that can identify "hooks," "climax points," and "narrative summaries" to automate the creation of trailers and highlights.
  • Spoiler & Context Detection: Create intelligence layers that identify plot-critical "spoilers" to ensure ShortForm assets don't ruin the viewing experience for new users.
  • Scalable Content Pipelines: Partner with Content Engineering to integrate these models into petabyte-scale video processing workflows.

 

Basic Qualifications:

 

  • 6-8+ years of experience in machine learning, with a heavy focus on Computer Vision (CV) and Multi-Modal architectures.
  • Deep Learning Expertise: Mastery of PyTorch or TensorFlow, specifically for video-based tasks (e.g., Video Transformers, 3D CNNs). Video Intelligence: Proven experience building safety/moderation models (Nudity, Profanity, Hate Speech) or content-tagging systems.
  • Leadership: Experience leading senior technical teams and translating complex "creative" goals into engineering requirements.
  • Video Tech Stack: Knowledge of video processing frameworks (FFmpeg) and handling various codecs/resolutions at scale.

 

Additional Qualifications:

 

  • Experience with Generative AI for Video (automated editing or style transfer).
  • Background in NLP/Speech for sync-ing transcripts with video frames.
  • Knowledge of Narrative Theory or experience in the media/entertainment industry.
  • Experience deploying large-scale models in Cloud Environments (AWS/GCP/Azure) with high GPU utilization efficiency.

Writing & Storytelling

Collaboration & Newsroom Culture

· Work closely with the assignment desk, managing editors, reporters, and photojournalists

· Contribute story ideas that reflect Pittsburgh and the communities KDKA serves

· Proven ability to work under aggressive deadlines

Product Management, Merchandising (International)

 

Job Summary
Paramount+ is seeking a Product Manager, Merchandising (International) to own how audiences across international markets discover and engage with content on our streaming platform. This role is responsible for defining and spearheading the international merchandising strategy and execution model, ensuring content is positioned effectively across regions while scaling through data‑driven workflows and automation.

Operating at the intersection of Product, Programming, Applied Machine Learning, Marketing, Design, and Operations, this role translates global and regional content priorities into clear merchandising strategies, measurable outcomes, and repeatable operating mechanisms. The Product Manager will balance global consistency with local relevance, ensuring international discovery experiences are intuitive, compliant, and optimized for engagement and retention.

Key Responsibilities
●    Define and drive the international on‑platform merchandising operations, including content positioning, prioritization, and lifecycle management across markets.
●    Establish consistent merchandising principles for international markets while enabling regional flexibility where audience needs or regulatory requirements differ.

●    Partner with Product and Engineering teams to inform platform capabilities, tooling improvements, and roadmap decisions that enable scalable merchandising execution.
●    Ensure merchandising workflows are designed to support global scale while minimizing manual intervention through automation and data-driven decision making.
●    Partner closely with Programming teams to align on content intent, timing, and regional considerations.
●    Collaborate with Applied Machine Learning (AMLG) teams to define rules, constraints, and success metrics that guide personalization and automation in international markets.
●    Work with Marketing and Design partners to ensure on‑platform experience aligns with campaign objectives and brand standards, while retaining merchandising accountability.
●    Partner with Legal, Privacy, and regional stakeholders to ensure international merchandising experiences meet regulatory and compliance requirements.
●    Champion experimentation across international markets, ensuring merchandising strategies are testable and supported by solid metadata, creative, and operational foundations.
●    Oversee monitoring and reporting to evaluate merchandising performance and surface insights that drive continuous optimization across markets.

 

Basic Qualifications
●    3+ years in product management, content merchandising, or content discovery for consumer facing digital products at scale.
●    Proven track record owning complex, cross‑functional initiatives in a global environment, with accountability for measurable outcomes. 

●    Bachelor’s degree required; technical or quantitative discipline preferred. 
●    Strong applied knowledge of data-driven methodologies, including behavioral analytics and segmentation, to inform merchandising decisions and drive subscriber level outcomes.
●    Experience defining content architecture and curation strategy across platforms, with working knowledge of how platform dependencies and metadata quality affect the consumer experience. 
●    Demonstrated ability to partner substantively with ML and engineering teams on personalization and recommendation systems, including evaluating outputs and defining constraints that reflect merchandising intent. 
●    Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence across product, technical, and creative teams.


Preferred Qualifications
●    Experience supporting international or regional discovery strategies for a global streaming or media platform.
●    Proficiency with analytics and data science tooling (such as Adobe Analytics, Looker, Tableau, Python, or SQL)
●    Working knowledge of how personalization and ranking systems are built, with experience contributing to the signals and inputs that shape content recommendations. 
●    Proven track record designing and interpreting experimentation programs, including A/B and multivariate testing, to drive merchandising optimization. 
●    Experience working across multiple time zones and cultural contexts.

job.title: PTP Associate - PO & Invoice Monitoring
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

Paramount is home to CBS, Nickelodeon, MTV, and Paramount Pictures. Behind every show, film, and stream is a long list of suppliers who need to be paid accurately and on time. That's where you come in. We're growing our Procure-to-Pay (PTP) team in Budapest and looking for a sharp, detail-obsessed Invoice Auditor. You'll be the quality checkpoint for invoices across our international entities. You'll catch what's wrong, work out why, and help us stop it happening again.

Contract: Fixed term, 12 months, with extension possible based on business needs
Start: As soon as possible. We're looking for someone who can start at short notice and commit to the full 12 months.

Closing date: 17th October 2026

What you'll do

  • Work the invoice error queues in SAP and Oracle, digging into why invoices aren't posting and getting them unstuck
  • Chase down aged invoices and open purchase orders (GR/IR exceptions) with the business so suppliers are paid on time
  • Run fiscal and tax compliance checks on invoices for our international entities
  • Recover vendor credit balances, overpayments, and unapplied credits
  • Enter approved invoices manually when automation can't
  • Be the go-to for vendor and stakeholder queries, partnering with Procurement, Disbursements, and Finance teams
  • Spot patterns in recurring issues and help fix them at the root, improving both efficiency and control

What you'll bring

Essential

  • 1-3 years in Procure-to-Pay, Accounts Payable, or a similar finance operations setting
  • Hands-on ERP experience
  • Strong Excel skills (analysis, reporting, reconciliations)
  • Fluent English, written and spoken
  • A sharp eye for detail and a knack for problem-solving
  • Ability to commute to our Budapest office 2-3 days a week

Nice to have

  • Oracle Fusion Cloud and/or SAP experience
  • A degree in Accounting, Finance, or Business
  • Hungarian or other languages
  • Experience in a shared services or GBS environment

You're likely a great fit if you like finding the needle in the haystack, take pride in getting it right, and are happy to pick up the phone or message to get an issue resolved.

Why this role

  • Real exposure: You'll work across systems, entities, and countries and see how a global media business runs its finance operations end to end
    Hands-on learning: You'll build deep knowledge of PTP processes, tax and compliance reviews, and SAP and Oracle
  • A genuine team: You'll join a collaborative GBS team in a friendly Budapest office
  • Perks: Private health insurance with a screening package, a monthly cafeteria package (SZÉP card, nursery, and home loan support), eyewear support, language courses after probation, weekly fresh fruit days and a dog-friendly office

Paramount Skydance Corporation (NASDAQ: PSKY) is a leading global media and entertainment company that creates premium content and experiences for audiences worldwide. Driven by iconic studios, networks and streaming services, Paramount's portfolio of consumer brands includes CBS, Showtime Networks, Paramount Pictures, Nickelodeon, MTV, Comedy Central, BET, Paramount+, and Pluto TV, among others. Paramount delivers the largest share of the U.S. television audience and boasts one of the industry's most important and extensive libraries of TV and film titles. In addition to offering innovative streaming services and digital video products, the company provides powerful capabilities in production, distribution and advertising solutions.

The Senior Cloud Architect is in charge of defining architectural standards, security frameworks and automation goals for all cloud deployments operated by Infrastructure & Media Technology. It is a high-impact and strategic role with a large scope that allows the candidate to work with brilliant co-workers to help solve some of Paramount’s most pressing technical challenges. The Senior Cloud Architect will have the ability to greatly influence cloud policy as well be a visionary for how Paramount should adopt the cloud over the next 3 to 5 years. job.title: Senior Director, Data Science
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

Overview:

 

We are the Global Content and Lifecycle Analytics team, part of the Paramount Streaming, Data & Insights Group (DIG) team. DIG is a key connector among the Paramount Streaming verticals. The group consists of subject matter experts that prototype, build, and scale data infrastructure and products; assess, aggregate, and analyze data; and shape qualitative and quantitative based narratives and insights, providing stakeholders with decision support, performance clarity and business driving recommendations.

The User Lifecycle Analytics team works closely with Lifecycle Marketing, Product, Finance, and DTC Executives to drive subscriber growth and retention.

 

The Senior Director will report into the VP of User Lifecycle Analytics, and will support a wide range of initiatives, partnering with the Lifecycle Marketing and Product teams, DTC executives and Finance. This role requires the ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable insights and strategic recommendations.

The ideal candidate will possess strong communication skills, an inquisitive nature, attention to detail, and a passion for media, ideally with experience in analyzing user journeys and advanced causal inference frameworks.

This role owns two core business questions:

 

  1. What drives long-term subscriber health, and how do we use our levers (lifecycle, product, pricing, promotions) to encourage it? 
  2. How are optimization efforts across content and the subscriber journey impacting the bottom line?

 

Responsibilities:

 

  • Design and lead causal inference frameworks (quasi-experimental methods, uplift modeling, instrumental variables, matching, diff-in-diff). Find what truly drives retention and value.
  • Work with Lifecycle Marketing and Product to turn causal findings into clear levers. These span content, onboarding, pricing, and promos to improve subscriber health.
  • Own how we link content and journey optimization to outcomes like ARPU, survival, and LTV.
  • Design, launch, and analyze A/B tests across the subscriber journey (acquisition, onboarding, involvement, win-back). Use sound design. Deliver clear results.
  • Build and keep LTV and survival models with the causal drivers above. Finance and DTC teams can then use them.
  • Lead subscriber journey mapping. Find where levers (lifecycle, product, pricing, promos) drive the most causal impact on retention and monetization.
  • Run pricing and promo analyses to shape pricing and promo design. Weigh short-term conversion against long-term value.
  • Explain technical findings clearly to non-technical teams, like DTC leaders and Finance.
  • Manage, mentor, and grow a team of data scientists and analysts. Set technical standards and review methods.
  • Work with Data Engineering and Product Analytics. Keep the data systems for causal analysis (experiment platforms, behavioral and billing data) reliable.
  • Share findings with senior leaders to shape the roadmap. Guide where we invest across Marketing, Product, and Finance.

  • A clear communicator who can present complex work to senior leaders and shape decisions.

Additional Qualifications:

 

  • Know pricing awareness/elasticity work. Design smart promos.

job.description:

Overview:

As the Senior Director, Paid Media Performance, you will develop strategic recommendations and own performance for paid user acquisition of paid media across search, social and programmatic channels, as well as programmatic/DSP investment for the full Paramount+ title portfolio. You will help shape the vision, in partnership with senior leadership, for how paid media drives efficient, scalable subscriber and engagement growth. Directing multiple large campaigns across genres and translating business goals into channel strategy, audience approach, and measurable performance targets.   You will lead and develop a team of paid media specialists across search, social and programmatic disciplines, while also managing media partner relationships and multi-million dollar media budgets across channels.   This is a senior leadership role accountable for results across multiple campaigns, channels, and disciplines. Requiring solid people leadership, sound judgment on decisions that carry real business risk, and the ability to drive priorities and influence direction across the organization.   This is an on-site position, based at our New York City office.   

Responsibilities include but not limited to:

  • Develop and execute the paid media acquisition strategy across paid search, social (Meta, TikTok, Pinterest, Snapchat, Reddit) and programmatic/DSP channels (e.g., DV360, Yahoo DSP, Amazon DSP, Samsung DSP), aligning channel and audience approach to the business goals across all genres.

  • Partner cross-functionally with internal marketing teams and senior leadership on budget, reporting, and strategic decisions, and represent paid search, social and programmatic in broader team planning.

  • 12+ years of experience in paid media/digital performance marketing across paid search, social and programmatic channels, with 5+ years of people management experience leading teams.

Additional Qualifications:

  • Proven ability to develop strategic recommendations and drive priorities for multiple large paid media programs across paid search, social platforms (Meta, TikTok, Pinterest, Snapchat, Reddit) and programmatic DSPs (e.g., DV360, Yahoo DSP, TTD), with deep, hands-on channel expertise.
  • Hands-on experience planning, executing, and optimizing programmatic campaigns within at least one major DSP. Experience with audience and inventory targeting, bid strategy, and PMPs/private marketplace deals.

  • Sound judgment on decisions that carry business risk, and the ability to recommend resourcing and staffing to meet objectives.
  • Solid data and analytics fluency, including comfort with platform/DSP reporting, BI tools, and experimentation or measurement frameworks to turn performance data into decisions.

  • Experience with social ad management/ad-serving platforms (e.g., Sprinklr, Smartly, CM360) and/or programmatic DSPs beyond DV360, Yahoo DSP, Amazon DSP, and Samsung DSP (e.g., The Trade Desk, StackAdapt).

job.title: Senior FP&A Analyst, Streaming Finance
job.description:
Shape the Future of Streaming | Senior FP&A Analyst (Budapest)

 

At Paramount, we don’t just watch content—we define it. From blockbuster movies to world-class streaming, our global team brings iconic entertainment to millions.

We are expanding our Streaming Affiliate Finance FP&A team and looking for a Senior Analyst in Budapest to own financial planning and analysis for the EMEA & APAC regions. In this role, you will work directly alongside the Budapest-based Senior Director/Lead, serving as their key partner locally while collaborating with a high-performing international team across New York and London.

If you’re ready to turn complex financial data into strategic insights, drive regional business decisions, and thrive in an interconnected global business, we want to hear from you.

 

Where You Fit In & Team Structure

 

  • Local Partnership: You will be joining as the first analyst on the ground in Budapest, working directly with your Hiring Manager/Director. You'll have direct mentorship, clear visibility, and a strong local sounding board.

  • Global Scope (EMEA & APAC): You will take end-to-end financial ownership of the EMEA & APAC markets. You’ll align with teammates handling Canada & LATAM (based in New York) and specialized large-contract FP&A (based in London).

  • High-Level Impact: Together, the regional outputs are consolidated locally in Budapest before being presented directly to executive leadership in New York.

  • Budapest Office Life: While your day-to-day workflow is tied to the global Streaming Affiliate Finance team, you’ll be based in a vibrant, friendly Budapest office alongside sister finance and business teams. Expect regular team lunches, social events, joint team-building activities, and a welcoming community on-site!

 

What You’ll Do

 

  • Drive Regional FP&A (EMEA & APAC): Own financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and reporting for Paramount’s Streaming Affiliate operations across EMEA and APAC.

  • Master Financial Planning Cycle: Support the Long-Range Plan, Annual Operating Plan, quarterly forecasts, and monthly financial reviews.

  • Track & Optimize Performance: Manage revenue and cost models, variance analyses, and continuous performance tracking to identify risks and growth opportunities.

  • Partner with Global Stakeholders: Work closely with cross-functional teams in Europe, Asia, and the US to evaluate new commercial initiatives and support strategic decision-making.

  • Modernize & Automate: Drive continuous improvement, process standardization, and automation across financial reporting and workflows.

  • Deliver Executive Analytics: Prepare impactful ad hoc financial analyses, business cases, and presentations for global leadership.

 

What We’re Looking For

 

  • Experience: 4+ years of FP&A and/or Accounting experience, with a Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field.

  • Regional or Global Mindset: Comfort working with cross-border stakeholders and managing dynamic, multi-market financial data.

  • Analytical Precision: Strong problem-solving capabilities with a knack for translating complex data into clear strategic insights.

  • Fluent English Communication: Excellent verbal and written English skills to collaborate smoothly with teams in New York, London, and across the globe.

  • Technical Savvy: Advanced Excel skills. Hands-on experience with systems like SAP, Oracle, or Longview is a strong advantage.

  • Accounting Foundations: Solid understanding of US GAAP, IFRS, or equivalent accounting principles.

  • Self-Starter & Agility: Ability to work autonomously, prioritize effectively, and thrive in a fast-paced environment.

 

Why You’ll Love Working Here

 

| Health & Wellness | Private health insurance with private clinic access and annual screening packages, plus eyewear support. | | Financial Flexibility | Monthly cafeteria plan featuring SZÉP card options, nursery support, and home loan assistance. | | Office Perks | Fresh fruit delivered weekly, cross-team social events, and a dog-friendly office—so your four-legged best friend can come to work with you! | | Growth & Culture | Company-sponsored language courses (post-probation) and exclusive pre-premiere movie screenings before official releases. |

  • Contract Type: 1-year fixed-term contract (with strong potential for extension)

  • Location: Budapest, Hungary (Hybrid / Office-based)

 

Ready to take ownership of EMEA & APAC finance on a global stage? Apply today!

As a senior engineer, you’ll play a key role in setting technical direction, mentoring team members, and collaborating with backend, data, and design partners to deliver performant, intuitive, and impactful user experiences.


Key Responsibilities

Required Technical Skills

• API Integration: Experience consuming and integrating RESTful or GraphQL APIs into production applications.  
• Full-Stack: Advanced proficiency in Frontend and Backend- React, TypeScript/JavaScript, and CSS (including modern CSS frameworks or CSS-in-JS) and Java (Spring Framework), Python, or Node.js.
• Web Frameworks: Experience with Next.js or comparable modern frameworks for high-performance, production-grade applications.
• Testing: Familiarity with automated testing frameworks and CI/CD processes.

 

Preferred Knowledge and Experience

• Frontend and Backend Integration: Working knowledge of server-side technologies such as React, TypeScript/JavaScript Java (Spring Framework), Python, or Node.js.
• DevOps and Infrastructure: Understanding of CI/CD pipelines, Kubernetes, and containerization workflows.
• Data Systems: Familiarity with event-driven architectures, streaming systems (e.g., Kafka, Pub/Sub), and real-time data visualization principles.

Qualifications

•  Strong foundation in modern front-end and back-end engineering principles, UX best practices, and performance optimization.
•  Proven track record of delivering reliable, maintainable, and scalable solutions.
•  Deep working development experience in environments with real-time or event-driven data streaming platforms. 
•  Excellent problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.
•  Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and committed to continuous learning and technical excellence.

Overview and Responsibilities   The Senior Staff, Risk & Analytics, Internal Audit supports the delivery of data‑driven insights, risk‑based audits, and advisory work across the company. This role involves advanced analytics and operational audits. It also includes investigations, risk assessments, and special projects. These activities help the business operate successfully in a fast-changing media and entertainment environment. The Senior collaborates with the Internal Audit executive team, business stakeholders, and cross‑functional teams to evaluate processes, governance, and internal controls. The role requires comfort working with complex and imperfect data, applying sound judgment, and designing analytics that address real business questions. Engagements may include operational reviews, T&E audits, production audits, management‑requested reviews, and other advisory initiatives.     Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:    
  • Support planning and execution of risk‑based analytics for audits, advisory engagements, and special projects
  • Develop project objectives, scopes, and risk assessments focused on key business priorities
  • Design approaches for non‑routine or evolving activities requiring professional judgment
  • Evaluate process efficiency, controls, and governance; identify opportunities to reduce friction and improve accountability
  • Conduct end‑to‑end process walkthroughs and root‑cause analysis
  • Assess operational maturity and scalability in a high‑growth or transformational area
  • Perform advanced data analysis to support audit planning, testing, investigations, and continuous risk monitoring
  • Analyze large datasets (e.g., production costs, T&E spend, payroll, vendor payments, advertising revenue) to identify trends and emerging risks
  • Translate business risks into targeted, meaningful analytics
  • Use dashboards and visuals to share insights. Prepare presentations for audience members who are not technical

  • Present insights through PowerPoint, dashboards, and other visualization tools

  • Maintain self-reliance and objectivity while serving as a trusted advisor

  • Support continuous improvement of audit methodologies and analytics capabilities
  • Act as a thought partner on analytics tools, technologies, and industry trends
  • Informally mentor less‑experienced team members

 

Basic Qualifications  
  • 5+ years of experience in internal audit, external audit, risk management, data analytics, or a related field
  • Robust knowledge of operational risk, internal controls, audit methodologies, and risk management
  • Experience executing analytics‑driven operational reviews (e.g., T&E, production, vendor payments, revenue processes)
  • Demonstrated ability to examine large, complex, and unstructured datasets and derive meaningful insights
  • Proficiency with analytics and visualization tools (SQL, Python, Power BI, Tableau, Alteryx, ACL, or similar)
  • Expert‑level skills in MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word)
  • Solid organizational and project‑management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities
  • Clear, concise communication skills, both written and verbal
  • Strong analytical, problem‑solving, and critical‑thinking abilities
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, Data Analytics, Information Systems, or related field

 

Additional Qualifications  
  • Big Four or consulting experience preferred
  • Professional certifications such as CIA, CPA, CFE, CISA (active or in progress) preferred
  • Knowledge with ERM frameworks and regulatory compliance considerations
  • Ability to build trust, influence others, and work skillfully across teams and levels
  • Self‑starter with well-developed effort and the ability to learn quickly
  • Enlightened curiosity and excitement for solving complex, ambiguous problems
  • Solid interpersonal skills, including the ability to manage up, down, and across teams

job.title: Senior Machine Learning Operations Engineer
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 
Overview

 We're hiring a Senior Machine Learning Operations Engineer to own the operational layer around our personalization and recommendation Machine Learning (ML) systems. Our models retrain and deploy daily on automated pipelines. Your job is to make sure we can trust what's running, know when something is off, and fix it fast. You'll sit within DevOps and work closely with ML engineers, who own the models end-to-end. You won't be building infrastructure from scratch, you'll partner with DevOps and Platform Engineering to get the tooling you need, then own it day-to-day.

What You'll Do
  • Own model traceability: Every model in production should have clear lineage: what data trained it, what code produced it, what validation it passed, and how it's performing. Evaluate and recommend tooling for versioning, metadata, and model registry, and work with MLEs to drive adoption.
  • Build end-to-end monitoring: Monitor the full signal path: data arrival, feature distribution stability, model metrics, and serving latency against SLA. Own this individually, don't rely solely on upstream teams to catch their own issues.
  • Partner with Data Engineering on data quality: Collaborate to surface data quality issues, detect drift in upstream sources, and ensure features stay fresh and reliable.
  • Detect issues proactively: Track drift over weeks, flag slow degradation before it crosses a threshold, surface feature freshness problems before they cascade.
  • Build diagnostic tooling: When something goes wrong, get from "recommendations look off" to root cause in minutes. That means ensuring the right context is logged at each stage, candidates, features, serving context, and building the dashboards to tie it collectively.
  • Own incident response for ML systems: Maintain rollback playbooks and pre-defined hotfix strategies with quantified tradeoffs. Own automated gates that block bad deployments. Run post-mortems and close the gaps.
  • Coordinate on post-deployment metrics: Work with ML engineers, data engineers, and stakeholders to define what metrics to collect after deployment and why they matter.


Basic Qualifications
  • 5+ years in ML engineering, applied ML, or a related ML role, with demonstrated experience on the operational side of monitoring, reliability, deployment, or incident response
  • Has built or operated model registries, ML monitoring systems, or production ML pipelines
  • Understands ML systems end-to-end — not just the infra layer, but why a stale feature or a shifted distribution matters
  • Robust SQL skills and comfort digging into data distributions, feature health, and model behavior
  • Comfortable partnering with DevOps and Platform teams to define infrastructure needs without needing to own the infra yourself


Additional Qualifications

  • Experience operating recommendation or personalization systems at scale

Paramount+ features an expansive library of original series, hit shows and popular movies across every genre from world-renowned brands and production studios, including SHOWTIME®.

job.title: Senior Machine Learning Operations Engineer, Agentic Systems Platform Engineering
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

Overview
We are looking for a Senior MLOps Engineer (IC3) to join the Platform Engineering pod. Your mission is to build the Agentic Systems Platform—the runtime environment where autonomous agents live, reason, and collaborate. You will lead the development of the MCP (Model Context Protocol) Gateway, routing logic, and the orchestration support required for multi-agent personalization systems. In this role, you will bridge the gap between traditional ML serving and autonomous agency. You will lead the design of agentic runtimes using GKE and Apigee, utilizing the ADK (Agent Development Kit) and A2A (Agent-to-Agent) protocols to enable complex workflows. Your challenge is to manage the "thinking time" and cognitive overhead of agentic systems, ensuring they remain responsive and cost-effective in a production environment.

Why This Role Matters

  • Architecting Agency: You are building the foundation for our shift from passive models to active, reasoning agents.
  • Governance & Routing: Your work on the MCP Gateway ensures that agents can safely access the tools and context they need to perform their tasks.
  • Collaborative Intelligence: By mastering A2A orchestration, you enable a new class of multi-agent applications that solve problems individual models cannot.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead Platform Design: Architect the production runtime for agentic systems, focusing on low-latency tool-use and state management.
  • Own the MCP Gateway: Design and implement the routing and security layer for agentic tool-use via Apigee.
  • Standardize Agentic Workflows: Develop orchestration patterns using ADK and A2A that are adopted by pods across the AMLG.
  • Performance Management: Monitor and optimize agentic "thinking" cycles to balance reasoning depth with production latency constraints.
  • Mitigate System Risks: Proactively identify and fix failure modes unique to agentic systems (e.g., tool-use loops or context window overflows).

Minimum Qualifications

  • 4–8+ years in MLOps or Platform Engineering
  • Experience with API Gateways (Apigee) and K8s (GKE)
  • Background in Agentic Orchestration

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with A2A protocols
  • Experience managing long-running stateful workflows

This role leads the local TV Media Marketing department in The Netherlands. What will you be doing?

 

Responsibilities:

  • Be responsible for all marketing activities for the TV channels (Comedy Central, Paramount Network, MTV) in Benelux.

  • Lead the Marketing and Social Media department in Amsterdam (2 head counts).

  • Actively define and manage marketing campaigns and initiatives that drive TV and digital KPIs. Set up the strategy and implement measures in close cooperation with the programming department, ad sales, the media planning department, PR and the international marketing teams.

  • Lead and manage above-the-line, social media and influencer marketing campaigns.

  • Monitor performance and optimize digital activations based on insights and KPIs.

Overview and Responsibilities: 

 

The Senior Network Engineer role focuses on the implementation and support of reliable, scalable network solutions supporting media and corporate systems. This position is primarily hands-on and technical, working within the broader network architecture and engineering organization to deliver and maintain high-performance, mission‑critical network services. 

The role participates in network projects across the full lifecycle and collaborates closely with peer engineers, operations teams, and cross‑functional partners. 

 

Responsibilities Include: 

  •     Design, implement, and support scalable, highly available routing and switching solutions for media and corporate network environments. 
  •     Participate in the evaluation and testing of new networking technologies and platforms; provide technical input and recommendations. 
  •     Work with vendors and internal teams to troubleshoot issues and support hardware/software lifecycle activities. 
  •     Implement approved network changes following established change management processes, including maintenance windows and validation. 
  •     Serve as a technical resource for network operations teams, assisting with troubleshooting, incident resolution, and root cause analysis. 
  •     Create and maintain accurate network documentation, diagrams, and configuration standards. 
  •     Participate in peer design reviews and technical discussions, contributing feedback and best practices. 
  •     Collaborate with Level 2 and Level 3 teams to resolve complex routing, switching, firewall, and connectivity issues. 
  •     Assist with knowledge sharing and technical guidance for junior and mid‑level engineers during new deployments or upgrades. 
  •     Escalate issues as needed and work with senior engineers or architects on complex or high‑impact problems.

  •     Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent professional experience.

  •     Solid understanding of routing and switching protocols (e.g., BGP, OSPF, MPLS). 
  •     Working knowledge of IP multicast and QoS concepts. 
  •     Experience using network monitoring and management tools. 
  •     Experience supporting medium to large enterprise or corporate network environments.

  •     Demonstrated interest in learning new technologies and adapting to evolving network environments.

The Video Engineering team is in charge of supporting the video delivery and architecture of VOD and Live content streamed on Paramount+ and other Paramount brands. About Us:
