Overview: 

Vice President, Office of the CFO, Analytics and Special Projects is a newly created, high-visibility leadership role within the Paramount Finance organization, serving as a strategic partner and trusted advisor to the CFO. This role sits at the intersection of strategy, operations, and execution, ensuring the CFO’s organization runs with discipline, clarity, and focus and also leading high-priority finance special projects.   The successful candidate will combine strong financial acumen with exceptional organizational and interpersonal skills, equally comfortable leading a complex analytical workstream as running a leadership town hall. This person will act as a proxy and trusted extension of the CFO across the finance leadership team and key cross-functional partners, while also protecting the CFO’s time and ensuring the right priorities get the right attention.   This is designed to serve as a launch pad into a senior finance leadership role within the organization. The Vice President will gain direct exposure to enterprise-level strategy, financial operations, and executive decision-making, while building the relationships and credibility needed to step into a broader finance leadership position at the conclusion of the program.  

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

Strategic Leadership & Special Projects
  • Lead and manage high-priority finance special projects on behalf of the CFO, including strategic initiatives, cross-functional analyses, and transformation efforts.
  • Serve as a thought partner to the CFO on key business decisions, synthesizing complex information into clear, actionable recommendations.
  • Drive follow-through on strategic priorities across the finance leadership team, ensuring alignment and accountability against commitments.
  • Prepare board and executive-level briefing materials, presentations, and talking points for the CFO.
  • Support earnings, investor day, and board-related content development in partnership with Investor Relations and Corporate Finance.
Priority & Time Management
  • Serve as a gatekeeper and air-traffic controller for the CFO’s time, triaging incoming requests and ensuring the CFO’s bandwidth is focused on the highest-value priorities.
  • Exercise independent judgment on what does and does not require the CFO’s direct attention, resolving issues on his behalf where appropriate.
  • Anticipate needs and potential issues before they escalate, proactively coordinating with stakeholders to keep initiatives on track.
Organizational Leadership & Communications
  • Plan and execute finance organization town halls, all-hands meetings, and leadership offsites, including content development and logistics.
  • Own the CFO’s staff meeting cadence, setting agendas, leading follow-ups, and tracking action items to closure.
  • Serve as a central point of contact between the CFO’s office and the broader finance leadership team, as well as cross-functional partners.
  • Shape internal communications strategy for the finance organization, ensuring consistent and clear messaging.
  • Represent and speak on behalf of the CFO in select internal forums where his direct presence is not required.
Operating Rhythm & Team Effectiveness
  • Partner with the CFO’s direct reports to coordinate priorities, surface issues early, and remove roadblocks.
  • Manage the CFO’s key operating mechanisms (staff meetings, business reviews, planning cycles) and maintain a scorecard of strategic priorities.
  • Partner with the CFO and Human Resources on finance organization design, headcount planning, and leadership succession considerations.
  • Work closely with Human Resources to help build and maintain a healthy team culture within the finance leadership organization.
  • Coordinate the finance organization’s initial response to urgent or sensitive issues (e.g., control matters, audit findings) in partnership with the relevant functional leaders.
  • Build relationships with Chiefs of Staff across the C-suite to keep the CFO’s agenda aligned with company-wide priorities.
 

Basic Qualifications:

  • 10 -15 years of experience in finance, strategy, investment banking, management consulting, or a related field.
  • Strong foundation in financial analysis, corporate finance, or FP&A experience with financial planning processes preferred.
  • Prior chief of staff, strategy, or similar experience supporting a senior executive strongly preferred.
  • Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or equivalent advanced degree preferred.

 

Additional Qualifications:

  • Experience supporting board or investor-facing materials is a plus.
  • Strong technical fluency, including hands-on proficiency in SQL and familiarity with AI/automation tools and their application to finance workflows.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including experience preparing executive-level materials.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent priorities with strong attention to detail and follow-through.
  • High emotional intelligence and discretion; ability to build trust and exercise sound judgment across all levels of the organization.
  • Comfortable operating with significant autonomy and representing the CFO’s perspective in his absence.

Overview:

Owns compensation strategy and execution for the company's AI/ML, product, and technology organizations — the highest-stakes, most competitive talent pools in the business. Partners with engineering and product leadership, recruiting, and Total Rewards leadership to design pay structures that win and retain talent in an AI labor market where comp packages move fast and get very large, very publicly.  

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Compensation strategy for tech/AI orgs: Design base, bonus, and equity structures for ML research, applied AI, and core engineering/product roles, including specialized retention and sign-on packages for high-demand AI talent
  • Market intelligence: Track fast-moving AI comp benchmarks (base salary inflation, mega equity grants, competitor offer data) and translate that into internal guidance before the market moves again
  • Leveling & career frameworks: Refine and maintain job architecture and leveling guides for technical ladders (IC and management tracks) that hold up as roles evolve quickly
  • Executive & critical-talent comp: Structure offers and retention packages for senior technical leaders and other business-critical hires, including complex negotiations
  • Equity strategy: Partner with Legal/Finance on equity plan design, refresh grant strategy, and dilution management specific to tech talent pools
  • Cross-functional partnership: Act as the trusted comp advisor to engineering/product VPs and recruiting leaders — fast turnaround on offer construction, counter-offer strategy, and internal equity checks
  • Program governance: Ensure pay equity, compliance, and consistency across the technical org as it scales, while staying flexible enough to move at hiring speed

 

Basic Qualifications:

  • 12+ years in compensation, with meaningful time designing comp for AI/ML or high-growth technical orgs at a large or high-growth tech company
  • Direct experience with the current AI talent market — comfort with unconventional, large, or fast-negotiated packages
  • Strong quantitative/analytical background; fluent in comp modeling, market data tools (Radford, Aon, etc.), and equity mechanics

 

Additional Qualifications:

  • Track record advising senior technical and product leaders directly, not just running programs from a distance
  • Executive presence — able to say no to a VP or push back on a comp ask with data, not just process

Therefore, there is a premium on strategic thinking, direct and indirect team guidance, collaboration, and use of data to drive business growth with this key retail partner.

 

Responsibilities include but not limited to:

  • Customer strategy & business planning - lead the team and play an active role in creating the strategic framework for the multi-year and annual business plans for Amazon.
  • Leverage and help improve the Joint Business Planning process to improve customer relationships, and to achieve/exceed revenue goals.
  • Outline strategies and actions to grow revenue by supporting licensees in developing meaningful presence and experiences for Paramount's brands on Amazon, working across the buying, marketing, and retail media functions to maximize revenue opportunities.
  • Data curiosity - hands on and data driven approach to account team guidance, with curiosity serving as the central tenet.
  • Track performance to understand drivers and detractors, using this information to inform guidance, guide the team's direction and drive solid retailer dialogues.
  • Lead the account's digital shelf strategy. This involves managing detail page content, optimizing search and discovery, creating A+ content, and ensuring catalog health. You will collaborate with licensees and internal content teams to improve conversion and increase search visibility.
  • Promotional & retail media investment - this role manages funding for promotional and retail media. You will work with Amazon to find the best ways to use these funds. This includes Amazon Advertising, Amazon DSP, and other retail media placements. The focus will be on increasing sales and improving the return on ad spend.
  • Relationship management and elevation - develop and maintain close collaboration with the buying, planning, and marketing teams.
  • Specifically, the strategic partnership with senior management within Amazon is a key responsibility.
  • Licensee relationships - collaborate with the sales teams of major licensees to ensure a fully integrated collaboration with Amazon.
  • Team guidance - positively contribute to team dynamics within the different Senior Team guidance forums, area of responsibility, Retail organization in totality as well as cross functionally.
  • Lead your team and inspire them. Help your direct reports grow through long-term coaching. Contribute to the organization by collaborating with other teams. This includes teams focused on categories, marketing, and product development.
  • P&L responsibility - establishing and managing budgets and forecasts for Amazon, maintaining annual and quarterly revenue and expense detail.
  • Work within a matrixed team representing Amazon on cross-functional senior teams.
     

Basic Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in retail development or key accounts including working with Amazon or a similar large e-commerce retailer. Ideally, you will have experience in the entertainment or licensing area.
  • Significant knowledge of the unique environment of warehouse clubs.
  • Bachelors degree; MBA preferred.
  • Extensive experience with Amazon's platforms such as Vendor Central and Seller Central.
  • Knowledge of retail media offerings and omni-channel partners.
  • Experienced people leader with a successful track record of working with executive team guidance, both external and internal.
  • Deep knowledge and proven success in creating and executing multi-million dollar integrated retail plans that include a broad range of vehicles including merchandising, POS materials, PR, promotions and events.
  • Willingness to travel as needed.
     

Additional Qualifications

  • World class interpersonal skills including meeting facilitation/presentation, and solid verbal and writing skills.
  • Important strengths needed to succeed on a sales team: participation in guidance forums, negotiation skills, strategic thinking, analytical skills, decision-making, communication skills, teamwork and integrity.
  • Strong understanding of marketplace dynamics, fulfillment models, including FBA and digital merchandising.
  • Willingness to push boundaries, experiment, learn fast and execute.
  • Experience working in a global matrixed environment preferred, with solid cross-functional team guidance.
  • Solid planning, organizational and execution skills.

job.description:

We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

Overview: 

CBS News Streaming is seeking a New York-based WGA Line Producer to join our 24/7 news coverage team. This role is ideal for a collaborative, editorially driven producer who thrives in a fast-paced, live news environment. The successful candidate will have exemplary news judgment, well-developed organizational skills, and a passion for visual storytelling. They will play a key role in producing live coverage, making sound editorial decisions under deadline, and partnering with teams across the newsroom to deliver accurate, compelling content. This role is represented by the WGA East.  

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Work closely with the executive producer & supervising producer in a fast-paced, demanding environment, handling breaking news and news-of-day demands for a 24-hour digital news channel
  • Line produce editorial news content, shape show flow and stack elements in the rundown
  • Work from the control room to guide shows in and out of breaks and to navigate both live and recorded content, including helping to determine when it will run in future hours
  • Partner with assignment desk and booking team to request correspondents and live interview guests
  • Order informative graphics and utilize compelling video to create engaging news programs
  • Distribute assignments and direct a team of writers, associate producers and digital associates to build original content as well as edit and repurpose content from broadcast and other content partners
  • Write teases, headlines, opening package and readers for live programming, including story slugs and lower-third banners
  • Generate story ideas for future coverage
  • Assign and record swap content for automated software wheel
  • Monitor and take newsworthy live events to air in the control room
  • Communicate with anchors, correspondents and control room team ahead of and during live shows, exhibiting a calm and professional demeanor in high pressure situations
  • Serve as a mentor to junior writers
  • Coordinate with sales department to implement accurate ad loads in rundowns
  • May also perform the responsibilities of content producers, producers, and associates producers and digital associates, as needed

 

Basic Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience producing and writing copy for a national broadcast, cable or streaming network, or equivalent local TV news experience in a major market Command of AP style and broadcast writing with impeccable grammar and spelling
  • Ability to multi-task and handle multiple assignments for regular programming as well as rolling breaking news coverage
  • Superior news judgment & critical thinking skills
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent education in journalism or related field
  • Fluency using ENPS is a must
  • Deep knowledge of news standards, rights and clearances and fact-checking practices
  • Must pass comprehensive CBS News Digital writing test
  • Must be available to work all shifts — early morning, dayside, nights, weekends and holidays — sometimes on short notice or as coverage, scheduling and news events warrant, as this is a 24-hour news organization
  • This position is based in New York and requires working in-person at the CBS Broadcast Center
 

Additional Qualifications:

  • Well-developed communication skills and ability to train and advise associate producers, production assistants and junior staff in writing and editing broadcast copy
  • Deep knowledge of editorial production, including control room experience, with well-developed writing and copy-editing skills
  • Detail oriented with ability to work in dynamic environment, deal with intense deadlines and continually react to breaking news with factual programming and creative storytelling
  • Broad knowledge of top stories driving the news cycle, including political news, and a knack for identifying lesser-known angles that resonate with audiences

 


CBS News and Stations, brings together the power of CBS News, 28 owned television stations in 17 major U.S. markets, the CBS News Streaming Network, CBS News Streaming local platforms, local websites and cbsnews.com, under one umbrella. CBS News and Stations is home to the nation’s #1 news program 60 MINUTES, the CBS News Streaming Network, the first 24/7 digital streaming news network, the award-winning broadcasts CBS MORNINGS, CBS SATURDAY MORNING, the CBS EVENING NEWS, CBS SUNDAY MORNING, CBS WEEKEND EVENING NEWS, 48 HOURS and FACE THE NATION WITH MARGARET BRENNAN. CBS News and Stations provides news and information for the CBS Television Network,  CBSNews.com, CBS News Radio and podcasts, Paramount +, all digital platforms, and the CBS News Streaming Network, the premier 24/7 anchored streaming news service that is available free to everyone with access to the internet. The CBS News Streaming Network is the destination for breaking news, live events, original reporting and storytelling, and programs from CBS News and Stations’ top anchors and correspondents working locally, nationally and around the globe. job.title: Career-track Teaching Professor or Clinical Professor (Content Creation)
job.description:
Career-track Teaching Professor or Clinical Professor (Content Creation)

Description
The Walter Cronkite School of Journalism and Mass Communication at Arizona State University-one of the nation's premier professional mass communications programs-seeks a professor to teach and lead within the school's L.A. Content Studio and instruct courses related to media production and content creation.

Hosted in the ASU California Center in Downtown Los Angeles, the Content Studio is an immersive strategic content learning experience in which students activate their multimedia content creation skills to build their own content brands, and work with existing brands to expand their content footprints.

The L.A. Content Studio is one of the Cronkite School's signature professional immersive learning experiences, exemplifying its "teaching hospital" model of education through hands-on learning and faculty mentorship. In the Content Studio, students cultivate their media and audience development skills as independent content entrepreneurs, producing video, digital, social and immersive media content; measuring content performance; and optimizing content strategy. Students work to build (and often monetize) their own independent content brands through YouTube channels, TikTok accounts, Substack newsletters, brand partnerships and more. The program's faculty leader will nurture students' content creation skills, and develop their strategic approach, content measurement skills and audience development acumen.

The successful candidate is an experienced multimedia content creator of the highest caliber with an entrepreneurial spirit and a firm understanding of how to thrive in the creative economy. The candidate must be a creative problem solver who is comfortable in an energetic, dynamic, startup environment while demonstrating a commitment to innovation and collaboration.

As a member of the faculty, the professor will have teaching and service responsibilities within the Cronkite School. In this role, there are no research or creative activity responsibilities.

This is a full-time, benefits-eligible, 12-month appointment based in the ASU California Center in Downtown Los Angeles. It is not a tenure-track appointment. The salary range for this position is $110,000 to $120,000. The professor will hold the rank of assistant, associate or full teaching professor, or assistant, associate or full clinical professor. This is not a tenure-track position.

Essential Responsibilities



- • Teach lower-, upper- and graduate-division courses (four classes in the fall semester, and four in the spring semester)
- • Foster a culture of innovation by harnessing fresh ideas and experimenting with new tools, technologies and techniques that enhance strategic communication and client impact
- • Lead the L.A. Content Studio, an immersive incubator for video, digital and social content creators, and support undergraduate and graduate students in meeting the Content Studio course learning outcomes
- • Teach related courses for graduate and undergraduate learners (the equivalent of four courses each semester, including the Content Studio)
- • Guide students in goal-setting, content strategy and launch/growth for their own content brands, and ideate compelling content guided by those strategies
- • Supervise student content production from conception to completion, for content produced both in the field and in the ASU California Center's production studios, editing rooms and control room facilities.
- • Develop students' content measurement and analytics reporting capabilities, and lead optimization and monetization.
- • Develop and engage clients for the Content Studio across a variety of industries, and lead brand activation and strategy within the course.
- • Foster a learning culture that inspires students with relevant content, tools and techniques that enhance digital storytelling and audience connection.
- • Serve as a disciplinary thought leader, proactively staying abreast of new content creation and strategic communication techniques and technology updates; curating exemplars of superior research and professional work; and highlighting superb student work.
- • Collaborate with leadership, faculty and staff to assess, optimize and develop curriculum
- • Perform service both internally (e.g., committee assignments, student recruitment, thesis direction) and externally (e.g. professional workshops, contest judging, academic/industry leadership)
- • Perform other duties as assigned



About the ASU California Center

At ASU's flagship Los Angeles campus, students can access internships and learning

opportunities only available in a global city, and world-class faculty and innovative media projects only available at the Cronkite School. The California Center hosts the L.A. Content Studio, where students build their own content brands and produce content for existing brands; Cronkite News' L.A. Bureau, where journalism students create award-winning news and sports content; the MA in Narrative and Emerging Media, which develops storytellers specializing in AR, VR and emerging media techniques; and a growing portfolio of learning experiences.

The heart of ASU's California Center campus is the flagship Herald Examiner Building, located at 11th Street and Broadway. Commissioned by William Randolph Hearst and designed by architect Julia Morgan, the building has stood in downtown L.A. since 1914. For decades, the building housed the Hearst Corporation's Herald Examiner newspaper; now, it's home to the L.A. Content Studio, Cronkite News' L.A. Bureau, as well as video/audio editing bays, a broadcast studio, a 3D studio, classrooms, a two-story event space and more.

About the Cronkite School

The Cronkite School is widely recognized as the nation's premier mass communication school. Rooted in the time-honored values that characterize its namesake-accuracy, responsibility, integrity-the school fosters excellence and ethics among students as they master the professional skills required to succeed in the media world of today and tomorrow.

Based on ASU's Downtown Phoenix campus in the heart of the nation's fifth-largest city, the School is known for its hands-on "teaching hospital" approach to learning led by a faculty composed of Pulitzer Prize-winning professional journalists, strategic communication leaders and world-class media scholars. More than 2,500 undergraduate, master's and doctoral students regularly lead the country in national competitions as they prepare for careers in journalism, PR, marketing, strategic media and related communication fields.

About Arizona State University

Arizona State University, ranked the No. 1 "Most Innovative School" in the nation by U.S. News & World Report for 10 years in succession, has forged the model for a New American University. Repeatedly ranked No. 1, ASU has topped more than 20 lists in the last three years: No. 1 in the U.S. for global impact (Times Higher Education) and No. 1 in the U.S. for sustainable practices (Association for the Advancement of Sustainability in Higher Education). ASU is a comprehensive public research institution, measured not by whom it excludes, but by whom it includes and how they succeed; advancing research and discovery of public value; and assuming fundamental responsibility for the economic, social, cultural and overall health of the communities it serves. ASU operates on the principles that learning is a personal and original journey for each student; that they thrive on experience and that the process of discovery cannot be bound by traditional academic disciplines. Through innovation and a commitment to accessibility, ASU has drawn pioneering researchers to its faculty even as it expands opportunities for qualified students, attracting some of the highest-quality students from all 50 states and more than 130 nations.



Qualifications
Required Qualifications



- Candidates pursuing a clinical professor rank must have a master's degree at the time of appointment, and at least 7 years professional experience in strategic communication, or equivalent specialized experience.
- Candidates pursuing a teaching professor rank must have a terminal degree at the time of appointment, and at least 7 years professional/teaching experience in strategic communication, content creation or equivalent specialized experience.



Desired Qualifications

• Demonstrated experience creating strategic content and campaigns for a brand, organization or media outlet with measurable success

• Expertise in content strategy, including goal-setting, audience targeting, funnel strategy, audience measurement, engagement and current approaches

• Exceptional video, digital and social content creation skills in mobile and studio formats

• Experience using native analytics tools and reporting content performance

• Demonstrable video editing ability, including knowledge of Adobe Premiere or equivalent nonlinear software

• Demonstrated leadership and supervisory experience in a content-creating team or role

• Experience cultivating and managing client, brand and/or partner relationships

• Experience working with students in a university, agency or production setting and/or mentoring emerging content creators

• A network of content creators, strategic communication practitioners and related experts who can advise on the field



Application Instructions
Applicants will be asked to create or use an existing Interfolio Dossier to submit the following:

• A cover letter stating qualifications

• Curriculum vitae or resume

• Contact information (name, address, email, telephone number) for three professional references

Successful candidates will demonstrate throughout their materials how their teaching, research, and service will contribute to the fulfillment of the ASU Charter.

The applicant's name should appear in each uploaded file name. Cover letters may be addressed to the Search Committee Chair, senior associate dean Jessica Pucci. Questions about the position should be directed to the search committee chair at: mailto:jepucci@asu.edu

Application deadline is October 29, 2026. Applications will continue to be accepted on a rolling basis for a reserve pool. Applications in the reserve pool may then be reviewed in the order in which they were received until the position is filled



For more information and to apply, visit https://apply.interfolio.com/193795

job.title: Creative Content Producer
job.description:
ONSITE ON LOCATION - Clearwater, Florida

Office Hours: Monday-Friday, 9:00AM - 6:00PM

This is a full-time, in-office position. Remote or hybrid work is not available.


PLEASE INCLUDE A PORTFOLIO OR DEMO REELSHOWCASING YOUR PREVIOUS WORK WITH YOUR APPLICATION.


Valor Real Estate Development is a boutique luxury developer creating community-transforming real estate icons in emerging cities. Our portfolio is anchored by prestigious brand partnerships, including Aston Martin and Roche Bobois, with additional luxury collaborations planned as our company continues to grow. 


We are looking for a Creative Content Producer to join our team. If you're the type of creative who naturally shifts from filming with a gimbal, to editing in Premiere Pro, to designing in InDesign, to brainstorming the next social campaign, you'll fit right in. Industry professionals sometimes call this a "Preditor" meaning a producer, videographer, photographer, and editor wrapped into one versatile creative professional.


You'll work directly alongside our Deputy Marketing & Promotion Manager and collaborate with executive leadership on projects that define the public image of our company. From luxury property launches and exclusive events to cinematic marketing films and digital campaigns, your work will help shape how thousands of people experience the Valor brand.


If you're passionate about storytelling, obsessed with quality, embrace AI as a creative force multiplier, and want to build work you're genuinely proud to put your name on, we'd love to meet you.


Primary Responsibilities

As a Creative Content Producer, you'll help create the visual identity of Valor Real Estate Development across every stage of our marketing efforts. This is a production role requiring versatility, creativity, and a passion for producing work that reflects the quality of our luxury brand.


Video Production & Post-Production (Primary Focus)

  • Assist in planning, filming, and producing cinematic marketing videos, property walkthroughs, promotional campaigns, and event coverage.
  • Operate professional camera systems, gimbals, lighting, and audio equipment during productions.
  • Edit short and long-form video content using Adobe Premiere Pro, including color correction, audio mixing, motion graphics, and final delivery.
  • Collaborate with executive leadership on high-end marketing films and brand storytelling.
  • Organize, archive, and manage digital media libraries, project files, and production assets.
  • Export and optimize video content for social media, websites, presentations, digital advertising, and broadcast applications.
  • Continue developing the skills necessary to independently plan, film, and produce complete marketing projects from concept to final delivery.

Photography & Visual Content

  • Capture professional photography for luxury properties, events, construction milestones, executive profiles, and marketing campaigns.
  • Photograph interiors, architecture, amenities, lifestyle imagery, and brand experiences.
  • Perform professional image selection, retouching, and color correction.
  • Maintain organized photo libraries and digital asset management.
  • Assist with drone productions as ground crew or second camera operator. FAA Part 107 certification is highly desirable.

Social Media & Digital Content

  • Create engaging content for Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube, and emerging platforms.
  • Plan, schedule, and publish content while maintaining a consistent luxury brand voice.
  • Produce reels, stories, carousels, and other platform-specific content.
  • Repurpose photography and long-form video into engaging digital content.
  • Monitor engagement metrics and recommend improvements based on performance analytics.

Graphic Design & Brand Development

  • Design premium marketing collateral including brochures, presentations, invitations, signage, advertisements, sales materials, and digital assets.
  • Produce graphics for social media, email marketing, presentations, websites, and events.
  • Prepare artwork for professional print production and vendor delivery.
  • Ensure strict adherence to Valor's luxury brand standards and those of our strategic partners, including Aston Martin, Roche Bobois, and future collaborations.

Content Writing & Marketing Communications

  • Write compelling copy for websites, email campaigns, advertisements, brochures, presentations, and social media.
  • Assist with scripting marketing videos and planning production storyboards.
  • Utilize modern AI tools to enhance content development, creative workflows, and production efficiency.
  • Support long-form marketing initiatives that strengthen Valor's reputation and brand authority.

Digital Marketing Support

  • Update company websites with new content, imagery, property information, and campaign assets.
  • Build and maintain landing pages for new developments, events, and marketing campaigns.
  • Design and distribute email marketing campaigns while maintaining mailing lists and reporting.
  • Assist with basic HTML email template updates and digital asset optimization.

Events, Production & Vendor Coordination

  • Support luxury sales events, grand openings, project launches, media events, and promotional campaigns.
  • Capture creative content during live events while coordinating with vendors and production partners.
  • Assist with print vendors, promotional suppliers, signage, mailing campaigns, and production logistics.
  • Track purchase orders, vendor invoices, marketing budgets, and project timelines.
  • Coordinate with external agencies, freelancers, and creative vendors to ensure projects are delivered on schedule and to Valor's standards.


Technical Qualifications

Applicants should possess strong working knowledge of most of the following:

  • Adobe Premiere Pro
  • Adobe After Effects
  • Adobe Photoshop
  • Adobe Illustrator
  • Adobe InDesign
  • Professional photography and camera operation
  • Professional video production and post-production
  • Color grading and audio editing
  • Social media content production and management
  • Copywriting and brand storytelling
  • AI-powered creative tools such as ChatGPT, Midjourney, Runway, Claude, and similar platforms


What We’re Looking For

  • • 4+ years of experience in creative marketing, content production, multimedia production, or comparable role.
  • •A portfolio or demo reel demonstrating exceptional video production, photography, and creative design work.
  • Excellent visual judgment and meticulous attention to detail.
  • Passion for luxury brands, architecture, design, hospitality, or premium lifestyle marketing.
  • Strong understanding of current social media trends and digital storytelling.
  • The ability to manage multiple projects and meet demanding deadlines.
  • Comfortable receiving creative direction while also contributing original ideas and innovative solutions.
  • Enthusiastic about adopting emerging technologies, including AI powered creative workflows, to improve quality and efficiency.
  • Professional camera experience required.
  • FAA Part 107 Drone License preferred
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the U.S.
  • Occasional evenings and weekends required (for launches and events)
  • Ability to lift and transport camera equipment 25–40 lbs.


Compensation & Benefits

Salary ranges for this position vary by experience and role, typically starting from $60,000 and scaling based on qualifications up to $70,000. We proudly offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental, and vision insurance, as well as paid time off. Please note: Valor Real Estate Development is conducting this search internally and is not partnering with recruiting agencies, staffing firms, headhunters, or independent subcontractors for this position. Unsolicited candidate submissions, recruiting services, or sales solicitations will not be reviewed or considered. By submitting your resume, you acknowledge that your application is voluntary and does not constitute a binding agreement or obligation on behalf of either party.


Valor Real Estate Development provides equal employment opportunities to applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, pregnancy, genetic information, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other legally protected basis, including arrest and conviction records, in accordance with applicable law.

job.description:
Program Director


R0153633
University of Nevada, Reno - Main Campus

The University of Nevada, Reno (UNR) appreciates your interest in employment at our growing institution. We want your application process to go smoothly and quickly. Final applications must be submitted prior to the close of the recruitment.

If you need assistance or have questions regarding the application process, please contact our recruitment helpline at (775) 784-1495 or jobs@unr.edu.

Job Description

Reporting to the General Manager of KUNR/KNCJ Public Radio, the Program Director provides strategic and day-to-day leadership for the broadcast programming and on-air operations of KUNR Public Radio, KNCJ Nevada's Classical and Jazz, and KNCC Elko. This position plays a central role in shaping the station's sound, programming strategy, audience experience, and overall broadcast quality while ensuring that programming meets professional public media standards and FCC requirements. The Program Director leads, coaches, and develops KUNR's full-time and part-time on-air talent and works closely with newsroom and station leadership to strengthen local programming and storytelling across platforms. The position oversees programming systems, broadcast automation, program schedules, network content, and technical audio quality to ensure reliable and seamless service to listeners. The Program Director also serves as an on-air host and participates in fundraising, community events, and other activities that advance KUNR's mission and connection with its audience. This position is well suited for a public media professional who combines strong editorial and programming judgment with leadership, technical aptitude, journalistic integrity, creativity, and a passion for developing people and serving audiences.

The successful candidate will have the opportunity to:
• Shape KUNR's sound and programming strategy while balancing local storytelling with high-quality national public media content.
• Develop and mentor on-air talent, helping broadcasters grow professionally and strengthening the overall quality of the station.
• Champion local programming and help identify opportunities for new programs, podcasts, partnerships, and content distribution.
• Work across departments with newsroom, engineering, development, and station leadership to advance KUNR's mission.
• Engage with the community through events, partnerships, interviews, and public media initiatives.
• Help guide the station's future, using audience information, emerging technologies, and evolving public media practices to improve the listener experience.
• Be part of a university environment that connects public media, journalism, education, and service to the Northern Nevada community.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's Degree and four years of professional work experience; OR a Master's Degree and two years of professional work experience

Related experience: On-air broadcasting, news collection, reporting, radio programming, or a closely related media field.

Schedule



- Regular schedule will generally be Monday through Friday and will be determined in part by assigned on-air programming. Current anticipated schedules may include approximately 6:00 a.m.-2:00 p.m. or 10:00 a.m.-7:00 p.m.

- The position requires occasional evening and weekend work for station events, special programming, emergency news coverage, and other operational needs.

Administrative Faculty - C

About Us

The University of Nevada, Reno is a leading public research university committed to the promise of a future powered by knowledge. Founded in 1874 as Nevada's original land-grant university, the University serves more than 23,000 undergraduate and graduate students from all 50 states and 63 countries.

Classified by the Carnegie® Classification of Institutions of Higher Education as an R1 ("Very High Research") university, it is also recognized in the Carnegie® Community Engagement classification. The University is also ranked by U.S. News & World Report among the "Best National Universities" and "Best National Public Universities." It also ranks in the top tier of the WSJ/Times Higher Education World University Rankings and the New York Times' "Top Colleges for Economic Diversity."

Since 2009, nearly $1 billion has been has invested in advanced labs, facilities, and residence halls on the main campus. The University is home to Nevada's first medical school - the University of Nevada, Reno School of Medicine and the Wayne L. Prim Campus at Lake Tahoe, where education, research, and creative work thrive in a stunning mountain setting. The University delivers on its original land-grant mission with outreach across the state through the University of Nevada, Reno Extension, Nevada Agricultural Experiment Station, Nevada Bureau of Mines and Geology, Nevada Small Business Development Center, the Nevada Seismological Laboratory, and Wolf Pack Athletics.

The main campus is in Reno, Nevada, a burgeoning global technology hub with a vibrant midtown and downtown. Found where the high desert of the Great Basin meets the High Sierra and Lake Tahoe, the beautiful, 290-acre main campus is also a Nevada State Arboretum. The University's physical infrastructure is expanding with ongoing construction of the newly named John Tullock Business Building, set to open in fall 2025. Groundbreaking is also planned for a new State Public Health Laboratory Building on campus, alongside the recent acquisition of 16 parcels near campus, known as "University Village," to provide affordable housing for graduate students and early career faculty.

Collaborating with world-renowned organizations, the University fosters innovation through initiatives such as the Digital Wolf Pack partnership with Apple, which ensures equitable access to technology for students, providing new incoming freshman or transfer students with an iPad Air and accessories. Google's TechWise initiate is an 18-month program that fully supports undergraduate students in becoming entry-level software engineers by graduation.

In 2023, the U.S. Department of Commerce's Economic Development Administration (EDA) announced that Nevada - led by the University of Nevada, Reno - was named one of the inaugural 31 Regional Technology and Innovation Hubs (TechHubs). Nevada was selected from a competitive pool of 489 applicants from across the United States and its territories. Nevada's Tech Hub will strengthen America's lithium batteries, critical elements and other electric vehicle materials industry sectors within the state.

Through its commitment to high-impact education, world-improving research and creative activity, and outreach that's transforming Nevada's communities and businesses, the University continues its 150-year tradition of benefitting our state, nation and world.

The University recognizes that diversity promotes excellence in education and research. The inclusive and engaged community on campus recognizes the added value that students, faculty, and staff from different backgrounds bring to the educational experience.

Today, the University delivers on its original land-grant mission of access to education and knowledge by investing in the academics, facilities, support, engagement and vibrant campus life that promote our diverse students' cognitive growth and academic achievement - all while remaining one of the best values in American higher education.

job.title: Account Executive, KMVT - Twin Falls
job.description:
Are you a driven sales professional ready to help local businesses thrive? KMVT, the CBS affiliate serving Twin Falls, Idaho, is seeking an Account Executive who will partner with businesses to deliver powerful advertising solutions that drive real results. This is your opportunity to combine strategic thinking with creative problem-solving while building lasting relationships in a community that values hard work and authenticity.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Sell advertising solutions to local and regional businesses and advertising agencies.
  • Apply the Scripps Sales Process (SSP) to analyze current and prospective customer needs and apply customized advertising solutions that provide return on their investment.
  • In addition to television commercial airtime sales, facilitate the customer's ability to take advantage of the full array of digital marketing options available.
  • Independently prospect, secure appointments, perform needs analysis, develop customized solutions, present and close sales to develop and maintain new business from traditional and non-traditional advertisers.
  • Use ratings data, qualitative information and market trends to negotiate program ratings and advertising rates with advertising agencies in order to maximize revenue as well as develop custom solutions for new advertisers.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor with new and existing clients, provide best-in-class customer service, grow accounts, and gain additional business from referrals.
  • Perform client services, including but not limited to media avail negotiations, presentation preparation delivery and execution, copy writing, credit applications and collection of revenue due.
  • Effectively and proactively manage a sales funnel by way of Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems, monitoring and achieving key performance indicators and expected activity levels.
  • Contribute to the creative development of campaigns though client communication and needs analysis, storyboard and concept creation, and assistance in production aspects.
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships, which may include entertaining prospective and existing clients.
  • Perform routine administrative functions of a media salesperson including makegood resolution, continuous update of CRM system with activity, account information and pending revenue, and communication with sales leadership regarding the status of accounts.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.


WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • BS/BA in related discipline preferred or equivalent years of experience
  • Generally 2+ years of proven sales success preferred
  • Experience in strategic account management, broadcast ratings and digital execution preferred
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company required insurance limits.


WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Highly self-motivated and goal focused
  • Highly creative and innovative thinker
  • Strong influencing, selling and upselling skills
  • Effective teamwork and collaboration skills
  • Very strong analysis and data interpretation - able to translate needs and research data into sound marketing proposals
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills
  • Outstanding presentation abilities (in person/virtual, small/large groups, all levels)
  • Strong time management and organizational skills
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel and PowerPoint)
  • Working knowledge of Google Office (Sheets, Docs, Slides) and virtual conferencing platforms (E.g. Skype, WebEx, Zoom or MS Teams etc.)


WHAT WE'LL OFFER:

  • Uncapped sales commission
  • Monthly allowance for mileage and cell phone
  • Extensive Scripps Sales Process training
  • A career path to grow your professional experiences
  • Full medical, dental and vision benefits, as well as certain other health and wellness benefits
  • Retirement savings plan with company match
  • Other key company benefits include disability accident insurance, life insurance, ID protection, pet discount program, and employee assistance program. More details about timing and conditions of benefits eligibility and other plan terms and conditions will be provided upon hire.


WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK AND PLAY:

Twin Falls, Idaho offers an exceptional quality of life in the heart of the Magic Valley. This vibrant community of approximately 50,000 residents combines small-town charm with big-city amenities. The area is famous for the stunning Shoshone Falls, often called the "Niagara of the West," which plunges 212 feet into the Snake River Canyon—actually taller than Niagara Falls itself.

Outdoor enthusiasts will find endless recreation opportunities, from hiking and mountain biking along the canyon rim to world-class fly fishing, kayaking, and BASE jumping at the Perrine Bridge. The region's high desert climate delivers 300 days of sunshine annually, with four distinct seasons that include mild winters and warm, dry summers.

Twin Falls boasts a thriving local economy anchored by agriculture, food processing, and growing tech sectors. The downtown area features locally-owned restaurants, breweries, shops, and a vibrant farmers market. The College of Southern Idaho adds cultural and educational opportunities to the community. With affordable housing, excellent schools, and a strong sense of community, Twin Falls offers the perfect balance for professionals seeking both career growth and an outstanding lifestyle. Plus, you're just a few hours from Boise, Sun Valley, and some of the West's most spectacular national parks and wilderness areas.

job.title: Administrative Assistant, KIVI - Boise, ID
job.description:
Are you an organizational powerhouse who thrives on keeping things running smoothly behind the scenes? KIVI is looking for a highly experienced, detail-driven administrative professional to provide advanced, confidential support to our general manager or department head. This is a role where your expertise, discretion, and proactive mindset will directly shape the effectiveness of station leadership — and make a real impact on how we operate every single day. If you bring broad administrative knowledge, a collaborative spirit, and the ability to juggle competing priorities without missing a beat, we want to hear from you.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Prepare advanced business presentation documents and spreadsheets.
  • Assist in special projects, perform research and maintain records.
  • Compose correspondence, based on the general knowledge of the manager's view, about administrative matters and general office policies for manager's approval.
  • Prepare recurring reports independently for signature.
  • Answer the phone, provide information and receive information concerning matters related to the department.
  • Schedule and maintain calendar of appointments, meetings and travel itineraries, coordinate related arrangements, and arrange for meeting rooms.
  • Anticipate and prepare materials needed by the manager for conferences, correspondence, appointments, meetings, telephone calls, etc.
  • Prepare and distribute minutes from meetings.
  • Establish and maintain a variety of files and records.
  • May be required to take and transcribe dictation.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • Associates degree in related discipline or equivalent years of experience preferred
  • Specialized training/certification may be required
  • Generally, 5+ years of experience in related area of responsibility

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Three to five years related experience and/or equivalent combination of experience and training in the professional discipline of the department.
  • Proficiency with various software programs including Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint for Windows.
  • Above average knowledge of general office practice and business etiquette.
  • Ability to balance multiple priorities and to work under tight deadlines while providing consistent and professional service.
  • Ability to perform secretarial and clerical duties with speed and accuracy without immediate and constant supervision.
  • Good knowledge of business correspondence composition.
  • Accurate and efficient typing skills.
  • Possess above average interpersonal and communication skills and the ability to maintain good working relationships with all co-workers.
  • Possess above average organizational skills including attention to detail and follow through.
  • Maintain complete confidentiality, possess a professional demeanor, and exercise discretion at all times.
  • Be able to work overtime as needed, often with little notice.
  • Must be able to lift up to 50 pounds.

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY: Boise is one of the West's most livable and fastest-growing cities, offering a rare combination of big-city amenities and easy access to the great outdoors. The Boise River Greenbelt winds through the heart of the city, giving residents a scenic corridor for biking, running, and walking year-round. Bogus Basin Mountain Recreation Area sits just 16 miles from downtown, delivering skiing and snowboarding in the winter and hiking and mountain biking in the summer. Whether you're into river rafting, fly fishing, or simply exploring the trails of the Boise Foothills, adventure is never far from your front door.

Downtown Boise is a thriving hub of culture, cuisine, and community. The famous Basque Block celebrates the city's unique Basque heritage with authentic restaurants, a cultural center, and lively festivals. The local food and craft beverage scene is booming, with award-winning restaurants, farm-to-table eateries, and a growing number of craft breweries and cideries. The annual Treefort Music Festival draws music fans from across the country, and the Boise Contemporary Theater, Treefort, and the Boise Philharmonic give the city a rich arts presence.

Boise is also a proud college sports town, home to Boise State University and the iconic blue turf of Albertsons Stadium. The city consistently earns recognition for its quality of life, safety, and economic opportunity, attracting professionals from across the country who want the energy of a growing metro without sacrificing affordability or a sense of community. It's a place where people put down roots — and love every minute of it.

job.title: Executive Reporter, KMGH
job.description:
KMGH, The E.W. Scripps Company ABC affiliate in Denver, Colorado, is seeking an Executive Reporter who will lead our mission to enhance storytelling and inspire the next generation of journalists. This role offers a unique opportunity to shape the narrative of our community while mentoring talented reporters and MMJs to reach their full potential.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Lead, develop, and enhance the storytelling skill and abilities of all reporters and MMJs in the station.
  • Collaborate with other newsroom leaders to consistently execute the content strategy through authentic, meaningful storytelling.
  • Oversee the writing of stories for all platforms; provide timely feedback to foster continuous improvement.
  • Develop and supervise effective workflow strategies and procedures for multiple news programs and outlets.
  • Ensure that all content adheres to journalistic standards and ethical guidelines.
  • Deliver a vision and create trust among reporters, photographers and newsroom staff.
  • May provide on-air, multi-platform coverage for breaking news as needed.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • BS/BA in related discipline preferred, or equivalent years of experience
  • Generally, 7+ years of experience in a related field preferred

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Demonstrated expertise in storytelling
  • Knowledge and demonstration of editorial judgment, journalistic ethics, and libel laws
  • Curiosity for the community, city, state, and world we report on daily
  • Deep understanding of content strategy
  • Ability to work a variety of shifts including nights, weekends, early mornings, and holidays

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK AND PLAY:

Denver, Colorado, combines big-market journalism opportunities with an unmatched outdoor lifestyle. As the Mile High City, Denver is one of the fastest-growing and most dynamic metropolitan areas in the country, offering journalists the chance to cover everything from rapid economic growth and innovation to government, transportation, education, public safety, and environmental issues that shape the future of the American West.


Situated at the foot of the Rocky Mountains, Denver provides year-round access to world-class skiing, hiking, mountain biking, camping, and countless outdoor adventures. The city features a thriving arts and culture scene, professional sports teams including the Broncos, Nuggets, Rockies, Avalanche, and Rapids, award-winning restaurants, and vibrant neighborhoods filled with unique stories and diverse perspectives.


KMGH is a trusted news leader serving one of the nation's most competitive and exciting media markets. With breathtaking scenery, an exceptional quality of life, and a community that values strong local journalism, Denver offers a remarkable place to build a meaningful career while making a lasting impact through storytelling.

job.title: Local Sales Manager, KKTV
job.description:
At KKTV, we are dedicated to helping local businesses connect with the communities they serve through innovative, results-driven advertising solutions. As Local Sales Manager, you'll lead a talented team of Account Executives while developing strategies that help clients grow using the power of broadcast television, digital marketing, OTT streaming, social media, search marketing, and targeted advertising solutions. Your leadership will directly influence revenue growth, talent development, and the success of local businesses throughout Southern Colorado. This is an exciting opportunity to mentor a high-performing sales team, build meaningful client relationships, and make a lasting impact in one of the nation's most dynamic media markets.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of local Account Executives to achieve revenue and performance goals.
  • Collaborate with the Director of Sales and cross-functional departments to execute station objectives and maximize business growth.
  • Drive new business development across all station platforms, including broadcast, OTT, digital, mobile, social, and search solutions.
  • Utilize and champion the Scripps Sales Process (SSP), providing coaching and field support to sales team members.
  • Develop and execute strategic sales plans that help clients achieve marketing objectives while maximizing station revenue.
  • Negotiate rates, ratings, and advertising budgets to deliver value for clients and the station.
  • Create innovative packaging and pricing strategies that meet client needs and optimize inventory utilization.
  • Monitor market trends, competitive activity, and emerging advertising solutions to position KKTV as the preferred media partner.
  • Partner with traffic and operations teams to ensure efficient management of airtime inventory and campaign execution.
  • Forecast revenue accurately, manage departmental expenses, oversee accounts receivable processes, and ensure financial goals are achieved.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related field preferred; equivalent professional experience will be considered.
  • Seven or more years of proven success in media sales, advertising sales, or related revenue-generating roles required.
  • Experience managing strategic agency and direct accounts with a strong understanding of broadcast inventory, digital advertising, and video solutions required.
  • Valid driver's license, a satisfactory driving record, and proof of insurance meeting company requirements.
  • Ability to travel within the market as needed to support clients, business development, and team initiatives.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Strong leadership, coaching, mentoring, and team development skills.
  • Ability to inspire, motivate, and influence individuals toward achieving shared goals.
  • Excellent sales, negotiation, and business development capabilities.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and translate insights into effective marketing solutions.
  • Proven ability to develop creative, client-focused advertising strategies across multiple platforms.
  • Outstanding verbal, written, and presentation skills with the confidence to engage audiences of all sizes.
  • Exceptional collaboration and relationship-building abilities across departments and with external partners.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
  • Working knowledge of Google Workspace applications and virtual collaboration platforms such as Zoom, WebEx, Skype, and Microsoft Teams.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment while maintaining attention to detail and delivering high-quality results.

OUR TEAM:

At KKTV, you'll join a collaborative and passionate team dedicated to serving businesses and audiences throughout Southern Colorado. We value innovation, accountability, teamwork, and professional growth, and we encourage every team member to bring their unique perspectives and ideas to the table. Our sales organization combines local market expertise with industry-leading advertising solutions, creating an environment where people can learn, grow, and achieve meaningful success together.


WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:

Nestled at the base of Pikes Peak, Colorado Springs offers an exceptional quality of life with breathtaking mountain views, more than 300 days of sunshine annually, and endless opportunities for outdoor adventure. Whether you enjoy hiking, biking, skiing, trail running, or simply exploring the region's natural beauty, you'll find no shortage of ways to stay active and connected to the outdoors.

Colorado Springs also features a thriving business community, vibrant dining and arts scene, family-friendly neighborhoods, and easy access to Denver and the Rocky Mountains. It's a place where professional opportunity and personal adventure come together, making it an outstanding place to build your career and enjoy your lifestyle.

job.title: Master Control Hub Operator
job.description:
Are you ready to be at the heart of television broadcasting? The Scripps Master Control Hub in Indianapolis is seeking a skilled Master Control Hub Operator to manage and monitor multiple programming sources while providing critical master control support. In this essential role, you'll be the technical expert ensuring seamless programming delivery across our television stations, making split-second decisions that keep our content flowing flawlessly to viewers across the region.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Monitor several programming sources simultaneously, manage and switch sources for local television station programming, remotely from the Hub.

  • Monitor various levels and signals from multiple television sites.

  • Manage several live program logs and ensure accuracy.

  • Ensure the correct spots are aired during programming and note any discrepancies.

  • Solve problems and make judgment calls with business implications in mind regarding programming changes, commercials, special reports, and technical difficulties; this includes evaluating clock/timing to consider options with regard to programming as well as deciding when to escalate issues.

  • Make decisions and consult with internal customers regarding local transmitter parameters and operation.

  • Routinely collaborate with media prep technicians and traffic personnel to manage daily operations. Collaborate with other local news personnel as needed during breaking news situations.

  • Interact both verbally and in writing with internal Hub client stations in a manner that ensures all of our internal customers have a consistent experience. This includes sending alerts, responses to inquiries, collaboration on problem-solving, documentation, and/or resolution of issues.

  • Work with networks and live program providers, where required, to problem-solve issues.

  • Maintain current knowledge of and preparedness to execute disaster recovery procedures.

  • Perform quality assurance checks as required.

  • May require working overtime, holidays, and weekends with short notice when necessary.

  • Other duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • Associate's degree in a related discipline or equivalent years of experience preferred

  • Generally, 5+ years of experience in a related field is preferred

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Ability to problem solve and quickly take corrective action as necessary

  • High sense of responsibility and urgency regarding corrective action and customer service

  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision

  • Composure: Demonstrated ability to multitask in a fast, deadline-driven environment, and maintain calmness and accuracy of work

  • Strong organization skills

  • Highly detail-oriented

  • Quick mathematical skills, especially concerning timekeeping

  • Working knowledge of video servers, routing processes, and related equipment

  • Working knowledge of transmitter parameters and operations

  • Good communication skills, both verbal and written

  • Working knowledge of all functions and responsibilities of television master control

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:
 

Indianapolis is a thriving Midwestern city that offers the perfect blend of urban amenities and hometown hospitality. Known as the "Crossroads of America," Indianapolis boasts a revitalized downtown featuring world-class museums like the Indianapolis Museum of Art at Newfields, the iconic Indianapolis Motor Speedway, and a vibrant Mass Ave cultural district filled with theaters, galleries, and locally-owned restaurants. The city's Canal Walk provides a scenic escape in the heart of downtown, while neighborhoods like Broad

Ripple and Fountain Square offer eclectic shopping, live music venues, and craft breweries.

Sports enthusiasts will love cheering on the Colts at Lucas Oil Stadium and the Pacers at Gainbridge Fieldhouse, while the city's extensive greenway system and Eagle Creek Park offer abundant outdoor recreation opportunities. Indianapolis combines big-city career opportunities with an affordable cost of living, no traffic nightmares, and genuine Hoosier hospitality. With a growing tech sector, excellent healthcare systems, and a thriving food scene that goes far beyond racing day traditions, Indianapolis offers an exceptional quality of life where you can truly make an impact in your community.

job.title: Meteorologist, KGUN
job.description:
At KGUN 9, we know weather is more than a forecast. It helps our viewers plan their days, stay safe during severe conditions, and stay connected to the community they call home. As our Morning Meteorologist, you'll be a trusted voice delivering accurate, engaging, and impactful weather coverage across multiple platforms. You'll analyze data from advanced weather technology, provide critical updates when conditions change, and help viewers understand the stories behind the forecast. This is an exciting opportunity to join a collaborative newsroom committed to serving Southern Arizona with urgency, accuracy, and innovation.



WHAT YOU'LL DO:


  • Analyze weather data from radar, satellite, and other forecasting tools to create accurate forecasts and weather stories.
  • Prepare and deliver compelling daily weathercasts for morning newscasts.
  • Provide urgent weather updates and breaking weather coverage when severe conditions impact the community.
  • Create and present weather content across television, digital, radio, and social media platforms.
  • Evaluate weather developments and identify story opportunities that impact local audiences.
  • Report live from the field, community events, and weather-related locations as needed.
  • Produce weather graphics and visual presentations using modern weather technology and newsroom systems.
  • Write and produce weather and news content for multiple platforms under daily deadlines.
  • Collaborate with photographers, producers, reporters, and newsroom leadership to deliver comprehensive coverage.
  • Research, gather, and verify information through interviews, observation, and data analysis to create informative weather storytelling.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:


  • Bachelor's degree in Meteorology preferred.
  • Generally 3+ years of meteorology, weather broadcasting, or related experience preferred.
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance meeting company-required limits are required for this driving role.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:


  • Strong understanding of meteorology, forecasting principles, and weather presentation techniques.
  • Proficiency with weather systems, newsroom technology, and computer-based forecasting tools.
  • Knowledge of broadcast-quality camera equipment and field reporting workflows.
  • Experience with video editing systems and digital content production.
  • Strong broadcast writing skills and knowledge of AP Style.
  • Ability to create and publish engaging content across websites, social media, and digital platforms.
  • Excellent communication and on-air presentation skills.
  • Strong news judgment and storytelling ability.
  • Self-motivation and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and breaking-weather situations simultaneously.

OUR TEAM:


At KGUN 9, you'll join a passionate team of journalists, storytellers, and weather professionals who are dedicated to serving Southern Arizona. We value collaboration, curiosity, creativity, and community connection. Our newsroom brings together people with diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, creating an environment where great ideas thrive and meaningful local journalism makes a difference every day.


WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:


Tucson offers a unique blend of desert beauty, vibrant culture, and outdoor adventure. Surrounded by stunning mountain ranges and blessed with more than 300 days of sunshine each year, the region provides endless opportunities for hiking, cycling, golf, and exploring the outdoors.


You'll also enjoy Tucson's rich culinary scene, thriving arts community, historic neighborhoods, and welcoming atmosphere. From breathtaking sunsets in the Sonoran Desert to world-class festivals and cultural attractions, Tucson is a place where both career and lifestyle can flourish.

job.title: Meteorologist, KIVI
job.description:
KIVI, The E.W. Scripps Company ABC affiliate in Boise, Idaho, is seeking a Meteorologist who will deliver accurate, engaging weather forecasts that matter to our community. As the trusted voice that keeps the Treasure Valley informed and safe, you'll be at the forefront of weather coverage in one of the most dynamic and growing markets in the Mountain West.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Prepare and deliver daily weathercasts utilizing all available weather data and graphics computers.

  • Prepare and deliver urgent weather updates interrupting regular programming as necessary.

  • Prepare and deliver all weathercast materials over a variety of mediums, including, but not limited to: TV, radio, streaming, and digital platforms.

  • Assist management in evaluations of potential new weather data gathering and presentation computers.

  • Receive assignments or evaluate news leads and news tips to develop story ideas.

  • Report live from event sites or mobile broadcast unit.

  • May write and produce quality news and weather stories for multiple media platforms.

  • May report, write, capture visual content, edit, and produce stories for multiple platforms on deadline, such as Internet and digital channels.

  • Work cooperatively with photographer assigned to story, if one is assigned.

  • Gather and verify factual information regarding stories through interview, observation, and research.

  • Perform other duties as needed and assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • Bachelor's degree in meteorology preferred or equivalent years of experience

  • Generally 5+ years of experience preferred

  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company required insurance limits

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Computer literacy required, including weather and newsroom computer systems

  • Knowledge of broadcast quality camera equipment

  • Knowledge of editing systems

  • Strong broadcast and AP style writing skills

  • Proficient at posting content to various websites

  • Self-motivated and able to work in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK AND PLAY:

Boise, Idaho offers an unbeatable quality of life where outdoor adventure meets urban sophistication. As one of the fastest-growing cities in America, Boise combines small-town charm with big-city amenities. The city sits at the base of the stunning Boise Foothills, offering immediate access to world-class hiking, mountain biking, and skiing at Bogus Basin—just 16 miles from downtown. The Boise River Greenbelt winds through the heart of the city, providing 25 miles of scenic pathways perfect for running, cycling, or leisurely strolls.

Downtown Boise boasts a thriving food and craft beer scene, vibrant arts and culture including the Boise Philharmonic and Idaho Shakespeare Festival, and professional sports with the Boise State Broncos. The city enjoys four distinct seasons with over 200 days of sunshine annually, making it perfect for year-round outdoor recreation. With a growing tech sector, affordable cost of living compared to other Western cities, and a welcoming community atmosphere, Boise truly offers the best of both worlds—urban energy and natural beauty at your doorstep.

job.title: Multimedia Journalist, KRTV
job.description:
At KRTV, we tell the stories that matter most to the communities we serve. As a Multimedia Journalist, you'll research, report, shoot, write, edit, and deliver compelling local news content across multiple platforms. You'll be at the center of breaking news, community events, and impactful storytelling, helping viewers stay informed and connected.


This role offers the opportunity to build strong relationships throughout the Great Falls community while developing engaging content for broadcast, digital, and social audiences. If you're a passionate storyteller who thrives in a fast-paced newsroom, we'd love to hear from you.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:


  • Research, develop, and pitch story ideas from news leads, tips, and community sources.
  • Gather and verify information through interviews, observation, and independent research.
  • Write clear, accurate, and engaging stories that meet broadcast and digital editorial standards.
  • Capture high-quality video and still photography to support storytelling efforts.
  • Edit video content for television broadcasts, websites, social media channels, and other multimedia platforms.
  • Deliver live reports from the scene of breaking news, community events, and special coverage.
  • Appear on-air for interviews, narrations, and news presentations.
  • Collaborate with photographers, producers, and newsroom colleagues to create compelling content.
  • Assist producers with newscast preparation and content development.
  • Partner with digital teams to publish and promote stories across multiple platforms.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:


  • Bachelor's degree in Journalism, Communications, or a related field preferred, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Three or more years of journalism, reporting, multimedia, or related experience preferred.
  • Valid driver's license, strong driving record, and the ability to provide proof of insurance that meets company requirements.
  • Ability to travel locally for assignments and drive company or personal vehicles as needed.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:


  • Strong broadcast writing skills with knowledge of AP Style.
  • Experience with videography and non-linear editing systems preferred.
  • Working knowledge of broadcast-quality camera equipment.
  • Experience editing video using Final Cut Pro or similar editing platforms.
  • Proficiency with newsroom computer systems and digital publishing tools.
  • Ability to post and manage content across websites and digital platforms.
  • Strong organizational, communication, and storytelling skills.
  • A self-starter mindset with the ability to work independently and collaboratively.
  • Comfort working in a fast-paced, deadline-driven news environment.
  • Ability to lift up to 50 pounds.

OUR TEAM:


At KRTV, you'll join a passionate team of journalists, storytellers, content creators, and community advocates dedicated to delivering trusted local news. We value collaboration, curiosity, innovation, and integrity. Our newsroom brings together people with diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives who share a commitment to serving viewers and making a meaningful impact across north-central Montana.


WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:


Great Falls offers an exceptional quality of life with easy access to some of the most breathtaking landscapes in the American West. Situated along the Missouri River and surrounded by Montana's natural beauty, the area provides endless opportunities for outdoor recreation, including hiking, fishing, camping, skiing, and wildlife exploration.


Whether you're enjoying local restaurants, exploring nearby state parks, visiting cultural attractions, or taking in panoramic mountain views, Great Falls combines small-town friendliness with big outdoor adventure. It's an ideal place for journalists who enjoy connecting with their communities while experiencing all that Montana has to offer.
