job.title: Multimedia Journalist, KTNV
job.description:
KTNV, the ABC affiliate in Las Vegas, NV, owned by The E.W. Scripps Company, is looking for a creative and driven Multimedia Journalist.


The Multimedia Journalist is responsible for researching, writing, capturing visual content, and editing stories for multiple platforms. You would be joining a strong team of talented journalists with exceptional leadership. This position is ideal for an MMJ with some experience who wants to grow and excel in a dynamic, competitive market. Bring your dedication to solid journalism and your motivation to uncover stories that matter to our community and make viewers want to watch.


Las Vegas is one of the most exciting and fast-growing cities in the country, known for its world-class entertainment, thriving sports scene, diverse communities, and vibrant economy. From major events and tourism to significant local stories that impact Southern Nevada residents every day, Las Vegas offers journalists a unique opportunity to cover meaningful and memorable news. Join a team that's making a difference.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Receive assignments or evaluate news leads and news tips to develop story ideas.
  • Gather and verify factual information regarding stories through interviews, observation, and research.
  • Organize material, determine slant or emphasis, and write stories according to prescribed editorial style and format standards.
  • Shoot video and still photos to illustrate stories.
  • Edit, or assist in editing, videos for all multimedia platforms.
  • Appear on TV in live and pre-recorded stories.
  • Work cooperatively with the photographer assigned to the story, if one is assigned.
  • Assist news producers in preparing newscasts.
  • Assist digital staff in preparing multimedia stories and online content.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • BS/BA in a related discipline or equivalent years of experience preferred.
  • Generally, 3+ years of experience in a related field preferred.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Computer literacy required, including newsroom computer systems.
  • Videography and non-linear editing experience preferred.
  • Knowledge of broadcast-quality camera equipment.
  • Edit video on Final Cut Pro editing systems, or similar equipment.
  • Strong broadcast and AP style writing skills.
  • Proficient at posting content to various digital and social media platforms.
  • Self-motivated and able to work in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
  • Must be able to lift up to 50 pounds.
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company's required insurance limits.

job.title: Producer, KIVI (Part Time)
job.description:
KIVI, The E.W. Scripps Company ABC affiliate in Boise, ID, is seeking a creative, motivated Part Time Producer who will craft engaging stories that connect with our community. This position offers a unique opportunity to produce content for multiple platforms and make a real impact in one of the fastest-growing markets in the nation.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:


  • Develop and organize newscasts or local programs.
  • Write story development and showcasing.
  • Collaborate with reporters, anchors, news managers and assignment editors to determine content needs.
  • Enhance content with graphics, video, research, and station branding.
  • Execute time sensitive decisions.
  • Oversee live broadcast and up to the minute editorial decisions.
  • Perform desktop editing.
  • Post content to station's websites.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:


  • BS/BA in related discipline preferred or equivalent years of experience
  • Generally, 2+ years of experience in related field preferred

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:


  • Avid local news consumer: knows daily news, events, trends and happenings on a local level
  • Strong vision and ability to advance stories
  • Excellent interpersonal communicator
  • Extraordinarily passionate about writing; courageous and creative storyteller with attention to even tiny details - choosing the perfect words, grammar, spelling
  • Highly organized
  • Highly adaptable - fast paced, deadline driven environment
  • Strong self-motivation
  • Working knowledge of journalistic ethics and libel laws and strong editorial judgement
  • Able to use web analytics
  • Proficient with newsroom computer systems, MS Office a plus
  • Flexible work hours may be required, including holidays, weekends and evenings

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK AND PLAY:

Boise, Idaho offers an unbeatable quality of life in one of America's most dynamic and fastest-growing cities. Nestled in the Treasure Valley along the Boise River and backed by the stunning Boise Foothills, this vibrant capital city perfectly balances urban sophistication with outdoor adventure. Downtown Boise features a thriving food and craft brewery scene, local boutiques, and a walkable city center, while the famous Boise Greenbelt provides 25 miles of scenic pathways for biking, running, and recreation.


Outdoor enthusiasts will find endless opportunities year-round, from world-class skiing at Bogus Basin just 16 miles from downtown to hiking, mountain biking, and rock climbing in the nearby foothills. The Boise River offers excellent fishing, rafting, and kayaking, while multiple nearby reservoirs provide boating and water sports. With over 300 days of sunshine annually, mild seasons, and easy access to wilderness areas, Boise delivers the perfect blend of city amenities and natural beauty.


The city's growing economy, strong sense of community, affordable cost of living compared to other Western cities, and family-friendly atmosphere have made Boise one of the most desirable places to live in the United States. Whether you're catching a Boise State Broncos game, exploring the vibrant arts district, or hitting the trails after work, Boise offers an exceptional lifestyle that's hard to match.

job.title: Sales Planner
job.description:
Are you a strategic thinker who thrives at the intersection of media, sales, and storytelling through numbers? Scripps is looking for a Sales Planner to play a critical role in driving linear revenue by crafting compelling proposals, managing campaign performance, and building powerful partnerships with agencies and sales teams alike. In this role, you'll be at the heart of the action — balancing advertiser goals with inventory strategy to deliver results that move the business forward.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:


  • Build linear media proposals aligned with pricing guidance, planning strategies, and inventory availability.
  • Partner with internal pricing teams and buying agencies to support negotiations for upfront and scatter buys.
  • Identify opportunities to maximize revenue across linear platforms by adapting plans to market and inventory conditions.
  • Monitor campaign performance against deal guarantees and proactively coordinate schedule adjustments to address under or over delivery.
  • Coordinate execution of on-air linear marketing campaigns from initial pitch through final activation.
  • Support P&I and revenue sales management on ad hoc analyses and projects.
  • Work closely with the Commercial Operations team to meet log deadlines and ensure accurate, timely delivery of all on air elements.
  • Partner with Sales teams and clients to address billing discrepancies and maintain financial accuracy.
  • Cultivate strong relationships with agencies, present media plans/programming opportunities, and maintain ongoing communication.
  • Provide guidance and training to Sales Assistants on sales planning processes, tools, and practices.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:


  • BS/BA in related discipline preferred or equivalent years of experience
  • Generally, 3+ years of experience in related field preferred

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:


  • Strong understanding of ad sales terminology and media math
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Strong problem solving & analytical skills
  • Flexibility and adaptability in a constantly evolving media landscape
  • Strong interpersonal and organizational skills, ability to multi-task and handle projects independently, as well as part of a team
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (especially Excel)
  • Wide Orbit Network experience a plus

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:


New York City is one of the world's great media capitals — and for good reason. Home to major networks, global agencies, and the pulse of the advertising industry, NYC puts you at the center of it all. The five boroughs offer an unmatched mix of neighborhoods, cuisines, arts, and culture, from the iconic skyline of Manhattan to the vibrant energy of Brooklyn, Queens, the Bronx, and Staten Island. World-class museums, Broadway shows, and legendary music venues mean there's always something to explore after hours.


Beyond the culture, New York is an outdoor enthusiast's playground in every season. Central Park offers a green escape in the heart of the city, while the Hudson River Greenway, Prospect Park, and the beaches of the Rockaways are just a subway or short drive away. The city's extensive transit network makes it easy to get around without a car, and weekend getaways to the Catskills, the Hamptons, or the Jersey Shore are well within reach.

Whether you're a lifelong New Yorker or arriving for the first time, the city has a way of matching your ambition and feeding your curiosity. With a food scene that spans every corner of the globe, a sports culture anchored by the Yankees, Mets, Knicks, Rangers, Giants, Jets, and more, and a professional network unlike anywhere else, New York City isn't just a place to work — it's a place to grow.

job.title: Scripps Sports Partnership Lead, Nashville
job.description:
Scripps Sports is looking for a passionate, experienced sports sales professional to help drive revenue growth for the Nashville Predators TV Broadcasts on Scripps Sports, one of the NHL's most recognized franchises. As a Scripps Sports Partnership Lead, you'll leverage the power of live sports and the strength of the Predators-Scripps partnership to develop strategic sponsorships, build lasting client partnerships, and create innovative linear and digital advertising and marketing solutions for regional and national advertisers. If you're a proven seller who thrives on developing new business, exceeding revenue goals, and delivering winning solutions, this is an exciting opportunity to make an immediate impact with a growing sports media organization.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Prospect and develop relationships with regional and national accounts to generate new business opportunities.
  • Conduct needs analyses and create customized sports sponsorship and advertising solutions that align with client objectives.
  • Secure appointments, present recommendations, negotiate agreements, and close sales to achieve revenue goals.
  • Create and sell sponsorship packages utilizing acquired league and team-controlled sports inventory, with a primary focus on Nashville Predators partnership opportunities.
  • Leverage the strength and visibility of the Nashville Predators brand to develop creative, integrated marketing solutions that deliver measurable results for clients.
  • Collaborate with Scripps national and local Account Executives on strategic sports sponsorship opportunities.
  • Participate in internal planning meetings to establish sales strategies, revenue targets, and growth initiatives.
  • Build long-term client partnerships through exceptional service, retention efforts, and referral generation.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to new and existing clients while identifying opportunities to expand partnerships and drive incremental revenue.
  • Prepare and deliver compelling presentations, sponsorship pitches, and partnership recommendations to clients and stakeholders.
  • Manage all aspects of client service, including media negotiations, proposal development, campaign execution, collections, reporting, and account retention activities.
  • Entertain prospective and existing clients through sporting events and other business development opportunities.
  • Maintain accurate client activity, pipeline, forecasting, account information, and revenue projections within CRM systems.
  • Resolve makegoods and other sales-related issues while ensuring client satisfaction.
  • Communicate regularly with sales leadership regarding account status, revenue performance, and business opportunities.
  • Travel up to 25% as needed to support client meetings, sponsorship opportunities, sporting events, and business development activities.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, Sports Management, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in sports, media, sponsorship, advertising, partnership sales, or a related industry.
  • Proven track record of success achieving and exceeding revenue goals in a highly accountable sales environment.
  • Valid driver's license, satisfactory driving record, and proof of insurance meeting company requirements.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • Strong understanding of sports sponsorships, media sales, and integrated marketing solutions.
  • Ability to identify client needs and develop strategic, customized partnership programs.
  • Exceptional prospecting, relationship-building, negotiating, and closing skills.
  • Proven ability to influence decision-makers and uncover new revenue opportunities.
  • Experience using CRM platforms and Microsoft Office applications.
  • Knowledge of media sales platforms and advertising solutions.
  • Outstanding verbal, written, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to confidently present to executives and audiences of all sizes in both virtual and in-person settings.
  • Strong organizational and time management capabilities.
  • Excellent attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Collaborative mindset and ability to work effectively across teams and departments.
  • Self-motivated, results-oriented approach with a strong sense of accountability.
  • Entrepreneurial spirit with a passion for sports, partnership development, and revenue generation.
  • Ability to effectively represent the Nashville Predators and Scripps Sports brands in the marketplace.

WHAT WE'LL OFFER

  • Competitive base salary plus uncapped commission opportunity.
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits.
  • Retirement savings opportunities, including company matching.
  • Generous paid time off and holidays.
  • Employee wellness programs and resources.
  • Professional development and career growth opportunities.
  • The opportunity to represent one of the most exciting brands in professional sports while helping clients connect with passionate fans.
  • A dynamic, collaborative culture where your contributions directly impact business growth and success.

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK AND PLAY

At Scripps Sports, you'll join a team that is redefining local sports media and building powerful connections between fans, teams, and advertisers. Utilizing our Nashville Predators broadcasts, you'll help brands tap into the passion, reach, and engagement of live sports while creating partnerships that drive measurable business results. If you're energized by sports, motivated by sales success, and excited about representing a premier NHL franchise, you'll find an incredible opportunity to grow your career and make a lasting impact in Nashville, Tennessee, one of the country's most vibrant sports, entertainment, and business communities.

job.title: Scripps Sports Partnership Lead, Salt Lake City
job.description:
Are you ready to bring the excitement of sports to life through innovative advertising solutions? Scripps Sports is seeking a dynamic Scripps Sports Partnership Lead in Salt Lake City who will drive revenue growth by selling linear, digital, and sponsorship solutions across our acquired league and team-controlled sports inventory. You'll work with regional and national accounts to create customized advertising packages that connect brands with passionate sports fans.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Independently prospect regional and national accounts, secure appointments, perform needs analysis, develop customized solutions, conduct presentations and close sales.
  • Create and sell sponsorship/advertising solutions utilizing acquired league and team controlled sports inventory.
  • Attend internal meetings to establish strategy and revenue goals and attend weekly sports division meetings.
  • Serve as trusted advisor with new clients, provide best-in-class customer service, grow accounts, and gain additional business from referrals.
  • Perform client services, including but not limited to media avail negotiations, presentation preparation delivery and execution, copy writing, credit applications, collections of revenue due and retention reports.
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships, which may include entertaining prospective and existing clients, attending sporting events or other associated functions.
  • Perform routine administrative functions of media sales including makegood resolution, continuous update of CRM system with activity, account information and pending revenue, and communication with VP of Revenue regarding status of accounts.
  • Assist Scripps national or local AE's on key client sales calls for sports sponsorships.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • BS/BA in related field required, or equivalent experience
  • Generally 5+ years of sports-related experience required
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company required insurance limits.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Demonstrated record of success in a goal-oriented, highly accountable sales environment
  • Proficient use of Microsoft Office and other programs such as customer relations software
  • Working knowledge of various media sales platforms
  • Strong influencing, selling and upselling skills required
  • Must have good organizational skills and time management
  • Ability to present and negotiate with confidence and professionalism
  • Strong attention to detail, ability to multitask and meet deadlines in fast pace environment
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills
  • Outstanding presentation abilities (in person/virtual, small/large groups, all levels)
  • Effective teamwork and collaboration skills
  • Highly self-motivated and goal focused

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:

Salt Lake City offers an unbeatable combination of urban sophistication and outdoor adventure. Nestled against the stunning Wasatch Mountains, you'll have world-class skiing and snowboarding at resorts like Park City, Alta, and Snowbird just 30-45 minutes from downtown. In warmer months, enjoy hiking, mountain biking, and rock climbing in Big and Little Cottonwood Canyons, or explore the unique landscape of the Great Salt Lake.

The city itself boasts a thriving downtown with excellent restaurants, craft breweries, and a vibrant arts scene including the Utah Symphony, Ballet West, and numerous galleries. Temple Square and the historic neighborhoods showcase the city's rich heritage, while the growing tech sector has earned Salt Lake City recognition as the "Silicon Slopes." With 300 days of sunshine annually, a lower cost of living than many major metros, and a family-friendly atmosphere, Salt Lake City provides an exceptional quality of life.

Sports fans will love being home to the NBA's Utah Jazz, Real Salt Lake (MLS), and Utah Hockey Club (NHL), plus easy access to outdoor recreation that rivals anywhere in the country. The city's central location also makes it a convenient hub for exploring Utah's "Mighty Five" national parks and other Western destinations.

job.title: Senior Director of News, KTNV
job.description:
Senior Director of News, KTNV


Are you a proven news leader ready to elevate one of the most dynamic newsrooms in the West? KTNV, The E.W. Scripps ABC affiliate in Las Vegas, Nevada, is seeking an experienced Senior Director of News to lead our newsroom and drive continued audience growth and journalistic excellence. This is your opportunity to lead a talented team of journalists committed to delivering critical community journalism that serves Las Vegas and Southern Nevada.


We're looking for a visionary leader who can inspire compelling storytelling, foster innovation, and navigate the rapidly evolving media landscape. If you're passionate about quality local journalism, digital innovation, developing great people, and building a positive, hard-charging newsroom culture, we want to hear from you.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Create and implement strategic plans for audience growth and newsroom operations.
  • Develop and implement measurable strategies for audience growth while effectively managing news content delivered across multiple platforms.
  • Communicate a compelling and inspired vision consistent with company strategy.
  • Analyze and respond to trends affecting the industry and DMA.
  • Approve all newsroom personnel decisions.
  • Develop and control the annual budget in compliance with station guidelines.
  • Build and maintain key relationships to foster a positive news image within the Las Vegas community.
  • Monitor all on-air and online products for compliance with federal, state and local laws as well as First and Fourteenth Amendment requirements.
  • Work closely with other members of the station management team to develop and attain departmental and station goals.
  • Maintain knowledge of and proficiency in posting content to station websites.
  • Adapt current resources to emerging technology.
  • Supervise and provide regular feedback and yearly performance appraisals for direct reports, with ultimate responsibility for all newsroom personnel.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • At least 5 years of news management experience is required.
  • Bachelor's degree in journalism, communication or a related field preferred.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Demonstrated ability to track and select trending news stories.
  • Strong organizational skills.
  • Ability to lead and make sound decisions in a rapid, fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to work a flexible schedule, including nights, weekends and holidays.
  • Strong editorial judgment and knowledge of journalistic ethics and libel laws.
  • Ability to create tactics and strategies to increase audience performance in key target areas across multiple platforms.
  • Working knowledge of federal, state and local laws impacting operations.
  • Advanced oral and written communication skills.
  • Effectiveness in a variety of formal presentation settings, both inside and outside the organization.
  • Proven and effective leadership skills, including fostering open dialogue, empowering others, and addressing conflict quickly and directly.

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK AND PLAY:

Las Vegas, Nevada offers far more than the world-famous Las Vegas Strip. The region combines the energy and entertainment of a major destination city with year-round outdoor recreation, a growing local community and easy access to some of the most striking landscapes in the Southwest.


Beyond the restaurants, entertainment and attractions that draw visitors from around the world, Las Vegas offers professional sports, arts and culture, and outdoor adventures throughout Southern Nevada. From exploring Red Rock Canyon and nearby desert landscapes to taking in major sporting events, concerts and entertainment, Las Vegas provides a unique blend of big-city excitement and Western outdoor living.


For a news leader, Las Vegas also offers the opportunity to serve a distinctive and active community. At KTNV, you'll lead a newsroom focused on delivering important local journalism to viewers across Las Vegas and Southern Nevada while helping shape how that journalism reaches audiences across platforms. KTNV is Scripps' ABC affiliate in Las Vegas.

job.title: Senior Manager, IT Audit (Hybrid - Cincinnati)
job.description:
Join Scripps as a Senior Manager, IT Audit and play a pivotal role in safeguarding our technology infrastructure while driving continuous improvement across the organization. In this critical position, you'll oversee all aspects of the IT control audits. In addition, this position will manage compliance efforts related to the company's IT general controls and assist in the identification and execution of value-adding projects. If you're a strategic thinker with deep expertise in IT controls and a passion for enhancing organizational effectiveness, we want to hear from you!


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Manage the planning and execution of audits of IT general controls and automated business applications.
  • Manage the planning and execution of value-adding consulting projects for corporate and operating unit management.
  • Perform reviews of IT audit reports to ensure accuracy and completeness of issues.
  • Assist in identifying and developing value-adding projects within the company.
  • Assist with developing and conducting compliance training programs related to IT internal controls and Sarbanes-Oxley.
  • In collaboration with corporate IT, reevaluate existing control designs and related efficiencies and make recommendations to corporate IT for improvements and efficiencies.
  • Review remediation plans related to IT control audit findings.
  • Participate in the selection and implementation of new or replacement business systems and upgrades across the company to ensure information technology control issues are properly addressed.
  • Other duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

  • BS/BA in related discipline preferred or equivalent years of experience
  • Generally, 7+ years of experience in related field preferred
  • CISA certification or equivalent  preferred
  • Prior managerial experience preferred

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • Foundational knowledge of artificial intelligence and cybersecurity principles preferred
  • Understand internal control concepts and experience in applying them to document, plan, perform and report on the evaluation of business processes, areas and functions
  • Understand internal auditing standards, COSO, risk assessment practices, and high-level technical aspects of accounting and financial reporting
  • Serve as a subject matter expert on IT general controls and related control concept
  • Demonstrated expertise of information technology and/or information technology-focused audit and reporting practices
  • Ability to plan and execute complex projects, including defining scope, timelines, resources, deliverables, and related risks
  • Strong analytical, interpersonal, and written/verbal communication skills
  • Ability to work effectively as part of a team on multiple projects

job.title: Sr. Account Manager, SMB Growth & Direct Response
job.description:
Are you ready to make an impact at the intersection of media innovation and client success? Scripps is seeking a strategic Sr. Account Manager, SMB Growth & Direct Response to join our dynamic team in New York City. In this role, you'll be the driving force behind strengthening advertiser and agency relationships while delivering integrated media solutions that span linear television, digital, and streaming/CTV platforms. If you're passionate about maximizing campaign performance and building strategic partnerships that drive real business results, this is your opportunity to shine.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Manage the day-to-day execution, delivery, and performance of assigned accounts and campaigns to meet client objectives, revenue goals, retention targets, and performance KPIs.
  • Serve as a contact for advertisers and agencies, developing a strong understanding of their business objectives, target audiences, marketing strategies, and performance goals while providing responsive, solutions-oriented support as well as upselling opportunities.
  • Partner with account executives and sales leadership on media plans, proposals, presentations, pipeline management, account growth, retention, and opportunities to increase advertiser investment.
  • Proactively monitor campaign pacing, delivery, and performance; analyze KPIs including CPA, CPL, ROAS, response, conversion, reach, and frequency; and implement optimization strategies to maximize campaign effectiveness.
  • Analyze campaign and account performance data to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement, and develop client-facing reports, campaign recaps, recommendations, and strategic insights.
  • Coordinate the campaign lifecycle from proposal through order entry, trafficking, scheduling, optimization, reporting, makegoods, and reconciliation while maintaining accurate account, campaign, and revenue information in applicable systems.
  • Partner with Sales, Ad Operations, Traffic, Inventory, Research, Marketing, Content, Finance, and other internal teams to ensure effective planning, execution, issue resolution, and delivery of client commitments.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

  • BS/BA in related discipline preferred or equivalent years of experience
  • Generally, 5+ years of experience in related field preferred

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • Demonstrated understanding of national advertising landscapes, agency structures, and enterprise-level client requirements preferred
  • Strong and comprehensive understanding of linear TV, digital, and streaming/CTV media planning, buying, and optimization across integrated platforms
  • Knowledge of Direct Response advertising, performance metrics (CPA, CPL, ROAS, conversion rates), and campaign management processes
  • Strong analytical skills to interpret campaign data, identify optimization opportunities, and translate insights into actionable recommendations
  • Exceptional client-service and communication skills
  • Ability to effectively present strategic recommendations to advertisers, agencies, and internal stakeholders
  • Demonstrated capability in end-to-end campaign oversight with focus on revenue optimization and strategic partnership alignment
  • Proficiency in CRM, analytics platforms, and Microsoft Office with strong organizational skills to prioritize competing demands in fast-paced environments

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK AND PLAY


New York City is the epicenter of media, advertising, and innovation—and there's no better place to advance your career in strategic account management. As the nation's largest media market, NYC offers unparalleled access to leading agencies, brands, and industry events. Beyond work, the city pulses with world-class dining, arts, culture, and entertainment. From Broadway shows to rooftop bars, Central Park to Brooklyn's vibrant neighborhoods, you'll find endless ways to explore and be inspired. With excellent public transportation and a hybrid work model, you'll enjoy the perfect balance of professional growth and urban living at its finest.

job.title: Briefing Coordinator, Live Journalism
job.description:
Who we are

Semafor is a global news platform for an increasingly complex world in which consumers are overwhelmed by too many news sources and unsure what to trust. We are building Semafor to enable world-class journalists to deliver reporting and insights with rigor in journalistic forms that ensure a new level of transparency. Our editors and reporters distill the most important stories from all over in formats that uncover the forces shaping the stories, explain the interests behind polarizing narratives, and replenish the stock of shared facts. As a global platform, Semafor recognizes that smart people can disagree and that informed readers need to understand alternative points of view from competing centers of power and culture in a multi-polar world. Want to join us? Read on. 

About this Role

Semafor seeks recent college graduates with experience working in communications, on Capitol Hill, or within executive offices to support our flagship live journalism events in a temporary role to prepare our journalists, speakers, and attendees for participation at our flagship convening, Silicon Valley & The World. You will collaborate with our content, programming, and events teams to develop briefing materials, prepare background research, gather biographies, and organize key event logistical information. The ideal candidate is highly organized and has an extreme attention to detail, independently motivated, and exceptionally responsive. This is more than an administrative and operations role; it is a fast-paced command center position at the intersection of media, live production, and executive operations.

Your Responsibilities 

  • Compile and synthesize complex logistical information.
  • Draft, format, and distribute briefing packets for VIP speakers, moderators, and attendees.
  • Research key talking points and gather speaker and attendee biographies. 
  • Support Semafor’s events team with other duties as required in preparation for the event. 

What makes you qualified

  • 1–2 years of experience in journalism, communications, Capitol Hill, or executive assistance in a high-velocity environment (Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience)
  • Impeccable judgment, comfort with ambiguity, and a calm, customer-service-driven composure when details change
  • Exceptional project management skills with the strongest attention to detail and an ability to manage multiple tasks, deadlines, and competing priorities
  • Strongest communication skills, both written and verbal
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office suite, especially Excel and Word, and Google Workspace

Compensation:

  • The hourly rate for this position will be $32.00 USD. Individual compensation varies based on job related factors, including business needs, experience, level of responsibility, and qualifications.

 

Additional job details

Semafor offers a Flexible Paid Time Off (PTO) policy to our full-time, salaried employees who may take paid time off as-needed without a prescribed limit or defined balance.

Semafor, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer and enthusiastically encourages people from all backgrounds and experiences to apply. Semafor, Inc. will consider all applicants without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical and/or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, age, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

job.title: Customer Service Representative - CCLI (Eastbourne)
job.description:
At CCLI (Christian Copyright Licensing International), we're passionate about helping churches focus on what matters most: worship and ministry. As a leading provider of church copyright licensing and worship solutions, we deliver innovative tools, trusted resources, and industry-leading services that enable churches to access and use worship content legally and confidently. Combining purpose-driven work with technology and creativity, CCLI supports worship communities around the world and empowers teams to serve with excellence.

THE OPPORTUNITY:

As a Customer Service Representative, you will play a key role in delivering exceptional customer experience by responding to enquiries, supporting customers with licensing and product solutions, and identifying opportunities to grow customer relationships. You will proactively engage customers through renewal and sales activities, process new and renewing licence applications across multiple channels, and maintain accurate customer records. Through every interaction, you will help churches and ministry organisations access the services they need while ensuring professional, efficient, and customer-focused experience.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

  • Respond to customer enquiries via telephone, email, and written correspondence in a timely, professional, and customer-focused manner.
  • Develop and maintain a thorough understanding of CCLI's products, services, and licensing solutions through ongoing training, team meetings, and self-development.
  • Provide accurate, clear, and helpful information to customers regarding products, services, policies, and procedures, ensuring a consistently positive customer experience.
  • Maintain detailed and accurate records of customer interactions, account updates, transactions, and feedback within the company's CRM and communication systems.
  • Proactively contact prospective customers to introduce CCLI's products and services, identify customer needs, and promote appropriate solutions.
  • Support the onboarding of new customers through telephone and video consultations, including delivering product demonstrations and guidance where required.
  • Provide customer support through telephone and video calls, troubleshooting issues, resolving queries efficiently, and ensuring customer satisfaction.
  • Build strong relationships with customers, promoting engagement, retention, and long-term loyalty through proactive and responsive service.
  • Collaborate effectively with colleagues across the business to resolve customer issues, share feedback, and contribute to continuous service improvement.
  • Provide training, guidance, and support to colleagues as required, sharing knowledge and best practices to enhance team capability.
  • Undertake additional duties and responsibilities consistent with the nature and level of the role, as required by the business.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING:

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to build positive relationships and communicate confidently with a wide range of customers.
  • A customer-focused mindset with a genuine passion for delivering outstanding service and ensuring customer satisfaction.
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Outlook, Word, Excel, and Teams.
  • Excellent organisational skills, with the ability to prioritise workload, manage multiple tasks, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong attention to detail and a commitment to maintaining accurate records and high standards of work.
  • Self-motivated and proactive, with the ability to work independently while contributing effectively as part of a collaborative team.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify customer needs and deliver practical, effective solutions.
  • Confidence in handling customer conversations via telephone, email, and video calls in a professional and engaging manner.
  • A willingness to learn new systems, products, and processes, and to continuously develop knowledge and skills.
  • An interest in, and general understanding of, Christian music, worship, and church culture, with an appreciation of the needs of churches and ministry organisations.

WHY JOIN CCLI?

  • Purpose-driven work that supports churches, ministries, and worship communities.
  • A collaborative and supportive team environment.
  • A customer-focused culture that values initiative, service, and continuous improvement.
  • The chance to work with industry-leading products and solutions that make a difference.

We welcome applications from candidates who are excited to be part of a collaborative, office-based team and able to work from our Eastbourne office five days a week. In return, we offer a competitive salary of up to £28,500, alongside a benefits package and leave policies that support your wellbeing and work-life balance.

job.title: AI Enablement Manager
job.description:
About The Role

Are you a curious, collaborative self-starter who enjoys building relationships, connecting ideas, and getting to the root of how things really work? Are you the kind of person who spots friction that has quietly become part of the routine and understands that the best solution starts with a well-understood problem? Are you excited about the possibilities of AI and interested in helping an organization turn those possibilities into practical solutions? If so, we want to hear from you.

Sinclair is hiring a Manager, AI Enablement to help identify, understand, and clearly frame the operational problems facing our teams and the business. This highly visible role works across every business function to surface AI opportunities and regularly informs C-suite discussions.

AI Enablement owns the AI opportunity pipeline at Sinclair: capturing, evaluating, and prioritizing opportunities across the business, and deciding which become approved-for-build projects. This role helps run that pipeline day to day and translates approved-for-build opportunities to the AI Product and Delivery team. Through ongoing conversations with employees and leaders, you will uncover pain points, examine processes closely, and contribute your judgment on whether an opportunity calls for AI, process improvement, or another solution. We do not layer AI on top of broken processes.

We are looking for a thoughtful, natural connector who listens closely, recognizes patterns in what people say and do, and sees potential value before the numbers are fully developed. You do not need to be a technical AI expert. You do need to be able to walk into any part of the business with curiosity, ask great questions, earn trust quickly, and leave with a sharper picture of what is possible.

What You Will Do

Business Discovery and Relationship Building

  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with employees and leaders across departments to surface opportunities and support AI adoption.
  • Engage with business teams across the organization to observe how work happens, ask questions that surface friction and inefficiency, and identify problems worth solving.
  • Understand the problem first, then examine the underlying process. Only when the process is sound should the question of AI come into play.

Pipeline, Prioritization, and Translation

  • Manage the intake path for AI-related opportunities from every source: the Champions Program, direct conversations, business partner requests, and escalations. Keep requesters informed of status and next steps.
  • Help run the AI Enablement opportunity pipeline: capture, evaluate, prioritize, and scope opportunities across Sinclair, and support the decision on which are ready to hand off as approved-for-build projects to AI Product and Delivery. 
  • Partner on business case development for opportunities as they move through the pipeline.
  • Translate approved-for-build opportunities into clear project briefs that carry the problem framing, the current state, open decisions, and the people involved, with sources for the facts so the receiving team can build with confidence.
  • Stay connected through evaluation, build, and delivery as an ongoing point of contact for the business partner. Answer questions, correct misunderstandings, maintain momentum, and keep the work anchored to the original business need.
  • Partner with AI Product and Delivery through the handoff and into build, so the problem framing, current state, and stakeholder context stay with the work as it moves to the technical partners who build it.
  • Partner with department leaders during opportunity evaluation, so technology fit, feasibility, and solution design shape an opportunity before it becomes an approved project.

AI Enablement and Adoption

  • Help run the ChatGPT Champions Program: working sessions, ongoing engagement, recognition, follow-through, and connecting champions with the resources and support they need.
  • Help employees understand practical ways AI can support their work by sharing successful use cases and supporting training, demonstrations, and other enablement activities.
  • Use AI actively in your own work and build working fluency through experimentation. You are not expected to be an expert; you are learning alongside our employees, and that shared experience is what makes you credible with them.
  • Stay current on what available AI tools can and cannot do so you can recognize relevant opportunities and provide practical guidance. Over time, use that fluency to help others prototype and improve workflows.

Reporting, Impact, and Communications

  • Analyze AI usage and engagement data, identify trends, and work with business teams to document time savings, productivity improvements, and other evidence of impact.
  • Prepare and contribute to briefings, reports, dashboards, Quarterly Business Reviews, and monthly updates that show what the AI Enablement function is finding, where value is showing up, and where the portfolio is headed.
  • Surface meaningful workflow patterns, employee stories, and progress through the Champions Dashboard and other leadership reporting.
  • Partner with Corporate Communications by providing the content, context, and examples needed to develop clear and accurate employee-facing messaging about AI initiatives.

 

What Success Looks Like in the First Six Months

  • You have built trusted relationships with champions and key business leaders across every division at Sinclair, and you are the person they call when something on their team is worth a closer look.
  • You have moved a first set of opportunities through the pipeline to approved-for-build, with clean project briefs handed off to the AI Product and Delivery team.
  • You have contributed to a Quarterly Business Review and a monthly leadership update, with material that showed the AI Enablement function's findings and where value is showing up.
  • You have built at least one AI agent or small solution to strengthen your own work, and you use AI actively enough to speak credibly with the champions you support.
  • You have supported the Champions Program's operating rhythm through multiple working sessions, and you have been the ongoing point of contact for at least one project moving through build.

 

Who You Are

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Communications, Technology, Marketing, Human Resources, or a related field.
  • Minimum of four years of professional experience within a large, complex organization.
  • Intellectual curiosity that keeps you learning, questioning, and connecting ideas.
  • Comfort with ambiguity, and a willingness to shape unclear problems rather than wait for them to clarify.
  • Track record of building trusted relationships across functions and levels, from individual contributors to senior leaders.
  • Strong writing and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain unfamiliar or complex ideas clearly.
  • Strong project-management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple initiatives and stakeholders without dropping threads.
  • Proficiency in Excel and general data literacy, including the ability to organize data, identify trends, and explain the story behind the information.
  • Understanding of how business operations translate into value. You do not need to build financial models.
  • Comfort learning new technology and developing fluency independently.

Preferred

  • Foundational familiarity with generative AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or similar tools, along with a working sense of what they can and cannot do.
  • Experience supporting a champions network, community of practice, peer adoption program, or similar engagement model.
  • Experience with technology adoption, organizational change, process improvement, or cross-functional program work.
  • Prior experience in broadcast, media, or a similarly distributed, multi-site organization.
  • Experience with opportunity discovery, intake and triage, or project pipeline management.

 

This position is on site in Hunt Valley, MD. Candidates must be local or willing to commute.

job.title: AI Product & Delivery Coordinator
job.description:
About The Role

Sinclair is building a practical AI Product and Delivery function that makes AI tools and solutions useful in the real world. The team owns the employee-facing AI product experience and supports the AI product strategy: listening to what employees need, developing the right signals into a focused product portfolio, and moving priority work through execution, delivery, launch, and improvement.

The AI Product and Delivery Coordinator is a hands-on product and delivery partner to the Director, AI Product. You will help run the day-to-day product experience for ChatGPT Enterprise and other AI tools, keep the backlog and roadmap well informed, and help move priority work from a real employee or business problem to a delivered and supported solution.

This is an early-career role for someone who likes turning ambiguity into momentum. You will not be expected to write code or carry out technical administration. You will be expected to walk into conversations with people across the company, ask good questions, understand what matters, and help the group leave with a clear next step. We are looking for judgment, confidence, follow-through, and the ability to be a positive business partner as much as we are looking for a conventional product background.

What You Will Do

Employee Requests And Product Support

  • Manage the day-to-day flow of employee questions, requests, access needs, change requests, and support signals for approved AI tools.

  • Talk with employees to understand the need behind a request; provide timely guidance when a question can be resolved directly and route actionable work to the right administrative, support, or delivery partner.

  • Keep requests moving and employees informed, making sure ownership, context, and next steps are clear across the teams involved.

  • Identify patterns in employee needs, recurring friction, and requests that should become a product improvement, a release consideration, or a new product opportunity.

AI Tool Releases And Employee Education

  • Help plan and coordinate the release of new features, functions, and AI tools, including the intended audience, timing, access and provisioning needs, product messaging, and learning materials.

  • Create clear, useful employee-facing guidance that explains what is new, why it matters, and how to use it responsibly and effectively.

  • Work with enablement, communications, training, and administrative partners to make releases understandable, well-supported, and ready for employees.

  • Collect early feedback and issues after a release, then turn that input into improvements, updated guidance, or follow-up product work.

Product Discovery Backlog And Roadmap

  • Help maintain the AI product backlog and portfolio, with clear opportunity records, status, owners, business context, dependencies, decisions, and expected outcomes.

  • Support discovery with business partners and employees to understand users, workflows, pain points, constraints, and the value a solution needs to create.

  • Turn problems, requests, ideas, and other signals into concise product briefs, requirements, user stories, workflow documentation, and recommended next steps.

  • Prepare the product and workflow context that helps technology partners evaluate solution options and delivery paths.

  • Support the Director in preparing roadmap recommendations and portfolio priority decisions with current business context, delivery information, and clear documentation.

Solution Delivery And Product Improvement

  • Coordinate priority product work from approved concept through build, pilot, release, and ongoing support with internal and external delivery partners.

  • Maintain delivery plans, milestones, dependencies, risks, decisions, and readiness activities; surface issues early and help keep the work moving.

  • Translate approved product direction into clear documentation and requirements for technology, administrative, implementation, and business partners.

  • Manage post-launch follow-through for selected solutions, including feedback collection, change needs, release-material updates, adoption signals, and enhancement backlog items.

  • Synthesize product usage, employee feedback, requests, and delivery learnings into clear updates and practical recommendations for the Director and cross-functional partners.

How You Work

  • Build productive working relationships with AI Technology Strategy, AI Operations and Enablement, IT, Engineering, Security, Legal, Communications, and business teams.

  • Bring the right people together at the right time, recognize when specialized review or implementation is needed, and make sure each partner has the context to move the work forward.

  • Be a thoughtful, credible representative of the AI Product team with everyone from frontline employees to executive leadership.

Who You Are

  • Two to four years of experience in product operations, product management, project or program delivery, strategy and operations, consulting, transformation, or a comparable cross-functional role.

  • A confident, clear communicator who can have a useful conversation with anyone in the organization, from a frontline employee to an executive leader.

  • Strong business acumen and the ability to quickly understand a team’s priorities, ask the right questions, and communicate a credible point of view.

  • A natural instinct for getting work done: you can turn a conversation into a plan, keep commitments visible, and follow through without damaging relationships.

  • Product instincts: you can understand users and workflows, distinguish a request from the underlying problem, write clearly, and think about adoption and success measures.

  • Strong organization and comfort managing a high volume of requests, details, handoffs, and competing priorities without losing the human side of the work.

  • A collaborative, positive working style. You know how to manage competing priorities, bring people along, and be direct without being difficult.

  • Comfort learning new technology, including generative AI tools, and applying practical judgment without needing to be the technical implementer.

 

This position is on site in Hunt Valley, MD. Candidates must be local or willing to commute.

Please note that this position is not eligible for visa sponsorship, including employer sponsorship for an H-1B visa, OPT-STEM employment, etc.

job.description:
Assistant News Director — News 4 & Fox 11

The Assistant News Director helps lead the newsroom’s daily editorial, operational and people-management responsibilities. This position works closely with the News Director to deliver accurate, impactful local journalism across broadcast, digital and social platforms.

Key responsibilities

  • Help set and execute the daily editorial agenda, with an emphasis on breaking news, enterprise reporting, investigative work and community-focused coverage.
  • Lead daily editorial meetings; coordinate assignments, live coverage, special projects and major-event plans.
  • Coach reporters, producers, anchors, photographers and digital staff on writing, storytelling, live execution, ethics and urgency.
  • Oversee newsroom workflows, staffing, schedules and performance expectations; assist with hiring, evaluations, scheduling and corrective action.

  • Help grow audience through strong local reporting, accountability journalism and content tailored for broadcast, web, mobile and social.
  • Maintain constructive relationships with community leaders, agencies and news sources.

  • Serve as News Director when needed and perform other newsroom leadership duties as assigned.

    Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in journalism, communications or a related field preferred.
  • At least five years of television news experience; newsroom leadership experience preferred.

job.description:
Full Measure with Sharyl Attkisson has a great opportunity for you!

Full Measure is a weekly Sunday news program focusing on investigative, original and accountability reporting. The host is Sharyl Attkisson, five-time Emmy Award winner and recipient of the Edward R. Murrow award for investigative reporting. She is backed by a team of award-winning journalists.

We are looking for a highly skilled and motivated broadcast producer to join the team of the nationally acclaimed broadcast.

Candidates should have experience as a broadcast line producer. We want someone who has the technical skills to manage a broadcast as well as offering experience producing stories/content for a show with high standards for investigative reporting.

The position requires someone with good communication skills, a desire to engage and contribute to an atmosphere of top-level journalists and who has the knowledge of multi-platform production to engage audiences at every level. This is for a person seeking both the challenge and reward of making a great broadcast, even better.

Essential Duties and Requirements include the following:

  • Exemplary verbal and written communication skills
  • Energy and positivity
  • Ability to take direction and work efficiently during breaking news events
  • Must work well in a team environment
  • Must be a self-starter who can generate his or her own story ideas on a daily basis
  • Ability to edit video for stories
  • Ability to create graphics for newscast
  • Ability to work under deadline and on a flexible schedule is required
  • Contribute story ideas to daily editorial meetings
  • Oversee coverage in control room during production.
  • Conduct interviews when required via, phone, email, Skype, or other methods
  • Participate in regular content planning meetings
  • Post content on assigned digital platforms daily
  • Other duties as assigned

 

Qualifications: 

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required.

  • A minimum of three (2) years’ experience producing engaging television newscasts at commercial news operations

job.title: Campaign Strategist - AMP Sports
job.description:
AMP Sports is looking for a detail-oriented, collaborative Campaign Strategist to support the execution of advertising campaigns across linear, digital, social, podcast, and owned-and-operated platforms.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working at the center of a fast-paced sports-media business. You will partner closely with Sales, Planning, Account Management, Traffic, Finance, Marketing, and Operations to ensure campaigns are launched accurately, paced effectively, delivered successfully, and managed efficiently from order entry through completion.

The right candidate is highly organized, proactive, solutions-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple priorities while maintaining a high level of accuracy.

What You’ll Do

Campaign Execution & Management

  • Support post-sale execution of advertising campaigns across linear, digital, social, podcast, and owned-and-operated platforms.
  • Coordinate campaign setup, trafficking, flighting, inventory allocation, and fulfillment activities.
  • Monitor campaign delivery, pacing, and performance; proactively identify and resolve issues to keep campaigns on track.
  • Maintain accurate campaign, advertiser, inventory, and order information across company systems.
  • Support make-goods, liability management, inventory adjustments, and campaign documentation.

 

Sales Support & Account Coordination

  • Serve as a primary operational resource for Account Executives, Planners, Account Managers, and other internal stakeholders.
  • Provide timely campaign updates, status reporting, and issue resolution.
  • Respond to campaign-related inquiries and support client-service efforts through proactive communication and follow-through.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Sales, Planning, Traffic, Finance, Marketing, and Operations to drive successful campaign execution.
  • Support discrepancy resolution, billing validation, and monthly reporting processes.
  • Assist with inventory management, revenue tracking, and quarterly readiness activities.
  • Help ensure campaign commitments, reporting, and documentation are accurate, complete, and delivered on time.

 

What You’ll Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant experience preferred.
  • 1–3 years of experience in advertising operations, campaign management, media planning, sales support, traffic, account management, or a related field.
  • Understanding of linear and digital advertising workflows and campaign execution.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills, with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Proficiency in Excel and experience working with reporting, inventory management, and campaign-tracking tools.
  • Experience with advertising and workflow platforms such as GAM, Broadway, JIRA, Teams, Megaphone, Sprout, Smartsheet, or similar tools preferred.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a deadline-driven environment.

 

The base hourly compensation range for this role is $22.60 to $26.57 per hour. In addition, this role may be eligible for a quartely bonus, which would be awarded based on individual and company performance. job.title: Client Services Manager
job.description:
CLIENT SERVICES MANAGER

WHO WE ARE:

We’re a fast-moving, collaborative team that keeps creative projects, digital campaigns, and client deliverables moving across multiple Sinclair markets. On the Agile Content Creation Engagement Team (ACCET), we partner with Sales, Creative Services, Production, and Digital to ensure every project is executed accurately, efficiently, and on time.

Our mission? Deliver an exceptional client experience by combining operational excellence with creative collaboration. Whether coordinating commercial production, managing integrated marketing campaigns, or supporting high-volume workflows, we help bring great ideas to life while keeping teams aligned every step of the way.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

As a Client Services Manager, you'll lead a team of Content Creators while remaining hands-on in the creative process. You'll oversee workflow across multiple Sinclair markets, helping projects move from concept to completion while keeping teams aligned, timelines on track, and clients supported every step of the way.

You'll partner with Sales, Creative Services, Production, and Digital teams to remove roadblocks, coach and develop your team, and ensure every campaign is delivered accurately, on schedule, and with the creative quality our clients expect. When needed, you'll jump in to write, produce, shoot, and edit commercial spots, branded content, and promotional creative. You’ll lead by example to help bring great ideas to life.

YOUR DAILY PLAYLIST:

  • Lead and support a team of Content Creators responsible for producing commercial spots, branded content, digital campaigns, and client deliverables across multiple Sinclair markets.
  • Coordinate workflow across multiple Sinclair markets, ensuring projects move efficiently from order entry through final delivery.
  • Partner with Sales, Creative Services, Production, and Digital teams to establish priorities, manage timelines, and resolve challenges.
  • Review project requests for completeness, accuracy, and required creative assets before production begins.
  • Track production schedules, revisions, approvals, and air-ready deadlines to ensure timely delivery.
  • Oversee quality control of commercial spots, digital campaigns, and other client deliverables.
  • Contribute creatively by writing, producing, shooting, and editing commercial spots, branded content, and other creative projects as business needs require.
  • Manage workflow through Adobe Workfront and other Sinclair systems while identifying opportunities to improve efficiency.
  • Coach, mentor, and develop team members through training, performance feedback, and workflow best practices.

 

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE STAGE:

  • A passion for storytelling, creative collaboration, and delivering exceptional client experiences.
  • Strong leadership skills with the ability to coach teams, inspire creativity, and build accountability.
  • Excellent communication and organizational skills with a proven ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • A collaborative mindset with the confidence to work across departments and build strong relationships with internal teams and clients.
  • A continuous improvement mentality with a focus on quality, efficiency, and operational excellence.

 

WHY IT MATTERS:

Behind every successful campaign is a team that keeps the work moving. This role serves as the operational backbone for multiple Sinclair markets while helping shape the creative work itself. By leading talented Content Creators, supporting our partners across the organization, and contributing to production when needed, you'll help create campaigns that connect with audiences, strengthen client relationships, and deliver results.

 

What skills do you need to be successful in our role?

  • 3–5 years of experience in client services, creative services, production coordination, media operations, or account management.
  • Experience leading creative teams or managing high-volume production workflows.
  • Strong understanding of commercial production, digital advertising, integrated marketing campaigns, and creative project management.
  • Ability to write, produce, shoot, and edit compelling commercial and branded content.
  • Proficiency with Adobe Creative Cloud, including Premiere Pro, After Effects, Photoshop, and Illustrator.
  • Experience with workflow management systems such as Adobe Workfront or similar project management platforms is preferred.
  • Exceptional communication, organization, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities while supporting several markets simultaneously.
  • Strong interpersonal skills to navigate internal and external employee and client relationships.
  • Must maintain a valid driver's license and good driving record.
  • Ability to routinely lift, carry, and move production equipment in excess of 40 lbs.
  • A college degree is preferred.
  • Familiarity with Sinclair systems, workflows, and operational processes is preferred.

job.title: Content Creator - Freelance
job.description:
Our freelance Content Creator develops, produces, captures, and edits original content across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, X, and YouTube. The role serves as the team's end-to-end creator, bringing ideas from concept to publication with speed, creativity, and a strong understanding of platform-native storytelling. The freelance Content Creator identifies content opportunities, responds to emerging trends, and produces engaging content designed to drive audience growth and engagement across channels.

The freelance Content Creator is equally comfortable creating fast-turn, mobile-first content and producing higher-polish branded, original, and tentpole projects. The role captures content using both smartphone and professional camera equipment, including DSLR and mirrorless systems, while also managing audio and production elements as needed. Working across multiple teams, the freelance Content Creator collaborates with the Senior Social Media Manager on social content initiatives and partners with the Director of Video Content on video production planning and coordination. The role works closely with the Social Media Specialist on trend-driven and user-generated content executions, the Social Graphics Content Specialist on visual packaging, the Short-Form Video Producer Lead on video development, and the on-shift coordinator to align content delivery with publishing priorities. Through strong creative instincts and hands-on production expertise, the freelance Content Creator helps deliver timely, engaging, and platform-optimized content across the brand's digital ecosystem.

This freelance role is expected to be approximately 40 hours per week, with schedules aligned to tournament coverage needs. Flexibility to work weekends may be required during key tournaments and high-volume event periods. This freelance engagement is anticipated to run through December 2026, with the potential to be extended through the end of 2027 based on business needs and performance.

This is a freelance position and onsite in Santa Monica, CA. 

In this freelance role, you will... 

Lead Content & Creative Direction  (primary lane — concept, produce, capture, edit) 

  • Concept content end-to-end across the five social platforms — trend-driven pieces, branded content, recurring serialized formats, tentpole moments, original creator concepts, and one-off campaign creative. 
  • Produce shoots from concept to set — define the shot list, coordinate talent, locations, props, and timing; manage logistics on the day. 
  • Capture content using both production modes: 
  •   • Phone-first capture — vertical video, BTS moments, court-side reactions, trend executions, fast-turn pieces. 
  •   • DSLR / mirrorless + audio capture — interviews, branded content, original series segments, higher-polish tentpole pieces. Comfortable running camera, lenses, lavalier and shotgun microphones, basic lighting. 
  • Edit captured content end-to-end — phone or CapCut for fastest-turn pieces, Premiere Pro for polished and longer-form work. 
  • Bring on-camera presence and voice-over capability where the piece calls for it. 
  • Operate under the Tennis Channel brand voice and visual standard set by the Senior Social Media Manager and the Director of Video Content; flag content-quality concerns up before publish. 

Bring Production Expertise  (what this role brings to the team) 

  • Phone-first production: fluent shooting vertical content directly on phone, with on-the-go lighting and audio when needed. 
  • DSLR / mirrorless production: owns end-to-end setup — camera body and lenses, monitor, lighting basics, lavalier and shotgun mics, on-camera and ambient audio. 
  • Audio capture: comfortable running lavs, shotguns, and USB mic setups for podcast-style or interview-style content. 
  • Self-editing in CapCut Pro (fast-turn vertical) and Premiere Pro (polished horizontal and vertical). 
  • Color and audio finishing competence for finished pieces; comfort handing off to a specialist editor when the piece warrants deeper finishing. 

Lead Campaign Execution

  • Lead end-to-end content creation for assigned tournament tentpoles, brand campaigns, sponsor activations, and serialized formats — concept, produce, capture, edit, and publish. 
  • Coordinate with the Senior Social Media Manager and Director of Video Content on which campaigns the Content Creator owns end-to-end vs. supports. 
  • Contribute the Content Creator's owned content slots to the Master Cross-Platform Content Calendar and the video team's 90-day pipeline view. 
  • Travel to select tournaments and shoots to capture on-the-ground content — typically 8-15 weeks per year on the road. 

Stay Ahead of Platform Expertise & Trends 

  • Live inside platform trend cycles on TikTok, Reels, Shorts, Instagram, and YouTube — sound choices, edit timing, format awareness, creator-economy moves. 
  • Bring concepts to the Weekly Trending Content Meeting (chaired by the Senior Social Media Manager) — daily and tournament concepts built on emerging trends — and own follow-through on what gets approved. 
  • Run a tight reactive-content loop: when a trend or moment breaks between meetings, ship a creator response fast under brand-voice guardrails. 
  • Run platform-feature tests on creator output (new format, new placement, new edit style); document what works and surface to the Senior Social Media Manager and Director of Video Content. 

Drive Strategy & Planning 

  • Maintain a 90-day forward view of creator-content opportunities aligned with the team's tournament tentpoles, brand campaigns, and serialized programming. 
  • Identify creator-content growth opportunities (new format, new on-camera concept, new platform-native execution) and bring them to the Senior Social Media Manager and Director of Video Content with a recommended action and a resource ask. 

Analyze Performance & Report Insights 

  • Surface content performance insights — which pieces performed, which formats are tired, what to test next — to the Senior Social Media Manager and Director of Video Content. 
  • Provide qualitative content read-back weekly to feed the cross-platform executive narrative. 
  • Track personal output volume and cycle time against targets set by the Senior Social Media Manager. 

Partner Cross-Functionally

  • Partner with the Senior Social Media Manager on social-side content concepting, brand voice, and the Master Cross-Platform Content Calendar. 
  • Partner with the Director of Video Content on video-pipeline coordination — when a creator piece needs production support, an editor pairing, or longer-form finish. 
  • Partner with the Social Media Specialist on UGC, trending executions, and on-the-ground tournament capture. 
  • Partner with the Social Graphics Content Specialist when a creator piece needs custom graphics (titles, lower-thirds, end cards). 
  • Partner with the Short-Form Video Producer Lead, Video Editor (short-form), and YouTube Editor when a piece needs polished editing beyond fast-turn self-edit. 
  • Coordinate with the on-shift coordinator on publish-window timing for creator-owned content. 

Key Performance Indicators 

  • Creator content output volume per tournament week and per non-tournament week. 
  • Engagement and reach on creator-owned content across the five platforms. 
  • Trend response time: trend identified to published content (target: under 24 hours, often under 6 hours during active tournaments). 
  • New creator format pilots launched per year — and percent that get repeated as serialized programming. 
  • Contribution to YoY platform growth: IG (+50%), FB (+50%), TikTok (+100%), and YouTube (+100% via Shorts and creator-led long-form). 
  • On-camera content performance vs. brand baseline (where on-camera is the format). 
  • Quality bar across creator output (qualitative review by Senior Social Media Manager and Director of Video Content). 
  • Production reliability: shoots executed on plan, deliverables hit on time, on-set issues resolved without surfacing as blockers. 

 

Key Qualifications 

  • 3-5 years as a creator in social media, brand, or creator-economy environment — ideally in sports, live events, news, or entertainment. 
  • Demonstrable portfolio across multiple platforms (TikTok, Reels, Shorts, Instagram, YouTube). 
  • Hands-on capture experience with BOTH phone-first production AND DSLR / mirrorless + audio production — required, not preferred. 
  • Owned or willing-to-own production kit: camera body and lenses, lavalier and shotgun microphones, basic lighting. 
  • Self-editing fluency in CapCut Pro and Premiere Pro. 
  • On-camera and voice-over comfort. 
  • Strong concept instincts and brand-voice sensibility — able to translate a brand into native-feeling content for each platform. 
  • Comfort traveling for tournaments and shoots (8-15 weeks per year on the road). 
  • Strong organizational skills under live-event pressure and creator-cycle pace. 
  • Tennis or live sports knowledge a strong plus.

job.title: DC Bureau Producer
job.description:
Sinclair's DC Bureau is seeking a highly organized, editorially driven Producer to support coverage of the nation’s most important political stories in Washington and in the field.

The DC Bureau Producer will work closely with bureau correspondents on daily stories, including occasional scriptwriting. This role also will coordinate interviews, logistics, and editorial elements for daily bureau stories in and around Washington, while also helping coordinate coverage of political campaigns, conventions and debates.

The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, demonstrates strong political news judgment, and anticipates coverage needs while managing multiple priorities under tight deadlines.

Responsibilities include:

  • Work closely with reporters, photographers, the DC Bureau Chief, and control room teams to execute live and taped coverage.
  • Produce packages, live elements, and social/digital content as needed. Occasionally conduct interviews with lawmakers and other officials.
  • Monitor political developments, daily Washington coverage, campaign activity, legislation, and breaking news to help shape daily coverage plans.
  • Build and maintain relationships with Capitol Hill, White House, and other federal press offices; political organizations and campaign staff.
  • Research candidates, policy issues, events, and key political players to support accurate, compelling storytelling.
  • Identify, pitch, and help secure relevant political guests, sources, and interview opportunities.
  • Plan logistics for live shots, interviews, reporter travel, credentials, equipment, and transmission paths.
  • Travel, including on short notice, to support major political events and breaking news coverage.
  • Maintain a high standard for accuracy, fairness, urgency, and editorial integrity.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Journalism, Communications, Political Science, or a related field preferred.
  • Previous experience producing political, national, or breaking news coverage in a television, digital, or multiplatform news environment.
  • Experience working directly with national news correspondents and writing broadcast news packages is required.
  • Strong knowledge of national politics, Congress, the electoral process, and current events.
  • Experience covering Congress and/or the White House is preferred.
  • Excellent editorial judgment, communication, organization, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work flexible hours, including early mornings, evenings, weekends, holidays, and extended shifts during major news events.
  • Ability to work independently in the field while collaborating effectively with remote and in-studio teams.
  • Experience coordinating live television production, field logistics, and/or satellite transmission is preferred.
  • Must have a valid driver’s license and be willing to travel.
