job.title: Director, Sales and Marketing
job.description:
This Job Description May Cause Extreme Excitement and Career Growth 

At AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions, we believe a great workplace isn't just something we say — it's something you can feel when you join the team. Here, it's all about great collabs, ambition, and results but most importantly, we grow here, and we enjoy here.  We're searching for that special someone — a driven, talented individual to join our innovative media sales and marketing solutions team. In this role, you'll engage with new and existing clients and show them how our innovative media solutions can amplify their brands and deliver measurable success. If you're energized by building relationships, closing deals, and making an impact, we'd love to hear from you. 

Sound like the right fit? Check out the checklist below and if it sounds like you, hit "Apply Now" and let's chat. 

 

Your Day-to-Day (aka the Playbook) 

o Help Us Thrive: You'll be at the forefront of our efforts to amplify our sales and marketing strategy. Your main mission will be to amplify our market presence while ensuring we hit our ambitious sales targets. Your success is our success, and we believe in celebrating wins!

 

o Results-Driven: Amplify our media sales efforts by leading the sales team to implement local sales and marketing strategies to attract, grow and retain business, showcase opportunities and deliver results across our multi-media content platforms and digital assets.

 

o Strategic Planning: You'll develop and implement innovative sales and marketing strategies that will amplify our sales performance. You'll be the mastermind behind tactics that not only meet but exceed our sales goals.

 

o Team Development:  Leading, mentoring, and inspiring a team of sales professionals is no small feat! Your ability to motivate and enhance their skills will be crucial in driving performance and achieving success together.

 

o Market Analysis: Dive deep into market trends, data, and customer needs. By understanding what drives our clients, you'll identify new opportunities for expansion and growth, ensuring we stay ahead of the competition.

 

o Authentic Relationships: Building strong, lasting relationships with key clients and stakeholders is crucial. You'll be the driving force behind our brand, amplifying customer satisfaction and loyalty through excellent service.

 

What We're Looking For 

o Proven Sales Ability: We're looking for someone with experience as a Sales Director or other sales management and leadership roles, ideally in a media-related industry. We value your drive, energy, and passion for achieving results. 

 

o High-Impact: A passion for achieving sales goals, amplifying growth and a results-driven mindset will set you apart. We want someone who's excited to push boundaries in a digital first environment and make an impact.

 

o Analytical Mindset: Strong analytical skills to assess market data and trends. Your insights will help guide our sales and marketing strategies.

 

o Strong Communication Skills:  You're a natural at building relationships, negotiating and communicating effectively. Proficiency with digital tools and applications is a must. 

 

o A Passion for Leading Others: You should be able to inspire your team, amplify their strengths while guiding them toward our collective goals, foster a collaborative environment and make a difference.

 

o A Willingness to Grow:  Do you thrive in unified environments? The media world is constantly evolving, and the ability to learn, adapt, and embrace challenges in a fast-paced, digital-first environment is key.

 

The Practical Stuff 

o A valid driver's license, up-to-date insurance, and reliable transportation are necessary for connecting with clients in your community. 

 

Why Join AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions? / The Reasons You Should Hit "Apply Now" 

o Serious Work, Seriously Cool People: Be part of a bold team that values creativity, collaboration, and fun! We are all for work that is rewarding.

 

o The Compensation Package: Enjoy competitive base salary with an enticing results-based bonus structure that rewards your hard work. Our people love our benefits package.

 

o We Make a Real Difference (Not Just Talk About It): At AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions, we help local businesses thrive through advertising strategies that create tangible impacts. Our media sales team isn't just selling ads; they're the boots on the ground, making a real difference where it counts. (And yes, it feels pretty good.)

 

o Career Growth Opportunities: We believe in investing in you. That's why you'll have access to training, mentorship, and career advancement opportunities to help you thrive. We are a leader in our industry, flexing our local charm and national muscle, to provide you with options to amplify your career in your local market or join one of our AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions teams in another city.

 

AMP is us. It's you. It isn't just a name; it's a mission. A promise to amplify our reach, amplify our innovation, and most importantly, amplify you. If you're ready to grow your career and help businesses achieve their goals, we'd love to hear from you.   

  

EEO AND INCLUSIVITY

Full time positions are eligible for benefits that include participation in a retirement plan, life and disability insurance, health, dental and vision plans, flexible spending accounts, sick leave, vacation time, personal time, parental leave, and employee stock purchase plan.

job.title: Executive Producer
job.description:
Key Responsibilities

  • Help set coverage priorities, enterprise reporting, breaking-news plans, and follow-up coverage.
  • Produce and oversee assigned newscasts from planning through air, ensuring strong pacing, writing, graphics, live elements, and accuracy.
  • Manage, coach, and develop producers, reporters and digital staff; provide regular feedback and performance accountability.
  • Collaborate with the News Director, Assignment Desk, Digital and Production teams to execute station priorities and special projects.
  • Make real-time editorial decisions during breaking news, severe weather, and major live coverage.
  • Ensure all content meets the Station's editorial standards, legal and ethical guidelines, and FCC requirements.
  • Use audience data, digital metrics, and viewer feedback to improve coverage, presentation, and engagement.
  • Build distinctive local content that serves the community, reflects diverse viewpoints, and strengthens the station’s brand.
  • Maintain clear communication across shifts and ensure rundowns, digital plans, and newsroom workflows are current and organized.
  • Assist with scheduling, staffing, long-range planning, election coverage, sweeps initiatives, sponsored content and other station-wide priorities.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Journalism, Communications, or related field preferred.
  • Minimum 3–5 years of television news producing experience; prior leadership experience preferred.
  • Strong editorial judgment, broadcast writing, copy editing, and breaking-news decision-making skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead teams in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
  • Experience with newsroom systems, rundowns, digital publishing, social media, and audience analytics.
  • Strong communication, coaching, organization, and problem-solving skills.
  • Flexible availability, including early mornings, nights, weekends, holidays, and extended breaking-news coverage.

job.title: Human Resources Coordinator
job.description:
We have an exciting opportunity for an experienced HR Coordinator to work for a dynamic media company, News4/Fox11!

The HR Coordinator will help develop our team and be responsible for direct support and guidance in various functional areas of human resources, supporting the station employees. The ideal candidate has a minimum of two years of experience in human resources working in a fast-paced environment. Positive attitude, effective communication, follow-through, and attention to detail are must-have attributes for this position. The HR Coordinator supports processes associated with the employee lifecycle: recruitment, onboarding/exiting, benefits administration, training and development, and performance management. This is an excellent opportunity for someone to be closely involved in all facets of the HR function.

While no day will be the same, you’ll be involved in a variety of HR functions including, but not limited to:

  • Collaborate in a team-based environment, providing excellent, friendly, and responsive HR customer service to employees and managers.
  • Develop and maintain a deep understanding of our people, work, and culture.
  • Ensure compliance with employment regulations, including, but not limited to, FMLA, FLSA, Worker’s Compensation, ADA, and EEO.
  • Interpret and apply policies and procedures.
  • Function as a liaison between managers and the Regional HR Manager on employee relations matters, including disciplinary actions, complaints, and investigations.
  • Coordinate onboarding and offboarding exiting processes, including presenting and gathering information. 
  • Support the recruitment process, i.e., post jobs in recruiting system, prepare offer letters, initiate background screening, etc. Ensure compliance with applicable regulations in all aspects of recruitment and hiring.
  • Coordinate pre-employment processes, handle timely and professional communications with candidates, maintain tracking records, and follow through on all pre-employment requirements.
  • Support the benefits administration process by maintaining working knowledge of company benefit plans, assist in the annual Open Enrollment process including employee education and communication, and participate in audits as needed.
  • Support the performance management and review process including compliance tracking and audits.
  • Administer leave of absence cases according to company policy, benefits and state and local laws.
  • Respond to unemployment claims, worker’s compensation claims, and employment verifications.
  • Maintain electronic HR records, including personnel records.
  • Assist in planning and coordinating team trainings, morale events, and activities.
  • Perform other related duties and projects as required and assigned.
  • Maintain strict confidentiality.
  • This position is an onsite role.

 

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in human resources or related program of study
  • Minimum of two years of HR experience
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office
  • Strong interpersonal, communication and multi-tasking skills with the ability to effectively communicate with employees at all levels, both verbally and in writing.
  • Ability to exhibit a high degree of confidentiality and proper judgement under pressure and in sensitive situations.
  • A positive attitude and high level of commitment to execution of job duties.
  • Organizational and time management skills with expert attention to detail.
  • Oracle HRIS experience a plus.

job.title: Live Desk Reporter
job.description:
WKEF is looking for a take-charge Live Desk Reporter for our morning show to help us continue to grow and empower our audiences! We are seeking a motivated, energetic, creative, and aggressive anchor who can think and perform outside the box. The ideal candidate should be able to develop story ideas and gather information, prioritizing anchoring from our live desk during key morning newscasts and for our digital platforms. 

Reporting on the live desk is a specialized role.  The ideal candidate must follow what’s happening locally, nationally, globally: then produce live desk segments in real-time on the morning newscast.  They will be an active and savvy social-media user with strong digital newsgathering skills. After the newscast is finished for the day, the ideal candidate will then work as a reporter, creating content for broadcast and digital platforms.  This content may be prioritized for future morning newscasts, YouTube, and other platforms.  The ideal candidate should also have sound writing skills, a great work ethic, and a can-do attitude.

No day will look the same as a Live Desk Reporter; however the main responsibilities of the role will include:

  • Research, investigate, write, and present meaningful and timely stories for station newscasts that can be used across multiple platforms

  • Engaging with local community members

  • Reviewing material for fairness, accuracy, and balance

  • Work closely with all members of the news team, which would include Producers, Editors, Anchors, News Management, etc.

Additionally, this person should have...

  • Proven knowledge and experience working with current media creation tools and contemporary newsroom systems

  • Excel in storytelling across multiple platforms

  • Strong writing and copy-editing skills are a must

  • 2 years of experience as a reporter preferred

  • Live Desk, or similar anchoring experience preferred. 

  • Ability to produce breaking news segments independently.

  • Bachelor’s degree in journalism or related field preferred

  • Must be able to work well under pressure to meet strict deadlines

job.title: Master Control Operator
job.description:
Sinclair’s content technology is at the core of our operational excellence. We thrive on innovation and a passion for connecting people with the best local news and sports content. As we grow our content offerings and expand our broadcast, cable, and digital distribution channels, we are embracing modern technologies to fuel that growth. We are excited by the promise of cloud-first approaches and artificial intelligence in media systems. Sinclair believes that flexibility and agility will address rapidly changing media environments and we are confident that great people and great technology equal great solutions.

The role of Master Control Operator is responsible for operating the multi-channel and multi-brand control point for Sinclair Television Stations located in Bristol, VA. Duties include, but are not limited to, Live event operations, graphics insertion, playlist manipulation, and monitoring on-air quality of the TV Station to ensure all content airs accurately and reflects the traffic and programming schedules.

Additional responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Understand and follow standard operating procedures for various networks, including high profile live events and disaster recovery.
  • Modification and verification of playlists for current and future broadcast times.
  • Manipulate playlist for the different “join in progress” scenarios.
  • Consistently monitor on-air material and communicate any discrepancies to Managers.
  • Consistently ensure that playlist information and media content are accurate, which may include but is not limited to:
  • SOM/EOM of segments
  • Database Information
  • Audio specifications
  • Video specifications
  • Secondary events (GPI,SCTE104 and Graphic Insertion)
  • Content
  • Closed Captioning
  • Active Format Descriptor.
  • Ensure proper video routing.
  • Record, Ingest and Prepare content for playout.
  • Monitor equipment for performance / device failures.
  • Capture and document network processes such as timing of log elements, program run times and on air discrepancies.
  • Setup and review content prior to scheduled airtime.
  • Communicate effectively with Managers and Operators to ensure a smooth transition between shifts.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.
  • Understand and follow departmental policies.

Qualifications:

  • Minimum 1 Year experience in Master Control Operations functions.
  • Experience in Local TV Station Operations. (A PLUS)
  • Experience in Switching Live Local News and Sporting Events. (A PLUS)
  • Must have great attention to detail and ability to multitask, monitoring multiple playlists and video monitors simultaneously.
  • General understanding of industry regulations and standards for video, audio, captioning and loudness.
  • Understanding of broadcast technology such as switchers, server playout, automation systems, waveform monitors and rasterizers.
  • Ability to communicate effectively, work under stress and perform as part of a team.
  • Aptitude for operating electronic equipment and the capability to learn specialized applications.
  • Experience with Systems and Hardware for Content Ingest, Playout and Distribution.
  • Knowledge of Amagi CLOUDPORT Automation system. (A PLUS)  
  • Available to work any shift in a 24/7 Operation as well as holidays and weekends.
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite. 

 

 

The hourly compensation range for this role is $16.75 per hour. Final compensation for this role will be determined by various factors such as a candidate’s relevant work experience, skills, certifications, and geographic location. Full time positions are eligible for benefits that include participation in a retirement plan, life and disability insurance, health, dental and vision plans, flexible spending accounts, 15 paid vacation days, 2 paid personal days, 9 paid holidays, 40 hours of paid sick leave, parental leave, and employee stock purchase plan.

job.title: Master Control Supervisor
job.description:
Sinclair’s content technology is at the core of our operational excellence. We are driven by innovation and a passion for connecting audiences with the best local news and sports content.   • Three or more years of experience as a Master Control Operator, Master Control Technician, or in a comparable role within television, media, or content operations.

job.description:
KOMO News is seeking an energetic, enterprise-driven Multimedia Journalist to expand our sports coverage across broadcast, digital, social, streaming and audio platforms.

This journalist will help lead coverage of the mega-successful sports brands that define Seattle, including the Seahawks, Mariners and Seattle Storm. The position will play an important role in maximizing KOMO’s partnerships while delivering smart, visual and original coverage that connects with fans throughout Western Washington.

The successful candidate is a strong visual storyteller who can report, shoot, write, edit and publish compelling sports content independently and collaborate closely with KOMO’s Sports Director, newsroom, digital and sales teams to grow audience and create sponsorship opportunities.
 

Key Responsibilities

  • Report, shoot, write and edit original sports stories for KOMO newscasts, KOMO News.com, social platforms, streaming and podcasts.
  • Cover breaking news, games, major events, athlete features and enterprise stories involving the Seahawks, Mariners, Seattle Storm and other key Pacific Northwest teams.
  • Help maximize KOMO’s Seattle Storm partnership through distinctive reporting, features, digital content and promotional opportunities.
  • Develop stories that go beyond scores and highlights, bringing perspective, accountability and strong local relevance to sports coverage.
  • Create digital-first video, articles and social content that reaches fans throughout the day.
  • Work with the Sports Director and newsroom producers to ensure sports stories are positioned prominently when they are meaningful to the broader community.
  • Contribute to and help grow KOMO sports franchises, podcasts and special-event coverage, including sponsored content opportunities where appropriate.
  • Build and maintain relationships with teams, athletes, coaches, community leaders and fans.
  • Represent KOMO professionally at games, events and in the community.
  • Meet daily deadlines while maintaining strong editorial judgment, accuracy and fairness.
  • Work a flexible schedule that includes nights, weekends, holidays and travel as sports coverage requires.
  • Assist with general news coverage and other newsroom assignments on an occasional, as-needed basis.

 

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in journalism, communications or a related field preferred, or equivalent professional experience.
  • At least two years of reporting, shooting and editing experience preferred; sports reporting experience strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to tell memorable stories on television, digital and social platforms.
  • Strong writing, live reporting, interviewing and editorial judgment.
  • Proficiency with non-linear editing, mobile journalism tools, content-management systems and social publishing.
  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

job.title: Multimedia Journalist (MMJ)
job.description:
CBS Austin (KEYE) is looking for a Multimedia Journalist to gather and share impactful stories in one of the fastest-growing and most dynamic markets in the country.

Austin and Central Texas are home to major stories every day, from state government and rapid growth to education, public safety, technology, transportation, and the issues affecting families across our communities. We’re looking for a journalist who is curious, competitive and ready to be in the middle of those stories.

As an MMJ, you will enterprise original story ideas, develop sources and report, shoot, write and edit compelling stories for our audiences. You’ll have opportunities to work alongside a photographer on larger assignments and special coverage, while continuing to strengthen your skills as a self-sufficient multimedia journalist.

This position works three weekdays and weekend shifts, playing an important role in driving our weekend coverage while remaining connected to the weekday content center and major developing stories.

You should be comfortable producing content across platforms, and ready to grow your live presence. Our MMJs contribute daily to television, streaming, digital, social media and mobile, with opportunities to go live across platforms as stories develop.

Responsibilities include:

  • Enterprise and pitch original, impactful story ideas
  • Develop sources and build relationships throughout Central Texas
  • Report, shoot, write and edit daily news stories and content on multiple platforms
  • Deliver compelling live reports from the field
  • Collaborate with photographers, producers and other journalists on major stories and special coverage
  • Respond quickly and creatively to breaking news

 

Skills and Experience:

  • Sharp news judgment and a strong understanding of what matters to local audiences
  • Strong writing and storytelling skills, including knowledge of AP style
  • Ability to tell impactful stories on deadline
  • Excellent shooting, editing and technical skills
  • Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a collaborative newsroom
  • Ability to develop sources and enterprise stories beyond the daily news cycle
  • Must have and maintain a valid driver’s license and a good driving record

 

Requirements and Qualifications:

  • A minimum of two years of professional reporting experience is required
  • Experience with LiveU is a plus

WPEC Fall News Intern

Step inside the newsroom where stories break, voices matter, and information moves at the speed of now.

We’re looking for a passionate, curious, and driven News Intern to join our team for Fall 2026. As part of a forward-thinking media organization, you won’t just observe—you’ll actively contribute to the storytelling that informs and connects our community across platforms.

From breaking news to digital-first storytelling, this is your opportunity to experience what modern journalism really looks like.

What You’ll Do

This is a fast-paced, real newsroom—no two days are the same.

  • Create & Contribute: Assist in researching, writing, and producing news stories for broadcast and digital platforms
  • Be Where the Action Is: Work alongside reporters, anchors, producers, and photographers—both in the newsroom and out in the field
  • Pitch Ideas: Bring fresh story ideas to the table and help shape coverage that matters to our audience
  • Get Hands-On: Learn how to shoot video, frame compelling visuals, and understand what makes a story stand out
  • Behind the Scenes: Gain exposure to control room operations and how live broadcasts come together in real time

 

What You’ll Gain

This internship is designed to build real skills—not just fill a line on your résumé.

  • Hands-on experience in modern, multi-platform journalism
  • A deeper understanding of how today’s newsrooms operate—from broadcast to digital and social
  • Opportunities to build a professional portfolio with published or produced work
  • Mentorship from experienced journalists who know the industry inside and out
  • Valuable connections to jumpstart your career in media

 

To be considered, candidates must:

  • Be at least 18 years of age
  • Be currently enrolled in an undergraduate or graduate program, or a recent graduate
  • Be at least a sophomore at an accredited college/university
  • Be eligible to work in the United States
  • Be available to work on-site at WPEC in West Palm Beach, FL approximately 15 hours per week for 10 weeks
  • Be able to start between August 24th - September 14th 
  • Have reliable transportation (housing/relocation is not provided)
  • Be passionate about local news, storytelling, and community impact
  • Thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment

 

All candidates must apply through our careers portal and complete pre-employment requirements.

Why Join Us

Because journalism in 2026 is more dynamic than ever—and this is your chance to be part of it.

Join a team that values accuracy, creativity, and impact. Help tell stories that matter, develop skills that translate across platforms, and take your first step into a career in news.

Strategic Programs and AI-Enabled Operations

Location: Seattle, WA — Hybrid, with two days per week in the office

The Opportunity

Sinclair Digital is seeking a highly experienced Principal Program Manager to lead complex, high-impact initiatives across digital product, technology, and business teams. Programs may include new product or business launches, platform initiatives, operational changes, and complex or first-of-kind station transitions that require an experienced, accountable program owner.

This role combines two closely connected mandates: leading ambiguous, enterprise-scale programs and strengthening the program-management practices and AI-enabled tools that help those programs succeed. An early priority will be improving planning, governance, visibility, decision tracking, and follow-through. As that foundation matures, the role will continue to lead major program delivery while applying lessons from real programs to improve how teams plan and execute work across Sinclair Digital.

This is not a status-reporting role. The right person creates clarity where the path is still forming, brings strong business-analysis and systems-thinking skills, and introduces practical structure that improves outcomes without slowing teams down. They will create leverage beyond their own programs through reusable approaches, coaching, and scalable improvements to how work is planned and delivered.

What You Will Do

Lead major programs

  • Independently lead ambiguous, high-impact initiatives across Product, Engineering, Data, Support, station teams, and other business stakeholders.
  • Translate strategic goals into clear outcomes, decision points, milestones, owners, dependencies, success measures, and integrated delivery plans.
  • Frame choices, surface tradeoffs, and bring leaders clear recommendations so decisions are made at the right time.
  • Identify and manage program risks and cross-team dependencies early, with practical mitigation and escalation plans.
  • Drive programs through launch readiness, adoption, and operational handoff with clear ownership and follow-through.
  • Provide decision-ready visibility for working teams and senior leaders without creating unnecessary reporting overhead.

 

Improve program-management practices and tools

  • Shape a more connected, AI-enabled approach to program planning and visibility by bringing roadmaps, milestones, risks, decisions, and follow-up into clearer workflows while reducing duplicated reporting.
  • Turn lessons from complex programs into reusable practices that improve execution across multiple teams.
  • Partner with the Director of Program Management and leaders across Product, Engineering, and the business to turn agreed improvements into working practices, workflows, tools, and automation.
  • Evaluate and improve the program-management tool ecosystem by connecting and extending existing platforms and introducing new capabilities where they add clear value.
  • Define, prototype, or implement AI-assisted workflows that synthesize updates, identify missing information, surface risks and dependencies, monitor follow-ups, and prepare decision-ready communications.

 

Lead through influence

  • Build trusted partnerships across a matrixed organization and align teams with competing priorities without relying on formal authority.
  • Lead focused program reviews that help teams resolve issues, make decisions, and maintain accountability for shared commitments.
  • Mentor Program Managers and Software Development Managers who provide program coverage within their teams.
  • Raise the quality of planning, decision-making, and delivery beyond a single assigned program through practical coaching and scalable operating improvements.
  • Solve systemic problems through influence, build alignment across functions, and turn agreed direction into lasting improvements.

 

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of program management, technical program management, product operations, business systems, or related experience.
  • Sustained success independently leading complex, high-visibility digital or software programs across multiple teams, from early definition through launch and operational adoption.
  • Strong working knowledge of digital product development and the software delivery lifecycle, including experience partnering with developers to define requirements, workflows, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and implementation plans.
  • Strong business-analysis and process-design skills, including the ability to understand current workflows, identify root problems, and distinguish valuable governance from unnecessary process.
  • Demonstrated experience improving program-management practices, governance, tools, or operating workflows across multiple teams.
  • Proven ability to influence across functions and levels without direct authority, including regular work with Director- and VP-level stakeholders.
  • Experience using AI-assisted tools, workflow automation, rapid prototyping, or similar approaches to improve how work is understood, coordinated, or delivered.
  • Hands-on experience with enterprise work-management and collaboration platforms such as Jira and Confluence, or comparable tools.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and visual communication skills, with the judgment to turn complex information into clear choices and recommendations.
  • Ability to operate independently, move between strategy and detail, and deliver results with limited oversight.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in digital media, local news, sports, streaming, content platforms, or another multi-brand consumer environment.
  • Experience improving program-management systems, governance practices, internal platforms, or operating workflows at scale.
  • Experience working with developers to translate business and operating needs into requirements, workflows, prototypes, and delivery plans.
  • Experience with AI agents, no-code or low-code tools, analytics, and workflow automation.
  • Experience with Jira, Confluence, Smartsheet, dashboarding tools, or comparable work-management platforms.

job.title: Product Designer II
job.description:
Sinclair Digital is seeking a Product Designer II to join the team! 

Major Goals:

Take ownership of assigned product experiences from discovery through implementation and iteration. Build a strong understanding of users, business goals, technology, and product performance. Collaborate with product, engineering, research, analytics, and stakeholders to create thoughtful, accessible solutions. Use Figma, research, data, and approved AI tools such as ChatGPT and Codex to improve design efficiency, quality, and outcomes. Share work early, communicate decisions clearly, and contribute to the growth of the Product Design team.

Key Result Areas:

Visual Design

• Demonstrates strong knowledge of layout, typography, color, visual hierarchy, responsive design, and platform

conventions.

• Creates polished experiences that support Sinclair's brand and meet user, product, and business needs.

• Produces accessible, inclusive designs with enough detail to guide implementation across platforms and screen sizes.

 

UX Design

• Creates clear information architecture, user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and interaction specifications.

• Considers the complete journey, including loading, empty, error, success, permission, and edge-case states.

• Uses research, analytics, feedback, and testing to understand problems, support decisions, and validate solutions.

 

Patterns

• Uses established design-system components and patterns to create consistent, intuitive, and scalable experiences.

• Balances shared patterns with platform conventions and the needs of each product and audience.

• Identifies gaps and helps improve, extend, and document reusable patterns across Sinclair products.

 

Product Thinking

• Understands the vision, audience, business goals, success measures, and constraints for the assigned product area.

• Connects design decisions to user needs, product objectives, technical feasibility, and measurable outcomes.

• Works with partners to clarify requirements and scope, then uses post-launch data to identify improvements.

 

Process

• Participates in discovery, exploration, validation, delivery, design QA, and post-launch evaluation.

• Explores multiple approaches, explains key decisions, and independently manages assigned work while

communicating risks and dependencies.

• Uses approved AI tools for appropriate tasks such as research synthesis, ideation, rapid prototyping,

documentation, and quality review.

• Validates AI-assisted work for accuracy, accessibility, brand alignment, bias, and technical feasibility.

• Supports implementation through organized files, clear specifications, developer walkthroughs, collaboration, and design QA.

 

Toolkit

• Demonstrates strong proficiency in Figma, including components, variables, prototypes, shared libraries, and

developer handoff.

• Uses ChatGPT and approved AI tools to support research, ideation, writing, accessibility reviews, and

documentation.

• Uses Codex and similar tools to build functional prototypes, explore feasibility, strengthen handoff, and support design QA.

• Verifies AI-generated work, maintains ownership of final decisions, and follows company requirements for privacy,

security, intellectual property, and responsible AI use.

 

Transparency

• Shares work early and regularly with design, cross-functional partners, and stakeholders.

• Communicates assumptions, unresolved questions, tradeoffs, risks, and next steps.

• Invites constructive feedback, documents important decisions, and keeps partners informed of changes.

 

Fluency

• Communicates effectively with product, engineering, research, analytics, editorial, and business partners.

• Understands different disciplines' priorities and constraints and accounts for them when developing solutions.

• Builds trust and works through scope and technical challenges while protecting the core user experience.

 

Communication

• Demonstrates strong written, verbal, visual, and presentation skills.

• Explains complex ideas and design decisions clearly, using relevant context and evidence.

• Keeps discussions focused, remains open to other perspectives, and communicates actionable next steps.

 

Mentorship

• Provides thoughtful, direct, and respectful feedback during critiques and project reviews.

• Supports less-experienced designers by sharing knowledge and constructive guidance when appropriate.

• Seeks coaching from Senior and Lead Designers to strengthen product thinking, craft, communication, and technical fluency.

 

Culture

• Identifies and supports design-led improvements within the assigned product area.

• Participates in critiques, workshops, team initiatives, and shared learning opportunities.

• Shares useful findings, patterns, templates, and AI-assisted workflows with curiosity, respect, and accountability.

 

Above the Line:

• Authentic Communication. Listen carefully, communicate directly and respectfully, and confirm shared

understanding.

• Constructive Negotiation. Address disagreements and tradeoffs collaboratively to move work forward.

• Impeccable Coordination. Keep key partners aligned on decisions, responsibilities, progress, risks, and changes.

job.title: Product Owner
job.description:
At Sinclair, the Product Owner is accountable for maximizing the value, reliability, and continuous improvement of established SaaS platform(s) used by internal teams. The role balances product enhancements with production stability, incident-driven priorities, technical health, vendor coordination, and evolving user needs. Working closely with business stakeholders, support, operations, and external providers, the Product Owner establishes clear product goals, orders the backlog, evaluates outcomes, and ensures that changes deliver measurable value.

Required Experience & Skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 3+ years of Product Ownership experience, including Agile Scrum practices.

Demonstrated ability to:

  • Lead through influence, facilitate decisions, resolve competing priorities, and align business, technical, operational, and vendor stakeholders.
  • Analyze complex software behavior, reproduce issues, assess business impact, and coordinate diagnosis and resolution with technical, support, and vendor teams.
  • Create clear, appropriately scaled product artifacts, including goals, roadmap outcomes, user stories, acceptance criteria, nonfunctional requirements, defects, operational improvements, and decision records.
  • Prioritize and organize customer feedback, product data, support cases, incident trends, and operational metrics to guide product and service performance.
  • Customer-focused mindset with empathy, curiosity, sound judgment, and a commitment to continuous learning and improvement.
  • Proactive, adaptable, and effective when working through ambiguity, change, and deadline pressure.


Responsibilities:

Business Intake and Prioritization:

  • Build relationships across departments to understand business processes, user needs, pain points, and desired outcomes.
  • Gather and clarify requirements with stakeholders, end users, and subject matter experts; organize requests for prioritization based on business value, user impact, risk, dependencies, and organizational objectives.

Backlog and Roadmap Management:

  • Maintain a clear backlog and roadmap covering enhancements, defects, operational improvements, and support-driven needs.
  • Communicate priorities, requirements, constraints, and expected outcomes to stakeholders and vendor(s).

Vendor Governance, Delivery, and Validation:

  • Review vendor solutions, plans, estimates, dependencies, delivery progress, commitments, and service-level obligations; escalate gaps and risks.
  • Coordinate QA and UAT for release readiness, including defect resolution, business impacts, communications, training, and support readiness

Production Health and Continuous Improvement:

  • Monitor service performance, incidents, recurring defects, user feedback, and operational metrics to identify risks and improvement opportunities.
  • Review major incidents, root causes, corrective actions, and delivered outcomes with support, operations, and the vendor.

Product Knowledge and Documentation:

  • Maintain product knowledge and essential documentation, including goals, requirements, decisions, roadmap outcomes, and release notes.
  • Other duties as assigned.

 

The base salary compensation range for this role is $85,000 to $105,000. Final compensation for this role will be determined by various factors such as a candidate’s relevant work experience, skills, certifications, and geographic location. job.title: Product Support Specialist
job.description:
Sinclair Digital is hiring a Product Support Specialist! Join Sinclair Digital, the innovation engine behind the largest and most diversified television broadcasting company in the country.

Sinclair Digital is hiring a Product Support Specialist! Join Sinclair Digital, the innovation engine behind the largest and most diversified television broadcasting company in the country. We’re at the forefront of transforming how local news and television are produced, distributed, and consumed across multiple platforms.

Our Product Support Specialists, play a crucial role in providing technical support for our Content Management System and our News station’s websites and mobile apps.  They are responsible for conducting administrative-level tasks such as creating new users, diagnosing and resolving technical issues, providing guidance to users, escalating issues to our software development team, and working closely with our software engineers to ensure that requests are prioritized and handled properly.  

Responsibilities: 

  • Provide technical support to internal users of our CMS software application via phone, email and ticketing system. 
  • Troubleshoot user-reported issues, diagnose root causes, and identify solutions. 
  • Research and resolve technical problems using internal knowledge bases and collaborating with senior team members, and developers. 
  • Document solutions and frequently asked questions (FAQs) to build a robust internal knowledge base. 
  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of our systems through ongoing training and keeping abreast of new features and updates. 
  • Provide clear and concise instructions to users with varying levels of technical expertise. 
  • Meet or exceed the Service Level Agreements for time to respond and time to resolve. 
  • Escalate issues that require software development level support.  Generate tickets with thorough detail on what is required, the priority of the issue, and include thorough steps for issue recreation. 
  • Attend daily standup meetings with Engineering, and provide feedback on new items to triage. 
  • Test and validate bug fixes. 
  • With other team members, take on-call shifts from 5:00 PM to 5:00 AM on a rotational basis. When on-call, you must be available to get online and assist customers if any emergency issues come through. 

Qualifications: 

  • At least 2 years of experience in a technical support role, preferably with software-related products. 
  • Strong understanding of web technologies and content management systems. 
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills. 
  • Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills. 
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team. 
  • Familiarity with ticketing systems and support tools. 
  • Understanding of the Software Development Lifecycle.   

Preferred Qualifications: 

  • Experience supporting software used in the media or news industry. 
  • Experience with video technologies. 
  • Knowledge of web development languages such as HTML, CSS and JavaScript. .
  • Understanding of database management systems. 
  • Experience with tools including Jira, Confluence, Slack, Google Analytics. 

 Attributes:

  • Positive Attitude 
    • Patient and empathetic  
    • Enthusiastic and helpful 
    • Team player  
  • Good Communicator 
    • Active listener  
    • Professional demeanor  
  • Problem-Solving Skills 
    • Analytical and methodical 
    • Resourceful

    • Commitment to continuous learning 
  • Adaptable 
  • Good time management skills  
  • Strong work ethic 
  • Natural leader who inspires and motivates others

job.title: Sales and Marketing Assistant
job.description:
This Job Description May Cause Extreme Excitement and Career Growth 

At AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions, we believe a great workplace isn't just something we say — it's something you can feel when you join the team. Here, it's all about great collabs, ambition, and results but most importantly, we grow here, and we enjoy here.  We're searching for that special someone — a driven, talented individual to join our innovative media sales and marketing solutions team. In this role, you'll engage with new and existing clients and show them how our innovative media solutions can amplify their brands and deliver measurable success. If you're energized by building relationships, closing deals, and making an impact, we'd love to hear from you. 

Sound like the right fit? Check out the checklist below and if it sounds like you, hit "Apply Now" and let's chat. 

 

Your Day-to-Day (aka the Playbook) 

o Help Us Thrive: Amplify our media sales efforts by supporting our sales operations. Your success is our success, and we believe in celebrating wins!

 

o Unleash Your Potential: Dive headfirst into the exciting world of media sales, where every interaction is an opportunity to make a lasting impression!

 

o Build Relationships: Connect with internal and external clients, understanding their needs to provide support. 

 

o Innovate and Inspire: We value creativity at all levels of our organization and encourage you to think outside the box to find new ways to support our business and elevate our brand.

 

o Collaborate and Grow: Work closely with our focused media sales teams to ensure a top-notch customer experience. Together, we'll amplify our impact and achieve remarkable results!

From onboarding to ongoing mentorship, we invest in your success with training programs that set you up for long-term growth.

We are a leader in our industry, flexing our local charm and national muscle, providing you with options to amplify your career in your local market or join one of our AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions teams in another city.  

 

Comprehensive Media Education (We Are Your Power Source!): New to the industry? We've got you covered with training programs that turn curiosity into expertise.  

 

AMP is us. It's you. It isn't just a name; it's a mission. A promise to amplify our reach, amplify our innovation, and most importantly, amplify you. If you're ready to grow your career and help businesses achieve their goals, we'd love to hear from you.

job.title: Senior Content Creator
job.description:
Are you an experienced creative storyteller who can lead high-quality production from idea through final delivery? Do you strive for “Excellence in Everything” while helping shape stronger creative, support teammates, and keep production moving?

Join Sinclair, Inc. and the Agile Creative Content Engagement Team (ACCET) as a Senior Content Creator based in our Asheville, NC TV station group. This senior hands-on production role is focused on writing, producing, shooting, editing, and delivering high-impact creative content across multiple markets and platforms.

As a Senior Content Creator, you will own complex client, market, regional, and national creative projects while helping guide creative execution, strengthen production quality, and support the development of other Content Creators. This role is ideal for someone with strong production judgment, advanced hands-on skills, and the ability to lead by example without losing connection to the work.

This is a senior creative role for someone who can step into the most important projects, shape scripts and concepts, produce shoots, solve edits, protect quality standards, and help bring priority work across the finish line.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

As an ACCET Senior Content Creator, you will create and help lead commercial, branded, digital, promotional, and multi-platform content for assigned markets while supporting strong creative quality, clear communication, and reliable delivery.

Lead High-Quality Creative Production

  • Write, produce, shoot, edit, and deliver commercial spots, branded content, digital campaigns, promotional creative, and other client deliverables.

  • Own high-profile, complex, or priority projects from concept through final delivery, including scripting, pre-production, field production, editing, graphics, audio, revisions, approvals, and exports.

  • Develop creative that is clear, compelling, strategically aligned, and appropriate for the audience, platform, client, and market need.

  • Maintain high standards for storytelling, visual quality, brand consistency, pacing, sound, graphics, and overall production value.

  • Use strong creative judgment to solve production challenges, improve creative outcomes, and protect the quality of the final product.

 

Support Market, Regional, and National Production Needs

  • Produce creative work for multiple assigned markets while balancing deadlines, priorities, revisions, and client expectations.

  • Support high-profile, priority, multi-market, regional, or national productions as business needs require.

  • Coordinate production details with Client Services Managers, Strategists, Project Managers, Sales teams, clients, and market stakeholders.

  • Help keep production moving during urgent deadlines, high-volume periods, priority campaigns, or complex client deliverables.

  • Adapt quickly to changing production needs, shifting priorities, production constraints, and time-sensitive requests.

 

Provide Creative Leadership and Team Support

  • Serve as a senior creative resource for Content Creators, helping support quality, clarity, creative direction, and production problem-solving.

  • Provide constructive feedback, practical guidance, and creative support to help teammates strengthen scripts, shoots, edits, graphics, audio, and final delivery.

  • Mentor and support Content Creators through knowledge sharing, production best practices, and feedback that helps raise the overall quality of the team.

  • Help translate client, Sales, and market needs into clear creative direction that can be executed effectively.

  • Model strong professionalism, accountability, collaboration, and creative ownership across ACCET.

 

Collaborate Across Teams and Maintain Workflow Standards

  • Partner with Sales, Client Services, Brand, Digital, Project Managers, and market leadership to understand goals and expectations.

  • Participate in creative discussions, campaign planning, production conversations, and feedback exchanges as needed.

  • Communicate clearly about project status, creative needs, production challenges, asset requirements, and delivery timelines.

  • Use Adobe Workfront and other Sinclair systems to track assignments, respond to requests, update project status, and support workflow accuracy.

  • Follow ACCET production standards, file management expectations, brand guidelines, quality-control steps, and approval processes.

 

WHAT MAKES THIS ROLE SPECIAL

  • A senior hands-on creative role with impact across multiple television markets.

  • Opportunity to lead and produce high-profile commercial, branded, digital, and promotional content.

  • A chance to support local, regional, and national creative work inside ACCET.

  • A role that combines advanced production skill with mentorship, creative judgment, and team support.

  • A fast-moving environment where storytelling, craft, collaboration, problem-solving, and creative ownership matter.

 

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • Advanced writing, producing, shooting, editing, storytelling, communication, and organizational skills.

  • 3+ years of experience in commercial production, broadcast television, creative services, video production, post-production, digital content, agency work, or a related field preferred.

  • Ability to independently lead polished commercial, branded, digital, or promotional content from concept through delivery.

  • Strong understanding of video production workflows, including concept development, scripting, shooting, editing, graphics, audio, client approvals, revisions, and final export.

  • Proficiency with Adobe Creative Cloud, including Premiere Pro; experience with After Effects, Photoshop, Illustrator, Audition, or similar tools is a plus.

  • Familiarity with digital video, social media content, OTT/CTV advertising, branded content, and multi-platform campaign production preferred.

  • Experience providing creative feedback, mentoring teammates, or helping guide production quality is preferred.

  • Comfort working in project management systems; Adobe Workfront experience is a plus.

  • Ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines, stakeholders, and priorities in a fast-paced environment.

  • Ability to lift, carry, and move production equipment as needed; valid driver license and good driving record may be required for production-related needs.

  • A proactive mindset focused on creativity, collaboration, accountability, quality, efficiency, and continuous improvement.

 

YOU SHOULD APPLY IF

  • You are an experienced creator who wants to lead by example while still staying hands-on in the work.

  • You can write, shoot, produce, edit, shape creative, and solve production challenges at a high level.

  • You enjoy helping teammates grow while maintaining strong standards for creative quality and delivery.

  • You can manage several projects at once while keeping priorities clear, quality high, and deadlines on track.

  • You communicate clearly, take feedback well, and work effectively with creative, Sales, client, and leadership partners.

  • You want to help ACCET deliver meaningful, high-quality creative work across multiple markets and platforms.

 

WORKING HOURS AND TRAVEL

  • Typical schedule is Monday to Friday during standard business hours.

  • Schedule flexibility may be required based on production needs, client deliverables, station events, regional or national productions, or other time-sensitive projects.

  • Some longer days, nights, weekends, or holidays may be required based on business needs.

  • Travel may be required but is expected to be infrequent.

 

If you are ready to lead high-quality creative execution, stay hands-on in the production process, support a strong creative team, and help ACCET deliver impactful work across multiple markets, we want to hear from you.

job.title: Senior Information Security Engineer
job.description:
The Senior Information Security Engineer will support an enterprise security program including conducting deep-dive Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) assessments, developing and delivering security awareness training campaigns, identifying, tracking, and coordinating vulnerability remediations based on threat intelligence feeds, performing litigation support and investigations, establishing policy enforcement processes, and engineering automations to improve time to deliver using Artificial Intelligence (AI) or automation platforms.

The applicant must have prior experience engineering security solutions with successful deployments in complex commercial enterprise environments. The candidate should have prior experience in a security operations or engineering role, with expertise conducting third-party, software, and vendor risk assessments. Additional required skills are, developing and enhancing security policies and standards, and hands-on knowledge of cloud (SaaS) and hybrid network infrastructure environments, establishing automations to improve accuracy and speed of outcomes, and performing disaster recovery (DR) /Continuity of Operations (COOP) assessments. The candidate will possess strong and polished communication skills, willingness and ability to present security topics to internal and external customers and thrive in a highly visible and fast-paced role. 

Responsibilities:

Process & Execution

  • Conduct high-quality and timely third-party/vendor/service provider/software risk assessments, with the ability to meet SLAs and communicate effectively with all stakeholders.
  • Contributes to the creation and maturation of information security policies and processes. 
  • Identifies opportunities to automate manual processes and successfully engineers and delivers on process improvements according to assigned timelines.
  • Develops and delivers Disaster Recovery and Continuity of Operations risk assessments to business units successfully establishing resiliency plans for the company. 
  • Assist with the governance of the enterprise Policy Exception process including stakeholder engagement, driving completion with internal teams, and providing balanced reports that will be visible to senior leaders.
  • Create, adapt, and enhance weekly metrics to measure program effectiveness.
  • Evaluate security architectures including the ability to identify risks, compensating controls, and mitigation plans.
  • Develop custom security awareness and phishing campaigns to elevate employee knowledge of current trends and threats to Sinclair.
  • Perform, and maintain litigation and data retention holds using eDiscovery and other actions to support Sinclair Legal requests.
  • Ability to multitask, prioritize, and remain organized with simultaneous assignments while remaining flexible and resilient. 
  • Maintain a high level of professionalism and integrity with the ability to effectively communicate with internal and external stakeholders. 
  • Ability to think strategically, plan methodically, and execute tactically.
  • Take ownership of personal and professional development needed to excel in the role.

Collaboration & Partnerships

  • Apply excellent communication skills to efficiently collaborate with company stakeholders and business partners.
  • Ability and prior experience delivering live training sessions to diverse audiences.
  • Evaluate and recommend new products, maintain knowledge of emerging technologies, and maximize value from existing tool sets to ensure return on investment. 
  • Demonstrate strong problem-solving skills by identifying gaps or issues and clearly formulating solutions.
  • Ensure compliance with Sinclair policies and standards by communicating requirements to internal stakeholders.
  • Proactively respond to information security tickets and requests according to team SLA.
  • Collaborate with third parties to remediate risks to effectively minimize attack surface.
  • Operating with a strong sense of teamwork and personal accountability.

Performance Improvement

  • Identify areas of improvement within the security team to maintain a level of excellence.
  • Design, document, and implement procedures for analyzing and evaluating risk. 
  • Proactively and effectively look for ways to improve and optimize processes and techniques. 
  • Research emerging technologies and provide options to leadership for problem solving. 
  • Champion collaboration amongst teams, quality execution on assignments, and take personal accountability for deliverables.
  • Thrive within fast-paced operational environment requiring priority adjustments, multi-tasking, and a high-level of communication skills.
  • Ability to self-motivate and go the extra mile to ensure team success. 
  • Maintain a positive and customer-oriented approach to daily operations.         
  • Comfortable working directly with other teams such as Legal, Privacy, and IT.

 

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Security, Information Technology, or related discipline. 
  • 7 years of relevant work experience or a combined background in the following areas: third-party risk management, security operations, security engineering, risk management, vulnerability management.
  • Experience with enterprise threat intelligence and third-party risk management platforms.
  • Demonstrated experience leveraging artificial intelligence (AI) and automation tools to streamline workflows, improve operational efficiency, and enhance decision-making.
  • Understanding of SOC-2, ISO-27001, and NIST SP 800 “series” frameworks with the ability to identify and mitigate control gaps.
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with an ability to present complex information to audiences of varying subject knowledge. 
  • Solid technical background with the ability to understand network and systems architectures. 
  • Prior experience working in commercial multi-cloud provider environments.
  • Industry certification required in one of the following areas: (e.g., CISSP, CISM, CRISC, Security+, CISA, or equivalent).
  • Basic knowledge of current data privacy laws (CCPA/CPRA, GDPR).
  • Prior experience in the broadcast/media entertainment industries preferred.
  • Experience conducting litigation holds, retention requests, and eDiscovery is a big plus.
  • Commercial enterprise experience is required. 

 

Please note that this position is not eligible for visa sponsorship, including employer sponsorship for an H-1B visa, OPT-STEM employment, etc.

job.title: Senior Manager, Media & Technical Operations
job.description:
Drive Auto is seeking a collaborative, hands-on Senior Manager, Media & Technical Operations to lead the teams responsible for paid-media execution and technical support. This role is ideal for an experienced digital advertising leader who combines deep paid media expertise with strong operational judgment, people leadership, and a commitment to high-quality client delivery.

The Senior Manager will lead the Drive Auto Media and Tech Support Managers, providing direction, coaching, and accountability across both teams. This person will ensure campaigns and technical work are delivered accurately and efficiently; maintain strong support and service standards; and keep the organization prepared for changes across advertising platforms and emerging channels.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and coach the Drive Auto Media and Tech Support teams, fostering a collaborative, accountable, and high-performing culture.

  • Oversee the Drive Auto Media team’s execution of paid campaigns, including campaign builds, optimization practices, quality standards, testing, and performance analysis.

  • Provide subject matter expertise and leadership across Google Ads, Meta, TikTok, and other platforms, including emerging advertising platforms, ensuring teams remain current on meaningful platform changes, new capabilities, and evolving best practices.

  • Evaluate the operational impact of platform updates and new advertising products; determine when the team should test, adopt, document, or train on new capabilities.

  • Oversee the Tech Support team’s work across platform configuration, technical setup, QA, implementations, migrations, troubleshooting, projects, and escalations.

  • Monitor and improve service-level expectations, customer service, workflow consistency, and operational processes across the Tech Support function.

  • Partner closely with the Drive Auto Onboarding, Customer Support, and Account Management teams to deliver media campaigns, issue resolution, and platform deliverables on time and with accuracy.

  • Confidently represent Drive Auto in client-facing conversations, presenting recommendations clearly, making decisive calls when needed, and guiding stakeholders toward the solution that best serves the client and the business.

  • Collaborate with Sales, leadership, and other internal teams to align on operational needs, resolve escalations, and support a strong client experience.

  • Mentor and develop team members through regular feedback, coaching, recognition, and training opportunities.

  • Lead by example through professionalism, adaptability, sound judgment, and a commitment to continuous improvement.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in digital advertising, paid media, automotive marketing, or automotive technology

  • 2+ years of experience leading and developing a team

  • Hands-on experience building and optimizing paid search and paid social campaigns

  • Deep working knowledge of Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager; experience with TikTok and other digital advertising platforms 

  • Experience overseeing campaign execution, optimization, QA, and performance analysis

  • Experience with technical support, platform implementation, configuration, migrations, troubleshooting, ticket workflows, and client escalations

  • Strong understanding of digital advertising platform changes, industry trends, and the ability to translate them into practical guidance for operational teams

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify operational issues and implement effective improvements

  • Demonstrated ability to balance established standards with thoughtful flexibility, using sound judgment to make client and business appropriate decisions

  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and leadership skills, with the ability to work effectively across teams and levels of the organization

 

This position will report into the Lafayette, LA office on a hybrid schedule. Drive Auto is a data-driven marketing and technology company helping automotive dealerships reach in-market shoppers and achieve measurable growth. Our collaborative team combines proprietary data, innovative technology, and digital marketing expertise to shape the future of automotive advertising.

job.title: Senior Video Producer, Long-Form & YouTube - Freelance
job.description:
Tennis Channel is looking for a freelance Senior Video Producer to help lead our long-form and YouTube content. You'll partner directly with the Head of Social and our two other video leads to shape and execute video strategy toward our team's growth goals, with a particular focus on long-form programming and the YouTube channel. This is a producer role, not a pure editor role: you'll concept and create content, direct shoots, and jump into edits yourself when needed — while also directing post producers/editors to bring bigger projects to finish.

This freelance role is expected to be approximately 30-40 hours per week, with schedules aligned to tournament coverage needs. Flexibility to work weekends may be required during key tournaments and high-volume event periods. This freelance engagement is anticipated to run through December 2026, with the potential to be extended through the end of 2027 based on business needs and performance.

This is a freelance role and onsite located in Santa Monica, CA. 

In this role, you will...

  • Partner with the Head of Social and the social video leads to shape and execute video strategy toward the team's shared goals, with a particular focus on long-form content and YouTube channel strategy.

  • Concept and pitch long-form and serialized video ideas and formats for YouTube, and help build out the plans to ship them.

  • Produce content start to finish — concept, shoot/direct shoots, and edit hands-on when needed.

  • Direct and collaborate with post producers/editors on longer or higher-lift projects — set creative direction, give cut feedback, and see projects through to finish.

  • Build and manage timelines — post-production schedules and on-site content/shoot plans — to keep projects and deliverables on track.

  • Cover live tournament action, reactive/trend-driven content, and other short-form needs as they come up alongside long-form priorities.

  • Bring recommendations on YouTube performance and long-form content opportunities to the Head of Social and video leads.

  • Maintain Tennis Channel's brand voice and visual quality bar across every deliverable.

Key Qualifications:

  • 5+ years in video production, including experience concepting and producing long-form or serialized content.

  • A track record contributing to YouTube channel strategy and growth, not just producing video for it.

  • Experience directing and collaborating with post producers/editors — comfortable giving creative direction and cut feedback, not only cutting everything yourself.

  • Project management experience — able to build and own timelines, post-production schedules, and on-site content plans, and keep multiple projects moving at once.

  • Strong hands-on shooting and editing skills (Adobe Premiere Pro) to jump into edits when needed.

  • Comfortable working on-site at live tennis events, capturing courtside and behind-the-scenes footage.

  • Sports or live-event production experience a plus.

 

Tennis Channel is proud to be equal opportunity employer and a drug free workplace. Employment practices will not be influenced or affected by virtue of an applicant's or employee's race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, military or veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.

 

About Tennis Channel

Tennis Channel is the only multiplatform destination dedicated solely to tennis year-round. Together, the Tennis Channel flagship network, Tennis Channel 2, and the Tennis Channel app (tennischannel.com) deliver the most accessible and concentrated single-sport coverage anywhere. As the exclusive U.S. home of the ATP Tour and WTA Tour, Tennis Channel features live coverage of every Masters 1000 tournament — including Indian Wells, the Miami Open, Madrid, Rome, Cincinnati, and more — alongside live studio programming including its premier series, TC Live. Tennis Channel 2, a free FAST channel available in over 100 million homes, brings fans matches from across the globe at every level of the game. The Tennis Channel app brings it all together in one place, delivering live and on-demand matches, original content, and a personalized multi-view experience for fans, available on mobile and connected TV devices. Owned by Sinclair, Tennis Channel is also a co-owner of PickleballTV (pickleballtv.com), a joint venture with the Professional Pickleball Association.

job.title: Specialist, Sales and Marketing
job.description:
This Job Description May Cause Extreme Excitement and Career Growth 

At AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions, we believe a great workplace isn't just something we say — it's something you can feel when you join the team. Here, it's all about great collabs, ambition, and results but most importantly, we grow here, and we enjoy here.  We're searching for that special someone — a driven, talented individual to join our innovative media sales team. In this role, you'll engage with new and existing clients and show them how our innovative media solutions can amplify their brands and deliver measurable success. If you're energized by building relationships, closing deals, and making an impact, we'd love to hear from you. 

 

Sound like the right fit? Check out the checklist below and if it sounds like you, hit "Apply Now" and let's chat. 

 

Your Day-to-Day (aka the Playbook) 

Help Brands Thrive: 

Join our media sales team and play a pivotal role in helping brands and companies grow. By identifying new opportunities, building strong client relationships, and delivering impactful solutions, you'll showcase how our multi-media content platforms and digital assets can drive meaningful results for our partners. 

 

Your focus will be on helping clients achieve their goals, ensuring that every campaign is a success. When our clients win, we win—and we believe in celebrating those victories together! 

  

Make Connections: Embrace your powers of persuasion and make every handshake and meeting count! Every interaction is a chance to build a genuine connection and show clients how we can help them succeed. You're not just selling; you're building partnerships. You're helping businesses find the right audience in the right place at the right time. When we say One Partner, Endless Possibilities, we mean it! 

 

Be A Trusted Guide: In this role, you'll connect with clients on a human level, understand their unique needs, and craft tailored sales and marketing solutions that deliver results. As their trusted advisor, you'll help them navigate the ever-evolving marketing landscape, ensuring every step of the journey is planned with care and precision.

job.title: Sr. Content Creator
job.description:
ABC7 is seeking an experienced, creative, and highly motivated Senior Content Creator to join our team. This role is ideal for a versatile storyteller who can take an idea from concept to completion—producing, shooting, writing, and editing compelling short- and long-form content for both television and digital platforms. The successful candidate will bring strong creative instincts, technical expertise, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment where deadlines are tight and priorities can shift quickly. 

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

As a Senior Content Creator, you’ll be the primary videographer for all kinds of marketing projects, including promos, commercials, and lifestyle segments. You’ll edit content that stops thumbs, turns heads, and moves audiences to action. You’ll serve as a creative partner to internal and external clients, translating their goals into compelling visual stories.

You’ll collaborate with sales teams, marketers, and clients to deliver strategic storytelling that balances emotion, brand objectives, and performance.

YOUR DAILY PLAYLIST:

  • Shoot, edit, produce and write projects ranging from quick-turn social content to longer-form branded pieces 
  • Create high-quality, scroll-stopping content for client campaigns across TV, social, web, and streaming platforms 
  • Lead creative execution for branded content, commercials, promotional spots, and social-first video 
  • Serve as the creative lead, working closely with internal teams and external clients 
  • Collaborate directly with clients to develop concepts, manage expectations, and deliver polished creative solutions 
  • Manage asset distribution across the network and track deliverables through Adobe Workfront 

 

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE STAGE:

  • A passion for visual storytelling with a client-focused, marketing-driven mindset
  • Strong camera, lighting, and production skills that elevate brand storytelling 
  • Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud, including Premiere Pro, After Effects, Photoshop, and Illustrator 
  • Confidence working directly with clients and internal stakeholders as a creative lead 
  • The ability to run a solo shoot or collaborate seamlessly as part of a team 
  • A portfolio that demonstrates strong branded content, commercial, or promotional work 

  

What skills do you need to be successful in this role?

  • Extensive video shooting experience with broadcast and DSLR cameras 
  • Ability to shoot, edit, and write content that tells a compelling story 
  • A strong understanding of fundamental design principles, color theory, typography, and composition 
  • Non-linear editing experience using Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, Photoshop, and Illustrator 
  • Advanced knowledge of the post-production process, including media management and encoding video into various formats 
  • Ability to manage a variety of projects and work with varying production styles while employing strong communication skills 
  • Advanced knowledge of high-definition (HD) cameras, videography, motion graphics, and creative lighting techniques 
  • Strong interpersonal skills to navigate internal and external employee and client relationships 
  • Must maintain a valid driver’s license and good driving record 
  • Ability to routinely lift, carry, and move equipment in excess of 40 lbs. 
  • A college degree is preferred

 

WORKING HOURS AND TRAVEL:

  • Typical schedule is Monday to Friday during standard business hours.
  • Schedule flexibility may be required based on production needs, client deliverables, regional, national or international productions, or other time-sensitive projects.
  • Travel may be required.
