job.title: SVP, Sports Podcast Revenue
job.description:
AMP Sports is seeking a visionary, commercially minded Senior Vice President of Sports Podcast Revenue to lead revenue strategy, advertiser partnerships, sponsorship development, and commercial performance across its growing sports podcast portfolio. This executive will identify, develop, and scale high-value revenue opportunities across podcasts, digital video, social-first programming, talent-led franchises, and multi-platform sports experiences.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead the sales strategy, client growth plan, and revenue performance for AMP Sports’ podcast and audio portfolio.
  • Develop and grow direct advertiser, agency, sponsorship, branded-content and strategic-partnership revenue opportunities.
  • Identify high-potential sports franchises, talent-led properties, audience segments, and cultural moments that can be transformed into scalable commercial offerings.
  • Partner with AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions to create compelling sales narratives, sponsorship packages, integrated marketing programs, and advertiser solutions.
  • Work alongside Sports Partnerships & Activations to develop premium partnership opportunities involving athletes, teams, leagues, live events, and brand activations.
  • Establish revenue targets, forecasts, pipeline discipline, pricing strategy, inventory models, and performance reporting for the business.
  • Build commercially viable packaging across podcast, video, social, digital, live, broadcast, and other relevant Sinclair platforms.
  • Develop relationships with senior brand marketers, agencies, media buyers, sports partners, platforms, talent representatives, and other strategic partners.
  • Identify new revenue streams, including branded content, custom programs, affiliate opportunities, licensing, commerce, events, subscriptions, and emerging platform monetization.
  • Partner with content, audience, analytics, legal, finance, and business affairs teams to ensure commercial opportunities are executable, brand-safe, and aligned with rights obligations.
  • Use audience data, market intelligence, advertiser feedback, and revenue performance to inform commercial strategy, product development, and investment priorities.
  • Recruit, lead, and develop a high-performing commercial team with clear accountability, strong collaboration, and a results-oriented culture.

  • Represent AMP Sports externally with clients, agencies, platforms, partners, and industry leaders.

     

What You’ll Bring

  • 15+ years of progressive leadership experience in sports media, podcasting, audio, digital media, advertising, sponsorship, partnerships, or a related commercial media business.
  • 8+ years leading senior sales, revenue, partnerships, business development, or commercial strategy teams.
  • Demonstrated success growing revenue for sports, audio, podcast, video, social, streaming, television, or talent-led media properties.
  • Deep understanding of advertising sales, sponsorship development, branded content, agency relationships, media monetization, and evolving sports-media consumption habits.
  • Experience developing multi-platform commercial packages across audio, video, social, digital, live events, and traditional media.
  • Strong financial and business judgment, including forecasting, pricing, inventory management, revenue planning, and performance analysis.
  • Proven ability to build and maintain senior-level relationships with brands, agencies, platforms, sports properties, talent, and strategic partners.
  • Experience negotiating or overseeing complex advertising, sponsorship, distribution, licensing, talent, or partnership agreements in partnership with legal and business affairs.
  • Exceptional executive presence, communication, negotiation, decision-making, and stakeholder-management skills.

  • High integrity and sound judgment in matters involving brand safety, rights, talent relationships, advertiser commitments, and audience trust.

     

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience monetizing a sports podcast, audio, digital-video, social, streaming, or multi-platform media portfolio.
  • Established relationships with national advertisers, media agencies, sports marketers, leagues, teams, talent representatives, and platform partners.
  • Experience launching new commercial products, scaling a revenue organization, or building monetization infrastructure during a period of rapid growth.

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience; advanced degree is a plus.

     

How Success Will Be Measured

  • Revenue growth, profitability, forecast accuracy, and achievement of annual commercial targets.
  • Growth of advertiser, agency, sponsorship, and strategic-partner relationships.
  • Development of scalable, differentiated sponsorship and advertising products.
  • Expansion of revenue across podcasts, video, social, digital, live, and other Sinclair platforms.
  • Strength and health of the revenue pipeline, renewals, client retention, and long-term partnership value.

  • Recruitment, development, and retention of a high-performing commercial team.

     

About AMP Sports

AMP Sports creates distinctive sports storytelling and fan experiences across podcasts, digital video, social, creator-led content, and emerging platforms. As part of Sinclair, the group combines an entrepreneurial approach with broad reach, strategic relationships, and the resources to build meaningful audiences and scalable media properties.

The base salary compensation range for this role is $250,000 to $325,000. In addition, this role may be eligible for a discretionary quarterly and annual bonus which would be awarded based on individual and company performance. Final compensation for this role will be determined by various factors such as a candidates’ relevant work experience, skills, certifications, and geographic location. Full time positions are eligible for benefits that include participation in a retirement plan, life and disability insurance, health, dental and vision plans, flexible spending accounts, sick leave, vacation time, personal time, parental leave and employee stock purchase plan.

job.title: Technical Director, The National News Desk
job.description:
We are looking for a dedicated Technical Director for our Washington ,D.C.-based national Morning newscast. Experience technical directing live news in an automation environment, and general television operations are essential. Our goal is to offer audiences on multiple platforms something different. The kind of coverage they care about, the kind that impacts their lives – but that they cannot find anywhere else.

This is a highly collaborative environment. Experience in a team environment is a must.

Responsibilities:

  • Technical direct/code morning newscasts using SAGA and Ross Overdrive automated production systems
  • Maintain strong level of daily communication and collaboration with producers, talent, and production team
  • Strive to maintain a high degree of production value with strong attention to production aesthetics, accuracy, and show pacing
  • Assist with pre-production and post-show recordings
  • Build on ROSS Acuity switcher and edit templates in Template Editor 
  • Perform duties as a Technical Director in manual operations using a Sony switcher
  • Work with team to maintain studio and control room working environment and systems 
  • Participate in pre-show planning for special show segments, provide guidance, and work with crew on sets, lighting, and shot blocking
  • Direct or act as crew for special studio or remote productions Perform other duties as assigned

Requirements:

  • Position requires a positive team player who possesses strong communication and interpersonal skills 
  • Strong IT skills and experience coding and technical directing newscasts using Ross Overdrive automated production system preferred
  • Ability to execute direction given by Director and Producers while working under pressure
  • Strong knowledge of production standards and equipment
  • Typing and good spelling skills necessary
  • Must be able to lift & position 40-pound lighting instruments
  • Must have valid driver’s license with clean record
  • Flexibility for weekends, holidays, and breaking news coverage.

 

Please note that this position is not eligible for visa sponsorship, including employer sponsorship for an H-1B visa, OPT-STEM employment, etc.

job.title: VP, General Manager
job.description:
This Job Description May Cause Extreme Excitement and Career Growth

At AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions, we believe a great workplace isn't just something we say — it's something you can feel when you join the team. Here, it's all about great collabs, ambition, and results but most importantly, building a culture where people feel connected, inspired, and proud of the work they do.  We grow here, and we enjoy it here.

We're searching for a visionary leader — a driven, talented VP, General Manager to lead one or more of our local content centers and monetization and marketing teams. In this role, you'll be the architect of strategy, the champion of growth, a steward of culture and the heartbeat of operational excellence. If you're energized by leading high-performing teams, driving revenue, and making a lasting impact, we’d love to hear from you.

Sounds Like the Right Fit? Check Out the Checklist Below and if it sounds like you, hit “Apply Now” and let’s chat. 

 

Your Day-to-Day (aka the Playbook)

Help Us Thrive
You’ll lead the charge in amplifying our market presence, ensuring every team — from content creation to sales — is aligned with our strategic goals and delivering results.

Results-Driven
Maximize share of wallet across all media platforms in your marketplace. You’ll guide sales and marketing teams to hit revenue targets, grow audience engagement, and build lasting client relationships.

Strategic Planning
Develop and implement innovative business plans across departments. You’ll identify growth opportunities, analyze market trends, and ensure every team is set up for success.

Team Development
Mentor and inspire cross-functional teams while actively shaping a positive, inclusive, and high-performance culture. You’ll model our values, foster collaboration, reinforce accountability, and create an environment where people feel engaged, supported, and motivated to do their best work. Your leadership will develop future leaders and strengthen team cohesion. 

Market Analysis
Dive deep into competitive landscapes and audience data. Your insights will fuel expansion strategies and keep us ahead of the curve.

Authentic Relationships
Build strong relationships with clients, advertisers, community leaders, and industry partners. Internally and externally, you’ll be a visible culture carrier and the  face of AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions in your market, amplifying our reputation and impact.

What We're Looking For

✔ Proven Leadership
Experience in senior management level roles, ideally in media, digital or broadcasting. You’ve led diverse teams and driven measurable success.

✔ Strategic Visionary
You see the big picture and know how to get there. You’re comfortable with P&L ownership, financial planning, and operational excellence.

✔ Regulatory Savvy
You understand broadcasting regulations, content guidelines, and compliance standards — and you know how to navigate them with confidence.

✔ Financial Acumen
You’re skilled in budgeting, forecasting, and financial analysis. You know how to drive profitability while managing expenses.

✔ Relationship Builder
You’re a natural communicator and connector. You build trust, foster loyalty, and amplify client satisfaction. You inspire and motivate your team.

✔ Digital First
You bring strong digital acumen and understand how to leverage emerging technologies — including AI — to drive innovation and revenue growth. You’re not just tech-aware; you’re tech-forward.

✔ Growth Mindset
You thrive in fast-paced environments and embrace change, and believe culture is a leadership responsibility. You’re always learning, adapting, and pushing boundaries – for yourself and your team.

The Practical Stuff

  • A valid driver's license, up-to-date insurance, and reliable transportation are necessary for connecting with clients and teams in your community.
  • Willingness and ability to travel when necessary.

Why Join AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions?

Serious Work, Seriously Cool People
Be part of a bold team that values creativity, collaboration, and fun. We celebrate wins and support each other every step of the way.

The Compensation Package
Competitive base salary + results-based bonus structure. Plus, a benefits package our people love.

We Make a Real Difference
We help local businesses thrive through advertising strategies that create tangible impacts. Our team isn’t just selling ads — we’re building communities.

Career Growth Opportunities
We invest in you. Training, mentorship, and advancement opportunities are all part of the package. Whether you grow locally or join another AMP team, your future is bright.

AMP is us. It's you. It isn't just a name; it's a mission. A promise to amplify our reach, amplify our innovation, and most importantly, amplify you. If you're ready to grow your career and help businesses achieve their goals, we'd love to hear from you.

EEO AND INCLUSIVITY

Sinclair is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and a drug-free workplace. Employment practices will not be influenced or affected by virtue of an applicant's or employee's race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, military or veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.

job.title: VP, Sports Partnerships and Activations
job.description:
AMP Sports is seeking a strategic, entrepreneurial Vice President of Sports Partnerships and Activation Revenue to lead the growth, development, and execution of high-impact partnerships at the intersection of sports, media, talent, and culture. This executive will set the partnership and activation strategy, lead and develop the team, personally drive the organization’s most important brand, agency, league, team, talent, and rights-holder relationships, and turn AMP Sports’ podcasts, digital video, social reach, creators, original storytelling, live experiences, and Sinclair scale into distinctive programs for partners and fans. The VP will be both a builder and an operator: someone who can create the commercial vision, sell the idea, and ensure the activation delivers from concept through measurement.

What You’ll Do

  • Own AMP Sports’ sports-partnership and activation strategy, annual revenue plan, sales targets, pipeline health, forecasting, and performance accountability.
  • Build a differentiated portfolio of integrated programs across podcasts and audio, digital video, social, talent and creator partnerships, branded content, sponsorships, live events, fan experiences, and other experiential opportunities.
  • Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing partnerships and activations team; establish clear expectations, account priorities, operating rhythms, and a culture of creativity, collaboration, and accountability.
  • Serve as executive sponsor and hands-on seller for the largest opportunities, building trusted relationships with senior brand marketers, agency executives, leagues, teams, talent representatives, rights holders, and other sports-industry partners.
  • Create activation platforms around tentpole events, sports seasons, original franchises, talent, cultural moments, and audience passions that can scale across brands and distribution channels.
  • Lead the full activation lifecycle—from insight, concept, packaging, and pitch through contracting, production, launch, on-site or digital execution, measurement, renewal, and expansion.
  • Partner with content, production, marketing, social, research, ad operations, experiential, finance, legal, and corporate sales teams to ensure programs are creative, executable, brand-safe, rights-compliant, and financially sound.
  • Guide packaging, pricing, sponsorship architecture, inventory strategy, activation budgets, and commercial policies to support revenue growth, market competitiveness, and healthy margins.
  • Lead executive-level proposal development and negotiations for complex, high-value agreements, balancing client objectives, fan experience, creative ambition, talent and usage rights, operational requirements, risk, and profitability.
  • Establish clear activation governance, ownership, timelines, approval processes, and cross-functional handoffs to deliver every partner commitment at a high standard.
  • Create a measurement approach that connects audience reach and engagement with brand objectives, activation performance, client satisfaction, renewal, and account growth.
  • Identify and pursue new opportunities involving events, hospitality, commerce, licensing, creators, talent, distribution, and emerging sports or fan-engagement platforms.
  • Represent AMP Sports at client meetings, agency summits, sports and advertising conferences, live events, and other major marketplace moments.

What You’ll Bring

  • 12+ years of progressive leadership experience in sports partnerships, sponsorships, experiential marketing, branded content, sports media, integrated sales, or a related field.
  • 5+ years leading and developing sales, partnerships, sponsorship, experiential, or activation teams, with a record of setting strategy and improving performance.
  • A sustained track record of meeting or exceeding significant revenue goals and personally closing complex, high-value, multi-platform sports partnerships.
  • Demonstrated experience taking major activations from concept through execution, including management of stakeholders, budgets, timelines, talent or rights considerations, and measurement.
  • Deep relationships and executive credibility with major brands, agencies, leagues, teams, rights holders, talent organizations, and relevant sports-industry partners.
  • Strong understanding of sports audiences, fandom, live and digital experiences, branded entertainment, podcast and creator monetization, social platforms, and integrated measurement.
  • Executive-level commercial and operational judgment, including fluency in pricing, forecasting, activation budgets, deal structure, margins, and revenue operations.
  • Ability to connect business strategy, consumer insight, creative storytelling, live experiences, and platform capabilities into an actionable partnership plan.
  • Exceptional leadership, communication, presentation, and negotiation skills, with the ability to influence senior internal and external stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building or scaling a sports-partnership or activation function, launching a new commercial offering, or repositioning a sports media portfolio in the market.
  • Experience working directly with sports talent, creators, leagues, teams, venues, rights holders, live events, or original sports programming.
  • Experience with seven-figure-plus partnerships, multi-year agreements, custom content production, live activations, hospitality, and complex rights or usage structures.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience; advanced degree is a plus.

How Success Will Be Measured

  • Achievement of annual revenue, profitability, pipeline coverage, and forecast-accuracy goals.
  • Growth and diversification of AMP Sports’ brand, agency, league, team, talent, and rights-holder relationships.
  • Development of distinctive, scalable sports partnerships and activation platforms.
  • On-time, on-budget, brand-safe delivery of activation commitments and strong fan engagement.
  • Performance, engagement, and development of the partnerships and activations team.
  • Partner retention, renewal, expansion, and executive-level satisfaction.
  • Effective collaboration across AMP Sports and Sinclair from concept through execution and measurement.

About AMP Sports

AMP Sports brings together sports, culture, storytelling, and fandom across podcasts, digital video, social platforms, creator-led content, and live or experiential opportunities. As part of Sinclair, AMP Sports can pair the agility and authenticity of emerging media with the reach, relationships, and resources of a diversified media company. We build ideas with brands—not simply placements—creating partnerships that feel relevant to audiences and deliver meaningful business results for advertisers.

The base salary compensation range for this role is $200,000 to $300,000. In addition, this role may be eligible for a discretionary quarterly and annual bonus which would be awarded based on individual and company performance. Final compensation for this role will be determined by various factors such as a candidates’ relevant work experience, skills, certifications, and geographic location. Full time positions are eligible for benefits that include participation in a retirement plan, life and disability insurance, health, dental and vision plans, flexible spending accounts, sick leave, vacation time, personal time, parental leave and employee stock purchase plan.

job.title: YouTube Editor - Freelance
job.description:
The dedicated freelance YouTube Editor creates and refines long-form and short-form video content for YouTube and social platforms, playing a key role in the brand's video content strategy. The role owns the editing process for YouTube-bound content, transforming linear segments into YouTube-optimized long-form videos and editing YouTube-native programming with a focus on audience retention, strong hooks, pacing, and effective chaptering. The freelance YouTube Editor brings a deep understanding of YouTube and YouTube Shorts best practices, applying platform-specific storytelling techniques to maximize engagement and performance.

As a member of the Long-Form Pod, the freelance YouTube Editor partners closely with the Long-Form Video Producer Lead to develop and deliver long-form content for the channel. The role also creates weekly podcast cutdowns for YouTube Shorts, TikTok, and Instagram, turning recurring podcast episodes into compelling short-form content that extends audience reach across platforms. Working within the Director of Video Content's YouTube strategy and the Head of Social's broader social media strategy, the freelance YouTube Editor helps drive content performance through strong editorial judgment, creative storytelling, and platform-native execution.

This freelance role is expected to be approximately 40 hours per week, with schedules aligned to tournament coverage needs. Flexibility to work weekends may be required during key tournaments and high-volume event periods. This freelance engagement is anticipated to run through December 2026, with the potential to be extended through the end of 2027 based on business needs and performance.

This is a freelance role and onsite located in Santa Monica, CA. 

In this freelance role, you will... 

Lead YouTube Editing & Production  (primary lane) 

  • Re-edit linear segments into YouTube-optimized long-form pieces (typically 8-25 minute range), with attention to retention pacing, hook structure, and chaptering. 
  • Produce and edit YouTube-native long-form content from scratch, in partnership with the Long-Form Video Producer Lead and the Director of Video Content. 
  • Maintain the YouTube content calendar in partnership with the Director of Video Content. 
  • Identify which linear content is best suited for YouTube re-editing; build relationships with the linear content team to access source material. 
  • Stage every YouTube upload for the Director of Video Content's pre-publish approval on brand-sensitive pieces; route SEO and thumbnail tests under the same approval flow. 

 

Create Podcast Weekly Cutdowns  (secondary lane) 

  • Cut the team's weekly podcast episodes down into platform-native short-form pieces for YouTube Shorts, TikTok, and Instagram — the standing recurring deliverable for this lane. 
  • Identify the strongest moments in each weekly episode — clean takes, sharp quotes, debate beats, reactions — and cut them into 30-90 second vertical pieces with platform-native styling (captions, sound, hooks, aspect ratio). 
  • Adapt each cutdown across the three target platforms — Shorts, TikTok, and Instagram Reels — with platform-appropriate length, pacing, captioning, and thumbnail/cover styling. 
  • Maintain a weekly cutdown publish cadence — typically 3-6 cuts per episode across the three platforms — coordinated with the Short-Form Pod and the on-shift coordinator on publish-window timing. 
  • Add platform-native styling to every cutdown (captions, sound mix, end cards) and a thumbnail/cover frame that holds up in feed. 
  • Partner with the Short-Form Video Producer Lead, the Social Media Specialist, and the on-shift coordinator on which cutdowns publish, when, and on which platforms. 

 

Drive Content & Creative Direction 

  • Apply Tennis Channel brand voice and visual standards on every YouTube piece and every podcast cutdown. 
  • Partner with the Tournament Highlights Editor and the Original/Long-Form Editor on occasional YouTube edits when their formats are a better fit. 
  • Pitch new YouTube formats and serialized programming ideas to the Director of Video Content. 

 

Stay Ahead of Platform Expertise & Trends 

  • Stay current on Shorts, TikTok, and Reels for the podcast cutdown lane — sound choices, edit timing, hook structures that work for podcast-derived clips. 
  • Run platform-feature tests on YouTube (Shorts placements, Premieres, chapter strategy, format experiments); document what works and roll learnings into the strategy. 
  • Bring YouTube-driven and podcast-cutdown ideas to the Weekly Trending Content Meeting (chaired by the Senior Social Media Manager). 

 

Partner Cross-Functionally 

  • Pair daily with the Long-Form Video Producer Lead in the Long-Form Pod on YouTube-bound long-form content — concept fit, on-site capture priorities, hand-off, finish. 
  • Partner with the Short-Form Pod and the Social Media Specialist on the podcast cutdown lane — what gets cut, what publishes, when, and on which platforms. 
  • Partner with Programming/Linear to identify which linear segments are candidates for YouTube re-editing; own the actual re-editing under the Director of Video Content's strategic direction. 
  • Coordinate with the Social Graphics Content Specialist on YouTube thumbnails, end cards, lower-thirds, and series art that wraps the channel. 
  • Coordinate with the on-shift coordinator on Shorts publish-window timing and cross-platform asset distribution. 

 

Key Performance Indicators 

  • YouTube subscriber growth (+100% YoY) — primary KPI. 
  • Average view duration trend on YouTube. 
  • Click-through rate on uploads (target: 6%+ on most uploads, 8%+ on linear re-edits). 
  • Number of linear-to-YouTube re-edits published per month vs. plan. 
  • Audience retention curve quality (qualitative review of retention graphs). 

 

Key Qualifications 

  • 3-5 years editing and/or producing YouTube content with documented growth results
  • Demonstrable track record on a brand or creator channel — must show analytics from prior work, not just edits
  • Strong understanding of YouTube algorithm fundamentals: retention, click-through rate, session time, watch time
  • Hands-on thumbnail design ability or strong art-direction skills with a designer
  • Hands-on short-form vertical editing for Shorts, TikTok, and Instagram Reels — the podcast cutdown lane requires the same craft as a dedicated short-form editor
  • Premiere Pro and DaVinci Resolve fluency; CapCut Pro for fastest-turn cutdowns
  • Comfort writing — titles, descriptions, occasional voice-over scripts, podcast cutdown captions
  • Comfort working at high volume across two distinct cadences — multi-day YouTube production cycles and weekly podcast cutdown turnaround
  • Prior experience adapting linear/broadcast content for YouTube
  • Sports, news, or entertainment YouTube channel experience
  • Podcast or talk-show editing experience — knowing how to find the clip moment inside a long conversation
  • Familiarity with YouTube Studio, vidIQ or TubeBuddy, and basic SEO research tools

About Tennis Channel
 

Tennis Channel is the only multiplatform destination dedicated solely to tennis year-round. Together, the Tennis Channel flagship network, Tennis Channel 2, and the Tennis Channel app (tennischannel.com) deliver the most accessible and concentrated single-sport coverage anywhere. As the exclusive U.S. home of the ATP Tour and WTA Tour, Tennis Channel features live coverage of every Masters 1000 tournament — including Indian Wells, the Miami Open, Madrid, Rome, Cincinnati, and more — alongside live studio programming including its premier series, TC Live. job.title: Associate Director, Content Marketing
job.description:
Who We Are:

SiriusXM and its brands (Pandora, SiriusXM Media, AdsWizz, Simplecast, and SiriusXM Connect) are leading a new era of audio entertainment and services by delivering the most compelling subscription and ad-supported audio entertainment experience for listeners -- in the car, at home, and anywhere on the go with connected devices. Our vision is to shape the future of audio, where everyone can be effortlessly connected to the voices, stories and music they love wherever they are.

This is the place where a diverse group of emerging talent and legends alike come to share authentic and purposeful songs, stories, sounds and insights through some of the best programming and technology in the world. Our critically-acclaimed, industry-leading audio entertainment encompasses music, sports, comedy, news, talk, live events, and podcasting. No matter their individual role, each of our employees plays a vital part in bringing SiriusXM’s vision to life every day.

SiriusXM:

SiriusXM is the leading audio entertainment company in North America, and the premier programmer and platform for subscription and digital advertising-supported audio products. SiriusXM’s platforms collectively reach approximately 150 million listeners, the largest digital audio audience across paid and free tiers in North America, and deliver music, sports, talk, news, comedy, entertainment and podcasts. Pandora, a subsidiary of SiriusXM, is the largest ad-supported audio entertainment streaming service in the U.S. SiriusXM's subsidiaries Simplecast and AdsWizz make it a leader in podcast hosting, production, distribution, analytics and monetization. The Company’s advertising sales organization, which operates as SiriusXM Media, leverages its scale, cross-platform sales organization and ad tech capabilities to deliver results for audio creators and advertisers. SiriusXM, through SiriusXM Canada Holdings, Inc., also offers satellite radio and audio entertainment in Canada. In addition to its audio entertainment businesses, SiriusXM offers connected vehicle services to automakers.

How you’ll make an impact:

SiriusXM is seeking a strategic, creative, and data-driven Associate Director, Content Marketing to lead the development and execution of multi-channel content marketing campaigns that drive subscriber acquisition, deepen listener engagement and strengthen brand affinity.  

This role will oversee content marketing across paid, owned, and earned media for both SiriusXM and Pandora. From promoting exclusive artist channels and major sports seasons to launching hit podcasts and celebrity talk shows, you will ensure our content shines across all consumer touchpoints.

The ideal candidate is a modern content leader who understands how to build integrated campaigns, manage editorial calendars, lead cross-functional teams, and turn audience insights into breakthrough creative. The Director of Content Marketing will partner closely with Brand Marketing, Growth Marketing, Programming, Talent Relations, Social, PR, Product Marketing, Creative, CRM, Partnerships, and Analytics teams to ensure SiriusXM shows up with consistent, engaging, and measurable content across the listener journey.

What you’ll do: 

Content Strategy & Leadership:

  • Develop and lead content marketing strategies across SiriusXM and Pandora, programming categories, tentpole campaigns, talent partnerships, cultural moments and audience-growth initiatives.
  • Create integrated content plans that support brand awareness, listener engagement, subscriber acquisition, retention, win-back, and cross-platform discovery.
  • Translate programming priorities into marketable stories, campaign themes, editorial packages, social-first concepts, landing page content, video franchises, short-form copy, and partner-ready messaging.
  • Own and manage a cross-channel content calendar that aligns marketing, programming, social, PR, CRM, product, and partnership priorities.

Campaign Development & Execution:

  • Lead the content strategy for major campaigns tied to SiriusXM and Pandora programming, exclusive channels, artist moments, sports seasons, comedy specials, talk programming, live events, podcasts, and seasonal initiatives.
  • Partner with Creative and Brand teams to develop campaign concepts, copy platforms, video/storytelling ideas, and audience-specific content assets.
  • Collaborate with Growth, Lifecycle, and CRM teams to create content that moves listeners from discovery to trial, conversion, engagement, renewal, and advocacy.
  • Support partnership marketing efforts by developing content packages and co-marketing narratives for talent, media partners, advertisers, automotive partners, device partners, and distribution platforms.

Audience, Performance & Insights:

  • Use audience research, behavioral data, search trends, social listening, content performance, and campaign analytics to inform content strategy and optimization.
  • Define KPIs for content marketing initiatives, including engagement, reach, conversion, retention, content consumption, click-through rate, subscriber impact, and campaign lift.
  • Lead regular performance reporting, turning insights into clear recommendations for future creative, channel strategy, programming support, and audience targeting.

Cross-Functional Collaboration:

  • Serve as a senior content marketing partner to Programming, Product, Brand, Growth, Social, PR, Partnerships, CRM, Sales Marketing, and Analytics teams.
  • Lead cross-functional planning sessions to align campaign goals, audience priorities, messaging, asset needs, timelines, and distribution strategies.
  • Manage stakeholders through complex campaign development, balancing creative ambition, business objectives, legal requirements, talent approvals, and production timelines.
  • Partner with internal and external creative resources, agencies, freelancers, producers, writers, designers, editors, and video teams as needed.

Team & Operational Leadership:

  • Build, mentor, and manage a high-performing content marketing team, fostering a culture of creativity, accountability, collaboration, and measurable impact.
  • Create scalable processes for intake, prioritization, editorial planning, content development, approvals, asset delivery, reporting, and post-campaign learning.
  • Manage budgets, agency scopes, freelance resources, production timelines, and content operations with discipline and transparency.
  • Stay ahead of trends in audio, streaming, music, podcasts, sports media, creator marketing, entertainment marketing, short-form video and audience development.

What you’ll need:

  • Typically has 8+ years of experience within a content marketing and/or digital marketing function, preferably within digital, Mobile and/or email channel.  
  • 5+ years of leadership experience managing teams
  • Bachelor's degree with focus on marketing or related field, or equivalent, relevant experience.
  • Leadership Skills: You’re a people manager who has experience leading teams. You’re someone that has a clear vision and strategy for your org. You know how to effectively communicate department goals to your team, as well as motivate and support your people in meeting those objectives. You always put your people first – you listen, inspire and coach. 
  • Entrepreneurial: You’re a self-starter who gets excited at the chance to run initiatives end-to-end with full ownership and autonomy. You have no problem getting down in the weeds but can also pivot to be strategic and provide thought leadership support. 
  • Results-Oriented: You are someone that drives outcomes with a demonstrated track record for improving results in business performance. You take a focused approach towards action and rapid testing. You know how to extract learnings from both wins and losses.
  • Analytical & Intensely Curious: You have a strong aptitude for data and reporting. You are familiar with and embrace tools of the trade including Tableau or similar BI platforms (i.e. Adobe reporting, Google Analytics, etc.). You are constantly analyzing all available data. You’re always building a roadmap of hypotheses and experiments to test to improve results for the business.
  • You’re a Facilitator: You are acutely aware of all the moving pieces necessary to build campaigns and can collaborate with other groups to execute.
  • You have a creative streak: A keen eye for top performing creative and the ability to work with multiple stakeholders and design and copywriting teams to develop best in class creative executions.
  • Exhibit strong verbal and written communication skills, public speaking, presentation skills and excellent interpersonal skills.
  • Demonstrate excellent attention to detail, time management skills, and an ability to prioritize multiple tasks in a highly fluid, fast-paced environment.
  • Thorough knowledge of MS-Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook).

SiriusXM’s new Dublin facility will comprise a workforce primarily focused on software development, automotive technology and engineering, AdTech, data science, and analytics. How you'll make an impact:

As a Senior Staff ML Engineer at SiriusXM, you will bring machine learning models from development and experimentation to reliable, scalable production systems. You will work closely with Data Scientists, Data Engineers, Platform Engineers, and Services teams to productionize models, build robust feature pipelines, and ensure models operate reliably in live environments. This is a hands-on engineering role with ownership across deployment, serving, monitoring, and lifecycle management of ML systems.

What you'll do:

Model Productionization and Deployment

  • Lead the deployment of ML models into production using Databricks and MLFlow, ensuring high performance and integration with existing systems.
  • Implement scalable and reliable model serving solutions (both batch and real-time).
  • Design and maintain CI/CD pipelines for automated build, test, validation, and deployment of ML artifacts.
  • Support safe rollout and rollback strategies across environments.

Feature Engineering and Serving

  • Translate feature definitions from data scientists into production-grade pipelines.
  • Build and maintain reliable feature serving systems to ensure consistency between training and inference environments.
  • Optimize feature pipelines for performance, maintainability, and scalability.

Model Lifecycle Management

  • Support model registration, versioning, publishing, and promotion.
  • Implement retraining pipelines and redeploy improved models as data and algorithms evolve.
  • Participate in the decommissioning and retirement of models.

Reliability, Observability, and Performance

  • Ensure production models meet latency, throughput, and reliability requirements.
  • Implement logging, monitoring, and alerting of ML systems.
  • Investigate and resolve issues related to model performance, deployments, and infrastructure.
  • Contribute to operational runbooks and documentation.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with data scientists, engineers, and other stakeholders, providing ML engineering and operations expertise and support.

Best Practices Implementation

  • Spearhead the adoption of industry best practices in ML engineering and operations, focusing on areas like version control, data governance, and resource optimization.

What you'll need:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 8+ years of experience in ML Engineering, MLOps, data engineering, or a similar role.
  • Deep knowledge of ML models and algorithms.
  • 8+ years of experience with Databricks, MLFlow, and other relevant ML tools and frameworks.
  • Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Scala, or Java.
  • Mastery of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, etc.) and containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Expert with infrastructure-as-code tooling and practices, e.g., CDK, Terraform
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

Data Governance, Quality & Responsible AI

  • Lead enterprise AI standards and responsible AI practices, including approved tooling, risk frameworks, data-use expectations, human oversight, model monitoring, auditability, and post-launch measurement.
  • Integrate data and AI governance into a coherent enterprise operating model that enables innovation while preserving clear decision rights, regulatory compliance, and security.
  • Drive responsible AI adoption across SiriusXM by translating governance into practical, scalable operating practices that support secure innovation, measurable impact, and human-centered use of AI.

Data Science, Applied ML & Enterprise AI Enablement

  • Establish the enterprise Data Science and Applied ML discipline, including standards for model development, experimentation, evaluation, MLOps, production adoption, performance management, and talent development.
  • Lead Applied ML and Experimentation in partnership with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Advertising, Automotive, and business leaders to move high-value use cases from concept to measurable production impact.
  • Enable product-embedded ML teams through shared platforms, reusable capabilities, governance, evaluation frameworks, and communities of practice, while preserving accountability within Product and Engineering.
  • Build and scale SiriusXM’s Agent and LLM platform and enterprise AI enablement model, including approved tools, reusable patterns, training, adoption mechanisms, and ongoing support.
  • Drive AI-enabled ways of working across Product & Technology and the broader enterprise, with clear measures of adoption, productivity, quality, speed, and organizational capacity.
  • Partner with People and functional leaders to evolve roles, skills, and operating models so AI transformation strengthens organizational leverage, workforce readiness, and appropriate governance.

Business, Product & Domain Partnerships

  • Build durable partnerships across SiriusXM’s major product and business domains, including listener experiences, personalization and discovery, automotive, advertising and MarTech, subscriptions and growth, content and programming, and enterprise operations.
  • Enable domain analytics and applied science teams to translate business priorities into actionable insights, experimentation, recommendations, and production capabilities that drive measurable outcomes.
  • Establish a clear federated operating model in which domain and product leaders retain accountability for business outcomes and priorities, while Data & AI Enablement provides shared capabilities, standards, governance, talent practices, and enterprise-wide coordination.

Investment, Measurement & Executive Accountability

  • Partner with the CPTO, CFO, and Finance leadership to align Data & AI priorities, investment decisions, enterprise metrics, platform economics, and value realization with broader business and technology priorities.
  • Establish an enterprise Data & AI scorecard that measures business impact, data trust, platform performance, adoption, risk and control health, workforce effectiveness, and realized value.

Organization, Leadership & Talent

  • Build the leadership capacity and organizational mechanisms required to manage a broad, enterprise-wide mandate with clarity, accountability, and effective decision-making.

What you’ll need:

job.description:

In addition to driving the Hong Kong market, this position will provide expanded creative support for campaign initiatives across Taiwan and Southeast Asia (SEA).

This position will play a key role in various creative marketing functions — assisting with pitch development, coordinating agency deliverables, maintaining release timelines, supporting in-market promotional visits, and creating assets (social media, short-form video, photo, and digital marketing materials) to craft engaging fan experiences on behalf of some of the biggest international artists in the world. 

The role is based in Hong Kong and covers Hong Kong, Taiwan and Southeast Asia (SEA). You will sit within Hong Kong, Taiwan and Southeast Asia (SEA) International Marketing community, reporting to the Director, International Marketing in Hong Kong and working closely with the Head of Creative, Southeast Asia, ensuring regional creative alignment while executing tailored campaigns locally.

What you'll do:

  • Campaign Ideation & Execution: Be a creative visionary, developing and implementing innovative marketing and superfan campaigns that enhance Sony Music artists’ presence and engage fans across Hong Kong, Taiwan, and Southeast Asia.
  • Vendor & Agency Coordination: Manage relationships with external creative partners such as agencies, photographers, and production teams to deliver high-quality content and assets on time and within budget.
  • Workflow & Asset Management: Assist with the end-to-end creative workflow—from routing concepts for approval to monitoring production schedules—ensuring asset alignment with artist and company brand guidelines.
  • Trend & Platform Research: Monitor music, pop culture, events, TikTok, digital marketing, and emerging tech trends to provide actionable ideas for creative asset production.
  • Data & Insights Application: Collaborate with the data and insights team to pull audience analytics, assisting in applying performance metrics to optimize asset design and content formats.

  • Cross-Functional Alignment: Support cross-functional integration across digital, audience development, catalogue, local PR, and content teams to ensure messaging alignment.
  • Post-Campaign Reporting: Gather feedback, compile post-campaign performance data, and draft summary reports to help refine future creative strategies.
  • Asset Production & Collaboration: Develop and produce engaging creative outputs that reflect the artist's unique identity, story, and vision across multiple platforms. Coordinate with graphic designers, videographers, and editors to produce visually compelling content. while remaining adaptable to artist management feedback.

job.title: Audience Development Executive
job.description:
The Audience Development Executive grows and deepens the audience for Sony Music's C-POP and J-POP repertoire across Taiwan, Hong Kong and Southeast Asia. You will own how fans find our artists, how they move from a first stream to a committed fan, and how we understand and act on what those audiences tell us. 

C-POP and J-POP are two of the fastest-moving parts of our regional business, with releases and campaigns increasingly running across several markets at once and audience behaviour that differs sharply between the two. This role is the connective tissue: setting audience strategy per artist and per release, coordinating rollout across markets, and turning streaming, social and first-party data into decisions the marketing teams can act on. Success looks like measurable audience growth market by market, a healthier conversion from casual listener to superfan, and a release calendar for both repertoires that runs as one regional plan rather than several disconnected ones. 

The role is based in Hong Kong and covers Hong Kong, Taiwan and Southeast Asia (SEA). You will sit within Hong Kong, Taiwan and Southeast Asia (SEA) International Marketing community, reporting to the Director, International Marketing in Hong Kong and working closely with the Head of Creative, Southeast Asia, ensuring regional creative alignment while executing tailored campaigns locally. 

 

What you'll do:

Own audience strategy for C-POP and J-POP repertoire 

  • Develop and deliver audience development plans for priority C-POP and J-POP artists, releases and catalogue across Taiwan, Hong Kong and Southeast Asia, with clear objectives for audience growth, retention and conversion. 
  • Segment and size audiences by market, identifying where an artist is over- or under-indexed and where the realistic growth is, then shape campaign priorities and budget recommendations around that. 
  • Build the discovery-to-superfan funnel for each project: map how listeners enter, what moves them deeper, and where they drop out, and design interventions at each stage. 
  • Own the audience narrative for both repertoires in regional planning sessions, bringing a clear point of view backed by data to marketing, creative, commercial and repertoire centre stakeholders. 
  • Recognise where C-POP and J-POP audiences behave differently, in discovery route, fandom structure, spending patterns and platform preference, and build strategies that reflect those differences rather than applying one regional template to both. 

Grow audiences on DSPs and across the streaming ecosystem 

  • Work with digital service partners including Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube Music, LINE MUSIC, JOOX, KKBOX and regional platforms on pitching, editorial support, on-platform programming and audience-growth opportunities across both repertoires. 
  • Drive playlist strategy across owned, editorial and algorithmic surfaces, including Filtr and other in-house playlist brands, and track how placement translates into sustained audience rather than a single-week spike. 
  • Partner with the digital marketing and media buying teams to align paid audience targeting with organic audience strategy, so spend is directed where it compounds. 
  • Monitor the creator and short-form ecosystem, identifying tracks and moments gaining traction and working with creative and digital teams to amplify them quickly. 
  • Track and act on the discovery routes specific to J-POP in this region, including anime, film and game sync, tour and event moments, and catalogue resurgence, and convert those spikes into retained audience. 

Build first-party data and superfan capability 

  • Grow first-party data capture across C-POP and J-POP campaigns, working with local teams to embed sign-up and data collection into releases, tours, fan events and D2C moments. 
  • Turn first-party data into usable audience segments for CRM, direct-to-consumer and superfan activity, and support markets in activating those segments responsibly. 
  • Identify and develop superfan opportunities that deepen the relationship with the most engaged part of each artist's audience, and support the commercial cases that sit behind them. 
  • Partner with Sony Music Japan and Greater China repertoire centre teams on first-party data and superfan initiatives, feeding regional audience insight back to them and translating their priorities into market-level plans. 
  • Work within local data protection and privacy requirements across each market, in partnership with legal and the relevant local teams. 

Coordinate across markets and repertoire centres 

  • Act as the regional coordination point for C-POP and J-POP releases and activities, aligning timelines, asset delivery and campaign moments across Taiwan, Hong Kong and Southeast Asia. 
  • Consolidate requirements from local marketing teams into workable regional plans that scale while still allowing for hyper-local adaptation. 
  • Maintain visibility of the release calendar and audience plans across both repertoires so markets and the repertoire centres know what is coming and what is expected of them. 
  • Flag risks, clashes and gaps early, and keep regional stakeholders informed of progress and performance. 

Measure, report and improve 

  • Track and report on audience KPIs including listener growth, retention, market share, playlist performance, and first-party data capture, and communicate results clearly to senior stakeholders. 
  • Lead post-campaign reviews, identifying what drove audience growth and feeding those learnings into the next cycle. 
  • Work with the insights, data and analytics team to develop reporting that markets will actually use, and build data literacy across the regional teams. 
  • Stay ahead of platform, format and consumption changes across Greater China and Southeast Asia, and advise the business on what they mean for how we grow audiences.

 

Who you are:

  • 2+ years' experience in audience development, digital marketing, streaming or artist marketing at a label, DSP, artist management company or comparable media business. 
  • Demonstrable track record of growing an artist, catalogue or content audience, with the numbers to show it. 
  • Strong working knowledge of the streaming landscape across Greater China and Southeast Asia, including DSP editorial and algorithmic mechanics, playlist strategy, and platform-specific audience behaviour. 
  • Genuine fluency in C-POP and J-POP: the artists, the fandoms, the platforms they live on, and how audience behaviour differs between Taiwan, Hong Kong and the Southeast Asian markets. 
  • Comfortable with data. Able to work with streaming, social and first-party data, draw a defensible conclusion from it, and explain that conclusion to people who are not analysts. 
  • Experience with first-party data capture, CRM or direct-to-consumer fan initiatives is a strong advantage. 
  • Fluent in Mandarin (Traditional Chinese) and English. Japanese is a strong advantage given the J-POP scope, and Cantonese an advantage given the Hong Kong scope. 
  • Strong coordination skills across multiple markets, time zones and stakeholders, with the ability to keep several campaigns moving at once. 
  • Ability to articulate an idea or point of view succinctly, with clarity and confidence, adapting the message to different audiences, seniority levels and cultures. 
  • Responds and adapts quickly to change, maintaining a flexible attitude and using new conditions to evolve their thinking. 
  • A thorough understanding of lifestyle and cultural trends across Greater China and Southeast Asia.

 

What we give you:

  • You join a vibrant global community with the opportunity to channel your passion every day
  • A modern office environment designed for you, empowering you to bring your best
  • Investment in your professional growth and development enabling you to thrive in our vibrant community

On the music side, SONY MUSIC MASTERWORKS is comprised of the label imprints Masterworks, Sony Classical, Milan Records, XXIM Records, and Masterworks Broadway which collectively, specialize in instrumental music (classical, neo-classical and classical crossover), soundtracks (film & television, video games, anime) and Broadway cast albums.  

MASTERWORKS LIVE! is comprised of fourteen innovative live event businesses, which as a collective conceives, builds, presents and promotes original and IP-based events and experiences in Music, Theater, TV, Film, Gaming, Anime, Sports Entertainment and more.  The division encompasses Backyard Cinema Black Ink Presents, Black Sky Creative, Culture Creative, GEA Live, The Luna Entertainment Group, MAC Global, Proactiv Entertainment, RG Live, RoadCo Entertainment, Roast Productions, Seaview Productions, Senbla, Ltd. and Terrapin Station Entertainment.

Sony Music Masterworks is seeking a Coordinator to provide essential administrative support to business and legal affairs and A&R administration for both recorded music and live. The position is based in Sony Music’s NYC headquarters, but the role is global in scope, requiring frequent contact with our colleagues in Los Angeles, the UK, Europe, Australia and Japan. This position offers a tremendous opportunity to learn, contribute and grow within a team-oriented environment.

The Coordinator, BLA & A&R Admin reports to the Senior Director of Business & Legal Affairs and the A&R Administration Department of Masterworks. This position will liaise with the various departments within the worldwide Sony Music Masterworks Division and Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Inter-Company Accounting, Release Planning, Royalties, Label Artists, their management, and recording studios.

We’re looking for candidates with a passion for the entertainment business as a whole, but with particular interest in music, live events and technology.  Meticulous organizational skills and the ability to pay close attention to detail are a must.  Candidates must also have the proven ability to manage a variety of tasks in a fast-paced environment, excellent oral and written communication skills, and the ability to work both autonomously and collaboratively across departments in a proactive and professional manner.

What you'll do:

  • Manage the core administrative needs of the Business and Legal Affairs department. This will include:
    • Circulating contracts internally and externally for execution.
    • Creating and maintaining workflows within Adobe Sign for purposes of securing deal memo approvals.
    • Mailing hard copies of notices when required.
    • Ensuring fully executed contracts and any other important documents or correspondence are submitted to the records department and uploaded to the CARMA database.
    • Generating updates, reports, spreadsheets and presentations for key internal stakeholders and external partners as directed.                          
  • Communicate with A&R, Business & Legal Affairs, Finance, Marketing, Royalties, JV Accounting, to properly administer artist contracts, licenses, and various other legal documents, including:
    • Administering A&R-related budgets and reviewing artist agreements to assess and enforce contractual obligations with respect to recording.
    • Assisting with creation of royalty accounts.
    • Liaising with release planning to ensure proper sub-project code setups.
    • Helping with union obligations for any relevant release.
    • Booking studio and travel for Artist Services.
  • Assist with ad hoc reports needed internally or externally.
  • Communicate with artist attorneys and managers about contractual issues, vendors, proper payments, and tax information.
  • Assist in day-to-day operations such as:
    • Administration of recording projects.
    • Tracking projects to ensure proper payment and budgeting.
    • Creation of recording and marketing budgets, including distinguishing between recoupable and non-recoupable costs for accurate statement rendering.
    • Issuing purchase orders.
    • Facilitating prompt invoice payment.
    • Reconciling BTA "ghost" card.
    • Setting up vendors in the Sony system, along with any relevant artist portal access.
  • Work with live businesses.
    • Create budgets and pay expenses.
    • Assist with customer and vendor onboarding.
    • Prepare billing requests and wire transfers.

Who you are:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience is required.
  • 1+ years of prior entertainment industry experience (including internships and extracurricular activities) highly encouraged, particularly in the areas of business and legal affairs, marketing, communications or business administration.
  • Highly organized, analytical, detail-oriented with exceptional follow-up skills, capable of managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced, multi-priority global environment.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills.
  • Skilled in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook, and especially PowerPoint) and Adobe Sign.
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud (Photoshop, Premiere, Illustrator, inDesign) or equivalent supremely helpful, including light video and photo editing.
  • Active engagement in music, theater, film, television, videogames, anime and general pop culture a plus.
  • Must be able to accept changes readily, both in job responsibilities as well as in the work environment
  • Ability to multitask, solve problems and prioritize across multiple time zones.
  • Excellent time management skills.
  • Professional, confident, positive and calm demeanor.
  • A team player, who is both ambitious and able to take initiative and see projects through independently
  • Able to communicate effectively with internal staff, artists/creatives, managers/agents, and external contacts.

job.title: Finance Accountant
job.description:
Sony Music Entertainment is currently looking for an experienced Financial Accountant to join our Finance team. You will be looking after our Malaysia and Singapore entities. Reporting to the Finance Director, you will be an integral member of the Sony Music Finance team and will be responsible for ensuring all reporting completed accurately and on time. 

What you'll do 

Accounts Payable & Accounts Receivable

  • Manage end-to-end accounts payable processes, including purchase requests, purchase orders, supplier invoice verification, three-way matching, invoice processing, and payment workflows in accordance with company policies and approval requirements.
  • Review payment proposals prepared by shared services teams and ensure payment instructions are accurate and properly approved.
  • Manage accounts receivable activities including client invoicing, collections follow-up, cash application, receipting, and resolution of billing discrepancies.
  • Maintain accurate supplier and customer master data, supporting documentation, and respond to internal and external stakeholder enquiries in a timely manner.

General Ledger, Financial Close & Reporting

  • Prepare and post month-end journal entries, including accruals, prepayments, reclassifications, provisions, and other accounting adjustments.
  • Perform monthly balance sheet and general ledger reconciliations, including bank accounts, accounts payable, receivables, accruals, provisions, and other assigned accounts, ensuring timely investigation and resolution of outstanding items.
  • Prepare management accounts and support the interface between local statutory ledgers and corporate reporting ledgers, including US GAAP reporting requirements.
  • Manage monthly, quarterly, and year-end financial closing activities, ensuring all transactions are accurately recorded within reporting deadlines.
  • Maintain accurate accounting records and documentation to support financial integrity, audit readiness, and compliance with US GAAP, IFRS, and company accounting policies.

Financial Planning & Business Support

  • Support monthly forecasting and annual budgeting processes using global reporting and planning tools.
  • Assist in financial analysis and provide insights to support business decision-making and operational planning.
  • Monitor financial performance against budgets and forecasts, highlighting key variances and trends to stakeholders.

Tax Compliance & Reporting

  • Assist with tax compliance activities across Singapore and Malaysia, ensuring timely and accurate submission of required tax filings and reporting obligations.
  • Support periodic withholding tax filings, VAT/GST filings, annual corporate income tax returns, and other statutory tax submissions in accordance with local regulations.
  • Prepare and coordinate group tax reporting packages, including information required for corporate tax consolidation and global reporting requirements.
  • Assist with non-resident withholding tax (NRWT) compliance, including review of applicable requirements, supporting documentation, and timely submission of filings.
  • Maintain accurate tax records and supporting documentation while liaising with internal stakeholders, external tax advisors, and tax authorities to resolve queries and ensure compliance.

Audit, Governance & Internal Controls

  • Support year-end statutory audits by preparing audit schedules, reconciliations, and supporting documentation for external auditors.
  • Ensure compliance with internal controls, accounting policies, tax requirements, and regulatory obligations.
  • Identify opportunities to improve finance processes, strengthen controls, and enhance operational efficiency.

Royalty & Special Projects

  • Prepare royalty statements and financial reporting for joint venture deals, licensing arrangements, and other commercial agreements.
  • Support finance transformation initiatives, process improvement projects, and other ad hoc assignments as required.

Who you are

Key Skills & Competencies

  • Strong knowledge of accounts payable, general ledger, reconciliation processes, and financial close activities.
  • Detail-oriented and process-driven with strong analytical and problem-solving skills to investigate discrepancies and maintain financial accuracy.
  • Ability to manage multiple entities, currencies, and deadlines while working effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with internal stakeholders and finance teams.
  • Ability to work independently while contributing positively to a collaborative finance team environment.

Education and Qualifications

  • Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Commerce, Business, Economics, or a related discipline, with CA/CPA qualification or progress towards professional qualification preferred.
  • 5 years of experience in accounts payable, general ledger accounting, financial accounting, or a similar finance operations role within a multinational or fast-paced environment.
  • Hands-on experience in invoice processing, purchase order workflows, payment runs, journal entries, month-end closing, and balance sheet reconciliations.
  • Experience with SAP ERP, Business Warehouse (BW), or other financial systems is preferred, with strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and financial reporting tools.
  • Strong understanding of accounting principles, financial reporting processes, and internal controls, with experience managing multiple priorities and meeting tight deadlines.

What we give you

 

  • You join a vibrant global community with the opportunity to channel your passion every day 
  • A modern office environment designed for you, empowering you to bring your best 
  • Investment in your professional growth and development enabling you to thrive in our vibrant community 
  • The space to accelerate progress, positively disrupt and create what happens next 
  • We give you the platform to champion positive change, with the opportunity to contribute to our social impact, diversity, equity and inclusion initiatives

This role serves as a flexible shared resource across COR's affiliated businesses, providing support on a need-based basis as priorities and workloads shift across the group. Success in this role requires strong accounting and analytical skills, attention to detail, comfort working across multiple businesses and systems, and the ability to prioritize effectively in a dynamic environment. This is an office-first role located in Culver City, CA and requires working 4 days in office per week.

What you'll do:

Artist Accounting & Royalty Settlements

  • Prepare and maintain artist royalty statements and settlement schedules across multiple revenue channels, including Tour, Ecommerce, Retail, and Licensing, for affiliates across the Ceremony of Roses group.
  • Review artist contracts and related agreements to ensure accurate interpretation and application of royalty rates, profit splits, recoupable costs, advances, and other settlement terms.
  • Reconcile revenue, costs, cash activity, and other settlement inputs to underlying operational and accounting records.
  • Identify settlement discrepancies, investigate variances, and coordinate with affiliate finance and operating teams to resolve issues on a timely basis.

Affiliate Support & Workload Triage

  • Provide artist accounting and finance support across Ceremony of Roses affiliated companies based on business needs, settlement calendars, and workload priorities.
  • Partner with finance leads across the group to assess open deliverables, prioritize work, and provide additional capacity where it is most needed.
  • Adapt to different affiliate processes, systems, and business models while helping drive consistency in artist accounting practices across the group.

Financial Analysis & Reporting

  • Support analysis of artist and project economics, including revenue, costs, margins, royalties, and settlement performance across revenue channels.
  • Assist with variance analysis and other financial reporting needed to explain artist, project, or affiliate performance.
  • Prepare schedules, analyses, and reporting materials for affiliate finance teams and Ceremony of Roses leadership as needed.

Accounting & Month-End Close

  • Support month-end close activities across affiliates, including preparation and review of artist royalty, revenue, cost, and tour-related accruals.
  • Reconcile artist accounting and operational data to the general ledger and investigate differences across systems or reporting sources.
  • Partner with affiliate Accounting and Finance teams to support complete, accurate, and timely financial reporting.

Process Improvement & Special Projects

  • Help standardize artist accounting, settlement, and reconciliation processes across the Ceremony of Roses group while respecting affiliate-specific business requirements.
  • Assist with process improvements, documentation, and automation initiatives that improve the timeliness and accuracy of artist accounting and reporting.
  • Support ad hoc finance, accounting, and cross-functional projects across affiliates as priorities evolve.

Who you are:

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or a related field.
  • 1 – 2 years of experience in accounting, artist/royalty accounting, financial analysis, or related roles.
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including the ability to reconcile and analyze large or detailed financial datasets.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills, with excellent attention to detail.
  • Ability to interpret contracts and translate financial terms into accurate royalty and settlement calculations.
  • Experience with royalty reporting, artist accounting, revenue-share arrangements, or similar contractual accounting models.
  • Experience working with merchandise, Ecommerce, retail, touring, licensing, music, entertainment, or consumer product revenue streams is preferred.
  • Familiarity with SAP, ERP systems, royalty platforms, or other financial reporting tools.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively across different teams, affiliates, and operating environments.
 

What we give you:

  • You join an inclusive, collaborative and global community where you have the opportunity to channel your passion every day  
  • A modern office environment designed to foster productivity, creativity, and teamwork empowering you to bring your best 
  • An attractive and comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life & disability coverage, and 401K + employer matching

job.title: Jr. Manager, Marketing Strategy, Argentina - The Orchard
job.description:
ABOUT THE ORCHARD

The Orchard is a leading full-service music distribution company operating in 50+ markets worldwide. The Orchard empowers creators and businesses to grow and evolve in the dynamic, global music industry. We specialize in being Artist focused, blending industry expertise and technology, leveraging data to drive success, and providing streamlined digital and physical solutions. The Orchard’s comprehensive artist & label services offerings include marketing, sync licensing, premium video services, transparent data analysis, advertising, rights management, radio promotion, D2C, and more.

The Orchard focuses on providing a comfortable, social, and engaging environment to encourage productivity and creativity.

As a Jr. Manager, Marketing Strategy, your role is crucial in driving the success of our clients' releases through innovative marketing plans and strategies, and data-driven campaigns. You will serve as a key point of contact, keeping labels and artists ahead of industry trends, platform tools, and audience engagement with plans and best practices. Owning and nurturing strong relationships with clients and internal teams is essential to creating impactful activations, building fanbases, and achieving overall release objectives.

What you'll do:

  • Serve as the marketing point of contact for labels and artists leading discussions around marketing strategies, campaign planning, data collection, and ongoing performance evaluation.
  • Conceptualize and execute creative marketing campaigns in order to remain at the forefront of marketing and audience development.
  • Oversee and manage marketing campaigns for high-priority releases, focusing on specific artist and label initiatives within a given team. Drive informed decisions based on data and performance metrics.
  • Analyze the impact of campaigns and the value of various fan and audience segments, identifying trends, areas for improvement, and opportunities to optimize both pre- and post-release strategies.
  • Utilize in-depth knowledge of platforms and tools to build audiences, engage fanbases, and drive demand.
  • Provide regular reports and key insights to team and regional leads regarding campaign success and areas for improvement.
  • Seek out opportunities for the development of the artist and label roster through internal resources and external tools or services that could enhance campaign efforts.
  • Work with multiple departments and teams to bring innovative marketing activations to life, both digitally and in the real world. Foster fan community relationships to amplify campaign reach and effectiveness.
  • Collaborate with different The Orchard teams across the globe to identify and leverage cultural touchpoints for audience acquisition, engagement, and other label objectives.
  • Be proactive in identifying challenges and providing solutions to keep release campaigns on track. Demonstrate flexibility and balance in supporting label needs. Be nimble as priorities arise outside of standard processes, with the ability to act with urgency and strategic vision.

Who you are:

  • At least 3+ years of experience in strategy marketing
  • Experience in music marketing is a plus
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Passionate about music, a regular attendee of live shows, interested in discovering new music, trend-savvy, and curious.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and timelines
  • A strong passion for music, creativity and marketing trends
  • Proven track record of success in developing marketing plans and strategies
  • Proficiency in Spanish and English is required
  • Extensive knowledge of the music industry, including trends, challenges, and opportunities
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build and maintain relationships with artists, labels, and other key partners
  • Creative thinker with the ability to develop and execute innovative marketing and promotional campaigns

What we give you:
