job.title: Junior Manager, Music Content & Marketing - Liquid State
job.description:
This hybrid role combines content production and marketing promotion and is directly responsible for leading the planning and execution of commercial music release projects. You will bridge creative vision and commercial objectives, independently managing end-to-end core music projects - from early-stage planning, A&R and content creation to full campaign rollout amid growing project scale and complexity that demand strong cross-team collaboration and resource coordination. Join us to lead landmark music initiatives and fuel commercial growth through creative content and innovative marketing.

 

What you'll do:

  • Market & Competitive Analysis: Conduct competitive research on music genres, major streaming platforms and user music consumption behaviours; propose and pitch new content projects based on data insights and market trends.
  • Content Planning & A&R: Scout songwriters, producers and artists for projects; oversee quality control of mixes, masters and final deliverables; identify commercially valuable music content aligned with market trends.
  • Marketing & Release Strategy: Formulate release strategies and marketing plans, refine core selling points, product positioning and narrative promotion angles with key marketing hooks and storytelling angles.
  • Project Management: Oversee timelines, deliverables and budget control for all content projects; coordinate cross-functional teams and resources to ensure smooth execution of both in-house and co-produced projects.
  • Rights & Compliance: Manage copyright licensing and compliance clearance for co-produced content.
  • Partnership & Execution: Independently communicate, execute and advance cooperation matters; follow up contracts and maintain partner relationships.
  • Performance Tracking: Track core KPIs including streaming volumes, revenue and ROI, and optimize campaigns based on performance data.
  • Complete other temporary work assigned by the supervisor and the company.

 

Who you are:

  • Bachelor's degree or above; majors in Music, Communication, Marketing and related disciplines are preferred.
  • 3-5 years of working experience in the music industry, with proven full-cycle song promotion experience from zero to one; proficient in the complete music production workflow and marketing logic.
  • Possess dual A&R and marketing capabilities; capable of independently managing end-to-end music projects with a track record of successful hit song releases.
  • Familiar with promotion logics and algorithm mechanisms of mainstream music & short-video platforms, including QQ Music, NetEase, Cloud Music, Douyin, Kuaishou and Bilibili.
  • Excellent content planning acumen, able to spot commercially valuable music content by capturing market trends timely.
  • Able to manage multiple projects simultaneously, with outstanding time management and cross-department communication & coordination skills; resilient and able to thrive under heavy work pressure.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Strong English proficiency. 
  • Established personal network of artists, producers and songwriters; able to integrate industry resources to facilitate project delivery. 
  • In-depth professional insight into specific music genres especially electronic dance music (e.g., hip-hop, folk, pop). 
  • Previous employment experience at record labels, hit-song indie labels or content studios of music streaming platforms. 
  • Show/Performance industry experiences/resources.

 

What we give you:

  • You join an inclusive, collaborative and global community where you have the opportunity to fuel the creative journey.
  • A modern office environment designed to foster productivity, creativity, and teamwork.
  • We invest in your professional growth & development.

job.title: Junior Manager, Public Performance & Finance Support - Colombia
job.description:
Sobre Sony Music Entertainment

En Sony Music Entertainment, impulsamos el viaje creativo. Hemos desempeñado un papel pionero en la historia de la música, desde la creación del primer sello discográfico hasta la invención del disco plano. Hemos apoyado a algunos de los artistas más icónicos de la música y producido algunas de las grabaciones más influyentes de todos los tiempos.

Hoy trabajamos en más de 70 países, apoyando un diverso roster de superestrellas internacionales, artistas en desarrollo e independientes, y creadores visionarios. Desde nuestra posición en la intersección de la música, el entretenimiento y la tecnología, aportamos imaginación y experiencia a los productos y plataformas más recientes, adoptamos nuevos modelos de negocio, empleamos herramientas innovadoras y brindamos información poderosa que ayuda a nuestros artistas a expandir sus límites creativos y llegar a nuevas audiencias.
En todo lo que hacemos, estamos comprometidos con la integridad artística, la transparencia y el espíritu emprendedor.

Sony Music Entertainment forma parte de la familia de compañías globales Sony.

Asegurar que todos los lanzamientos de fonogramas de SONY MUSIC sean acreditados dentro de las sociedades de gestión colectiva para garantizar el recaudo de estos usos en los establecimientos públicos y apoyar la operación del área financiera en ciertas actividades puntuales.

Qué harás:

  • Desde el modelo de la Promesa Global de las Personas, GPP, los Valores y los Comportamientos de SMG en todo lo que hace, ayudando a impulsar una cultura sostenible de alto rendimiento dentro de nuestro negocio
  • Acreditar los fonogramas en todos los formatos disponibles, tanto digitales como análogos, garantizando su correcta identificación y registro en las plataformas y sistemas correspondientes, con el fin de asegurar su adecuada gestión y el cumplimiento de los estándares de la industria.
  • Coordinar y ejecutar el retiro de fonogramas de todas las plataformas y formatos disponibles cuando los derechos correspondientes hayan expirado o ya no estén vigentes, asegurando el cumplimiento de las normativas legales y las políticas internas de la compañía.
  • Gestionar y resolver conflictos relacionados con la acreditación de fonogramas cuando dos o más productores, hayan registrado el mismo fonograma, asegurando una revisión objetiva, la correcta asignación de derechos y el cumplimiento de los lineamientos establecidos por la compañía y las entidades de gestión colectiva.
  • Gestionar la elaboración y seguimiento de facturas manuales en coordinación con Shared Services, relacionadas con acuerdos de sincronización, nuevos negocios y broadcasting, asegurando la correcta emisión de los documentos, el cumplimiento de los procesos financieros establecidos que permitan su adecuada contabilización.
  • Crear y administrar familias de fonogramas en los sistemas corporativos, garantizando la disponibilidad y confiabilidad de la información necesaria para el monitoreo de gastos, la generación de reportes y el análisis financiero por parte de las diferentes áreas involucradas.
  • Realizar la validación y seguimiento de las cuentas de balance de Marketing generadas por el equipo de Contabilidad, asegurando la razonabilidad de los registros, la identificación oportuna de inconsistencias y el adecuado soporte de las cifras financieras.
  • Consolidar, analizar y validar la información requerida para la construcción del indicador de Market Share, garantizando la confiabilidad de los datos y la elaboración oportuna de los reportes para su presentación, revisión y análisis junto con el Finance Sr. Manager.

  • Gestionar la elaboración y presentación de reportes financieros y de gestión relacionados con Marketing, Talento y Overheads, incluyendo informes de cierre, cargue de Forecast y Budget de la región Andes, asegurando la precisión de la información, el cumplimiento de los cronogramas establecidos y el soporte a la toma de decisiones del negocio

Quién eres:

  • Profesional en Administración de Empresas y/o Finanzas.
  • Conocimientos solidos en manejo Excel y SAP.
  • Experiencia de mínimo de 3 años en cargos de similar responsabilidad, deseable en compañías multinacionales.
  • Inglés B1.
  • Persona con gran habilidad para conectar con otros, construyendo relaciones de confianza y colaboración. Se comunica con claridad, respeto y seguridad, lo que le permite influir positivamente en su entorno. Es proactiva, toma la iniciativa y actúa con responsabilidad, siempre enfocada en encontrar soluciones. Tiene una mentalidad analítica que le permite entender contextos complejos y tomar decisiones acertadas. Su capacidad para unir personas, ideas y procesos lo convierte en un verdadero conector dentro del equipo y la organización. (relaciones interpersonales - comunicación asertiva - proactividad – responsabilidad – acción - análisis – conexión).

Lo que te damos:

  • Te unes a una comunidad inclusiva, colaborativa y global donde tienes la oportunidad de canalizar tu pasión cada día
  • Un entorno de oficina moderno diseñado para fomentar la productividad, la creatividad y el trabajo en equipo que te permite aportar lo mejor de ti mismo
  • Inversión en tu crecimiento y desarrollo profesional que te permita prosperar en nuestra vibrante comunidad.
  • El espacio para acelerar el progreso, perturbar positivamente y crear lo que suceda a continuación.
  • Te damos la plataforma para liderar el cambio positivo, con la oportunidad de contribuir a nuestras iniciativas de impacto social, diversidad, equidad e inclusión.
  • Una cartera de prestaciones que responde a sus necesidades y las de su familia, desde ayudas al bienestar y prestaciones familiares hasta tiempo libre remunerado para ayudarle a conciliar la vida laboral y personal.
  • Tiempo libre para las vacaciones de fin de año.

job.title: Live Experience Manager
job.description:
RG Live is looking for a highly organised, motivated, and commercially minded individual to join our growing Live Experiences team. The role offers the opportunity to support the delivery and expansion of large-scale event formats - from light trails to immersive location-based experiences - across global markets. You’ll play a central role in keeping projects running while contributing to the evolution of exciting, audience-facing experiences.

The role involves direct ownership and management of key commercial projects across the portfolio, working across core functions including ticketing, marketing, and finance to coordinate a smooth and successful delivery. You’ll also work closely with multiple external partners, and support the development of junior team members.

We’re looking for someone with proven experience in event promotion, strong commercial understanding, excellent communication skills, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Most importantly, you’ll bring energy, a proactive mindset, and a genuine enthusiasm for being part of an ambitious and growing team.

What you'll do:

Project Management
•    Attend and lead Senior Management Team meetings as required, conducting venue visits on a regular basis (where applicable).
•    Collaborate closely with venue teams and wider operational partners to ensure successful event delivery.
•    Monitor and execute opportunities for sales and profit maximization throughout the yearly event cycle.
•    Ensure booking processes, builds and reporting are executed accurately by the ticketing team for key projects.
•    Support re-contracting of sites where applicable.

Ticketing
•    Manage and support ticketing functions of the business as and where required – inclusive of relationship management, event builds, and creation and circulation of sales reports.
•    Support the Director of Development and Innovation in the development of ticketing practices for the company going forwards.
•    Support wider team / ticket agents in customer service responsibilities.

Financial Management
•    Monitor financial performance across assigned sites, working with the Director of Live Experiences and Finance team to support accurate and regular re-forecasting.
•    Manage, develop and grow P&L models for individual projects, ensuring they are kept up to date and accurate – with any key variances raised to the wider team.
•    Support the financial reconciliation of assigned projects with venues and internal and external teams.

Wider Business Support
•    Assist with the management, implementation, and growth of F&B and other secondary income opportunities across the portfolio.
•    Support the development and delivery of new and existing sponsors where required
•    Support the Director of Live Experiences and Director of Development and Innovation with delivery of P&L models and wider research for potential new projects.

 

 

Who you are:

  • Well-organised, excellent at multi-tasking and prioritising, and deadline focused with a flexible approach.
  • Excellent literacy skills with a proven ability to communicate across multiple internal and external business functions, both verbally and in writing.
  • Excellent numeracy skills with exceptional accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Motivated, proactive and demonstrates initiative, drive, and commitment to achieve objectives and support business growth.
  • Uses interpersonal skills to establish excellent rapport and working relationships.

 

What we give you:

job.description:
As Marketing Manager within Sony Music Entertainment Thailand, you will be the project lead on your assigned roster of domestic artists, responsible for building campaign plans in line with the artists vision and Sony Music.

Within the role you will be working closely with the artists, guiding them on social media, marketing planning and executing marketing and paid advertising strategies for the project, as well as commissioning creative and the marketing tools needed.

You will report to the Senior Marketing Manager of Sony Music Thailand and be joining a passionate group of like-minded and collaborative music fanatics.

job.title: Physical Sales & E-Commerce Executive, SEA
job.description:
The Physical Sales & E-Commerce Executive will support Sony Music’s growth of the physical market across Southeast Asia. The role will support the development and operation of physical sales channels for Vinyl, CDs and other physical products, working across both wholesale/distribution and D2C channels.

The role focuses on developing and operating sales channels, ensuring products are priced appropriately, inventory is forecasted and managed effectively, order are fulfilled and collected, and sales channels are maintained and optimised. This includes supporting the development of D2C infrastructure and storefronts using Shopify.

What you'll do:

  • Develop and grow physical sales channels across Southeast Asian territories, supporting the sale of Vinyl, CDs and other physical products.
  • Manage the day-to-day operational requirements of sales channels, including pricing, inventory management, forecasting, orders, delivery and collection of payments.
  • Support the development and management of wholesale/distribution channels, working with local distributors and retail partners to increase physical distribution and sales.
  • Support the development and operation of D2C sales channels, including the ongoing maintenance and optimisation of Shopify powered storefronts.
  • Act as a key operational contact for local and international stakeholders, working across labels, artist teams, merchandise companies, distributors, retail partner and platform partners.
  • Assist in the delivery of album launches, pre-orders, bundles and release activity across wholesale and D2C sales channels, working closely with artist, label and merchandise company partners.
  • Oversee the operational flow of physical products into sales channels, collaborating with fulfilment, logistics and other partners to maintain high service standards.
  • Support sales channel performance, contributing to sales targets, inventory optimisation, forecasting and commercial performance.

Who you are:

  • 2+ years experience in a physical sales, e-commerce or online retail role.
  • Strong hands-on experience managing sales channels and/or e-commerce stores.
  • Sales and operational experience, ideally with physical music products or consumer products.
  • Experience working with distributors, retail partners and D2C sales channels.
  • Comfortable working across multiple projects, artists and stakeholders in a fast-paced environment.  
  • Strong understanding of sales performance, inventory and forecasting and using data to guide decisions.
  • Highly organised, detail oriented, and confident working with numbers, spreadsheets, and Microsoft tools such as Excel, Teams, and Copilot.  
  • Hands-on Shopify experience.
  • Familiarity with the Southeast Asian retail or consumer landscape is advantageous.
 

What we give you:

  • You join a vibrant global community with the opportunity to channel your passion every day
  • A modern office environment designed for you, empowering you to bring your best
  • Investment in your professional growth and development enabling you to thrive in our vibrant community
  • The space to accelerate progress, positively disrupt and create what happens next
  • We give you the platform to champion positive change, with the opportunity to contribute to our social impact, diversity, equity and inclusion initiatives

job.title: Principal Software Engineer, Pub Admin
job.description:
At Sony Music Entertainment, we fuel the creative journey. We’ve played a pioneering role in music history, from the first-ever music label to the invention of the flat disc record. We’ve nurtured some of music’s most iconic artists and produced some of the most influential recordings of all time.

Today, we work in more than 70 countries, supporting a diverse roster of international superstars, developing and independent artists, and visionary creators. From our position at the intersection of music, entertainment, and technology, we bring imagination and expertise to the newest products and platforms, embrace new business models, employ breakthrough tools, and provide powerful insights that help our artists push creative boundaries and reach new audiences. In everything we do, we’re committed to artistic integrity, transparency, and entrepreneurship.

Sony Music Entertainment is a member of the Sony family of global companies.

Sony Music’s Product, Design, Engineering & Global Operations (PDEGO) team is seeking a Lead Software Engineer within our Pub Admin product team in our London King’s Cross office. Pub Admin is our unified, modern rights and royalty platform - where our engineers help transform a complex domain into simple, scalable, high-performance product solutions for Sony Music’s global songwriting community.

What you'll do:

  • Work with a cross-functional team to build products that empower artists and record labels across the globe
  • Contribute to all tiers of our architecture to produce high quality, robust user experiences
  • Write clean, tested, maintainable code
  • Work closely with product management to understand client requirements
  • Design, communicate and execute a vision in collaboration with your team and other teams across the technology organization
  • Participate in re-architecture, refinement and technical design of various systems
  • Mentor more junior engineers and contribute to a culture of continuous learning

Who you are:

  • Seeking 20+ years of software engineering experience in the following areas:
  • Experience implementing distributed systems
  • Experience in a scripting language (we use Python and JavaScript)
  • Experience building frontend applications (we use TypeScript, React, and GraphQL)
  • Experience with various database technologies and query languages (we use Neo4j, Kafka, MySQL, Snowflake, OpenSearch, and more)

The Ideal Candidate:

job.title: Sales and Marketing Manager
job.description:
About The Orchard

The Orchard is a leading full-service music distribution company operating in 48 markets worldwide and servicing top global independent artists and labels. With cutting-edge operations and an unparalleled global team, The Orchard partners with clients to provide full scale solutions across a variety of verticals. Championed by an exceptional community of music lovers and experts, The Orchard empowers creators to grow and evolve in the dynamic, global industry. 

The Orchard focuses on providing a comfortable, social, and engaging environment to encourage productivity and creativity.

This position will manage the day to day activities for key distributed labels, working alongside label clients to develop artists and promote content at the industry's leading independent music distributor and label services company.  The candidate must be Dubai based and have strong passion for and knowledge of the music distribution scene and the independent cross-genre music market, an understanding of digital retail platforms, release requirements and opportunities, a creative spirit, and solid technical capabilities.

What you'll do:

DSP Strategy & Campaign Management:

  • Develop, implement, and manage end-to-end digital marketing campaigns for new releases, with a core focus on DSP performance.
  • Secure and optimize key promotional placements across all DSPs, including playlist adds (editorial and algorithmic), homepage features, new release banners, and programmatic advertising.
  • Serve as the primary internal and external point of contact for all DSP partners, building and maintaining strong, productive relationships.
  • Lead catalog optimization initiatives to maximize the long-term performance, discoverability, and consumption of both frontline and catalog releases across all DSPs

Marketing Initiatives Development

  • Propose and pilot innovative marketing tactics to optimize the exposure of our new releases and maximize catalog potential.
  • Stay ahead of the latest trends, tools, and best practices in the digital music landscape, especially new features and promotional opportunities on DSPs.

Cross-Functional Leadership:

  • Lead the digital marketing planning process for assigned projects, presenting strategies and results to the relevant stakeholders.
  • Work closely with the Label Management Team to enhance the visibility and impact of priority releases across all DSPs.

Team Development

  • Provide active support and guidance to direct team members, facilitating problem resolution and implementing processes that enhance productivity and efficiency.
  • Act as a role model by demonstrating best practices for effective communication and pitching approaches with DSPs.

Who you are:

  • 5-7 years of experience in digital marketing, with a minimum of 3+ years focused specifically on music marketing at a label, distributor, or DSP.
  • Proven, demonstrable track record of successfully launching and managing music campaigns that resulted in significant growth in streams or playlist placements.
  • Experience working within a label, artist management or distribution system managing releases, projects or relationships
  • Established relationships with key contacts at major DSP is a significant advantage.
  • Deep understanding of the pitching tools, editorial workflows, algorithmic levers, and promotional opportunities across all major DSPs.
  • ⁠Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret streaming data and performance insights to optimize campaign execution and support strategic decision-making.
  • Knowledge of social marketing, online video platforms, digital advertising, and online
  • promotional outlets
  • High level of awareness and passion for local independent labels, artists and the Arabic music scene
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, fluent in Arabic and English
  • Demonstrated ability to lead teams and drive results through coaching and mentorship.

What we give you:

  • You join a vibrant global community with the opportunity to channel your passion every day
  • A modern office environment designed for you, empowering you to bring your best
  • Investment in your professional growth and development enabling you to thrive in our vibrant community

job.title: Senior Accountant – Finanzbuchhalter:in (m/w/d)
job.description:
Location: Berlin, Hamburg,

 

Wir suchen kurzfristig einen erfahrenen Finanzbuchhalter

Die Kings Road Merch GmbH ist ein weltweit etablierter Full-Service Anbieter von Merchandise-Produkten und -Dienstleistungen.

Als eigenständige deutsche Tochter eines weltweiten Musikkonzerns bieten wir individuelle Webshops für Bands oder Künstler an. Auf ihren Touren betreuen wir das Merchandising in Spielstätten in ganz Europa.

Unsere Services reichen dabei von der Herstellung der Merch-Produkte über die Lagerung und Logistik in unserem Logistikzentrum in Dortmund, die europaweite Tourbetreuung sowie den Betrieb individualisierter Webshops.

Wir suchen dich, wenn du Spaß daran hast, in der Musikindustrie rund um bedruckte T-Shirts und Fanartikel zu arbeiten. Europäische Umsatzsteuern, OSS und Quellensteuern schrecken dich nicht ab? Du möchtest mit unserem ERP-System NetSuite und eng mit internationalen Finance-Partnern arbeiten?

Als Senior Accountant übernimmst du eine zentrale Rolle bei der Steuerung, Überwachung und kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung der Finance- und Accounting-Prozesse für das europäische Geschäft von Kings Road Merch. In enger Abstimmung mit dem europäischen Management und der globalen Finance-Organisation stellst du sicher, dass Abschlüsse, Reporting, Compliance und interne Kontrollen verlässlich, fristgerecht und nach einheitlichen Standards umgesetzt werden.

Aufgaben

  • Zentrale Steuerung und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung der Accounting-Prozesse für das europäische Geschäft von KRM
  • Eigenständige Betreuung der Debitoren- und Kreditorenbuchhaltung
  • Prüfung von Rechnungen und Abwicklung des Zahlungsverkehrs
  • Forderungsmanagement
  • Erstellung der Umsatzsteuermeldungen in allen europäischen Ländern in Zusammenarbeit mit unserem internationalen Compliance Partner
  • Vorbereitung und Koordination der Monats- und Jahresabschlüsse nach HGB sowie des Reportings
  • Erstellung und Qualitätssicherung des monatlichen Finanzreportings an die US-Muttergesellschaft
  • Funktion als zentrale Finance-Schnittstelle zwischen KRM EU, dem europäischen Management und der globalen Finance-Organisation
  • Sicherstellung verlässlicher interner Kontrollen, Dokumentationen und einheitlicher Accounting-Standards
  • Identifikation und Umsetzung von Verbesserungen und Automatisierungen innerhalb der Finance-Prozesse
  • Unterstützung bei der Weiterentwicklung und effizienten Nutzung von NetSuite

 

Profil

  • Abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung, idealerweise als Steuerfachangestellte:r oder Finanzbuchhalter:in; alternativ eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in einer eigenverantwortlichen Accounting-Funktion
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse der Finanzbuchhaltung und Abschlusserstellung nach HGB
  • Erfahrung mit Monats- und Jahresabschlüssen sowie Finanz- und Konzernreporting; IFRS-Kenntnisse sind wünschenswert
  • Erfahrung in der Steuerung und Verbesserung von Accounting-Prozessen, idealerweise in einem internationalen Unternehmensumfeld
  • Fähigkeit, eigenständig zu arbeiten und gleichzeitig eng mit internationalen Finance- und Managementteams zusammenzuarbeiten
  • Erfahrung mit NetSuite oder die Bereitschaft, sich einzuarbeiten
  • Gute Englischkenntnisse für die regelmäßige Zusammenarbeit mit der globalen Finance-Organisation

Unser Angebot

  • Spannende und abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeiten im Musikbusiness
  • Sicherheit und Möglichkeiten eines internationalen Konzerns
  • Modernes, digitalisiertes Accounting im weltweiten Umfeld
  • Eigenverantwortung und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten
  • Flache Hierarchien und kurze Entscheidungswege
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten (Mo-Fr) mit der Möglichkeit zum mobilen Arbeiten
  • Vielfältiges Team
  • Moderne Altersvorsorge
  • Fahrkostenzuschuss oder Jobrad

 

English Translation:

Location: Berlin, Hamburg, 


We are currently seeking a Senior Accountant.

Kings Road Merch GmbH is a globally established full-service provider of merchandise products and services. As an independent German subsidiary of a global music group, we offer customized online shops for bands and artists. We manage merchandising at venues throughout Europe during their tours.

Our services range from the production of merchandise products to storage and logistics in our logistics center in Dortmund, Europe-wide tour support, and the operation of customized online shops.

We are looking for you if you enjoy working in the music industry with printed T-shirts and merchandise. European VAT, OSS and withholding tax requirements do not intimidate you, and you are keen to work with NetSuite and collaborate closely with international Finance partners.

As Senior Accountant, you will play a key role in overseeing and continuously improving the finance and accounting processes supporting KRM's European business. Working closely with the European management team and the global Finance organization, you will ensure that financial close, reporting, compliance and internal controls are accurate, timely and consistently applied.

 

What you will do:

  • Central oversight and continuous improvement of the accounting processes supporting KRM’s European business
    Independent management of accounts receivable and accounts payable processes
  • Invoice review and payment processing
  • Accounts receivable management
  • Preparation of VAT returns in all European countries in collaboration with our international compliance partner
  • Preparation and coordination of monthly and annual financial statements in accordance with the German Commercial Code (HGB), as well as reporting
  • Preparation and quality assurance of monthly financial reporting to the US parent company
  • Act as the central Finance interface between KRM EU, the European management team and the global Finance organization
  • Ensure reliable internal controls, documentation and consistently applied accounting standards
  • Identify and implement improvements and automation opportunities across Finance processes
  • Support the continued development and effective use of NetSuite

 

Who you are:

  • Completed commercial training, ideally as a tax clerk or financial accountant, or an equivalent qualification
  • Several years of professional experience in an accounting role with a high level of ownership
  • Strong knowledge of financial accounting and financial statement preparation under the German Commercial Code (HGB)
  • Experience with monthly and annual financial statements as well as financial and group reporting; IFRS knowledge is desirable
  • Experience in overseeing and improving accounting processes, ideally within an international business environment
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating closely with international Finance and management teams
  • Proficiency in Oracle NetSuite and Microsoft Excel is highly desirable.
  • Good English skills for regular collaboration with the global Finance organization

 

What we offer

  • Exciting and varied activities in the music business
  • Security and opportunities of an international corporation
  • Modern, digitalized accounting in a global environment
  • Personal responsibility and development opportunities
  • Flat hierarchies and short decision-making processes
  • Flexible working hours (Mon-Fri) with the option of remote working
  • Diverse team
  • Modern pension plan
  • Travel allowance or company bike

job.title: Senior Director, Artist Lead, Columbia Records
job.description:
About Sony Music Entertainment

At Sony Music Entertainment, we fuel the creative journey. We’ve played a pioneering role in music history, from the first-ever music label to the invention of the flat disc record. We’ve nurtured some of music’s most iconic artists and produced some of the most influential recordings of all time.

Today, we work in more than 70 countries, supporting a diverse roster of international superstars, developing and independent artists, and visionary creators. From our position at the intersection of music, entertainment, and technology, we bring imagination and expertise to the newest products and platforms, embrace new business models, employ breakthrough tools, and provide powerful insights that help our artists push creative boundaries and reach new audiences. In everything we do, we’re committed to artistic integrity, transparency, and entrepreneurship.

Sony Music Entertainment is a member of the Sony family of global companies.

As a Senior Director, Artist Lead within Marketing, you are the lead marketing & digital strategist across assigned roster. You will be responsible for overseeing the planning, development, and execution of innovative marketing strategies for assigned artist projects, which will have a focus on Rock and Dance genres. You will lead collaboration across all internal departments, and all communication with external artist camps.

What you'll do:

  • Lead the creation, development, and execution of marketing roll out strategies for assigned projects.
  • Participate in near- and long-term creative planning to ensure a clear and consistent message for assigned projects while acting as a central point of contact and lead for all assigned projects.  Work with all departments in meeting deadlines and keeping a creative thread running throughout the projects.
  • Liaise with artist management on a regular basis and communicate label plans and expectations.
  • Manage campaign budgets for each assigned project.
  • Participate in managing release schedule as it pertains to assigned projects.
  • Lead brainstorm sessions w/ internal Viral/UGC & Audience Development teams to prepare campaign concepts for pitching and execution.
  • Assist in the creation & execution of artist messaging calendars across social media websites ensuring timely and accurate delivery.
  • Liase w/ internal short form content team to support campaign rollout and ensure all content needs are underway.
  • Oversee and own digital setup across artist profile and campaign rollout.
  • Liase & collaborate w/ internal audience development team across assigned artists to ensure proper on-going campaign engagement.
  • Liase & collaborate w/ internal VIRL/UGC team to support online creator & sound growth campaigns.
  • Research and evaluate customer needs, industry landscape, and market/cultural trends.
  • Identify and analyze new and innovative exposure and revenue generating opportunities for assigned artists.
  • Coordinate video launches with release planning, including acquiring ISRCs, setting up YouTube premieres, and monitoring engagement metrics to ensure successful video rollouts.
  • Work with artist management and A&R on assessing artist development needs.
  • Ideate and execute lifestyle marketing strategies to position artist/roster within highly engaged cultural and lifestyle communities, fostering deep emotional connections, brand affinity, and advocacy.
  • Work directly with internal publicity team on assigned artist campaign strategy. Liase w/ external indie press partners, as needed, to ensure campaign execution.
  • Work with International Marketing department to ensure marketing plans and project needs are met and executed on a global basis.
  • Liase w/ internal experiential marketing team on the planning and execution of artist showcases/listening parties/events.

Who you are:

  • You’re a passionate music fan with at least 8 years of progressive marketing experience in the music industry and expertise in breaking artists in the Dance and Rock spaces.
  • Self-starter who adapts quickly to change and can work in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.
  • Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills for crafting compelling narratives and collaborating with various teams including artists camps and senior management.
  • Creative thinker with a demonstrated ability to apply ideas strategically while working to a set budget and timeline.
  • Ability to generate original and engaging digital marketing and content ideas that align with the artist's brand.
  • Proficient with major social media platforms including TikTok, Instagram, Twitter, Triller, YouTube Reddit and Snapchat.
  • Strong understanding of short form content and what performs best online.
  • Organizational Skills: Strong ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines.
  • Adaptability and Learning Agility: Openness to feedback, willingness to learn new skills, and adaptability to rapidly changing digital trends and technologies.
  • Accountability: Strong sense of responsibility and accountability for deliverables, ensuring high-quality and timely output.
 

What we give you:

  • You join an inclusive, collaborative and global community where you have the opportunity to channel your passion every day  
  • A modern office environment designed to foster productivity, creativity, and teamwork empowering you to bring your best 
  • An attractive and comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life & disability coverage, and 401K + employer matching 
  • Voluntary benefits like company-paid identity theft protection and resources for pets, mental health and meditation resources, industry-leading fertility coverage, fully paid leave for childbirth or bonding, fully paid leave for caregivers, programs for loved ones with developmental disabilities and neurodiversity, subsidized back-up child and elder care, and reimbursement for adoption, surrogacy, tuition, and student loans 
  • Investment in your professional growth and development enabling you to thrive in our vibrant community.  
  • The space to accelerate progress, positively disrupt, and create what happens next

job.title: Senior Director, Learning eXperience Curator (International)
job.description:
The Senior Director, Learning eXperience Curator is a regionally embedded people leader responsible for translating The Learning Collective’s learning, performance, and growth strategy into practical, high‑impact execution on learning experiences across a multi‑region portfolio. This role develops and leads in-person and virtual learning experiences across international regions in Europe, Africa, Australia & New Zealand, and Asia & Middle East. In this role you will ensure learning experiences are globally aligned and locally resonant, while building scalable delivery capacity through a strong Train‑the‑Trainer program and Learning Ambassador network.

What you'll do:

  • Participate in setting the global learning strategy, ensuring that local and regional cultural needs and differences are represented and considered. Drive its delivery across international markets, ensuring regional consistency while addressing local learning needs.
  • Establish strategic partnerships with Regional Presidents and Regional PX VPs to translate the TLC Strategy into regional and local deliverables and learning experiences. Define regional learning agendas aligned with the global strategy and, where required, reflecting varying levels of learning maturity, in line with TLC standards.
  • Lead needs analyses with PX Business Partners and leaders; convert insight into scalable, measurable learning solutions that improve performance, skills, and capability development.
  • Design and facilitate high‑impact learning or group coaching experiences (live and virtual) that drive behavior change, team effectiveness, and high performance across multiple cultures and seniority levels.
  • Own Train‑the‑Trainer (TTT) for International: design and deliver TTT recruitment and enablement, develop facilitator standards, build practice and quality loops (observation, feedback, co‑facilitation), and sustain a facilitator community rhythm.
  • Lead through a matrix: directly manage relevant local learning roles and provide support and coaching to the extended TLC team, Learning Ambassadors, and cross‑regional contributors to ensure consistent quality and adoption.
  • Ensure governance and coherence: reduce duplication, maintain quality, and partner with internal content/design/communications and external partners where appropriate.
  • Embed measurement: define success metrics and reporting, share executive‑ready insights, and continuously improve experiences based on data and feedback.

Who you are:

  • Proven senior learning leader with significant experience designing and facilitating learning experiences (live and virtual) that deliver measurable behaviour change.
  • Strong people leader with experience coaching and developing teams across geographies, cultures, and time zones.
  • Confident working in matrixed organizations with dual reporting lines and high stakeholder complexity.
  • Culturally fluent and agile - able to tailor content and approach across regions, audiences, role functions, and business contexts.
  • Coaching capability strongly preferred; ICF accreditation (or progress toward) is an advantage.

job.title: Senior Manager, Audience Intelligence
job.description:
About Sony Music Entertainment

At Sony Music Entertainment, we fuel the creative journey. We’ve played a pioneering role in music history, from the first-ever music label to the invention of the flat disc record. We’ve nurtured some of music’s most iconic artists and produced some of the most influential recordings of all time.

Today, we work in more than 70 countries, supporting a diverse roster of international superstars, developing and independent artists, and visionary creators. From our position at the intersection of music, entertainment, and technology, we bring imagination and expertise to the newest products and platforms, embrace new business models, employ breakthrough tools, and provide powerful insights that help our artists push creative boundaries and reach new audiences. In everything we do, we’re committed to artistic integrity, transparency, and entrepreneurship.

Sony Music Entertainment is a member of the Sony family of global companies.

The Senior Manager, Audience Intelligence leads Sony Music Canada’s audience insights function, delivering data-driven intelligence that informs campaign planning, audience growth, fan engagement, and direct-to-consumer strategy across the organization. The position currently manages 1 direct report and reports into a broader regional team spanning the U.S, Canada, Australia, and New Zealand.

This role focuses on transforming audience, streaming, social, and commerce data into actionable insights that support artist development, release strategy, CRM initiatives, and fan monetization opportunities.

The Senior Manager plays a critical role in measuring release and campaign performance, uncovering audience trends, to build a more unified view of the fan journey from streaming discovery and social engagement through to owned-channel interaction and commerce conversion.

This is a highly collaborative role for an analytically driven individual who is passionate about music, fan behaviour, and the evolving music data and distribution ecosystem.

What you'll do:

Analytics & Audience Insight Development

• Collaborate with Commercial Partnerships, Marketing, A&R, the Executive team and Audience Intelligence teams with real-time insights to inform artist signings, campaign planning, optimization, and post-campaign analysis.
• Collect, analyze, and interpret audience data across streaming platforms, physical sales, social media, paid media, CRM, and D2C commerce channels.
• Conduct deep-dive analyses into audience behavior, fan demographics, psychographics, and engagement trends to support targeting and segmentation strategies.
• Identify emerging audience opportunities, cultural trends, and high value fan segments that can inform artist marketing and growth strategies.
• Manage product release forecasting and audience trend analysis for domestic and international frontline and catalogue priorities.
• Deliver ad-hoc analysis to support the needs of the business, assist with other projects and process improvement initiatives as required.

D2C, CRM & Fan Lifecycle Intelligence

• Lead audience measurement and performance reporting across Sony Music Canada’s direct-to-consumer ecosystem, CRM programs, and owned fan acquisition initiatives.
• Analyze customer behavior, conversion trends, retention, and purchase activity to inform D2C strategy and optimization.
• Develop frameworks that map audience pathways between streaming engagement, social interaction, CRM acquisition, and commerce conversion.
• Partner with digital and marketing teams, and D2C stakeholders to identify opportunities for fan acquisition, audience re-engagement, lifecycle marketing, and conversion growth.

Reporting, Visualization & Operational Excellence

• Build and evolve scalable dashboards, KPI scorecards, and reporting frameworks tracking campaign performance, audience growth, streaming trends, CRM engagement, and D2C performance.
• Translate complex datasets into clear, actionable business intelligence for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Assist with funding requests (e.g., Ontario Music Investment Fund), support new business development, and handle ad hoc data or reporting requests from key departments.

Who you are:

• 5+ years of experience in analytics, digital marketing, audience insights, or performance reporting (music, entertainment, media, or e-commerce preferred).
• Proficiency in analytical languages such as SQL and/or Python is considered a strong asset.
• Experience with analytics and BI tools including Alteryx, Tableau, Power BI and Shopify analytics.
• Experience with music and audience platforms including Luminate, Spotify for Artists, Apple Music For Artists, Amazon Music For Artists, YouTube Analytics and Chartmetric.
• Strong analytical and quantitative skills with experience working across multiple datasets.
• Strong communication skills to build trusted relationships and translate data into actionable business insights.
• Highly organized, detail-oriented, and collaborative with strong follow through.
• Creates an environment where direct reports can perform, grow, and contribute at their highest level
• Navigates a fast-changing industry while helping their team to adapt.
• Fosters a culture where diverse perspectives are valued and everyone can contribute
• Understands how decisions impact artists, audiences, and business performance
• Passion for music, fan culture, digital platforms, and audience behavior.

job.title: Android Engineer - Fan Monetization
job.description:
SoundCloud empowers artists, tastemakers and fans to connect and share through music. Founded in 2007, SoundCloud is a creator-first platform helping artists build and grow their careers by providing them with the most advanced tools, services, and resources. With over 4x the music catalog of every other major streaming platform, spanning 40+ million artists across 190+ countries, SoundCloud is where emerging artists find their sound, hidden gems are discovered, and music culture is shaped in real time.

We are looking for a mid-level Android Engineer to join the SoundCloud Fan Monetization team. Our mission is to deepen the connection between fans and creators, building features that enhance how fans engage with and support their favorite artists. In this role, you will operate as part of a truly global team, collaborating regularly with engineers and product partners in London, Berlin, and elsewhere to deliver high-quality mobile experiences. You’ll focus almost exclusively on a modern Jetpack Compose stack, shipping high-impact features to millions of users worldwide.

This role offers a fantastic growth runway. You'll work in a forward-thinking environment that fully embraces AI acceleration to streamline development, while focusing on building clean, intuitive user interfaces.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and scale SoundCloud's fan-facing features across Android, focusing heavily on building clean, responsive UI and features using Kotlin and Jetpack Compose
  • Embrace and utilize advanced AI tools to safely, securely, and responsibly accelerate your coding workflows, code reviews, and testing
  • Partner closely with product, design, and data teams across our international offices (including London and Berlin) to define, build, and iterate on features
  • Participate in feature scoping, product experimentation (A/B testing), analytics integration, and agile delivery to optimize user engagement
  • Engage in code reviews and engineering best practices to maintain a high standard of performance, accessibility, and platform consistency

Experience and Background:

  • 3+ years of experience building Android applications with a solid foundation in Kotlin and a strong familiarity with Jetpack Compose
  • You prefer looking forward; this role focuses entirely on our modern Kotlin/Jetpack Compose components, with no requirement to maintain or refactor legacy Java or outdated architectures
  • Excited about leveraging AI development assistants to optimize your productivity, code quality, and learning
  • Skilled at working within agile, distributed teams, proactively communicating, and breaking down problems into elegant, maintainable code
  • While your primary focus is Android, an openness or curiosity toward occasionally learning or collaborating across other tech stacks—such as iOS, Web, or Backend (Go)—is a welcome plus
  • You love music, mobile products, and the idea of helping creators build closer bonds with their audience

The salary range for this role is $140,000 - $165,000 annually. The final salary offered will be determined based on relative experience, skills, internal equity, and location. We also offer a generous total rewards program - read more about additional benefits and perks below! 

About us:

  • We are a multinational company with offices in the US (New York and Los Angeles), Germany (Berlin), and the UK (London)
  • We provide a flexible work culture that offers the opportunity to collaborate and connect in person at our offices as well as accommodating work from home
  • We are deeply committed to ensuring diversity, equity and inclusion at all levels of our organization and fostering a community where everyone’s voice, perspective and experience is respected and heard
  • We believe a strong team is made by investing in employees through mentorship, workshops and enrichment opportunities

Benefits:

  • Comprehensive health benefits including medical, dental, and vision plans, as well as mental health resources
  • Robust 401k program
  • Employee Equity Plan
  • Generous professional development allowance
  • Interested in a gym membership, photography course or book? We have a Creativity and Wellness benefit!
  • Flexible vacation and public holiday policy where you can take up to 35 days of PTO annually
  • 16 paid weeks for all parents (birthing and non-birthing), regardless of gender, to welcome newborns, adopted and foster children
  • Various snacks, goodies, and 2 free lunches weekly when at the office

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion at SoundCloud

SoundCloud is for everyone. Diversity and open expression are fundamental to our organization; they help us lead what’s next in music by understanding and empowering our creators and fans, no matter their identity. We acknowledge the challenges in the music industry, and strive to influence an inclusive culture where everyone can contribute respectfully and thrive, especially the historically marginalized communities that many of our creators, fans and SoundClouders identify with. We are dedicated to creating an inclusive environment at SoundCloud for everyone, regardless of gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, migration background, national origin, age, disability status, or care-giver status.

At SoundCloud you can find your community or elevate your allyship by joining a Diversity Resource Group. Diversity Resource Groups are employee-organized groups focused on supporting and promoting the interests of a particular underrepresented community in order to build a more inclusive culture at SoundCloud. Anyone can join, whether you share the identity or strive to be an ally.

job.description:
SoundCloud empowers artists, tastemakers and fans to connect and share through music. Founded in 2007, SoundCloud is a creator-first platform helping artists build and grow their careers by providing them with the most advanced tools, services, and resources. With over 4x the music catalog of every other major streaming platform, spanning 40+ million artists across 190+ countries, SoundCloud is where emerging artists find their sound, hidden gems are discovered, and music culture is shaped in real time.   SoundCloud is looking for a Staff Accountant with a passion for numbers to join our great finance team in New York! In this role, you will be part of a dynamic Finance team distributed across our offices in the US and Berlin. The position will focus on supporting our music distribution, premium artist, and advertising business lines. You will work closely with stakeholders across multiple lines of business and global teams, contributing your skills to core finance-related processes and projects within the SoundCloud Group. As part of our US finance function, you will collaborate closely with team members in Berlin while taking ownership of your day-to-day responsibilities. Experienced colleagues are dedicated to sharing their knowledge to help you thrive, grow your skill set, and expand your impact. Following an initial onboarding phase, you will have the opportunity to help streamline and elevate our accounting processes as our business continues to evolve.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Manage monthly & annual closing and reporting for the distribution line of business
  • Own Revenue Recognition and Accounts Receivable, including the reconciliation process between DSP reporting, our royalties system, and the general ledger
  • Execute monthly reconciliations of all accounts associated with your respective business lines
  • Track Cash and Marketing advance payments and recoupments, including ensuring that all recoupable expenses are accurately associated with an artist account
  • Maintain General Ledger bookkeeping, ensuring accuracy and completeness for all P&L and balance sheet items within your respective business line
  • Creating and processing outgoing invoices to customers and booking the receipt of associated cash
  • Processing record label and music publishing invoices and payments
  • Partnering with our FP&A department
  • Collaboration with other teams on accounting matters/projects, acting as a proactive business partner

Experience and Background:

  • 1+ year of experience in Accounting or Auditing, preferably in the Music industry
  • Strong skills in MS Excel and good knowledge in the use of ERP systems (Oracle Fusion would be a plus) 
  • Knowledge of US GAAP and/or IFRS 
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced and ambitious work environment in which colleagues are measured by outputs and not formalities
  • Excellent analytical skills and a structured approach to work are as much a part of your personality as your ability to work in a team and your strong sense of initiative 

The salary range for this role is $70,000 - $75,000 annually. The final salary offered will be determined based on relative experience, skills, internal equity, and location. We also offer a generous total rewards program - read more about additional benefits and perks below!

About us:

  • We are a multinational company with offices in the US (New York and Los Angeles), Germany (Berlin), and the UK (London)
  • We provide a flexible work culture that offers the opportunity to collaborate and connect in person at our offices as well as accommodating work from home
  • We are deeply committed to ensuring diversity, equity and inclusion at all levels of our organization and fostering a community where everyone’s voice, perspective and experience is respected and heard
  • We believe a strong team is made by investing in employees through mentorship, workshops and enrichment opportunities

Benefits:

  • Comprehensive health benefits, including medical, dental, and vision plans, as well as mental health resources
  • Robust 401k program
  • Employee Equity Plan
  • Generous professional development allowance
  • Interested in a gym membership, photography course, or book? We have a Creativity and Wellness benefit!
  • Flexible vacation and public holiday policy, where you can take up to 35 days of PTO annually
  • 16 paid weeks for all parents (birthing and non-birthing), regardless of gender, to welcome newborns, adopted, and foster children
  • Various snacks, goodies, and 2 free lunches weekly when at the office

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion at SoundCloud

SoundCloud is for everyone. Diversity and open expression are fundamental to our organization; they help us lead what’s next in music by understanding and empowering our creators and fans, no matter their identity. We acknowledge the challenges in the music industry, and strive to influence an inclusive culture where everyone can contribute respectfully and thrive, especially the historically marginalized communities that many of our creators, fans, and SoundClouders identify with. We are dedicated to creating an inclusive environment at SoundCloud for everyone, regardless of gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, migration background, national origin, age, disability status, or care-giver status.

At SoundCloud, you can find your community or elevate your allyship by joining a Diversity Resource Group. Diversity Resource Groups are employee-organized groups focused on supporting and promoting the interests of a particular underrepresented community in order to build a more inclusive culture at SoundCloud. Anyone can join, whether you share the identity or strive to be an ally.

job.title: Chief Financial Officer
job.description:
Spanish Broadcasting System, Inc. | Miami, Florida

Reports to: Chief Operating Officer

Position Overview

Spanish Broadcasting System, Inc. (“SBS”), a leading Hispanic media and entertainment company, is seeking an experienced Chief Financial Officer to lead the Company’s finance organization and serve as a strategic partner to senior management.

Reporting to the Chief Operating Officer, the CFO will oversee the Company’s financial strategy and operations, including accounting and financial reporting, treasury, budgeting and forecasting, financial planning and analysis, internal controls, audit, tax oversight, and financial systems.

The ideal candidate will be a hands-on, commercially minded finance executive with strong leadership skills and experience operating in a complex, multi-market organization.

Key Responsibilities
  • Lead the Company’s overall finance and accounting functions.
  • Partner with executive leadership on financial strategy, business planning and operational performance.
  • Oversee budgeting, forecasting, cash management, treasury and working capital.
  • Ensure timely and accurate financial reporting and maintain strong accounting and internal-control processes.
  • Lead financial planning and analysis, including performance reporting, variance analysis and key financial and operating metrics.
  • Oversee external audit, tax and other financial compliance matters.
  • Provide financial analysis and support for strategic initiatives, investments and business opportunities.
  • Partner with operating leadership to evaluate performance across markets, products and business lines.
  • Lead, develop and strengthen the finance organization, promoting accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement.
  • Identify opportunities to improve financial systems, reporting, automation and business processes.
  • Support corporate finance, banking, capital markets and transactional activities, as appropriate.
  • Provide clear and effective financial reporting and analysis to senior management and the Board of Directors.
Qualifications
  • Significant progressive finance leadership experience, ideally as a CFO, divisional CFO or senior finance executive.
  • Strong experience in accounting, financial reporting, FP&A, treasury, budgeting, forecasting and internal controls.
  • Demonstrated experience leading finance functions in a complex, multi-entity or multi-location organization.
  • Strong business judgment and ability to translate financial information into actionable business insights.
  • Experience working with senior executives, Boards, auditors, banks and other external partners.
  • Experience with financial systems, automation and process improvement.
  • Media, broadcasting, digital media, advertising, entertainment or related industry experience is preferred.
  • Public-company experience is preferred.
  • M&A, financing and capital markets experience is a plus.
  • CPA and/or advanced degree preferred.
  • Bilingual English/Spanish is highly desirable.
Leadership Profile

The successful candidate will be a hands-on, strategic and collaborative leader who combines strong financial discipline with a practical understanding of business operations. The individual should be comfortable operating in a dynamic environment, developing high-performing teams, improving processes and partnering across functions to support growth and long-term value creation.

Spanish Broadcasting System, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world. Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible. Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. Reporting to the Director of Accounting, you'll own meaningful pieces of the monthly close, help carry the company through its first-year audit and toward IPO readiness, and bring a measured, meaningful approach to AI that unlocks the efficiency expected of a best-in-class team. job.title: Lead Corporate Security Engineer
job.description:
About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world. Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible. Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

About the role

The Lead Corporate Security Engineer will be our domain expert for securing our Corporate IT environment. You’ll work closely with colleagues in IT, Business Systems, Security, and Engineering to ensure that our corporate systems are implemented and maintained securely. As a senior member of the team, your impact will be split between building your team, enabling others, and doing hands-on work to mature our systems, processes, and behaviors. You'll lead the corporate security domain end to end: identity and access governance, endpoint and vulnerability management, detection and response, third-party integration risk, vendor assessment, and SaaS posture. You'll set the standard, own the roadmap, and be accountable for the outcome. IT Engineering runs the platforms day to day and are your closest partners. How this role works with IT Ownership splits by layer, not by system. IT Engineering owns the run; you own the standard and the direction. You set the corporate security roadmap. What we secure, in what order, to what bar with buy-in from leadership and XFN stakeholders IT engineering owns platform operations. Our SaaS portfolio is administered and integrated by them. You define what those platforms must enforce You raise the bar around you. You make your reasoning explicit so that partners make good security calls without you in the room, and you build the tooling and defaults that make the secure path the default path What you'll own Identity and access governance Own the access model at Suno: the RBAC and entitlement design, least-privilege defaults, and the governance layer in Lumos that enforces them Set the standard for what access review, certification, and approval should look like here — then build toward it rather than importing someone else's framework Drive access lifecycle automation so joiner/mover/leaver is correct by default and exceptions are visible Get ahead of non-human identity: service accounts, agents, and automations are a growing share of what holds access at Suno, and we need a model for them before it's urgent Endpoint security and vulnerability management Own the security standard for our fleet: hardening baseline, compliance signals, device trust, and how endpoint posture feeds access decisions Own third-party vulnerability management as a program — coverage, risk-based remediation SLAs, reporting, and the negotiation with teams whose tools are the problem Partner with the IT engineer who owns Kandji so the standard becomes deployed policy without degrading how people work Detection and response Own our EDR deployment and maintenance Collaborate with Detection and Response on corporate security incidents to closure Third-party and integration risk Own how Suno evaluates third-party access: integration and OAuth review for Slack, Google Workspace and the rest of the portfolio, plus vendor security assessment at purchase and renewal Define our risk appetite in practice and make it legible enough that others apply it without you Turn recurring decisions into policy, scope guidance, and tooling so the review queue shrinks as the company grows SaaS security posture Build and own the program: the bar for our SaaS applications, the assessment cadence, and the remediation that follows Improve tenant-level configuration across the portfolio — SSO and SCIM coverage, MFA and session policy, admin role hygiene, OAuth grant and token management, data sharing defaults Cross-functional leadership Work with IT, Security, Engineering, AI Enablement, and Legal to shape how Suno builds and buys Influence the scope of what comes next: how our GRC function plugs in, what we automate versus staff, where the next investment goes Mentor and raise the technical bar for people around you, including partners who aren't security specialists What success looks like First 90 days: you've formed your own view of our security posture, built working relationships with the IT engineers the broader Security team, and told us the three things we're wrong about First 6 months: a corporate security roadmap exists that IT and the CISO are aligned behind, with the sequencing and the tradeoffs made explicit; the highest-risk items are already moving First year: entitlement sprawl and vulnerability backlog are measurably down, detection reflects our real risks, third-party review is fast enough that nobody routes around it, and the standard holds because it's built into tooling and shared judgment rather than into you What you'll bring ~8+ years in corporate/enterprise security or security engineering, including having owned identity, endpoint, or SaaS Suno’s growth runs on paid social, and paid social runs on creative. This is a hands-on motion design role for someone who builds motion that stops the scroll on Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok. You’ll take our brand team’s polished motion and rework it into performance-native ad variants, and you’ll build original motion from scratch for paid: kinetic type, animated text and captions, logo, product, and UI motion, the pieces that carry a hook when there’s no live footage. This is a craft role with real creative latitude. You won’t be handed a finished board and told to render it. You’ll bring your own ideas for how motion can earn attention and drive a click, then move fast to test, iterate, and find what wins. Great work here is measured by performance, and you’ll see the results of your work quickly enough to act on them. If you live in After Effects, think in hooks and hold rates as much as keyframes, and want your motion in front of a massive global audience within days, this one is for you. Check out the song we made about it: https://suno.com/s/dDrWV7XNe6I5mJax

What You’ll Do

Rework the brand team’s motion into performance-native ad variants for Meta and TikTok. Build original motion from scratch for paid: kinetic type, animated captions, logo, product, and UI motion. Design motion that carries the hook in the first second, especially where there’s no live footage. Produce multiple iterations of winning concepts to feed continuous creative testing. Adapt motion across formats and placements (9:16, 1:1, 4:5) for Stories, Reels, and Feed. Bring original concepts and angles to the table, not just execute against a board. Hold brand coherence while pushing what actually works for performance. Turn performance signals into sharper motion, doubling down on what’s working.

What You’ll Need

A strong portfolio of motion built for short-form video ads on Meta and/or TikTok, or comparable performance work. Senior-level command of Adobe After Effects, plus Premiere for assembly and CapCut for fast cuts. A real grasp of direct-response creative: hooks, angles, pacing, and why motion wins or loses, not just how it looks. Proven ability to produce a high volume of variants at pace without dropping quality. A proactive, self-directed working style. You spot what’s missing and bring ideas without being asked. Comfort extending an existing brand system while building net-new motion for performance. Nice-to-Haves

Experience

at a consumer subscription app, a growth agency running paid social, or a DTC/ecommerce brand. Comfort reading performance metrics such as hook rate, hold rate, and CTR, and adjusting creative accordingly. Working knowledge of Illustrator, Photoshop, and Figma for prepping and adapting assets. Comfort folding AI tools into a motion workflow to move faster. A love of music and an eye for culture. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a Senior / Staff Behavioral Engineer to make safe behavior the path of least resistance at Suno. Instead of only catching abuse after it happens, you'll work upstream. You'll study how bad actors exploit our product and where well-intentioned employees fall into risky shortcuts. Then you'll redesign the flows, defaults, friction points, and incentives underneath so that harmful behavior is structurally harder to carry out. Working at the intersection of behavioral science, product design, and security and trust & safety, you'll partner closely with Product and Engineering to build risk-reducing changes directly into their roadmaps. This work will help lay the foundation for Suno's security programs and strengthen our overall risk posture across security, trust & safety, fraud, and privacy.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Investigate how abuse and risk actually happen on our platform and inside the company. That includes reading logs, interviewing support and ops teams, and reconstructing user and employee journeys to find the easy paths to harm. Design concrete changes to signup flows, permission defaults, rate limits, approval steps, and verification gates, working alongside PMs and designers. Get your recommendations onto other teams' roadmaps by making the case in planning meetings, writing proposals, and negotiating trade-offs, all without owning the roadmap yourself. Measure changes in real behavior, not just detection rates. You'll define success metrics before a change ships and run before/after comparisons to prove impact. Lead cross-functional root-cause reviews after incidents and near-misses by asking what about the design made risky behavior the easy option, then turning the answers into concrete backlog items. Stay ahead of new attack patterns by tracking industry incidents and behavioral science research. You'll design targeted awareness and training only where it's the best lever, and make sure people actually find it useful. Help make safe, trustworthy experiences part of how Suno builds every product, in service of making creative fulfillment a daily reality for everyone.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

MUST-HAVES 6+ years of

experience

in trust & safety, security, fraud, anti-abuse, or risk-focused product work, with the technical fluency to dig into logs and data yourself and to work credibly with engineers on implementation. A track record of reducing risky behavior through product and process design (flows, defaults, friction, incentives), with measurable before/after results. Strong influence skills, including a history of getting changes prioritized on roadmaps you didn't own by building trust with Product, Engineering, and Design partners. NICE-TO-HAVES Formal background in behavioral science, behavioral economics, human factors, or UX research.

Experience

at a consumer tech company at scale, especially one with user-generated content, creator platforms, or payments.

Experience

supporting security compliance programs (e.g. SOC 2), or being an early or founding hire in a trust, safety, or security function. Suno is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. job.title: Workplace Project Coordinator (Contractor)
job.description:
About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world. Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible. Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

About the Role

Suno is looking for a Workplace Project Coordinator to help deliver a fast-moving portfolio of workplace and real estate projects. Working closely with our Senior Workplace Project Manager, you’ll turn decisions into action, keep dependencies visible, and make sure the people involved know what needs to happen next. This is a 6 month contract engagement. This is an execution-focused role for someone who can coordinate confidently with vendors, consultants, onsite teams, and senior stakeholders. You’ll support several projects at once, maintain reliable project information, and flag risks before they affect delivery. You’ll work with direction on major project decisions. As you learn the projects and build trust with the team, you may take ownership of smaller workstreams and set working-level deadlines, while escalating decisions that materially affect schedule, cost, or scope. Check out the song we made about it: https://suno.com/s/a5dHdj40vORMQErR

What You'll Do

Support the Senior Workplace Project Manager by driving day-to-day execution, follow-through, and coordination across active projects Drive follow-up and execution on decisions made across active projects Track actions, dependencies, deadlines, risks, and outstanding information Coordinate meetings, recaps, communications, and accountability for next steps Maintain project trackers, documentation, and status information Coordinate deliveries and installations in partnership with onsite office teams Follow up with vendors, consultants, and internal stakeholders for required inputs and deliverables Surface risks, missed dependencies, or potential schedule impacts early Support multiple concurrent workplace projects without losing visibility across workstreams Travel occasionally to support project milestones, site activities, installations, and office openings as needed Who You Are 3-5 years of relevant

experience

in workplace buildouts, owner’s rep/project coordination, commercial construction, corporate real estate, facilities projects, or a related environment

coordinating across multiple vendors, consultants, and senior/executive stakeholders Working familiarity with drawings, construction/project terminology, schedules, furniture, IT/AV, procurement, and design documentation Strong written and verbal communication skills Comfortable working across multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-changing environment Office, workplace, interiors, or hospitality project

experience

is a plus Compensation $62–$83 per hour Suno is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.
