job.title: 2027 Summer News Intern | Multiple Locations
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

2027 TEGNA Summer News Internship Program

Your Future Starts Here

At TEGNA, making news isn’t legacy — it’s leadership.

This isn’t old-school TV. We’re setting the pace for a sustainable, streaming-first future of journalism.

We’re hiring bold, creative interns who embrace cutting-edge tech to deliver high-impact journalism that makes a difference.

This 10-week paid internship runs May 31 – August 6, 2027, at select TEGNA stations nationwide.

Many interns launch full-time TEGNA careers right after the program.

What You’ll Do

  • Pitch and research stories that matter
  • Create content for streaming, digital, social, and TV
  • Work alongside reporters, producers, anchors, and meteorologists—sometimes in the field
  • Jump in on special projects that shape local coverage

How This Internship Skyrockets Your Career

  • Hands-On Work – Real assignments for your demo reel
  • Career Growth – Development sessions to fast-track your skills
  • Networking – Learn from some of the nation’s top media pros
  • Paid Opportunity – Earn money while making an impact in a fast-paced newsroom
    • The standard compensation rate is $15.00 per hour unless a higher state or local minimum wage overrides it. Notable exceptions include:
      • Denver, CO - $19.84 per hour
      • Sacramento, CA - $17.40 per hour
      • San Diego, CA - $17.75 per hour
      • Seattle, WA - $21.30 per hour
      • Spokane, WA - $17.13 per hour

What We’re Looking For

  • Current college juniors or seniors with a 3.0 GPA or higher
  • Studying journalism, communications, or a related major
  • Passion for one of these three career paths:
    • TV news producing
    • TV news reporting
    • TV meteorology
  • Experience writing, editing, fact-checking, and using digital/social tools
  • Strong communicator who never misses deadlines

This internship is not for sports or film. It’s for hard-news journalists and meteorologists ready to disrupt the industry and deliver information in new ways that meet audiences where they are.

A Final Note

Our summer internship program is highly competitive. We review every application personally, but only selected candidates will be contacted for interviews.

  • Rolling applications — most 2027 interns hired by the end of 2026
  • Decisions by email — expect updates by Jan/Feb 2027
  • Summer Only — Our internships are in the summer, not fall or spring
Pay Range $15—$15 USD

Benefits: 

TEGNA offers comprehensive benefits designed to safeguard the physical, mental and financial health of our employees and their families. TEGNA offers two medical plan options for full and part-time employees through Blue Cross Blue Shield of Texas, as well as access to dental and eye care coverage; fertility, surrogacy and adoption assistance; disability and life insurance.

Our 401(k) program offers full, part-time and temporary employees the opportunity to contribute 1% - 80% of their pay on a pre-tax basis to TEGNA’s 401(k). Contributions made up to the first 4% of pay are eligible for a 100% match from the company and are 100% vested from day one.

Regardless of participation in TEGNA medical plans, ALL employees and their eligible family members receive nine free virtual doctor’s appointments with a physician through Teladoc, and 12 free annual therapy sessions with a licensed clinician through Spring Health.

TEGNA offers a generous Paid Time Off (PTO) benefit as well as nine paid holidays per year. 

* Some jobs are covered by a collective bargaining agreement and thus some or all of the benefits described herein may not apply. For example, some newsroom bargaining unit employees receive health and retirement benefits under plans administered by the union.

EEO statement:

TEGNA Inc. is a proud equal opportunity employer. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, hiring and developing individuals from diverse backgrounds and experiences to add to our collaborative culture. We value and consider applications from all qualified candidates without regard to actual or perceived race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, age, marital status, personal appearance, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, family responsibilities, disability, medical condition, enrollment in college or vocational school, political affiliation, military or veteran status, citizenship status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law. TEGNA will reasonably accommodate qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with applicable law. If you are in need of an accommodation in order to submit your application, please email askhr@tegna.com 

Recruiting Fraud Alert:

To all candidates: your personal information and online safety are important to us. Only TEGNA Recruiters or Hiring Managers will reach out to you regarding consideration of your application or background.  Communications with TEGNA employees will either come from a TEGNA email address with a domain of tegna.com or one of our affiliate station domains.

job.title: Account Executive
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

We are seeking a highly motivated and results-driven technology or digital media sales account executive to join our team. This role is responsible for driving revenue growth through the sale of digital and television media solutions, including streaming and broadcast television, digital advertising, and content partnerships. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record in digital sales, business development with a deep understanding of media and marketing trends, and the ability to build and maintain strong client relationships. This role requires a strategic approach to identifying opportunities, pitching solutions, and delivering measurable results for clients.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Sales & Revenue Generation: Drive sales by identifying and securing new business opportunities across multiple digital channels, including streaming, online video and display, and content marketing solutions.
  • Client Relationship Management: Develop and nurture long-term relationships with clients, ensuring their marketing needs are met and identifying areas for upselling and cross-selling additional services.
  • Consultative Selling: Provide consultative solutions to clients by understanding their business goals, analyzing market trends, and recommending tailored marketing strategies that drive results.
  • Market Research & Lead Generation: Research industry trends and competitor offerings to develop a robust pipeline of prospective clients and stay ahead of market shifts.
  • Proposal Development & Pitching: Craft compelling sales presentations and proposals that showcase the value of our media offerings, using data and insights to communicate potential ROI.
  • Campaign Management & Optimization: Collaborate with internal teams to ensure successful campaign execution, monitoring performance, and optimizing for maximum effectiveness and client satisfaction.
  • Reporting & Analytics: Regularly review and report on sales targets, campaign performance, and key metrics to clients and internal stakeholders.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with the account management, and product teams to align on campaign strategies, creative assets, and ad placements that meet clients’ needs.
  • Performance Management: Strategically use CRM and prospecting tools to manage and achieve quotas as it pertains to activity metrics and revenue goals.

Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of experience in digital media sales, advertising, or a related industry
  • Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets in a competitive environment
  • Strong understanding of digital marketing channels and industry trends, including programmatic, streaming media, display, video, social, and content marketing
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills
  • Ability to interpret data and analytics to provide actionable insights
  • Self-motivated, with a passion for sales and digital media
  • Proficient in CRM software and Microsoft Office Suite; familiarity with ad management tools a plus
  • Must possess and maintain a valid driver’s license and be able to travel locally to meet with clients and business partners as needed.

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience in working with business owners and/or agency clients
  • Knowledge of streaming and digital media
  • Familiarity with tools like Google Analytics, DSPs, and SSPs.

Why Join Us? We offer a collaborative, high-energy environment where your contributions make an immediate impact. Join a forward-thinking team and drive the future of media sales with access to cutting-edge tools and resources.

Location: Hybrid
Salary: Competitive base + commission

job.title: Account Executive
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

KWES-TV Midland, the TEGNA-owned NBC affiliate in Midland-Odessa, is seeking a competitive, coachable and results-driven Account Executive to develop new business and grow a portfolio of advertising clients. This is an opportunity to build a career in media sales while gaining experience across broadcast television, streaming, connected TV and digital advertising.

You’ll sell one of the strongest portfolios in the market, combining the reach and trust of KWES broadcast television with the targeting and growth of streaming. On the linear side, you’ll connect advertisers with the large, engaged local audiences that turn to Midland-Odessa’s trusted news and programming. On the streaming side, you’ll leverage Premion, TEGNA’s streaming and CTV advertising business, to reach cord-cutting audiences across a premium marketplace of 125+ OTT and connected-TV publishers. Together with digital video, display and content solutions, you’ll have a powerful cross-screen portfolio to help local businesses reach their customers and achieve their goals.

We provide the coaching, tools and support to help you build your skills and your business. You bring the drive to learn, compete and succeed.

Responsibilities

Develop new business. Build and maintain a strong pipeline through consistent prospecting. Research local businesses, identify key decision-makers and create opportunities across broadcast TV, Premion streaming/CTV and digital.

Manage the full sales process. Prospect, qualify, uncover client needs, present solutions, handle objections and close business while working toward established activity and revenue goals.

Sell consultatively. Learn each client’s business and marketing goals and recommend the right mix of broadcast television, Premion streaming/CTV and digital solutions to deliver measurable results.

Build compelling proposals. Develop data-informed presentations that demonstrate how broadcast reach and connected-TV targeting can work together to meet client objectives.

Grow client relationships. Build new accounts into long-term partnerships by delivering results, maintaining strong relationships and identifying opportunities for continued growth.

Manage your pipeline. Use CRM and prospecting tools to manage activity, maintain an accurate pipeline and keep opportunities moving. Partner with account, creative and product teams to deliver effective campaigns for clients.

Requirements

Competitive, self-motivated and goal-oriented with a genuine interest in building a career in sales.

Strong communication, presentation and relationship-building skills.

Coachable, curious and motivated to learn consultative media sales.

Strong organizational skills and follow-through, with the ability to manage multiple priorities.

Interest in broadcast television, streaming/CTV and digital advertising, with a willingness to learn and stay current on the evolving media landscape.

Sales, customer service, marketing or advertising experience preferred but not required. Internships, relevant coursework and transferable experience are welcome.

Bachelor’s degree preferred.

Comfort with Microsoft Office; familiarity with CRM or digital advertising tools is a plus.

Valid driver’s license and ability to travel locally to meet with clients as needed.

job.title: Anchor
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

KWES-TV Midland-Odessa a TEGNA NBC affiliate in Midland-Odessa has an amazing opportunity for a creative, innovative, and enterprising Anchor who is an excellent on-camera communicator to help serve the needs of our audience and community. We are looking for a journalist who excels at both accountability reporting and breaking news. We are seeking candidates who will trailblaze the future of news, find and defend the truth, and tell the stories of our community. This anchor should be someone who is comfortable asking tough but fair questions. This journalist must be able to work with producers to develop smart and engaging newscasts. We are looking for someone who understands the “why” behind stories and excels at impact journalism. The Anchor is a newsroom leader who will be one of the faces of the station in charge of developing contacts and relationships in the community enabling them to create and present unique, compelling, and innovative stories of interest.  

 

Responsibilities: 

  • Use editorial judgment to help determine content of the newscasts.
  • Work with producer and team to create unique, fast-paced innovative newscasts.
  • Use social media to determine content of newscasts and highlight big social stories.
  • Write and post daily on all digital platforms including social media.
  • Develop story ideas, write, shoot and edit news stories for on-air broadcasting.
  • Develop original content through social listening and independent sources.
  • Perform other tasks as required by supervisor or executive producer.
  • Journalism and/or Communication degree preferred.
  • Understand the tenets of professional Journalism.
  • Excellent, creative presentation and writing skills a must

Requirements: 

  • Minimum 1-3 years news anchor/reporting experience
  • Develop story ideas, write, shoot and edit news stories for television, mobile and social platforms.
  • Write in an exciting, captivating, and authentic manner.
  • Use the latest editing and photography tools to tell great stories.
  • Develop original content through social listening and independent sources.
  • Deliver on-air news events in an engaging, exciting, and accurate manner.
  • Interview news subjects and research for facts and credibility.
  • Write and post daily on all digital platforms including social media.
  • Enterprise news stories.
  • Write for the web, including attaching images and streaming video.
  • Use creative production techniques such as graphics and new forms of media (viewer pictures, webcam interviews, etc.) to enhance stories.

We are seeking candidates who will trailblaze the future of news, find and defend the truth, and tell the stories of our community. This anchor should be someone who is comfortable asking tough but fair questions. Current driver's license and ability to operate news gathering vehicle to and from various locations is required.

  • Write and post daily on all digital platforms including social media.

  • Develop original content through social listening and independent sources.

WHAS11, TEGNA's ABC affiliate in Louisville, KY, is searching for a motivated and people-oriented leader to serve as Assistant News Director. 

Our ideal candidate is a collaborative, experienced leader who’s great at juggling multiple projects and growing journalists. Through careful coaching, the Assistant News Director elevates our station's storytelling, writing and execution.

The ideal candidate has excellent news judgment and strong management skills with the ability to motivate, collaborate and own the big story. The Assistant News Director will lead day-to-day decision making on broadcast coverage and work closely with the digital team to ensure our content best serves the audience on all platforms.

At WHAS11 we are passionate about developing the very best news coverage across all platforms, making sure our content reflects the diverse communities we represent.

Current driver's license and ability to operate news gathering vehicle to and from various locations is required.

Work closely with producers, reporters, anchors, and photographers on compelling, impact-driven original storytelling and daily news coverage

Oversee production of newscasts and special programming

Make split-second decisions to lead the news team during breaking news and severe weather events

Work with executive producers to ensure a multi-platform content approach in every stage of the news gathering process

Strategize with executive team on goals focused on growing our people, our content, and our audience

Build relationships with news sources and community stakeholders

Execute administrative duties such as managing direct reports, creating schedules, and training new employees

Assist in training and providing valuable feedback for entire editorial team

Evaluate workflow efficiencies and adjust processes and procedures as necessary

Bachelor’s degree in journalism, communications or related field and news leadership experience

3-5 years of content experience, including generation of original content

Solid journalistic and content judgement that emphasizes accurate, fair and unique local content, along with community engagement

Strong organizational skills in a fast-paced and deadline-driven environment

job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

KPNX-TV, the TEGNA NBC affiliate in Phoenix seeks a Broadcast Director. The primary responsibility of this position is intended to support new newscasts as well as directing daily newscasts and other local programs, utilizing both production automation and manual switching operations. The Broadcast Director will work closely with our news, production, and technical teams to produce fast-paced, compelling and comprehensive newscasts and programs.

We are looking for someone to bring forward-thinking production ideas, strong technical knowledge, and the ability to manage quality control at a high level. In addition, the candidate must also be familiar with all studio operations, including floor directing, camera operation, teleprompter, graphics creation, audio, lighting, non-linear editing, content management systems and master control systems.

 

Responsibilities: 

  • Direct daily live newscasts and recorded shows using both automation and manual switching.
  • Oversee the overall look of newscasts and on-air programming.
  • Identify and correct potential problems before they hit air.
  • Troubleshooting technical systems when required.
  • Use non-linear editing and content management systems for programming, commercial and digital content creation.
  • Other production department duties as assigned.

Requirements: 

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Communications or TV Production or related degree preferred or equivalent experience may be substituted.
  • Experience (3 years preferred) with production automation, video switchers, newsroom computer systems, video servers, and graphics systems.
  • Ability to adapt quickly and respond effectively for breaking news and unexpected events.
  • Excellent communication skills, with an emphasis on working as a team with multiple departments.
  • Experience with ENPS, Chyron, and BitCentral systems is a plus
  • Flexible scheduling: this position includes weekends, and may also cover early mornings, nights, or holidays as needed.

Responsibilities:

  • Good verbal and written communications skills.
  • Ability to think on their feet, work well with others and be a self-starter.  A team player who is focused on quality customer service for internal/external customers.
  • Support day to day operations of broadcast systems.
  • Create and maintain wiring documentation and system configuration documentation.
  • Maintain knowledge and stay current on technological advances including television broadcasting, studio production and associated broadcast equipment.
  • Willing to train, if required, on IT and broadcast system operation and maintenance to service all aspects of the television environment.
  • Ability to lift up to 50 lbs., climb ladders, work on elevated surfaces, pull and install wiring, use had and power tools, work on small components and perform other physical tasks.
  • Other duties as assigned.

 
 
Requirements:

  • Associate degree in Electronics, Communications or equivalent combination of education and work-related experience preferred.
  • Minimum three years' experience in a television broadcasting environment.
  • Familiarity with Bitcentral-related hardware/software and Sony ELC a plus.
  • In-depth knowledge of broadcast technologies including; transmitters, antennas, broadcast switchers, router systems, ENG and DSNG transmissions, field cameras, signal path workflows and automation.
  • Ability to work well and make solid decisions under pressure.
  • Must be able to work a flexible schedule in support of a 24x7x365 operation.

WFMY is seeking a Broadcast Engineer Lead to drive innovation and maintain excellence across our broadcast and IT infrastructure. This is a pivotal role for a technical visionary who balances hands-on expertise with strategic project leadership.

The Broadcast Engineer Lead is responsible for shaping system design decisions, defining local engineering standards, and leading complex projects that directly impact station operations. Operating with significant autonomy, you will not only execute tasks but also take full accountability for technical outcomes, ensuring our 24/7 environment remains resilient, modern, and efficient.

Responsibilities:

  • Technical Leadership & Ownership
  • System Accountability: Serve as the primary technical owner for key broadcast and IT systems; ensure reliability, scalability, and long-term performance.
  • Strategic Direction: Make independent decisions regarding system architecture and technical standards within corporate guidelines.
  • Modernization: Proactively identify opportunities for upgrades and recommend technology roadmaps aligned with evolving business needs.
  • Influence & Mentorship: Act as the technical authority and escalation point for engineering staff; mentor team members by setting direction and reviewing work for quality.
  • Project Leadership & Design
  • End-to-End Project Management: Lead the planning, technical design, and execution of major local, capital, and corporate engineering projects.

  • Systems Integration: Design and approve the integration of studios, control rooms, transmission infrastructure, automation, and digital asset management systems.

  • System Maintenance: Maintain and upgrade infrastructure including servers, storage, workstations, network systems, and assist with facilities coordination of HVAC, UPS, and backup power.
  • Complex Troubleshooting: Oversee the resolution of systemic issues and manage technical support documentation to minimize downtime.
  • Security & Regulatory Standards: Ensure strict adherence to FCC regulations, IT security protocols, OSHA requirements, and disaster recovery readiness.
  • Documentation: Define and maintain rigorous local engineering standards, wiring documentation, and operating procedures.
  •

job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. Position:        Inventory Specialist
Department:    TEGNA Commercial Operations (TCO)
Location:    Any TEGNA market 

Description:
We are hiring! The TEGNA Commercial Operations (TCO) team is looking for a talented and motivated person to join our team.
A broadcast Traffic department maximizes revenue for a television station through careful consideration of spot placement and program formatting. We describe our group as “Commercial Operations” because we do more than just place spots on a log; we work hand in hand with the sales, marketing/promotions, programming, news and engineering departments to create an on-air product that generates positive results for both our stations and clients. Our daily workflow has often been described as working a puzzle; we manipulate commercial inventory to maximize an advertiser’s return on investment. 
A successful Inventory Specialist pays attention to detail, is customer-service oriented, shows initiative and can balance multiple projects and requests while meeting daily deadlines.  

Specific job requirements include:
•    Using WideOrbit Traffic software, manage commercial inventory by accurately preempting or placing spots on the broadcast log
•    Meet daily log finalization deadlines and clear oversold inventory 13 weeks out
•    Understand and follow spot placement guidelines to ensure client specifications are met
•    Verify the broadcast log is maximized for revenue and meets product and advertiser separation requirements
•    Collaborate with TCO and station teammates to identify and communicate revenue opportunities to the sales team
•    Process sales orders and assist sales team with accurate order entry
•    Various other duties as assigned


If this sounds like a great fit, we are looking for applicants with the following skills and experience:
•    High school diploma (required)
•    Undergraduate degree in marketing, communications, or a related field (preferred)
•    Broadcasting, cable or radio traffic or sales support experience (preferred)
•    WideOrbit traffic system knowledge (preferred)
•    Proficient with computer software/applications, including Microsoft Office: Outlook, Word and Excel (required)
•    Attention to detail and strong organizational skills (required)
•    Desire to work in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment (required)
•    If you have relevant work experience, we are willing to train the right candidate
•    Work from home flexibility, must be in a TEGNA market

job.description:

KWES TV is looking for an IT/Broadcast Technician to join our talented team and play a key role in keeping our broadcast operations running smoothly. As part of our technical team, you’ll be at the forefront of supporting both IT and broadcast systems—ensuring our broadcast equipment and network operations to deliver top-quality content to our viewers. This role offers the perfect opportunity for someone with a strong background in IT systems, hardware, and broadcast technology to make their mark in a fast-paced media environment.


Responsibilities:

•    Support IT and Broadcast Systems: Maintain, troubleshoot, and optimize IT systems, servers, networks, and broadcast equipment that ensure seamless
     broadcast operations
•    Monitor and Troubleshoot Broadcast Systems: Oversee the performance of broadcast systems, ensure top-quality audio/video, and resolve any issues quickly during live or recorded broadcasts.
•    Content Ingestion and Storage: Assist in managing content workflows—ingesting, storing, and retrieving data on broadcast servers and cloud systems with focus on data integrity.
•    Install and Configure Equipment: Manage and install broadcast equipment like cameras, servers, routers, switches, encoders, and control systems.
•    Support Digital Streaming Operations: Collaborate with the digital streaming team to ensure smooth hardware and software operations.
•    Solve Problems Under Pressure: Respond to technical issues with speed and precision, ensuring minimal downtime during live broadcasts.
•    Collaborate Across Teams: Work closely with production, technical, and other departments to improve broadcast operations and address technical challenges.
•    Other Duties as Assigned: Help improve and streamline our broadcast and IT infrastructure as needed.

Requirements:

•    Education & Experience: A degree in IT or 1-3 years of experience in a broadcast/IT environment.
•    Technical Expertise: Strong knowledge of broadcast equipment (servers, routers, switches, encoders), IT systems, and networking protocols.
•    Problem-Solving Skills: A natural ability to diagnose and resolve hardware, software, and network issues quickly and efficiently.
•    IT Security Knowledge: Familiarity with IT security best practices, including firewalls, antivirus tools, and network monitoring.
•    Adaptability Under Pressure: Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, especially during live broadcasts.
•    Communication Skills: Strong interpersonal and communication skills for working across multiple teams.
•    Physical Requirements: Ability to lift 50 lbs. and work at heights (on ladders) as necessary.
•    Availability: Our work is 24/7, and you must be able to respond quickly to emergencies or technical issues as they arise.


Why Join KWES TV?
•    Impact: Be part of a growing, innovative company that is part of the TEGNA family, a leader in local broadcast media.
•    Professional Growth: Work in an environment that offers opportunities to learn and grow, with exposure to the latest broadcast technologies.
•    Work-Life Balance: We offer a supportive work culture.


If you’re ready to apply your IT and broadcast expertise to help us deliver high-quality content and support our dynamic team, we’d love to hear from you!

job.description:

TEGNA, one of the most geographically diverse broadcasters in the U.S., is seeking a Collections Specialist to join our Shared Services team. This position will be part of the TEGNA corporate team with company-wide responsibility but will be physically located at our NBC Affiliate in Indianapolis, WTHR. The Collections Specialist is responsible for contacting customers to ensure timely payments of accounts receivables for an assigned portfolio and working with station personnel to minimize the risk of incurring write-offs and/or credit adjustments. This individual will ensure appropriate contact with customers and station personnel is followed per policy and all relationships are appropriately maintained for assigned portfolio.

Additional responsibilities include but are not limited to:
•    Perform collection activity including reviewing accounts receivable reports, performing daily analysis of balances, payments, and making customer service calls leading to sound decisions to minimize risk and implement effective solutions.
•    Engage in the investigation and resolution of customer issues/inquiries in a prompt, effective, and professional manner.
•    Plan and execute periodic calls with station personnel to review account balances, update status, and make decisions regarding next actions.
•    Prepare reporting and analysis as needed for review by others.
•    Communicate with the Credit team regarding updates needed to credit profile status/ratings.
•    Submit appropriate information to third-party collection agencies upon assignment.
•    Identify and communicates cash-in-advance accounts with debit balances
•    Makes appropriate notations on accounts in WideOrbit


Responsibilities:
•    High School Diploma or GED
•    2 years of customer service or business-to-business collections experience
•    Keen ability to determine which accounts require attention and ability to prioritize actions needed each day
•    Excellent written and verbal skills including superior customer service skills
•    Understanding of ‘soft’ collection methods and helping customers resolve issues and set dates for action with timely follow-up
•    Strong organizational skills to plan one’s day without being provided specific actions by the supervisor
•    High-level of customer service skill with the ability be seen as someone helping TEGNA customers resolve balance issues and providing high-quality service to our stations
•    Good Excel skills with history of exporting to Excel with minor formatting of results
•    Ability to run and command remote meetings with sales and local finance to review accounts

job.title: Commercial Production Manager
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

We are looking for an experienced Commercial Production Manager to lead a distributed team of commercial producers and oversee the delivery of high-quality commercial video content across multiple TEGNA markets. This role will directly manage approximately 8–10 commercial producers located in different markets, providing leadership, coaching, prioritization, and operational support to ensure the team consistently delivers strong work for our clients and sales partners.

The Commercial Production Manager will be a key partner to local sales leadership and sales teams, helping create effective workflows between sales and production, balance client needs with production resources, and continuously improve how commercial creative is developed and delivered. The ideal candidate combines strong production expertise with people leadership, practical problem-solving, collaboration, and change management skills. This person should be comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment, introducing new processes and technologies, and finding pragmatic solutions that improve both quality and efficiency.

Responsibilities: 

  • Team Leadership & Development: Lead, coach, and develop a distributed team of approximately 8–10 commercial producers across multiple TEGNA markets. Establish clear expectations, provide regular feedback, support professional development, and foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, creativity, and high performance.
  • Production Leadership: Provide oversight and direction for commercial production from concept through final delivery, ensuring work is completed efficiently, on time, within budget, and to established quality standards.
  • Sales Partnership: Build strong, collaborative relationships with local sales leaders and sales teams. Serve as a trusted production partner who understands business priorities, client needs, and market realities and helps teams develop practical solutions that support revenue and client retention.
  • Sales & Production Workflow: Develop, implement, and continuously improve systems and processes that create seamless collaboration between sales and production. Establish clear expectations, roles, timelines, and communication practices across teams.
  • Resource & Workload Management: Manage production capacity and priorities across multiple markets, balancing workloads and deploying resources effectively to meet client and business needs.
  • Change Management: Lead teams through evolving production processes, organizational changes, and new technologies and tools, including AI-enabled capabilities. Help producers and sales partners understand the rationale for change, adopt new ways of working, and translate new processes into practical day-to-day execution.
  • Operational Improvement: Identify opportunities to simplify workflows, improve turnaround times, increase consistency, and scale best practices across markets. Take a pragmatic approach to solving problems, balancing ideal creative solutions with business needs, available resources, timelines, and budgets.
  • Client Experience: Ensure production teams understand client objectives and deliver a professional, responsive experience throughout the production process. Step in as needed to help resolve complex client or production issues.
  • Quality Control: Establish and maintain strong creative and technical standards across the team, providing guidance and feedback to ensure commercial content meets both client expectations and TEGNA standards.
  • Production Planning: Ensure effective production planning across markets, including scheduling, budgeting, location needs, talent coordination, equipment, and other production resources.
  • Budget & Vendor Management: Oversee production budgets and the effective use of external vendors, freelancers, and contractors. Ensure resources are used responsibly and projects remain within financial parameters.
  • Problem Solving & Escalation: Anticipate and resolve production, staffing, workflow, and client challenges. Exercise sound judgment and provide practical solutions that keep work moving while maintaining strong relationships with internal and external partners.
  • Compliance: Ensure production activities comply with applicable legal, safety, contractual, rights, and clearance requirements.
  • Performance & Reporting: Monitor team workload, production performance, timelines, quality, and other key measures. Provide visibility to leadership on performance, opportunities, and areas requiring attention.

Requirements: 

  • Bachelor’s degree in Film Production, Media Studies, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in commercial video production, production management, creative operations, or a related field.
  • Extensive experience with the Adobe Creative Cloud suite, specifically Premiere and After Effects.
  • Demonstrated experience leading and developing teams, preferably including employees working across multiple locations or markets.
  • Strong understanding of video production workflows, including pre-production, shooting, post-production, and delivery.
  • Proven ability to build strong partnerships with sales teams, business leaders, creative teams, and other cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Experience leading teams through process, technology, or organizational change, with the ability to build adoption and maintain momentum during periods of transition.
  • Strong organizational and operational skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities, allocate resources, and make sound decisions in a fast-paced environment.
  • A pragmatic, solutions-oriented mindset with the judgment to balance creative quality, client expectations, business priorities, timelines, and available resources.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, including the ability to navigate challenging conversations, resolve conflicts, and build credibility across different functions and levels of the organization.
  • Experience managing production budgets and external vendors or contractors.
  • Comfort working with evolving production technologies and tools, including AI-enabled creative and production capabilities.

Location: Any TEGNA station within the Northwest region, preferably Portland, OR or Seattle, WA #LI-MS1

job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

TEGNA is seeking a Digital Campaign Specialist to support local broadcast stations with their digital advertising operations. This role offers an excellent opportunity for individuals looking to grow their career in digital ad operations within a collaborative and fast-paced environment.

Location:

This role may be based at any TEGNA market location. Candidates should be located within commuting distance of a TEGNA market office and will follow the hybrid work schedule applicable to their local TEGNA location.

About the Role

As a Digital Campaign Specialist, you will work exclusively with TEGNA properties across various ad-serving platforms and order management systems. You’ll help manage CTV (Connected TV) and digital advertising campaigns from setup through delivery, ensuring they launch accurately, run smoothly, and meet performance goals.

This position involves campaign trafficking, troubleshooting, optimization, reporting, and quality assurance, making it ideal for individuals with strong technical aptitude, attention to detail, and an interest in digital advertising technology.

This role includes participation in an on-call rotation after appropriate training.

Responsibilities:

  • Master the digital workflow between business units and Ad Operations.
  • Develop expertise in ad servers and order management systems, with an emphasis on CTV campaign execution.
  • Set up, schedule, and manage digital advertising campaigns accurately, including CTV-specific formats and delivery methods.
  • Ensure proper deployment of creative assets by understanding ad specifications, templates, and ad-tag technologies, including VAST/VPAID tags and dynamic ad insertion.
  • Provide timely support to TEGNA stations and internal stakeholders, particularly for CTV and digital campaign delivery issues.
  • Troubleshoot campaign performance concerns and conduct quality assurance reviews to ensure campaign accuracy and effectiveness.
  • Send campaign reports, communicate technical information clearly, and manage service-level agreement expectations.
  • Monitor shared inboxes and workflow systems consistently and respond to requests in a timely manner.
  • Track campaign performance and implement optimization strategies, including fill-rate management, frequency capping, and ad podding.
  • Ensure campaigns meet applicable rate-card requirements and revenue-margin standards.
  • Collaborate effectively with vendors, stations, and internal teams while maintaining a customer-focused approach.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited university or college in a related discipline required.
  • 1–2 years of experience with ad-serving platforms, digital advertising, campaign management, or ad trafficking preferred.
  • 3–5 years of practical experience in digital technology or advertising may be accepted in lieu of a degree.
  • Hands-on experience with CTV ad trafficking, Server-Side Ad Insertion (SSAI), and VAST/VPAID tags is preferred.
  • Strong technical aptitude and the ability to work effectively in a technical environment.
  • Excellent organizational skills and strong attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to different audiences.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Outlook, and Word.
  • Basic knowledge of HTML and JavaScript is a plus.
  • Experience with CTV or digital advertising platforms such as Publica or Google Ad Manager (GAM) is preferred.
  • Quick learner with a growth mindset and collaborative approach to teamwork.


Why Join Us?

  • Hands-on training and mentorship to develop your expertise in digital ad operations.
  • Opportunity to work with digital advertising and CTV technology across TEGNA's nationwide portfolio of local markets.
  • Hybrid work environment with the ability to be based at a TEGNA market location across the country.
  • Exposure to multiple ad-serving, campaign-management, and reporting platforms.

Apply now and grow your career in digital advertising with TEGNA.

job.title: Digital Campaign Specialist
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

TEGNA is seeking an Entry-Level Digital Ad Operations Specialist to support local broadcast stations with their digital advertising operations. This role offers an excellent opportunity for individuals looking to launch their career in digital ad operations within a collaborative and fast-paced environment.



Location: Hybrid role – work from home with Tuesdays and Thursdays in the downtown Dallas office.



About the Role:

As a Digital Ad Operations Specialist, you will work exclusively with TEGNA properties across various ad-serving platforms and order management systems. You’ll help manage CTV (Connected TV) and digital ad campaigns from setup to delivery, ensuring they run smoothly and meet performance goals.

This position involves troubleshooting, campaign optimization, and quality assurance, making it ideal for individuals with strong technical skills and attention to detail.



This role includes being part of an on-call rotation after proper training.

Responsibilities:

  • Digital Workflow & Execution: 
  • Master the digital workflow between business units and Ad Operations. 
  • Become proficient in ad servers and order management systems, with a focus on CTV campaign execution. 
  • Campaign Scheduling & Creative Management: 
  • Set up and schedule digital ad campaigns accurately, including CTV-specific ad formats and delivery methods. 
  • Ensure proper execution of creative assets by understanding ad specs, templates, and ad tags (e.g., VAST/VPAID tags, dynamic ad insertion). 
  • Support & Troubleshooting: 
  • Provide urgent support to broadcast stations and internal stakeholders, particularly for CTV ad delivery issues. 
  • Identify and resolve ad performance issues through detailed troubleshooting and quality assurance (QA). 
  • Email & Workflow Management: 
  • Send daily reports to stations, communicate technical information clearly, and manage service-level agreements (SLAs). 
  • Consistently monitor email inboxes and respond to requests promptly. 
  • Campaign Monitoring & Optimization: 
  • Track campaign delivery and apply optimization strategies, such as CTV fill rate management, frequency capping, and ad podding.
  • Ensure compliance with rate card adherence and revenue margins. 


Customer Service:

  • Collaborate with vendors and stations while maintaining a customer-friendly attitude and providing excellent service.

Reporting & Analytics:

  • Generate reports on campaign performance, including CTV analytics (viewability, completion rates, and ad delivery metrics).

 

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited university/college or a technical-related discipline required. 
  • 1-2 years of experience in ad serving platforms or ad trafficking. (3-5 years of practical experience in digital technology or advertising can substitute for a degree.) 
  • Hands-on experience with CTV ad trafficking, SSAI (Server-Side Ad Insertion), and VAST/VPAID tags is a plus. 
  • Strong technical skills and the ability to function effectively in a technical role. 
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail. 
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously. 
  • Strong communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly. 
  • Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Outlook, Word). 
  • Basic knowledge of Flash, HTML, and JavaScript is beneficial. 
  • Experience with CTV ad platforms such as FreeWheel, Publica, or Google Ad Manager (GAM) is a plus. 
  • Quick learner with a growth mindset and a collaborative attitude. 

 

Why Join Us?

  • Hands-on training and mentorship to develop your expertise in digital ad operations. 
  • Opportunity to work with cutting-edge ad tech platforms. 
  • Hybrid work environment with flexibility. 
  • Growth opportunities within TEGNA’s expanding digital ad operations team. 


Apply now and kickstart your career in digital advertising with TEGNA!

Benefits: 

TEGNA offers comprehensive benefits designed to safeguard the physical, mental and financial health of our employees and their families. TEGNA offers two medical plan options for full and part-time employees through Blue Cross Blue Shield of Texas, as well as access to dental and eye care coverage; fertility, surrogacy and adoption assistance; disability and life insurance.

Our 401(k) program offers full, part-time and temporary employees the opportunity to contribute 1% - 80% of their pay on a pre-tax basis to TEGNA’s 401(k). Contributions made up to the first 4% of pay are eligible for a 100% match from the company and are 100% vested from day one.

Regardless of participation in TEGNA medical plans, ALL employees and their eligible family members receive nine free virtual doctor’s appointments with a physician through Teladoc, and 12 free annual therapy sessions with a licensed clinician through Spring Health.

TEGNA offers a generous Paid Time Off (PTO) benefit as well as nine paid holidays per year. 

* Some jobs are covered by a collective bargaining agreement and thus some or all of the benefits described herein may not apply. For example, some newsroom bargaining unit employees receive health and retirement benefits under plans administered by the union.

This hybrid role combines the skills of an assignment editor and a digital content producer. The Story Desk Editor also known as Digital Content Producer drives daily editorial execution, curates and produces impactful stories, and ensures our content connects authentically with audiences across streaming, digital, social and broadcast platforms.

Role Summary
As a Story Desk Editor, you will be part of the Story Management Desk (SMD), a unified desk that replaces the legacy assignment and digital desks. The SMD model ensures a single, streamlined workflow for planning, producing and curating stories across platforms. You will help shape daily story planning and curate content across platforms. This position requires strong editorial judgment, strong writing skills, and the ability to thrive under tight deadlines. You will collaborate with MSJs, producers and photojournalists to deliver accurate, relevant and engaging stories that serve the community.

Responsibilities
• Identify and plan stories that matter most to the community, using editorial judgment and social listening
• Create and edit engaging content for digital platforms: website, mobile app and streaming,
• Provide editorial support for MSJs, producers, and photojournalists
• Edit reporter content for accuracy, grammar, AP style, digital best practices, fairness and ethical considerations
• Enhance storytelling with creative elements (graphics, video, audience-submitted content, etc.)
• Use available metrics to inform coverage and improve audience reach
• Support newsroom operations and coverage planning as needed
• Uphold journalistic standards and values across all platforms



Requirements
• 1–3 years of journalism experience in a local newsroom, digital production, or related role
• Strong news judgment and the ability to make fast, sound editorial decisions under pressure
• Excellent writing skills, with the ability to produce accurate and compelling content quickly
• Experience with newsroom systems, CMS tools

job.title: FAST Support Analyst
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

The FAST Workflow Analyst is responsible for supporting the day-to-day operation, monitoring, troubleshooting, and distribution of live and linear content feeds for TEGNA to Free Ad-Supported Television (FAST) platforms and other streaming partners. This role serves as a key point of contact between internal streaming and technology teams, local stations, FAST partners, vendors, and development teams to ensure feeds are available, reliable, correctly configured, and delivered according to established distribution requirements.

Responsibilities:
•    Monitor and operate FAST distribution and 24/7 streaming workflows to ensure feeds remain available, content plays as scheduled, and streams are delivered reliably to FAST partners and digital platforms. Monitor stream health, content continuity, audio/video quality, slates, interruptions, and other issues that may impact the viewer experience. – 25%
•    Troubleshoot, triage, and manage streaming and FAST distribution incidents from initial detection through resolution. Investigate issues across station, cloud, streaming, distribution, and partner environments; determine scope and impact; coordinate escalation; communicate status; and ensure incidents are resolved within established service expectations. – 25%
•    Support FAST distribution operations and partner relationships, including onboarding new feeds, testing and validating feeds, coordinating configuration changes, troubleshooting partner delivery issues, supporting feed migrations, and working directly with FAST partners and vendors to resolve service-impacting issues. – 15%
•    Implement and maintain monitoring, alerting, and operational tools across streaming and FAST distribution platforms to proactively identify failures and performance issues. Analyze monitoring data and recurring alerts to improve detection, reduce mean time to detect (MTTD), and reduce mean time to restore (MTTR). – 10%
•    Partner with station engineering, digital, streaming, application, and infrastructure teams to support end-to-end workflows from content origination through streaming and FAST distribution. Assist with capacity planning, workflow changes, platform migrations, technology implementations, and projects that improve reliability and scalability. – 10%
•    Document end-to-end streaming and FAST distribution workflows, including feed configurations, partner requirements, troubleshooting procedures, escalation paths, and operational runbooks. Maintain knowledge base articles and enable effective Service Desk escalation and self-service where appropriate. – 5%
•    Maintain accurate inventories and operational information for streaming feeds, FAST channels, applications, services, integrations, configurations, and versions within the ServiceNow CMDB or other designated systems to support reporting, lifecycle management, troubleshooting, and incident response. – 5%
•    Analyze incidents, operational trends, and partner feedback to identify recurring issues and opportunities for process, workflow, tooling, automation, or architecture improvements that increase reliability and improve the viewer and partner experience.
•    Support special projects, major events, new technology implementations, and evolving streaming initiatives as assigned. Participate in testing and validation of new workflows and constructively challenge existing processes to improve reliability, efficiency, and scalability. – 2%

Requirements:
•    College degree, relevant certifications, or equivalent practical experience in broadcast, media technology, or IT operations.
•    Hands-on experience supporting broadcast, newsroom, and streaming technologies, such as Cuez, AWS media services, including AWS Elemental MediaConnect and MediaLive.
•    Working knowledge of cloud and hybrid environments supporting media workflows (e.g., cloud-based contribution, streaming, monitoring, or playout).
•    Strong understanding of IT service management concepts and tooling, including ITIL practices, incident/problem management, knowledge management, CMDBs, and ServiceNow.
•    Proven ability to manage multiple operational priorities simultaneously, particularly in live production or time-sensitive environments.
•    Clear communicator who can translate technical issues into business and operational impact for engineers, newsroom staff, digital teams, vendors, and leadership.
•    Analytical, methodical problem solver with the ability to diagnose complex issues across systems, networks, applications, and workflows.

job.description:

WTOL 11, Toledo’s News Leader, is looking for a Multi-Skilled Journalist to join our award-winning 11Investigates team.This is an exciting opportunity for an early-career journalist who wants to learn how to dig deeper, ask tough questions and tell stories that make a difference. You don’t need years of investigative reporting experience. We’re looking for someone with strong journalism fundamentals, curiosity, determination and a willingness to sharpen your skills. You’ll work alongside our Emmy Award-winning and national Edward R. Murrow Award-winning journalists, gaining hands-on experience in investigative, accountability and consumer reporting.

What You’ll Do
As part of the 11Investigates team, you will:
•    Pitch, shoot, write, edit and report stories across broadcast, digital and streaming platforms.
•    Work alongside experienced investigative journalists to research and develop stories.
•    File and track FOIA and public records requests
•    Research court records, government documents, public information and data to help uncover new stories.
•    Follow up on daily news stories and look for unanswered questions and accountability angles.
•    Take viewer calls, emails and story tips and help determine where our newsroom can get involved.
•    Support our Call 11 for Action reporting by helping investigate consumer concerns and working to get viewers answers.
•    Conduct interviews with community members, public officials and other newsmakers.
•    Create journalism for all WTOL 11 platforms, including television, WTOL.com, streaming, social media and vertical video.
•    Assist with breaking news and major coverage when needed.


The ideal candidate
•    Has a degree in journalism, communications or a related field, or equivalent journalism experience.
•    Understands the basics of reporting, writing, shooting and video editing.
•    Has strong writing and communication skills.
•    Is comfortable approaching people, making phone calls and asking questions.
•    Has strong attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy and fairness.
•    File public records requests, analyze documents and conduct accountability interviews.
•    Can manage multiple assignments and deadlines.
•    Wants coaching and is eager to grow as a reporter, storyteller and investigative journalist.

Why WTOL 11

At WTOL 11, you'll have the opportunity to develop skills that can set you apart throughout your career.

job.title: Marketing Lead - East
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

The Marketing Lead is the primary strategic partner to the Regional Marketing Director (RMD) and drives marketing execution across the full ecosystem of centralized capabilities: Production, Paid Media, Social, CRM and Lifecycle. This role translates strategy into integrated campaign plans, owns the campaign calendar, and is the day-to-day marketing contact for station leadership across the portfolio.

 

Responsibilities:

 

  • This person excels at navigating complexity, building stakeholder trust, and leading integrated work across multiple teams and markets.

Strategic & Campaign Leadership

  • Develop the campaign brief for each initiative — translating RMD strategy into an integrated plan with clear objectives, target audiences, key messages, channel mix and success metrics — and submit to the RMD for approval before execution begins.
  • Own the regional campaign calendar and integrated delivery timeline; ensure all campaigns are planned, resourced and launched on time and to spec.
  • Lead campaign development and execution, coordinating across Production, Paid, Social, CRM, Lifecycle and other centralized capabilities.
  • Direct Marketing Specialist to initiate campaign setup in monday.com; confirm boards are complete with the right assignments, timelines and deliverables.
  • Collaborate with Production through the creative development process — bring the audience, brand, and business context to concept development and scripting.
  • Hold creative and strategic standards across all campaign deliverables; ensure every asset is on-brand, on-message, and built to perform.
  • Drive clarity and prioritization across a complex portfolio of concurrent campaigns; make informed trade-offs and escalate strategic conflicts to the RMD as needed.

Station Partnership & Communications

  • Serve as the day-to-day marketing partner to station general managers, news directors and content leaders across the region.
  • Communicate campaign plans, status, and results clearly to station stakeholders; manage expectations, align on priorities and surface issues early.
  • Maintain the continuity and market context that allow centralized teams to move fast and with credibility in each market.

Campaign Performance & Team Development

  • Establish measurement frameworks for campaigns; track and report performance against objectives for the RMD and station leadership.
  • Apply audience data, ratings, digital analytics and market feedback to sharpen campaign strategy; translate performance patterns into recommendations that improve future planning and strengthen the team's overall approach.
  • Model campaign management discipline, strategic thinking and stakeholder communications; raise the overall capability and consistency of the marketing team.

 

Requirements:

  • 5–7 years in marketing, integrated campaign management or brand strategy — media, broadcast or a fast-moving content environment strongly preferred.
  • Proven ability to lead integrated campaigns across multiple markets, channels and stakeholder groups simultaneously.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communications skills; comfortable translating complex strategy into clear stakeholder-ready messaging and creative briefs.
  • Strong command of campaign planning, prioritization and project management; experience with monday.com, Asana or similar platforms.
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate across paid media, social, CRM, content and other marketing channels toward shared campaign outcomes.
  • Familiarity with audience research, ratings, digital analytics and performance measurement in a media or broadcast context.
  • Comfortable operating in a 24/7 news-driven environment with fast-moving priorities, breaking news demands and tight timelines.
  • Must be willing to travel to markets within the portfolio when needed.
  • Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, journalism or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

We are seeking candidates who will trailblaze the future of news, find and defend the truth, and tell the stories of our community. This anchor should be someone who is comfortable asking tough but fair questions. Current driver's license and ability to operate news gathering vehicle to and from various locations is required.

Responsibilities: 

  • Use editorial judgment to help determine content of the newscasts.
  • Work with producer and team to create unique, fast-paced innovative newscasts.
  • Use social media to determine content of newscasts and highlight big social stories.
  • Write and post daily on all digital platforms including social media.
  • Develop story ideas, write, shoot and edit news stories for on-air broadcasting.
  • Develop original content through social listening and independent sources.
  • Perform other tasks as required by supervisor or executive producer.

  • Excellent, creative presentation and writing skills a must

  • Write in an exciting, captivating, and authentic manner.
  • Use the latest editing and photography tools to tell great stories.
  • Develop original content through social listening and independent sources.
  • Deliver on-air news events in an engaging, exciting, and accurate manner.
  • Interview news subjects and research for facts and credibility.
  • Write and post daily on all digital platforms including social media.

job.title: Multi-Market Media Strategist
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

We are seeking a results-oriented, highly organized professional to support the Atlanta, Macon & Tampa sales teams by partnering closely with Account Executives and Sales Leadership to drive Total TV (linear, OTT, and digital) revenue growth. This role generates data-driven insights through market research and competitive analysis, creates sales presentations, manages order entry, and ensures flawless campaign execution from avails generation to makegoods. The position delivers superior customer service to agencies and direct clients while maintaining sales materials and workflow systems that keep Account Executives empowered with relevant information. With a focus on enabling Account Executives to maximize client-facing time, this position plays a key role in driving growth and operational excellence across both markets.

Responsibilities:

•    Develop tailored packages, proposals and client-focused sales presentations that clearly communicate Total TV (linear and digital) opportunities, deliverables, and value within integrated media campaigns
•    Act as a strategic advisor for Atlanta, Macon & Tampa sales teams by leveraging ratings data, competitive intelligence tools, and AI resources to conduct client research and provide market insights that empower Account Executives in client conversations.
•    Organize, maintain, and update sales materials, presentations, and marketing collateral ensuring Account Executives have immediate access to current, professional materials for client meetings.
•    Attend sales meetings and training sessions to gain product knowledge, stay informed on TEGNA’s broadcast, OTT, and digital solutions, understand sales processes, and maintain ability to discuss solutions with team members.
•    Generate and maintain current inventory availability across linear and digital platforms, respond to avails requests to support client proposals and sales presentations. Process and enter advertising orders accurately into traffic system and ensure seamless campaign execution from order to air.
•    Prepare attribution reports for OTT and linear TV campaigns, synthesizing data into actionable presentations
•    Monitor campaign delivery, pull posts to address under-delivery situations, coordinate makegood schedules, and ensure clients receive full value on their advertising investments.
•    Process co-op advertising invoices following client guidelines, prepare special billing as needed, and ensure timely and accurate invoices that supports client reimbursement processes.
•    Complete required forms and updates in Monday.com project management system to ensure accurate workflow tracking, team coordination, and commercial production project visibility across both markets.
•    Perform additional responsibilities as needed to support team objectives.

Requirements:
•    Minimum 2 years providing operational or administrative support in media, advertising, or sales-related environments preferred
•    Proven ability to support pre-sale and post-sale campaign implementation and client service responsibilities that enable sales teams to focus on revenue generation.
•    Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office suite, particularly Excel (formulas, tables, data analysis) and PowerPoint (presentation creation and design); ability to leverage AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot) to generate insights and build sales presentations.
•    Ability to learn with CRM software, traffic system (Wide Orbit), and project management tools; ability to learn new software systems quickly.
•    Understanding of broadcast television advertising, Comscore ratings, OTT/streaming platforms, and digital advertising concepts; ability to articulate TEGNA’s multi-platform solutions.
•    Exceptional organizational skills with proven ability to manage multiple accounts, campaigns, and projects simultaneously while maintaining accuracy and meeting deadlines.
•    Strong analytical skills with ability to track campaign performance, identify trends, and translate data into actionable insights that support revenue growth conversations.
•    Excellent written and verbal communication skills with professional demeanor in all client and internal interactions.
•    Detail-oriented with high standards for accuracy and quality; understands that precision in fulfillment builds client confidence and retention.
•    Team-oriented mindset with understanding that supporting Account Executives’ success is the primary measure of performance in this role.
•    Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive financial and client information appropriately.
•    Positive attitude and collaborative approach.

With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

KENS 5's morning lifestyle show, Great Day SA, is looking for a highly motivated, creative, and dynamic Multi-Skilled Journalist to join our team. We are seeking a storyteller who can shoot, write, edit, and deliver engaging content both on-air and across digital platforms.

The ideal candidate is a self-starter with a passion for lifestyle storytelling, a strong visual eye, and the ability to generate fresh, compelling content independently. You should be comfortable behind the camera, and in front of the camera conducting live and recorded interviews. If you're a creative journalist who thrives in a fast-paced environment and loves bringing exciting stories to life, we'd love to hear from you!

Responsibilities

Shoot, write, edit, and produce original lifestyle content for broadcast and digital platforms.
Use the latest photography and editing tools, including Adobe Premiere, to create engaging and visually compelling stories.
Develop unique, shareable content that resonates with television and social media audiences.
Conduct LIVE and recorded interviews for the show, both in-studio and in the field.
Pre-produce, shoot, and edit feature stories and lifestyle segments.
Write compelling scripts and create content that informs, entertains, and connects with viewers.
Edit b-roll, teases, promotional elements, and show content as assigned.
Research story ideas and regularly pitch creative, original content to the Executive Producer.
Attend editorial meetings, contribute story ideas, and content strategies.
Build and maintain relationships with sources, community partners, and potential guests.
Post content to social media platforms, including videos, photos, stories, and promotional content as assigned.
Use social media, digital tools, and audience trends to research, discover, and distribute content.
Monitor trends and identify opportunities for timely and relevant lifestyle coverage.
Perform other duties as assigned.

Responsibilities

1-3 years of television news, lifestyle, or content production experience preferred. This is not an entry-level position.
Bachelor’s degree in journalism, Communications, Broadcasting, or a related field preferred, or equivalent professional experience.
Strong photography, editing, and storytelling skills.
Proficiency with Adobe Premiere and modern content creation tools.
Comfortable appearing on camera and conducting live interviews.
Strong writing skills with the ability to craft compelling scripts and digital content.
Proven ability to generate creative story ideas and develop content independently.
Self-starter who can work with minimal supervision and take ownership of projects from concept to completion.
Strong understanding of social media platforms and digital audience engagement.
Experience creating and posting content across multiple social media platforms.
Excellent organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple assignments and deadlines.
Positive attitude, strong work ethic, and a collaborative team mindset.
Ability to adapt quickly and solve problems in a LIVE production environment.
Understanding of professional journalism ethics and standards.
Must be dependable, flexible, and reliable.
Valid driver's license and ability to travel to and from assignment locations.

Benefits: 

TEGNA offers comprehensive benefits designed to safeguard the physical, mental and financial health of our employees and their families. TEGNA offers two medical plan options for full and part-time employees through Blue Cross Blue Shield of Texas, as well as access to dental and eye care coverage; fertility, surrogacy and adoption assistance; disability and life insurance.

Our 401(k) program offers full, part-time and temporary employees the opportunity to contribute 1% - 80% of their pay on a pre-tax basis to TEGNA’s 401(k). Contributions made up to the first 4% of pay are eligible for a 100% match from the company and are 100% vested from day one.

Regardless of participation in TEGNA medical plans, ALL employees and their eligible family members receive nine free virtual doctor’s appointments with a physician through Teladoc, and 12 free annual therapy sessions with a licensed clinician through Spring Health.

TEGNA offers a generous Paid Time Off (PTO) benefit as well as nine paid holidays per year. 

* Some jobs are covered by a collective bargaining agreement and thus some or all of the benefits described herein may not apply. For example, some newsroom bargaining unit employees receive health and retirement benefits under plans administered by the union.

EEO statement:

TEGNA Inc. is a proud equal opportunity employer. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, hiring and developing individuals from diverse backgrounds and experiences to add to our collaborative culture. We value and consider applications from all qualified candidates without regard to actual or perceived race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, age, marital status, personal appearance, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, family responsibilities, disability, medical condition, enrollment in college or vocational school, political affiliation, military or veteran status, citizenship status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law. TEGNA will reasonably accommodate qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with applicable law. If you are in need of an accommodation in order to submit your application, please email askhr@tegna.com 

Recruiting Fraud Alert:

To all candidates: your personal information and online safety are important to us. Only TEGNA Recruiters or Hiring Managers will reach out to you regarding consideration of your application or background.  Communications with TEGNA employees will either come from a TEGNA email address with a domain of tegna.com or one of our affiliate station domains.  

Recruiters or Hiring Managers will never request payments, ask for financial account information or sensitive information such as social security numbers. 

  Privacy Notice for California Residents   SMS Messaging Privacy Policy

job.title: Multiskilled Journalist
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television.
