WTHR-TV Indianapolis, the NBC/MeTV TEGNA affiliate,  is looking for an experienced Multi-Skilled Journalist to help maintain our tradition of superior reporting and newsgathering. We are interested in finding a journalist who can create unique, memorable and well written stories, who can share them on all platforms with a mix of outstanding photography and unforgettable editing. If you're a creative storyteller who understands true multi-platform journalism and who is not bound by the methods of traditional TV news – we want to hear from you! 

Current driver's license and ability to operate news gathering vehicle to and from various locations is required.

Responsibilities: 

  • Perform authoritative, compelling live shots in a developing story or in breaking news situations
  • Develop story ideas
  • Mine the community to find sources who will keep you informed about events and ideas in their areas of expertise
  • Ability to identify, write and produce stories within a specific framework.
  • Research for facts and credibility.
  • Maintain and develop sources who will help bring our reporting to the next level.
  • Shoot, write, produce and edit on air and online content within deadlines.
  • Use creative production techniques such as graphics and new forms of media (viewer pictures, webcam interviews, etc.) to enhance stories.
  • Use social media and digital tools to research, discover and distribute content.
  • Attend editorial meetings and offer story ideas daily.
  • Write in an exciting, captivating and authentic manner.

Requirements: 

  • 1-3 years reporting experience preferred.
  • Must possess solid news judgment, display strong communication skills, creativity, and ethical decision-making skills.
  • Strong writing skills, production skills and tease writing abilities.
  • ENPS, EDIUS and Axis graphics experience is preferred.
  • Must be organized with the ability to work under constant deadlines.
  • Must be able to calmly handle live breaking news situations and changing events.
  • Proven social and digital content creation ability.
  • Knowledge of Indianapolis a plus ​

The ideal candidate will embrace KBMT’s high standards of engaging storytelling, investigative excellence and creating relevant, compelling and impactful news content with a laser focus on breaking news, local weather and sports. The ideal candidate brings an interest and track record of growing young talent to lead staff development and recruit high potential team members.   

Beaumont is a highly competitive market, with a mix of news, sports and weather that guarantees multiple lead story options each day. The News Director will work creatively and collaboratively with KBMT/KJAC’s news and station management to ensure newscasts are both relevant to the needs of our diverse audience through owning the day’s big story, being consistent in presentation and giving our audience context plus exclusive information. 

This leader will uphold TEGNA’s values in every decision: demand the truth, work smarter, do the right thing and win. These values guide how we serve our audiences, support our teams and deliver essential journalism every day. 

This is a chance to lead a strong news team in a region where the news is 24/7!

· Coach on-air reporters to perform in an engaging manner.

· Be a key voice in the KBMT editorial process. 

· Use research and analytics to guide editorial decisions.

· Solid social media skills, including an active news hound strategy across platforms.

Data-informed approach to journalism with experience using research, audience analytics and performance metrics to guide editorial strategy and measure impact.

job.title: Operations Analyst
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

This Operations Analyst role is part of a team that owns the day-to-day monitoring, support, and operational stability of TEGNA's broadcast and digital platforms while providing advanced support to stakeholders and business-critical applications. You'll work closely with distributed IT teams, engineering, and vendors in a 24x7 support environment—triaging incidents, resolving tickets, and keeping services online. Automating the repetitive task with AI and workflow tools. You'll leverage intelligent ticket routing, help implement our next predictive monitoring solution, and automations. Clear ownership from intake through resolution, sharp communication, and the ability to work across technical teams.

  • Incident Support & Workflow Automation 
    Own support tickets in ServiceNow from intake through resolution, with responsibility for issues spanning PC/Mac endpoints, imaging workflows, collaborative tools (Teams/O365), and emerging AI/workstream tooling. Troubleshoot complex endpoint issues across Intune (device compliance, conditional access, app distribution), hybrid identity systems (Okta, AD, Entra), and Exchange Online. Leverage Moveworks for intelligent ticket intake, prioritization, and automated routing to reduce manual triage. Coordinate cross-functionally with remote teams, document root causes and remediation steps in ServiceNow, and drive first-contact resolution rates. Identify automation opportunities—flagging repetitive tickets for workflow automation, knowledge gaps, and tooling inefficiencies that slow resolution. The role is also responsible for monitoring and supporting patch compliance.
  • System Monitoring and Operational Support 
    Provide proactive monitoring and day-to-day operational support for critical broadcast and streaming systems by responding to PagerDuty alerts, performing routine health checks in New Relic and native monitoring platforms, identifying early warning indicators, and taking preventative action to avoid service disruption. Own operational dashboards and alert tuning to reduce noise and catch real issues early.
  • Problem Management and Documentation 
    Analyze, resolve, and document incidents and recurring problems using structured root cause analysis. Capture resolutions, workarounds, and lessons learned in ServiceNow knowledge articles and operational runbooks. Drive continuous refinement of documentation to reduce repeat tickets and improve first-contact resolution rates.
  • Knowledge Management and Operational Readiness 
    Create, maintain, and improve operational documentation, standard operating procedures, and knowledge base content to support the Service Desk and enable effective remote handoffs across distributed teams. Build self-service resources that reduce support load and empower end users.
  • Operational Flexibility and Continuous Improvement
    Adapt to changing priorities and operational demands, take ownership of assigned work, and constructively challenge existing tools and processes. Identify automation opportunities and champion process improvements that increase reliability, efficiency, and support outcomes.
  • Team Collaboration and Remote Support 
    Collaborate effectively with a globally distributed, remote-first team, including engineers, application owners, and broadcast/streaming operations. Support handoffs across time zones and enable a follow-the-sun operating model with clear communication and documentation.

Requirements:

  • College degree, relevant certifications, or equivalent hands-on experience in IT operations, service desk, or enterprise support roles.
  • Three or more years of experience in an operations or advanced helpdesk role, supporting enterprise applications, infrastructure, and end-user environments in a production or 24x7 support setting.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting broadcast, media, or digital workflow systems, including server platforms, end-user computing orchestration, and monitoring/management toolsets. Cloud and hybrid environment experience is a plus.
  • Strong working knowledge of IT service management practices and tooling, including ITIL concepts, incident and problem management, knowledge management, and ServiceNow.
  • Hands-on experience with automation and scripting technologies, such as PowerShell, Python, or similar languages, used to improve operational efficiency and reduce manual support effort.
  • Proven ability to manage and prioritize multiple concurrent tickets, incidents, or tasks, working independently while collaborating effectively with remote and globally distributed teams.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly document issues and resolutions and communicate technical information to a wide range of internal customers and business partners.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues and identify practical, repeatable solutions.

Benefits:

job.description:

About the Role:

We’re seeking a highly skilled Paid Marketing Manager - Social with deep hands-on experience in scaling social media campaigns and a strong background in creative development and testing. This role requires someone who has an extensive understanding of the paid social ecosystem, including campaign strategy, execution, and performance optimization. The ideal candidate will have experience placing and managing media buys on platforms like Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, and others, with the ability to deliver measurable results. 

Responsibilities:

Campaign Strategy and Execution:

  • Develop and implement paid social media strategies that align with broader marketing objectives, focusing on driving traffic, engagement, and conversions.
  • Plan, execute, and manage paid media buys across platforms, including Facebook Ads Manager, TikTok Ads, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, and emerging social platforms.
  • Set up campaigns with detailed targeting parameters, budgets, bidding strategies, and creative variations.
  • Monitor campaigns daily to ensure performance goals are met, adjusting bids and strategies as needed. 

Creative Development & Testing:

  • Partner closely with internal creative teams to concept, brief, and develop high-performing assets tailored for social and cross-channel use. 
  • Provide data-driven insights to influence creative direction, messaging, and visual strategy. 
  • Build structured A/B and multivariate testing roadmaps, including creative rotations, variant testing, messaging frameworks, and placement-level analyses. 
  • Translate testing results into actionable creative and channel recommendations. 

Performance Optimization & Analysis:

  • Monitor pacing, CAC/CPA efficiency, ROAS, retention, and device-level performance daily. 
  • Analyze in-platform metrics and downstream engagement to optimize budgets, bids, audiences, and creative mix. 
  • Work with analytics teams to refine dashboards, measurement strategies, and attribution frameworks. 
  • Run experiments across audiences, creatives, and placements to systematically improve efficiency. 

Cross-Functional Partnership:

  • Collaborate with analytics, product, engineering, and creative teams to align efforts across acquisition, retention, and monetization. 
  • Influence creative and product roadmaps through insights and performance trends. 
  • Communicate findings and recommendations clearly to leadership and peer teams. 

Operational Excellence:

  • Ensure accurate campaign setup, trafficking, tagging, and QA across all social campaigns. 
  • Maintain documentation of campaign learnings, testing frameworks, and optimization decisions. 
  • Ensure data integrity across MMPs, attribution systems, and platform dashboards.

  • Sharp analytical mindset with experience reading dashboards, performance reports, and attribution data. 
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to simplify complex findings.

•    Use social media and digital tools to discover, research, verify and share news content.

This is an opportunity for an enterprising journalist who wants to help build something new: a truly statewide local-news operation with strong local teams in both Phoenix and Tucson.
Job summary
The Photographer/Reporter will be based in Tucson and serve as a key member of our Southern Arizona content team. This person will report, shoot, write and edit compelling journalism for our Tucson and Phoenix broadcast, streaming, digital and social platforms. The successful candidate will work closely with fellow reporters, photographers, producers and newsroom leaders in Tucson and Phoenix as part of one coordinated statewide content operation. They will be expected to develop original story ideas, build trusted sources, deliver compelling live reports and ensure the issues and communities of Southern Arizona are strongly represented across our coverage.

Responsibilities:
•    Cover live breaking news, enterprise stories, major community issues across our Tucson and Phoenix newscasts and platforms
•    Collaborate daily with newsroom teams in both Tucson and Phoenix as part of an integrated statewide content operation
•    Report, shoot, write, edit and produce impactful content for broadcast, streaming, digital and social platforms.
•    Own and develop original story ideas rooted in Tucson and Southern Arizona that are relevant locally and statewide
•    Build deep relationships and trusted sources throughout Southern Arizona
•    Deliver clear, confident and conversational live reports in planned coverage and breaking-news situations
•    Serve as a regular live presence across our Tucson and Phoenix newscasts and digital/streaming platforms, delivering clear, confident and conversational live reports in planned coverage and breaking-news situations
•    Use social media and digital tools to discover, research, verify and share news content.
•    Uphold our newsroom standards for accuracy, fairness, urgency and compelling storytelling.

Requirements:
•    2 years of reporting experience preferred.
•    Proven ability to shoot, write, edit and produce strong broadcast and digital stories independently.
•    Demonstrated ability to deliver polished, engaging live reports daily, including during breaking news.
•    Strong news judgment, writing ability, ethical decision-making and attention to accuracy.
•    A track record of generating original story ideas and building trusted sources in a community.
•    Comfort working independently in the field while collaborating closely with a larger newsroom.
•    Ability to work quickly, calmly and accurately under deadline pressure.
•    Experience using social media and digital platforms for newsgathering and audience engagement

  • Create graphics for day turn packages.
  • Generate vertical videos daily for our digital and streaming apps.

  • Proficiency with Adobe Creative Cloud (Premiere, After Effects, & Photoshop) to create compelling visual graphics.

Compensation and Benefits 

We are offering competitive pay along with benefits. This position is full-time, hourly, and IATSE union. Compensation Range: $35.86 - $40.76 hourly.

We are an equal opportunity employer

job.title: President & General Manager
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

WOI/KCWI-TV, the TEGNA-owned ABC affiliate in Des Moines and WQAD the ABC affiliate in Quad Cities, is searching for an accomplished, strategic leader to serve as President & General Manager. 

The President & General Manager is responsible for the overall performance of both stations and markets, setting strategy and leading the organization to drive revenue growth, deliver high-quality local journalism, strengthen financial performance, grow audiences and deliver meaningful community impact across platforms. The successful candidate will be a proven business and people leader who builds high-performing teams, identifies new opportunities for growth, drives innovation and creates a culture of collaboration and accountability across both markets.

Responsibilities:

Leads the overall strategy and performance of both stations and markets, with accountability for content, sales, brand and operations across all platforms.

Develops and executes short- and long-term strategies to grow revenue, audience, market share and profitability in each market.

Provides strategic leadership for each station’s content operation, ensuring high-quality, relevant journalism that serves its local community, grows audiences and strengthens each station’s brand across platforms.

Leads multiplatform strategy across both markets, identifying opportunities to expand audience reach, engagement, content and distribution.

Partners with sales leadership in each market to drive revenue growth, strengthen customer relationships and deliver effective advertiser solutions.

Develops and manages annual budgets and forecasts, ensuring strong financial performance and accountability against business objectives across both markets.

Builds, develops and leads high-performing leadership teams across both stations, establishing clear expectations and accountability for results.

Creates alignment across content, sales and other functions while ensuring each market is responsive to its unique business, audience and community needs.

Drives innovation and continuous improvement, identifying new opportunities to grow the business, strengthen both operations and better serve audiences and customers.

Serves as a visible leader across both communities and builds strong relationships with community partners, advertisers, viewers and other key stakeholders.

Requirements:

Bachelor’s degree in journalism, business or related field and 7-10 years of progressive leadership experience in media or a related industry.

Proven track record of leading high-performing teams and delivering strong business, financial and audience results.

Demonstrated ability to develop and execute strategy, translate priorities into action and hold teams accountable for results.

Strong financial acumen with experience managing budgets, forecasting performance and driving revenue and profitability.

Experience leading across multiple functions and building alignment among teams with different priorities and areas of expertise.

Strong understanding of evolving media consumption, digital and streaming platforms, and opportunities to grow audiences and revenue across platforms.

Excellent judgment and critical-thinking skills with a demonstrated ability to make sound, data-informed decisions.

Innovative and growth-oriented mindset with a willingness to challenge existing approaches and identify new ways to win.

Effective communicator and inclusive leader who listens well, develops talent and creates a clear, shared vision.

Demonstrated ability to represent the organization as a credible and engaged leader in the communities it serves.

job.title: Product Manager, Product Analytics & Experimentation
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

We're looking for a Product Manager, Product Analytics & Experimentation to help TEGNA measure, learn from, and continuously improve our digital products. This role sits at the intersection of product analytics and experimentation, partnering with Product Managers to transform customer behavior into actionable insights that improve our websites, mobile apps, notifications, and personalization capabilities.

You'll help evolve TEGNA's analytics and experimentation capabilities, enabling product teams to measure outcomes, validate hypotheses, and make confident, data-informed decisions throughout the product lifecycle. Working across Product, Engineering, Design, Data, QA, and Editorial, you'll help build a culture where analytics and experimentation are integral to how we discover, deliver, and continuously improve our products.

Who You Are

You are passionate about understanding customer behavior and using data to improve products. You enjoy digging into analytics, identifying opportunities, designing experiments, and translating complex findings into practical recommendations.

You're equally comfortable partnering with Product Managers to define success metrics, collaborating with Engineering on instrumentation requirements, working with Data teams to ensure analytics quality, partnering with UX Research and Design to better understand customer behavior, building dashboards, and helping stakeholders interpret the impact of new features, experiments, and customer journeys.

You have a strong analytical mindset but understand that data is only valuable when it leads to better decisions. You're curious, collaborative, and eager to develop expertise in product analytics and experimentation while helping teams build better products.

You're organized, proactive, and motivated by TEGNA's mission to connect and serve local communities everywhere.

Scope of Responsibility

Partner with Product Managers across TEGNA's Consumer Products organization to define success metrics, measure product performance, identify opportunities, and support experimentation initiatives.

Help evolve TEGNA's analytics and experimentation capabilities by establishing best practices for instrumentation, dashboard development, experimentation, and product analysis.

Support product teams throughout the product lifecycle by helping define measurement plans, analyze product performance, and communicate actionable insights that improve customer outcomes.

Top Key Activities

  • Product Analytics - Partner with Product Managers to define success metrics, develop dashboards, analyze customer behavior, and identify opportunities to improve product performance.
  • Analytics Enablement - Develop dashboards, reports, and reusable measurement frameworks that make product performance visible and actionable across the organization.
  • Instrumentation - Partner with Product Managers and Engineering to define analytics requirements, document event tracking, validate instrumentation, and improve the consistency and quality of product data.
  • Product Analysis - Analyze product performance, feature adoption, customer journeys, conversion funnels, engagement trends, and experiment results to generate actionable recommendations.
  • Experimentation - Support the design, execution, and measurement of A/B tests and feature rollouts, partnering with product teams to validate hypotheses and measure customer impact.
  • Communications - Present dashboards, findings, experiment results, and recommendations to product teams and stakeholders through clear written and verbal communication.

Domain Acumen

  • Experience working with digital product analytics platforms such as Amplitude (preferred) or Google Analytics.
  • Experience supporting A/B testing, experimentation, feature flagging, or progressive delivery using LaunchDarkly or similar platforms.
  • Strong understanding of product metrics including adoption, engagement, retention, conversion, funnels, and customer behavior analysis.
  • Experience partnering with Engineering to define or validate analytics instrumentation.
  • Ability to translate business questions into meaningful product insights.
  • Strong understanding of agile software development and how analytics supports continuous product improvement.
  • Experience with SQL, visualization tools, or business intelligence platforms is a plus.
  • Experience with digital media, publishing, consumer products, or content platforms is desirable.

Key Professional Traits and Requirements

  • 2-5 years of experience in Product Analytics, Digital Analytics, Product Management, Business Analysis, or a related field
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Experience partnering with Product Managers and Engineering teams
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong planning, prioritization, and organizational skills
  • Comfortable collaborating across Product, Design, Engineering, QA, Data, and Editorial teams
  • Data-informed decision maker with experience measuring product outcomes
  • Curious, collaborative, and eager to learn
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability
  • Comfortable working in fast-paced, iterative environments

Tools

Deep knowledge and proficiency with the following:

  • Analytics: Amplitude or equivalent
  • Experimentation: LaunchDarkly or equivalent
  • Atlassian products: Jira, Jira Product Discovery, Confluence
  • Visualization: Tableau, Power BI, Looker Studio, or equivalent

Why Join Us?

Help shape how TEGNA builds better digital products through data.

As a Product Analyst, you'll partner with product teams across websites, mobile apps, personalization, notifications, experimentation, and analytics to help teams understand customer behavior, validate ideas, and continuously improve the experiences that reach millions of users every day.

You'll work alongside experienced product leaders and analysts, building deep expertise in product analytics and experimentation while making a meaningful impact on the future of local journalism.

This is an opportunity to grow your career at the intersection of analytics, experimentation, and product strategy, helping create a culture where every product decision is informed by data and every product improvement is measurable. #LI-MS1

job.title: Reporter MMJ (Tucson)
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

Help us build the future of statewide local news in Arizona.
TEGNA is creating a statewide news operation by bringing together teams in Phoenix and Tucson to build a stronger content organization serving viewers across Arizona. We are looking for MMJ Reporters based in Tucson to be part of a dedicated Southern Arizona news team serving our Tucson stations while also contributing to statewide coverage across our Phoenix and Tucson broadcast, streaming, digital and social platforms. This reporter will cover breaking news, enterprise stories, major community issues and the people shaping Tucson and Southern Arizona. They will be deeply connected to the Tucson community while working as part of one collaborative Arizona newsroom serving audiences across both markets. This is an opportunity for an enterprising journalist who wants to help build something new: a truly statewide local-news operation with strong local teams in both Phoenix and Tucson.
Job summary
The MMJ Reporter will be based in Tucson and serve as a key member of our Southern Arizona content team. This person will report, shoot, write and edit compelling journalism for our Tucson and Phoenix broadcast, streaming, digital and social platforms.
The successful candidate will work closely with fellow reporters, photographers, producers and newsroom leaders in Tucson and Phoenix as part of one coordinated statewide content operation. They will be expected to develop original story ideas, build trusted sources, deliver compelling live reports and ensure the issues and communities of Southern Arizona are strongly represented across our coverage.

Responsibilities:
•    Cover live breaking news, enterprise stories, major community issues across our Tucson and Phoenix newscasts and platforms
•    Collaborate daily with newsroom teams in both Tucson and Phoenix as part of an integrated statewide content operation
•    Report, shoot, write, edit and produce impactful content for broadcast, streaming, digital and social platforms.

•    Serve as a regular live presence across our Tucson and Phoenix newscasts and digital/streaming platforms, delivering clear, confident and conversational live reports in planned coverage and breaking-news situations

•    Uphold our newsroom standards for accuracy, fairness, urgency and compelling storytelling.

The Sales Assistant / Sales Development position provides comprehensive support to the KWES Sales Department and Director of Sales while gaining broad exposure to the station's sales, operational and client-service functions. This is a department-wide sales support position and is not dedicated exclusively to individual Account Executives. Responsibilities and priorities may shift based on the operational, Account Manager, sales and leadership needs of the department.
  The position will support sales leadership, assist Account Executives as needed, provide backup Account Manager coverage, and develop knowledge of KWES's broadcast, streaming and digital sales solutions. This role is also designed to provide professional development and exposure that may prepare a successful employee for a future Account Executive opportunity as business needs and openings arise.
Four Core Areas of Responsibility
1. Director of Sales & Department Support
Serve as a primary support resource to the Director of Sales and overall
KWES sales organization.
Responsibilities include:
• Assist the DOS with sales reports, presentations, meeting preparation
and follow-up. • Support preparation for weekly sales meetings, revenue discussions
and sales initiatives.
• Assist with revenue, inventory and sales activity reporting.
• Maintain current sales materials, programming information,
sponsorship opportunities and other department resources.
• Track department deadlines, outstanding items and projects requiring
follow-up.
• Assist with special sales initiatives, client events and station
opportunities.
• Coordinate information and workflow between Sales and other
departments, including Traffic, Creative Services, Finance, Digital and
Sales Fulfillment.
• Assist with organization and execution of seasonal programming,
sports, political and special sales opportunities.
• Provide administrative and project support as assigned by the DOS.
• Take on additional responsibilities based on changing department
priorities and business needs.
2. Account Executive & Sales Support
Provide operational and administrative support to Account Executives as
needed and based on department priorities to allow sellers to maximize
client-facing and new-business development time.
Responsibilities include:
• Assist with order entry, revisions and schedule changes.
• Support campaign setup and maintenance.
• Monitor active schedules and campaign delivery.
• Assist with makegoods, preemptions and discrepancy resolution. • Prepare and update client presentations, proposals and sales
materials.
• Assist with avails and inventory coordination.
• Coordinate commercial materials, scripts and creative needs.
• Follow up with Traffic, Creative Services and Sales Fulfillment on
outstanding items.
• Assist with routine client and agency administrative requests.
• Support campaign recaps and post-campaign reporting.
• Help maintain accurate client, account and campaign information.
• Assist with Matrix/CRM administrative support while maintaining AE
accountability for prospecting activity, opportunities and pipeline
management.
The Sales Assistant supports the business of the sales department rather
than being permanently assigned to any individual Account Executive.
3. Account Manager Coverage & Operational Support
Develop proficiency in Account Manager responsibilities to provide reliable
backup coverage during vacations, PTO, vacancies, periods of increased
workload or other business needs.
Responsibilities include:
• Become proficient in WO Media Sales and applicable sales systems.
• Enter and revise orders accurately.
• Understand Traffic workflow, deadlines and requirements.
• Assist with schedule maintenance and campaign stewardship.
• Coordinate makegoods and resolve scheduling discrepancies.
• Assist with billing and invoice questions as appropriate.
• Track commercial materials and creative requirements. • Understand MediaFerry and applicable creative workflows.
• Provide professional client and agency administrative communication.
• Coordinate with internal departments to ensure campaign fulfillment.
• Maintain continuity of sales operations when Account Manager
coverage is needed.
The expectation is that this employee becomes a dependable cross-trained
resource who can step into operational gaps without disrupting service to
clients or the sales team.
4. Account Executive Development
Develop the foundational skills, product knowledge and sales experience
necessary to potentially advance into a future Account Executive position.
Development opportunities may include:
• Participate in sales and product training.
• Develop knowledge of KWES/KIDY/KXVA broadcast programming and
sales opportunities.
• Learn TEGNA's Total TV approach: Broadcast + Streaming + Digital.
• Develop working knowledge of Premion, CTV/OTT, Audience
Marketplace and other digital solutions.
• Learn Matrix CRM and proper pipeline management.
• Participate in prospect research and new-business development
exercises.
• Learn effective prospecting techniques.
• Observe and participate in client discovery.
• Attend selected client meetings and AE ride-alongs.
• Assist with development of integrated client recommendations.
• Learn proposal development and presentation skills. • Gain exposure to pricing and inventory strategy.
• Develop understanding of campaign measurement, stewardship and
renewal.
• Participate in role-play, presentation and sales-development exercises.
• Demonstrate the ability to communicate the value of
KWES/KIDY/KXVA and TEGNA solutions to local businesses.
Career Development Opportunity
This position is designed to provide broad exposure to the KWES/KIDY/KXVA sales organization and may serve as a developmental pathway toward a future Account Executive opportunity. As the employee demonstrates proficiency in their core responsibilities, additional opportunities may be provided to develop prospecting, discovery, presentation, client relationship and new-business skills. Advancement into an Account Executive position is not guaranteed and will depend upon individual performance, demonstrated sales readiness, business needs and future position availability.
Key Qualifications
The ideal candidate should demonstrate:
• Strong organization and attention to detail.
• Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
• Professional written and verbal communication.
• Strong customer-service mindset.
• Ability to work effectively across multiple departments.
• Comfort learning new software, systems and processes.
• Working knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Outlook, Teams,
PowerPoint and Excel. • Ability to analyze information and identify potential problems before
they affect clients.
• Initiative and willingness to take ownership of assignments.
• Interest in sales, marketing, advertising and business development.
• Ability to work independently while functioning as part of a larger
sales team.
• Desire to learn and grow within the organization.
Experience in media, advertising, sales support, customer service or account
management is beneficial but not necessarily required for the right
candidate.
Measures of Success
Success in this position will be measured by:
• Accuracy and timeliness of work.
• Responsiveness to DOS and department priorities.
• Reliability of AE and AM support.
• Ability to manage and follow through on assigned projects.
• Reduction of administrative and operational workload on sellers and
sales leadership.
• Quality of internal and external communication.
• Campaign and order accuracy.
• Ability to identify and resolve issues proactively.
• Growth in product, system and sales knowledge.
• Demonstrated readiness to assume increasing responsibility.     Role Philosophy
The purpose of this position is straightforward: Support the sales operation. Protect the client experience. Give sellers more time to sell. Provide the DOS with additional operational support. Build organizational depth. Develop future sales talent.

job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

We are seeking a results-oriented, highly organized Sales Operations Specialist to support the San Antonio sales team by partnering closely with Account Executives and Sales Leadership to drive Total TV (linear, OTT, and digital) revenue growth. This role takes full ownership of station sales projects and special initiatives that drive new business and digital revenue. The position delivers superior customer service to agencies and direct clients while maintaining sales materials and workflow systems that keep Account Executives empowered with relevant information. With a focus on enabling Account Executives to maximize client-facing time, this position plays a key role in driving growth and operational excellence in market. This position reports to the Director of Sales.

Responsibilities
•    Full ownership of station projects, Great Day SA segments and franchises, special initiatives, and go-to market strategy.
•    Own existing list of Station projects from start to finish (creation, process, implementation, execution) and generate new ideas for non-traditional revenue generation, quarterly.
•    Complete required forms and updates in Monday.com project management system to ensure accurate workflow tracking, team coordination, and commercial production project visibility across both markets.
•    Work together with Sales Activation Coordinator to ensure precise execution of station projects and initiatives. Act as internal liaison between Sales Activation coordinator and station leadership/ departments.
•    Create new business package opportunities based on inventory and take ownership of GDSA bundles and accelerator packages.
•    Create custom solutions-driven campaigns that meet client needs across multiple media platforms including broadcast, digital, and Streaming (OTT), and attend client meetings with AE’s as needed (approx. 3-5x per week).
•    Prepare attribution reports for OTT and linear TV campaigns, synthesizing data into actionable presentations
•    Act as a strategic advisor for the San Antonio sales team by leveraging ratings data, competitive intelligence tools, and AI resources to conduct client research and provide market insights that empower Account Executives in client conversations.
•    Organize, maintain, and update sales materials, presentations, and marketing collateral ensuring Account Executives have immediate access to current, professional materials for client meetings.
•    Work closely with sales leadership on the training and development of AE’s, including planning for weekly Digital Sales Huddles, bi-weekly Sales Huddles, monthly lunch and learns for underperforming AEs and AE 1-1’s, as needed.
•    Attend TEGNA training sessions to gain product knowledge, stay informed on TEGNA’s broadcast, OTT, and digital solutions, understand sales processes, and maintain ability to discuss solutions with team members.
•    Support organizational growth priorities as assigned by the Director of Sales.

Requirements
•    Minimum 5-7 years of linear and digital media sales experience.
•    Proven ability to support pre-sale and post-sale campaign implementation and client service responsibilities that enable sales teams to focus on revenue generation.
•    Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office suite, particularly Excel (formulas, tables, data analysis) and PowerPoint (presentation creation and design); ability to leverage AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot) to generate insights and build sales presentations.
•    Ability to learn with CRM software, traffic system (Wide Orbit), and project management tools; ability to learn new software systems quickly.
•    Understanding of broadcast television advertising, Comscore ratings, OTT/streaming platforms, and digital advertising concepts; ability to articulate TEGNA’s multi-platform solutions.
•    Exceptional organizational skills with proven ability to manage multiple account campaigns and projects simultaneously while maintaining accuracy and meeting deadlines.
•    Strong analytical skills with ability to track campaign performance, identify trends, and translate data into actionable insights that support revenue growth conversations.
•    Excellent written and verbal communication skills with professional demeanor in all client and internal interactions.
•    Experience in project management and proposal creation. Deep understanding of driving non-traditional sponsorship revenue and communicating value internally and externally.
•    Detail-oriented with high standards for accuracy and quality; understands that precision in fulfillment builds client confidence and retention.
•    Team-oriented mindset with understanding that supporting Account Executives’ success is the primary measure of performance in this role.
•    Positive attitude and collaborative approach.

job.title: Senior Account Executive
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

KFMB-TV San Diego, the TEGNA-owned CBS affiliate in San Diego, is seeking a proven, results-driven Account Executive to grow new business and manage a book of advertising clients across one of the strongest cross-screen portfolios in the market. This is a seat for a closer who can walk into a business owner's office or an agency pitch, uncover what's really driving their marketing decisions, and build the multi-platform solution that wins the budget. 

You'll sell the full weight of TEGNA: the mass reach and trust of CBS broadcast television paired with the targeting and growth of streaming. On the linear side, you'll connect advertisers to the large, engaged local audiences that tune in to San Diego's trusted news and programming. On the streaming side, you’ll leverage Premion, TEGNA’s streaming and CTV advertising business, to deliver premium, brand-safe connected-TV inventory. Premion’s curated marketplace includes 125+ OTT and CTV publishers, offering the same premium environments national buyers demand. Layered with digital video, display, and content solutions, it's a cross-screen story few competitors can match and in your hands, a clear advantage in every pitch. 

We give experienced sellers the portfolio, the autonomy, and the support to build something significant. Top performers grow their books, their earnings, and their careers. 

Responsibilities: 

  • Drive new business. Build and maintain a strong pipeline of local and regional advertisers, connect with key decision-makers and create opportunities across broadcast TV, Premion streaming/CTV and digital.
  • Sell strategically and consultatively. Uncover each client's real business goals, read the market and competitive landscape, and architect tailored, multi-platform solutions that tie directly to measurable outcomes. 
  • Own the full sales cycle. Prospect, qualify, present, negotiate and close business while consistently meeting activity and revenue targets.
  • Grow and defend the book. Turn accounts into long-term partnerships; expand them through smart upsell and cross-sell across the portfolio and stay close enough to results to renew and grow every cycle. 
  • Pitch with data. Build compelling, insight-driven proposals that show advertisers exactly how broadcast reach and connected-TV targeting combine to deliver ROI. 
  • Run your business. Manage pipeline, forecast accurately, and keep deals moving in CRM and partner with account, creative, and product teams to deliver campaigns that perform and retain. 

Requirements:  

  • 3-5+ years of media, digital, or advertising sales experience with a proven track record of meeting or exceeding revenue targets in a competitive market 
  • Demonstrated ability to prospect, open new business, and build a self-sustaining pipeline. You don't wait for leads 
  • Command of the modern media landscape: broadcast television, streaming/CTV, programmatic, digital video, display, social, and content 
  • Experience selling to business owners and/or agencies, and the presence to lead the room in a strategic pitch 
  • Strong negotiation, presentation, and relationship-building skills 
  • Fluency in turning data and analytics into a clear ROI story clients believe 
  • Proficiency with CRM and Microsoft Office; familiarity with Google Analytics, DSPs/SSPs, and ad-management tools a plus 
  • Valid driver's license with the ability to travel locally to meet clients and partners as needed 

Salary: Competitive base + commission

At KIII-TV Corpus Christi, we build creative shows that engage, educate and inform our audiences. We prioritize original storytelling and investigative journalism as key components of our newscasts to set our product apart in the Corpus Christi market. We value a collaborative, motivated journalist who works well within a team to bring the truth to our growing audiences across platforms, starting with our streaming and broadcast services. KXTV-ABC10, the TEGNA-owned affiliate in Sacramento, is transforming the way we gather and present news, and we’re looking for a Senior Story Desk Editor to embrace our transition to the newsroom of the future.

This role combines the skills of an experienced assignment editor, digital content producer and newsroom leader. The Senior Story Desk Editor helps drive daily editorial execution across all platforms with a focus on digital, social and streaming and ensures our content connects authentically with audiences. 

Role Summary:

As a Senior Story Desk Editor, you will be part of the Story Management Desk (SMD), helping lead a unified desk that replaces the legacy assignment and digital desks. The SMD model ensures a single, streamlined workflow for planning, producing, and curating stories across platforms.

The Senior Story Desk Editor will support the newsroom with coverage of breaking news, planning of major news events and curating content across platforms. This position requires decisive editorial judgment, strong writing skills, and the ability to thrive under tight deadlines. You will collaborate with news management to deliver engaging content, analyze digital trends, help in developing best practices on all platforms, and train story desk editors. 
 
Responsibilities:
 
• Help with newsroom coverage during breaking news, ensuring accuracy, urgency, and balance.
 
• Find unique local and regional story opportunities through sourcing and market trend analysis, resulting in exclusive, high-performing stories and measurable audience impact.
 
• Ability to independently create, edit, and optimize content across all digital platforms — including websites, mobile verticals, streaming products, and social platforms — with a focus on engagement and conversion.
 
• Demonstrate ability to execute audience growth strategies through a deep understanding of content analytics and tracking tools (including Tableau, CrowdTangle, Google Analytics, and other performance dashboards).
 
• Able to find actionable insights and adjust coverage plans in real time.
 
• Provide digital support for story desk editors, MSJs, producers, and photojournalists.
 
• Edit content for accuracy, grammar, AP style, digital best practices, fairness, and ethical considerations.
 
• Use available metrics to inform coverage and improve audience reach.
 
• Support newsroom operations, coverage planning and training as needed.
 
• Uphold TEGNA’s journalistic standards and values across all platforms, 
 
Requirements:
 
• At least three years of journalism experience in a local newsroom, digital production, or related role.
 
• Strong news judgment and the ability to make fast, sound editorial decisions under pressure.
 
• Excellent writing skills, with the ability to produce accurate and compelling content quickly.
 
• Experience with newsroom systems, CMS tools.
 
• Organizational skills to manage competing priorities in a deadline-driven environment.
 
• A collaborative, solutions-focused mindset that thrives in a team environment.
 
• Bachelor’s degree in journalism, communications, or equivalent experience.

Success in this role comes from strong sales collaboration, creative sports strategy, disciplined follow-through, and the ability to turn linear TV, content sponsorships, digital, streaming, and OTT opportunities, including PREMION, into compelling advertising solutions that drive revenue growth and measurable client outcomes. 

Responsibilities 

  • Partner with the team of Account Executives to identify, develop, and close sports advertising revenue from new and existing clients. 
  • Join Account Executives on client sales calls as the sports subject matter expert, helping uncover needs, shape opportunities, and advance business. 
  • Support Account Executives throughout the sales process, from targeted prospecting and pre-call planning through proposal development, presentation, negotiation, and post-sale transition. 
  • Identify market potential, category opportunities, and competitive insights that help grow sports revenue and expand advertiser participation. 
  • Develop strategic, insight-driven sports marketing solutions tied to key properties including the Denver Broncos, Denver Nuggets, Colorado Avalanche, Colorado Rockies, NBC Olympics, NBC Sunday Night Football, NBA on NBC, MLB on NBC, NBC PGA Tournaments, Premion OTT Sports programming, and additional sports programming connected with 9NEWS. 
  • Create custom campaigns and sponsorship concepts that meet client needs across broadcast, digital, streaming, OTT, and content sponsorships. 
  • Upsell current clients across the full 9NEWS sports and media product line. 
  • Collaborate with sales leadership, marketing, research, production, digital, and operations teams to build integrated campaigns. 
  • Maintain strong relationships with clients, agencies, league/team contacts, and internal stakeholders. 
  • Manage CRM activity, pipeline, forecasts, and sports revenue updates. 
  • Represent 9NEWS at client events, networking opportunities, and sports-related hospitality as needed. 

Qualifications 

  • Minimum of 5 years of sales experience in a fast-paced sports-centric media environment; local market sports, broadcast, digital, streaming, agency, or sponsorship experience preferred. 
  • Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales goals and developing new business opportunities. 
  • Strong understanding of sports marketing, fan engagement, sponsorship packaging, and advertiser strategy. 
  • Ability to translate advertiser objectives into creative, actionable, and measurable sports marketing solutions. 
  • Confident presenter and consultative seller with strong written and verbal communication skills. 
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate with Account Executives, sales leaders, and cross-functional teams. 
  • Strong organization, follow-through, and ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, proposals, and active sales opportunities. 
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and CRM systems; experience with Wide Orbit Sales, Salesforce, Wide Orbit Analytics, Comscore, Monday.com, AdImpact, Tableau, or similar platforms preferred. 
  • Positive, adaptable, and solutions-oriented in a fast-moving sales environment. 

Supervision/Contacts 

Reports to the Director of Sales at 9NEWS and works closely with Sales Management, Account Executive Team, clients, agencies, internal marketing and production teams, and external sports partners. 

Competitive compensation includes base salary plus an incentive plan tied to sports revenue growth, sales collaboration, and overall performance. On-target compensation range of $150,000-$200,000 based on experience, qualifications, and market considerations. 

 

The application deadline for this position is Nov 6, 2026

Pay Range$120,000—$200,000 USD

job.description:

KWES-TV, the TEGNA-owned NBC affiliate in Midland - Odessa, Texas, is searching for an Story Desk Editor who thrives in a fast-paced news environment and has an audience-first approach to writing, producing and distributing local news content. Our digital producers monitor digital audience trends to identify and write engaging local news content that broadens our audience. They are responsible for curating quality content and overseeing the audience experience across NewsWest 9's website, mobile, app, streaming and social media platforms. They work as part of the larger content team to break news and tell great stories in a 24/7 news environment.

The ideal candidate is an avid news consumer and writes accurate, compelling content with a sense of urgency. Qualified candidates should be strong writers, first, with the ability to write quickly and accurately while tracking multiple streams of information. They should also have solid news judgment and experience producing and copy-editing content for digital platforms. Experience with SEO best practices and audience listening are a big plus. We’re also looking for someone with strong initiative and an inner drive who is ready to learn and grow.

Responsibilities:

Write and distribute original and accurate breaking news content

Curate and schedule news content on all station platforms, including website, mobile app, social media and streaming platforms

Edit reporter stories for grammar, clarity, structure, AP style and optimize the content for digital

Use creative production or story-packaging techniques, like subheads, hyperlinks, graphics and media (viewer pictures, user-generated content, etc.) to enhance digital stories

Write in an exciting, captivating and authentic manner

Research for facts and credibility

Monitor news releases and use social listening to find new content, enterprise stories and make community contacts

Analyze and actively use data and metrics to inform editorial and strategic decisions

Ensures podcast recordings have a producer assigned and are properly staffed

Schedules and optimizes 24/7 streaming content by becoming familiar with our analytics, audience trends and what content performs best

Serve as the liaison between the story desk team and broadcast producers, making sure producers are up to date on new shows, streaming priorities and what content we need to push

Ensure the newsroom upholds journalistic integrity and the station brand across platforms

Requirements

BA/BS in journalism, communications and/or equivalent experience in the field

1-3 years of experience writing breaking news articles or writing news articles in AP style

Strong communication and organizational skills and the ability to work under constant time pressure and meet deadlines

Ability to calmly handle live, breaking news situations and rapidly changing coverage

Strong news and editorial judgment, and an understanding of the tenets of professional journalism

Strong knowledge of AP style, copy editing and SEO best practices

Experience with CMS, photo and video-editing systems preferred

The ability to write in an exciting, captivating and conversational tone is preferred

Experience creating and managing content on social media platforms, including Instagram, Twitter and Facebook

An aptitude for creating and packaging engaging, audience-driven content

Knowledge of how to interpret and use digital analytics is a plus

Knowledge of ENPS, Edius, Canva is a plus

Ability to work various shifts, including mornings, nights and weekends

WBIR-TV, the TEGNA-owned NBC affiliate in Knoxville, is searching for an Story Desk Editor who thrives in a fast-paced news environment and has an audience-first approach to writing, producing and distributing local news content. Our digital producers monitor digital audience trends to identify and write engaging local news content that broadens our audience. They are responsible for curating quality content and overseeing the audience experience across all WBIR-TV website, mobile, app, streaming and social media platforms. They work as part of the larger content team to break news and tell great stories in a 24/7 news environment.

The ideal candidate is an avid news consumer and writes accurate, compelling content with a sense of urgency. Qualified candidates should be strong writers, first, with the ability to write quickly and accurately while tracking multiple streams of information. They should also have solid news judgment and experience producing and copy-editing content for digital platforms. Experience with SEO best practices and audience listening are a big plus. We’re also looking for someone with strong initiative and an inner drive who is ready to learn and grow.

Responsibilities:

Write and distribute original and accurate breaking news content

Curate and schedule news content on all station platforms, including website, mobile app, social media and streaming platforms

Edit reporter stories for grammar, clarity, structure, AP style and optimize the content for digital

Use creative production or story-packaging techniques, like subheads, hyperlinks, graphics and media (viewer pictures, user-generated content, etc.) to enhance digital stories

Write in an exciting, captivating and authentic manner

Research for facts and credibility

Monitor news releases and use social listening to find new content, enterprise stories and make community contacts

Analyze and actively use data and metrics to inform editorial and strategic decisions

Manages the WBIR podcast room calendar, including scheduling recordings and coordinating guests

Ensures podcast recordings have a producer assigned and are properly staffed

Schedules and optimizes 24/7 streaming content by becoming familiar with our analytics, audience trends and what content performs best

Serve as the liaison between the story desk team and broadcast producers, making sure producers are up to date on new shows, streaming priorities and what content we need to push

Ensure the newsroom upholds journalistic integrity and the station brand across platforms

 

Requirements

BA/BS in journalism, communications and/or equivalent experience in the field

1-3 years of experience writing breaking news articles or writing news articles in AP style

Strong communication and organizational skills and the ability to work under constant time pressure and meet deadlines

Ability to calmly handle live, breaking news situations and rapidly changing coverage

Strong news and editorial judgment, and an understanding of the tenets of professional journalism

Strong knowledge of AP style, copy editing and SEO best practices

Experience with CMS, photo and video-editing systems preferred

The ability to write in an exciting, captivating and conversational tone is preferred

Experience creating and managing content on social media platforms, including Instagram, Twitter and Facebook

An aptitude for creating and packaging engaging, audience-driven content

Knowledge of how to interpret and use digital analytics is a plus

Knowledge of ENPS, Edius, Canva is a plus

Ability to work various shifts, including mornings, nights and weekends

Uphold TEGNA's journalistic standards and values across all platforms

Organizational skills to manage competing priorities in a deadline-driven environment

job.title: Story Desk Manager
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

WOI/KCWI, TEGNA’s ABC and CW affiliates serving the Des Moines–Ames DMA, has an opening for a Story Desk Manager. As the Story Desk Manager, you will lead the Story Management Desk (SMD), a unified desk that brings together the traditional functions of the assignment and digital desks.

The SMD model creates a single, streamlined workflow for discovering, planning, producing and curating stories across platforms. This position will play a central role in coordinating news coverage across the Des Moines–Ames market and communities throughout central Iowa.

Position Overview:

The Story Desk Manager works alongside the News Director and other newsroom leaders to oversee daily editorial decisions while helping set the newsroom's broader content and audience strategy.

You will guide our team of journalists in story discovery, development and presentation across all platforms with a strong digital- and streaming-first mindset. The Story Desk Manager oversees breaking news coverage across platforms and helps lead strategy for WeAreIowa.com, the Local 5 mobile app, We Are Iowa+ streaming platforms and social media.

This role is about more than managing the daily assignment file. The Story Desk Manager helps determine which stories we pursue, how we tell them, where they should be published or streamed, and how we can maximize their reach and impact.

We're looking for an exceptional, people-focused leader who can coach journalists, develop coverage plans and help grow audiences across platforms while maintaining a relentless focus on stories that matter to Iowans. Analyzing audience data, identifying trends and translating those insights into actionable guidance for the newsroom are also critical parts of the role.

The ability to identify and pursue stories that are urgent, impactful and distinctly local is essential. This leader should be able to respond quickly to breaking news, calmly manage rapidly changing situations, pivot coverage when necessary, solve problems creatively and guide a multi-platform newsroom through both the daily news cycle and major breaking stories.

Responsibilities:

  • Oversee daily coverage decisions and reporter assignments with the goal of owning the biggest and most important stories in the Des Moines–Ames DMA.
  • Lead the Story Management Desk and ensure strong coordination among Story Desk Editors, reporters, MSJs, photojournalists, producers and newsroom managers.
  • Determine the best format and platform for each story — including broadcast, web, mobile, streaming, social and vertical video — and establish reasonable timelines for delivery of those elements.
  • Work closely with the News Director to program and grow We Are Iowa+, identifying opportunities for live coverage, breaking news, weather, special programming and original streaming content.
  • Look beyond the daily news cycle and develop coverage plans for upcoming events, enterprise stories and major news opportunities across central Iowa.
  • Lead regular story check-ins throughout the day to evaluate reporting progress, sharpen story focus and ensure content is being delivered effectively across platforms.
  • Analyze and actively use audience data and performance metrics to inform editorial decisions, identify opportunities and create accountability for results.
  • Help develop and execute strategies to grow audiences across WeAreIowa.com, the Local 5 mobile app, We Are Iowa+, social media and emerging platforms.
  • Ensure competitive, engaging and impactful content across broadcast and digital platforms.
  • Identify opportunities to extend major stories beyond a single newscast or article through follow-up reporting, streaming coverage, vertical video, explainers and other platform-specific storytelling.
  • Collaborate with other departments to identify opportunities to grow and monetize the success of our digital and streaming platforms while maintaining editorial independence.
  • Alongside Story Desk Editors, provide editorial support for MSJs, producers and photojournalists, including reviewing scripts, videos and digital content for accuracy, grammar, AP style, digital best practices, fairness and ethical considerations.
  • Lead and communicate newsroom coverage during breaking news and severe weather, ensuring teams are coordinated across broadcast, digital, streaming and social platforms.
  • Maintain strong awareness of developing stories throughout the Des Moines metro, Ames and communities across the DMA, ensuring our coverage reflects the entire market we serve.
  • Foster a newsroom culture that values urgency, enterprise reporting, collaboration, experimentation and audience-focused storytelling.
  • Uphold TEGNA's journalistic standards and values across all platforms.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in journalism, communications or a related field, or 3-5 years of journalism experience in a local newsroom, digital production or related role.
  • Superior news judgment and the ability to make fast, sound editorial decisions under pressure.
  • Proven record of successfully coordinating breaking news and major developing stories.
  • Experience managing, coaching or leading a team of journalists.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of assignment desk, digital desk or content desk operations.
  • Strong understanding of digital journalism, streaming, social media and multi-platform storytelling.
  • Experience analyzing audience data and identifying behavioral and content-performance trends. Experience with Google Analytics or similar audience measurement tools is a major plus.
  • Experience helping transform newsroom workflows, systems or news-gathering operations.
  • Impeccable organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple stories, crews and platforms simultaneously.
  • Demonstrated success as both a team leader and collaborative newsroom partner.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, conflict-resolution and interpersonal skills.
  • Familiarity with Iowa and the Des Moines–Ames DMA is a plus.
  • Ability to work a variety of shifts, including nights, early mornings, weekends, overtime and breaking news situations as needed.
  • Knowledge of AP Style is a plus.

Benefits:

TEGNA offers two medical plan options for full and part-time employees through Blue Cross Blue Shield of Texas, as well as access to dental and eye care coverage; fertility, surrogacy and adoption assistance; disability and life insurance.

Our 401(k) program offers full, part-time and temporary employees the opportunity to contribute 1% - 80% of their pay on a pre-tax basis to TEGNA’s 401(k). Contributions made up to the first 4% of pay are eligible for a 100% match from the company and are 100% vested from day one.

Regardless of participation in TEGNA medical plans, ALL employees and their eligible family members receive nine free virtual doctor’s appointments with a physician through Teladoc, and 12 free annual therapy sessions with a licensed clinician through Spring Health.

WTLV/WJXX, the TEGNA-owned NBC and ABC affiliate in Jacksonville, Florida, is transforming the way we gather and present news, and we’re looking for a Story Desk Manager to embrace a leadership role in this transition to the newsroom of the future.

The successful candidate will guide our team of content creators in story discovery and presentation across all platforms. The person in this position will help manage the story development process throughout the day, having experience with the best practices of running an assignment desk and training others to excel at developing local contacts and responding to breaking news. They’ll also be part of a leadership team that oversees the station’s coverage of breaking news, developing stories and enterprise reporting for streaming, online, app, social media and linear television platforms, while maintaining a focus on stories that matter to our community.

The ideal candidate is an experienced journalist with a knack for building a team of people who work smarter, not harder, and are as adept at seeking information as they are in presenting those stories in modern and creative ways. The aptitude to identify and pursue stories that are urgent, impactful and newsworthy is important. The ability to respond urgently to breaking news, calmly manage chaos, pivot quickly, solve problems creatively, train a motivated team, and guide a multi-platform newsroom’s content are all desirable for this leader.

Role Summary

As the Story Desk Manager, you will lead the Story Management Desk (SMD), a unified desk that replaces the legacy assignment and digital desks. The SMD model ensures a single, streamlined workflow for planning, producing and curating stories across platforms.

· Demonstrated knowledge regarding content desk operations

· Experience helping transform and manage news-gathering systems

TEGNA is reimagining local journalism for the newsroom of the future. With 64 stations across 51 markets, we deliver trusted, fact-based news that informs, engages, and empowers communities. Our values Demand the Truth, Work Smarter, Debate Fearlessly, Listen Carefully, and Zero-Base Every Process guide everything we do.

The ideal candidate is more than a skilled photographer—they are a storyteller who understands how powerful video, sound and emotion connect with audiences. job.description:

ABC10, the TEGNA-owned ABC affiliate in Sacramento, California, is seeking a talented and innovative Visual Journalist & Storyteller to join our award-winning ABC10 Originals team.
This is a unique opportunity for a creative photojournalist and editor who is passionate about long-form storytelling, investigative journalism, documentaries, and streaming content. We are looking for someone who can produce compelling visual narratives that stand out across broadcast, digital, and streaming platforms.
The ideal candidate is a strong shooter, editor, and collaborator who thrives on enterprise storytelling and can help bring ambitious projects to life through cinematic visuals, thoughtful production, and creative editing.
This is a full-time, non-exempt position reporting to the Director of Special Projects.
Responsibilities:
•    Serve as a dedicated visual journalist for ABC10 Originals, contributing to investigative, enterprise, and documentary-style projects.
•    Shoot and edit high-quality stories ranging from general assignment and enterprise pieces to half-hour and hour-long specials.
•    Collaborate closely with reporters, producers, and editors to develop visual storytelling strategies from concept through completion.
•    Create compelling content for television, digital platforms, social media, and ABC10+ streaming.
•    Utilize advanced production techniques including drone photography, graphics, motion design, natural sound storytelling, and creative lighting.
•    Operate professional video equipment, including mirrorless and Sony FS-series cameras.
•    Perform advanced post-production work, including color correction, color grading, audio mixing, and visual effects.
•    Edit using Adobe Premiere Pro and Adobe After Effects, producing content optimized for multiple platforms and audiences.
•    Support breaking news and special event coverage when needed.
•    Operate station vehicles and travel throughout Northern California for assignments.

•    Advanced proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro and working knowledge of Adobe After Effects.
•    Strong understanding of cinematography, visual sequencing, natural sound, and pacing.
•    Experience with color grading, advanced lighting techniques, and professional audio recording.
•    Familiarity with Sony camera systems, S-Log workflows, and modern digital production techniques.
•    Experience using live transmission tools such as TVU, Dejero, or similar systems.
•    FAA Part 107 drone certification preferred.
•    Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.
•    Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within a team environment.

job.description:
About TEGNA

Premion, a leading “Over-the-Top” advertising and media business seeks a talented and dedicated Revenue Operations and Monetization Analyst

The Team

This position is part of a larger global Revenue Operations and Monetization team and is responsible for digital programmatic campaign management, maximizing revenue, margin profits, and minimizing liability through inventory control and strategic ad placements. Management members and traders are located in our New York, New York and Phoenix, AZ offices.

The Position

We are seeking a strategic and data-driven digital campaign trader who is responsible for the execution of optimizations for digital campaigns assigned to them. The ideal candidate has a strong understanding of digital campaign management, reading performance analytics with the ability to translate insights into high-impact campaign strategies. The right person for this role must thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced collaborative environment, want an opportunity to make a significant impact and jump at the opportunity to take on new challenges. 

Location

Premion is a high growth division of TEGNA with services within Phoenix, AZ, New York City, NY and India. This is a full-time position located in Phoenix, AZ.

THIS DESCRIBES YOU

  • You have a positive approach to challenges and like to collaborate and create with others on our team.
  • You enjoy being strategic and problem-solving.
  • You can leverage quantitative thinking to manage campaign success.
  • You have excellent attention to detail, set high standards and hold yourself accountable.
  • You have a passion for online advertising, media, and music.
  • You have a positive approach to challenges.

Responsibilities: 

  • A digital programmatic trader is responsible for managing and optimizing online ad campaigns using our proprietary automated bidding platform (SDP) known as PRISM to ensure maximum performance and return on investment (ROI) for clients. This role is a blend of analytical thinking, data analysis, and campaign management.
  • This candidate will be tasked with the monitoring of day-to-day programmatic buys across various channels including connected TV (CTV), display, video, and audio.
  • This candidate will also monitor campaign performance against Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and make data-driven decisions to optimize parameters like bid strategies, client ROI, ad frequency, and delivery.
  • This candidate will proactively identify and resolve campaign setup and performance issues and work alongside their ad ops counterparts to ensure campaigns are delivering smoothly and soundly.
  • This candidate will have a mathematical and analytical aptitude, with comfortability in tools like Excel and Power BI to organize, consolidate, and interpret large datasets.
  • This candidate will adopt a systematic approach to problem-solving and the ability to proactively troubleshoot issues in a fast-paced environment.
  • This candidate will have excellent written and verbal communication skills to articulate complex data insights and strategies to diverse internal members with different titles and experiences in their careers.
  • This candidate will have strong soft skills like attention to detail, time management, the ability to work independently or collaboratively, and a self-starting, proactive mindset are crucial.

REQUIREMENTS:

  • 1 year+ experience in programmatic trading/campaign management role in the advertising/online media space (video ad experiences a strong plus)
  • Highly analytical mindset and skills needed with a hyper focus on profit margins and campaign delivery.
  • Passion for your work and your clients’ satisfaction
  • Excellent verbal, written and MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) skills.
  • Teamwork and interpersonal skills. Trustworthy and dependable
  • Excellent attention to detail
  • Able to set high standards and hold yourself accountable.
  • Become a product expert in programmatic buying.
  • Work with customers to develop achievable campaign goals.
  • Desire and ability to learn new technical skill sets such as using an API to automate campaigns.
  • An eagerness for career progression in AdTech
  • Passion for your work and your clients’ satisfaction
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication
  • Creative Thinking
  • Research and problem-solving skills.
  • Bachelor's Degree
