Candidate will also have radio and television production knowledge and the ability to adapt to multiple positions during the week all under the multimedia production environment.

 

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Assist in organization and execution of all station promotions, events, and community support activities.
  • Execute the documentation process of all on-air contests, including creating winner forms, distributing forms to appropriate control rooms, making prizes available for winners in an efficient manner for front desk pick up.
  • Ensure complete integrity of prize distribution process, maintain winner files, and keep these records.
  • Assist with writing Official Rules for all contests to be distributed to Program Directors, Air Talent, Reception, and Sales Management
  • Create and maintain records of performance for all remotes, station events, promotional and liner announcements, and other station activities in the specific Promotional File
  • Copy writing of promotional spots and translation of documents such as commercial copy, letters, as needed
  • Assist with on-site Promotional activities including set up, tables, banner placement, inflatables, tents, P.A. systems and other promotional displays
  • Maintain, organize, and perform routine inventory of all promotional remote and station equipment.
  • Ability to create basic presentations and proposals for sales and promotions
  • Will aid in the development and production of promotional content in Spanish for news and commercials including TV, radio, digital and local events.
  • Production knowledge desired - ability to provide technical production and promotional support for live broadcasts, news and commercials productions including TV, radio, digital and local events.
  • Most importantly, the perfect candidate should have good attitude, be proactive and work well in a fast-paced deadline driven environment.
  • Other duties as deemed necessary.

 

REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE:

  • Must be able to work evenings, weekends, and holidays
  • Ability to implement station promotions
  • Proficient with MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook and able to learn project specific software
  • Must have excellent organizational skills and able to work with tight deadlines
  • Bilingual (English/Spanish - written and spoken)
  • Must be able to drive and have a valid Florida driver’s license with a good driving record

 

DESIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE:

  • High School Diploma or GED and Prior Experience in similar position desired
  • Basic Knowledge of Adobe CC Suite and studio/field production environment experience
  • Knowledge of social media, posting applications
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and on multiple tasks simultaneously

 

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally required to stand; walk; sit; use hands to handle or feel objects; reach with hands and arms; climb stairs; balance; stoop, kneel or crouch. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds.   Must be able to drive a Company vehicle.

 

ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS:

  • Must be 18 years of age or older.
  • Employment/education will be verified.
  • Must be willing to work from locations in FL, fully onsite, remote, and/or hybrid.
  • Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.

job.title: Analyst, Privacy Operations
job.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE & TEAM:


The TU Legal team is looking for a Privacy Operations Analyst to join our team.

TelevisaUnivision is committed to embedding privacy by design into our products and building a world-class privacy team to enable our business strategy. In accordance with privacy laws and regulations internationally, TelevisaUnivision’s Privacy Team is responsible for helping to ensure compliance with applicable legal requirements, including honoring individual privacy rights requests and providing appropriate opt out or other consent mechanisms for the sale or sharing of personal data. The role will report into the Law, Policy and Integrity team and will work closely with engineering and product teams across TelevisaUnivision.


ABOUT YOU: 

A successful candidate will have proven experience supporting privacy operations, including individual privacy rights, consent management, and data requests. The role will interface directly with legal, business, product, and engineering teams, requiring strong organizational and technology skills. Experience with privacy management platforms, including but not limited to OneTrust, and translating legal requirements into operational processes is strongly preferred.


YOUR DAY-TO-DAY: (aka Responsibilities)

  • Document and optimize the company’s Privacy Operations processes, such as individual requests, including step-by-step process flows, e-mail templates, and response timelines
  • Manage Privacy Operations platforms and tooling, including but not limited to OneTrust, that implement access, deletion, opt-out, and consent
  • Review, triage, and respond to internal and external inquiries, such as those received via email and in tickets
  • Maintain and update inventory of the company’s data partners and contracts involving the handling of personal data
  • Serve as liaison between Legal and Technical teams handling Privacy Operations, including translating legal requirements into technical classifications for data, processes, and tools
  • Ensure timely handling of all individual requests, and approving/processing or rejecting each request in accordance with laws, deadlines, and internal processes
  • Partner with business and technical owners to implement changes necessary to comply with privacy law, such as access, deletion, opt-out, and consent
  • Prepare weekly/monthly reports
  • Partner with legal resources to understand various requirements and the global privacy landscape
  • Research options for automating and/or streamlining compliance tasks, including leveraging technology tools
  • Maintain and enhance playbooks and contract templates
  • Serve as a liaison between Legal and Procurement teams, on the one hand, and external vendors and other business partners, on the other hand, to update data provisions of contracts.
  • Assist with other privacy-related tasks, such as data inventory, discovery, or mapping

 

YOU HAVE: (aka Qualifications)

  • Bachelor’s degree or comparable experience in Cybersecurity, Information Security, Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology or related field
  •  1-2 years of professional experience in data privacy, security risk management, or compliance
  • IAPP certification such CIPM or CIPT is preferred
  • Strong project management skills, project planning methodologies
  • Experience in managing digital platforms
  • Experience with Privacy Operations platforms, such as OneTrust, TrustArc, ServiceNow, Ethyca, DataGrail, Osano, or Ketch
  • General knowledge of compliance processes
  • Fluent in English/Spanish

 

 

BENEFITS:

TelevisaUnivision believes that a happy, well-balanced employee is what makes our culture thrive. We offer a wide selection of perks and benefits including PTO; tuition reimbursement; wellness and employee support programs; 401K; and life and other insurance plans. This is all in addition to our comprehensive and competitive health benefits package featuring medical, dental and vision coverage options.

job.title: Assignment Desk Editor & Producer
job.description:
TelevisaUnivision Austin and Antonio is looking for a dynamic, competitive and creative Assignment Editor/Producer to join our Austin and San Antonio newsrooms.

This role is central to shaping our daily news coverage. The Assignment Editor/Producer is responsible for identifying and developing high-impact stories, managing day-to-day coverage and field logistics, helping lead editorial decisions, and producing compelling newscasts across platforms.

The ideal candidate has a strong sense of journalistic urgency and can quickly recognize the stories that matter most to our communities and have the greatest potential to drive audience interest. This person must know how to aggressively advance those stories, deploy resources strategically, anticipate what is needed to meet deadline and continuously look for ways to make our coverage stronger and more competitive.

This role requires someone who brings a competitive mindset and strong editorial leadership to the newsroom. The Assignment Editor/Producer should come to editorial meetings informed and prepared to help establish the direction of the news day, while fostering creative discussion that strengthens story angles and differentiates our coverage from competitors.

The ideal candidate must also clearly communicate the editorial vision and priorities to reporters, photographers, producers and other newsroom teams while remaining collaborative and open to ideas that may strengthen or change the original coverage plan.

Strong visual storytelling is also essential. This person should consistently look for creative ways to showcase stories, strengthen newscast presentation and make our journalism more engaging across broadcast, digital and social platforms.

The Assignment Editor/Producer will source and verify content through traditional reporting methods, community contacts, scanners, newsroom feeds and social media platforms; coordinate breaking news and planned coverage; field produce when necessary; and perform other duties as directed by News Management.


YOUR DAY-DAY:

  • Identify, research, develop, write and produce stories for broadcast and digital platforms.
  • Demonstrate strong journalistic urgency, quickly recognizing high-impact and audience-relevant stories and ensuring they are aggressively pursued and advanced before deadline.
  • Help lead editorial meetings by coming prepared and informed, establishing priorities and helping define the direction of the news day and upcoming newscasts.
  • Drive creative editorial conversations that identify stronger angles, unanswered questions, follow-ups and opportunities to distinguish our coverage from competitors.
  • Clearly communicate editorial priorities, coverage goals and expectations to reporters, photographers, producers and other newsroom teams.
  • Remain flexible during the editorial process and adjust coverage plans when new information or team discussion identifies a stronger direction.
  • Maintain strong competitive awareness, monitoring other news organizations and identifying opportunities to advance stories beyond what competitors are reporting.
  • Assign stories and provide crews with the information, contacts, context and expectations necessary to successfully execute coverage.
  • Monitor scanners, newsroom feeds, wire services, social media and other breaking-news sources to quickly identify developing stories and determine when immediate newsroom action is needed.
  • Monitor breaking news and understand how local, state and federal agencies communicate information across traditional and digital platforms.
  • Make timely decisions regarding deployment of crews and newsroom resources as stories develop.
  • Coordinate interviews, breaking-news logistics, future coverage and priority events.
  • Maintain constant and clear communication with producers, field crews, newsroom managers and outside agencies while obtaining and confirming information.
  • Line produce newscasts as assigned.
  • Use strong visual creativity to showcase stories through video, graphics, live elements, sound, reporter involvement and other production tools.
  • Contribute to story placement, teases, graphics, writing, timing and other editorial and production elements.
  • Work closely with reporters to conceptualize, develop and strengthen story packages while ensuring they meet station standards and editorial expectations.
  • Source, verify and develop potential stories from social media and digital platforms, including Facebook, Instagram, X, Reddit and emerging platforms.
  • Serve as a bridge between the newsroom and digital team, ensuring timely communication of developing stories, confirmed information, key elements and available content to support digital coverage across platforms.
  • Engage with viewers and community sources to identify potential stories and develop newsroom contacts.
  • Capture incoming video feeds and assist with newsroom coordination and troubleshooting when necessary.
  • Plan ahead for developing stories and future coverage while maintaining awareness of immediate newsroom priorities.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

 

YOU HAVE:

  • Strong news judgment and the ability to quickly identify which stories deserve priority, resources and aggressive follow-up.
  • A demonstrated sense of journalistic urgency and ability to manage breaking news and multiple deadlines simultaneously.
  • A competitive mindset and desire to advance stories, develop distinctive angles and strengthen coverage beyond what competitors are reporting.
  • Strong editorial leadership skills and the confidence to help lead a newsroom through a developing news day.
  • Ability to lead productive editorial meetings, communicate a clear vision and encourage collaborative discussion and creative thinking.
  • Strong visual storytelling instincts and the ability to identify creative ways to showcase content within a newscast.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in both English and Spanish.
  • High ethical and journalistic standards.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to make decisions quickly and calmly in a fast-paced newsroom environment.
  • Ability to receive feedback, adapt and continuously improve.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with reporters, photographers, producers, anchors, digital teams and newsroom leadership.
  • Strong understanding of the Hispanic community and the issues, interests and stories that affect our audience.
  • Ability to identify, verify and develop strong content originating from social media and digital sources.
  • Experience monitoring scanners, newsroom feeds, wire services and other breaking-news sources, with the ability to recognize developing stories and act with urgency.
  • Proficiency with newsroom computer systems and software, including iNews, Microsoft Word, Excel and Outlook.
  • Familiarity with video systems, incoming news feeds and non-linear editing tools.
  • Ability to work flexible hours, including early mornings, overnights, weekends and holidays.

 

DESIRED SKILL & EXPERIENCE:

  • BA/BS in Journalism, Mass Communications or related field preferred, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Minimum two years of newsroom experience as a producer, assignment editor or similar editorial role, preferably in a medium-to-large market.
  • Proven ability to develop and execute compelling newscasts and showcase major stories.
  • Experience helping lead editorial discussions and coordinating daily newsroom coverage.
  • Proven ability to identify and advance breaking, developing and enterprise stories.
  • Strong understanding of digital and social media strategies and audience behavior.
  • Demonstrated ability to work across broadcast and digital teams to ensure important information and content move quickly between platforms.
  • Strong communication, organizational and leadership skills.

 

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Ability to stand, walk, bend, type, edit, reach and sit for up to (8) hours

 

OUR BENEFITS:

TelevisaUnivision believes that a happy, well-balanced employee is what makes our culture thrive. We offer a wide selection of perks and benefits including PTO; tuition reimbursement; wellness and employee support programs; 401K; and life and other insurance plans. This is all in addition to our comprehensive and competitive health benefits package featuring medical, dental and vision coverage options.

Apply on-line at TelevisaUnivision’s career page:https://corporate.televisaunivision.com/careers/

job.title: Chofer de Dirección General, Santa Fe
job.description:
Título: Chofer de Dirección General

Ubicación: Ciudad de México, Santa Fe


Acerca del puesto y el equipo

Forma parte del equipo de TelevisaUnivision, la empresa líder en el mundo de medios y contenido en español, TelevisaUnivision cuenta con la más extensa videoteca de contenido propio y es líder en capacidad de producción en el sector, lo que impulsa su contenido digital de streaming, televisión tradicional y plataformas de radio.

 

Somos una empresa vibrante con más de 10,000 colaboradores en México, Colombia y EE. UU, nos une la pasión por el entretenimiento, la creatividad y los grandes hitos. en TelevisaUnivision encontrarás un ambiente amigable y lleno de equidad para crecer personal y profesionalmente.

 

¡Únete y se parte de este gran equipo dinámico!

 

TelevisaUnivision está en búsqueda de un Chofer para el área de Dirección General

 

El área de Dirección General se encarga de liderar y definir la estrategia global de la empresa, estableciendo objetivos y políticas que guían su funcionamiento. Sus responsabilidades incluyen tomar decisiones clave, gestionar recursos, supervisar el desempeño y garantizar que la organización cumpla con su misión y visión, impulsando su crecimiento y éxito a largo plazo.

 

Sobre ti:

Profesionalismo, discreción, excelente manejo de vehículos, puntualidad, buena presentación personal y habilidades de comunicación, así como capacidad para mantener la confidencialidad y manejar situaciones imprevistas con cortesía y amabilidad.


Tu día a día:

  • Transportar al ejecutivo a diferentes destinos, asegurando su seguridad y comodidad en todo momento.
  • Realizar revisiones periódicas del vehículo para asegurar su buen funcionamiento y mantenerlo limpio y en buen estado.
  • Planificar las rutas más eficientes para llegar a los destinos de manera oportuna y evitando congestiones.
  • Mantener una comunicación clara y respetuosa con el Ejecutivo.
  • Estar disponible para trabajar en horarios flexibles, incluyendo fines de semana y feriados, según sea necesario.

 

Tu deberás tener:

  • Licencia de conducir vigente y sin restricciones.
  • Tener al menos 5 años de experiencia como chofer.
  • Conocer las leyes de tránsito y las rutas principales de la ciudad.
  • Tener habilidades de comunicación efectivas y ser capaz de interactuar con personas de alto nivel.
  • Mantener la confidencialidad y discreción en todo momento.

Beneficios:

En TelevisaUnivision, valoramos el bienestar integral de nuestros empleados. Creemos que un equilibrio saludable entre la vida personal y profesional es fundamental para el éxito. Por eso, ofrecemos: Beneficios de ley y Beneficios superiores que superan los requisitos legales. Nuestro objetivo es crear un entorno laboral que fomente la productividad, la creatividad y el crecimiento personal y profesional.


Nuestro compromiso con la inclusión

TelevisaUnivision es un empleador que ofrece igualdad de oportunidades. Todos los solicitantes calificados serán considerados para el empleo sin distinción de sexo, identidad de género, orientación sexual, raza, color, religión, nacionalidad, discapacidad, edad o cualquier otra característica protegida por la ley.

job.title: Editor & Photographer
job.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE & TEAM:


News Department at Univision Chicago is looking for a Photographer/editor to join our team!


Univision Chicago, has an immediate opening for a full-time photographer/editor.  This position will be responsible for shooting and editing for the station’s newscasts.  Responsibilities include, but are not limited to: shooting, editing, daily newsgathering, and reporting as well as appearances at community and station events in a fast-paced, extremely competitive market.


ABOUT YOU:

Our photographers work hand in hand with reporters and producers. They produce and report news stories using non-linear editing equipment, camaras, phones, gopro and related broadcasting equipment and newsroom computer systems. We are looking for a passionate storyteller. Willing to work in a deadline driven environment.

 

YOUR DAY-DAY: (aka Responsibilities)

•Go to news sites in all types of weather and capture newsworthy events as they happen.

•Be able to work closely with our Reporters to produce compelling, significant stories.

•Editing video for daily news coverage, special projects, and sweep period pieces using Adobe Premiere and other non-linear editing software

•Taking in news feeds from news bureaus and various news organizations

•Collaborating with anchors, reporters, and producers on video elements of newscasts

•Meeting daily deadlines in a high-energy working environment

•Covering specialized consumer content, day-to-day news stories and long-term assignments

•Maintain assigned photography gear and vehicles and operate in a safe manner

•Work well with P2 and XD cameras to shoot interviews and general footage.

•Establish a good working-relationship with newscast producers and co-anchors to ensure a well-paced, accurate and informative broadcast.

•Must be a strong and fast writer and have solid news judgment as a Producer.

•Attend and participate in off-site company-sponsored and community events as assigned by station management.



YOU HAVE: (aka Qualifications)


Required Skills & Experience

•Technical/College School degree and 2 years’ college preferred, but may consider 2 years’ experience in lieu of degree if all qualifications are met

•Bilingual English/Spanish communication skills both written and oral

•A thorough knowledge of all ENG practices is required.

•Must have working knowledge of television news photography and technology

•Must be able to shoot with P2 and XD Cameras, and edit under deadline pressure

•Be able to lift and carry broadcast video equipment (approximately 45 pounds), and have manual dexterity in use of keyboard, video editing equipment (linear and non-linear) video machines, server-based video editing and playback systems and other broadcast equipment. Avid and Adobe CS Suite required

•Must have and maintain a good driving record and a valid driver’s license, along with the ability to drive daily

•Personal computer experience required, including non-linear editing equipment


Desired Skills & Experience

•BA/BS preferred in Journalism/Mass Communications or equivalent experience in broadcast news experience in Spanish language broadcasting as reporter or photographer/editor

•Needs to be able to work on tight deadlines, with a reporter or independently

•Able to improvise when situation warrants

•Valid driver’s license and clean driving record

•Familiar with the Chicago area

•Skills to be a problem solver

•Creative with strong sense of community involvement for unique story ideas

•Must be able to work flexible hours, including weekends and holidays

•Must be able to multi-task, work well under extreme pressure, and communicate effectively


Physical Requirements

•Ability to lift and carry up to 50 pounds


Eligibility Requirements

•Must be willing to work from office in Chicago, IL

•Employment/education will be verified

•Must have unrestricted authorization to work in the United States


OUR BENEFITS:

TelevisaUnivision believes that a happy, well-balanced employee is what makes our culture thrive. We offer a wide selection of perks and benefits including PTO; tuition reimbursement; wellness and employee support programs; 401K; and life and other insurance plans. This is all in addition to our comprehensive and competitive health benefits package featuring medical, dental and vision coverage options.


*This position will require the employee to be a member or join NABET-CWA


Salary - $52,885.91 to $75,543.40


#LI-ONSITE (for 100% onsite requirement)


TelevisaUnivision is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to characteristics protected by law.

job.title: Editor and Photographer
job.description:
Univision Local Media San Antonio is seeking Editor & Photographer to shoot news and other events for TV productions, both live and recorded. Edit material to script using non-linear, computer-based editing software from our facility, or via field ENG equipment from remote locations.

 

YOUR DAY-DAY:

equipment.

closely with producers, assignment desk editors, video editors and chief photographer.

contact with the public, as well as local, state and federal officials.

• Must be able to lift and carry broadcast video equipment (approximately 50 pounds)

job.title: Finance Manager, Digital, Record to Report
job.description:
TelevisaUnivision is seeking a highly motivated Manager, Record to Report (Digital) to support the Digital Finance organization. This role is responsible for overseeing key accounting activities related to the monthly close process, general ledger management, account reconciliations, and financial reporting for the Digital business. The position partners closely with Digital Finance leadership to ensure accurate and timely financial results while driving process improvements, maintaining strong internal controls, and leading a team of accounting professionals. The position reports to the Vice President, Record to Report.

ABOUT YOU:

You are a collaborative and detail-oriented accounting professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment. You excel at managing competing priorities, solving complex problems, and partnering with leaders across the organization to deliver accurate financial results, strengthen internal controls, and drive continuous process improvements. You are an effective communicator and team player who can build strong relationships and lead accounting professionals to achieve shared goals.

YOUR DAY-DAY: (aka Responsibilities)

Financial Close and Reporting

  • Oversee the monthly, quarterly, and annual close processes to ensure timely and accurate financial reporting.
  • Review and approve journal entries, ensuring compliance with company accounting policies and close calendar deadlines.
  • Review account reconciliations and ensure they are prepared, reviewed, and certified in accordance with company policies and internal control requirements.
  • Prepare and review quarterly flux analysis packages, providing meaningful explanations of financial results and variances.
  • Partner with the Digital CFO and Finance team to ensure the accuracy and integrity of financial statements.

Accounting and General Ledger Management

  • Manage day-to-day general ledger activities for the Digital business.
  • Ensure compliance with U.S. GAAP, company accounting policies, and internal control requirements.
  • Oversee accounting for specialized contractual arrangements and obligations.
  • Review accounting treatment related to digital content licensing, produced content, programming rights, obligations, and related cash flow schedules.
  • Interpret and analyze contracts to determine appropriate accounting treatment and financial impact.
  • Lead Oracle ERP Record-to-Report processes, including financial consolidations, allocations, data interfaces, journal posting, period open/close activities, foreign currency exchange rate maintenance, revaluation and translation processes, cash management, subledger-to-ledger reconciliations, intercompany accounting, and governance of cross-validation rules to ensure accurate and compliant financial reporting.

Team Leadership and Process Improvement

  • Lead, develop, and mentor accounting staff, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Monitor team performance and service levels, identifying opportunities to improve efficiency and effectiveness.
  • Escalate significant issues, disputes, and risks to management in a timely manner.
  • Maintain and enhance accounting procedures, process documentation, and internal controls.
  • Collaborate with Enterprise Technology Services (ETS) and cross-functional stakeholders to identify and implement process and system improvements.

Audit and Compliance

  • Coordinate and support internal and external audit requests, ensuring timely delivery of required documentation and analysis.
  • Assist in maintaining compliance with SOX and internal control requirements.
  • Ensure supporting documentation is complete, accurate, and audit-ready.

Projects and Initiatives

  • Support system implementations, integrations, and other finance transformation initiatives.
  • Participate in special projects and ad hoc analyses as requested by Finance leadership.
  • Drive automation and standardization efforts to improve the efficiency of Record-to-Report processes.

YOU HAVE: (aka Qualifications)

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting
  • 5+ yrs. accounting experience
  • Strong PC Skills with moderate knowledge of Excel
  • Certified Public Accountant is a plus
  • Ability to speak/write/understand Spanish is preferred.
  • Ability to work flexible hours, as there will be work weeks that require more than 40 hours to ensure the Company’s reporting requirements are met.

New Jersey Salary Range: $90,000 - $110,000.Salary ranges for other locations may differ based on local market conditions and candidate qualifications

OUR BENEFITS:

TelevisaUnivision believes that a happy, well-balanced employee is what makes our culture thrive. We offer a wide selection of perks and benefits including PTO; tuition reimbursement; wellness and employee support programs; 401K; and life and other insurance plans. This is all in addition to our comprehensive and competitive health benefits package featuring medical, dental and vision coverage options.

TelevisaUnivision is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to characteristics protected by law.

job.title: Graphics Operator
job.description:
Production Operations at Televisa Univision is looking for a Graphics Operator to join our team!

Responsibilities include playing back graphics for live and pre-produced shows and working closely with show producers, graphic artists and production staff. The Graphics Operator will report to the Production Manager.

 

YOUR DAY-DAY: (aka Responsibilities)

  • Cue and trigger graphic elements such as name and location lower thirds, boxes, full screens and wall graphics
  • Along with a strong technical background, the Graphics Operator must be alert, fast paced and able to work productively under high pressure situations
  • Be highly organized and able to work closely with show producers, graphic artists and production staff
  • Knowledge of iNews and basic computer skills (i.e. Microsoft Office and Outlook)
  • Knowledge of Vizrt Graphic System is preferred

 

 

YOU HAVE: (aka Qualifications)

  • Minimum Associates Degree or equivalent college degree
  • Minimum 2-years’ experience on live shows
  • Bi-lingual (English and Spanish) required
  • Must have a working knowledge of control room workflows, basic GFX formats and execution
  • Able to perform many different duties, often changing from one task to another of a different nature without loss of efficiency or composure
  • Strong knowledge and understanding of broadcast and production technology
  • Interpersonal and professional communication skills

job.title: Ingeniero de Respuesta a Incidentes SOC, Threat Hunting, CTI y Análisis
job.description:
Título: Ingeniero de Respuesta a Incidentes, Threat Hunting, CTI y Análisis Forense

Ubicación: Santa Fe, Ciudad de México

Acerca del puesto y el equipo

Forma parte del equipo de Ciberseguridad de TelevisaUnivision, contribuyendo directamente a fortalecer las capacidades de ciberdefensa y la resiliencia de la organización frente a amenazas e incidentes de seguridad.

Buscamos un perfil técnico especializado en Incident Response, Threat Hunting, Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI) y análisis forense digital, capaz de participar en incidentes de alta criticidad, investigar amenazas avanzadas y transformar los hallazgos obtenidos en mejoras concretas para las capacidades de detección y respuesta.

Esta posición tendrá interacción directa con el SOC, equipos de respuesta a incidentes, Tecnologías de la Información y usuarios internos, además de especialistas externos de seguridad.

 

Sobre ti

Serás un referente técnico dentro de la respuesta a incidentes de ciberseguridad, participando activamente en la investigación, contención, erradicación y recuperación ante amenazas.

Tu responsabilidad será ayudar a reducir el tiempo de permanencia de los atacantes, preservar evidencia digital y determinar la causa raíz y alcance de los incidentes.

Además, utilizarás inteligencia de amenazas, threat hunting y las lecciones aprendidas de cada incidente para fortalecer continuamente las capacidades de detección y respuesta de la organización.

 

Tu día a día

• Producir y difundir Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI) táctica, operativa y estratégica sobre actores, campañas y TTPs relevantes para la organización.

• Diseñar y ejecutar campañas de Threat Hunting basadas en hipótesis, alineadas al framework MITRE ATT&CK, cubriendo endpoints, identidad, red, nube y correo electrónico.

• Transformar hallazgos derivados de threat hunting e inteligencia en nuevas capacidades y reglas de detección en producción.

• Ejecutar investigaciones de análisis forense digital, incluyendo adquisición y preservación de evidencia y análisis de disco, memoria, red, logs y ambientes cloud.

• Determinar causa raíz, alcance, vector inicial e impacto de incidentes de seguridad.

• Realizar análisis de malware estático y dinámico en ambientes controlados para identificar indicadores, capacidades y comportamientos maliciosos.

• Brindar soporte técnico especializado en incidentes de alta criticidad, apoyando directamente en las etapas de contención, erradicación y recuperación.

• Elaborar reportes forenses e informes de incidentes con profundidad técnica y claridad ejecutiva para Dirección, Auditoría, áreas Legales y, cuando corresponda, requerimientos regulatorios.

• Conducir revisiones de lecciones aprendidas y dar seguimiento a las acciones correctivas derivadas de los incidentes.

• Evolucionar las capacidades del SOC mediante la actualización de playbooks, automatización, ejercicios Tabletop y evaluación de nuevas herramientas, tendencias y amenazas emergentes, incluidas aquellas potenciadas por IA.

 

Perfil que buscamos

Buscamos un profesional de ciberseguridad con experiencia técnica en investigación y respuesta a incidentes, con capacidad para analizar situaciones complejas y tomar decisiones técnicas bajo presión.

Conocimientos clave

• Incident Response
• Threat Hunting
• Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI)
• Digital Forensics / DFIR
• Malware Analysis
• MITRE ATT&CK
• Análisis de endpoints, redes, identidad, correo y cloud
• Análisis de logs y evidencia digital
• Desarrollo y optimización de capacidades de detección
• Manejo de indicadores de compromiso (IoCs) y TTPs
• Procesos y operación de SOC
• Desarrollo y mejora de playbooks de respuesta
• Automatización aplicada a ciberseguridad
• Investigación de amenazas y actores maliciosos

 

 

Competencias / Habilidades

• Pensamiento analítico y capacidad de investigación
• Resolución de problemas complejos
• Capacidad para tomar decisiones técnicas bajo presión
• Comunicación clara con audiencias técnicas y ejecutivas
• Organización y documentación rigurosa
• Orientación a resultados
• Trabajo colaborativo
• Capacidad de aprendizaje continuo
• Atención al detalle
• Manejo adecuado de información sensible

 

Responsabilidades críticas del rol

La posición deberá tener capacidad para intervenir directamente ante incidentes críticos y trabajar de manera coordinada con los diferentes equipos involucrados en la respuesta.

Será responsable de convertir la información obtenida durante incidentes, investigaciones forenses, análisis de malware y campañas de threat hunting en acciones concretas que fortalezcan las capacidades preventivas y de detección de la organización.

Asimismo, deberá contribuir a la evolución continua del SOC mediante inteligencia de amenazas, nuevas detecciones, automatización y actualización de procedimientos de respuesta.

 

Principales relaciones

Internas:
• Miembros del SOC
• Equipo de Respuesta a Incidentes
• Equipos de Tecnologías de la Información
• Usuarios que reporten o presenten eventos de seguridad

Externas:
• Consultores y especialistas de seguridad

 

Beneficios

Ofrecemos la oportunidad de participar en un entorno de ciberseguridad de alta complejidad, trabajando con incidentes, amenazas y tecnologías relevantes para una organización de gran escala.

La posición brinda exposición a diferentes áreas de seguridad y oportunidades de desarrollo técnico en Threat Hunting, CTI, DFIR, Incident Response y evolución de capacidades SOC.

Incluye prestaciones de ley y beneficios adicionales.

 

Nuestro compromiso con la inclusión

TelevisaUnivision promueve un entorno de trabajo basado en la igualdad de oportunidades y la inclusión. Las personas candidatas serán consideradas con base en su experiencia, conocimientos y competencias para la posición.

Univision es un empleador que ofrece equidad e igualdad de oportunidades. Todos los solicitantes calificados recibirán consideración para el empleo sin distinción de sexo, identidad de género, orientación sexual, raza, color, religión, origen nacional, discapacidad, estado de veterano protegido, edad o cualquier otra característica protegida por la ley.

job.title: Manager, Payments
job.description:
¡TelevisaUnivision es la compañía líder de medios en español a nivel mundial! Estamos invirtiendo en nuestro contenido, nuestra gente y nuestras plataformas digitales, de streaming, sociales, audio, televisión lineal y eventos en vivo. A medida que continuamos impulsando el crecimiento de nuestra plataforma global de streaming, ViX, ofrecer experiencias de pago confiables y sin fricciones es fundamental para respaldar nuestro negocio de suscripciones y la experiencia de nuestros usuarios.

 

El equipo de ViX está buscando un Gerente de Pagos responsable de gestionar las relaciones con proveedores de pago, monitorear el desempeño de pagos y apoyar la optimización continua de nuestro ecosistema de pagos digitales.

 

Esta posición trabajará de manera cercana con los equipos de Producto, Customer Care, Finanzas/Administración, Legal y otras áreas para apoyar integraciones de pago, prevención de fraude, optimización de flujos transaccionales y las operaciones diarias relacionadas con pagos. El Gerente de Pagos monitoreará indicadores clave de desempeño, identificará problemas y oportunidades, y trabajará con equipos internos y socios externos para incrementar las tasas de aprobación y reducir la fricción en la experiencia del usuario.

 

TU DÍA A DÍA: (Responsabilidades)

·      Gestionar y mantener relaciones sólidas con proveedores de servicios de pago, adquirentes, procesadores y otros socios de pago.

·      Monitorear el desempeño de pagos, incluyendo tasas de aprobación, disponibilidad, fraude, costos, contracargos y otros KPIs relevantes.

·      Identificar proactivamente problemas y oportunidades relacionados con el desempeño de pagos y coordinar las acciones correctivas correspondientes.

·      Escalar y resolver incidencias operativas con proveedores de pago, minimizando el impacto para los usuarios y el negocio.

·      Participar en la evaluación de nuevos proveedores, tecnologías y soluciones de pago de acuerdo con las necesidades del negocio.

·      Supervisar disputas y contracargos, coordinando con proveedores de pago y equipos internos para minimizar su impacto.

·      Preparar y presentar reportes periódicos sobre el desempeño de pagos e información relevante a stakeholders internos.

·      Colaborar estrechamente con los equipos de Producto y Tecnología para apoyar integraciones e iniciativas de pago.

·      Revisar las reglas de prevención de fraude junto con Producto y realizar los ajustes correspondientes cuando sea necesario.

·      Apoyar la optimización continua de los flujos transaccionales, incluyendo checkout, reintentos de pago y enrutamiento de transacciones, para maximizar las tasas de aprobación y minimizar la fricción para el usuario.

·      Colaborar con Customer Care, Finanzas/Administración, Legal y otras áreas para apoyar los requerimientos operativos relacionados con pagos.

·      Asegurar que los contratos con proveedores de pago y las certificaciones regulatorias aplicables se mantengan actualizados.

·      Identificar oportunidades para mejorar procesos, herramientas y flujos operativos relacionados con pagos.

·      Desarrollar y apoyar iniciativas enfocadas en incrementar las tasas de aprobación y mejorar la experiencia de pago del usuario.

·      Mantener actualizada la documentación de los principales procesos y procedimientos relacionados con pagos.

 

TÚ TIENES: (Habilidades, Calificaciones y Experiencia Requeridas)

·      Más de 8 años de experiencia en pagos, fintech, e-commerce, medios digitales, streaming o áreas relacionadas, idealmente incluyendo al menos 2 años en posiciones de liderazgo.

·      Experiencia comprobada gestionando relaciones con proveedores de servicios de pago (PSPs), adquirentes y procesadores.

·      Experiencia trabajando estrechamente con equipos de Producto y Tecnología en integraciones de pago e iniciativas de prevención de fraude.

·      Sólido conocimiento del ecosistema de pagos digitales, incluyendo tarjetas, métodos alternativos de pago, wallets digitales y métodos de pago locales en Latinoamérica.

·      Conocimiento sólido de métricas clave de pagos, incluyendo tasa de aprobación, tasa de contracargos, tasa de fraude y costo por transacción.

·      Fuertes habilidades analíticas y capacidad para interpretar datos, identificar tendencias y problemas, y traducir los hallazgos en acciones concretas.

·      Fuertes habilidades de negociación y gestión de relaciones con terceros.

·      Excelentes habilidades de comunicación y capacidad para presentar resultados y recomendaciones a diferentes niveles de la organización.

·      Capacidad para trabajar de manera autónoma, asumir responsabilidad y adaptarse rápidamente a procesos y sistemas existentes.

·      Experiencia en streaming, servicios de suscripción o modelos de pagos recurrentes es deseable.

·      Inglés avanzado requerido.

 

REQUISITOS DE ELEGIBILIDAD

·      Disponibilidad para trabajar en Ciudad de México.

·      Se verificará la experiencia laboral y educación.

Univision es un empleador que ofrece equidad e igualdad de oportunidades. Todos los solicitantes calificados recibirán consideración para el empleo sin distinción de sexo, identidad de género, orientación sexual, raza, color, religión, origen nacional, discapacidad, estado de veterano protegido, edad o cualquier otra característica protegida por la ley.

job.title: Multimedia Journalist
job.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE & TEAM:

The News Department at TelevisaUnivision is looking for a Multimedia Journalist to join our team! The

successful candidate should be proud of the commitment of serving our local community.

In this hybrid role, you will support the Performance Media Sales team by managing key components of linear and digital media strategy, campaign execution, and client servicing from pre-sale through post-sale.

You bring a strong foundation in linear and digital marketing and campaign operations, ideally from a digital publisher, media agency, or content platform. You're not only great with numbers and media math, but also collaborative and solutions-driven with an eye for detail. This position requires the ability to juggle multiple projects in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment, and to build strong relationships with both internal teams and external partners.

You will report to the  Performance Account Executives and partner closely with senior sales executives.

job.title: Sales Operations Analyst
job.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE AND TEAM

TelevisaUnivision is the leading Spanish-language media company in the world! We’re investing in our content, our people, and our properties, which span digital, streaming, social, audio, linear and live events. We’re growing our offerings, building on the recent launch of our successful streaming platform, ViX. We were the fastest growing major media company in the U.S.


The Sales Operations Analyst supports the management, analysis, and optimization of linear advertising inventory across the portfolio. Working closely with Planning, Sales, Programming, Traffic, and other internal partners, the Analyst helps ensure inventory is accurately maintained, effectively utilized, and aligned with revenue and client-delivery objectives. The role combines day-to-day inventory management with analytical problem solving and will increasingly leverage AI, automation, and data-driven tools to identify inventory risks, recommend actions, and improve yield.


ABOUT YOU

The successful Sales Operations Analyst will move beyond simply reporting on inventory conditions to understanding why they exist and recommend what the business should do about them. Over time, as reporting and transactional work become increasingly automated, the role will place greater emphasis on analysis, exception management, validation of AI-generated recommendations, and improving inventory utilization and yield.

You are an Excel rock star, who enjoys analyzing numbers and data to provide insights into our sales organization. For you, every challenge is an opportunity to find a solution.


YOUR DAY TO DAY

· Monitor inventory availability, capacity, sellout levels, and utilization across networks, dayparts, programs, and high-profile events.

· Identify inventory risks and opportunities and recommend actions to improve utilization, protect revenue, and support client delivery.

· Partner closely with Planning teams to ensure proposals, allocations, stewardship decisions, and inventory changes reflect current availability and business priorities.

· Support management of oversold inventory, preemptions, underdelivery, liability, and other inventory exceptions.

· Analyze supply and demand trends and provide actionable recommendations to Planning and Sales leadership.

· Maintain and validate inventory-related data, including capacities, format grids, ratecards, program information, and other inputs used in planning and inventory systems.

· Support inventory requirements for tentpoles, live sports, and other high-profile programming.

job.title: Scheduling Coordinator
job.description:
TelevisaUnivision is seeking a detail-oriented Scheduling Coordinator to support Noticias 24/7, a News streaming channel on our streaming service, VIX. This position plays an essential role in ensuring the integrity of the streaming service to deliver viewer satisfaction.

The Scheduling Coordinator will accurately schedule content playlists, maintain program calendars, oversee playout, and manage all program data. Additionally, this role contributes to the execution of scheduling strategies and operations, including collaboration in the development of promotional materials, coordinating deliverables between multiple departments, and participating in the evaluation and implementation of workflows and systems.

ABOUT YOU:

The successful candidate will be organized, detail-oriented and deadline-driven, as well as very comfortable learning and using program scheduling and playout systems both on-site and remotely. As this is a 24-hour a day news service, this individual would be on-call to support breaking news or off-hour playlist changes as needed.

YOUR DAY-DAY: (aka Responsibilities)

  • Schedule all long-form programming for streaming news service based on strategic direction from supervisor.
  • Develop fluency in using the scheduling software and executing workflows for a flawless on-air experience.
  • Create, capture, and edit all content metadata in systems as needed.
  • Generate and maintain schedule grids (24 hour and weekly) for internal distribution and on Sharepoint.
  • Help prepare and distribute weekly programming notifications, such as premieres, TV listings and updates.
  • Maintain internal and external distribution lists for programming department.
  • Create, maintain, and set program formats on the grid level as well as live or server events. Review formats on a quarterly basis and make recommendations for revisions as needed to support business objectives.
  • Cutting clips from the programs to create segments for program reruns and preparing clips for social media distribution.
  • Monitor the Network Playout and adjust as needed for breaking news and content issues.
  • Be available on call after hours and weekends as necessary to revise playlist, trigger breaking news or support News team needs.
  • Produce work orders for promotional materials that communicate strategy, objectives and deadlines.
  • Schedule all short form elements including promos, graphics, news briefs and crawls.
  • Execute and track promotional and advertising campaigns for internal and external clients and generate reports (AS-RUNS).
  • Partner with News Production, Art Department, Ad Sales, Marketing, Business Affairs and Content Management.
  • Perform ad-hoc assignments as needed.

YOU HAVE: (aka Qualifications)

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in a broadcast/cable television or digital environment.
  • Minimum 3 years of Program Scheduling, Playlist Management, Media Planning, Promo Scheduling or similar experience
  • Self-starter, resourceful, adaptable and able to work well under pressure and on multiple projects at the same time.
  • Ability to be on-call after regular business hours and weekends.

job.title: Art Director
job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

Job Description

The New York Times Advertising is hiring for an Art Director to join our T Brand Studio. As an Art Director, you will lead the visual execution of assigned projects. Art Directors do the following: they imagine ways to tell stories visually. They present visual ideas and recommendations internally and to our clients. They find visual reference, specifically relevant to each idea, project, and opportunity. They contribute to and oversee the creation of great mood boards, inspired type treatments, exceptional color palettes, and page layouts.

About the Role

You will oversee the design of presentations which enhance our work, the assembly of excellent paid posts in webflow, the design of impactful print ads, and work with developers internal and external on complex custom projects. You will mentor Designers and Senior Designers, and collaborate with external partners, building relationships and guiding them through insightful feedback to create their best work. This is a hybrid role, reporting to the Director, Design. You can typically expect to be in the office 3 days per week.

Responsibilities:

  • Contribute to and oversee excellent design work on client and internal projects, with guidance from Design Directors, and Creative Directors.
  • Translate conceptual and strategic ideas into impactful visual solutions.
  • Contribute creative concepts to client and internal projects, brainstorming with other teams.
  • Design iteratively with an easy command of typography, composition, messaging hierarchy, layout, and other fundamental principles of graphic design, and give pointed feedback to designers which directly improves their work.
  • Research and oversee selection of visual reference that inspires (Design, Page Animation, Illustration, and Photography), and build a mental reference library of styles, approaches, creators, and projects.
  • Manage Designers, delegate work to resourced Designers and Senior Designers based on workload, capabilities, and experience. Contribute to the professional growth of direct reports through mentorship, and feedback.
  • Select, brief, and direct outside collaborators to create their best work.
  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world.

Basic Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of professional work experience in the art industry
  • 5+ years of experience with Adobe Creative Cloud (InDesign, Photoshop, Illustrator, Figma) and modern digital publishing platforms such as Webflow.
  • An experienced creative portfolio demonstrating mastery of design principles - specifically typography, grid systems, layout hierarchy, color theory, and art direction for both digital and print media
  • Experienced managing designers including delegating tasks, giving constructive feedback, and overseeing visual quality.
  • Experience commissioning and directing external creative partners including photographers, illustrators, animators and external development teams
  • Experience presenting visual strategies and creative direction to executive-level clients and company partners.
  • Visual research skills, with a rich, active mental library of contemporary and historical art, design, photography, and interactive digital trends.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Working knowledge of front-end web technologies (HTML/CSS) and an understanding of dynamic layout capabilities, responsive design, and digital motion/animation principles.
  • Experience in luxury, editorial, or prestige brand storytelling, with a deep appreciation for high-end aesthetic stewardship and cultural context.
  • Experience prioritizing competing programs, responsibilities, and projects
  • Experience working in a collaborative design space/team

job.description:

It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

The Data Journalism team is looking for an experienced journalist with editing, management and data analysis skills to serve as an assistant editor. You'll help to run a group of data journalists who collaborate across the newsroom. You'll also advise on analyses conducted elsewhere in the newsroom.

You should be obsessed with detail and rigor, display a knack for lifting stories to the next level and care deeply about developing your colleagues' talents. Collaboration is at the heart of this role; the Data Journalism team works with virtually every other desk in the newsroom. We'll expect you to deftly navigate these partnerships, which require crisp communication, a problem-solving attitude and a dash of diplomacy.

  • Be comfortable working on an unpredictable mix of short, medium and long deadlines

  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world.

  • You will report to the Data Editor, who is based in New York City.

  • Proficiency working with data in Python and/or R, spreadsheets and relational databases

  • Experience leading a data journalism team

  • Experience with, and a preference for, working collaboratively on multidisciplinary teams

  • Experience data-editing in response to major news cycles

job.title: Assistant Editor, Fine Arts
job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

The New York Times Culture desk covers the arts and culture to help people understand the world. Through our reporting, criticism and service journalism, we provide trusted guidance to help people live fuller, more considered lives.

We are seeking an Assistant Editor, Fine Arts to help shape and elevate our coverage of visual art, architecture and design; museums and other art institutions; and auctions, with an eye toward ambitious, distinctive journalism that reaches a broad, curious audience. You should have expertise that will produce stories that lead readers into the boardrooms and the studios of today's cultural influencers and will also develop stories about the intersection of art and new media, including artificial intelligence.

You will work closely with the art discipline editor, critics and reporters to determine coverage, assign, edit and second edit news, features, reviews and visual story forms.

You'll also manage a critic and assign and oversee the work of freelancers. You should have a deep understanding of fine arts and art institutions, strong editing skills across formats and platforms and a track record of guiding world-class journalism.

This is a hybrid position, based in New York City, and includes regular attendance in the office at least four days each week.

Responsibilities:

  • Help identify and prioritize key fine-arts storylines, from breaking news to longer-term investigations, profiles and criticism that illuminate how the arts intersect with politics, power and the broader culture
  • Assign, shape and edit daily art stories, including news, features, criticism, service pieces, visual pieces and enterprise projects
  • Assign and edit news of institutions, including museums, art galleries, auction houses and non-profits, throughout the U.S. and Europe
  • Respond to news events in the art world by assigning and editing timely stories, explainers and off-the-news pieces that give readers essential context and insight
  • Plan and assign advance obituary coverage of notables in art
  • Coordinate with our European cultural editor on coverage of major events including biennales and museum openings
  • Manage and direct the work of at least one critic
  • Assign, schedule and edit freelance reviews for Weekend Arts, including the weekly Galleries section
  • Identify and shape features and profiles for the weekly Arts & Leisure page
  • Collaborate with photo, design, visual and video editors on stories across a variety of formats
  • Help foster a collaborative, inclusive culture on the desk, modeling clear communication, constructive feedback and high editorial standards
  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world
  • You will report to the Art Editor

Basic Qualifications:

  • 7–10 years of editing experience, ideally as an editor in a newsroom
  • Knowledge of and curiosity about visual art
  • A track record of editing a variety of story forms and formats
  • Ability to meet deadlines, juggle multiple stories at once and make sound editorial decisions under pressure
  • Excellent communication and organizational skills, including the ability to manage complex workflows and coordinate across multiple teams

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience supervising or mentoring journalists, including guiding reporters from pitch through publication
  • Experience working closely with visual, audio and video teams on digital storytelling, and a willingness to experiment with new formats
  • Familiarity with Times style, standards and journalistic independence, and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world
  • A demonstrated ability to collaborate across desks and disciplines, building strong working relationships in a large, complex newsroom
  • A passion for expanding the audience for arts coverage and making our journalism accessible, surprising and indispensable to a global readership

job.title: Associate Creative Director, Earned Marketing (Temporary)
job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. In service of that mission, we have a journalism operation that includes thousands of people reporting on the ground from most countries around the world, producing journalism with the independence, accuracy, depth and authority for which The Times is famous.

Marketing plays a key part in extending this journalistic legacy into the future. Our job is to answer the question, “Why is quality journalism worth paying for?” We create award-winning marketing that builds our brand and deepens affinity for our journalistic offering. Above all, we strive to be timely, straightforward and relevant — illustrating in new and creative ways how The New York Times can enrich the lives of our readers.

We are seeking an Associate Creative Director, Earned Activations (Contract) to lead the creative vision for our specific “earned” marketing initiatives. This is a critical leadership role for a creative strategist who can move beyond traditional advertising to produce culturally resonant work that drives organic press and social conversation.

Reporting to the Creative Director, Design, with a dotted line to the Executive Director, Brand Marketing, you will serve as a creative partner to our marketing, editorial, comms, commerce, photo, external agency partners, Games and The Athletic creative teams. You will be responsible for dreaming up and executing ideas that turn the value of our world-class journalism and lifestyle products into shareable experiences. You will focus exclusively on creating a cohesive but distinct earned lens for our core products: News, The Athletic, Games, and Cooking.

We will look to you to bring unexpected, deeply resonant thinking to how we market our journalism, championing creative ideas that can break through the noise of the modern media landscape.

This is a temporary hybrid role based in our New York City headquarters, reporting to the the Creative Director, Design. You can typically expect to come into the office 3 days per week.

Responsibilities:

  • Concept and lead the development of brand-building activations, partnerships, and communications content designed specifically to generate earned media and social sharing.

  • Direct the day-to-day work of a Senior Designer, Earned providing clear conceptual vision to guide projects from strategy to launch. You will oversee the translation of earned media concepts into high-quality design solutions, ensuring that every deliverable—from seeding kits to social assets—upholds The New York Times's rigorous brand standards.

  • Translate marketing strategies into clear, provocative creative directives that excite internal teams and external partners.

  • Develop creative ideas tailored to the unique audiences of our core products, ensuring a cohesive visual and conceptual narrative for News, The Athletic, Games, and Cooking.

  • Create work that natively integrates celebrities, influencers, and culturally noteworthy subscribers to amplify our mission in ways that feel authentic and newsworthy.

  • Guide the creation of "social-first" activations designed to thrive on digital platforms and spark community engagement without relying solely on paid media or editorially motivated social media handles.

  • In partnership with the Director, Creative Strategy and Earned Production and Director, Brand Earned Activations, guide external agency relationships to ensure top-notch quality and brand/product standards are enforced.

  • Work closely with the Executive Director of Brand Activations and Talent to ensure earned ideas align with broader business goals.

  • Act as an ambassador for earned thinking across the organization, engaging the right stakeholders in productive conversations to build alignment.

  • Execute high-concept ideas, balancing quality with the demands of the news cycle.

  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world.

Basic Qualifications:

  • 8+ years of experience in creative leadership, with a heavy focus on earned media, PR-led activations, or non-traditional advertising.

  • A portfolio that demonstrates “work the world talked about”—campaigns that broke through via PR, social trends, or cultural moments.

  • Deep understanding of how to leverage Social, Celebrity, and Influencer ecosystems to drive brand discovery.

  • Experience translating marketing strategies, product roadmaps, and the news cycle into clear creative directives.

  • Service diverse categories across the NYT portfolio, from the rigor of News to the fandom of The Athletic and the community-driven spaces of Games and Cooking.

  • Cultivate trusted relationships across the organization and navigate complex stakeholder dynamics.

  • Operational agility to navigate the time sensitive requirements of earned media while maintaining high standards of craft.

job.title: Associate Creative Director, Events
job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

The New York Times creates original, quality journalism in many forms, from the daily paper to The Daily podcast. Our live events play an important role in this mission, connecting readers to the story and to each other. From flagship convenings like DealBook and Climate Forward to immersive gatherings like Hard Fork Live, New York Times events intrigue, inform and inspire in equal measure.

This is a leadership role for an accomplished creative who can translate the value of world-class journalism into powerful design experiences. You will help bring New York Times journalism to life and create compelling environments for a portfolio of public events and experiences. You will lead creative work that defines both individual events and the overall audience experience across our events portfolio. As part of a cross-disciplinary team, you will shape how audiences experience these moments across every touchpoint, from physical stages to digital screens to marketing assets.

This is a hybrid role based in our New York City headquarters and requires regular in-office attendance three days per week.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead the strategic visual development and art direction for our portfolio of public events and experiences, demonstrating expert knowledge of spatial design, environmental graphics, wayfinding, audience journeys, live audience engagement, and meticulous physical execution.
  • Guide the creative lifecycle of each event—from naming and foundational identity to marketing campaigns, live production, and post-event storytelling.
  • Thoughtfully integrate the design of sponsor support into revenue-generating events, balancing business objectives with an audience experience that reflects the values of our journalism.
  • Art direct video interstitials and live screen graphics, working closely with our Senior Writer for Events to merge narrative outlines with visual storytelling, and collaborating with editors and motion designers to create work that defines the event experience.
  • Work across editorial, events, and marketing to secure resources, navigate live-event production challenges, and steward relationships between editorial priorities and advertising objectives.
  • Oversee the thoughtful documentation of our events, working with photo editors to capture high-quality visual assets that extend the life of the experience and support future programming and partnerships.
  • Manage and mentor a design team dedicated to event projects, cultivating an environment of high-quality execution, continuous learning, and diverse perspectives.
  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world.
  • You will report to the Creative Director for Culture, Communications and Live Experience.

Basic Qualifications:

  • 10+ years of hands-on experience in brand identity, spatial and experiential design, environmental graphics, and live-event production.
  • Experience designing for physical environments, including signage systems, audience wayfinding, and large-scale event graphics.
  • A versatile design portfolio showcasing an experience with layout, typography, and experience handling high-profile editorial content and designing around newsmakers.
  • A strong conceptual understanding of motion design and the ability to think in and direct motion, with considerable experience collaborating with external motion design studios or internal teams to execute graphics for event screens, presentations, and digital platforms.
  • Familiarity with video production workflows and experience directing editors, motion designers, and video teams on larger-scale event productions.
  • Proficiency across contemporary design tools (Figma, Adobe Creative Suite) and presentation software (Google Slides), with a strong understanding of motion workflows and social publishing platforms.
  • B.A., B.S., B.F.A. or M.F.A.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • A track record of effective people management, including creating robust development plans, delivering actionable feedback, and fostering an environment of trust and respect.
  • A high bar of accountability and the ability to navigate the demands of live-event production under tight deadlines.
  • A genuine passion for journalism and a deep curiosity about our work and company—we hope you enjoy reading, watching, and listening to it.

Benefits may include medical, dental and vision benefits, Flexible Spending Accounts (F.S.A.s), a company-matching 401(k) plan, employee stock purchase plan, paid vacation, paid sick days, paid parental leave, tuition reimbursement and professional development programs.

The New York Times Advertising is hiring an Associate Programmatic Sales Director to join our Sales Team. You will join The Times at a very exciting time, as we tap into the enormous programmatic demand for quality audiences and content from our agency and advertiser partners. Success will require an intensity of effort, demonstrated through targeted outreach, pitch meetings, and securing new PMP deals, in partnership with The Times's vertical sales teams. This is a temp position, beginning mid-October, 2026, covering the Programmatic Sales Director.

About the Role

You will grow our programmatic revenue across The New York Times portfolio. Using existing programmatic-buyer relationships is an imperative for success. You will engage with Ad Monetization, Ad Product, and Product Marketing teams to grow our programmatic value proposition and capability awareness in-market. This is a hybrid role, reporting to the VP, Head of Agency Development and Sales Strategy. You can typically expect to be in the office 3 days per week.

Responsibilities:

  • Programmatic Sales Strategy: Develop and execute a plan to secure programmatic deals from PMP spenders who are active in the market along with NYTA-direct accounts, in collaboration with the direct sales team.
  • Full-Funnel Accountability involves overseeing client relationships and revenue outcomes. This oversight occurs before and after PMP creation. To meet client commitments and identify growth opportunities, one must work with Account Management, Ad Operations, and Direct Sales.
  • Industry Expert: You understand agency programmatic needs, determine what KPI's are required for successful PMP outcomes, and recognize how you impact new and prospective advertisers with the NYT audience.
  • Sales Collaboration: Champion all programmatic-related efforts across the sales organization by being the PMP expert for direct sales. This includes leading post-sale account management collaboration and external client engagements.
  • Buyer Relationships: Establish and maintain relationships with agency and advertiser buyers, understanding their marketing goals and applying our suite of programmatic products.
  • Prospecting: Understanding of where programmatic spend is happening in the market and create conversations with net-new NYTA advertisers
  • Tech-Stack Mastery: Understand The New York Times technology stack, to be the first line of defense in supporting troubleshooting deals and addressing obstacles with clients
  • Voice of the Buyer: Represent buyer needs to guide Ad Product roadmap and Product Marketing collateral toward agreement on external demand
  • Campaign Optimization: Collaborate with our teams to ensure campaigns are driving maximum revenue
  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world.

Basic Qualifications:

  • 3+ years experience of the programmatic advertising ecosystem.
  • 2+ years experience programmatic sales
  • Experience meeting sales goals, with a history of building and nurturing high-value programmatic-buyer relationships within the digital media space.
  • Experience applying data to inform strategic decisions, forecast trends, and optimize campaign performance
  • Experience explaining complex programmatic concepts in a clear manner to diverse audiences
  • Experience operating in ambiguity and strategies to keep pace with industry developments.

  • Publisher experience
