job.title: Sr. Creative Recruiter
job.description:
Who We Are

UnitedMasters is building a marketplace that connects artists, brands and fans - empowering over 1.5M artists to earn and grow. UnitedMasters has taken the bold step of building a music distribution service that, radically, puts artists first - disrupting the legacy music business by letting up-and-coming artists distribute their music directly to fans through streaming services while maintaining ownership of their master recording rights and up to 100% of royalties. Through the combination of UnitedMasters’ music distribution platform and its deep ties to brands, UnitedMasters enables independent artists to grow and earn unlike any other platform. 

Its unrivaled monetization opportunities for artists are amplified by Translation, UnitedMasters’ in-house creative marketing agency renowned for helping ambitious brands thrive in contemporary culture. In 2022, Translation was awarded the number three spot in Ad Age’s Agency A-List and AdWeek’s Multicultural Agency of the Year. One year before, Translation was awarded Ad Age’s Small Agency of the Year. 

We’re looking for a Sr. Creative Recruiter to join our team and support hiring for Translation, our creative advertising agency that partners with some of the world’s most recognized brands.

You’ll recruit across creative, strategy, production, and account roles, from Creative Directors and Strategists to Producers and Account leaders, while also helping build freelance teams for agency projects. You’ll partner with hiring managers throughout the recruiting process and help improve our recruiting operations, candidate experience, and hiring quality.

This role is based in our Brooklyn, NY Office 4 days a week. 

What You'll Do

Full-Cycle Recruiting

  • Manage the end-to-end recruiting process across a wide variety of corporate, technical, creative, and business roles.
  • Partner with hiring managers to define hiring strategies, interview plans, and ideal candidate profiles.
  • Build and maintain strong candidate pipelines through sourcing, networking, referrals, and market research.
  • Deliver an exceptional candidate experience from initial outreach through offer acceptance.
  • Manage multiple searches simultaneously while maintaining speed, quality, and communication.

Talent Partnership

  • Act as a strategic advisor to hiring managers throughout the recruiting process.
  • Provide market insights, compensation guidance, and hiring recommendations.
  • Facilitate interview calibration and drive effective hiring decisions.
  • Influence stakeholders to ensure an efficient, high-quality hiring process.

Sourcing & Pipeline Development

  • Proactively source passive talent using LinkedIn Recruiter, networking, referrals, and creative sourcing strategies.
  • Develop diverse talent pipelines for current and future hiring needs.
  • Build relationships with candidates across creative, technical, and business disciplines.

Recruiting Operations

  • Maintain accurate recruiting data within the applicant tracking system.
  • Track recruiting metrics including time-to-fill, pipeline health, and offer acceptance rates.
  • Recommend process improvements that enhance efficiency and candidate experience.
  • Support employer branding initiatives, recruiting events, and talent community engagement.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Ability to recruit a mix of corporate, technical, and creative talent.
  • Strong sourcing skills with demonstrated success attracting passive candidates.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Ability to prioritize competing searches in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience using Greenhouse or another ATS.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Data-driven approach to recruiting and process improvement.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 4+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience within an advertising agency 
  • Proven track record of hiring high-performing talent across multiple functions and levels, including senior-level roles

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with ADP, Greenhouse, and Google suite preferred

About UnitedMasters, Inc.

UnitedMasters has over 1.5 million artists on its platform and is growing rapidly. Brands like Diageo, Ally, and ESPN come to UnitedMasters to partner with these artists and play a role in moving culture forward. In the past year, UnitedMasters subscribers have grown rapidly. With $170M raised to date and valued at $550M, UnitedMasters is backed by Andreessen Horowitz, Apple, Alphabet (aka Google), and Disney amongst others. Over the last year, UnitedMasters artists have used our platform to land sync deals with major brands including the NBA, ESPN, Overtime Elite, Bose, Warner Brother Studios and in the NBA video game 2k. These deals give them additional money for their work and increase their exposure.

job.title: Sr. Program Manager
job.description:
Senior Program Manager 

Who We Are

We are an award-winning independent creative solutions company that aspires to be the most culturally-influential company in the world. We help ambitious brands harness the power of culture to solve their biggest challenges. As a unique mix of experts in culture, technology, and storytelling, we are united by a passion to grow brands in ways that advertising alone can never do.

We are an entrepreneurial business—not a traditional “ad agency.” That means we value resourcefulness and tenacity just as much as we value creativity and intelligence. We’re unapologetically ambitious!

We are seeking a Senior Program Manager to join Translation. This is a hybrid role based out of our Brooklyn office (4 days in office).

What You'll Do

As a Senior Program Manager, you’ll own internal program coordination across assigned work and be a key driver of both operational excellence and program delivery. You will lead integrated campaigns and ensure we deliver groundbreaking work that meets our clients’ objectives and propels agency growth. You’ll blend strategic thinking with sharp project management and a strong sense of ownership, overseeing teams and guiding work from scope through execution while managing the health (budget, scope, team design) of your projects. The Sr. Program Manager reports to the Program Director (or Group Program Director) and will manage Associates and/or Managers. The Sr. PM partners with the Business Supervisor or Business Director to run most Tier 1 or 2 projects. 

Responsibilities

  • Oversee day-to-day program coordination and delivery of assigned projects, ensuring internal teams are aligned and work meets client expectations.
  • Drive the end-to-end process for integrated campaigns (film, experiential, digital/social, OOH), ensuring seamless delivery on time and on budget by developing and tracking tactical plans to develop each with a keen understanding of client parameters and objectives. Work with junior team members to create and manage all tactical schedules
  • Partner with Business Leadership counterpart to develop all scope proposals for assigned projects, developing a compelling proposal as well as profitable approach for the agency
  • Provide strong financial management of assigned accounts including managing all budget allocations, reviewing burn, proactively creating scope change orders (internal and external), proactively suggesting areas for optimization and macro view of out-of-pocket budget tracking
  • Lead all reporting and reconciliation processes in partnership with finance team 
  • Help digest all client feedback and lead the team on how we address and action the feedback. Understand and mentor teams on where/when to escalate creative feedback or work reviews to senior leadership 
  • Build and nurture strong client relationships, serving as a trusted advisor who understands how to get things done effectively and efficiently leveraging our teams and resources to create innovative and breakthrough creative solutions that solve clients business objectives 
  • Manage and mentor junior program managers, strategically deploying them across projects and fostering their professional growth.
  • Collaborate with department leads (account, production, creative, strategy) to assemble the right teams for each initiative, confirm the right allocations and manage overall workforce planning with Resource Management lead
  • Work closely with production to ensure timelines accommodate production requirements and projects continue to move seamlessly in execution 
  • Support the Business Lead and Production teams during executional and production phases of creative work to ensure absolute clarity client & media requirements, provide tactical support during production and oversee the successful delivery/traffic assets when required 
  • Partner with Creative, Production, and Business teams to turn campaign ideas into actionable plans, ensuring timelines, budgets, and deliverables stay on track without compromising creative ambition.
  • Manage and monitor production and creative workflows, proactively identifying risks and driving solutions to keep projects moving smoothly.
  • Foster clear, integrated ways of working by aligning teams on roles, processes, and communication throughout the creative and production lifecycle.
  • Proactively identify potential issues or opportunities, keeping teams and clients informed and driving swift, effective solutions.
  • Oversee the creation of presentation materials that uphold agency standards and resonate with clients’ business objectives.
  • Participate in new business efforts, contributing to proposals, pitches, and strategic planning to showcase our operational strengths and capabilities
  • Champion a positive, collaborative environment that values diverse perspectives, accountability, and a shared passion for producing culturally powerful work.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Strong critical thinking, problem-solving, and “off-script” navigation skills, with the confidence to lead and adapt in dynamic situations.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to present complex ideas clearly, accurately, and persuasively.
  • Deeply proactive, hands-on mentality—takes pride in their work, holds themselves accountable, and drives momentum across teams.
  • Diplomatic yet persistent; able to guide teams through peak moments with empathy, clarity, and a focus on solutions.
  • Highly organized with exceptional time management and prioritization abilities, balancing multiple workstreams with quality and care.
  • Passionate about people and culture, with a results-driven approach balanced by genuine curiosity and sensitivity to team dynamics.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5–7 years of experience managing large-scale brands or programs within a creative agency or related communications environment.
  • Proven ability to build strong client partnerships that drive long-term growth and mutual success.
  • Demonstrated expertise managing multi-disciplinary teams across creative, production, and strategy disciplines.
  • Solid understanding of financial principles as they relate to agency scopes, budgets, and P&L impact.
  • Experience leading strategic and day-to-day client communications, as well as mentoring junior team members.
  • Familiarity with the lifecycle of integrated campaigns, including digital, social, print, and broadcast production.
  • Comfortable with Google Suite (Sheets and Slides); experience with Monday.com or SmartSheets is a plus.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in telco or retail categories, or in performance marketing environments.
  • Background in managing cross-functional agency partners and leading collaborative workstreams.
  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, or a related field preferred.

About UnitedMasters, Inc.

UnitedMasters Inc. represents the creative solutions company, Translation, and the leading software and services platform for independent creators, UnitedMasters. UnitedMasters enables ownership, exposure, and new paths for financial return for independent creators, while Translation helps brands leverage the power of contemporary culture to achieve transformational growth. Combined, UnitedMasters, Inc. is the world’s leading marketplace for cultural capital, connecting independent artists and brands to realize a future in which all creators own their future. Backed by Alphabet, Andreessen Horowitz, and Apple, UnitedMasters, Inc. is reimagining how brands and artists come together to tell their stories, build profitable growth, and push culture forward.

job.description:

UnitedMasters is building a marketplace that connects artists, brands and fans - empowering artists to earn and grow. We are looking for a versatile, culture-obsessed part-time Copywriter to join our team on a part-time basis. 

The Role

This role will sit at the intersection of music, tech, and media, supporting both the UnitedMasters brand and the 16Bars platform.

The ideal candidate has a sharp ear for voice, a deep understanding of music culture, and the ability to pivot between high-level brand storytelling and punchy social communications. You will collaborate closely with the Integrated Marketing, Social and Creative teams to drive engagement across our digital ecosystem.

What You’ll Do 

  • Digital & Web: Draft compelling website copy for landing pages and product launches, ensuring a seamless user experience.
  • Go-To-Market (GTM): Develop clear, impactful messaging for brand initiatives and new feature rollouts.
  • CRM & Editorial: Write engaging weekly newsletters and email marketing campaigns that drive conversion and community loyalty.
  • Social Media: Craft platform-specific copy (Instagram, TikTok, X) that resonates with independent artists and music fans.
  • Creative Development: Assist in writing creative treatments and "big idea" pitches for brand partnerships.
  • Content Scripts: Script short-form video content (Reels/TikToks) that feels authentic, trendy, and on-brand.

Who You Are 

  • 4-7 years of experience: working on internal and external facing brand copy across digital and social platforms
  • Culture-First Mindset: You’re plugged into music and culture, specifically the independent artist landscape.
  • Versatile Portfolio: Proven experience writing for tech, music, or lifestyle brands across web, email, and social.
  • Adaptability: Ability to switch voices between the professional/empowering tone of UnitedMasters and the editorial/sharp tone of 16Bars.
  • Efficiency: Capable of managing multiple projects under tight deadlines without sacrificing quality.
  • Collaboration: A team player who can take feedback from integrated marketing leads and turn it into polished prose.

Our Values

  • We Get on the Plane — Entrepreneurial spirit means fully committing to the journey not just having the idea.
  • We Expect Challenge + Respect — We constantly challenge each other and the work to reach excellence, always with respect.
  • We Are Defined by Our Resilience — We stay resourceful, fail fast, keep getting better, and never quit on our mission or our team.
  • We Pursue Answers Before the Question Has to Be Asked — We understand our customers so well that we anticipate what they need before they ask.
  • We Run Towards Darkness — We have the courage to work through uncertainty rather than settling for an easier, inferior plan.
  • We Know What We Don't Know — We bring confidence in what we do know, and honesty about what we don't.

Compensation

job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 

How we LEAD:

We are seeking a Business Partner Account Manager in our Digital Operations group that globally supports UMG’s owned and associated labels to set up new releases, manages the ongoing delivery of new releases and catalogue to business partners, and drives the introduction of new processes, product types and services with a continuous improvement focus.

In this position, the successful candidate will be responsible for and oversee designated aspects of Business Partner operations. The candidate will act as the key operational UMG contact for assigned partners and be a key internal point of contact for the Digital Strategy, Commercial, Business & Legal Affairs, and Rights teams for new partner developments, onboarding activities, and emerging digital initiatives.

How You’ll CREATE

Business Partner Onboarding & Approval Process Implementation

  • Ensure the agreed partner setup process required between Business & Legal Affairs and the global digital supply chain is implemented in response to partner account setup requests.

Business Partner Account Management & Internal UMG Account Support

  • Manage the ongoing operational and technical relationship management of UMG digital business partners and raise issues with effective communication. Provide partner-specific operational guidance and best practices to internal stakeholders to support successful content delivery and issue resolution.

Data Stewardship

  • Run, analyze, and reconcile repertoire data using comparison techniques as needed for specialized business partner activities.

  • Maintain and update digital records, including version control and replacements. Collaborate cross-functionally with internal stakeholders to ensure data accuracy and process adherence.

Business Partner Fulfillment Support

  • Manage individual partner content fulfillment as appropriate and in line with partner and UMG business expectations. Act as point of contact for Label Production & Release

  • Support Management teams to troubleshoot content and technical issues with designated partners.

Business Partner Catalog Backfill

  • Manage catalog backfill initiatives as assigned across the global digital supply chain. Remedy catalog gaps due to ingestion incidents and support catalog expansion efforts as necessary.

  • Act as a liaison within UMG for operational and technical integration activities related to catalog availability, distribution capabilities, and repertoire management enhancements.

Digital Supply Chain Improvements

  • Specify future enhancements as noted from technical relationships with partners. Observe global digital supply chain processes and identify key areas for improvement.

  • Support the implementation of new digital fulfillment guidance for emerging digital initiatives, evolving content management capabilities, and new partner requirements.

Emerging Business Models & Partner Operations

  • Support operational readiness for new partner types, products, and services, including AI-related platforms and emerging technologies where applicable.

  • Coordinate with the Business Partner Account Management team leader to evaluate onboarding requirements, operational impacts, and ongoing support models for evolving business opportunities.

Meeting Attendance and Participation

  • Organize and participate in meetings as necessary to meet UMG and business partner objectives.

Bring your VIBE:

  • Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate effectively, often regarding complex issues with people at all levels within the business

  • Excellent organizational skills with attention to detail and sharp time/project management skills

  • Solutions and results driven, conscientious, with a consistent desire to see a job through to conclusion

  • Proven ability to identify improvements to current working methods and systems and facilitate the implementation of change

  • Maintain overall professionalism with communication, message management and executive interaction

  • Must work well in a collaborative environment and display a strong team-player attitude

  • Skillful with technical, operational and commercial aspects of digital content management and distribution

  • Understanding of digital content distribution, DDEX, and related technologies

  • Proactive and methodical approach to work

  • Experience managing operational and technical business relationships

  • Ability to isolate underlying problems and implement permanent solutions

  • Skilled at navigating multiple or conflicting requirements between different parties and determining the best overall solution

  • Strong knowledge of key digital formats, digital distribution systems, and music and media industries

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Communications or other related area

  • Solid overall understanding of different roles throughout a recording company

  • Experience establishing collaborative relationships in an enterprise setting across different groups

  • Experience acting as a central coordination and communication point with senior stakeholders internally and externally

Perks Playlist:

Join an entrepreneurial, global organization where authenticity, boldness, creativity, connection, drive, and insight aren’t just values—they’re how we work every day. Here are some of the ways we support you along the way (and just a few of the benefits we offer):

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage

  • Including 100% coverage for out-patient in-network mental health services

job.title: Director, Privacy & Data Protection
job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 

Director, Privacy & Data Protection

Job Category: Business & Legal Affairs


How We LEAD:

The Director, Privacy & Data Protection will be an experienced privacy attorney supporting Universal Music Group's global privacy and data protection program. Working closely with the Senior Vice President, Privacy & Data Protection, this role will provide practical, hands-on legal support across privacy contracting, data subject rights, cybersecurity incidents, digital marketing and other matters involving the collection, use, sharing and protection of personal data.


As the world leader in music-based entertainment, UMG operates across a broad range of labels, artist businesses, digital platforms, e-commerce experiences, marketing initiatives and fan-facing services. The Director will work with colleagues across Legal, Information Security, Technology, Digital, Marketing, E-Commerce and the business to help UMG use data responsibly while supporting artists, creators and fans around the world.


The ideal candidate will combine strong privacy law fundamentals with excellent drafting and negotiation skills, sound judgment and a practical, business-oriented approach. This role requires an attorney who is comfortable managing a significant volume of day-to-day matters, can independently handle work within established frameworks, and recognizes when novel, sensitive or higher-risk issues require escalation.


How You'll CREATE:

  • Draft, review and negotiate data protection and privacy terms in commercial agreements, including data processing agreements, data-sharing arrangements, international data transfer provisions, information security terms and other privacy-related contractual provisions.
  • Partner with UMG's Business & Legal Affairs teams on privacy issues arising in artist, vendor, technology, platform, licensing, e-commerce, marketing and other commercial arrangements involving personal data.
  • Handle UMG's day-to-day legal work relating to data subject and consumer privacy rights requests, including assessing request scope and applicable legal requirements, advising on exemptions and response obligations, coordinating with privacy operations and relevant business teams, reviewing and drafting responses, and escalating complex or sensitive matters as appropriate.
  • Support the privacy-law aspects of cybersecurity and data security incidents, working closely with Information Security, Legal and other stakeholders to assess incident facts and affected data, analyze applicable notification and regulatory requirements, document legal assessments, and draft or review incident-related communications.
  • Assist with investigations of potential privacy and data security issues, including gathering relevant facts, evaluating legal obligations and coordinating with outside counsel where appropriate.
  • Advise business and legal teams on privacy requirements affecting UMG's websites, applications, digital platforms, artist and fan experiences, e-commerce operations, advertising and marketing activities.
  • Provide practical guidance on online advertising and tracking technologies, marketing communications, consent and preference management, and related privacy and consumer protection requirements.
  • Advise on compliance with U.S. federal and state privacy laws, GDPR and other applicable international privacy and data protection requirements.
  • Support privacy reviews of new and evolving business initiatives, technologies, vendors, products and uses of data, including privacy impact assessments where appropriate.
  • Assist with third-party privacy and data protection matters, including vendor diligence, data-transfer requirements, privacy questionnaires and remediation of identified issues.
  • Help maintain and improve privacy policies, procedures, templates, playbooks and other resources that support consistent and scalable privacy practices across UMG's labels, territories and business units.
  • Work with privacy operations, Information Security and business teams to identify recurring issues and improve processes for contract review, rights requests, incident response and other recurring privacy matters.
  • Support responses to regulatory inquiries, audits and other privacy or data protection matters as needed.
  • Monitor relevant developments in privacy, data protection, cybersecurity, digital marketing and consumer protection law and provide clear, practical guidance regarding developments relevant to UMG's businesses.
  • Provide privacy guidance and training to Legal, business and operational teams as needed.
  • Support privacy issues arising from emerging technologies and new uses of data as appropriate.
  • Collaborate effectively with colleagues across UMG's labels, business units and territories, handling routine and moderately complex matters independently and escalating novel, sensitive or significant matters as appropriate.

  • Strong working knowledge of U.S. federal and state privacy laws, including CCPA/CPRA and other comprehensive state privacy laws, and meaningful familiarity with GDPR and international data protection requirements.

  • Meaningful experience supporting cybersecurity or data security incident response, including familiarity with breach-notification requirements and experience working with information security or technical teams during investigations.
  • Strong legal research, analytical, drafting and negotiation skills, with the ability to identify the issues that matter and provide clear, practical and business-oriented advice.
  • Ability to understand technical and operational facts sufficiently to identify relevant privacy, cybersecurity and digital marketing legal issues.
  • Sound judgment and the ability to handle a significant volume of matters independently while recognizing when an issue warrants escalation.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple matters and competing priorities in a fast-moving, global and highly collaborative environment.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to explain complex privacy and data protection requirements clearly to lawyers and non-lawyers.
  • CIPP/US, CIPP/E or another relevant privacy certification preferred.

job.title: Senior Manager, Strategic Initiatives and Investing
job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 

The Strategic Initiatives & Investing team is a highly visible corporate development and investing team within UMG. The group partners with Virgin Music Group's executive leadership, business units, labels, and internal stakeholders to evaluate and execute opportunities across M&A, artist and business deals, catalog acquisitions, joint ventures, new business ventures, and select strategic initiatives. The team is lean and committed to a culture that is rigorous, collaborative, supportive, and fun.


How we LEAD:

The Strategic Initiatives & Investing team is looking for a full-time Senior Manager based in Los Angeles, CA. This is a hands-on corporate development role whose primary focus is financial analysis, valuation, diligence, and transaction execution across M&A, catalog acquisitions in coordination with Chord Music Partners, artist and business deals, joint ventures, and growth investments. The Senior Manager will own discrete transaction and analytical workstreams, develop clear recommendations for senior leaders, and partner with stakeholders across recorded music, publishing, merchandise, D2C, artist services, digital, technology, and marketing. The role will report to the VP, M&A and Strategic Investments, and work closely with other team members. The successful candidate is analytical, proactive, intellectually curious, and able to turn complex information into practical recommendations.


How you'll CREATE:

  • Build and own financial models, valuation analyses, and scenario assessments for potential M&A targets, artist and business deals, catalog acquisitions, joint venture partners, and other growth investments.
  • Manage discrete transaction workstreams, including data requests, financial and commercial diligence, sensitivity analyses, and synthesis of key findings.
  • Analyze deal economics and key terms, pressure-test operating assumptions, and identify value drivers, risks, and potential mitigants.
  • Coordinate with business units and cross-functional partners, including Finance, Legal, Business Affairs, Tax, Accounting, and commercial teams, to gather inputs and advance evaluations.
  • Conduct industry, market, and competitive research to inform valuation assumptions, strategic fit, and investment theses.
  • Prepare concise, executive-ready presentations and recommendations for senior management and other VMG leaders; communicate complex analyses clearly and accurately.
  • Support select strategic initiatives by structuring analyses around growth opportunities, revenue drivers, investment requirements, and business model implications.
  • Maintain transaction materials and improve models, templates, trackers, and processes to support consistent and efficient decision-making.
  • Support post-transaction reviews and performance tracking against the original investment case, where relevant.

Bring your VIBE:

  • 3+ years of relevant work experience in investment banking, corporate development, music IP or catalog investing, private equity, transaction advisory, consulting or strategy with a strong financial focus, or a similar field.
  • Direct experience with music IP, catalog investing, recorded music, publishing, or artist deal economics strongly preferred.
  • Strong financial modeling and valuation experience, including operating models, DCF, IRR, scenario and sensitivity analyses, and new venture economics.
  • Demonstrated ability to own analytical and diligence workstreams independently, with strong attention to detail and sound judgment.
  • Proven ability to synthesize complex findings into concise executive recommendations and presentations.
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint; proficiency in Word required. Experience with HFM, SAP, or similar financial systems is a plus.

job.title: Vice President, Enterprise Data Governance and Strategy
job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 

How You’ll Lead:

The Vice President, Data Governance & Strategy is a senior executive leader responsible for defining and operationalizing a comprehensive enterprise data governance and data strategy across UMG. This role ensures that critical data assets—spanning music rights, royalties, digital consumption, fan engagement, e-commerce and merchandise (online and on-tour), physical products, and artist development—are accurate, trusted, compliant, and strategically leveraged.

Operating at the intersection of business strategy, technology, privacy, and partnerships, the VP champions a data-driven culture and enables scalable, compliant data usage that fuels monetization, fan growth, and innovation in a rapidly evolving global music ecosystem.

How You’ll Create:

Strategic Leadership

  • Define and drive the enterprise data strategy to support business growth, monetization of music assets, and fan engagement.

  • Identify and assess new fan data sources and partnership opportunities aligned with the enterprise data strategy, accounting for label and regional differences.

  • Align data initiatives with music industry trends, business priorities, and evolving digital platforms, including streaming, social platforms, AI-enabled services, and emerging distribution models.

  • Partner with C-level executives and senior leaders across Legal, Finance, Marketing, Commercial, HR, and Technology to integrate data insights into strategic and operational decision-making.

  • Serve as a trusted executive advisor on data value, risk, and opportunity across the organization.

Data Governance

  • Develop and implement a robust, scalable data governance framework covering:

    • Fan, CRM, and e-commerce data

    • Digital consumption and DSP reporting

    • Artist, repertoire, and product metadata

    • Financial, royalty, and rights data

  • Establish clear data ownership, stewardship, quality standards, and accountability models across business units and regions.

  • Standardize data definitions and identifiers (e.g., ISRC, ISWC, IPI) to ensure consistency, transparency, and auditability across systems and partners.

  • Ensure compliance with global music rights regulations, licensing requirements, and data privacy laws (e.g., GDPR, CCPA), in close partnership with Legal, Privacy, and Security teams.

Collaboration & Enablement

  • Work cross-functionally with legal, operations, analytics, product, and technology teams to operationalize governance standards through platforms, processes, and workflows.

  • Promote data literacy, stewardship, and accountability across departments and business units.

  • Lead organizational change to position data as a managed enterprise asset, enabling trusted insights and scalable innovation.

Technology, Innovation & Future-Readiness

  • Evaluate, select, and deploy enterprise data governance and cataloging technologies supporting discovery, classification, lineage, quality monitoring, and access controls.

  • Drive automation and scalability in data ingestion, normalization, and reconciliation from digital platforms such as Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube, TikTok, and emerging channels.

AI Readiness, Responsible AI & Privacy by Design

  • Facilitate in establishing AI-ready data foundations, ensuring data used for advanced analytics, machine learning, and generative AI is accurate, well-governed, traceable, and ethically sourced.

  • Partner with Legal, Privacy, Security, and Technology teams to define and operationalize AI governance frameworks, including controls for data usage, consent, provenance, bias mitigation, explainability, and auditability.

  • Embed privacy-by-design and privacy-by-default principles into AI-enabled initiatives involving fan, artist, and partner data, ensuring compliance with global privacy regulations and contractual obligations.

  • Play an active role in defining policies and guardrails for the responsible use of generative AI across the music lifecycle, including metadata enrichment, rights identification, royalty processing, fan engagement, marketing optimization, and internal productivity tools.

  • Assess and mitigate risks related to AI-driven data sharing, automated decision-making, synthetic data, and data leakage, while enabling innovation that supports monetization, efficiency, and trust.

  • Stay informed on emerging technologies such as AI/ML, blockchain, smart contracts, NFTs, and next-generation rights management, and evaluate their implications for music data governance, licensing, and revenue models.

Bring your VIBE:

Experience & Expertise

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Data Science, Music Business, or a related field; Master’s degree or MBA preferred.

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in data governance, data strategy, information management, or digital rights management—preferably within music, media, or entertainment.

  • Deep understanding of music rights, publishing, royalties, and global distribution models.

  • Strong familiarity with industry standards and ecosystems, including DDEX, ISRC, ISWC, IPI, and global licensing organizations.

  • Hands-on experience with data governance, catalog, and rights/royalty platforms (e.g., Collibra, Informatica, SynchTank, Vistex, Revelator or similar).

Leadership & Influence

  • Proven ability to operate at the executive level, influencing across technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Track record of driving enterprise-wide data transformation and cultural change.

  • Exceptional communication, storytelling, and stakeholder-management skills.

Key Competencies

  • Visionary leadership at the intersection of data, music, and innovation

  • Strong grasp of digital music consumption, fan data, and data monetization models

  • Compliance-minded, detail-oriented, with a pragmatic business lens

  • Ability to align diverse teams and priorities in a complex, global organization

job.title: R1 Board Operator
job.description:
Job Position:       Board Operator 

Department:        Programming 

Reports to:            Operations Manager

FLSA:                     Non-Exempt 

Status:                   Part-time 

Work Location:   Indianapolis, IN

 

OVERVIEW: 

The Radio One story began simply with a dream and one radio station. Forty-five years, 13 markets, and 70+ stations later, we are an urban media empire, spanning multiple media platforms. We are in your ears with Reach Media/Radio One, on your televisions with TV One, and may even be the name behind your favorite website, with our digital platform Interactive One. Information is power, and our mission here at Radio One, Inc. is simple – to be the most trusted media source in the African American community. At Radio One, we pride ourselves on hiring people who are dedicated and continue to challenge the norm, while embracing a corporate culture built on creativity and passion. We are our employees’ biggest fans, and it is our daily mission to attract, develop, and retain the brightest stars in the business.

 

ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES: 

 

  • Airs live and pre-recorded shows
  • Completes traffic logs and fixes logging discrepancies
  • Airs emergency alert system tests as indicated
  • Engineers’ remote broadcasts and follows station procedures. 
  • Regulates timing of programs, operates syndicated programming, and plays commercials and promotions as scheduled
  • Off-air support of commercial production, dubbing music to hard disk and programming automation computers
  • Monitors and updates weather, traffic, and news reports into automation equipment
  • Monitors station contest
  • Performs on-air announcements or shifts as assigned
  • Assists with remote appearances
  • Takes transmitter readings and maintains transmitter logs

 

KNOWLEDGE/SKILLS/ABILITIES: 

  • Excellent organizational skills, and the ability to prioritize and effectively manage time
  • Self-starter, with the ability to take and follow direction
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to interact effectively with the station’s clients and listeners
  • Can work well independently and as an integral part of the team

job.title: R1 Integrated Marketing Spec
job.description:
About the Role:

The R1 Integrated Marketing Specialist plays a pivotal role in developing and executing comprehensive marketing strategies that align with the organization's business objectives. This position is responsible for integrating various marketing channels and campaigns to create a cohesive brand message that drives customer engagement and business growth. The specialist will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams including sales, product development, and creative services to ensure marketing initiatives are effectively implemented and measured. By analyzing market trends and customer insights, the role aims to optimize marketing efforts and maximize return on investment. Ultimately, the R1 Integrated Marketing Specialist will contribute to strengthening brand presence and expanding market share across the United States.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of experience in integrated marketing or a similar role.
  • Proven ability to manage multi-channel marketing campaigns from concept to execution.
  • Strong analytical skills with experience using marketing analytics tools.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in healthcare or technology marketing sectors.
  • Proficiency with marketing automation platforms such as HubSpot, Marketo, or Salesforce Marketing Cloud.
  • Familiarity with SEO, SEM, and digital advertising best practices.
  • Graphic design skills or experience working closely with creative teams.
  • Project management certification or experience.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and implement integrated marketing campaigns across digital, print, and social media platforms to support business goals.
  • Coordinate with internal teams and external vendors to ensure timely and consistent delivery of marketing materials.
  • Analyze campaign performance data to identify trends, measure effectiveness, and recommend improvements.
  • Manage marketing budgets and allocate resources efficiently to maximize impact.
  • Support the creation of content, including copywriting, graphic design coordination, and multimedia production.
  • Conduct market research to stay informed about industry trends, competitor activities, and customer preferences.
  • Collaborate with sales teams to align marketing strategies with sales objectives and lead generation efforts.
  • Maintain brand consistency across all marketing channels and communications.

Skills:

The required skills enable the specialist to design and execute integrated marketing campaigns that effectively reach target audiences and achieve measurable results. Analytical skills are essential for interpreting data and optimizing marketing strategies to improve performance continuously. Strong communication skills facilitate collaboration with internal teams and external partners, ensuring alignment and consistency in messaging. Preferred skills such as proficiency with marketing automation tools and digital advertising techniques enhance the ability to leverage technology for campaign efficiency and scalability. Additionally, project management and creative collaboration skills support the seamless delivery of marketing initiatives within deadlines and budget constraints.

job.title: Account Executive - Vista Idea Sales (VIS) - Kelowna, BC
job.description:
CHANGE THE GAME

Vista Radio’s elite sales division is called Vista Idea Sales (VIS) — and no, we don’t do “typical” sales. We challenge it, push it, and outperform it. As Vista continues to grow across Canada, this team is at the center of it all — driving revenue across multiple markets from one place: the Okanagan region in BC.

We’re not just growing — we’re building one of the most dynamic media sales teams in the country.

We are looking for a lifer, someone who gets us and wants to grow with us long-term 😉 We’re competitive, driven, and we support each other to win. This is not an easy role — it’s a high-energy, high-reward environment where resilience, consistency, and attitude matter.

If you’re someone who thrives on challenge, isn’t afraid of hearing “no,” and knows that success in sales is built through dedication to training, and pure old-fashioned hard work — we’re ready to talk to you.

About the Job:

Vista Radio has an immediate opening for a full-time Account Executive, based in Kelowna, BC, as part of our Vista Idea Sales (VIS) team.

This role focuses on sales, working with clients across Canada in all Vista Radio markets. No travel is required though as almost all the work will be via correspondence, primarily on the phone. You will build relationships, develop new business opportunities, and manage a pipeline of clients using both provided leads and self-generated prospects.

What you’ll do

Build and manage a sales pipeline using both internal databases and self-sourced leads

Prospect businesses across Canada to develop new client relationships

Develop creative radio and digital advertising solutions tailored to client needs

Conduct sales presentations and close new business

Maintain strong follow-up and relationship management with clients

Collaborate with internal teams to execute campaigns and ensure client satisfaction

Track activity, manage accounts, and stay organized in a high-volume sales environment

Consistently work toward and exceed sales targets

What you Bring

Strong communication skills and confidence speaking with clients over the phone

High level of resilience — comfortable handling rejection and staying motivated

Self-driven, goal-oriented mindset with a strong desire to succeed in sales

Ability to work in a structured, fast-paced environment

Strong organizational and time management skills

Creative thinking and problem-solving abilities

Previous sales experience is an asset, but not required — attitude and drive matter most

Why Vista Idea Sales

Best-in-Class Training – Our VIS team offers one of the most structured and supportive sales training programs in the company

Guaranteed Salary During Training – We invest in your success with a guaranteed base for the first 6 months (or longer if needed)

Uncapped Potential – Your earnings? They grow as fast as you do, and the sky’s the limit

Growth Opportunity – Be part of a team that is expanding across Canada with real career progression potential

Team Environment – Competitive, supportive, and built for people who want to win

This is not a passive sales role. It’s for people who want to build something, push themselves, and grow quickly.

Have questions? Apply and start the conversation — we’d love to connect with you. Taking that first step is exactly the kind of drive we’re looking for.

Vista Radio’s Vault of Benefits

At Vista Radio, we’re more than just a workplace — we’re a community of passionate people making a difference through local storytelling, music, and meaningful connections. We invest in our people with a benefits package that supports your health, well-being, and future — all in a fun, collaborative environment.

Here’s what you can expect when you join us:

🩺 Health & Dental Coverage – Comprehensive plans for individuals and families📈 RRSP Program with DPSP Matching – Vista matches your contributions into a Deferred Profit-Sharing Plan💪 Short-term & Long-term Disability – Income protection when life throws you a curveball🧠 Employee and Family Assistance Plan (EFAP) – 24/7 access to mental health and counseling support🏖️ Annual Vacation & Stat Holidays – Paid time off to relax and recharge❤️ Life & Optional Life Insurance – Protection for you and your loved ones💻 Virtual Care Access – On-demand, 24/7 healthcare wherever you are🌍 Work Where You Live – Make a real impact in the communities we serve

If you’re motivated by results, driven by challenge, and ready to take control of your earning potential, Vista Radio wants you on our team.

Application Instructions

On our company website, click the "Apply" button on the tap left corner of the job posting to get started! Click here: Job Board | Dayforce Jobs

If you experience any difficulty submitting your application, please contact the Human Resources Department at hr@vistaradio.ca.

job.title: Director, Digital Marketing
job.description:
At Warner Music Group, we’re a global collective of music makers and music lovers, tech innovators and inspired entrepreneurs, game-changing creatives and passionate team members. Here, we turn dreams into stardom and audiences into fans. We are guided by three core values that underpin everything we do across all our diverse businesses: 

  • Curiosity: We do our best work when we’re immersing ourselves in culture and breaking through barriers. Curiosity is the driving force behind creativity and ingenuity. It fuels innovation, and innovation is the key to our future. 

  • Collaboration: Making music and bringing it to the world is all about the power of originality amplified by teamwork. A great idea, like a great song, travels globally. We ignite passions and build connections across our diverse community of artists, songwriters, partners, and fans.

  • Commitment: We pursue excellence for our team and our talent. Everything in music starts with a leap into the unknown, and we’re committed to keeping the faith, acting with integrity, and delivering on our promises.

WMG is home to a wide range of artists, musicians, and songwriters that fuel our success. That is why we are committed to creating a work environment that actively values, appreciates, and respects everyone.  We encourage applications from people with a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences.

Consider a career at WMG and get the best of both worlds – an innovative global music company that retains the creative spirit of a nimble independent.
 

Job Title: Director, Digital Marketing 

 

A little bit about our team: 

The mission of the Warner Records Digital Marketing team is to drive fandom, music consumption, D2C purchases and social conversation/engagement using innovative digital marketing strategies. The team is responsible for all aspects of an artist’s digital presence including digital narrative development, digital advertising, social content ideation, influencer campaigns, digital advertising, CRM, social/digital partner activations, content seeding, websites, etc.  We work directly with the artists to translate the vision of their music into groundbreaking digital campaigns and provide in-depth creative consulting geared toward growing a highly engaged fanbase. 

 

Your role: 

The Director, Digital Marketing will oversee high level digital marketing campaigns at Warner Records. The position will be responsible for developing campaigns that create cultural conversation, build artist social followings and engagement, and drive music consumption. You will be a digital expert as well as know the leading industry standards for digital marketing music.  

 

Here you’ll get to: 

  • Oversee the development and execution of groundbreaking digital marketing campaigns and build growth strategies for both established and developing artists, leading to follower growth and consumption 
  • Monitor campaigns in real-time, making recommendations for continuous improvement. Create post-mortem analyses to quantify the impact of each campaign and measure effectiveness of each tactic 
  • Collaborate with internal teams including Commercial Revenue, Marketing, Brand Partnerships, Creative and Publicity, to build cohesive cross-platform campaigns 
  • Be responsible for the day-to-day social media strategy, website, and CRM strategies for a designated roster of artists and the Warner Records social accounts with a focus on driving fandom, engagement, and music consumption 
  • Use your expert-level knowledge of social platforms and social content strategies when partnering with artists and management to craft a social narrative and content strategy that elevates their brands and drives fandom, cultural conversation and music consumption 
  • Work with artist management and internal departments to develop and maintain an editorial calendar across all social platforms 
  • Partner with internal creatives and external creators to develop high-performing short-form content for Warner Records artists 
  • Partner with the VP of Paid Media Strategy, Operations and Audience Growth to develop and execute paid media campaigns and CRM strategy for each artist 
  • Work with our Insights team to profile our online audiences, building digital marketing strategies based on that demographic and psychographic data 
  • Build and maintain relationships with social media platform representatives and participate in regular update meetings 
  • Manage online marketing budget spend for each artist 

 

About you: 

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent 
  • Minimum of 6+ years professional experience in digital/social media marketing, direct to consumer marketing, and/or related fields preferably at a Record Label or music management company 
  • Outstanding organizational skills, verbal and written communication skills, and expertise in social media content strategy 
  • Innate ability to lead and mentor  
  • Passion for fan-focused digital strategies with a problem-solving attitude to see projects through completion 
  • Ability to excel in a fast-paced, tight timeframe, and team-oriented environment 
  • Knowledge on  how to “move the needle” online, be it driving consumption, engagement, or growth 
  • Proven leadership experience in team discussions and client meetings 
  • Impeccable follow-up and follow-through 
  • A deep professional understanding of interactive technologies and communication tools, including: TikTok, Facebook, Instagram, Threads, Twitter, YouTube, Snapchat, Discord, Website strategy, Email/CRM strategy 

 

We’d love it if you also had: 

  • Photoshop, Illustrator, or other graphic design knowledge 
  • Experience using project management software such as Jira and Basecamp 
  • Understanding of social media analytics and posting tools such as Falcon and HootSuite 
  • Knowledge of web3, NFT’s and crypto currency marketing 
  • Record Label experience 
  • People management skills 


As the home to 10K Projects, Asylum, Atlantic Music Group, East West, FFRR, Fueled by Ramen, Nonesuch, Parlophone, Rhino, Roadrunner, Sire, Warner Records, Warner Classics, and several other of the world’s premier recording labels, Warner Music Group champions emerging artists and global superstars alike. And our renowned publishing company, Warner Chappell Music, represents genre-spanning songwriters and producers through a catalog of more than one million copyrights worldwide. Warner Music Group is also home to ADA, which supports the independent community, as well as artist services division WMX. In addition, WMG counts film and television storytelling powerhouse Warner Music Entertainment among its many brands.

Together, we are Warner Music Group: Independent Minds. Major Sound.

Love this job and want to apply?

Click the “Apply” link at the top of the page, or apply directly with your LinkedIn. Applying with LinkedIn will import all of the information you put in your profile, but will still allow you to upload a resume and cover letter.

 

Don’t be discouraged if you don’t hear from us right away. We’re taking our time to review all resumes, and to find the best people for WMG.

 

Thanks for your interest in working for WMG. We love it here, and think you will, too.
 

This position requires a minimum of 4 days per week in the office. We value in-office collaboration, which is essential for talent development and strong working relationships. #LI-Onsite Annual Rate: $105,000 to $120,000 Annually


Warner Music Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

job.title: Applied Machine Learning Scientist 2, Personalization & Recommendations
job.description:
Join the future of news

We’re on a mission to deliver riveting storytelling for all of America. At The Washington Post, you’ll help reinvent news. Our work is driven by a deep investigative spirit and enhanced by innovation to bring audiences closer to the stories that matter most.


About Our Team


The Washington Post is powered by the passion and talent of our people. It takes all of us to reinvent news. Beyond our award-winning News and Opinions teams, we work across many departments, including Brand & Events, Communications, Customer Care, Engineering & Product, Finance, Human Resources, Legal, Marketing & Advertising, Print Operations, and Sales.


Why This Role Matters

 

The Washington Post is looking for an Applied Machine Learning Scientist 2 to build AI/ML systems that help readers discover, understand, and engage with journalism. This role will focus on personalization, recommendations, ranking, user modeling, experimentation, and generative AI-powered discovery experiences.

You will work with scientists, engineers, data teams, product managers, editors, and other stakeholders to turn large-scale behavioral, content, and interaction data into intelligent reader experiences.

What Motivates You

  • You value world-class journalism and want to support it through practical AI/ML solutions.

  • You enjoy building models that improve reader experience and business outcomes.

  • You are interested in personalization, recommender systems, ranking, generative AI, and experimentation.

  • You collaborate well, communicate clearly, and respond positively to feedback.

  • You are eager to grow by learning and applying modern AI/ML techniques.

How You'll Support the Mission

  • Design, train, evaluate, and deploy ML models for personalization, recommendation, ranking, user modeling, and content discovery.

  • Build and improve systems for For You, homepage ranking, article recommendations, related content, and real-time user modeling.

  • Apply modern ML techniques, including embedding generation, transformer-based models, two-tower architectures, learning-to-rank models, LLM driven and GenAI-based approaches for content personalization and recommendation.

  • Support AI-powered reader experiences such as content understanding, question answering, intelligent discovery, and personalized content recommendations.

  • Work across the ML lifecycle, from problem definition and data exploration to model deployment, monitoring, and iteration.

  • Design offline and online evaluations, including ranking metrics, recommender-system metrics, A/B testing, and causal analysis.

  • Analyze large-scale behavioral, content, and interaction datasets to generate insights and improve models.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable, reliable, and maintainable AI/ML solutions.

  • Communicate model approaches, evaluation results, tradeoffs, and impact to technical and non-technical partners.

  • Stay current with advances in ML, GenAI, NLP, recommender systems, ranking, and experimentation.

The Skills and Experience You Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Machine Learning, or a related technical field.

  • 2+ years of experience in applied machine learning, AI, data science, recommender systems, NLP, or a related field.

  • 2+ years of professional experience with Python and at least one ML framework such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or JAX.

  • Experience working with large-scale datasets and real-world ML problems.

  • Strong foundation in machine learning, statistical analysis, model evaluation, and experimental design.

job.description:

This first-of-its-kind role will build and scale The Washington Post’s corporate development capability, creating a disciplined approach to partnerships, acquisitions, joint ventures, and other inorganic growth opportunities. The Director will help translate enterprise strategy into actionable investment theses and transactions that expand audiences, accelerate innovation, create new capabilities, and strengthen long-term business performance. Reporting to the Head of Partnerships, this role will bring together leaders across Partnerships, Strategy, Finance, Legal, Product, Technology, and other functions to evaluate and advance complex growth opportunities.Through rigorous analysis, trusted relationships, and disciplined execution, this role will help leadership make informed decisions about where and how The Post invests for future growth.

 

What Motivates You

  • You are inspired by The Washington Post’s mission and the opportunity to advance independent journalism through innovation and strategic growth.
  • You enjoy identifying transformative opportunities and turning ambitious ideas into actionable business strategies and transactions.
  • You thrive in ambiguous environments and bring structure, judgment, and momentum to complex initiatives.
  • You are equally comfortable developing investment theses, analyzing financial returns, negotiating transaction terms, and coordinating execution.
  • You build credibility with senior executives and external partners by combining strategic perspective, financial discipline, and practical business judgment.
  • You value collaboration and enjoy aligning stakeholders with different priorities around a shared business objective.

  • Develop and implement a comprehensive corporate development strategy aligned with The Post’s enterprise priorities, establishing a focused roadmap for inorganic growth.

  • Lead the identification and evaluation of acquisitions, joint ventures, strategic investments, partnerships, and related opportunities, creating a qualified and actionable transaction pipeline.
  • Establish consistent sourcing, screening, valuation, diligence, and decision-making processes, strengthening the effectiveness and scalability of the corporate development function.
  • Direct strategic and financial analyses, including valuation models, business-case development, return scenarios, and risk assessments, providing leadership with clear recommendations.
  • Lead cross-functional due diligence in partnership with Finance, Legal, Strategy, Product, Technology, and operational stakeholders, ensuring opportunities are evaluated comprehensively and efficiently.
  • Structure and negotiate transactions in coordination with Legal, Finance, and executive sponsors, achieving terms that appropriately balance strategic value, financial return, and organizational risk.

  • Cultivate relationships with target-company executives, founders, investors, investment bankers, advisers, and prospective partners, expanding The Post’s access to high-value opportunities.
  • Coordinate transaction transition and integration planning with accountable business leaders, ensuring approved deals move from execution to measurable business value.
  • Represent The Post at relevant industry events and in strategic external discussions, strengthening the company’s profile and corporate development network.

The Skills and Experience You Bring

Minimum Qualifications

  • At least 10 years of relevant experience in corporate development, mergers and acquisitions, investment banking, private equity, corporate strategy, strategic partnerships, or a related field.
  • A bachelor’s degree in business, finance, economics, strategy, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.
  • Demonstrated experience evaluating and executing complex acquisitions, joint ventures, investments, partnerships, or comparable strategic transactions.
  • Advanced financial modeling, valuation, business-case development, and due diligence capabilities.
  • Strong understanding of transaction strategy, structuring, negotiation, approval, and execution processes.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex cross-functional initiatives involving senior stakeholders with different priorities and perspectives.
  • Sound judgment and the ability to make clear recommendations when information is incomplete, risks are significant, or outcomes are uncertain.
  • Executive-level communication and presentation skills, including the ability to translate complex financial and strategic information into concise, actionable recommendations.
  • Strong negotiation and relationship-management skills, with the credibility to engage senior executives and sophisticated external stakeholders.
  • Ability to manage multiple sensitive and time-critical opportunities while maintaining discretion, accuracy, and attention to detail.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in media, digital content, consumer technology, subscriptions, advertising, marketplaces, or other adjacent industries.
  • Experience building or scaling a corporate development function, operating model, or transaction pipeline.

Join the future of news

We’re on a mission to deliver riveting storytelling for all of America. At The Washington Post, you’ll help reinvent news. Our work is driven by a deep investigative spirit and enhanced by innovation to bring audiences closer to the stories that matter most.

The Washington Post is powered by the passion and talent of our people. It takes all of us to reinvent news. Beyond our award-winning News and Opinions teams, we work across many departments, including Brand & Events, Communications, Customer Care, Engineering & Product, Finance, Human Resources, Legal, Marketing & Advertising, Print Operations, and Sales.


Why This Role Matters

 

The Washington Post is seeking an ambitious, intellectually curious and authoritative journalist to chronicle the discoveries that are transforming medicine, science and our deepening understanding of the human body.


This is a unique opportunity to build a beat focused on the breakthroughs that will shape the future of health and medicine. The reporter will identify the most consequential advances across medicine, biology, genetics, biotechnology, drug development, diagnostics, surgery, and vaccines to help readers understand not only what scientists are discovering, but why those discoveries matter.


We are looking for an experienced, well-sourced journalist with exceptional reporting instincts and the ability to distinguish genuine breakthroughs from incremental advances and overhyped claims. The ideal candidate combines scientific rigor with elegant storytelling, producing a mix of exclusive reporting, ambitious narratives and authoritative explanatory journalism that captures both the excitement of discovery and the discipline of scientific inquiry.


This position is based in our Washington, D.C., newsroom.


What Motivates You:

  • You are fascinated by scientific discovery and the questions that shape our understanding of diseases, treatments, health and the human body.
  • You enjoy translating complex research into stories that captivate broad audiences.
  • You are driven to separate meaningful breakthroughs from scientific hype and misinformation.
  • You are energized by telling stories that combine rigorous reporting with wonder and curiosity.
  • You thrive in collaborative environments and enjoy experimenting with innovative storytelling formats.

How You'll Support the Mission:

  • Identify and report on the most significant scientific discoveries and technological breakthroughs across medicine, biology, genetics, biotechnology and related fields.
  • Develop original reporting on the scientists, institutions, companies and government agencies driving or disrupting scientific innovation. Feature the human stories behind the medical advances.
  • Produce a mix of breaking news, exclusive reporting, explanatory journalism and deeply reported narrative features. Highlight emerging fields and promising ideas before they become widely understood.
  • Evaluate new research critically, helping readers distinguish transformational discoveries from incremental advances and overstated claims.
  • Explain complex scientific concepts in ways that are clear, engaging and accessible to general audiences.
  • Collaborate with visuals teams across the newsroom to create immersive, visually rich journalism.
  • Develop ambitious storytelling franchises that establish The Post as a destination for coverage of scientific discovery.
  • Engage audiences through newsletters, social media, video, podcasts, live events and other evolving storytelling platforms.

The Skills and Experiences You Bring:

  • A track record of producing exceptional reporting on science, medicine or related fields.
  • Deep understanding of the scientific process and the ability to critically evaluate research and evidence.
  • Knowledge of the government institutions that support American scientific and biomedical innovation and funding.
  • Excellent reporting, interviewing and source-building skills.
  • A stylish, engaging writing style capable of moving between breaking news, explanatory journalism and narrative storytelling.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex scientific concepts into accessible journalism without sacrificing accuracy.
  • Strong editorial judgment and the ability to identify discoveries with lasting significance.
  • A collaborative mindset and eagerness to work across disciplines.
  • A commitment to scientific rigor, fairness and the highest standards of journalism.

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis until the position is filled, but those received by Sept. 30 will be prioritized. The cover letter should be addressed to Health, Climate & Science Editor Lynh Bui, Deputy Futures Editor Juliet Eilperin and Futures Editor Zachary Goldfarb.

Join the future of news

We’re on a mission to deliver riveting storytelling for all of America. At The Washington Post, you’ll help reinvent news. Our work is driven by a deep investigative spirit and enhanced by innovation to bring audiences closer to the stories that matter most.

Why This Role Matters

 

The Washington Post is seeking a creative, collaborative and visually sophisticated designer to help shape how audiences experience our journalism across digital platforms.


News Design is a team of visual journalists who elevate The Post’s reporting through compelling, reader-centered storytelling. Working across digital formats and platforms, news designers collaborate with journalists throughout the newsroom to create presentations that deepen understanding, capture attention and make our journalism distinctive.


We are looking for a designer with exceptional visual instincts, strong editorial judgment and a passion for solving storytelling problems. The ideal candidate understands how typography, composition, color, imagery and interaction can work together to make journalism clearer and more powerful. They should be equally energized by creating an ambitious custom presentation for a major enterprise story and finding smart, elegant solutions on a tight news deadline.


This is a highly collaborative role. News designers work alongside reporters, editors, photographers, graphics journalists, illustrators and developers, contributing ideas from the earliest stages of a story through publication. We are looking for someone eager to experiment, take thoughtful creative risks and help evolve the visual identity of The Washington Post.


This position is based in our Washington, D.C., newsroom and will require some night and weekend work.


What Motivates You:

  • You believe thoughtful design can fundamentally improve how audiences understand and experience journalism.
  • You enjoy finding the right visual approach for a story through typography, imagery, color, composition and interaction.
  • You are energized by solving complicated storytelling problems and turning them into intuitive reader experiences.
  • You thrive on collaborating with journalists from different disciplines.
  • You enjoy balancing ambitious long-term projects with the urgency of breaking and developing news.
  • You are curious about new technologies, formats and approaches to digital storytelling.

How You’ll Support the Mission:

  • Collaborate with reporters, editors and visual journalists to conceive and build distinctive digital storytelling experiences.
  • Identify stories that would benefit from enhanced visual presentation and help develop the right design approach for each.
  • Create engaging, content-driven designs, illustrations and visual packages that are smart, original and reader-centered.
  • Guide the visual storytelling process from initial concept through publication, incorporating feedback and maintaining a high level of craft throughout.
  • Design experiences that work effectively across desktop, mobile, newsletters, social platforms and other digital surfaces.
  • Partner with developers and other visual journalists on interactive and custom storytelling projects.
  • Contribute to breaking and major news coverage, developing sophisticated visual solutions on tight deadlines.
  • Use art direction, illustration, animation and other techniques when they can strengthen a story.
  • Review work carefully for visual consistency, accessibility and accuracy before publication.
  • Contribute ideas that help evolve The Post’s visual identity and push our digital storytelling forward.

The Skills and Experiences You Bring:

  • A strong portfolio demonstrating excellent visual design, creative thinking, initiative and curiosity.
  • Experience designing digital editorial experiences, interactive applications or other content-rich products.
  • Sophisticated understanding of typography, composition, color, visual hierarchy and information design.
  • Strong editorial instincts and a passion for using design in service of storytelling.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with an ability to build productive relationships across disciplines.
  • A demonstrated ability to manage multiple short- and long-term projects and deliver refined work under deadline pressure.
  • A thoughtful, ethical approach to incorporating new technologies including AI-assisted tools into the design brainstorming process, with sound judgment about where they strengthen the work but knowing human craft and editorial judgment must lead.
  • Experience with art direction, animation, illustration, original artwork or maintaining a cohesive visual identity is a plus.
  • Fluency with design tools such as Figma, Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator.
  • Experience with HTML, CSS or JavaScript and familiarity with modern web frameworks such as React, Svelte, Angular or Vue is a plus.
  • A commitment to accessibility, accuracy and the highest standards of visual journalism.

job.title: Senior Applied Machine Research Scientist, GenAI, Search, & Retrieval
job.description:
Join the future of news
