job.title: Manager, Threat Management
job.description:
Job Description:


About the Team:
The People team at Dow Jones is dedicated to attracting, developing, and retaining world-class talent that drives our mission forward. As strategic partners, we  provide  comprehensive support across the entire employee lifecycle. Our team includes Talent Acquisition, Talent Management, People Business Partners, Compensation, HR Operations, Workplace, and Security—all working together to create an exceptional employee experience. We champion a culture of inclusion, innovation, and excellence, ensuring our people have the resources, support, and opportunities they need to thrive and do their best work.  



About the Role


Based in New York, NY or Washington, DC, the Manager, Threat Management supports the Global Risk, Safety & Resilience (GRSR) team by delivering intelligence-driven insights that enable the organization to identify, assess, and mitigate threats to Dow Jones personnel, journalists, facilities, and operations.


This role serves as a subject-matter expert in threat management and protective intelligence, helping evaluate and mature Dow Jones’ existing threat management capabilities. The Manager will assess current processes, technologies, intelligence sources, monitoring platforms, and investigative workflows to identify capability gaps, redundancies, and opportunities for improvement, and develop recommendations for a more holistic and integrated threat management program.


The position focuses on identifying and evaluating threat actors, targeting behaviors, and emerging risk dynamics that may impact Dow Jones employees, journalists, executives, and public-facing activities. This includes threats such as harassment, intimidation, stalking, doxxing, insider risk indicators, extremist activity, civil unrest, and geopolitical developments that may affect personnel, operations, or events.


A key responsibility of this role is evaluating and improving the organization’s existing threat intelligence and monitoring ecosystem. The Manager will assess the effectiveness of current intelligence providers, digital monitoring capabilities, GSOC and investigative platforms, and other security technologies, making recommendations on how these capabilities should be integrated, enhanced, or evolved to support a sustainable threat management program.


This role is ideal for a technically capable and intellectually curious threat management professional who understands how technology, intelligence, and operational processes can work together to improve threat detection, assessment, and response. The Manager will also identify opportunities to leverage automation, AI-enabled workflows, analytics, and other emerging technologies where they can meaningfully improve the program.


The role also supports investigative activities related to threats and security incidents impacting Dow Jones personnel, ensuring emerging threat indicators are appropriately validated, assessed, escalated, and managed. The Manager will work closely with affected individuals and cross-functional partners, requiring strong judgment, discretion, empathy, and emotional intelligence when supporting individuals experiencing threats, harassment, stalking, or other targeted activity.

You Will


  • Identify and assess threat actors, targeting behaviors, and emerging threat dynamics that may impact Dow Jones personnel, journalists, executives, or facilities.
  • Evaluate existing threat management processes, technologies, intelligence sources, and monitoring capabilities to identify gaps, redundancies, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Develop threat assessments evaluating risks related to harassment, insider threats, geopolitical instability, civil unrest, reputational exposure, or other security concerns affecting the organization.
  • Translate complex intelligence signals into clear and actionable protective intelligence insights for leadership and operational stakeholders.
  • Identify early warning indicators and behavioral escalation signals that may indicate increased threat activity.
  • Assess and optimize the use of threat intelligence, digital monitoring, GSOC, investigative, and other security technology platforms across the threat management lifecycle.
  • Develop recommendations for future-state tools, workflows, and capabilities that strengthen Dow Jones’ overall threat management program.
  • Identify opportunities to leverage automation, analytics, or AI-enabled workflows to improve threat detection, assessment, monitoring, and response.
  • Produce written intelligence products including threat briefs, situational awareness reports, executive briefings, and operational risk summaries.
  • Provide intelligence insights that support operational planning, travel safety, newsroom assignments, executive protection, and event security.
  • Assess online threats, harassment campaigns, doxxing activity, insider risk indicators, or other forms of targeted behavior directed toward Dow Jones personnel.
  • Support and conduct investigations related to threats or security incidents affecting employees, journalists, executives, or facilities.
  • Brief stakeholders across security, editorial, and leadership teams on emerging threats, assessments, and risk implications.
  • Build and maintain relationships with relevant law enforcement and external partners to support the escalation and resolution of threats impacting Dow Jones personnel or operations.
  • Serve as a trusted threat management resource to internal partners across the organization.

 

You Have


  • 7+ years of experience in threat management, protective intelligence, geopolitical risk analysis, or related disciplines.
  • Experience developing or improving intelligence monitoring workflows that automate the aggregation of intelligence feeds and operational reporting into centralized dashboards, alerts, or situational awareness tools.
  • Strong technical aptitude and intellectual curiosity, with demonstrated experience leveraging intelligence, digital risk, GSOC, and investigative platforms to improve threat detection, assessment, monitoring, and case management.
  • Experience conducting protective intelligence analysis or threat assessments involving targeted threats against individuals or organizations.
  • Demonstrated ability to aggregate intelligence from multiple sources - including external intelligence providers, internal monitoring capabilities, and open-source reporting - and translate those inputs into actionable threat assessments and operational risk insights.
  • Strong understanding of OSINT, digital monitoring methodologies, threat actor analysis, and online targeting behaviors.
  • Experience producing written intelligence assessments, situational awareness reports, and executive briefings.
  • Strong analytical judgment and communication skills, with the ability to evaluate credibility, intent, escalation risk, and operational impact.
  • High emotional intelligence and interpersonal judgment, with the ability to build trust and communicate empathetically and professionally with individuals experiencing threats, harassment, stalking, or other targeted activity.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional partners across security, legal, HR, editorial, cyber, and operational teams.
  • Ability to operate effectively in dynamic environments where emerging threats require rapid synthesis of intelligence, sound judgment, and timely decision support.


Preferred Qualities

  • Experience collaborating with cybersecurity teams or digital risk functions to assess cyber-enabled threats impacting personnel, operations, or brand reputation.
  • Familiarity with insider threat indicators, behavioral risk signals, or insider threat management programs.
  • Familiarity with structured analytic techniques or intelligence methodologies used to evaluate threat actors and emerging risks.
  • Experience working within corporate protective intelligence, threat intelligence, cybersecurity intelligence, or security intelligence programs.
  • Familiarity with the convergence of cyber, physical, geopolitical, and reputational risks affecting global organizations.
  • Experience analyzing online threat ecosystems, including harassment campaigns, doxxing activity, coordinated targeting, or other digitally enabled threats.
  • International operational experience across diverse regions or security environments.
  • Certifications such as CTIA, CICA, CISSP, Security+, GCTI, or similar.

  • Paid Time Off

job.title: People Experience Program Manager
job.description:
Job Description:



About the Role

As People Experience Program Manager, you’ll focus on the details behind the employee experience, getting into the smaller interactions, handoffs and moments that shape how employees and managers experience People Team support.


You’ll look at how things work today, understand where there is friction or unnecessary effort, and help find better ways of doing things. You’ll work across the People team to connect the details of individual experiences with the wider employee journey, making sure improvements are joined up rather than solving one problem in isolation.


Working in our Midtown Manhattan office 3 days a week and reporting to the Senior Manager, People Experience, you will collaborate closely with cross-functional process owners to embed an intuitive employee and manager perspective into the core operations supporting our wider People Experience.


This is a role for someone who enjoys getting into the details, spotting patterns, challenging how things are done, and turning problems into practical improvements. You’ll work with People Experience, People Operations, People Business Partners, Centers of Excellence and Technology teams, bringing a broad view of how People support works across Dow Jones.


You Will

  • Get into the detail of individual People experiences and the employee & manager moments that matter
  • Spot the small things that create friction and unnecessary effort, such as extra steps, repeated information, unclear ownership, poor handoffs or confusing communications
  • Look across teams and systems to understand how different parts of the experience connect and how they shape the wider employee journey
  • Work closely with the People Process Manager and process owners to surface friction, dependencies and opportunities that may not be visible when looking at the experience end to end
  • Use employee feedback, case trends, service data, focus groups and other listening methods to understand employee experiences, identify patterns and uncover areas worth exploring
  • Break complex experiences down into individual steps and challenge whether each one is needed, where effort can be removed and where the experience could be simpler
  • Work with PX, People Operations, PBPs and specialist teams to understand different perspectives and find practical solutions
  • Turn personas, user stories and pain points into clear ideas and recommendations across service, technology, ways of working or communication
  • Explore where self-service, automation, AI and existing technology could remove unnecessary effort or improve the experience
  • Test ideas with employees, managers and People teams, using feedback to refine solutions
  • Connect related employee moments and experiences across the lifecycle, helping avoid disconnected fixes
  • Create simple journey maps, experience views and guidance where they help people understand how something works
  • Work with People Technology and system owners to identify opportunities to improve HR systems, workflows and digital tools
  • Bring the employee and manager perspective to wider People experience and transformation work
  • Track whether changes are making a difference, including employee effort, repeat contact, satisfaction and service trends
  • Share useful findings and ideas across the People team so improvements can be applied beyond a single process or team

You Have

  • 7+ years of experience in HR, Operations, Employee Experience, service design, transformation or a similar environment
  • Experience using feedback, data, case trends or other insight to identify patterns and opportunities
  • An understanding of the employee lifecycle and the ways of working that sit behind it
  • A naturally curious mindset and a willingness to ask why things work the way they do
  • Experience getting into the detail of challenges and finding ways to improve them
  • Strong problem-solving skills, from understanding the root cause through to finding practical solutions
  • The ability to see both the detail and the bigger picture
  • Experience working across different teams and bringing people together around a problem
  • An interest in HR technology, automation and AI, with a focus on how they can genuinely make things simpler
  • The ability to take something complicated and explain it clearly
  • Strong organization skills and the ability to manage multiple pieces of work at once
  • A practical approach with the goal of improving things, not just documenting what is wrong
  • Willingness to work in our Midtown Manhattan office 3 days a week
  • Experience working across global teams or processes (preferred)
  • An understanding of how employees and managers interact with People services and technology (preferred)
  • Experience working with Workday, ServiceNow HRSD or similar People technology platforms (preferred)
  • Experience using AI, automation or digital tools to improve individual employee experiences (preferred)
  • Experience mapping employee journeys, interactions and handoffs to identify friction and opportunities to improve (preferred)
  • Experience working with different People teams to test and improve how an experience works end to end (preferred)

You'll Get

  • The opportunity to help shape the new People Experience model at Dow Jones
  • The chance to have a real influence on how employees and managers experience People support
  • Exposure to a wide range of People teams, processes, systems and technology
  • The opportunity to work on global processes and problems across Dow Jones
  • Hands-on exposure to AI, automation and new technology, with a focus on making People support simpler and more human
  • A role where curiosity, challenge and practical ideas are valued
  • Opportunities to build your experience across People Experience, process improvement, technology and employee experience
  • A supportive environment with professional development

job.title: People Operations & Compliance Analyst
job.description:
Job Description:


About the Team:
The People team at Dow Jones is dedicated to attracting, developing, and retaining world-class talent that drives our mission forward. As strategic partners, we  provide  comprehensive support across the entire employee lifecycle. Our team includes Talent Acquisition, Talent Management, People Business Partners, Compensation, HR Operations, Workplace, and Security—all working together to create an exceptional employee experience. We champion a culture of inclusion, innovation, and excellence, ensuring our people have the resources, support, and opportunities they need to thrive and do their best work.  


About the Role

The People Operations & Compliance Analyst supports the execution of Dow Jones' global HR compliance program while contributing to the effective delivery of Global People Operations.

Working closely with the Senior Manager, People Operations & Compliance, the role will have a primary focus on HR compliance, policy governance, regulatory monitoring, audit and assurance activities, data integrity, and compliance-related process execution. The Analyst will also support broader People Operations priorities, including operational reporting, data validation, process documentation, controls and continuous improvement.

This role sits within the Global HR Operations & Compliance team and works closely with People Operations, People Technology, Legal, Compensation and other People Team functions to help ensure People processes are compliant, accurate, well-controlled and scalable. You will be based in our New York office.


You Will:

Global HR Compliance & Policy

  • Support the day-to-day execution of global HR compliance programs, processes and controls across the employee lifecycle.
  • Monitor and track employment legislation and regulatory developments across global markets, escalating relevant changes and supporting resulting policy, process, system, communication and training activity.
  • Support the development, maintenance and governance of global HR policies, employee handbooks and related documentation.
  • Maintain global compliance calendars, trackers, regulatory requirements and supporting documentation.
  • Support internal and external HR audit and assurance activities, including recurring compliance reviews and ISO/ISAE requirements.
  • Maintain audit-ready documentation, process maps, controls, evidence and other compliance records.
  • Support global compliance initiatives including working time and time tracking, medical accommodations, pay equity and other emerging employment requirements.
  • Partner with Legal and appropriate local experts to gather requirements and help translate regulatory requirements into practical People processes and controls.
  • Partner with People Technology and People Operations to support implementation and testing of compliance-related system and process requirements.
  • Support compliance education and communications by coordinating materials, documentation and implementation activity.

People Operations & Data

  • Support operational processes and projects across Global People Operations, particularly where compliance, controls or data integrity are critical.
  • Perform data validation, reconciliation and quality assurance across People data, identifying discrepancies and coordinating resolution. 
  • Support recurring reporting and analysis, including compliance metrics, operational reporting and dashboards.
  • Assist with audits and controls related to employee and People data, ensuring accuracy, completeness and appropriate documentation.
  • Maintain SOPs, process documentation and controls to support consistent global execution.
  • Support operational escalations and cross-functional issues requiring research, data analysis or coordination across People functions.
  • Identify recurring issues, process gaps and opportunities for simplification, standardization or automation.

Cross-Functional Partnership & Continuous Improvement

  • Partner across Global People Operations, People Technology, Compensation, Legal, People Experience, PBPs and COEs to support effective implementation of People programs and requirements.
  • Support projects that require coordination between policy requirements, People data and operational execution.
  • Contribute to the continued development of the Global HR Operations & Compliance operating model, including clearer controls, documentation, reporting and ways of working.
  • Support ad hoc analysis and operational initiatives based on evolving People Team priorities.

You Have:

  • 2–4 years of experience in HR Compliance, People/HR Operations, HR Analytics, Compensation Operations or a related field.
  • Experience supporting HR compliance, policy, audit, controls or other risk-related activities preferred.
  • Strong analytical skills with demonstrated experience reviewing, validating and reconciling data.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to manage recurring requirements, deadlines and documentation across multiple workstreams.
  • Ability to research requirements, identify relevant information and translate findings into clear actions.
  • Strong process orientation with an interest in improving how work is documented, controlled and delivered.
  • Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills; experience with Workday, ServiceNow or similar HR systems preferred.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively across functions and geographies.
  • Experience working within a global or complex organization is preferred.

job.title: People Process & Solutions Manager
job.description:
Job Description:



About the Role

As the Manager, People Process & Solutions within the People Operations team at Dow Jones, you will serve as the architect of our operational efficiency. You'll be a critical link between our current global state and our AI-powered, self-service future. You will own the documentation of processes for the People team, and design and refine process changes to ensure any HR workflow is as AI-optimized, simplified, and compliant as possible.


Working 3 days a week in our Midtown office and reporting to the Director, People Technology & Solutions, you'll partner closely with People COEs and the Dow Jones People Technology team, to document, design and transform processes.


You Will

  • Act as the go-to person for HR process architecture
  • Develop and maintain a global service catalogue, ensuring consistency, compliance, and clarity across all regions and the People team
  • Serve as a technical lead for AI & Automation within People Ops, contributing to the evolution of best practices and ways of working
  • Lead end-to-end process discovery and mapping to identify bottlenecks, compliance risks, and redundancies
  • Define clear ownership frameworks (RACI/RAD) for cross-functional HR workflows, ensuring accountability and preventing fragmentation in global operations
  • Design and refine streamlined and standardized Future State processes that are lean, self-service, scalable, compliant and AI/automation ready
  • Establish, track, and report on key process health metrics
  • Actively monitor cycle times, process compliance, error rates, and volume to identify opportunities to improve
  • Collaborate extensively across HR, Tech, and legal/compliance functions
  • Bridge the gap between HR business needs and the technical requirements of Workday, ServiceNow and emerging AI tools


You Have

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business, IT, or a related field or comparable work experience
  • 7+ years of experience in HR Operations, Business Process Outsourcing (BPO), Management Consulting or a similar role within a global organization
  • Proven ability to document complex current-state vs. future-state gap analysis, whilst managing stakeholders
  • Demonstrated success working in a cross-functional, matrixed, global environment
  • Ability to navigate complex stakeholder landscapes, challenge the status quo, and act as a disciplined gatekeeper for process quality
  • A proactive interest in AI transformation and an understanding that good process is a prerequisite for AI
  • A motivation driven by the challenge of preparing HR for the future
  • A strong understanding of Workday HCM and ServiceNow HRSD platforms or similar (preferred)
  • A strong understanding of AI agents, workflow design and automation (preferred)
  • Experience with process mining tools and data analytics (preferred)
  • An advanced degree or professional certifications in Lean Six Sigma or similar (preferred)

job.title: Platform Partnerships Manager
job.description:
Job Description:




About the Team
The Strategic Partnerships team manages Dow Jones’ strategic relationships with major technology and distribution platforms, working across brands including The Wall Street Journal, Barron’s and MarketWatch.


The team partners closely with Editorial, Product, Marketing, Finance and other functions to maximize the audience and commercial value of these relationships. Combining partnership strategy, data and performance insights, the team identifies opportunities to grow engagement, strengthen distribution and drive measurable business results.


About the Role
As a core member of this team, the Platform Partnerships Manager is the operational engine supporting the Senior Platform Partnerships Manager in managing the health of the business.


Your mission is to ensure the smooth execution of Dow Jones’ high-profile partnerships on platforms like Apple News and Snapchat. You will bridge the gap between high-level strategy and day-to-day execution, ensuring that our internal workflows are seamless, our data is impeccable, and our performance is tracked with precision.


You Will
Drive Internal Synergy: Facilitate coordination across newsrooms, marketing, product, and finance by acting as the "connective tissue" that keeps multiple internal groups aligned on partnership goals.


Master Performance Data: Take full ownership of KPI tracking by monitoring and visualizing performance data to provide actionable insights into how our brands are performing on third-party platforms.


Optimize Content Experience: Support the Senior Manager in auditing and improving the user experience for Dow Jones content on platform partner apps.


Streamline Business Operations: Navigate the business lifecycle of our partnerships by managing contract routing and financial workflows (such as purchase orders and billing) to ensure projects move forward without friction.


Orchestrate Complex Logistics: Manage the cadence of the partnership team by organizing cross-functional meetings and managing calendars to ensure all stakeholders are engaged at the right time.


Reporting directly to the Senior Platform Partnerships Manager, you will work in our Midtown Manhattan office 3 days a week.


You Have

Digital Media Fluency: 7 years of experience in digital media, account management, or operations with an understanding of the platform partnerships ecosystem. Ideally, you have pulled and analyzed audience data, identified engagement opportunities, built performance reporting, recommended optimizations, worked with editorial/newsroom teams to implement them, and measured the resulting impact.


Exceptional Organizational Rigor: You are a highly effective project manager who thrives on creating order out of complexity and never lets a detail slip through the cracks.


Expert Data & Spreadsheet Skills: This is a core requirement. You must be highly proficient in Excel/Google Sheets, comfortable manipulating large datasets and translating numbers into clear performance updates.


AI-First Mindset: You are an early adopter of AI tools and use them proactively to automate repetitive workflows, summarize data, and increase your overall output.


Internal Influence: You are able to communicate effectively across diverse departments (from Legal to Editorial) to get contracts signed and projects approved.


Education: You have a Bachelor’s degree in Business, Data Analytics, Communications, or a related field or equivalent experience.


Flexibility: You are willing and able to work on-site in our Midtown Manhattan office 3 days each week.

job.title: Principal - Finance Operations (Dow Jones Technology)
job.description:
Job Description:


About the Role:

 As Principal - Finance Operations, you will transform Technology Finance Operations from a manual, spreadsheet-driven function into an AI-enabled, systems-oriented operating model that delivers greater speed, transparency, and operational leverage. 

You will own the business and financial operating cadence for Technology Operations while helping redesign how planning, governance, and execution works across both capital and operating investments. You will lead the redesign of the FY28 budget process, modernizing how Product, Engineering, and Design triads operate alongside PMO partners, business stakeholders and executives, and build scalable operating systems that allow Technology to accelerate with precision and accountability. 

This is a rare opportunity to build an operating model rather than inherit one. You will help shape how Technology plans investments, governs execution, and measures performance across a $300M+ portfolio while partnering directly with senior Technology and Finance leadership. 

You will report to the Vice President - Head of Financial Operations. 

About the Team:

Technology Operations is in the middle of a significant operating-model transformation: shifting from initiative tracking to OKR-driven governance, driving a vendor-partnered efficiency transformation, consolidating location strategy around strategic hubs, and redesigning processes with automation and AI-enabled capabilities at the core. Business Operations helps translate these strategic priorities into measurable operational and financial outcomes.

Working across Technology, Finance, Sourcing, Human Resources, the PMO, and external vendors, our team provides the operational discipline, financial stewardship, and governance needed to turn strategy into execution, enable better investment decisions, and build a simpler, more scalable operating model.

You Will:

  • Own the Technology Operations business management function, establishing the operating rhythm for planning, forecasting, decision support, governance, and execution

  • Lead the redesign of the FY28 budget process

  • Oversee the operating cadence for the $300M+ Product & Technology budget

  • Reengineer recurring financial and operational workflows by replacing manual processes with automation, intelligent workflows, and durable management systems

  • Partner with Finance, Sourcing, Human Resources, PMO, and Technology Executive and other stakeholders to translate strategic priorities into annual and multi-year operating plans

  • Improve governance and planning across triads by strengthening decision-making, planning discipline, accountability, and operating transparency in partnership with PMO leadership

  • Build and continuously evolve executive dashboards, KPIs, and operating reviews

  • Oversee vendor and investment governance across a complex technology portfolio

  • Establish scalable governance and financial controls across planning, forecasting, reporting, capitalization, and monthly operating reviews

  • Identify and deliver cost optimization opportunities while protecting service quality, resiliency, and long-term transformation objectives

  • Continuously raise the standard for business operations, financial stewardship, systems thinking, and execution excellence

You Have:

  • 12+ years’ experience in business operations, financial operations, FP&A, PMO, strategic planning, or related leadership roles supporting technology, infrastructure, or enterprise operations

  • Significant experience managing budgets, forecasts, business cases, capitalization planning, and executive financial reporting within complex organizations

  • A proven track record of redesigning operating models, governance frameworks, planning processes, or business management functions

  • Demonstrated success leading cross-functional transformation in ambiguous, high-impact environments while influencing senior leaders across multiple functions

  • Strong expertise in financial operations, vendor management, investment governance, cost optimization, and executive reporting

  • Experience designing executive dashboards, KPIs, and operating review mechanisms that improve business decisions

  • Proven ability to translate strategic priorities into structured plans, measurable outcomes, and repeatable operating systems

  • Ability to influence senior stakeholders and align organizations without direct authority.

  • A systems-thinking mindset with sound business judgment and a bias toward simplification, standardization, and continuous improvement

  • Experience designing, implementing, or leading the adoption of automation, analytics, dashboards, or AI-enabled workflows that materially reduced manual work in finance, planning, or business operations

  • Comfort working hands-on with automation, advanced analytics, and modern technology to improve cycle time, quality, and operational effectiveness

  • Bachelor's degree -or- equivalent practical experience

job.title: Principal Consultant
job.description:
Job Description:

About Our Organization:

Dow Jones is a global provider of news and business information, delivering content to consumers and organizations around the world across multiple formats, including print, digital, mobile and live events. Dow Jones has produced unrivalled quality content for more than 130 years and today has one of the world’s largest news-gathering operations globally. It is home to leading publications and products including the flagship Wall Street Journal, America’s largest newspaper by paid circulation; Barron’s, MarketWatch, Mansion Global, Financial News, Investor’s Business Daily, Factiva, Dow Jones Risk & Compliance, Dow Jones Newswires, and Dow Jones Energy with multiple heritage brands (OPIS, Chemical Market Analytics (CMA), PetroChem Wire, Axxis, A2i and Eco-Movement). Dow Jones is a division of News Corp (Nasdaq: NWS, NWSA; ASX: NWS, NWSLV).

 

About the Team:

Dow Jones Energy enables energy and chemical stakeholders around the global to improve operational efficiency and make strategic decisions with deep insights, future outlooks, price discovery and consultation from a celebrated team of subject matter experts. We offer short- and long-term market coverage for more than 200 core building-block chemicals with a full suite of advisory services and top-tier events held around the globe. Our bespoke consulting team has experience from upstream oil, gas, and minerals operations to chemicals, plastics and downstream end-use markets. This rich expertise equips us with a deep understanding of the industry’s most significant challenges, allowing us to collaborate closely and deliver the best solution that fits the needs of our clients. The worldwide chemical and energy industry looks to Dow Jones Energy to guide decisions and help manage risk across the entire value chain.

 

Job Summary:

Principal Consultant is a leadership position in our bespoke consulting practice, with a responsibility to develop, quote, lead and conduct bespoke research consulting projects covering multiple business lines including energy, feedstocks, olefins, plastics, aromatics, inorganics, syngas, and other materials. This is an opportunity for highly experienced consulting professional having in-depth knowledge of the chemical, petrochemical, refining and energy industries across various regions. The role involves taking ownership of the project execution, client relationship and mentoring the consulting team.

The position is based at our Dubai office and will require working closely with our global team on a regular basis.

 

Key Responsibilities:

  • Take ownership of projects executed from Dubai office and ensure timely delivery of projects. 
  • Actively manage the consultancy project team, including team members assigned to projects from other regions, and ensure smooth execution of projects.
  • Utilise both internal and external subject matter experts to provide in-depth analysis.
  • Support consulting directors and senior management in implementing projects.
  • Manage, guide and mentor the analyst and consulting team through successful completion of project tasks.
  • Interface with clients and present the study findings.
  • Participate in business development activities and assist in proposal writing for the consulting business.
  • Participate in resource planning, performance appraisal and recruiting processes.
  • Contribute to team discussions on various consulting projects as a knowledgeable stakeholder.
  • Travel on an ad-hoc basis.

 

Qualifications:

  • A minimum of B.Sc./B.Eng./B.Tech. degree in chemical engineering or chemistry is required.
  • A postgraduate degree in science or business management will be considered as an advantage.

 

Experience:

  • At least 7 years of experience in a commercial or techno-economic role in the energy, refining or petrochemical industry or within energy/petrochemical market consultancy is required.
  • Proven track record in successfully leading consulting or similar projects
  • In-depth understanding of the energy and petrochemicals business, the structure of industry, the production technologies, and economic aspects such as markets and pricing is important.

 

Skills:

  • High level of analytical and project management skills.
  • Appropriate level of technical knowledge and industry insight to be able to effectively guide the consulting team and lead discussions with clients
  • Articulate in English with excellent communication skills for client interaction and team collaboration.
  • Additional language skills are a plus.
  • Proficiency in MS Office suite of programs.

job.title: Principal Product Designer - Market Data
job.description:
Job Description:


About the Role:

As Principal Product Designer - Market Data, you will own the design strategy for our Market Data platform—the real-time quotes, charting, watchlists, screeners, and visualization systems that power how millions of people read and act on financial markets across The Wall Street Journal, Barron's, MarketWatch, and Investor's Business Daily. This is a senior individual-contributor role for someone who sets direction across our financial brands and is the go-to design expert for how Dow Jones presents market data.

Market Data connects across every one of our financial brands, and this role sets the design strategy that spans all of them. Your decisions will establish shared patterns—for quotes, charts, tables, portfolios, and alerts—that these brands build on. You will own the direction for how investors of every kind, from first-time savers to sophisticated professionals, interpret dense, fast-moving data and turn it into confident decisions, balancing the distinct needs of each brand against the consistency and quality users expect wherever they encounter our data.

And this reach won't stop at the consumer. Market and pricing data runs across much of Dow Jones—so your influence will extend well beyond the consumer brands into our professional and enterprise products, from Factiva and Dow Jones Risk & Compliance to Dow Jones Energy, wherever market data underpins the experience. Where data meets the broader product, you will be the design lead who makes it cohere.

This is a role of real influence and scope. You will shape strategy with senior leadership, resolve tension between individual brand priorities and platform consistency, define the market-data patterns that live in our Index Design System, and mentor senior designers across the financial brands. You will be the design authority for your domain—navigating ambiguity and setting the standard others in your area build on.

You will report to the VP of Product Design within the Design & Research organization.

About the Team:

Our Design & Research org brings together world-class designers and researchers with a unified purpose: to connect people to the news and information that matters most. We're the strategic force that transforms deep user understanding into exceptional product experiences across our entire portfolio—from The Wall Street Journal to Factiva.

Our integrated approach ensures that research insights directly shape design decisions, while design explorations reveal new research opportunities. Together, we're building coherent, accessible experiences that honor our 135-year legacy while pushing us boldly into the future. We're a globally distributed team spearheading a digital transformation at Dow Jones, newly staffed by industry leaders from Google, LinkedIn, The New York Times, and more. Through our combined expertise in design craft and research rigor, we ensure that millions of users can depend on our platforms for truth in a world full of noise.

You Will:

  • Own the design strategy for the Market Data platform across our financial brands—setting a coherent, multi-year direction for quotes, charting, watchlists, screeners, portfolios, and data visualization that spans The Wall Street Journal, Barron's, MarketWatch, and IBD, and connecting it to measurable outcomes like engagement, retention, and revenue

  • Shape strategy with senior leadership. Present your design direction for the Market Data platform to senior design, product, and business leaders—and to executives where the work warrants—building the partnerships that advance it across brands and making the case for how well-designed data experiences create competitive advantage

  • Solve the hard, ambiguous problems in your domain—developing new patterns, methods, and approaches for presenting complex financial information across multiple brands, and building a deep understanding of the problem space that lets you see opportunities ahead

  • Shape the market-data patterns in our Index Design System. Establish the charting, data-table, real-time, and visualization standards that become the norm across the financial brands—knowing when consistency serves the user and when a brand's audience warrants a tailored approach—and help adjacent teams adopt and evolve them

  • Extend your influence beyond our consumer brands into the wider portfolio—the professional and enterprise products, from Factiva and Risk & Compliance to Newswires and OPIS, where market and pricing data is just as central—so the experiences built on our data share the same clarity, rigor, and craft. Be the design lead wherever data shapes the product

  • Set a high bar for craft. Define what excellence looks like for dense, real-time financial information—typography, information density, motion, and the accessibility of complex tables and charts—and ensure consistent quality across the brands through design reviews and audits

  • Connect design to outcomes. Partner with Research and analytics to tie your decisions to engagement, retention, and subscription metrics, and help teams across the financial brands understand which measures matter for market-data experiences

  • Mentor and grow senior designers across the financial brands, shape a strong design culture, and strengthen the talent pipeline through the standards you set and the craft you share

You Have:

  • 10+ years of product design experience, including significant time owning complex, systems-level or platform work, with a track record of setting design direction that spans multiple products or brands

  • Deep expertise designing data-rich experiences—financial data, analytics, dashboards, data visualization, or other complex information display—where clarity, density, and trust matter as much as visual polish

  • A portfolio that demonstrates strategic impact across multiple products or brands: platform or design-system contributions, cross-team pattern-setting, and strong end-to-end craft on sophisticated products

  • A proven ability to influence senior stakeholders, translating design strategy into business terms and building alignment across teams whose priorities compete

  • Mastery of data visualization and information design—charting, tables, real-time data, progressive disclosure—and the judgment to know when complexity serves the user and when it gets in the way

  • Strong systems thinking and deep experience with design systems, including establishing patterns that other teams adopt and evolve

  • Excellence in Figma, with the ability to set standards for design communication, specifications, and documentation across teams

  • A deep command of design fundamentals and accessibility standards (WCAG), with particular fluency in making dense, complex data usable for everyone

  • A track record of mentoring designers and helping raise the craft and quality of the teams around you

  • Comfort operating in ambiguity—setting direction in your domain amid shifting priorities and emerging technology, and acting as the go-to expert others turn to

  • Bachelor's degree in Design, HCI, related field -OR- equivalent experience 

Nice to Have

  • Experience designing for financial services, investing, trading, or fintech products

  • Familiarity with real-time or streaming data systems and the constraints they place on design

  • Working knowledge of financial concepts—markets, instruments, portfolio construction—sufficient to partner deeply with domain experts

  • Background in news media, publishing, or other content-heavy products

  • Experience designing across a multi-brand portfolio

  • Experience contributing meaningfully to a design system

  • An external presence through speaking or writing on data visualization, information design, or design at scale

  • International or cross-cultural design experience

job.title: Principal Product Designer - Subscription Growth (Acquisition)
job.description:
Job Description:


About the Role:

As Principal Product Designer - Subscription Growth (Acquisition), you will define the future of subscriber growth across Dow Jones' portfolio of brands, including The Wall Street Journal, Barron's, MarketWatch, Investor's Business Daily, and future subscription products.

In this senior individual contributor role that operates at the intersection of design strategy, business strategy, and growth, you'll establish the long-term vision for how prospective customers discover, evaluate, and subscribe across our Commerce ecosystem - spanning registration, paywalls, shop experiences, pricing and packaging, checkout, identity, and experimentation.

You will partner closely with Product, Marketing, Brand, Engineering, Research, Analytics, and executive leadership to solve highly ambiguous challenges and shape investment priorities that accelerate subscriber growth. Your work will define scalable Commerce patterns, influence our acquisition platform strategy, and connect design decisions to measurable business outcomes across multiple brands.

Beyond delivering exceptional product experiences, you'll mentor senior designers, elevate design quality across Commerce, and establish standards that scale throughout the organization.You will report to the Director of Product Design, Commerce.

About The Team:

Our Design & Research org brings together world-class designers and researchers with a unified purpose: to connect people to the news and information that matters most. We're the strategic force that transforms deep user understanding into exceptional product experiences across our entire portfolio—from The Wall Street Journal to Factiva.

Our integrated approach ensures that research insights directly shape design decisions, while design explorations reveal new research opportunities. Together, we're building coherent, accessible experiences that honor our 135-year legacy while pushing us boldly into the future. We're a globally distributed team spearheading a digital transformation at Dow Jones, newly staffed by industry leaders from Google, LinkedIn, The New York Times, and more. Through our combined expertise in design craft and research rigor, we ensure that millions of users can depend on our platforms for truth in a world full of noise.

You Will:

  • Define the long-term design strategy for subscriber growth across multiple Dow Jones brands.

  • Lead highly ambiguous, business-critical initiatives spanning registration, identity, paywalls, shop experiences, pricing, packaging, checkout, and experimentation.

  • Partner with senior leadership across Product, Marketing, Brand, Engineering, Research, and Analytics to shape roadmap priorities and strategic investments.

  • Create scalable acquisition patterns, frameworks, and interaction models that extend our Index Design System and can be reused across brands.

  • Drive experimentation strategy by identifying high-impact opportunities throughout the acquisition funnel and translating insights into long-term product improvements.

  • Translate customer research, behavioral data, market trends, and business goals into experiences that improve acquisition performance while maintaining a high bar for user experience.

  • Lead strategic design explorations, vision work, and cross-functional workshops that align teams around future Commerce investments.

  • Mentor junior and mid-level designers through design reviews, coaching, and thoughtful feedback that elevates craft across the organization.

  • Influence how Commerce measures success by defining experience quality metrics alongside conversion, acquisition, and revenue KPIs.

  • Represent Commerce Design within the broader Design & Research organization while contributing to company-wide design strategy and thought leadership.

You Have:

  • 10+ years of product design experience leading complex digital products.

  • Portfolio demonstrating systems thinking, product vision, and measurable business impact.

  • Experience leading highly ambiguous, cross-functional initiatives.

  • Exceptional interaction, visual, systems, and service design skills.

  • Demonstrated success influencing senior stakeholders and driving alignment across disciplines.

  • Experience defining design systems, reusable frameworks, and scalable product patterns.

  • Outstanding communication and storytelling skills.

job.title: Principal Product Designer - Wall Street Journal Enterprise Products
job.description:
Job Description:


About the Team:

Our Technology team drives the evolution of our Technology, Engineering, Data, Product and User Experience functions. With a keen focus on delivering cutting-edge solutions, we shape the digital landscape for our customers, readers and users. From revolutionizing visuals to optimizing tools and harnessing the power of data, mobile, video and social platforms, our team is committed to providing a seamless and immersive experience across all touchpoints. Collaborating closely with our newsrooms and strategic partners, we spearhead the development of groundbreaking products and technologies.

About Dow Jones Design & Research:

Our Design & Research org brings together world-class designers and researchers with a unified purpose: to connect people to the news and information that matters most. We're the strategic force that transforms deep user understanding into exceptional product experiences across our entire portfolio—from The Wall Street Journal to Factiva.

Together, we're building coherent, accessible experiences that honor our 135-year foundation while pushing us boldly into the future. We're a globally distributed team spearheading a digital transformation at Dow Jones, newly staffed by industry leaders from Google, LinkedIn, The New York Times, and more. Through our joint expertise in design craft and research rigor, we ensure that millions of users can depend on our platforms for truth in a world full of noise.

About the Role:

We're seeking a Principal Product Designer to own the design strategy for our WSJ enterprise products—professional experiences that bring The Wall Street Journal and the wider Dow Jones portfolio to the businesses and institutions that rely on our journalism to make informed decisions. In this a senior individual-contributor role, you will set the direction for one of our growth areas and become a go-to design expert on how Dow Jones serves enterprise and professional customers.

Enterprise customers don’t always consume content the way consumers do. Designing for them means thinking beyond the article—how a professional finds what's relevant to their work, how an organization manages access for its employees, and how our trusted journalism earns a place in the working day of decision-makers. You'll hold enterprise design to the high bar set by our consumer products and be tightly integrated with the platforms guaranteeing these decision-makers are empowered with WSJ + Dow Jones content.

This is a role with influence and scope. You'll shape strategy with senior design, product, and business leadership, resolve the tension between enterprise requirements and consumer-grade craft, contribute to the enterprise patterns that live in our Index Design System, and mentor senior designers across both our professional and consumer brands. You'll be the design authority for your domain—navigating ambiguity and setting the standard others build upon.

You will report to the SVP of Product Design within the Design & Research organization.

You Will:

  • Own the design strategy for our enterprise experiences. Set a coherent, multi-year direction for how professional customers discover, read, and act on our journalism, and tie it to measurable outcomes such as seat growth, engagement, renewal, and expansion

  • Own the admin experience that powers the reader experience. Design how organizations manage seats, assign content, and understand engagement across their teams

  • Hold enterprise work to the Journal's standard of craft. Bring the typography, information design, and attention to detail that characterize our consumer products into a business environment, and help set the bar for what enterprise design quality means at Dow Jones

  • Shape strategy with senior leadership. Present your direction to senior design, product, and business leaders, and to other executives where needed, building the partnerships that move great design forward across a field of competing priorities

  • Establish further patterns in our Index Design System—the components, density, navigation, and permission-aware behavior that professional products depend on—knowing when conformity with our consumer brands serves the user and when a professional audience warrants a different approach

  • Solve the hard, ambiguous problems in your domain. Professional workflows, AI-assisted features users must trust, and personalization that must earn its place are problems devoid of clear precedent. You'll create clarity where none exists and develop the approaches others adopt

  • Connect design to outcomes. Partner with Research and analytics to tie your decisions to engagement, retention, and revenue, and help teams understand which measures actually matter for a professional product

  • Mentor and grow senior designers across our professional and consumer brands, shape a strong design culture, and strengthen the talent pipeline through the standards you set and the craft you share

You Have:

  • 10+ years of product design experience, including significant time owning complex, systems-level or platform work, with a track record of setting design direction that spans multiple products or audiences

  • Depth in both enterprise and consumer design. You've built products for professional users with real workflows and real constraints, and you hold that work to the standard of the best consumer experiences. This combination is the core requirement of the role.

  • Experience designing professional platforms—workspaces, dashboards, personalized feeds, admin and permissions tooling

  • A portfolio that demonstrates strategic impact across multiple products or audiences: platform or design-system contributions, cross-team pattern-setting, and strong end-to-end craft on sophisticated products

  • A proven ability to influence senior stakeholders, translating design strategy into business terms and building alignment across teams whose priorities compete

  • Strong systems thinking and deep experience with design systems, including establishing patterns that other teams adopt and evolve

  • Judgment about personalization and AI-assisted experiences—when they genuinely help a professional user, when they diminish trust, and how to design for these scenarios

  • Excellence in Figma, with the ability to set standards for design communication, specifications, and documentation across teams

  • A deep command of design fundamentals and accessibility compliance standards (WCAG), with fluency in dense, information-rich interfaces

  • A track record of mentoring designers and helping raise the craft and quality of the teams around you

  • Comfort operating amid ambiguity—setting direction in your domain during shifting priorities and emerging technology, and acting as the go-to expert others turn to

  • Bachelor's degree -or- equivalent work experience in Design, HCI, or a comparable field

Nice to Have:

  • Experience designing B2B information services, professional intelligence, or research platforms

  • Familiarity with entitlements, seat management, or permissions models at enterprise scale

  • Experience shipping AI-assisted features—summarization, recommendation, or generative content—in production products

  • Background in news media, publishing, or other content-heavy products

  • Experience designing across a multi-brand portfolio

  • Experience contributing productively to a design system

  • Experience partnering with external research, brand, or design agencies

  • Working knowledge of financial services, consulting, or other professional-services industries

  • An external presence through speaking or writing on design at scale

  • International or cross-cultural design experience

job.title: Principal Product Manager - Subscriber Lifecycle
job.description:
Job Description:


About the Role:

As Principal Product Manager - Subscriber Lifecycle, you will own the product responsible for showing new customers the value of their subscription, building the habits that keep them engaged, and giving them compelling reasons to stay subscribed across The Wall Street Journal and other Dow Jones subscription products. You will own the in-life subscriber lifecycle end to end, from onboarding and activation through retention, save offers, upsell, and winback, across web and mobile app surfaces that reach millions of subscribers. You will lead a team of product managers and work closely with marketing, engineering, design, and subscription strategy to set direction, run experiments, and ship work that directly protects and grows recurring revenue. You will report to the VP of Product - Commerce.

About the Team:

Our Technology team drives the evolution of our Technology, Engineering, Data, Product and User Experience functions. With a keen focus on delivering cutting-edge solutions, we shape the digital landscape for our customers, readers and users. From revolutionizing visuals to optimizing tools and harnessing the power of data, mobile, video and social platforms, our team is committed to providing a seamless and immersive experience across all touchpoints. Collaborating closely with our newsrooms and strategic partners, we spearhead the development of groundbreaking products and technologies.

You Will:

  • Work with marketing and subscription business stakeholders to define and execute the long-term product strategy for the in-life subscriber lifecycle across web and mobile app platforms

  • Lead and develop a team of product managers as a player-coach

  • Own prioritization and trade-offs across a complex multi-brand, multi-surface portfolio (WSJ, Barron's, MarketWatch; web and native mobile apps), driving alignment with engineering, design, marketing, data science, and senior leadership

  • Run a rigorous experimentation program, using A/B testing and funnel analysis to drive measurable outcomes across activation, engagement, save, and winback experiences.

  • Own the strategy for core retention systems and tooling 

  • Exhibit strong product judgment on high-impact decisions, balancing retention and revenue goals with subscriber experience and long-term brand health

You Have:

  • At least 8 years’ of product management experience with a focus on subscriber retention, engagement, subscription, or direct-to-consumer products

  • A track record of managing and developing product managers, including hiring, coaching, and performance management

  • Proven ability to use AI tools to improve the quality and velocity of your work, while coaching the people around you to do the same

  • Deep expertise in experimentation and data-driven decision making

  • Ability to engage in detailed discussions with engineering, understand subscription and messaging system architecture, and make product decisions informed by technical feasibility

  • A track record of influencing VP-level and above stakeholders and communicating product strategy, trade-offs, and business impact to executive audiences.

  • Knowledge of digital media and subscription businesses

job.title: Sales Director, North America - Storyful News & Video
job.description:
Job Description:

About Us

Storyful, a Dow Jones company and part of News Corp, is a global leader in verified social media news, video and intelligence. We help newsrooms, publishers, broadcasters, platforms and other media organizations understand what is happening across the social and digital landscape, with a focus on verified eyewitness content, rights-cleared video and trusted digital context.

About the Role

Storyful is hiring a Sales Director to lead growth for our core News & Video business in North America.

This is a senior player/coach role with ownership of a defined North America revenue target across Storyful Newswire subscriptions, including new business, renewals, retention, upsell and account expansion. The role is central to how Storyful grows its publisher, broadcaster and digital news customer base in one of our most important markets.

We are looking for someone who can combine disciplined sales execution with strong market judgement. Marketing will support broader awareness, campaign activity and sales enablement, but this role will be directly responsible for turning that activity into targeted account engagement, stakeholder mapping and commercial follow-through.

The right candidate will be credible with newsrooms and media organizations, comfortable navigating complex sales cycles, and able to position the value of verified eyewitness video in a market where speed, trust, rights, workflow value and audience relevance all matter.

While the immediate priority is disciplined growth in the core Newswire business, the role may also support selected video licensing opportunities where there is clear client demand.

Why This Role Matters

This is an opportunity to take ownership of a priority growth region for Storyful News & Video as well as leading the global team. The role sits at the intersection of Sales, Editorial, Marketing and Product, with scope to influence how Storyful engages the North American media market.

For a commercially driven seller, it offers a strong mix of account ownership, new business development, senior client engagement and input into targeted go-to-market strategy.

What You’ll Do

Core Newswire Growth

  • Own a defined North America revenue target across the Storyful Newswire customer and prospect base.

  • Drive new business, renewals, retention and upsell across publishers, broadcasters and digital news organisations.

  • Build and convert a high-quality pipeline through targeted outreach, account planning and structured follow-up.

job.title: Senior Compliance Analyst - Technology Operations
job.description:
Job Description:


About the Team:

Our Technology team drives the evolution of our Technology, Engineering, Data, Product and User Experience functions. With a keen focus on delivering cutting-edge solutions, we shape the digital landscape for our customers, readers and users. From revolutionizing visuals to optimizing tools and harnessing the power of data, mobile, video and social platforms, our team is committed to providing a seamless and immersive experience across all touchpoints. Collaborating closely with our newsrooms and strategic partners, we spearhead the development of groundbreaking products and technologies.



About the Role:

As Senior Compliance Analyst, you will help modernize how IT Compliance operates. You will own end-to-end execution across the IT SOX program and adjacent certifications (ISO, PCI, SOC 2), while helping build the next generation of compliance operating practices, moving from manual, email-based evidence collection toward AI-assisted workflows, automated controls testing, and consolidated cross-certification evidence. You will operate with high autonomy across a global, cross-functional program, running the day-to-day of one or more compliance workstreams while contributing directly to controls automation, evidence-request modernization, and the consolidation of certification cycles. You will report to the Director, IT SOX Compliance.



You Will:

  • Support execution across compliance workstreams, assisting with policy rollouts, training programs, and audit/certification cycles across IT SOX, ISO 27001, PCI-DSS, and SOC 2
  • Track compliance timelines and operational tasks, helping manage deadlines, evidence-request workflows, and status reporting to keep global audits on schedule
  • Coordinate with internal and external partners—including Legal, Risk, Finance, operational technology teams, internal/external auditors, and offshore testing partners—to facilitate evidence collection
  • Identify straightforward compliance issues, surfacing findings with context to leadership and assisting in tracking remediation efforts 
  • Promote compliance awareness across Technology squads, helping translate framework requirements into routine tasks that engineers and operators can execute
  • Support controls automation initiatives, working with leadership to identify repetitive testing workflows that can be modernized through automated and AI-assisted tools


You Have:

  • 2 to 4 years’ experience in IT compliance, audit, controls testing, or a related discipline within technology or enterprise environments
  • Foundational knowledge and practical experience supporting an audit cycle end-to-end under IT SOX, ISO 27001, PCI-DSS, or SOC 2 frameworks
  • Proven cross-functional coordination, comfortable partnering with Legal, Risk, Finance, Internal Audit, external auditors, and offshore testing teams simultaneously
  • Able to translate compliance framework language into operator-friendly tasks, and technical findings into executive-ready summaries
  • Ability to take a high-level objective and return a structured plan and shipped outcomes without extensive oversight
  • Hands-on comfort with automation, analytics, and modern productivity tools
  • Working understanding of how AI, automation, and intelligent workflows can reduce manual effort in compliance operations
  • Bias toward simplification, standardization, and continuous improvement

job.title: Senior Data Analyst - Dow Jones Energy Product Management
job.description:
Job Description:


About the Team:

Dow Jones Energy delivers trusted price transparency, benchmarks, analytics, news, and insights across the global energy, chemicals, metals, and fuel supply value chains. Our offerings support institutional investors, analysts, and traders navigating spot, wholesale, and retail markets, as well as emerging segments tied to the global energy transition.


Through authoritative data, real-time intelligence, and deep market expertise, Dow Jones Energy enables financial professionals to mitigate risk and make high-stakes commercial decisions in volatile, fast-evolving global markets.



About the Role:

This is an exciting time to join our small but growing Commercial Product Management team where you will be supporting a number of key sectors including: Energy & Feedstocks, Coal, Metals and Mining, Renewables & Clean Energy and Chemicals.


We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Senior Data Analyst to support business performance, revenue management, customer analytics, sales operations, product strategy, and executive decision-making. The position requires a combination of advanced Excel, SQL, Python, business intelligence, financial analysis, data visualization, and strong business judgment.


You will work across large and complex datasets to develop reporting, dashboards, analytical models, and actionable insights for product and leadership teams. You are comfortable working independently on ambiguous analytical problems, reconciling data from multiple sources, automating recurring processes, and communicating findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You will also serve as a key analytical partner to the Product, Sales, Finance, Customer Care, Consulting, and leadership teams. You will report to the Vice President - Product Management. 



You Will:
  • Commercial & Revenue Optimization: Own end-to-end reporting for the Book of Business (ACV, renewals, new business, win/loss), building bottoms-up financial models, scenario analyses, and churn diagnostics to drive pricing, budgeting, and revenue retention strategies
  • Advanced Data Engineering & SQL: Query, transform, and aggregate complex datasets across multiple source systems using optimized SQL to resolve data discrepancies and ensure unified, cross-system reporting integrity
  • Data Quality & Governance: Establish rigorous validation processes, data cleansing protocols, and repeatable quality assurance checks to maintain accuracy and reliability across all core business metrics
  • Business Intelligence & Dashboards: Design and maintain scalable, user-friendly Power BI/Looker Studio dashboards that deliver actionable visibility into product performance, sales activity, customer health, and financial KPIs for non-technical stakeholders
  • Process Automation & AI Integration: Streamline recurring workflows using SQL, Python, Excel/VBA, and Power Query, while exploring AI/BigQuery solutions to scale self-service analytics and reduce manual reporting dependencies
  • Customer & Usage Behavioral Analytics: Synthesize product adoption, API/web activity, and usage data into customer health scores and engagement metrics that empower Sales and Account Management teams to mitigate churn Risk
  • Product Portfolio Strategy: Conduct product performance and entitlement analyses to evaluate pricing packages, support new product launches, and inform portfolio optimization or sunsetting initiatives
  • Cross-Functional Stakeholder Partnership: Serve as a strategic analytics partner across Sales, Finance, Product, and executive leadership, effectively communicating complex methodologies and managing ad-hoc analytical priorities to guide business decisions



You Have:
  • 3+ years’ professional experience in data analytics, commercial analytics, financial analysis, market research, or a related analytical role
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel; including complex formulas, PivotTables, XLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, SUMIFS, nested logic, and data manipulation, VBA, Excel Macros, or Power Query
  • Experience with some or all of the following technologies:
    • Python (particularly Pandas and data analysis/automation)
    • BigQuery, Snowflake, SQL Server, Athena, or other cloud/data warehouse platforms
    • Power BI, Looker Studio, Tableau, or similar BI platforms
  • Experience with B2B data/information, industry analysis, and/or applied software products (highly desirable)
  • Domain knowledge in chemicals/energy or other related industry areas
  • An interest to pursue a career in product management and want to leverage your existing analytical skill set while deepening your product management capabilities and expertise
  • Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Finance, Business, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field -OR- equivalent work experience

job.title: Senior Personal Finance Editor - Loans & Credit Cards
job.description:
Job Description:

Job Description:


WSJ Buy Side is seeking an experienced senior editor with deep expertise in loans and credit cards, who can create engaging, accurate, and actionable coverage for consumers. In this role, you will help break down complex financial topics and empower readers to make informed decisions on loans and credit cards.

 

The ideal candidate has proven experience editing and writing about a variety of loan and credit card topics, working with large datasets, and developing data-driven methodologies that simplify consumer decision-making.

 

You should have experience reporting or editing on credit cards as well as key loan categories, including auto, business, personal, and student loans.

 

About Buy Side from WSJ:


Dow Jones’s reviews and recommendations site operates independently of The Wall Street Journal newsroom and is dedicated to helping consumers make smart decisions about how to spend their time and money.

 

About the Role:


As part of the Buy Side from WSJ editorial team, you will ensure content meets high standards of journalistic excellence and responsibly guides readers.

 

You Will:


  • Serve as Buy Side’s subject matter expert on loans and credit cards, staying ahead of industry trends and changes.
  • Edit and write high-quality articles on loans and credit card topics tailored to WSJ subscribers.
  • Manage credit cards compliance and make compliance updates as needed. 
  • Uphold rigorous editorial standards to deliver independent, unbiased reporting.
  • Ensure appropriate sourcing and oversee thorough fact-checking processes across the team.
  • Coach and mentor writers and editors to deepen their knowledge of loan products and credit cards.
  • Develop data-driven methodologies for evaluating loan products.
  • Coordinate data collection, fact-checking, and scoring for large datasets.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to develop best-in-class content.
  • Partner with editorial and commerce teams to plan future editorial lineups that resonate with the WSJ audience.
  • Maintain a deep understanding of the WSJ.com audience to ensure alignment with brand standards.
  • Identify and recommend linking opportunities to relevant WSJ news articles.

 

You Have:


  • 8+ years of personal finance reporting and editing experience.
  • In-depth understanding of the loans and credit card industries, including market trends, compliance and consumer concerns.
  • Experience creating data-driven methodologies to evaluate loans and credit card products.
  • A proven track record of managing and developing editorial teams.
  • Strong knowledge of SEO best practices and content optimization techniques.
  • Ability to deliver high-quality content consistently in a fast-paced, high-volume environment.
  • Strong ability to quickly identify structural or stylistic issues in copy and provide clear, constructive feedback and line edits.
  • Familiarity with affiliate revenue models and operations is preferred.
  • Prior experience on staff in a newsroom or major digital publication environment.

About the Team:

OPIS, a Dow Jones company, provides price transparency across the global fuel supply chain, including the Spot, Wholesale Rack and Retail markets. OPIS enables customers to buy and sell energy commodities with confidence with multi-platform access to accurate data, real-time news, powerful software and educational events. Our commitment to reliability is reinforced by personalized customer service and constant innovation. OPIS listens to what the energy community needs and responds with flexible and easy-to-use products. Navigating world fuel markets is complex – OPIS makes it simpler.

About the Role:

As Senior Editor for the U.S. export and global LPG market, you will be an important member of the Spots price reporting team across North America and Europe. You will engage with market contacts and sources to produce price assessments, analytics, and news for daily publication. You will also be a strong networker with a mindset for content creation and attention to detail. You will report to the North American Editorial Lead for LPG.

You Will:

  • Gather and verify market price data and transactions from traders, brokers, and exchanges

  • Publish accurate daily price assessments and market commentary adhering to IOSCO principles

  • Develop and maintain a network of market sources

  • Contribute to methodology development and updates as markets evolve

  • Work closely with the global team in the Americas, Europe, and Asia

  • Track and analyze export flows and shipping

  • Identify and explain trends in supply, demand, and pricing dynamics

  • Contribute to analytical reports, dashboards, and newsletters

  • Write clear, concise market reports, news stories, and analytical pieces

  • Participate in editorial meetings and collaborate with other reporters and analysts

  • Represent the organization at industry events, conferences, and webinars

  • Complete end-of-day operations for daily report publishing

You Have:

  • Minimum of three years’ reporting experience in commodities reporting, financial journalism, or environmental markets (preferred)

  • Strong communication, writing, and networking skills, with the ability to work under tight deadlines with accuracy and attention to detail

  • Knowledge of market dynamics, price drivers, and price reporting functions in the energy and/or shipping industry (a strong advantage) 

  • Ability to build relationships with market sources

  • Proficiency in Excel, market data platforms, and digital publishing tools

  • Bachelor’s degree in Economics, Finance, Energy, Journalism, related discipline -OR- equivalent work experience

  • Additional language proficiency will be beneficial (but not essential)
