job.title: Senior Sales Specialist, Risk & Compliance
job.description:
Job Description:


About the Team:

Dow Jones Risk & Compliance is a global provider of best-in-class risk data, technology solutions, due diligence and managed services for managing regulatory and reputational risk. For 20+ years, its market-leading data has helped financial institutions and businesses have greater control managing Financial Crime Compliance, Third Party Risk Management, Sanctions Compliance and Trade Compliance. With a global team of expert researchers covering more than 60 languages, Dow Jones applies the same rigor to its data that it has always brought to its journalism, offering the most accurate and complete risk datasets and solutions on the market.


About the Role:

We are seeking exceptional business development professionals to work in close partnership with the Risk & Compliance, Product and Marketing teams globally as well as the wider Dow Jones sales force. The Senior Sales Specialist, Dow Jones Risk & Compliance roles is responsible for managing the complete solutions sales cycle for Dow Jones Risk and Compliance suite or products and services, as well as coaching and mentoring sales counterparts through their sales process. The Senior Sales Specialist will drive new business revenue through any combination of the following activities:

  • Aggressively grow revenue for the R&C business across the region through new clients and by cross-selling/upselling existing ones
  • Own the sales process for the R&C product portfolio (including data, software, due diligence and managed services) alongside account management team
  • Attend conferences and participate as well as speak at industry events with regulators and thought leaders across the region
  • Educate peers and the wider sales team about Risk & Compliance market dynamics, competition, and develop effective positioning and reasons to call
  • Work with peers and the wider sales teams to devise and implement territory business plans in order to identify growth opportunities and retain business. 
  • Contribute to or lead the writing of any proposal, statement of work or technical document relating the products
  • Participate in, lead or coach the negotiation of terms, conditions, or price leading to closure of the contract
  • Devise and roll out business development sales campaigns across the region and key buying centers.
  • Other activities, tactics and behaviors as directed by sales management

You Will:

  • Have a minimum of 2 years experience in the Risk & Compliance Sales Specialist Role (or equivalent).
  • 10+ years of overall sales experience
  • Be an expert in the Dow Jones Risk & Compliance product suite.
  • Identify, qualify, develop and close new business for the entire Risk & Compliance product portfolio to achieve individual New Business Revenue and overall Group revenue goals.
  • Work closely with marketing management to ensure that events, PR, branding and communication supports sales objectives and execution plans.
  • Maintain robust relationships with external facilitators such as technology companies.
  • Maintain records of sales visits, appointments, contacts and sales campaigns in the global CRM to provide timely management information.
  • Educate peers and the sales team in developing and implementing both territory plans and individual strategic account plans to expand Dow Jones’ presence within the compliance & risk segment.
  • Contribute thought leadership around the strategic direction of the Risk & Compliance business on subjects such as brand, competitive positioning, value proposition, identifying new industry verticals and product roadmap.

You Have:

  • A thorough understanding of the Dow Jones Risk & Compliance solutions.
  • Experience in selling sophisticated, risk-related SaaS, data, or due diligence solutions. Technical expertise is a plus.
  • Experience in selling information and/or compliance tools to senior business decision makers.
  • Ability to drive new business opportunities within new prospects, as well as ability to upsell to existing Dow Jones customers within a team selling environment.
  • Strong understanding of customers’ issues.
  • Ability to maintain effectiveness when working closely with people of diverse cultures or backgrounds.
  • Ability to effectively handle multiple activities and reprioritize when necessary to ensure revenue goals are achieved.
  • Clear, concise communication and presentation skills.

job.title: Speaker and Programming Coordinator
job.description:
Job Description:


About the Team


Barron's Wealth & Asset Management Group harnesses the power of an elite community of the nation’s top financial advisors, who collectively manage $9 trillion and use our platforms to share best practices, insights, and strategies that have resulted in outstanding client outcomes. Our two-decade history of coveted advisor rankings sets the industry standard and serves as a valuable resource for advisors and investors alike. 


We host a series of invitation-only summits to help the most successful advisors further improve their practices. The summits convene the top 1% in the field, giving them the opportunity to share game plans for personal and professional growth. The W&AM (Barron’s Advisor) group also serves as a thought leader in the industry, helping advisors develop best practices, benchmark their own practices, and advance their development by pairing them with coaches.


 

About the Role


Barron’s Wealth & Asset Management Events


The Speaker & Programming Coordinator supports the Senior Director of Programming in the development and execution of Barron’s Wealth & Asset Management events, with primary responsibility for coordinating the speaker experience from confirmation through onsite execution and post-event follow-up. Speaker and program operations are the foundation of this role, complemented by content-support responsibilities such as research, drafting, editing, and preparation of program materials.


We are looking for a highly organized, proactive professional with exceptional follow-through, strong writing and research skills, and the judgment to work confidently with senior financial advisors, executives, and other high-profile speakers. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, can independently coordinate a large volume of speaker details across multiple events, and understands the distinction between responsibilities they own independently and programming or content decisions that require alignment and approval.



You Will:


  • Manage speaker coordination from confirmation through post-event follow-up, including communications, scheduling, deliverables, contracts, travel, AV requirements, special requests, and onsite support.
  • Proactively manage speaker timelines and deadlines across multiple events, accurately track details, and follow up without prompting.
  • Coordinate the Senior Director’s speaker and moderator calls, including scheduling, calendar invitations, agendas, background materials, reminders, notes, and follow-up.
  • Maintain accurate speaker records, program documents, databases, contracts, and planning systems.
  • Research speakers or topics assigned by the Senior Director and compile factual background for her review.
  • Review speaker proposals, presentations, and program materials for completeness, deadlines, and logistical needs; flag questions or concerns for the Senior Director.
  • Draft and edit session descriptions, speaker briefs, moderator questions, and other program materials using direction and source material provided by the Senior Director.
  • Work with production, editorial, sales, marketing, and other internal teams to ensure speaker and program requirements are met.
  • Provide onsite program support, including speaker check-in, mic and AV coordination, session readiness, and troubleshooting.
  • Manage assigned speaker operations independently. Refer speaker selections, invitations, session placements, and all substantive content or programming decisions to the Senior Director.

 

 

You Have:

  • Bachelor’s degree and 0–2 years of relevant professional experience in event programming, conferences, financial services, editorial, communications, marketing, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Exceptional organization, attention to detail, and follow-through, with the ability to manage a high volume of speakers, deadlines, and deliverables across multiple events.
  • Strong writing, editing, research, and critical-thinking skills.
  • A proactive working style, with the ability to anticipate needs, identify problems, and move logistical work forward with minimal oversight.
  • Sound judgment in managing logistics independently and referring speaker and content matters to the Senior Director.
  • A collaborative, team-oriented approach and the ability to work effectively within a small group and across departments.
  • Interest in financial services, wealth management, business, markets, or technology; relevant industry experience is preferred.
  • Comfort working across technology and project-management platforms; experience with Google Docs and Sheets, Cvent, HubSpot, or similar systems is a plus.
  • Ability and willingness to travel throughout the year.

job.title: Sr. Analyst, Strategy & Operations
job.description:
Job Description:


About the Team:

The Global Business Operations Strategy & Operations team is a dynamic, newly established function driving organizational clarity, operational efficiency, and execution across Dow Jones. Operating as a high-impact Center of Excellence (COE), this new team combines strategic execution—such as OKRs, operating cadences, dashboards—with process optimization. We map, redesign, and optimize end-to-end workflows to translate business pain points into strategic improvements, digital automation, and technology opportunities.

About the Role

The Senior Analyst sits within GBO Strategy & Operations and plays a key role in delivering operational performance, workflow optimization, and strategic alignment across the enterprise. As an early team member, you will have the unique chance to help establish our frameworks, playbooks, and service model from scratch.

This is fundamentally an analytical, diagnostic, and facilitation role—you will not be building technical systems directly, but you will own the process redesigns, operational diagnostics, metrics frameworks, and strategic handoffs that ensure initiatives deliver tangible business value.

In this role, you will operate across multiple intake channels: working directly on business unit operational requests, embedding within GBO PMO-led projects, supporting internal strategic planning and cadences, and partnering with Tech to translate future-state process designs into automation and AI blueprints.

You will report to the Director of Strategy & Operations and be based in our NYC office. 

You Will:

Process Optimization & Workflow Redesign

  • Lead structured working sessions, interviews, and observations to map current-state workflows, swimlanes, decision rights, and pain points across business units.

  • Redesign end-to-end processes to remove bottlenecks, eliminate friction, establish clear handoffs, and define explicit human-vs.-technology task allocation.

  • Evaluate business pain points to translate future-state designs into clear automation, technology, or AI recommendations; prepare handoff packages for Tech teams with recommendations

  • Conduct root-cause analysis, identify operational risks, and establish process baselines to frame improvement opportunities.

  • Audit existing platforms and prototype lightweight solutions—including experimenting with AI tools—to test feasibility and solve business problems before recommending tech builds.

  • Help build and scale Process Mapping templates, playbooks, and self-service enablement resources across Dow Jones.

Strategy & Operations Execution

  • Embed metric frameworks, establish baselines and support the development of dashboard to track performance and ROI (e.g., time savings, cost reduction, quality thresholds).

  • Support GBO program reporting, OKR tracking, and status dashboards to provide executive visibility into key initiatives.

  • Own execution of the Innovation Pairing Program, including administration of communications, meetings, and operating cadences to keep the program running and embed a culture of continuous improvement across GBO key partners.

  • Partner smoothly across Business Units, GBO PMO, Tech, and Organizational Development, and others to align process recommendations with broader strategic roadmaps, technical builds, and org design.

  • Facilitate and execute core GBO operational rhythms, including executive deck creation, quarterly all-hands coordination, leadership offsite planning, and weekly status updates.

You Have:

  • 3+ years of experience in Business Analysis, Process Optimization, Strategy & Ops, or Management Consulting in a technology-adjacent environment. 

  • Demonstrated experience writing business requirements documents, process maps, user stories, or functional specifications.

  • Exceptional facilitation and communication skills to drive cross-functional alignment, paired with enthusiasm for helping build a new team function from the ground up.

  • Hands-on experience with project tracking tools such as Jira and comfort working within established SDLC or agile delivery frameworks.

  • Experience with at least one AI or automation platform in a professional setting.

job.description:
Job Description:

Summer 2027 Internship – Marketing Data Science Intern

Application Deadline: November 13, 2027
We encourage you to submit your application as early as possible, as internship applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.

AMER Internship Dates: June 7, 2027 – August 13, 2027
(You must be available to work full-time, in-office during this period.)

About Our Internship Program:
Dow Jones Internship Program is a 10-week summer experience designed to give students real exposure to how . Our interns work on meaningful projects alongside our teams, gaining hands-on skills that make an impact on the business.

We believe the best way to learn is by doing — that’s why you’ll be paired with a mentor, connected with senior leaders, and included in professional development sessions. You’ll also join a diverse global intern community, sharing experiences and building networks that last beyond the program.

Our goal is to provide a supportive, engaging, and fun environment where your work feels valued and your growth comes first. Check out our Dow Jones Internship Program page to learn more and hear directly from past interns about their journeys. At Dow Jones, you’ll have the chance to start your career in an environment where collaboration, trust, and impact come first.

About the Role:
As a Marketing Data Science Intern, you will collaborate with experienced data scientists and marketing professionals to support data-driven strategies for optimizing marketing effectiveness. You will work on projects that involve building and enhancing predictive models, analyzing customer behavior, and supporting marketing optimization efforts across our product lines. This is an excellent opportunity to gain hands-on experience in advanced analytics, machine learning, and data-driven marketing strategies while contributing to high-impact business outcomes.

This role is hybrid, based in our NYC - 1211 Ave of the Americas City office.

You Will:
Support Predictive Modeling & Advanced Analytics: Assist in building and refining predictive models that forecast customer behaviors such as churn, lifetime value, and purchase propensity. Participate in data preparation, model training, and validation efforts.

Assist with Marketing Spend Analysis & Optimization: Work on media spend attribution models, help structure data for analysis, and assist in scenario planning for marketing optimization.

Data-Driven Insights: Support the analysis of large datasets to derive insights about customer segments, behavior patterns, and marketing performance. Contribute to personalizing marketing campaigns through data-driven insights.

Collaborate Across Teams: Work closely with marketing, sales, and product teams to understand their data needs. Help communicate data insights and recommendations to different stakeholders.

You Have:
-At least two years completed towards your Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.
-Familiar with programming languages such as Python, R, or SQL, and basic knowledge of data manipulation and visualization tools like Tableau or Looker.
-Interest in predictive modeling, machine learning, and data-driven marketing strategies.
-Strong interest in digital marketing, with a focus on acquisition strategies.
-Familiarity with digital marketing platforms such as Google, Meta or TikTok
-Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data and draw meaningful conclusions.
-Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
-Creativity and willingness to contribute ideas to marketing campaigns.

Program Eligibility: 
Enrollment in a 4-year undergraduate degree program
Graduating in Dec 2027 – July 2029 (U.S.)  
Does not require sponsorship for employment visa status (now or in the future) in the country where applying.

About Dow Jones:
Dow Jones is a global provider of news and business information, delivering content to consumers and organizations around the world across multiple formats, including print, digital, mobile and live events. Dow Jones has produced unrivaled quality content for more than 130 years and today has one of the world’s largest newsgathering operations globally.

It is home to leading publications and products including the flagship Wall Street Journal, America’s largest newspaper by paid circulation; Barron’s, MarketWatch, Mansion Global, Financial News, Dow Jones Risk & Compliance and Dow Jones Newswires. Dow Jones is a division of News Corp (Nasdaq: NWS, NWSA; ASX: NWS, NWSLV).

job.description:
Job Description:

Summer 2027 Internship – Brand Intern

Application Deadline: November 13, 2027
We encourage you to submit your application as early as possible, as internship applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.

AMER Internship Dates: June 7, 2027 – August 13, 2027
(You must be available to work full-time, in-office during this period.)

We believe the best way to learn is by doing — that’s why you’ll be paired with a mentor, connected with senior leaders, and included in professional development sessions. You’ll also join a diverse global intern community, sharing experiences and building networks that last beyond the program.
Our goal is to provide a supportive, engaging, and fun environment where your work feels valued and your growth comes first. Check out our Dow Jones Internship Program page to learn more and hear directly from past interns about their journeys. At Dow Jones, you’ll have the chance to start your career in an environment where collaboration, trust, and impact come first.

About the Role:
We’re seeking a Brand Design Intern to join our Marketing team. In this hands-on role, you’ll help create new brand identities and support cohesive design experiences across digital, print, and spatial touchpoints. You’ll work with senior designers on projects spanning multiple brands—including The Wall Street Journal, WSJ Events, MarketWatch, Barron’s, IBD, and other Dow Jones companies.

This role is ideal for someone resourceful, proactive, and eager to learn in a fast-paced environment. You’ll gain exposure to high-visibility projects while also rolling up your sleeves on the essential day-to-day tasks that keep brand systems running.

As a Brand Design Intern, you will:
Assist in creating new brand identities from the ground up (logos, color palettes, typography, art direction) and brand guides, moodboards, and toolkits to communicate with stakeholders, partners, and brand ambassadors.
Support senior designers on projects that deliver full brand experiences, including:
Visual concepts and mockups
Digital and media assets (emails, ads, landing pages, digital signage, social graphics campaign collateral, podcast art)
Print and spatial applications (event materials, invitations, onsite design recommendations)
Help build and maintain design systems (typography, composition, hierarchy, color theory, etc.) in Figma, including templates, guidelines, and scalable components.
Collaborate across teams to ensure design consistency across multiple channels and formats.
Conduct competitive research to spot trends, best practices, and opportunities for brand differentiation.
Translate research findings into clear insights that guide creative strategy.

You Have:
Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, or a related field.
Strong knowledge of digital design principles and fundamentals;
Proficiency in Figma (or similar tools such as Sketch, Adobe Creative Suite).
Strong attention to detail and the ability to produce polished, professional work.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment with shifting priorities.
Resourceful, self-driven, and proactive—able to ask the right questions and seek solutions independently.
Open to feedback and eager to learn.
Some knowledge of UI/UX, animation, or print is a plus, but not required.

Program Eligibility: 
Enrollment in a 4-year undergraduate degree program
Graduating in Dec 2027 – July 2029 (U.S.)  
Does not require sponsorship for employment visa status (now or in the future) in the country where applying.

About the Role:
The Strategy & Data Intern will be embedded within the Commercial Strategy Team, supporting initiatives that improve global data visibility, enhance reporting frameworks, and enable structured growth planning.Dow Jones Energy is strengthening its global commercial strategy capabilities , consolidating commercial data, improving process scalability, and leveraging AI to enable smarter decision-making. This role sits at the center of those efforts.

This is a hands-on analytical role focused on turning complex commercial data into actionable insight and scalable processes, not an observational one. You will contribute to real initiatives that influence how Dow Jones Energy allocates resources, prioritizes markets, and makes strategic decisions.

Global Data Consolidation & Commercial Intelligence: Consolidate and structure commercial and customer data across regions and segments. Analyze the global book of business to identify growth opportunities, whitespace, cross-sell potential, and retention risk. Build dashboards and reporting tools to support strategic prioritization. Support segmentation and account planning initiatives.

Process Optimization & Standardization: Map and evaluate current commercial reporting workflows. Identify inefficiencies and propose scalable process improvements. Support development of standardized performance tracking frameworks.

AI & Automation Enablement: Identify opportunities to leverage AI tools to streamline reporting and analysis. Pilot automation solutions for recurring commercial insights. Support documentation of AI-enabled best practices for broader team adoption.

Strategic Planning Support: Assist in preparing executive-ready strategy materials. Translate complex datasets into clear, actionable recommendations. Support quarterly and annual commercial planning cycles.

Responsibilities:
Direct exposure to global commercial strategy and senior leadership at a leading information businessHands-on experience supporting real strategic initiatives with measurable business impact
Practical exposure to AI-driven workflow improvement and automation in a live commercial environmentDeep familiarity with how global commodity markets
Experience building dashboards, frameworks, and tools adopted and used by the broader commercial team
Mentorship from experienced strategy and analytics professionals working across global markets
A strong foundation for careers in strategy, analytics, consulting, or commercial leadership

You Have:
Completed at least 2 years of undergraduate studies.
Strong analytical and quantitative skills, comfortable working with large, complex datasets and drawing structured conclusions
Advanced Excel proficiency; experience with Power BI, Tableau, SQL, or Python is a plus
Structured thinker with sharp attention to detail, you build logical, well-organized outputs from ambiguous inputs
Genuinely curious about AI and how automation can improve business processes
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex analysis into clear, executive-ready narratives
Interest in energy markets, B2B commercial strategy, or financial services

job.title: The Wall Street Journal Visual Investigations Internship (Summer 2027)
job.description:
Job Description:


The Wall Street Journal internship program is an opportunity primarily for college juniors to work with our award-winning data and visual investigations teams in New York. Graduate students enrolled in a degree program by the application deadline – October 31– who are returning to school in the fall are also eligible to apply. Graduating seniors should apply to WSJ News Associates.


Applicants should be excited at the prospect of scraping poorly formed websites, reviewing massive datasets, analyzing satellite imagery, geolocating and chronolocating videos and photos, and digging through public records, including FOIA requests. You will have the opportunity to pitch editorially strong visual journalism, which may include data-driven interactives, maps, charts and explanatory graphics, as well as help experiment with AI-powered reporting workflows.


You will:

Contribute reporting, data analysis, open-source reporting and visual verification to ambitious investigative projects and quicker-turn visual stories. 

Work cross-functionally with reporters and editors across the newsroom

Be immersed in audience-first visual storytelling that aims to reveal critical information through maps, video, satellite imagery, and interactive graphics. 

Gain hands-on experience analyzing large datasets and utilizing open-source intelligence (OSINT) to verify digital evidence and uncover hidden truths while maintaining rigorous editorial standards.


You have:

An analytical approach to journalism, with experience cleaning, analyzing, and visualizing data to support reporting. 

The ability to scrape and mold unstructured data using tools like Python, R and SQL. 

Familiarity with JavaScript, D3.js, 3D modeling, animation, video editing and open-source reporting techniques such as geolocation, video and photo verification is a significant bonus.

Completed at least one prior reporting internship with another professional media organization or published exceptional data or visual or open-source investigative  work with a campus news outlet or as a freelancer.


You should be a self-starter with a collaborative mindset who understands the needs of our audience across multiple platforms and is able to work independently under deadline pressure. Dedication to high journalistic standards and excellent reporting skills are required. A demonstrated interest in business reporting is a plus, though prior business/finance reporting experience is not required.


HOW TO APPLY:

Please upload one PDF document (max. 5MB). Your application should contain:


  • A cover letter that highlights why you would be an asset to that desk. 
  • Your résumé.

job.title: Vice President - Head of Consulting (Dow Jones Energy)
job.description:
Job Description:


About the Team:

Dow Jones Energy delivers trusted price transparency, benchmarks, analytics, news, and insights across the global energy, chemicals, metals, and fuel supply value chains. Our offerings support institutional investors, analysts, and traders navigating spot, wholesale, and retail markets, as well as emerging segments tied to the global energy transition.


Through authoritative data, real-time intelligence, and deep market expertise, Dow Jones Energy enables financial professionals to mitigate risk and make high-stakes commercial decisions in volatile, fast-evolving global markets.



About the Role:

As Vice President - Head of Consulting, you will lead Dow Jones Energy’s bespoke solutions business across both public and private sector markets — owning its strategy, proposition, commercial performance, and external profile. In this role, you will combine commercial leadership with operational rigor and a strong external presence, scaling a professional services practice that translates the analytical depth of Dow Jones Energy data and insights into high-impact engagements for corporate, government, and multilateral clients. You will report to the Senior Vice President - Head of Research, Consulting & Community.



You Will:
  • Design and execute the growth strategy for the Energy Consulting business, setting clear commercial, brand, and delivery targets
  • Ensure the consulting team meets or exceeds business development and growth targets
  • Drive the evolution and scaling of the consulting practice — its operating model, talent and delivery capabilities
  • Own the business with a relentless focus on customer value, output quality, business margin, expert utilization, and delivery efficiency across every engagement
  • Design, champion, and continuously evolve the Energy Consulting value proposition, articulating differentiated offerings that capitalize on Dow Jones Energy’s expertise across energy, chemicals and resources, as well as the broader Dow Jones capability suite
  • Serve as a senior external face of the business — representing Dow Jones Energy on stage, on air, and in print to shape how clients and the broader market understand global energy and chemical market dynamics
  • Partner with Sales, Marketing, Product, Research and Community leadership within Dow Jones Energy to translate our analytical depth into commercially successful consulting engagements
  • Support business development and consulting operations with travel to all regions up to 40% of time 



You Have:
  • 20+ years’ experience in the energy, chemical, or commodity consulting space
  • A track record of leading an advisory business of $20M+ in revenue with full P&L accountability and proven topline and margin growth
  • Experience presenting at industry conferences on panels and to groups of c-suite decision makers
  • Proven experience scaling a professional services business — building delivery models, talent pipelines, and operating discipline that enable durable, profitable growth
  • Experience delivering advisory work for both public sector (government, defense, multilateral) and private sector (corporate, financial) clients
  • Knowledge of and familiarity with key players and competitors in the energy and chemical consulting space
  • Demonstrated ability to lead and influence cross-functional teams
  • History of successful stakeholder management at executive levels

job.description:
Job Description:


About the Role:

As Vice President - Head of Marketing for the Energy business, you will define the marketing strategy and plan to support the business’ strategic growth initiatives. You will act as the primary marketing partner to the General Managers and Senior Leaders and lead product marketing efforts to define value propositions and points of differentiation by market segment, while maximizing the outcomes and success of lead generation campaigns. You will orchestrate a unified, data-driven marketing ecosystem that optimizes the entire client lifecycle. You will report to the Executive Vice President - General Manager, Dow Jones Energy.

About the Team:

Dow Jones Energy delivers trusted price transparency, benchmarks, analytics, news, and insights across the global energy, chemicals, metals, and fuel supply value chains. Our offerings support institutional investors, analysts, and traders navigating spot, wholesale, and retail markets, as well as emerging segments tied to the global energy transition.

Through authoritative data, real-time intelligence, and deep market expertise, Dow Jones Energy enables financial professionals to mitigate risk and make high-stakes commercial decisions in volatile, fast-evolving global markets.

You Will:

  • Lead a centralized direct marketing organization for the Energy product suite: OPIS, CMA, PCW, A2i, Ecomovement

  • Act as a key partner to the GM and Business Leaders to ensure marketing activities and resources support the business’ strategic initiatives and are optimized for effectiveness

  • Define the marketing strategy, roles, and resources needed to support Industries’ growth and target areas of opportunity as the Energy product suite evolves 

  • Leverage customer feedback and market research to inform and prioritize plans

  • Define value propositions for product offerings for different markets and end users

  • Coordinate and prioritize marketing initiatives by client types and market segments to achieve sales and retention targets 

  • Collaborate with different teams within the central marketing organization to execute and optimize paid media, online presence, and event-related activities for target market segments

  • Align closely with respective Sales leaders and organizations to optimize quality, pipeline velocity, and closed-won outcomes

  • Track and measure lifecycle impact of leads through to closed won/lost opportunities

  • Establish a performance dashboard to monitor daily KPIs, diagnose bottlenecks, and optimize resource allocation

  • Manage and coordinate online presence and positioning for different products and different market segments to maximize awareness

  • Lead exploration and testing of different channels for promoting awareness and engaging customers

  • Collaborate with other marketing leaders and teams of B2B products within Dow Jones 

You Have:

  • At least 15 years’  B2B marketing experience within technology, energy/commodities, financial information services, or media/publishing 

  • Extensive experience working with Sales organizations in leading product and account-based marketing activities and lead generation campaigns

  • Experience with recurring revenue/subscription revenue models and one-off events models

  • Deep understanding of paid media, content marketing, thought leadership, events, digital/online presence, and branding 

  • Familiarity with AI-driven analytics, reporting technologies, subscription intelligence platforms, and enterprise SaaS solutions

  • Experience working in or leading a centralized marketing model 

  • Strong background in managing significant marketing budgets with a focus on high-impact resource allocation and cost-efficiency

  • Ability to act as a trusted advisor to General Managers and Business Leaders

job.title: Video Journalist
job.description:
Job Description:


About the Role:

 

The Video Journalist will create videos for MarketWatch and Barron’s that explain business news, markets, and personal finance topics with clarity, creativity, and personality — from quick turnarounds to longer in depth explainers to documentary-style features. You’ll be a hands-on storyteller who can take an idea from concept to publish: scripting, shooting, and editing your own work with a sharp sense of what performs on YouTube. You will also work with other team members to produce, shoot or edit across other projects as well. 

 

You Will:

 

- Research, pitch, write and produce original short and long form video stories about business, personal finance, markets, technology, and the economy.

- Conduct interviews and write scripts that explain complex financial ideas in a clear, engaging and relatable way.

- Shoot and edit videos, managing everything from lighting and framing to post-production.

- Work closely with the Senior Director of Video to refine story structure, visuals, and editorial accuracy.

- Adapt content for multiple formats — YouTube explainers, on site clips, and social/vertical video.

- Incorporate graphics and data to help audiences visualize trends and financial concepts.

- Collaborate across teams to optimize reach and engagement.

- Use and report on analytics to understand what drives performance and apply insights to future projects.

- Appear on camera as needed to host videos.


You Have:

 

- 3-5 years of experience producing, shooting, and editing video and producing journalism in video, audio or print. 

- Proven track record of YouTube success.

- Demonstrated experience producing compelling news, explainer, documentary and character driven videos.

- Strong journalistic skills, including but not limited to: story ideation, research, fact-checking, sourcing experts and real people, interviewing subjects and experts, and sifting through and understanding data to produce compelling videos.

- A good understanding of business/finance news and current affairs.

- Ability to produce, shoot and edit both documentary on location videos and in-studio interviews.

- Skilled with multiple camera setups, including but not limited to the Sony FS7, A7S and multiple lighting setups.

- Professional competency editing with Adobe Premiere and using or creating professional graphics utilizing After Effects, Photoshop and Illustrator.

- Academic coursework in journalism (whether in undergrad or graduate school) is preferred.

- On camera experience is a plus.

job.title: Director, Business Development
job.description:
Who We Are:

TKO Group Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: TKO) is a premium sports and entertainment company. TKO owns iconic properties including UFC, the world’s premier mixed martial arts organization; WWE, the global leader in sports entertainment; and PBR, the world’s premier bull riding organization. Together, these properties reach 1 billion households across 210 countries and territories and organize more than 500 live events year-round, attracting more than three million fans. TKO also services and partners with major sports rights holders through IMG, an industry-leading global sports marketing agency; and On Location, a global leader in premium experiential hospitality.

The Role and What You’ll Do:

TKO Global Partnerships is looking for a driven, relationship-first sales executive to join one of the most dynamic commercial teams in sports and entertainment. As a Director of Sales, you will own new business development across UFC and/or WWE — two of the most recognized and emotionally powerful properties on the planet — delivering partnership and sponsorship solutions that create genuine value for brands, their agencies, and their customers.

This is a role for a closer who thrives in a consultative environment, builds trust quickly at the executive level, and knows how to turn a first conversation into a multi-year, seven-figure partnership. You will be on the front lines of revenue generation for TKO, prospecting aggressively, presenting compellingly, and delivering results that consistently exceed targets.

  • Build and manage a robust pipeline of qualified brand and agency prospects large enough to meet — and beat — your financial goals
  • Drive new business revenue through the sale of UFC and WWE media, sponsorship, and integrated partnership assets
  • Leverage deep knowledge of and relationships across the brand and agency landscape to identify and accelerate revenue opportunities
  • Understand client marketing objectives inside and out, and translate those needs into tailored UFC and WWE partnership solutions with clear, compelling value propositions
  • Guide clients from initial pitch through contract close, onboarding, and long-term strategic account growth
  • Host clients and prospects at UFC and WWE live events, creating immersive brand experiences that deepen relationships and accelerate deal cycles
  • Explore creative packaging and upsell opportunities, including co-sell structures with TKO's media distribution partners
  • Accurately forecast revenue, proactively identify risks, and bring solutions — not just problems
  • Contribute ideas that elevate the broader team's performance and reinforce TKO Global Partnerships as the premier destination for brand investment in sports and entertainment 

You Have These:

  • 10+ years of revenue development experience with a focus on partnership and sponsorship sales, ideally in sports, media, or entertainment
  • Proven track record closing six- and seven-figure deals with Fortune 500 brands and/or senior agency decision makers
  • Deep understanding of the sports sponsorship and media landscape — the players, the trends, the terminology, and the deals that matter
  • A hunter's mentality paired with a relationship-builder's instincts — you're equally comfortable cold-opening a C-suite conversation and deepening a decade-long partnership
  • Strong consultative selling skills with the ability to build custom solutions, not just pitch off a rate card
  • Robust analytical capability, including market strategy development and value-based selling
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills — you present with authority and follow up with precision
  • Highly organized with sharp attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple opportunities simultaneously
  • Advanced negotiation skills and the confidence to navigate complex, multi-stakeholder deals
  • Motivated by a rewarding, performance-based compensation structure
  • Flexibility to work evenings, weekends, and holidays as dictated by the live event calendar
  • Ability to be based in or work across New York City and Stamford, CT
  • Willingness and ability to travel regularly to support client and prospect engagement
  • Bachelor's degree required

Per local requirements and in the interest of transparency, the hourly rate shown below reflects the prevalent current hiring range for this position. Hiring pay rates are based on a number of factors, including location and may vary depending on job-related qualifications, knowledge, skills and experience. The company strives to provide locally competitive rewards packages, which include base rate along with, as applicable, short- and long-term incentives, growth and developmental opportunities, and robust benefits, such as health care, retirement, vacation and other paid time off, and additional offerings.

Hiring Rate Minimum:

$123,750 annually(minimum will not fall below the applicable State/local minimum salary thresholds)

Hiring Rate Maximum:

$165,000 annually

job.title: Project Manager
job.description:
Who We Are:

WWE® is the global leader in sports entertainment. The company creates and delivers original content 52 weeks a year to a global audience. WWE is committed to family-friendly entertainment on its television programming, Premium Live Events, digital media, and publishing platforms. WWE's TV-PG programming can be seen in more than 1 billion households worldwide in more than 20 languages through world-class distribution partners including Netflix, ESPN, NBCUniversal, USA Network and The CW. WWE is part of TKO Group Holdings (NYSE: TKO). Additional information on WWE can be found at wwe.com and corporate.wwe.com. TKO Group Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: TKO) is a premium sports and entertainment company. TKO owns iconic properties including UFC, the world’s premier mixed martial arts organization; WWE, the global leader in sports entertainment; and PBR, the world’s premier bull riding organization. Together, these properties reach 1 billion households across 210 countries and territories and organize more than 500 live events year-round, attracting more than three million fans. TKO also services and partners with major sports rights holders through IMG, an industry-leading global sports marketing agency; and On Location, a global leader in premium experiential hospitality.

Position Summary

The Project Manager is responsible for managing the flow of creative work from intake through final delivery across a high-volume, fast-paced environment supporting the AAA brand. This role coordinates creative requests, licensing submission support, merchandise initiatives, talent-related projects, logo development, and related brand deliverables across internal teams and external partners.


This position serves as a key operational partner to Creative, helping projects move efficiently from concept through completion while ensuring alignment on priorities, timelines, approvals, budgets, and deliverable requirements. The Project Manager works closely with designers, creative leads, licensing, merchandise, talent, marketing, production partners, and other stakeholders to keep work organized, on track, and executed to a high standard.


Key Responsibilities

Project Management & Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Establish and maintain strong working relationships across AAA and related business functions, including Creative, Licensing, Consumer Products, Merchandise, Talent, Marketing, Communications, Digital, Production, and other stakeholders.
  • Manage projects through all phases of the creative, approval, licensing, and production process to ensure timelines, budget requirements, and job specifications are met.
  • Coordinate project intake, timelines, milestones, deliverables, and approvals across multiple concurrent assignments, ensuring clear communication and accountability at every stage.
  • Partner closely with designers and creative leads to define project scope, deliverable requirements, production approaches, and workflow needs.
  • Maintain clear project documentation, status updates, schedules, and action items so stakeholders have visibility into priorities, next steps, risks, and dependencies.
  • Keep current with AAA programming, talent, events, brand priorities, merchandise needs, and business objectives to support informed planning and effective project coordination.

AAA Creative & Brand Support

  • Manage the intake and coordination of creative requests supporting the AAA brand across marketing, digital, social, events, merchandise, talent, licensing, and other business needs.
  • Help translate stakeholder requests into clear creative briefs, project plans, timelines, and deliverable lists.
  • Coordinate the development and review of AAA brand assets, including campaign creative, promotional materials, merchandise graphics, talent-related creative, logos, and other visual applications.
  • Partner with creative leads to ensure work is aligned with approved brand direction, usage requirements, project scope, and stakeholder expectations.
  • Track feedback and approvals, consolidate comments, and help drive timely decisions across internal teams and external partners.
  • Identify potential creative, operational, or approval issues early and help develop practical solutions that protect quality and delivery timelines.

Licensing Submission Support

  • Coordinate the preparation, organization, and routing of creative materials required for licensing submissions and approvals.
  • Maintain submission trackers, deadlines, asset requirements, status updates, and approval records for active licensing projects.
  • Partner with Licensing, Creative, Merchandise, Legal, and other stakeholders to confirm that submissions are complete, accurate, properly formatted, and delivered on time.
  • Help manage revisions, comments, and follow-up requests throughout the licensing review process.
  • Maintain organized records of approved assets, supporting materials, and final submission files.

Merchandise, Talent & Logo Development

  • Support project management for AAA merchandise initiatives from initial request through concept development, review, approval, production, and final delivery.
  • Coordinate creative needs related to talent, including asset requests, approvals, usage considerations, and time-sensitive deliverables.
  • Help organize and manage logo development projects, including creative briefs, exploratory concepts, review rounds, approvals, final files, and usage documentation.
  • Coordinate with designers, merchandise partners, talent representatives, licensing stakeholders, and vendors to keep projects moving and expectations aligned.
  • Track project-specific requirements, including artwork specifications, product applications, talent or partner approvals, production deadlines, and final deliverables.

Production Support & Execution

  • Obtain estimates and help secure vendors based on quality, cost, service, and turnaround time when outside production support is needed.
  • Interface with external vendors and production partners, staying current with industry practices and helping resolve production-related issues quickly and effectively.
  • Coordinate print, digital, merchandise, event, and other production deliverables as assigned.
  • Address potential production or execution issues before they impact delivery, helping teams stay ahead of risks and maintain momentum.
  • Help ensure final deliverables are produced accurately, on brand, on time, and within scope across a range of creative applications.

Workflow Optimization & AI-Enabled Organization

  • Use AI tools and workflow systems in practical ways to improve request intake, job organization, task tracking, status visibility, and overall project efficiency across the team.
  • Help the team adopt new tools and ways of working that improve project tracking, communication, and operational clarity without disrupting creative quality or delivery.
  • Support stronger visibility into project progress, next steps, approvals, and resource needs by maintaining accurate timelines, updates, and tracking systems.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify recurring processes, improve documentation, and create greater consistency across AAA creative workflows.

Qualifications

  • Fluency in Spanish is required.
  • Minimum of 4 years of experience in project management within an agency, in-house creative department, design studio, entertainment company, sports property, consumer products organization, licensing environment, or related fast-paced creative setting.
  • Thorough knowledge of creative project and production management principles and practices, with working knowledge of print, digital, merchandise, and brand asset workflows.
  • Proven experience establishing and maintaining schedules, budgets, approvals, and deliverables for multiple concurrent, deadline-driven projects through all phases of design, review, licensing, and production.
  • Experience supporting licensing submissions, merchandise creative, talent-related projects, logo development, or other brand asset development is strongly preferred.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, and project tracking or workflow management tools; familiarity with AI-assisted productivity tools is a plus.
  • Bachelor’s degree preferred.
  • Excellent organizational, negotiation, communication, and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong interpersonal skills, including the ability to communicate effectively and persuasively with a wide range of internal and external partners.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, stay detail-oriented, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment.
  • Reliable, punctual, self-directed, and flexible in responding to changing priorities and business needs.
  • A collaborative, solutions-oriented approach and a strong interest in supporting the AAA brand through thoughtful, organized, and high-quality creative execution.
